import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBuilding, faFloppyDisk, faSitemap, faUserGroup, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
interface AreaModalOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companyOptions = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    ruc: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{11}$/)]],
    razonSocial: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(200)]],
    nombreComercial: ['', [Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)]],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: [''],
    numeroPartida: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(120)]],
  });

  openCompany(detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(options: AreaModalOptions, area: Area | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({ emitEvent: false });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }
    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }
    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = this.areaForm.getRawValue().empresaId;
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;
    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        area.areaId !== currentAreaId &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') return 'Detalle de organización';
    const editing = Boolean(this.kind() === 'area' ? this.currentArea() : this.currentCompany());
    if (this.kind() === 'association') return editing ? 'Editar asociación' : 'Registrar asociación';
    if (this.kind() === 'area') return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') return this.associationIcon;
    if (this.kind() === 'area') return this.areaIcon;
    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;
    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null);

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: company?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: company?.correo ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[company ? 'disable' : 'enable']({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.companyForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: values.razonSocial.trim(),
      nombreComercial: values.nombreComercial.trim() || undefined,
      telefono: values.telefono.trim() || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: values.referencia.trim() || undefined,
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(current.empresaId, {
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion: values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: values.numeroPartida.trim() || undefined,
          })
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc: values.ruc.trim(),
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion: values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: values.numeroPartida.trim() || undefined,
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(current.empresaId, common)
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({ ruc: values.ruc.trim(), ...common });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current ? 'Asociación actualizada' : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current ? 'Empresa actualizada' : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo guardar la organización', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(`AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`, values.nombre, 30),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const areaPadreId = Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
      ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
      : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: values.nombre.trim(),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: values.nombre.trim(),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo guardar el área', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.resetState();
  }
}
```

<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div
    class="modal-box admin-modal-box"
    [class.admin-modal-box--wide]="kind() === 'view'"
  >
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="icon()" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Organizaciones</p>
          <h2>{{ title() }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    @if (kind() === 'view' && detail(); as organizationDetail) {
      <div class="organization-view">
        <section class="organization-summary">
          <div>
            <span>Razón social</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.razonSocial }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>RUC</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.ruc }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Tipo</span>
            <strong>
              {{ organizationDetail.organizacion.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Correo</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.correo || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Teléfono</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.telefono || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Nombre comercial</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.nombreComercial || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Distrito</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.distritoNombre || organizationDetail.distritoCodigo }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Centro poblado</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.centroPobladoNombre || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Referencia</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.referencia || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Áreas</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.areas.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (area of organizationDetail.areas; track area.areaId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ area.nombre }}</strong>
                  <small>{{ area.codigo }}</small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay áreas registradas.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Empleados activos</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.empleados.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (employee of organizationDetail.empleados; track employee.empleadoId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ employee.empleado }}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {{ employee.numeroDocumento || 'Sin documento' }}
                    ·
                    {{ employee.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}
                  </small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay empleados activos.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cerrar
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    } @else if (kind() === 'area') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="areaForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="areaCompany">Organización</label>
          <select
            id="areaCompany"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="empresaId"
          >
            @for (option of companyOptions(); track option.value) {
              <option [value]="option.value">{{ option.label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="areaForm.controls.empresaId"
            fieldLabel="La organización"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="areaParent">Área superior</label>
          <select
            id="areaParent"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="areaPadreId"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Sin área superior</option>
            @for (area of areasForSelectedCompany(); track area.areaId) {
              <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="areaName">Nombre</label>
          <input
            id="areaName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="nombre"
            maxlength="120"
            placeholder="Nombre del área"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="areaForm.controls.nombre"
            fieldLabel="El nombre"
          />
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="companyForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationRuc">RUC</label>
          <input
            id="organizationRuc"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="ruc"
            inputmode="numeric"
            maxlength="11"
            placeholder="11 dígitos"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.ruc"
            fieldLabel="El RUC"
            [messages]="{ pattern: 'Ingresa un RUC válido de 11 dígitos.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="businessName">Razón social</label>
          <input
            id="businessName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="razonSocial"
            maxlength="200"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.razonSocial"
            fieldLabel="La razón social"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="tradeName">Nombre comercial</label>
          <input
            id="tradeName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="nombreComercial"
            maxlength="160"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationPhone">Teléfono</label>
          <input
            id="organizationPhone"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="telefono"
            maxlength="30"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationEmail">Correo</label>
          <input
            id="organizationEmail"
            class="admin-input"
            type="email"
            formControlName="correo"
            maxlength="180"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.correo"
            fieldLabel="El correo"
          />
        </div>

        <app-geography-cascade
          [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
          [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
        />

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo"
            fieldLabel="El distrito"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
          <input
            id="organizationReference"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="referencia"
            maxlength="300"
            placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia"
          />
        </div>

        @if (kind() === 'association') {
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="foundationDate">Fecha de constitución</label>
            <input
              id="foundationDate"
              class="admin-input"
              type="date"
              formControlName="fechaConstitucion"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="registryNumber">Número de partida</label>
            <input
              id="registryNumber"
              class="admin-input"
              type="text"
              formControlName="numeroPartida"
              maxlength="50"
            />
          </div>
        }

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    }
  </div>
</dialog>

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260905_155619_282113\src\app\features\administracion\empleados\adapter\in\ui\pages\empleado-form\empleado-form.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260905_155619_282113/src/app/features/administracion/empleados/adapter/in/ui/pages/empleado-form/empleado-form.ts`

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faUserPlus, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import { Empleado, EmpleadoDetalle, TipoDocumentoEmpleado } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';

interface EmployeeFormOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoEmpleado;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipoDocumento: ['DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado, [Validators.required]],
    numeroDocumento: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    nombres: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    apellidoPaterno: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    apellidoMaterno: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    fechaNacimiento: [''],
    distritoCodigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)]],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigoEmpleado: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required]],
    areaId: [0],
    cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    fechaAsignacionArea: [''],
  });

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? employee as EmpleadoDetalle
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null);

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: (employee?.tipoDocumento as TipoDocumentoEmpleado) || 'DNI',
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: employee?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: employee?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: employee?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId: employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);
    return this.areas().filter((area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado);
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
        buildSystemCode('EMP', this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value, 30),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: values.numeroDocumento.trim(),
      nombres: values.nombres.trim(),
      apellidoPaterno: values.apellidoPaterno.trim(),
      apellidoMaterno: values.apellidoMaterno.trim() || undefined,
      telefono: values.telefono.trim() || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: Number(values.areaId) > 0 ? Number(values.areaId) : undefined,
      cargo: values.cargo.trim() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: values.referencia.trim() || undefined,
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea: values.fechaAsignacionArea || undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(current ? 'Empleado actualizado' : 'Empleado registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado' : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

export type TipoDocumentoProductor = 'DNI' | 'CE' | 'PASAPORTE' | 'OTRO';
export type SituacionMembresia = 'ACTIVO' | 'SUSPENDIDO';

export interface ProductorUbicacionInput {

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faUserPlus, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-productor.use-case';
import { EditarProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-productor.use-case';
import { ProductorDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/productor-detalle.model';
import {
  Productor,
  SituacionMembresia,
  TipoDocumentoProductor,
} from '../../../../../domain/productor.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productor-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productor-form.html',
  styleUrl: './productor-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductorFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearProductorUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarProductorUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly current = signal<Productor | ProductorDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly associations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoProductor;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  readonly memberships: readonly {
    value: SituacionMembresia;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'ACTIVO', label: 'Activo' },
    { value: 'SUSPENDIDO', label: 'Suspendido' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipoDocumento: ['DNI' as TipoDocumentoProductor, [Validators.required]],
    numeroDocumento: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    nombres: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    apellidoPaterno: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    apellidoMaterno: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    fechaNacimiento: [''],
    distritoCodigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)]],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaAlta: ['', [Validators.required]],
    asociacionId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    fechaDesde: ['', [Validators.required]],
    situacionMembresia: ['ACTIVO' as SituacionMembresia, [Validators.required]],
  });

  open(
    associations: readonly AdminSelectOption[],
    producer: Productor | ProductorDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.associations.set(associations);
    this.current.set(producer);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = producer && 'fechaNacimiento' in producer
      ? producer as ProductorDetalle
      : null;
    const today = this.today();

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null);

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: (producer?.tipoDocumento as TipoDocumentoProductor) || 'DNI',
      numeroDocumento: producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: producer?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: producer?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: producer?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: producer?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: producer?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaAlta: producer?.fechaAlta ?? today,
      asociacionId: producer?.asociacionId ?? associations[0]?.value ?? 0,
      fechaDesde:
        detail?.afiliaciones.find((item) => item.estado)?.fechaDesde ??
        producer?.fechaAlta ??
        today,
      situacionMembresia:
        (producer?.situacionMembresia as SituacionMembresia) || 'ACTIVO',
    });

    this.form.controls.fechaAlta[producer ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.current();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: raw.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: raw.numeroDocumento.trim(),
      nombres: raw.nombres.trim(),
      apellidoPaterno: raw.apellidoPaterno.trim(),
      apellidoMaterno: raw.apellidoMaterno.trim() || undefined,
      telefono: raw.telefono.trim() || undefined,
      correo: raw.correo.trim() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: raw.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      asociacionId: Number(raw.asociacionId),
      fechaDesde: raw.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: raw.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: raw.referencia.trim() || undefined,
      },
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<number | void> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.socioId, common)
      : this.createUseCase.execute({ ...common, fechaAlta: raw.fechaAlta });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Productor actualizado' : 'Productor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value:
              typeof value === 'number'
                ? value
                : current?.socioId ?? null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el productor'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el productor',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  private today(): string {
    const now = new Date();
    const local = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
    return local.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}

      <div class="admin-field">

        <input id="producerLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" maxlength="80" formControlName="apellidoPaterno" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoPaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido paterno" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Apellido materno</label><input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="apellidoMaterno" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Fecha de nacimiento</label><input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaNacimiento" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Teléfono</label><input class="admin-input" maxlength="30" formControlName="telefono" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field">

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label>Referencia de ubicación</label>

      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Afiliación</span></div>

          @for (association of associations(); track association.value) { <option [value]="association.value">{{ association.label }}</option> }
        </select>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.asociacionId" fieldLabel="La asociación" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">

      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Situación de membresía</label>
        <select class="admin-select" formControlName="situacionMembresia">
          @for (membership of memberships; track membership.value) { <option [value]="membership.value">{{ membership.label }}</option> }
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

          @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

  AdminModalResult,
  AdminSelectOption,
} from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import {
  Empleado,
  EmpleadoDetalle,
  TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
} from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';

interface EmployeeFormOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoEmpleado;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: [''],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: employee?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: employee?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: employee?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId:
        employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);

    if (employee && type === 'DNI') {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
      );
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    return this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value === 'DNI'
      ? 8
      : 30;
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    return this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value === 'DNI'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    return this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value === 'DNI';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length === 8;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    if (!this.shouldResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando primero en DESCO y, solo si corresponde, consultando VerificaPE...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', 'DNI', documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, documentNumber),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey('DNI', documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No fue posible consultar la identidad automáticamente. Puede completar los datos manualmente; el backend volverá a validar la información al guardar.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onCompanyChange(): void {
    const selectedArea = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);

    if (
      selectedArea > 0
      && !this.availableAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === selectedArea,
      )
    ) {
      this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
    );
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'Valide el DNI antes de guardar. La búsqueda evita duplicar personas y consultas innecesarias a VerificaPE.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            areaId > 0 && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey('DNI', documentNumber);

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    if (result.isEmployee) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'El DNI ya está vinculado a un empleado. No se puede crear otro empleado para la misma persona.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.origin === 'LOCAL') {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Persona encontrada en DESCO. Se reutilizará el registro existente y se completarán únicamente los datos del empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.origin === 'VERIFICAPE') {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'DNI validado mediante VerificaPE. Revise los datos precargados y complete los campos restantes antes de guardar.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'La consulta automática no devolvió datos. Puede completar la identificación manualmente y continuar.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.message
        || 'No fue posible validar el DNI para este registro.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
    });
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Empleados</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar empleado' : 'Registrar empleado' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Identificación</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocumentType">Tipo de documento</label>
        <select
          id="employeeDocumentType"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="tipoDocumento"
          (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()"
        >
          @for (item of documentTypes; track item.value) {
            <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocument">Número de documento</label>
        <div class="identity-document-control">
          <input
            id="employeeDocument"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />

          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="identity-search-button"
              [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()"
              [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
              (click)="resolveIdentity()"
            >
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                Validando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                Validar DNI
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El número de documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            blank: 'El número de documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
        @if (!shouldResolveIdentity()) {
          <small class="identity-help">
            CE, pasaporte y otros documentos se registran manualmente. VerificaPE se utiliza solo para DNI en empleados porque ese es el contrato vigente del backend.
          </small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="employeeNames" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="nombres" maxlength="100" autocomplete="given-name" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeLastName">Apellido paterno</label>
        <input id="employeeLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoPaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="family-name" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoPaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido paterno" [messages]="{ blank: 'El apellido paterno no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeSecondLastName">Apellido materno</label>
        <input id="employeeSecondLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoMaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="additional-name" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoMaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido materno" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeBirthDate">Fecha de nacimiento</label>
        <input id="employeeBirthDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaNacimiento" [max]="today" autocomplete="bday" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaNacimiento" fieldLabel="La fecha de nacimiento" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de nacimiento no puede ser futura.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeePhone">Teléfono</label>
        <input id="employeePhone" class="admin-input" type="tel" inputmode="tel" formControlName="telefono" maxlength="30" autocomplete="tel" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.telefono" fieldLabel="El teléfono" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="employeeEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" formControlName="correo" maxlength="180" autocomplete="email" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Ubicación de la persona</span>
      </div>

      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="employeeReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="employeeReference" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Información laboral</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeCompany">Organización</label>
        <select id="employeeCompany" class="admin-select" formControlName="empresaId" (change)="onCompanyChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.empresaId" fieldLabel="La organización" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEntryDate">Fecha de ingreso</label>
        <input id="employeeEntryDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaIngreso" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaIngreso" fieldLabel="La fecha de ingreso" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeArea">Área</label>
        <select id="employeeArea" class="admin-select" formControlName="areaId" (change)="onAreaChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Sin área asignada</option>
          @for (area of availableAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeRoleName">
          Cargo
          @if (form.controls.areaId.value > 0) { <span aria-hidden="true">*</span> }
        </label>
        <input id="employeeRoleName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="cargo" maxlength="120" placeholder="Cargo o función" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.cargo" fieldLabel="El cargo" [messages]="{ blank: 'El cargo no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      @if (current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeAreaDate">Fecha de asignación de área</label>
          <input id="employeeAreaDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAsignacionArea" />
          @if (form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
            <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de asignación de área no puede ser anterior a la fecha de ingreso.</small>
          }
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {

import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-code.util';
import {

import { CrearProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-productor.use-case';
import { EditarProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-productor.use-case';
import { ProductorDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/productor-detalle.model';
import {
