      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: [''],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: employee?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: employee?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: employee?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId:
        employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);

    if (
      employee
      && (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC')
    ) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
      );
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del documento...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onCompanyChange(): void {
    const selectedArea = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);

    if (
      selectedArea > 0
      && !this.availableAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === selectedArea,
      )
    ) {
      this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
    );
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${values.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            areaId > 0 && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    const current = this.current();

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    if (
      result.isEmployee
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.empleadoId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        `El ${type} ya está vinculado a otro empleado. No se puede crear o reasignar un empleado a la misma persona.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos disponibles fueron obtenidos correctamente. Revise la información y complete los campos faltantes.'
          : 'La persona ya se encuentra registrada. Se utilizarán sus datos disponibles y puede completar la información faltante.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      `No fue posible validar el ${type}. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.`,
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
    });
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

      telefono: producer?.telefono ?? '',

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del documento...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }

    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.current();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      raw.tipoDocumento,
      raw.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(raw.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${raw.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este productor.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: raw.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(raw.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(raw.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(raw.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(raw.telefono),
      correo: raw.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: raw.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      asociacionId: Number(raw.asociacionId),
      codigoSocio: raw.codigoSocio.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaDesde: raw.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: raw.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
      },
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<number | void> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.socioId, common)
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          ...common,
          fechaAlta: raw.fechaAlta,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Productor actualizado'
              : 'Productor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value:
              typeof value === 'number'
                ? value
                : current?.socioId ?? null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el productor'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el productor',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedPartnerCode(): void {
    if (this.current()) {
      return;
    }

    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoSocio.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('SOC', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    const current = this.current();

    if (
      result.isPartner
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.socioId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        `El ${type} ya está vinculado a otro socio. No se puede crear o reasignar un socio a la misma persona.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos disponibles fueron obtenidos correctamente. Revise la información y complete los campos faltantes.'
          : 'La persona ya se encuentra registrada. Se utilizarán sus datos disponibles y puede completar la información faltante.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      `No fue posible validar el ${type}. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.`,
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
    });
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoProductor,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeProducerDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoProductor {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

@Component({

export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);

  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companyOptions = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({

  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({

      '',

        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],

      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,

    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(

    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);

  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {

      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del RUC...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(

          );

  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();

  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {

    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        area.areaId !== currentAreaId &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: company?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: company?.correo ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: normalizeOptionalText(values.correo),
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    if (result.businessName) {
      this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.setValue(
        result.businessName.slice(0, 200),
      );
    }

    if (
      result.suggestedFiscalAddress &&
      !this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value.trim()
    ) {
      this.companyForm.controls.referencia.setValue(
        result.suggestedFiscalAddress.slice(0, 300),
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association' &&
      result.found &&
      result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'El RUC ya pertenece a una asociación registrada. No se creará un duplicado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos disponibles del RUC fueron obtenidos correctamente. Revise la información y complete los campos faltantes.'
          : 'La organización ya se encuentra registrada. Se utilizarán sus datos disponibles y puede completar la información faltante.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos del RUC. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No fue posible validar el RUC. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.resetState();
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {
  IdentityResolveRequest,
  IdentityResolveRequestEntidadObjetivoEnum,
  IdentityResolveRequestTipoDocumentoEnum,
} from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/identityResolveRequest';
import { ValidacinDeIdentidadService } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/validacinDeIdentidad.service';

export type IdentityTarget = 'PERSONA' | 'EMPRESA';
export type IdentityDocumentType = 'DNI' | 'RUC';
export type IdentityOrigin = 'LOCAL' | 'MANUAL' | string;

export interface IdentityResolution {
  origin: IdentityOrigin;
  found: boolean;
  insertedAutomatically: boolean;
  manualEntryAllowed: boolean;
  target: IdentityTarget;
  entityId: number | null;
  personType: string | null;
  documentType: string | null;
  documentNumber: string | null;
  names: string | null;
  paternalSurname: string | null;
  maternalSurname: string | null;
  businessName: string | null;
  birthDate: string | null;
  sex: string | null;
  locationId: number | null;
  departmentCode: string | null;
  departmentName: string | null;
  provinceCode: string | null;
  provinceName: string | null;
  districtCode: string | null;
  districtName: string | null;
  populationCenterId: number | null;
  populationCenterName: string | null;
  locationReference: string | null;
  reniecUbigeo: string | null;
  sunatUbigeo: string | null;
  entityActive: boolean | null;
  isEmployee: boolean;
  isPartner: boolean;
  isAssociation: boolean;
  queryStatus: string | null;
  suggestedFiscalAddress: string | null;
  retryFromUtc: string | null;
  message: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class IdentityResolverService {
  private readonly api = inject(ValidacinDeIdentidadService);

  resolve(
    target: IdentityTarget,
    documentType: IdentityDocumentType,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): Observable<IdentityResolution> {
    const request: IdentityResolveRequest = {
      entidadObjetivo:
        target === 'EMPRESA'
          ? IdentityResolveRequestEntidadObjetivoEnum.Empresa
          : IdentityResolveRequestEntidadObjetivoEnum.Persona,
      tipoDocumento:
        documentType === 'RUC'
          ? IdentityResolveRequestTipoDocumentoEnum.Ruc
          : IdentityResolveRequestTipoDocumentoEnum.Dni,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber.trim(),
    };

    return this.api
      .identidadResolverDocumento(
        { identityResolveRequest: request },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => {
          const data = this.record(response.datos);

          if (!data) {
            throw new Error(
              'No fue posible obtener la información del documento.',
            );
          }

          return {
            origin: this.string(data['origen']) ?? 'MANUAL',
            found: this.boolean(data['encontrado']),
            insertedAutomatically: this.boolean(
              data['insertadoAutomaticamente'],
            ),
            manualEntryAllowed: this.boolean(
              data['permiteCargaManual'],
            ),
            target:
              this.string(data['entidadObjetivo']) === 'EMPRESA'
                ? 'EMPRESA'
                : 'PERSONA',
            entityId: this.number(data['entidadId']),
            personType: this.string(data['tipoPersona']),
            documentType: this.string(data['tipoDocumento']),
            documentNumber: this.string(data['numeroDocumento']),
            names: this.string(data['nombres']),
            paternalSurname: this.string(
              data['apellidoPaterno'],
            ),
            maternalSurname: this.string(
              data['apellidoMaterno'],
            ),
            businessName: this.string(data['razonSocial']),
            birthDate: this.string(data['fechaNacimiento']),
            sex: this.string(data['sexo']),
            locationId: this.number(data['ubicacionId']),
            departmentCode: this.string(
              data['departamentoCodigo'],
            ),
            departmentName: this.string(
              data['departamentoNombre'],
            ),
            provinceCode: this.string(
              data['provinciaCodigo'],
            ),
            provinceName: this.string(
              data['provinciaNombre'],
            ),
            districtCode: this.string(data['distritoCodigo']),
            districtName: this.string(data['distritoNombre']),
            populationCenterId: this.number(
              data['centroPobladoId'],
            ),
            populationCenterName: this.string(
              data['centroPobladoNombre'],
            ),
            locationReference: this.string(
              data['referenciaUbicacion'],
            ),
            reniecUbigeo: this.string(data['ubigeoReniec']),
            sunatUbigeo: this.string(data['ubigeoSunat']),
            entityActive: this.nullableBoolean(
              data['estadoEntidad'],
            ),
            isEmployee: this.boolean(data['esEmpleado']),
            isPartner: this.boolean(data['esSocio']),
            isAssociation: this.boolean(data['esAsociacion']),
            queryStatus: this.string(data['estadoConsulta']),
            suggestedFiscalAddress: this.string(
              data['direccionFiscalSugerida'],
            ),
            retryFromUtc: this.string(data['reintentoDesdeUtc']),
            message:
              response.mensaje ||
              'La información del documento fue procesada.',
          } satisfies IdentityResolution;
        }),
      );
  }

  private record(
    value: unknown,
  ): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
      : null;
  }

  private string(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()
      ? value.trim()
      : null;
  }

  private number(value: unknown): number | null {
    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)
      ? value
      : null;
  }

  private boolean(value: unknown): boolean {
    return value === true;
  }

  private nullableBoolean(value: unknown): boolean | null {
    return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : null;
  }
}

import {

} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {

import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';

} from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import {
  Empleado,

} from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';

interface EmployeeFormOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',

  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoEmpleado;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: [''],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: employee?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: employee?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: employee?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId:
        employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);

    if (
      employee
      && (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC')
    ) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
      );
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del documento...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onCompanyChange(): void {
    const selectedArea = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);

    if (
      selectedArea > 0
      && !this.availableAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === selectedArea,
      )
    ) {
      this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
    );
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${values.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            areaId > 0 && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    const current = this.current();

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    if (
      result.isEmployee
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.empleadoId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        `El ${type} ya está vinculado a otro empleado. No se puede crear o reasignar un empleado a la misma persona.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos disponibles fueron obtenidos correctamente. Revise la información y complete los campos faltantes.'
          : 'La persona ya se encuentra registrada. Se utilizarán sus datos disponibles y puede completar la información faltante.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      `No fue posible validar el ${type}. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.`,
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    this.form.patchValue({
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">

    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
