import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faPen,
  faUserPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  dateOrderValidator,
  dniValidator,
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import {
  AdminModalResult,
  AdminSelectOption,
} from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import {
  Empleado,
  EmpleadoDetalle,
  TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
} from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';

interface EmployeeFormOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  names: boolean;
  paternalSurname: boolean;
  maternalSurname: boolean;
  birthDate: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    names: false,
    paternalSurname: false,
    maternalSurname: false,
    birthDate: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly resolvedReniecUbigeo = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly resolvedSunatUbigeo = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoEmpleado;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: [''],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: employee?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: employee?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: employee?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId:
        employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);

    if (
      employee
      && (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC')
    ) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
      );
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del documento...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onCompanyChange(): void {
    const selectedArea = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);

    if (
      selectedArea > 0
      && !this.availableAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === selectedArea,
      )
    ) {
      this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
    );
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${values.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            areaId > 0 && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    const current = this.current();

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    if (
      result.isEmployee
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.empleadoId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        `El ${type} ya está vinculado a otro empleado. No se puede crear o reasignar un empleado a la misma persona.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos disponibles fueron obtenidos correctamente. Revise la información y complete los campos faltantes.'
          : 'La persona ya se encuentra registrada. Se utilizarán sus datos disponibles y puede completar la información faltante.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      `No fue posible validar el ${type}. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.`,
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      names: result.found && Boolean(result.names?.trim()),
      paternalSurname:
        result.found && Boolean(result.paternalSurname?.trim()),
      maternalSurname:
        result.found && Boolean(result.maternalSurname?.trim()),
      birthDate:
        result.found && Boolean(result.birthDate?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.form.patchValue({
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? result.phone.trim().slice(0, 30)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.resolvedReniecUbigeo.set(
      result.reniecUbigeo?.trim() || null,
    );
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(
      result.sunatUbigeo?.trim() || null,
    );
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.resolvedReniecUbigeo.set(null);
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly resolvedReniecUbigeo = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly resolvedSunatUbigeo = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoProductor;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  readonly memberships: readonly {
    value: SituacionMembresia;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'ACTIVO', label: 'Activo' },
    { value: 'SUSPENDIDO', label: 'Suspendido' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoProductor,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      fechaAlta: ['', [Validators.required]],
      asociacionId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoSocio: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaDesde: ['', [Validators.required]],
      situacionMembresia: [
        'ACTIVO' as SituacionMembresia,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaAlta',
          'fechaDesde',
          'membershipDateOrder',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    associations: readonly AdminSelectOption[],
    producer: Productor | ProductorDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.associations.set(associations);
    this.current.set(producer);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = producer && 'fechaNacimiento' in producer
      ? (producer as ProductorDetalle)
      : null;
    const today = this.today;
    const type = this.normalizeProducerDocumentType(
      producer?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: producer?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: producer?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: producer?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: producer?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: producer?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaAlta: producer?.fechaAlta ?? today,
      asociacionId:
        producer?.asociacionId ?? associations[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoSocio:
        producer?.codigoSocio
          ?? buildSystemCode(
            'SOC',
            producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
            30,
          ),
      fechaDesde:
        detail?.afiliaciones.find((item) => item.estado)?.fechaDesde
        ?? producer?.fechaAlta
        ?? today,
      situacionMembresia:
        (producer?.situacionMembresia as SituacionMembresia)
        || 'ACTIVO',
    });

    this.form.controls.fechaAlta[
      producer ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);

    if (
      producer
      && (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC')
    ) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.identityKey(type, producer.numeroDocumento),
      );
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
    this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del documento...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }

    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.current();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      raw.tipoDocumento,
      raw.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(raw.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${raw.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este productor.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: raw.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(raw.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(raw.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(raw.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(raw.telefono),
      correo: raw.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: raw.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      asociacionId: Number(raw.asociacionId),
      codigoSocio: raw.codigoSocio.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaDesde: raw.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: raw.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
      },
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<number | void> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.socioId, common)
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          ...common,
          fechaAlta: raw.fechaAlta,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Productor actualizado'
              : 'Productor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value:
              typeof value === 'number'
                ? value
                : current?.socioId ?? null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el productor'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el productor',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedPartnerCode(): void {
    if (this.current()) {
      return;
    }

    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoSocio.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('SOC', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    const current = this.current();

    if (
      result.isPartner
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.socioId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        `El ${type} ya está vinculado a otro socio. No se puede crear o reasignar un socio a la misma persona.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos disponibles fueron obtenidos correctamente. Revise la información y complete los campos faltantes.'
          : 'La persona ya se encuentra registrada. Se utilizarán sus datos disponibles y puede completar la información faltante.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos del documento. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      `No fue posible validar el ${type}. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.`,
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      names: result.found && Boolean(result.names?.trim()),
      paternalSurname:
        result.found && Boolean(result.paternalSurname?.trim()),
      maternalSurname:
        result.found && Boolean(result.maternalSurname?.trim()),
      birthDate:
        result.found && Boolean(result.birthDate?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.form.patchValue({
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? result.phone.trim().slice(0, 30)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.resolvedReniecUbigeo.set(
      result.reniecUbigeo?.trim() || null,
    );
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(
      result.sunatUbigeo?.trim() || null,
    );
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.resolvedReniecUbigeo.set(null);
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoProductor,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeProducerDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoProductor {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" /></span>
        <div><p>Productores</p><h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar productor' : 'Registrar productor' }}</h2></div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Cerrar" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityLocks().geography" (click)="close()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" /></button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) { <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div> }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Identificación</span></div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerDocumentType">Tipo de documento</label>
        <select id="producerDocumentType" class="admin-select" formControlName="tipoDocumento" (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()">
          @for (type of documentTypes; track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerDocument">Número de documento</label>
        <div class="identity-document-control">
          <input
            id="producerDocument"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />
          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button type="button" class="identity-search-button" [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()" [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()" (click)="resolveIdentity()">
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> Validando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" /> Validar {{ form.controls.tipoDocumento.value }}
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            ruc: 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.',
            rucNature: 'Para un productor solo se admite RUC de persona natural (10, 15 o 17).',
            blank: 'El documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
        @if (!shouldResolveIdentity()) {
          <small class="identity-help">CE, pasaporte y otros documentos se registran manualmente y no consumen VerificaPE.</small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="producerNames" class="admin-input" type="text" maxlength="100" formControlName="nombres" autocomplete="given-name" / [readOnly]="identityLocks().names">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerLastName">Apellido paterno</label>
        <input id="producerLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" maxlength="80" formControlName="apellidoPaterno" autocomplete="family-name" / [readOnly]="identityLocks().paternalSurname">

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerPhone">Teléfono</label>
        <input id="producerPhone" class="admin-input" type="tel" inputmode="tel" maxlength="30" formControlName="telefono" autocomplete="tel" / [readOnly]="identityLocks().phone">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.telefono" fieldLabel="El teléfono" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="producerEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" maxlength="180" formControlName="correo" autocomplete="email" / [readOnly]="identityLocks().email">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Ubicación</span></div>
      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="producerReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="producerReference" class="admin-input" maxlength="300" formControlName="referencia" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle, referencia u otra indicación" / [readOnly]="identityLocks().reference">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Afiliación</span></div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerRegistrationDate">Fecha de alta</label>
        <input id="producerRegistrationDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAlta" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAlta" fieldLabel="La fecha de alta" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerAssociation">Asociación</label>
        <select id="producerAssociation" class="admin-select" formControlName="asociacionId">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
          @for (association of associations(); track association.value) { <option [value]="association.value">{{ association.label }}</option> }
        </select>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.asociacionId" fieldLabel="La asociación" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">

        <small class="identity-help">Se genera automáticamente a partir del documento y se envía al backend porque el PA lo requiere.</small>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.codigoSocio" fieldLabel="El código de socio" />

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerMembershipDate">Fecha desde</label>

        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaDesde" fieldLabel="La fecha de afiliación" />
        @if (form.hasError('membershipDateOrder')) {
          <small class="producer-form-error">La fecha de afiliación no puede ser anterior a la fecha de alta.</small>

      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerMembershipStatus">Situación de membresía</label>
        <select id="producerMembershipStatus" class="admin-select" formControlName="situacionMembresia">
          @for (membership of memberships; track membership.value) { <option [value]="membership.value">{{ membership.label }}</option> }
        </select>
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
          @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBuilding,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface AreaModalOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companyOptions = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSunatUbigeo = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('JURIDICA'),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: [''],
    numeroPartida: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando información del RUC...',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          if (mapped.status === 400) {
            this.identityTone.set('error');
            this.identityBlocked.set(true);
            this.identityMessage.set(mapped.message);
            return;
          }

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos del RUC. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().empresaId);
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        area.areaId !== currentAreaId &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: company?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: company?.correo ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'La identidad encontrada no puede utilizarse para este registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: normalizeOptionalText(values.correo),
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? result.phone.trim().slice(0, 30)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(
      result.sunatUbigeo?.trim() || null,
    );

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'El RUC ya pertenece a una asociación registrada. No se creará un duplicado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.insertedAutomatically
          ? 'Los datos del RUC fueron obtenidos, persistidos y precargados. Los datos oficiales disponibles quedan bloqueados.'
          : 'La organización ya existe en DESCO. Se precargaron sus datos persistidos y los valores disponibles quedan bloqueados.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos del RUC. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No fue posible validar el RUC. Verifique el documento e intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.resolvedSunatUbigeo.set(null);
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.resetState();
  }
}
