```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBuilding,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface AreaModalOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companyOptions = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('JURIDICA'),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: [''],
    numeroPartida: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().empresaId);
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        area.areaId !== currentAreaId &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: company?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: company?.correo ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(values.telefono),
      correo: normalizeOptionalText(values.correo),
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? result.phone.trim().slice(0, 30)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.resetState();
```
```html
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBan, faEye, faFloppyDisk, faKey, faLock, faPen, faPlus, faRotate, faShieldHalved, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { CrearRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-rol.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-rol.use-case';
import { EditarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-rol.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { Rol } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';
@Component({
    selector: 'app-roles-list-page',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [
        ReactiveFormsModule,
        RouterLink,
        FaIconComponent,
        PermissionDirective,
        LoadingStateComponent,
        ErrorStateComponent,
        EmptyStateComponent,
        PaginatorComponent,
        ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
        FormErrorComponent,
        PageHeaderComponent,
    ],
    templateUrl: './roles-list.html',
    styleUrl: './roles-list.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolesListPage implements OnInit {
    @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
    private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
    private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearRolUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRolUseCase);
    private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarRolUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly loading = signal(true);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly modalError = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly currentRole = signal<Rol | null>(null);
    readonly result = signal<PageResult<Rol>>(emptyPageResult(20));
    readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly viewIcon = faEye;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly permissionsIcon = faKey;
    readonly disableIcon = faBan;
    readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly lockIcon = faLock;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
        nombre: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(100)]],
        descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(200)]],
        requiereSegundoFactor: [false],
    });
    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.load(1);
    }
    load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
        this.loading.set(true);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.listUseCase
            .execute(page, size)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    openCreate(): void {
        this.currentRole.set(null);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: '',
            nombre: '',
            descripcion: '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.roleDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    }
    openEdit(role: Rol): void {
        if (role.esSistema) {
            return;
        }
        this.currentRole.set(role);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: role.codigo,
            nombre: role.nombre,
            descripcion: role.descripcion ?? '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: role.requiereSegundoFactor,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.roleDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    }
    closeModal(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        this.roleDialog.nativeElement.close();
        this.currentRole.set(null);
        this.modalError.set(null);
    }
    save(): void {
        const current = this.currentRole();

        if (!current) {
            this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(buildSystemCode('ROL', this.form.controls.nombre.value, 40), {
                emitEvent: false,
            });
        }

        this.form.markAllAsTouched();

        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }

        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        this.saving.set(true);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.rolId, {
                nombre: values.nombre.trim(),
                descripcion: values.descripcion.trim() || undefined,
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
                nombre: values.nombre.trim(),
                descripcion: values.descripcion.trim() || undefined,
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Rol actualizado' : 'Rol registrado');
                this.closeModal();
                this.load(current ? this.result().page : 1);
            },
            error: (error) => this.modalError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    async disable(role: Rol): Promise<void> {
        if (role.esSistema || this.disablingId()) {
            return;
        }
        const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
            title: 'Deshabilitar rol',
            message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible para nuevas asignaciones.`,
            tone: 'danger',
            confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
            cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
            requiresReason: true,
            reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
            reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
            minimumReasonLength: 5,
        });
        if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
            return;
        }
        this.disablingId.set(role.rolId);
        this.disableUseCase
            .execute(role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success('Rol deshabilitado');
                this.load();
            },
            error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el rol', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Roles y permisos"
    subtitle="Administra roles y la asignación de permisos disponibles."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="openCreate()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        Nuevo rol
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando roles"
        message="Consultando roles y asignaciones activas."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin roles"
        message="No hay roles disponibles."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Rol</th>
              <th>Código</th>
              <th class="text-center">Permisos</th>
              <th class="text-center">Usuarios</th>
              <th class="text-center">Segundo factor</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>

                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar"
                        (click)="openEdit(role)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>

                      <a
                        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_CREAR'"

                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_RETIRAR'"

              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>

      </div>

      <app-paginator

        [size]="result().size"

    }
  </section>
</div>

<dialog #roleDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeModal()">

</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faCheck,
  faCheckDouble,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faKey,
  faLock,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ActualizarPermisosRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/actualizar-permisos-rol.use-case';
import { ObtenerRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-rol.use-case';
import { PermisoAsignable } from '../../../../../domain/rol-permiso.model';
import { RolDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';

interface PermissionGroup {
  moduleCode: string;
  moduleName: string;
  permissions: readonly PermisoAsignable[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-rol-permisos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './rol-permisos.html',
  styleUrl: './rol-permisos.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolPermisosPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRolUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(ActualizarPermisosRolUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly roleId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<RolDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly selectedIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly reason = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faKey;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly selectIcon = faCheckDouble;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly checkIcon = faCheck;

  readonly assignable = computed<readonly PermisoAsignable[]>(() => {
    const unique = new Map<number, PermisoAsignable>();

    for (const permission of this.access.permissions()) {
      if (!permission.permisoId) {
        continue;
      }

      unique.set(permission.permisoId, {
        permisoId: permission.permisoId,
        codigo: permission.codigo,
        nombre: permission.nombre || permission.codigo,
        descripcion: permission.descripcion,
        accion: permission.accion,
        moduloCodigo: permission.codigoModulo || 'GENERAL',
        moduloNombre:
          this.access
            .modules()
            .find((module) => module.codigo === permission.codigoModulo)
            ?.nombre ||
          permission.codigoModulo ||
          'General',
        sensible: permission.sensible,
        requiereMotivo: permission.requiereMotivo,
      });
    }

    return [...unique.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.moduloNombre.localeCompare(b.moduloNombre) ||
        a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre),
    );
  });

  readonly groups = computed<readonly PermissionGroup[]>(() => {
    const term = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    const grouped = new Map<string, PermissionGroup>();

    for (const permission of this.assignable()) {
      const searchable =
        `${permission.nombre} ${permission.codigo} ${permission.moduloNombre}`.toLowerCase();

      if (term && !searchable.includes(term)) {
        continue;
      }

      const current = grouped.get(permission.moduloCodigo);

      if (current) {
        grouped.set(permission.moduloCodigo, {
          ...current,
          permissions: [...current.permissions, permission],
        });
      } else {
        grouped.set(permission.moduloCodigo, {
          moduleCode: permission.moduloCodigo,
          moduleName: permission.moduloNombre,
          permissions: [permission],
        });
      }
    }

    return [...grouped.values()];
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.detail.set(detail);
          this.selectedIds.set(
            new Set(
              detail.permisos
                .filter((permission) => permission.estado)
                .map((permission) => permission.permisoId),
            ),
          );
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  isSelected(id: number): boolean {
    return this.selectedIds().has(id);
  }

  toggle(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedIds());

    if (checked) {
      next.add(id);
    } else {
      next.delete(id);
    }

    this.selectedIds.set(next);
  }

  toggleGroup(group: PermissionGroup): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedIds());
    const allSelected = group.permissions.every((permission) =>
      next.has(permission.permisoId),
    );

    for (const permission of group.permissions) {
      if (allSelected) {
        next.delete(permission.permisoId);
      } else {
        next.add(permission.permisoId);
      }
    }

    this.selectedIds.set(next);
  }

  save(): void {
    const role = this.detail()?.rol;

    if (!role || role.esSistema || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);

    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(role.rolId, {
        permisoIds: [...this.selectedIds()],
        motivo: this.reason().trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Permisos actualizados');
          void this.router.navigate([
            '/administracion/roles-permisos',
            role.rolId,
          ]);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudieron actualizar los permisos',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Permisos del rol"
    subtitle="Selecciona únicamente los permisos que deben formar parte del rol."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />

      <button

      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Restablecer
      </button>

      @if (detail()?.rol?.esSistema) {
        <span
          class="admin-managed-badge"
          title="Rol base administrado por el sistema"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
          Solo lectura
        </span>
      } @else {
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="save()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar permisos
          }
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando permisos"
        message="Preparando los permisos disponibles para este rol."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as value) {
      <section class="role-permission-summary">
        <div>
          <span>Rol</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.nombre }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.codigo }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Seleccionados</span>
          <strong>{{ selectedIds().size }}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
        <div class="admin-notice admin-notice--warning mt-4">
          Este rol es administrado por el sistema y sus permisos no pueden modificarse desde esta pantalla.
        </div>
      }

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="permission-toolbar">
          <div class="admin-search">
            <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
            <input
              type="search"
              placeholder="Buscar permiso o módulo"
              [value]="search()"
              (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="permission-count">
            {{ assignable().length }} permisos disponibles
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="permission-groups">
          @for (group of groups(); track group.moduleCode) {
            <section class="permission-group">
              <header>
                <div>
                  <h2>{{ group.moduleName }}</h2>
                  <span>{{ group.moduleCode }}</span>
                </div>

                @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                  <span class="admin-managed-badge">
                    <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
                    Base
                  </span>
                } @else {
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                    (click)="toggleGroup(group)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="selectIcon" />
                    Alternar grupo
                  </button>
                }
              </header>

              <div class="permission-options">
                @for (permission of group.permissions; track permission.permisoId) {
                  <label class="permission-option">
                    @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                      <span
                        class="permission-state"
                        [class.permission-state--selected]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        @if (isSelected(permission.permisoId)) {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="checkIcon" />
                        }
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        class="checkbox checkbox-primary checkbox-sm"
                        [checked]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        (change)="toggle(permission.permisoId, $any($event.target).checked)"
                      />
                    }
                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ permission.nombre }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ permission.codigo }}</span>
                      @if (permission.descripcion) {
                        <small>{{ permission.descripcion }}</small>
                      }
                    </div>
                    @if (permission.sensible) {
                      <em>Sensible</em>
                    }
                  </label>
                }
              </div>
            </section>
          } @empty {
            <div class="admin-table-empty">No hay permisos para el filtro indicado.</div>
          }
        </div>

        @if (!value.rol.esSistema) {
          <div class="permission-reason">
            <label for="permissionReason">Motivo del cambio</label>
            <textarea
              id="permissionReason"
              class="admin-textarea"
              rows="3"
              maxlength="300"
              placeholder="Opcional"
              [value]="reason()"
              (input)="reason.set($any($event.target).value)"
            ></textarea>
          </div>
        }
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators, } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faEye, faEyeSlash, faFloppyDisk, faPen, faUserPlus, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { buildUsernameSuggestion } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption, } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-cuenta.use-case';
import { EditarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-cuenta.use-case';
import { Usuario, UsuarioDetalle, } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
interface UserFormOptions {
    employees: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
    roles: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
}
@Component({
    selector: 'app-usuario-form',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
    templateUrl: './usuario-form.html',
    styleUrl: './usuario-form.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuarioFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearCuentaUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarCuentaUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly showPassword = signal(false);
    readonly current = signal<Usuario | UsuarioDetalle | null>(null);
    readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly selectedRoleIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly eyeIcon = faEye;
    readonly eyeSlashIcon = faEyeSlash;
    private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        empleadoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
        nombreUsuario: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
        passwordInicial: [''],
        correoSeguridad: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(320)]],
        requiereCambioPassword: [true],
        segundoFactorHabilitado: [false],
    });
    openCreate(options: UserFormOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.current.set(null);
        this.employees.set(options.employees);
        this.roles.set(options.roles);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(options.roles.length === 1
            ? new Set([Number(options.roles[0].value)])
            : new Set());
        this.errorMessage.set(null);

        const firstEmployee = options.employees[0] ?? null;

        this.form.reset({
            empleadoId: firstEmployee?.value ?? 0,
            nombreUsuario: firstEmployee
                ? buildUsernameSuggestion(firstEmployee.label, Number(firstEmployee.value))
                : '',
            passwordInicial: '',
            correoSeguridad: '',
            requiereCambioPassword: true,
            segundoFactorHabilitado: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.empleadoId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.setValidators([
            Validators.required,
            Validators.minLength(12),
            Validators.maxLength(128),
        ]);
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.setValidators([
            Validators.required,
            Validators.email,
            Validators.maxLength(320),
        ]);
        this.updateValidators();
        return this.show();
    }
    openEdit(user: Usuario | UsuarioDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.current.set(user);
        this.employees.set([]);
        this.roles.set([]);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(new Set());
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        const detail = 'requiereCambioPassword' in user
            ? (user as UsuarioDetalle)
            : null;
        this.form.reset({
            empleadoId: user.empleadoId,
            nombreUsuario: user.nombreUsuario,
            passwordInicial: '',
            correoSeguridad: '',
            requiereCambioPassword: detail?.requiereCambioPassword ?? false,
            segundoFactorHabilitado: detail?.segundoFactorHabilitado ?? user.segundoFactorHabilitado,
        });
        this.form.controls.empleadoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.clearValidators();
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.clearValidators();
        this.updateValidators();
        return this.show();
    }
    suggestUsername(value: string): void {
        if (this.current()) {
            return;
        }

        const employeeId = Number(value);
        const employee = this.employees().find((item) => Number(item.value) === employeeId);

        if (!employee) {
            this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            return;
        }

        this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.setValue(buildUsernameSuggestion(employee.label, employeeId), {
            emitEvent: false,
        });
    }

    close(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
    toggleRole(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
        const next = new Set(this.selectedRoleIds());
        if (checked) {
            next.add(id);
        }
        else {
            next.delete(id);
        }
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(next);
    }
    roleSelected(id: number): boolean {
        return this.selectedRoleIds().has(id);
    }
    save(): void {
        this.form.markAllAsTouched();
        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        const current = this.current();
        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        if (!current && this.selectedRoleIds().size === 0) {
            this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona al menos un rol para crear la cuenta.');
            return;
        }
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.saving.set(true);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.usuarioId, {
                nombreUsuario: values.nombreUsuario.trim(),
                requiereCambioPassword: values.requiereCambioPassword,
                segundoFactorHabilitado: values.segundoFactorHabilitado,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                empleadoId: Number(values.empleadoId),
                nombreUsuario: values.nombreUsuario.trim(),
                passwordInicial: values.passwordInicial,
                correoSeguridad: values.correoSeguridad.trim(),
                requiereCambioPassword: values.requiereCambioPassword,
                rolIds: [...this.selectedRoleIds()],
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Cuenta actualizada' : 'Cuenta registrada');
                this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
            },
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    private updateValidators(): void {
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
    }
    private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.showPassword.set(false);
        this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            this.resolver = resolve;
        });
    }
    private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
        if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
            this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
        }
        this.resolver?.(result);
        this.resolver = null;
        this.current.set(null);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(new Set());
    }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Usuarios y accesos</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar cuenta' : 'Crear cuenta' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      @if (!current()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="userEmployee">Empleado</label>
          <select
            id="userEmployee"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="empleadoId"
            (change)="suggestUsername($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar empleado</option>
            @for (employee of employees(); track employee.value) {
              <option [value]="employee.value">{{ employee.label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.empleadoId"
            fieldLabel="El empleado"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="username">Nombre de usuario</label>
        <input
          id="username"
          class="admin-input"
          type="text"
          formControlName="nombreUsuario"
          maxlength="80"
          autocomplete="off"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombreUsuario"
          fieldLabel="El nombre de usuario"
        />
      </div>

      @if (!current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="initialPassword">Contraseña inicial</label>
          <div class="admin-password-field">
            <input
              id="initialPassword"
              class="admin-input"
              [type]="showPassword() ? 'text' : 'password'"
              formControlName="passwordInicial"
              maxlength="128"
              autocomplete="new-password"
              placeholder="Mínimo 12 caracteres"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-password-toggle"
              [attr.aria-label]="showPassword() ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Mostrar contraseña'"
              (click)="showPassword.set(!showPassword())"
            >
              <fa-icon [icon]="showPassword() ? eyeSlashIcon : eyeIcon" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.passwordInicial"
            fieldLabel="La contraseña inicial"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="securityEmail">Correo de seguridad</label>
          <input
            id="securityEmail"
            class="admin-input"
            type="email"
            formControlName="correoSeguridad"
            maxlength="320"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.correoSeguridad"
            fieldLabel="El correo de seguridad"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Roles iniciales</label>
          <div class="admin-option-grid">
            @for (role of roles(); track role.value) {
              <label class="admin-check-option">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  class="checkbox checkbox-primary checkbox-sm"
                  [checked]="roleSelected(role.value)"
                  (change)="toggleRole(role.value, $any($event.target).checked)"
                />
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ role.label }}</strong>
                  @if (role.description) {
                    <span>{{ role.description }}</span>
                  }
                </div>
              </label>
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      }

      <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
        <div>
          <strong>Cambio de contraseña requerido</strong>
          <span>Solicitar una nueva contraseña en el siguiente acceso.</span>
        </div>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="admin-switch-control"
          formControlName="requiereCambioPassword"
        />
      </label>

      @if (current()) {
        <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
          <div>
            <strong>Segundo factor</strong>
            <span>Solicitar una verificación adicional durante el acceso.</span>
          </div>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            class="admin-switch-control"
            formControlName="segundoFactorHabilitado"
          />
        </label>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="close()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Permisos del rol"
    subtitle="Selecciona únicamente los permisos que deben formar parte del rol."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [routerLink]="['/administracion/roles-permisos', roleId]"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Restablecer
      </button>

      @if (detail()?.rol?.esSistema) {
        <span
          class="admin-managed-badge"
          title="Rol base administrado por el sistema"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
          Solo lectura
        </span>
      } @else {
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving() || !hasPermissionChanges()"
          (click)="save()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar permisos
          }
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando permisos"
        message="Preparando los permisos disponibles para este rol."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as value) {
      <section class="role-permission-summary">
        <div>
          <span>Rol</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.nombre }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.codigo }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Seleccionados</span>
          <strong>{{ selectedIds().size }}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
        <div class="admin-notice admin-notice--warning mt-4">
          Este rol es administrado por el sistema y sus permisos no pueden modificarse desde esta pantalla.
        </div>
      }

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="permission-toolbar">
          <div class="admin-search">
            <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
            <input
              type="search"
              placeholder="Buscar permiso o módulo"
              [value]="search()"
              (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="permission-count">
            {{ assignable().length }} permisos disponibles
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="permission-groups">
          @for (group of groups(); track group.moduleCode) {
            <section class="permission-group">
              <header>
                <div>
                  <h2>{{ group.moduleName }}</h2>
                  <span>{{ group.moduleCode }}</span>
                </div>

                @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                  <span class="admin-managed-badge">
                    <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
                    Base
                  </span>
                } @else {
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                    (click)="toggleGroup(group)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="selectIcon" />
                    Alternar grupo
                  </button>
                }
              </header>

              <div class="permission-options">
                @for (permission of group.permissions; track permission.permisoId) {
                  <label class="permission-option">
                    @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                      <span
                        class="permission-state"
                        [class.permission-state--selected]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        @if (isSelected(permission.permisoId)) {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="checkIcon" />
                        }
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        class="checkbox checkbox-primary checkbox-sm"
                        [checked]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        (change)="toggle(permission.permisoId, $any($event.target).checked)"
                      />
                    }
                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ permission.nombre }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ permission.codigo }}</span>
                      @if (permission.descripcion) {
                        <small>{{ permission.descripcion }}</small>
                      }
                    </div>
                    @if (permission.sensible) {
                      <em>Sensible</em>
                    }
                  </label>
                }
              </div>
            </section>
          } @empty {
            <div class="admin-table-empty">No hay permisos para el filtro indicado.</div>
          }
        </div>

        @if (!value.rol.esSistema) {
          <div class="permission-reason">
            <label for="permissionReason">Motivo del cambio</label>
            <textarea
              id="permissionReason"
              class="admin-textarea"
              rows="3"
              maxlength="500"
              [placeholder]="reasonRequired() ? 'Indique el motivo del cambio' : 'Opcional'"
              [value]="reason()"
              (input)="onReasonInput($any($event.target).value)"
            ></textarea>
            <small>{{ reason().length }}/500 caracteres</small>
            @if (reasonError()) {
              <small class="text-red-600">{{ reasonError() }}</small>
            } @else if (reasonRequired()) {
              <small>Este cambio requiere un motivo.</small>
            }
          </div>
        }
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>
```

```typescript
import { ActualizarPermisosRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/actualizar-permisos-rol.use-case';

import { PermisoAsignable } from '../../../../../domain/rol-permiso.model';
import { RolDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';

interface PermissionGroup {
  moduleCode: string;
  moduleName: string;
  permissions: readonly PermisoAsignable[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-rol-permisos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './rol-permisos.html',
  styleUrl: './rol-permisos.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolPermisosPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRolUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(ActualizarPermisosRolUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly roleId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<RolDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly selectedIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
  readonly initialSelectedIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly reason = signal('');
  readonly reasonError = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faKey;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly selectIcon = faCheckDouble;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly checkIcon = faCheck;

  readonly assignable = computed<readonly PermisoAsignable[]>(() => {
    const unique = new Map<number, PermisoAsignable>();

    for (const permission of this.access.permissions()) {
      if (!permission.permisoId) {
        continue;
      }

      unique.set(permission.permisoId, {
        permisoId: permission.permisoId,
        codigo: permission.codigo,
        nombre: permission.nombre || permission.codigo,
        descripcion: permission.descripcion,
        accion: permission.accion,
        moduloCodigo: permission.codigoModulo || 'GENERAL',
        moduloNombre:
          this.access
            .modules()
            .find((module) => module.codigo === permission.codigoModulo)
            ?.nombre ||
          permission.codigoModulo ||
          'General',
        sensible: permission.sensible,
        requiereMotivo: permission.requiereMotivo,
      });
    }

    return [...unique.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.moduloNombre.localeCompare(b.moduloNombre) ||
        a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre),
    );
  });

  readonly groups = computed<readonly PermissionGroup[]>(() => {
    const term = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    const grouped = new Map<string, PermissionGroup>();

    for (const permission of this.assignable()) {
      const searchable =
        `${permission.nombre} ${permission.codigo} ${permission.moduloNombre}`.toLowerCase();

      if (term && !searchable.includes(term)) {
        continue;
      }

      const current = grouped.get(permission.moduloCodigo);

      if (current) {
        grouped.set(permission.moduloCodigo, {
          ...current,
          permissions: [...current.permissions, permission],
        });
      } else {
        grouped.set(permission.moduloCodigo, {
          moduleCode: permission.moduloCodigo,
          moduleName: permission.moduloNombre,
          permissions: [permission],
        });
      }
    }

    return [...grouped.values()];
  });

  readonly hasPermissionChanges = computed(() => {
    const initial = this.initialSelectedIds();
    const current = this.selectedIds();

    if (initial.size !== current.size) {
      return true;
    }

    return [...initial].some((id) => !current.has(id));
  });

  readonly reasonRequired = computed(() => {
    const initial = this.initialSelectedIds();
    const current = this.selectedIds();
    const changed = new Set<number>();

    for (const id of initial) {
      if (!current.has(id)) changed.add(id);
    }
    for (const id of current) {
      if (!initial.has(id)) changed.add(id);
    }

    return this.assignable().some(
      (permission) => changed.has(permission.permisoId) && permission.requiereMotivo,
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.detail.set(detail);
          const selected = new Set(
            detail.permisos
              .filter((permission) => permission.estado)
              .map((permission) => permission.permisoId),
          );
          this.selectedIds.set(new Set(selected));
          this.initialSelectedIds.set(new Set(selected));
          this.reason.set('');
          this.reasonError.set(null);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  isSelected(id: number): boolean {
    return this.selectedIds().has(id);
  }

  toggle(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedIds());

    if (checked) {
      next.add(id);
    } else {
      next.delete(id);
    }

    this.selectedIds.set(next);
  }

  toggleGroup(group: PermissionGroup): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedIds());
    const allSelected = group.permissions.every((permission) =>
      next.has(permission.permisoId),
    );

    for (const permission of group.permissions) {
      if (allSelected) {
        next.delete(permission.permisoId);
      } else {
        next.add(permission.permisoId);
      }
    }

    this.selectedIds.set(next);
  }

  onReasonInput(value: string): void {
    this.reason.set(value.slice(0, 500));
    this.reasonError.set(null);
  }

  save(): void {
    const role = this.detail()?.rol;

    if (!role || role.esSistema || this.saving() || !this.hasPermissionChanges()) {
      return;
    }

    const reason = normalizeOptionalText(this.reason());

    if (this.reasonRequired() && (!reason || reason.length < 5)) {
      this.reasonError.set('Indique un motivo de al menos 5 caracteres para este cambio.');
      return;
    }

    if (reason && reason.length > 500) {
      this.reasonError.set('El motivo no puede superar 500 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    this.reasonError.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(role.rolId, {
        permisoIds: [...this.selectedIds()],
        motivo: reason,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Permisos actualizados');
          void this.router.navigate([
            '/administracion/roles-permisos',
            role.rolId,
          ]);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudieron actualizar los permisos',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```
