```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Permisos del rol"
    subtitle="Selecciona únicamente los permisos que deben formar parte del rol."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [routerLink]="['/administracion/roles-permisos', roleId]"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Restablecer
      </button>

      @if (detail()?.rol?.esSistema) {
        <span
          class="admin-managed-badge"
          title="Rol base administrado por el sistema"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
          Solo lectura
        </span>
      } @else {
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving() || !hasPermissionChanges()"
          (click)="save()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar permisos
          }
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando permisos"
        message="Preparando los permisos disponibles para este rol."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as value) {
      <section class="role-permission-summary">
        <div>
          <span>Rol</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.nombre }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.codigo }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Seleccionados</span>
          <strong>{{ selectedIds().size }}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
        <div class="admin-notice admin-notice--warning mt-4">
          Este rol es administrado por el sistema y sus permisos no pueden modificarse desde esta pantalla.
        </div>
      }

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="permission-toolbar">
          <div class="admin-search">
            <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
            <input
              type="search"
              placeholder="Buscar permiso o módulo"
              [value]="search()"
              (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="permission-count">
            {{ assignable().length }} permisos disponibles
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="permission-groups">
          @for (group of groups(); track group.moduleCode) {
            <section class="permission-group">
              <header>
                <div>
                  <h2>{{ group.moduleName }}</h2>
                  <span>{{ group.moduleCode }}</span>
                </div>

                @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                  <span class="admin-managed-badge">
                    <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
                    Base
                  </span>
                } @else {
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                    (click)="toggleGroup(group)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="selectIcon" />
                    Alternar grupo
                  </button>
                }
              </header>

              <div class="permission-options">
                @for (permission of group.permissions; track permission.permisoId) {
                  <label class="permission-option">
                    @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                      <span
                        class="permission-checkbox-box permission-checkbox-box--readonly"
                        [class.permission-checkbox-box--selected]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        @if (isSelected(permission.permisoId)) {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="checkIcon" />
                        }
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        class="permission-checkbox-native"
                        [checked]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        [attr.aria-label]="'Permiso ' + permission.nombre"
                        (change)="toggle(permission.permisoId, $any($event.target).checked)"
                      />
                      <span
                        class="permission-checkbox-box"
                        [class.permission-checkbox-box--selected]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        @if (isSelected(permission.permisoId)) {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="checkIcon" />
                        }
                      </span>
                    }
                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ permission.nombre }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ permission.codigo }}</span>
                      @if (permission.descripcion) {
                        <small>{{ permission.descripcion }}</small>
                      }
                    </div>
                    @if (permission.sensible) {
                      <em>Sensible</em>
                    }
                  </label>
                }
              </div>
            </section>
          } @empty {
            <div class="admin-table-empty">No hay permisos para el filtro indicado.</div>
          }
        </div>

        @if (!value.rol.esSistema) {
          <div class="permission-reason">
            <label for="permissionReason">Motivo del cambio</label>
            <textarea
              id="permissionReason"
              class="admin-textarea"
              rows="3"
              maxlength="500"
              [placeholder]="reasonRequired() ? 'Indique el motivo del cambio' : 'Opcional'"
              [value]="reason()"
              (input)="onReasonInput($any($event.target).value)"
            ></textarea>
            <small>{{ reason().length }}/500 caracteres</small>
            @if (reasonError()) {
              <small class="text-red-600">{{ reasonError() }}</small>
            } @else if (reasonRequired()) {
              <small>Este cambio requiere un motivo.</small>
            }
          </div>
        }
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>
```

```typescript
import {
  AbstractControl,
  ValidationErrors,
  ValidatorFn,
} from '@angular/forms';

export type RucNature = 'ANY' | 'NATURAL' | 'JURIDICA';

export const MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE = 18;
export const MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE = 120;

const RUC_WEIGHTS = [5, 4, 3, 2, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2] as const;
const NATURAL_RUC_PREFIXES = new Set(['10', '15', '17']);
const PERSON_NAME_PATTERN = /^[\p{L}\p{M}]+(?:[ \x27\-][\p{L}\p{M}]+)*$/u;
const USERNAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$/;
const PHONE_PATTERN = /^\+?\d{7,15}$/;

export function notBlankValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  return String(value).trim().length > 0
    ? null
    : { blank: true };
}

export function optionalNotBlankValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '');

  if (value.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return value.trim().length > 0
    ? null
    : { blank: true };
}

export function personNameValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return PERSON_NAME_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { personName: true };
}

export function phoneValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return PHONE_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { phone: true };
}

export function usernameValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return USERNAME_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { username: true };
}

export function passwordSafetyValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '');

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (value !== value.trim()) {
    return { passwordOuterWhitespace: true };
  }

  return /[\r\n\t\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(value)
    ? { passwordControlCharacter: true }
    : null;
}

export function dniValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return /^\d{8}$/.test(value)
    ? null
    : { dni: true };
}

export function rucValidator(
  nature: RucNature = 'ANY',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isValidRuc(value)) {
      return { ruc: true };
    }

    const prefix = value.slice(0, 2);

    if (nature === 'JURIDICA' && prefix !== '20') {
      return { rucNature: true };
    }

    if (
      nature === 'NATURAL'
      && !NATURAL_RUC_PREFIXES.has(prefix)
    ) {
      return { rucNature: true };
    }

    return null;
  };
}

export function notFutureDateValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!isValidIsoDate(value)) {
    return { invalidDate: true };
  }

  return value <= todayLocalIsoDate()
    ? null
    : { futureDate: true };
}

export function adultBirthDateValidator(
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
  maximumAge = MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE,
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isValidIsoDate(value)) {
      return { invalidDate: true };
    }

    if (value > maxBirthDateIso(minimumAge)) {
      return { underage: true };
    }

    if (value < minBirthDateIso(maximumAge)) {
      return { ageOutOfRange: true };
    }

    return null;
  };
}

export function dateOrderValidator(
  startControlName: string,
  endControlName: string,
  errorKey = 'dateOrder',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const start = String(control.get(startControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();
    const end = String(control.get(endControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!start || !end) {
      return null;
    }

    return end >= start
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator(
  birthControlName: string,
  eventControlName: string,
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
  errorKey = 'dateBeforeMinimumAge',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const birth = String(control.get(birthControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();
    const event = String(control.get(eventControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!birth || !event || !isValidIsoDate(birth) || !isValidIsoDate(event)) {
      return null;
    }

    const minimumEventDate = addYearsIso(birth, minimumAge);

    return event >= minimumEventDate
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function isValidRuc(value: string): boolean {
  const ruc = value.trim();

  if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(ruc)) {
    return false;
  }

  const sum = RUC_WEIGHTS.reduce(
    (total, weight, index) =>
      total + Number(ruc.charAt(index)) * weight,
    0,
  );

  let checkDigit = 11 - (sum % 11);

  if (checkDigit === 10) {
    checkDigit = 0;
  } else if (checkDigit === 11) {
    checkDigit = 1;
  }

  return checkDigit === Number(ruc.charAt(10));
}

export function sanitizeDocument(
  type: string,
  value: string,
): string {
  const normalizedType = type.trim().toUpperCase();

  if (normalizedType === 'DNI') {
    return value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  }

  if (normalizedType === 'RUC') {
    return value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  }

  return value
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 30);
}

export function sanitizePersonName(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{M} \x27\-]/gu, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s*([-\x27])\s*/g, '$1')
    .replace(/^\s+/, '');
}

export function sanitizePhone(value: string): string {
  const raw = String(value ?? '').trim();
  const hasLeadingPlus = raw.startsWith('+');
  const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 15);

  if (!digits) {
    return '';
  }

  return hasLeadingPlus ? `+${digits}` : digits;
}

export function sanitizeUsername(value: string): string {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]/g, '')
    .replace(/[._-]{2,}/g, '.')
    .replace(/^[._-]+|[._-]+$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 80);
}

export function normalizeText(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

export function normalizeOptionalText(
  value: string,
): string | undefined {
  const normalized = normalizeText(value);
  return normalized || undefined;
}

export function todayLocalIsoDate(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  return isoFromLocalDate(now);
}

export function maxBirthDateIso(
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
): string {
  return yearsAgoIso(minimumAge);
}

export function minBirthDateIso(
  maximumAge = MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE,
): string {
  return yearsAgoIso(maximumAge);
}

function yearsAgoIso(years: number): string {
  const today = new Date();
  const year = today.getFullYear() - Math.max(0, Math.trunc(years));
  const month = today.getMonth();
  const day = clampDay(year, month, today.getDate());
  return formatIsoDate(year, month + 1, day);
}

function addYearsIso(value: string, years: number): string {
  const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);
  const targetYear = year + Math.trunc(years);
  const targetMonthIndex = month - 1;
  const targetDay = clampDay(targetYear, targetMonthIndex, day);
  return formatIsoDate(targetYear, month, targetDay);
}

function isValidIsoDate(value: string): boolean {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    return false;
  }

  const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);

  if (month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1) {
    return false;
  }

  return day <= clampDay(year, month - 1, 31);
}

function clampDay(year: number, monthIndex: number, day: number): number {
  const lastDay = new Date(year, monthIndex + 1, 0).getDate();
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, day), lastDay);
}

function isoFromLocalDate(value: Date): string {
  return formatIsoDate(
    value.getFullYear(),
    value.getMonth() + 1,
    value.getDate(),
  );
}

function formatIsoDate(year: number, month: number, day: number): string {
  return `${String(year).padStart(4, '0')}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
```

```typescript
export class ProductorFormComponent {

    const type = this.normalizeProducerDocumentType(

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(

      apellidoMaterno: producer?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: producer?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: producer?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaAlta: producer?.fechaAlta ?? today,
      asociacionId:

        producer?.codigoSocio
          ?? buildSystemCode(

            producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
            30,

      fechaDesde:

        ?? producer?.fechaAlta
        ?? today,
      situacionMembresia:

        || 'ACTIVO',
    });

    this.form.controls.fechaAlta[

    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);

    if (producer) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);
      this.identityLocks.set({

        paternalSurname: true,

        birthDate: true,

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    control.setValue(

      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
    this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }

    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.current();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      raw.tipoDocumento,
      raw.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(raw.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${raw.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'No se puede usar esta persona para el socio.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: raw.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(raw.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(raw.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(raw.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(raw.telefono),
      correo: raw.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: raw.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      asociacionId: Number(raw.asociacionId),
      codigoSocio: raw.codigoSocio.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaDesde: raw.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: raw.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
      },
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<number | void> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.socioId, common)
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          ...common,
          fechaAlta: raw.fechaAlta,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Productor actualizado'
              : 'Productor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value:
              typeof value === 'number'
                ? value
                : current?.socioId ?? null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el productor'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el productor',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedPartnerCode(): void {
    if (this.current()) {
      return;
    }

    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoSocio.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('SOC', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    const current = this.current();

    if (
      result.isPartner
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.socioId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta persona ya está registrada como socio.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);

      const resolvedType = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
      const resolvedDocument = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value;

      if (resolvedType === 'DNI' || resolvedType === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(resolvedType, resolvedDocument),
        );
      }

      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set('Datos de la persona cargados.');
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = result.found
      ? {
          names: true,
          paternalSurname: true,
          maternalSurname: true,
          birthDate: true,
          phone: true,
          email: true,
          geography: true,
          reference: true,
        }
      : emptyIdentityFieldLocks();

    this.form.patchValue({
      tipoDocumento:
        result.documentType === 'RUC' ? 'RUC' :
        result.documentType === 'DNI' ? 'DNI' :
        this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      numeroDocumento:
        result.documentNumber?.trim() ||
        this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? result.phone.trim().slice(0, 30)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  canEditIdentityData(): boolean {
    return this.permissions.has('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR');
  }

  canToggleIdentityEditing(): boolean {
    return this.identityRecordLoaded()
      && this.canEditIdentityData();
  }

  toggleIdentityEditing(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(
      enabled && this.canToggleIdentityEditing(),
    );
  }

  isIdentityFieldReadOnly(
    field: keyof IdentityFieldLocks,
  ): boolean {
    return this.identityLocks()[field]
      && !this.identityEditingEnabled();
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(false);
    this.identityRecordLoaded.set(false);
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoProductor,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeProducerDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoProductor {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">

    @if (errorMessage()) { <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div> }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Identificación</span></div>

            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading() || !!current()"

          />
          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button type="button" class="identity-search-button" [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()" [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()" (click)="resolveIdentity()">
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> Buscando...
              } @else {

      <div class="admin-field">

        <select id="producerMembershipStatus" class="admin-select" formControlName="situacionMembresia">
          @for (membership of memberships; track membership.value) { <option [value]="membership.value">{{ membership.label }}</option> }
        </select>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
          @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faPlus, faTrashCan, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarProductoresUseCase } from '../../../../../../productores/application/use-case/listar-productores.use-case';
import { CrearPredioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-predio.use-case';
import { EditarPredioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-predio.use-case';
import { PredioDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/predio-detalle.model';
import { TipoTitularidad, TitularidadInput } from '../../../../../domain/titularidad.model';
import { PredioMapComponent } from '../../components/predio-map/predio-map';

interface ProducerOption {
  id: number;
  label: string;
  document: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-predio-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
    PredioMapComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './predio-form.html',
  styleUrl: './predio-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PredioFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly create = inject(CrearPredioUseCase);
  private readonly update = inject(EditarPredioUseCase);
  private readonly producersUseCase = inject(ListarProductoresUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly current = signal<PredioDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly producers = signal<readonly ProducerOption[]>([]);
  readonly owners = signal<readonly TitularidadInput[]>([]);
  readonly latitude = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly longitude = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly deleteIcon = faTrashCan;

  readonly ownershipTypes: readonly TipoTitularidad[] = [
    'PROPIETARIO',
    'COPROPIETARIO',
    'POSESIONARIO',
    'ARRENDATARIO',
    'OTRO',
  ];

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    fechaRegistro: ['', [Validators.required]],
    distritoCodigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)]],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    altitudM: [0],
    areaTotalHa: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.0001)]],
    areaCultivableHa: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    tipoRiego: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    fuenteAgua: ['', [Validators.maxLength(150)]],
    infraestructura: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    fechaDesde: ['', [Validators.required]],
    ownerSocioId: [0],
    ownerTipo: ['PROPIETARIO' as TipoTitularidad],
    ownerPorcentaje: [100, [Validators.min(0.01), Validators.max(100)]],
  });

  open(detail: PredioDetalle | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(detail);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.owners.set(
      detail?.titulares
        .filter((item) => item.estado)
        .map((item) => ({
          socioId: item.socioId,
          tipoTitularidad: item.tipoTitularidad as TipoTitularidad,
          porcentaje: item.porcentaje,
        })) ?? [],
    );
    this.latitude.set(detail?.latitud ?? null);
    this.longitude.set(detail?.longitud ?? null);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null);

    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    this.form.reset({
      codigo: detail?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: detail?.nombre ?? '',
      fechaRegistro: detail?.fechaRegistro?.slice(0, 10) ?? today,
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      altitudM: detail?.altitudM ?? 0,
      areaTotalHa: detail?.areaTotalHa ?? 0,
      areaCultivableHa: detail?.areaCultivableHa ?? 0,
      tipoRiego: detail?.tipoRiego ?? '',
      fuenteAgua: detail?.fuenteAgua ?? '',
      infraestructura: detail?.infraestructura ?? '',
      observacion: detail?.observacion ?? '',
      fechaDesde: detail?.fechaDesde?.slice(0, 10) ?? today,
      ownerSocioId: 0,
      ownerTipo: 'PROPIETARIO',
      ownerPorcentaje: 100,
    });

    this.loadProducers();
    this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  setLocation(point: { latitude: number; longitude: number }): void {
    this.latitude.set(point.latitude);
    this.longitude.set(point.longitude);
  }

  addOwner(): void {
    const value = this.form.getRawValue();
    const id = Number(value.ownerSocioId);
    const percentage = Number(value.ownerPorcentaje);

    if (!id || percentage <= 0 || percentage > 100) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.owners().some((item) => item.socioId === id)) {
      this.error.set('El socio ya forma parte de la titularidad.');
      return;
    }
    if (this.totalOwnership() + percentage > 100.0001) {
      this.error.set('La suma de porcentajes no puede superar el 100 %.');
      return;
    }

    this.error.set(null);
    this.owners.set([
      ...this.owners(),
      {
        socioId: id,
        tipoTitularidad: value.ownerTipo,
        porcentaje: percentage,
      },
    ]);
    this.form.patchValue({
      ownerSocioId: 0,
      ownerPorcentaje: Math.max(0, 100 - this.totalOwnership()),
    });
  }

  removeOwner(index: number): void {
    this.owners.set(this.owners().filter((_, current) => current !== index));
  }

  totalOwnership(): number {
    return this.owners().reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.porcentaje, 0);
  }

  producerLabel(id: number): string {
    return this.producers().find((item) => item.id === id)?.label ?? `Socio ${id}`;
  }

  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    const value = this.form.getRawValue();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }
    if (value.areaCultivableHa > value.areaTotalHa) {
      this.error.set('El área cultivable no puede superar el área total.');
      return;
    }
    if (this.owners().length === 0) {
      this.error.set('Agrega al menos un titular.');
      return;
    }

    const base = {
      codigo: value.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
      nombre: value.nombre.trim(),
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: value.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(value.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(value.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: value.referencia.trim() || undefined,
        latitud: this.latitude() ?? undefined,
        longitud: this.longitude() ?? undefined,
        altitudM: Number(value.altitudM) || undefined,
      },
      caracteristicas: {
        areaTotalHa: Number(value.areaTotalHa),
        areaCultivableHa: Number(value.areaCultivableHa),
        tipoRiego: value.tipoRiego.trim().toUpperCase(),
        fuenteAgua: value.fuenteAgua.trim() || undefined,
        infraestructura: value.infraestructura.trim() || undefined,
        observacion: value.observacion.trim() || undefined,
        fechaDesde: value.fechaDesde,
      },
      titulares: this.owners(),
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = this.current()
      ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.predioId, {
          codigo: base.codigo,
          nombre: base.nombre,
          fechaTitularidad: value.fechaDesde,
          ubicacion: base.ubicacion,
          caracteristicas: base.caracteristicas,
          titulares: base.titulares,
        })
      : this.create.execute({ ...base, fechaRegistro: value.fechaRegistro });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            this.current() ? 'Predio actualizado' : 'Predio registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.error.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            this.current()
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el predio'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el predio',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private loadProducers(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.producersUseCase
      .execute({ situacion: 'ACTIVO', page: 1, size: 200 })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.producers.set(
            result.items.map((item) => ({
              id: item.socioId,
              label: [item.nombres, item.apellidoPaterno, item.apellidoMaterno]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' '),
              document: item.numeroDocumento,
            })),
          ),
        error: () => this.producers.set([]),
      });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialog.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.error.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
      />
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito"/></div>

      <div class="admin-field"><label>Área total (ha)</label><input type="number" step="0.0001" min="0" class="admin-input" formControlName="areaTotalHa"/></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Área cultivable (ha)</label><input type="number" step="0.0001" min="0" class="admin-input" formControlName="areaCultivableHa"/></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de riego</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="tipoRiego" maxlength="50" placeholder="Ej. Goteo"/></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Fuente de agua</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="fuenteAgua" maxlength="150"/></div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Titulares</label><div class="owner-editor"><select class="admin-select" formControlName="ownerSocioId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar socio</option>@for(p of producers();track p.id){<option [value]="p.id">{{p.label}} · {{p.document}}</option>}</select><select class="admin-select" formControlName="ownerTipo">@for(t of ownershipTypes;track t){<option [value]="t">{{t}}</option>}</select><input type="number" min=".01" max="100" step=".01" class="admin-input" formControlName="ownerPorcentaje"/><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (click)="addOwner()">@if(referencesLoading()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="addIcon"/>} Agregar</button></div><div class="owner-list">@for(o of owners();track o.socioId;let i=$index){<article><div><strong>{{producerLabel(o.socioId)}}</strong><span>{{o.tipoTitularidad}} · {{o.porcentaje}}%</span></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" (click)="removeOwner(i)"><fa-icon [icon]="deleteIcon"/></button></article>}@empty{<p>Agrega al menos un titular.</p>}</div><div class="owner-total">Total: <strong>{{totalOwnership() | number:'1.0-2'}}%</strong></div></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" formControlName="observacion" rows="3" maxlength="500"></textarea></div>
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">@if(saving()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando...}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon"/> Guardar}</button></footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faPlus, faRoute, faTrashCan, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/empleados/application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { EditarSalidaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-salida.use-case';
import { ProgramarSalidaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/programar-salida.use-case';

import { SalidaParticipanteInput } from '../../../../../domain/salida-participante.model';
interface ParticipantRow extends SalidaParticipanteInput {
    label: string;
}
@Component({ selector: 'app-salida-form', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent], templateUrl: './salida-form.html', styleUrl: './salida-form.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class SalidaFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
    private readonly employeesUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
    private readonly program = inject(ProgramarSalidaUseCase);
    private readonly update = inject(EditarSalidaUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly refsLoading = signal(false);
    readonly current = signal<SalidaDetalle | null>(null);
    readonly motives = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly participants = signal<readonly ParticipantRow[]>([]);
    readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
    private resolver: ((r: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly pageIcon = faRoute;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly deleteIcon = faTrashCan;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ motivoSalidaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], fechaHoraProgramada: ['', [Validators.required]], descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(400)]], empleadoId: [0], funcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]], esResponsable: [false] });
    open(detail: SalidaDetalle | null = null) { this.current.set(detail); this.error.set(null); this.participants.set(detail?.participantes.filter(x => x.estado).map(x => ({ empleadoId: x.empleadoId, funcion: x.funcion ?? undefined, esResponsable: x.esResponsable, label: this.personName(x) })) ?? []); this.form.reset({ motivoSalidaId: detail?.salida.motivoSalidaId ?? 0, fechaHoraProgramada: this.toLocal(detail?.salida.fechaHoraProgramada), descripcion: detail?.salida.descripcion ?? '', empleadoId: 0, funcion: '', esResponsable: false }); this.loadReferences(); this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise<AdminModalResult>(r => this.resolver = r); }
    close() { if (!this.saving())
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
    addParticipant() { const v = this.form.getRawValue(), id = Number(v.empleadoId); if (!id)
        return; if (this.participants().some(x => x.empleadoId === id)) {
        this.error.set('El empleado ya forma parte de la salida.');
        return;
    } const option = this.employees().find(x => x.value === id); this.participants.set([...this.participants(), { empleadoId: id, funcion: v.funcion.trim() || undefined, esResponsable: v.esResponsable, label: option?.label ?? `Empleado ${id}` }]); this.form.patchValue({ empleadoId: 0, funcion: '', esResponsable: false }); this.error.set(null); }
    removeParticipant(index: number) { this.participants.set(this.participants().filter((_, i) => i !== index)); }
    save() { this.form.markAllAsTouched(); const v = this.form.getRawValue(); if (this.form.invalid || this.saving())
        return; if (this.participants().length === 0) {
        this.error.set('Agrega al menos un participante.');
        return;
    } const input = { motivoSalidaId: Number(v.motivoSalidaId), fechaHoraProgramada: new Date(v.fechaHoraProgramada).toISOString(), descripcion: v.descripcion.trim() || undefined, participantes: this.participants().map(({ label, ...p }) => p) }; this.saving.set(true); this.error.set(null); const op: Observable<unknown> = this.current() ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.salida.salidaCampoId, input) : this.program.execute(input); op.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success(this.current() ? 'Salida actualizada' : 'Salida programada'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); }, error: e => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(e).message) }); }
    private loadReferences() { this.refsLoading.set(true); let pending = 2; const done = () => { pending--; if (pending === 0)
        this.refsLoading.set(false); }; this.refs.catalog('MOTIVO_SALIDA').subscribe({ next: r => { this.motives.set(r.map(x => ({ value: Number(x.id), label: x.label, description: x.code }))); if (!this.current() && this.motives()[0])
            this.form.patchValue({ motivoSalidaId: this.motives()[0].value }); done(); }, error: () => { this.motives.set([]); done(); } }); this.employeesUseCase.execute({ activo: true, page: 1, size: 200 }).subscribe({ next: r => { this.employees.set(r.items.map(x => ({ value: x.empleadoId, label: [x.nombres, x.apellidoPaterno, x.apellidoMaterno].filter(Boolean).join(' '), description: x.cargo || x.area }))); done(); }, error: () => { this.employees.set([]); done(); } }); }
    private personName(x: {
        nombres: string;
        apellidoPaterno: string;
        apellidoMaterno: string | null;
    }) { return [x.nombres, x.apellidoPaterno, x.apellidoMaterno].filter(Boolean).join(' '); }
    private toLocal(value: string | null | undefined) { const d = value ? new Date(value) : new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000); const off = d.getTimezoneOffset(); return new Date(d.getTime() - off * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16); }
    private finish(r: AdminModalResult) { if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open)
        this.dialog.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(r); this.resolver = null; this.current.set(null); this.error.set(null); }
}
```

```typescript
import { computed, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from '../access/access.store';
import { AccessModule } from '../access/models/access-module.model';
import { NavigationItem } from './navigation-item.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NavigationService {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly items = computed(() => this.buildTree(this.accessStore.modules()));

  private buildTree(modules: readonly AccessModule[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    const moduleById = new Map(
      modules.map((module) => [module.moduloId, module] as const),
    );

    const includedIds = new Set<number>();

    for (const module of modules) {
      if (!module.visibleMenu) {
        continue;
      }

      includedIds.add(module.moduloId);
      let parentId = module.moduloPadreId;

      while (parentId !== null) {
        const parent = moduleById.get(parentId);

        if (!parent || includedIds.has(parent.moduloId)) {
          break;
        }

        includedIds.add(parent.moduloId);
        parentId = parent.moduloPadreId;
      }
    }

    const included = modules.filter((module) =>
      includedIds.has(module.moduloId),
    );

    const byParent = new Map<number | null, AccessModule[]>();

    for (const module of included) {
      const key =
        module.moduloPadreId !== null && includedIds.has(module.moduloPadreId)
          ? module.moduloPadreId
          : null;

      const bucket = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
      bucket.push(module);
      byParent.set(key, bucket);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null): NavigationItem[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden || a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre))
        .map((module) => ({
          id: module.moduloId,
          code: module.codigo,
          label: module.nombre,
          route: this.normalizedRoute(module),
          icon: module.icono,
          order: module.orden,
          children: build(module.moduloId),
        }));

    return build(null);
  }

  private normalizedRoute(module: AccessModule): string | null {
    if (!module.visibleMenu) {
      return null;
    }

    if (module.codigo === 'CULTIVOS') {
      return '/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos';
    }

    if (module.codigo === 'PRODUCCION') {
      return '/gestion-tecnica/produccion';
    }

    return module.ruta;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBuilding,
  faChevronDown,
  faCircle,
  faClipboardList,
  faCoins,
  faFileShield,
  faFolderOpen,
  faGaugeHigh,
  faLeaf,
  faLocationDot,
  faMoneyBillTransfer,
  faRoute,
  faSeedling,
  faShop,
  faTruck,
  faUserGroup,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { NavigationItem } from '../../../core/navigation/navigation-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sidebar-item',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, RouterLinkActive, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './sidebar-item.html',
  styleUrl: './sidebar-item.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SidebarItemComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) item!: NavigationItem;
  @Input() collapsed = false;

  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() requestExpand = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly expanded = signal(false);
  readonly chevronIcon = faChevronDown;
  readonly childIcon = faCircle;

  toggleGroup(): void {
    if (this.item.children.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.collapsed) {
      this.requestExpand.emit();
      this.expanded.set(true);
      return;
    }

    this.expanded.update((value) => !value);
  }

  iconFor(item: NavigationItem): IconDefinition {
    const code = item.code.toUpperCase();

    if (code === 'INICIO') {
      return faGaugeHigh;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_TECNICA')) {
      return faSeedling;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_COMERCIAL')) {
      return faShop;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_FINANZAS')) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_RECURSOS')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_ADMIN')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_REPORTE')) {
      return faFileShield;
    }

    if (code.includes('PRODUCTOR') || code.includes('SOCIO')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (code.includes('PREDIO')) {
      return faLocationDot;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('CULTIVO') ||
      code.includes('PRODUCCION') ||
      code.includes('SANIDAD')
    ) {
      return code.includes('SANIDAD') ? faLeaf : faSeedling;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('SALIDA') ||
      code.includes('VISITA') ||
      code.includes('OPERATIVO')
    ) {
      return faRoute;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('JABA') ||
      code.includes('INVENTARIO') ||
      code.includes('RECURSO')
    ) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('ENTREGA')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('PAGO') ||
      code.includes('COBRO') ||
      code.includes('LIQUID')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (code.includes('GASTO') || code.includes('AJUSTE')) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    if (code.includes('USUARIO') || code.includes('ROL')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (code.includes('ORGANIZ')) {
      return faBuilding;
    }

    if (code.includes('REPORTE') || code.includes('AUDITOR')) {
      return faFileShield;
    }

    if (code.includes('CAMPANIA') || code.includes('PRECIO')) {
      return faShop;
    }

    if (code.includes('CENSO') || code.includes('EVALUACION')) {
      return faClipboardList;
    }

    return faFolderOpen;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faLayerGroup, faPen, faPlus, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { normalizeOptionalText, normalizeText, notBlankValidator, optionalNotBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { EditarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { Catalogo } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
@Component({
    selector: 'app-catalogo-detail',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
    templateUrl: './catalogo-detail.html',
    styleUrl: './catalogo-detail.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogoDetailComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearItemCatalogoUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarItemCatalogoUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly catalog = signal<Catalogo | null>(null);
    readonly current = signal<CatalogoItem | null>(null);
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly catalogIcon = faLayerGroup;
    private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>) => void) | null = null;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
        nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)]],
        descripcion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
        categoria: [''],
    });
    open(catalog: Catalogo, item: CatalogoItem | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>> {
        this.catalog.set(catalog);
        this.current.set(item);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: item?.codigo ?? '',
            nombre: item?.nombre ?? '',
            descripcion: catalog.codigo === 'PROBLEMA_FITOSANITARIO'
                ? ''
                : item?.descripcion ?? '',
            categoria: item?.categoria ?? '',
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo[item ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
        if (catalog.requiereCategoria) {
            this.form.controls.categoria.setValidators([Validators.required]);
        }
        else {
            this.form.controls.categoria.clearValidators();
        }
        this.form.controls.categoria.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
        this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            this.resolver = resolve;
        });
    }
    save(): void {
        const catalog = this.catalog();
        const current = this.current();

        if (catalog && !current) {
            this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(buildSystemCode(catalog.codigo, this.form.controls.nombre.value, 40), {
                emitEvent: false,
            });
        }

        this.form.markAllAsTouched();

        if (!catalog || this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.saving.set(true);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.id, {
                catalogo: catalog.codigo,
                nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
                categoria: raw.categoria.trim() || undefined,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                catalogo: catalog.codigo,
                codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
                nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
                categoria: raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Valor actualizado' : 'Valor registrado');
                this.finish({
                    saved: true,
                    value: current,
                });
            },
            error: (error) => {
                this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
            },
        });
    }
    close(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
    private finish(result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>): void {
        if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
            this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
        }
        this.resolver?.(result);
        this.resolver = null;
        this.catalog.set(null);
        this.current.set(null);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
    }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import {
  CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES,
  Catalogo,
} from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
import { CatalogoDetailComponent } from '../catalogo-detail/catalogo-detail';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    CatalogoDetailComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './catalogos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(CatalogoDetailComponent)
  private detailModal!: CatalogoDetailComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarCatalogosUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly catalogCode = signal(CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES[0].codigo);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<CatalogoItem>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly catalogs = CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES;
  readonly pageIcon = faLayerGroup;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly selectedCatalog = computed<Catalogo>(
    () =>
      this.catalogs.find((item) => item.codigo === this.catalogCode()) ??
      this.catalogs[0],
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        catalogo: this.catalogCode(),
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeCatalog(value: string): void {
    if (!value || value === this.catalogCode()) {
      return;
    }

    this.catalogCode.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog());

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  async edit(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog(), item);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    if (item.enUso || this.disablingId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar valor',
      message: `El valor "${item.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible para nuevos registros.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica por qué debe deshabilitarse este valor.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.disablingId.set(item.id);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(item.id, this.catalogCode(), confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Valor deshabilitado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Catálogos"
    subtitle="Administra los valores maestros utilizados por los procesos del sistema."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        Nuevo valor
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="catalogSelector">Catálogo</label>
        <select
          id="catalogSelector"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="catalogCode()"
          (change)="changeCatalog($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          @for (catalog of catalogs; track catalog.codigo) {
            <option [value]="catalog.codigo">{{ catalog.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="catalog-description">
        <strong>{{ selectedCatalog().nombre }}</strong>
        <span>{{ selectedCatalog().descripcion }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando catálogo"
        message="Consultando los valores disponibles."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        title="No se pudo cargar el catálogo"
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin valores registrados"
        message="Este catálogo todavía no tiene valores disponibles."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Código</th>
              <th>Nombre</th>
              <th>Descripción</th>
              <th class="text-center">Uso</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of result().items; track item.id) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                      <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ item.codigo }}</strong>
                      <span>Valor de catálogo</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td class="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  {{ item.nombre }}
                </td>
                <td class="max-w-md text-slate-500">
                  {{ item.descripcion || '—' }}
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-usage-badge"
                    [class.admin-usage-badge--used]="item.enUso"
                  >
                    {{ item.cantidadUso }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!item.estado"
                  >
                    {{ item.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar"
                      (click)="edit(item)"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                    </button>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_RETIRAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                      [attr.title]="item.enUso ? 'No se puede deshabilitar porque está en uso' : 'Deshabilitar'"
                      [disabled]="item.enUso || disablingId() === item.id"
                      (click)="disable(item)"
                    >
                      @if (disablingId() === item.id) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-catalogo-detail />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```
