```typescript
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBuilding,
  faCalendarDays,
  faChartLine,
  faCoins,
  faFileLines,
  faFilter,
  faGaugeHigh,
  faLeaf,
  faLocationDot,
  faMoneyBillTransfer,
  faSeedling,
  faTruck,
  faUserGroup,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ObtenerDashboardUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-dashboard.use-case';
import { Dashboard, EMPTY_DASHBOARD } from '../../../../../domain/dashboard.model';
import { DashboardFilter } from '../../../../../domain/dashboard-filter.model';
import { AlertasPanelComponent } from '../../components/alertas-panel/alertas-panel';
import { GraficosPanelComponent } from '../../components/graficos-panel/graficos-panel';
import { IndicadoresPanelComponent } from '../../components/indicadores-panel/indicadores-panel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inicio-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    AlertasPanelComponent,
    IndicadoresPanelComponent,
    GraficosPanelComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inicio.html',
  styleUrl: './inicio.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InicioPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly useCase = inject(ObtenerDashboardUseCase);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly dashboard = signal<Dashboard>(EMPTY_DASHBOARD);

  readonly dashboardIcon = faGaugeHigh;
  readonly filterIcon = faFilter;
  readonly resetIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;

  readonly today = this.localIsoDate(new Date());
  readonly desde = signal(this.offsetDate(-89));
  readonly hasta = signal(this.today);

  readonly greeting = computed(() => {
    const user = this.access.user();
    const firstName = user?.nombres?.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

    return firstName ? `Hola, ${firstName}` : 'Dashboard';
  });

  readonly primaryRole = computed(
    () => this.access.roles()[0]?.nombre ?? 'Perfil autorizado',
  );

  readonly filterError = computed(() => {
    const from = this.parseDate(this.desde());
    const to = this.parseDate(this.hasta());

    if (!from || !to) {
      return 'Selecciona un periodo válido.';
    }

    if (from.getTime() > to.getTime()) {
      return 'La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la fecha final.';
    }

    const days = Math.floor(
      (to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / 86_400_000,
    );

    if (days > 365) {
      return 'El periodo máximo permitido es de 366 días.';
    }

    if (this.hasta() > this.today) {
      return 'La fecha final no puede estar en el futuro.';
    }

    return null;
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (this.filterError()) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.useCase
      .execute(this.currentFilter())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (dashboard) => {
          this.dashboard.set(dashboard);

          if (dashboard.periodo.desde) {
            this.desde.set(dashboard.periodo.desde);
          }

          if (dashboard.periodo.hasta) {
            this.hasta.set(dashboard.periodo.hasta);
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  applyFilters(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  resetFilters(): void {
    this.desde.set(this.offsetDate(-89));
    this.hasta.set(this.today);
    this.load();
  }

  updateDesde(event: Event): void {
    this.desde.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }

  updateHasta(event: Event): void {
    this.hasta.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }

  iconForModule(code: string): IconDefinition {
    const normalized = code.toUpperCase();

    if (normalized.includes('PRODUCTOR') || normalized.includes('SOCIO')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('PREDIO')) {
      return faLocationDot;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('CULTIVO') ||
      normalized.includes('PRODUCCION') ||
      normalized.includes('SANIDAD')
    ) {
      return normalized.includes('SANIDAD') ? faLeaf : faSeedling;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('CAMPANIA') ||
      normalized.includes('OPERATIVO') ||
      normalized.includes('SALIDA') ||
      normalized.includes('VISITA')
    ) {
      return faCalendarDays;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('INVENTARIO') ||
      normalized.includes('RECURSO') ||
      normalized.includes('JABA')
    ) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('ENTREGA')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('PAGO') ||
      normalized.includes('COBRO') ||
      normalized.includes('LIQUID')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('GASTO') || normalized.includes('AJUSTE')) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('USUARIO') || normalized.includes('ROL')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('REPORTE') || normalized.includes('AUDITOR')) {
      return faFileLines;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('ORGANIZ')) {
      return faBuilding;
    }

    return faChartLine;
  }

  private currentFilter(): DashboardFilter {
    return {
      desde: this.desde(),
      hasta: this.hasta(),
    };
  }

  private offsetDate(days: number): string {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
    return this.localIsoDate(date);
  }

  private localIsoDate(date: Date): string {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  }

  private parseDate(value: string): Date | null {
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
      return null;
    }

    const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`);

    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }
}
```

```html
      <button

      >

    </div>

  <div class="dashboard-content">

      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando dashboard"

      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state

      <div class="dashboard-lower-grid">
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable, of, tap } from 'rxjs';

import {
  REFERENCE_DATA_GATEWAY,
  ReferenceDataGateway,
} from './reference-data.gateway';
import {
  GeographyItem,
  ReferenceCatalogCode,
  ReferenceItem,
} from './reference-data.model';
import { ReferenceDataStore } from './reference-data.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ReferenceDataService {
  private readonly gateway: ReferenceDataGateway = inject(REFERENCE_DATA_GATEWAY);
  private readonly store = inject(ReferenceDataStore);

  catalog(
    code: ReferenceCatalogCode,
    force = false,
  ): Observable<readonly ReferenceItem[]> {
    const cached = this.store.get(code);

    if (!force && cached) {
      return of(cached);
    }

    return this.gateway.listCatalog(code, 1, 200).pipe(
      map((page) => page.items.filter((item) => item.active)),
      tap((items) => this.store.set(code, items)),
    );
  }

  invalidateCatalog(code: ReferenceCatalogCode): void {
    this.store.remove(code);
  }

  departments(): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listDepartments();
  }

  provinces(departmentCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listProvinces(departmentCode);
  }

  districts(provinceCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listDistricts(provinceCode);
  }

  populationCenters(
    districtCode: string,
  ): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listPopulationCenters(districtCode);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import {
  PageResult,
  emptyPageResult,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import {
  CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES,
  Catalogo,
} from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
import { CatalogoDetailComponent } from '../catalogo-detail/catalogo-detail';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    CatalogoDetailComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './catalogos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(CatalogoDetailComponent)
  private detailModal!: CatalogoDetailComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarCatalogosUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  private readonly routeData = this.route.snapshot.data;
  readonly catalogs = CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES;

  readonly fixedCatalogCode = this.resolveFixedCatalogCode();
  readonly fixedCatalog = this.fixedCatalogCode !== null;

  readonly pageTitle = this.routeText('pageTitle', 'Catálogos');
  readonly pageSubtitle = this.routeText(
    'pageSubtitle',
    'Administra los valores maestros utilizados por los procesos del sistema.',
  );
  readonly createLabel = this.routeText('createLabel', 'Nuevo valor');
  readonly entityLabel = this.routeText('entityLabel', 'Valor de catálogo');
  readonly emptyTitle = this.routeText(
    'emptyTitle',
    'Sin valores registrados',
  );
  readonly emptyMessage = this.routeText(
    'emptyMessage',
    'Este catálogo todavía no tiene valores disponibles.',
  );

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly catalogCode = signal(
    this.fixedCatalogCode ?? CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES[0].codigo,
  );
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<CatalogoItem>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly pageIcon = faLayerGroup;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly selectedCatalog = computed<Catalogo>(
    () =>
      this.catalogs.find((item) => item.codigo === this.catalogCode()) ??
      this.catalogs[0],
  );

  readonly showDescription = computed(
    () => this.selectedCatalog().admiteDescripcion !== false,
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        catalogo: this.catalogCode(),
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeCatalog(value: string): void {
    if (this.fixedCatalog || !value || value === this.catalogCode()) {
      return;
    }

    this.catalogCode.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog());

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  async edit(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog(), item);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    if (item.enUso || this.disablingId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: `Deshabilitar ${this.entityLabel.toLowerCase()}`,
      message: `El valor "${item.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible para nuevos registros.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica por qué debe deshabilitarse este valor.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.disablingId.set(item.id);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(item.id, this.catalogCode(), confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(`${this.entityLabel} deshabilitado`);
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private resolveFixedCatalogCode(): string | null {
    const value = this.routeData['catalogCode'];

    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      return null;
    }

    const normalized = value.trim().toUpperCase();

    return this.catalogs.some((catalog) => catalog.codigo === normalized)
      ? normalized
      : null;
  }

  private routeText(key: string, fallback: string): string {
    const value = this.routeData[key];

    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()
      ? value.trim()
      : fallback;
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="pageTitle"
    [subtitle]="pageSubtitle"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        {{ createLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    @if (!fixedCatalog) {
      <div class="admin-toolbar">
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
          <label for="catalogSelector">Catálogo</label>
          <select
            id="catalogSelector"
            class="admin-select"
            [value]="catalogCode()"
            (change)="changeCatalog($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            @for (catalog of catalogs; track catalog.codigo) {
              <option [value]="catalog.codigo">{{ catalog.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="catalog-description">
          <strong>{{ selectedCatalog().nombre }}</strong>
          <span>{{ selectedCatalog().descripcion }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    }

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        [title]="'Cargando ' + selectedCatalog().nombre.toLowerCase()"
        message="Consultando los valores disponibles."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [title]="'No se pudo cargar ' + selectedCatalog().nombre.toLowerCase()"
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        [title]="emptyTitle"
        [message]="emptyMessage"
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Código</th>
              <th>Nombre</th>
              @if (showDescription()) {
                <th>Descripción</th>
              }
              <th class="text-center">Uso</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of result().items; track item.id) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                      <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ item.codigo }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ entityLabel }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td class="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  {{ item.nombre }}
                </td>
                @if (showDescription()) {
                  <td class="max-w-md text-slate-500">
                    {{ item.descripcion || '—' }}
                  </td>
                }
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-usage-badge"
                    [class.admin-usage-badge--used]="item.enUso"
                  >
                    {{ item.cantidadUso }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!item.estado"
                  >
                    {{ item.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar"
                      (click)="edit(item)"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                    </button>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_RETIRAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                      [attr.title]="item.enUso ? 'No se puede deshabilitar porque está en uso' : 'Deshabilitar'"
                      [disabled]="item.enUso || disablingId() === item.id"
                      (click)="disable(item)"
                    >
                      @if (disablingId() === item.id) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-catalogo-detail />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBookOpen,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTrashCan,
  faTruck,
  faWarehouse,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/catalogos/application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { ConsultarKardexSuministroUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-kardex-suministro.use-case';
import { ListarBienesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-bienes.use-case';
import { ListarSuministrosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-suministros.use-case';
import { RetirarBienUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-bien.use-case';
import { BienInventario } from '../../../../../domain/bien-inventario.model';
import { MovimientoSuministro } from '../../../../../domain/movimiento-suministro.model';
import { Suministro } from '../../../../../domain/suministro.model';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';

type InventoryTab = 'assets' | 'supplies';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inventario-vehiculos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InventarioVehiculosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private form!: RecursoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listAssetsUseCase = inject(ListarBienesUseCase);
  private readonly listSuppliesUseCase = inject(ListarSuministrosUseCase);
  private readonly kardexUseCase = inject(ConsultarKardexSuministroUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarBienUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly catalogsUseCase = inject(ListarCatalogosUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly tab = signal<InventoryTab>('assets');
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly suppliesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly suppliesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly retiringId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly kardexSupply = signal<Suministro | null>(null);
  readonly kardexLoading = signal(false);
  readonly kardexError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly kardexItems = signal<readonly MovimientoSuministro[]>([]);

  readonly assets = signal<PageResult<BienInventario>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly supplies = signal<PageResult<Suministro>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly types = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly typeFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly assetIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly supplyIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly truckIcon = faTruck;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadAssets(1);
    this.loadSupplies(1);
  }

  setTab(tab: InventoryTab): void { this.tab.set(tab); }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      companies: this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100),
      types: this.catalogsUseCase.execute({ catalogo: 'TIPO_BIEN', page: 1, size: 100 }),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, types }) => {
          this.companies.set(companies.items.map((item) => ({ value: item.empresaId, label: item.razonSocial, description: item.ruc })));
          this.types.set(types.items.filter((item) => item.estado).map((item) => ({ value: item.id, label: item.nombre, description: item.codigo })));
        },
        error: () => { this.companies.set([]); this.types.set([]); },
      });
  }

  loadAssets(page = this.assets().page, size = this.assets().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.listAssetsUseCase
      .execute({
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        tipoBienId: this.typeFilter() ?? undefined,
        estadoBien: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.assets.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadSupplies(page = this.supplies().page, size = this.supplies().size): void {
    this.suppliesLoading.set(true);
    this.suppliesError.set(null);
    this.listSuppliesUseCase.execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.suppliesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.supplies.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.suppliesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createAsset(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('createAsset', { companies: this.companies(), assetTypes: this.types() });
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets(1);
  }

  async editAsset(asset: BienInventario): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('editAsset', { asset });
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets();
  }

  async createSupply(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('createSupply');
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies(1);
  }

  async editSupply(supply: Suministro): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('editSupply', { supply });
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies();
  }

  async movement(supply: Suministro): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('movement', { supply });
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadSupplies();
      if (this.kardexSupply()?.suministroId === supply.suministroId) this.openKardex(supply);
    }
  }

  openKardex(supply: Suministro): void {
    this.kardexSupply.set(supply);
    this.kardexItems.set([]);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
    this.kardexLoading.set(true);
    this.kardexUseCase.execute(supply.suministroId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.kardexLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardexItems.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.kardexError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  closeKardex(): void {
    this.kardexSupply.set(null);
    this.kardexItems.set([]);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
  }

  async retire(asset: BienInventario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.retiringId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Dar de baja el bien',
      message: `El bien “${asset.nombre}” quedará fuera de uso.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Dar de baja',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la baja.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.retiringId.set(asset.bienInventarioId);
    this.retireUseCase.execute(asset.bienInventarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Bien dado de baja'); this.loadAssets(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo dar de baja el bien', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';

import { ApiError } from '../models/api-error.model';

interface BackendErrorEnvelope {
  codigo?: unknown;
  mensaje?: unknown;
  correlacionId?: unknown;
  fechaHoraUtc?: unknown;
}

export const apiErrorInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) =>
  next(request).pipe(
    catchError((error: unknown) => {
      if (!(error instanceof HttpErrorResponse)) {
        return throwError(() => error);
      }

      const payload =
        error.error && typeof error.error === 'object'
          ? (error.error as BackendErrorEnvelope)
          : null;

      const normalized: ApiError = {
        status: error.status,
        code:
          typeof payload?.codigo === 'string'
            ? payload.codigo
            : error.status === 0
              ? 'SERVICIO_NO_DISPONIBLE'
              : 'ERROR_HTTP',
        message:
          typeof payload?.mensaje === 'string'
            ? payload.mensaje
            : error.status === 0
              ? 'No se pudo establecer comunicación con el servidor.'
              : error.message || 'La operación no pudo completarse.',
        correlationId:
          typeof payload?.correlacionId === 'string'
            ? payload.correlacionId
            : null,
        timestamp:
          typeof payload?.fechaHoraUtc === 'string'
            ? payload.fechaHoraUtc
            : null,
        details: error.error,
      };

      return throwError(() => normalized);
    }),
  );
```

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class IdempotencyKeyService {
  create(): string {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
      return crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}-${Math.random()
      .toString(36)
      .slice(2)}`;
  }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260912_145202_450623\src\app\core\navigation\navigation.service.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145202_450623/src/app/core/navigation/navigation.service.ts`

```typescript
import { computed, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from '../access/access.store';
import { AccessModule } from '../access/models/access-module.model';
import { NavigationItem } from './navigation-item.model';

const TIPOS_BIEN_NAV_ID = -6_001;

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NavigationService {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly items = computed(() =>
    this.withFrontendEntries(
      this.buildTree(this.accessStore.modules()),
    ),
  );

  private buildTree(
    modules: readonly AccessModule[],
  ): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    const moduleById = new Map(
      modules.map((module) => [module.moduloId, module] as const),
    );

    const includedIds = new Set<number>();

    for (const module of modules) {
      if (!module.visibleMenu) {
        continue;
      }

      includedIds.add(module.moduloId);
      let parentId = module.moduloPadreId;

      while (parentId !== null) {
        const parent = moduleById.get(parentId);

        if (!parent || includedIds.has(parent.moduloId)) {
          break;
        }

        includedIds.add(parent.moduloId);
        parentId = parent.moduloPadreId;
      }
    }

    const included = modules.filter((module) =>
      includedIds.has(module.moduloId),
    );

    const byParent = new Map<number | null, AccessModule[]>();

    for (const module of included) {
      const key =
        module.moduloPadreId !== null &&
        includedIds.has(module.moduloPadreId)
          ? module.moduloPadreId
          : null;

      const bucket = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
      bucket.push(module);
      byParent.set(key, bucket);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null): NavigationItem[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .sort(
          (a, b) =>
            a.orden - b.orden || a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre),
        )
        .map((module) => ({
          id: module.moduloId,
          code: module.codigo,
          label: module.nombre,
          route: this.normalizedRoute(module),
          icon: module.icono,
          order: module.orden,
          children: build(module.moduloId),
        }));

    return build(null);
  }

  private withFrontendEntries(
    items: readonly NavigationItem[],
  ): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    if (!this.hasPermission('CATALOGOS_LISTAR')) {
      return items;
    }

    const decorate = (
      nodes: readonly NavigationItem[],
    ): NavigationItem[] =>
      nodes.map((node) => {
        let children = decorate(node.children);

        const catalog = children.find(
          (child) => child.code.trim().toUpperCase() === 'CATALOGOS',
        );

        const alreadyAdded = children.some(
          (child) => child.code.trim().toUpperCase() === 'TIPOS_BIEN',
        );

        if (catalog && !alreadyAdded) {
          children = [
            ...children,
            {
              id: TIPOS_BIEN_NAV_ID,
              code: 'TIPOS_BIEN',
              label: 'Tipos de bien',
              route: '/administracion/tipos-bien',
              icon: 'boxes-stacked',
              order: catalog.order + 1,
              children: [],
            },
          ].sort(
            (a, b) =>
              a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label),
          );
        }

        return {
          ...node,
          children,
        };
      });

    return decorate(items);
  }

  private hasPermission(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();

    return this.accessStore
      .permissions()
      .some(
        (permission) =>
          permission.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized,
      );
  }

  private normalizedRoute(module: AccessModule): string | null {
    if (!module.visibleMenu) {
      return null;
    }

    if (module.codigo === 'CULTIVOS') {
      return '/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos';
    }

    if (module.codigo === 'PRODUCCION') {
      return '/gestion-tecnica/produccion';
    }

    return module.ruta;
  }
}
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
  font-family:
    Inter,
    ui-sans-serif,
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    'Segoe UI',
    sans-serif;
}

.auth-form-card {
  width: min(100%, 24rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.auth-form-header {
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.auth-form-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #172033;
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 750;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.auth-login-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.35rem;
}

.auth-field {
  min-width: 0;
}

.auth-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: #344054;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
}

.auth-password-row {
  display: flex;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.auth-password-row .auth-label {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.auth-forgot-link {
  color: #3159c7;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 140ms ease;
}

.auth-forgot-link:hover {
  color: #21449f;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 0.18rem;
}

.auth-forgot-link:focus-visible {
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
  outline: 2px solid rgb(49 89 199 / 0.2);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.auth-input-wrap {
  position: relative;
}

.auth-input-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 1rem;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #98a2b3;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: color 140ms ease;
}

.auth-input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 3.25rem;
  border: 1px solid #d0d5dd;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0 0.95rem 0 2.7rem;
  color: #172033;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  outline: none;
  transition:
    border-color 140ms ease,
    box-shadow 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease;
}

.auth-input::placeholder {
  color: #98a2b3;
  opacity: 1;
}

.auth-input:hover:not(:focus) {
  border-color: #b5bdc9;
}

.auth-input:focus {
  border-color: #5272cf;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(49 89 199 / 0.1);
}

.auth-input:read-only {
  cursor: default;
}

.auth-input-wrap:focus-within .auth-input-icon {
  color: #3159c7;
}

.auth-input-password {
  padding-right: 3rem;
}

.auth-password-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 0.55rem;
  display: grid;
  width: 2.15rem;
  height: 2.15rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: transparent;
  color: #667085;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  transition:
    background-color 140ms ease,
    color 140ms ease;
}

.auth-password-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #f2f4f7;
  color: #344054;
}

.auth-password-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid rgb(49 89 199 / 0.2);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.auth-password-toggle:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.auth-primary-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 3.25rem;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid #264db8;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #3159c7;
  color: #ffffff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 140ms ease,
    border-color 140ms ease,
    box-shadow 140ms ease;
}

.auth-primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #21449f;
  background: #294ead;
}

.auth-primary-button:active:not(:disabled) {
  background: #234596;
}

.auth-primary-button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid rgb(49 89 199 / 0.16);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.auth-primary-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.64;
}

.auth-inline-error {
  margin: -0.65rem 0 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid #fecdca;
  border-radius: 0.65rem;
  background: #fffbfa;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  color: #b42318;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 550;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .auth-form-card {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .auth-form-header {
    margin-bottom: 1.65rem;
  }

  .auth-form-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }

  .auth-password-row {
    align-items: center;
  }
}
```

### 131. `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145202_697445/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/out/http/interceptors/session-refresh.interceptor.ts`

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145202_697445/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/out/http/interceptors/session-refresh.interceptor.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260912_145202_697445\src\app\features\acceso\adapter\out\http\interceptors\session-refresh.interceptor.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145202_697445/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/out/http/interceptors/session-refresh.interceptor.ts`

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import {
  Observable,
  catchError,
  defer,
  finalize,
  shareReplay,
  switchMap,
  throwError,
} from 'rxjs';

import { SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH } from '../../../../../../core/http/context/http-context.tokens';
import { AccessService } from '../../../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { AuthRefreshResult } from '../../../../domain/auth-context.model';
import { RefrescarSesionUseCase } from '../../../../application/use-case/refrescar-sesion.use-case';

let refreshInFlight$: Observable<AuthRefreshResult> | null = null;

export const sessionRefreshInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) => {
  if (request.context.get(SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH)) {
    return next(request);
  }

  const session = inject(SessionStore);
  const access = inject(AccessService);
  const refreshUseCase = inject(RefrescarSesionUseCase);

  return next(request).pipe(
    catchError((error: unknown) => {
      if (
        !(error instanceof HttpErrorResponse) ||
        error.status !== 401 ||
        !session.refreshToken()
      ) {
        return throwError(() => error);
      }

      if (!refreshInFlight$) {
        refreshInFlight$ = defer(() => refreshUseCase.execute()).pipe(
          finalize(() => {
            refreshInFlight$ = null;
          }),
          shareReplay({ bufferSize: 1, refCount: false }),
        );
      }

      return refreshInFlight$.pipe(
        switchMap(() => next(request)),
        catchError((refreshError) => {
          session.clear();
          access.clear();
          return throwError(() => refreshError);
        }),
      );
    }),
  );
};
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
}

.role-permission-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.role-permission-summary > div {
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: white;
  padding: 0.9rem;
}

.role-permission-summary span,
.permission-group header span {
  display: block;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.role-permission-summary strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.permission-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.permission-count {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.permission-groups {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.permission-group {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
}

.permission-group > header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
}

.permission-group h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.permission-options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.permission-option {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.permission-option:nth-child(odd) {
  border-right: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
}

.permission-option:has(.permission-checkbox-native:checked) {
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.permission-option:focus-within {
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.permission-checkbox-native {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.permission-option .permission-checkbox-box {
  display: grid;
  width: 1.25rem;
  height: 1.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  margin-top: 0.02rem;
  border: 2px solid #64748b;
  border-radius: 0.35rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: transparent;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    border-color 120ms ease,
    background-color 120ms ease,
    box-shadow 120ms ease,
    transform 120ms ease;
}

.permission-option .permission-checkbox-box--selected {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  background: #2563eb;
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.28);
}

.permission-option .permission-checkbox-check {
  display: block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  transform: translateY(-0.02rem);
  user-select: none;
}

.permission-checkbox-native:focus-visible + .permission-checkbox-box {
  outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.22);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.permission-option:hover .permission-checkbox-box:not(.permission-checkbox-box--selected) {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  background: #eff6ff;
}

.permission-option:active .permission-checkbox-box:not(.permission-checkbox-box--readonly) {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}

.permission-checkbox-box--readonly {
  cursor: default;
}

.permission-option:has(.permission-checkbox-box--readonly) {
  cursor: default;
}

.permission-option > div {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.permission-option strong,
.permission-option span,
.permission-option small {
  display: block;
}

.permission-option strong {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.permission-option span {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.permission-option small {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.permission-option em {
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #fff7ed;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.4rem;
  color: #c2410c;
  font-size: 0.56rem;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.permission-reason {
  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.permission-reason label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .role-permission-summary,
  .permission-options {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .permission-option:nth-child(odd) {
    border-right: 0;
  }

  .permission-toolbar {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}
```

```css
:host { display: block; }
.producer-summary { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; }
.producer-avatar { display: grid; width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border-radius: .85rem; background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; }
.producer-main { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.producer-main > strong, .producer-main > span { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.producer-main > strong { color: #0f172a; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 800; }
.producer-main > span { margin-top: .15rem; color: #64748b; font-size: .65rem; }
.producer-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .55rem; margin-top: .45rem; color: #94a3b8; font-size: .61rem; font-weight: 650; }
.producer-meta span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; }
.producer-summary--compact .producer-meta { display: none; }
.producer-summary--compact .producer-avatar { width: 2.2rem; height: 2.2rem; }
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145203_461137/src/app/features/gestion-tecnica/productores/adapter/in/ui/pages/productor-form/productor-form.css`

```css
:host {
  display: contents;
}

.producer-form-section {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.identity-document-control {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.identity-search-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.65rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0 0.8rem;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.identity-search-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #93c5fd;
  background: #dbeafe;
}

.identity-search-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.identity-feedback {
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.72rem 0.85rem;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.identity-feedback--success {
  border-color: #bbf7d0;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #166534;
}

.identity-feedback--warning {
  border-color: #fde68a;
  background: #fffbeb;
  color: #92400e;
}

.identity-feedback--error {
  border-color: #fecaca;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.identity-help,
.producer-form-error {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.38rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.producer-form-error {
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-weight: 650;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .identity-document-control {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .identity-search-button {
    width: 100%;
  }
}
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
}

.section-heading {
  display: flex;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.section-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.section-heading h2 {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.section-copy {
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.35rem;
}

.section-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 2.5rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.charts-grid {
  display: grid;
  width: 100%;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.chart-slot {
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

/*
 * Regla de composición:
 * - En escritorio siempre se muestran 2 gráficos por fila.
 * - Si la cantidad es impar, únicamente el último ocupa toda la fila.
 * - No se utiliza grafico.ancho para evitar que la configuración recibida
 *   fuerce cada tarjeta a una fila independiente.
 */
.charts-grid > .chart-slot:last-child:nth-child(odd) {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.empty-panel {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  border: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .charts-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .charts-grid > .chart-slot:last-child:nth-child(odd) {
    grid-column: auto;
  }
}
```

### 162. `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145203_736545/src/app/features/inicio/adapter/out/http/inicio-http.adapter.ts`

```typescript
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { environment } from '../../../../../../environments/environment';
import { ApiEnvelope } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { InicioGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/inicio.gateway';
import { DashboardFilter } from '../../../domain/dashboard-filter.model';
import { InicioHttpMapper } from './inicio-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class InicioHttpAdapter implements InicioGateway {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly mapper = inject(InicioHttpMapper);
  private readonly baseUrl = environment.apiBaseUrl;

  getDashboard(filter: DashboardFilter) {
    let params = new HttpParams();

    const desde = filter.desde?.trim();
    const hasta = filter.hasta?.trim();

    if (desde) {
      params = params.set('desde', desde);
    }

    if (hasta) {
      params = params.set('hasta', hasta);
    }

    return this.http
      .get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
        `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/dashboard`,
        {
          params,
          transferCache: false,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapper.dashboard(response),
        ),
      );
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header title="Inventario y vehículos" subtitle="Gestiona bienes, vehículos, suministros y movimientos." eyebrow="Recursos" [icon]="pageIcon" />

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="tab()==='assets'" (click)="setTab('assets')"><fa-icon [icon]="assetIcon" /> Bienes y vehículos</button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="tab()==='supplies'" (click)="setTab('supplies')"><fa-icon [icon]="supplyIcon" /> Suministros</button>
  </div>

  @if (tab()==='assets') {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar">
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Organización</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="companyFilter()??0" (change)="companyFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value||null); loadAssets(1)"><option [value]="0">Todas</option>@for (company of companies(); track company.value) { <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Tipo de bien</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="typeFilter()??0" (change)="typeFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value||null); loadAssets(1)"><option [value]="0">Todos</option>@for (type of types(); track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Estado</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); loadAssets(1)"><option value="">Todos</option><option value="DISPONIBLE">Disponible</option><option value="MANTENIMIENTO">Mantenimiento</option><option value="NO_DISPONIBLE">No disponible</option><option value="BAJA">Baja</option></select></div>
        <div class="admin-toolbar-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="loadAssets()"><fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (click)="createAsset()">@if(referencesLoading()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="addIcon"/>} Nuevo bien</button></div>
      </div>
      @if (loading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando inventario" message="Consultando bienes y vehículos." /> }
      @else if (errorMessage()) { <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage()||'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadAssets()" /> }
      @else if (assets().items.length===0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin bienes" message="No hay bienes para los filtros seleccionados." /> }
      @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Bien</th><th>Código</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Organización</th><th>Vehículo</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for (asset of assets().items; track asset.bienInventarioId) {
            <tr><td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{asset.nombre}}</strong><span>{{asset.marca||'—'}} {{asset.modelo||''}}</span></div></td><td><span class="admin-code">{{asset.codigoPatrimonial}}</span></td><td>{{asset.tipoBien}}</td><td>{{asset.empresa}}</td><td>@if(asset.vehiculo){<span class="admin-type-badge"><fa-icon [icon]="truckIcon"/> {{asset.placa}}</span>}@else{—}</td><td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="asset.estadoBien==='DISPONIBLE'" [class.admin-status--warning]="asset.estadoBien==='MANTENIMIENTO'" [class.admin-status--inactive]="asset.estadoBien==='BAJA'">{{asset.estadoBien}}</span></td><td><div class="admin-row-actions"><a *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos',asset.bienInventarioId]" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon"/></a><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="asset.estadoBien==='BAJA'" title="Editar" (click)="editAsset(asset)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon"/></button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" [disabled]="asset.estadoBien==='BAJA'||retiringId()===asset.bienInventarioId" title="Dar de baja" (click)="retire(asset)">@if(retiringId()===asset.bienInventarioId){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon"/>}</button></div></td></tr>
          }
        </tbody></table></div>
        <app-paginator [page]="assets().page" [size]="assets().size" [totalRecords]="assets().totalRecords" [totalPages]="assets().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAssets($event,assets().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAssets(1,$event)" />
      }
    </section>
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="suppliesLoading()" (click)="loadSupplies()"><fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="suppliesLoading()" [icon]="refreshIcon"/> Actualizar</button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="createSupply()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon"/> Nuevo suministro</button></div>
      @if(suppliesLoading()){<app-loading-state title="Cargando suministros" message="Consultando stock disponible."/>}
      @else if(suppliesError()){<app-error-state [message]="suppliesError()||'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadSupplies()"/>}
      @else if(supplies().items.length===0){<app-empty-state title="Sin suministros" message="No hay suministros registrados."/>}
      @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Suministro</th><th>Unidad</th><th class="text-right">Stock</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for(supply of supplies().items;track supply.suministroId){
            <tr><td><span class="admin-code">{{supply.codigo}}</span></td><td class="font-semibold text-slate-800">{{supply.nombre}}</td><td>{{supply.unidadMedida}}</td><td class="text-right font-semibold">{{supply.stock}}</td><td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="supply.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!supply.estado">{{supply.estado?'Activo':'Inactivo'}}</span></td><td><div class="admin-row-actions"><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver kardex" [disabled]="kardexLoading()&&kardexSupply()?.suministroId===supply.suministroId" (click)="openKardex(supply)">@if(kardexLoading()&&kardexSupply()?.suministroId===supply.suministroId){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="kardexIcon"/>}</button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="editSupply(supply)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon"/></button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small" (click)="movement(supply)">Movimiento</button></div></td></tr>
          }
        </tbody></table></div>
        <app-paginator [page]="supplies().page" [size]="supplies().size" [totalRecords]="supplies().totalRecords" [totalPages]="supplies().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadSupplies($event,supplies().size)" (sizeChange)="loadSupplies(1,$event)"/>
      }
    </section>

    @if(kardexSupply(); as selectedSupply){
      <section class="admin-surface mt-4 inventory-kardex">
        <div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Kardex</p><h2>{{selectedSupply.nombre}}</h2></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Cerrar kardex" (click)="closeKardex()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon"/></button></div>
        @if(kardexLoading()){<app-loading-state title="Cargando kardex" message="Consultando movimientos del suministro."/>}
        @else if(kardexError()){<app-error-state [message]="kardexError()||'No se pudo cargar el kardex.'" (retry)="openKardex(selectedSupply)"/>}
        @else{<div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Tipo</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Documento</th><th>Usuario</th><th>Observación</th></tr></thead><tbody>@for(item of kardexItems();track item.suministroMovimientoId){<tr><td><span class="admin-type-badge">{{item.tipoMovimiento}}</span></td><td>{{item.cantidad}} {{item.unidadMedida}}</td><td>{{item.fechaHora?(item.fechaHora|date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'):'—'}}</td><td>{{item.documentoReferencia||'—'}}</td><td>{{item.usuario||'—'}}</td><td>{{item.observacion||'—'}}</td></tr>}@empty{<tr><td colspan="6" class="admin-table-empty">No hay movimientos para este suministro.</td></tr>}</tbody></table></div>}
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-recurso-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBookOpen,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTrashCan,
  faTruck,
  faWarehouse,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { ConsultarKardexSuministroUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-kardex-suministro.use-case';
import { ListarBienesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-bienes.use-case';
import { ListarSuministrosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-suministros.use-case';
import { RetirarBienUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-bien.use-case';
import { BienInventario } from '../../../../../domain/bien-inventario.model';
import { MovimientoSuministro } from '../../../../../domain/movimiento-suministro.model';
import { Suministro } from '../../../../../domain/suministro.model';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';

type InventoryTab = 'assets' | 'supplies';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inventario-vehiculos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InventarioVehiculosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private form!: RecursoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listAssetsUseCase = inject(ListarBienesUseCase);
  private readonly listSuppliesUseCase = inject(ListarSuministrosUseCase);
  private readonly kardexUseCase = inject(ConsultarKardexSuministroUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarBienUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly referenceData = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly tab = signal<InventoryTab>('assets');
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly suppliesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly suppliesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly retiringId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly kardexSupply = signal<Suministro | null>(null);
  readonly kardexLoading = signal(false);
  readonly kardexError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly kardexItems = signal<readonly MovimientoSuministro[]>([]);

  readonly assets = signal<PageResult<BienInventario>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly supplies = signal<PageResult<Suministro>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly types = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly typeFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly assetIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly supplyIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly truckIcon = faTruck;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadAssets(1);
    this.loadSupplies(1);
  }

  setTab(tab: InventoryTab): void { this.tab.set(tab); }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      companies: this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100),
      types: this.referenceData.catalog('TIPO_BIEN'),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, types }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.items.map((item) => ({
              value: item.empresaId,
              label: item.razonSocial,
              description: item.ruc,
            })),
          );
          this.types.set(
            types
              .map((item) => ({
                value: Number(item.id),
                label: item.label,
                description: item.code,
              }))
              .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item.value) && item.value > 0),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.types.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  loadAssets(page = this.assets().page, size = this.assets().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.listAssetsUseCase
      .execute({
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        tipoBienId: this.typeFilter() ?? undefined,
        estadoBien: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.assets.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadSupplies(page = this.supplies().page, size = this.supplies().size): void {
    this.suppliesLoading.set(true);
    this.suppliesError.set(null);
    this.listSuppliesUseCase.execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.suppliesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.supplies.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.suppliesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createAsset(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('createAsset', { companies: this.companies(), assetTypes: this.types() });
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets(1);
  }

  async editAsset(asset: BienInventario): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('editAsset', { asset });
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets();
  }

  async createSupply(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('createSupply');
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies(1);
  }

  async editSupply(supply: Suministro): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('editSupply', { supply });
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies();
  }

  async movement(supply: Suministro): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('movement', { supply });
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadSupplies();
      if (this.kardexSupply()?.suministroId === supply.suministroId) this.openKardex(supply);
    }
  }

  openKardex(supply: Suministro): void {
    this.kardexSupply.set(supply);
    this.kardexItems.set([]);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
    this.kardexLoading.set(true);
    this.kardexUseCase.execute(supply.suministroId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.kardexLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardexItems.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.kardexError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  closeKardex(): void {
    this.kardexSupply.set(null);
    this.kardexItems.set([]);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
  }

  async retire(asset: BienInventario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.retiringId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Dar de baja el bien',
      message: `El bien “${asset.nombre}” quedará fuera de uso.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Dar de baja',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la baja.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.retiringId.set(asset.bienInventarioId);
    this.retireUseCase.execute(asset.bienInventarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Bien dado de baja'); this.loadAssets(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo dar de baja el bien', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core'; import { map } from 'rxjs'; import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service'; import { AdjustSupply,CreateSupply,InventarioYVehculosService,InventoryAssetCreateRequest,InventoryAssetUpdateRequest,RegisterVehicle,RetireAsset,UpdateMileage,UpdateSupply } from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated'; import { InventarioVehiculosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/inventario-vehiculos.gateway'; import { BienInventarioCreate,BienInventarioFiltro,BienInventarioUpdate } from '../../../domain/bien-inventario.model'; import { KilometrajeUpdate,VehiculoCreate } from '../../../domain/vehiculo.model'; import { MovimientoSuministroCreate } from '../../../domain/movimiento-suministro.model'; import { SuministroCreate,SuministroUpdate } from '../../../domain/suministro.model'; import { InventarioVehiculosHttpMapper } from './inventario-vehiculos-http.mapper';
@Injectable() export class InventarioVehiculosHttpAdapter implements InventarioVehiculosGateway{private readonly api=inject(InventarioYVehculosService);private readonly mapper=inject(InventarioVehiculosHttpMapper);private readonly idem=inject(IdempotencyKeyService);
listAssets(f:BienInventarioFiltro){return this.api.inventarioBienesListar({empresaId:f.empresaId,tipoBienId:f.tipoBienId,estadoBien:f.estadoBien,pagina:f.page,tamano:f.size},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.assetsPage(r,f.size)));} getAsset(id:number){return this.api.inventarioBienesVer({id},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.detail(r)));} createAsset(i:BienInventarioCreate){const inventoryAssetCreateRequest:InventoryAssetCreateRequest=i;return this.api.inventarioBienesCrear({xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),inventoryAssetCreateRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.createdId(r)));} updateAsset(id:number,i:BienInventarioUpdate){const inventoryAssetUpdateRequest:InventoryAssetUpdateRequest=i;return this.api.inventarioBienesEditar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),inventoryAssetUpdateRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.void(r)));} retireAsset(id:number,motivo:string){const retireAsset:RetireAsset={motivo};return this.api.inventarioBienesBaja({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),retireAsset},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.void(r)));}
getVehicle(id:number){return this.getAsset(id).pipe(map(d=>this.mapper.vehicle(d)));} registerVehicle(id:number,i:VehiculoCreate){const registerVehicle:RegisterVehicle=i;return this.api.inventarioVehiculosRegistrar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),registerVehicle},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.createdId(r)));} updateMileage(id:number,i:KilometrajeUpdate){const updateMileage:UpdateMileage=i;return this.api.inventarioVehiculosKilometraje({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),updateMileage},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.void(r)));}
listSupplies(page:number,size:number){return this.api.inventarioSuministrosListar({pagina:page,tamano:size},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.suppliesPage(r,size)));} createSupply(i:SuministroCreate){const createSupply:CreateSupply=i;return this.api.inventarioSuministrosCrear({xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),createSupply},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.createdId(r)));} updateSupply(id:number,i:SuministroUpdate){const updateSupply:UpdateSupply=i;return this.api.inventarioSuministrosEditar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),updateSupply},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.void(r)));} movements(suministroId?:number){return this.api.inventarioSuministrosKardex({suministroId},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.movements(r)));} registerMovement(id:number,i:MovimientoSuministroCreate){const adjustSupply:AdjustSupply=i;return this.api.inventarioSuministrosMovimientoRegistrar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),adjustSupply},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.createdId(r)));}}
```
