```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="icon()" /></span>
        <div><p>Recursos</p><h2>{{ title() }}</h2></div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (mode() === 'create') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="createForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationType">Destino</label>
          <select id="resourceDestinationType" class="admin-select" formControlName="destinoTipo">
            <option value="SALIDA">Salida de campo</option>
            <option value="OPERATIVO">Operativo de venta</option>
            <option value="CAMPANIA">Campaña de venta</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationId">Identificador del destino</label>
          <input id="resourceDestinationId" class="admin-input" type="number" min="1" step="1" formControlName="destinoId" />
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.destinoId" fieldLabel="El destino" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceType">Tipo de recurso</label>
          <select
            id="resourceType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="recursoTipo"
            (change)="changeResourceType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="BIEN">Bien / vehículo</option>
            <option value="SUMINISTRO">Suministro</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceId">Recurso disponible</label>
          <div class="resource-select-row">
            <select id="resourceId" class="admin-select" formControlName="recursoId">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @if (createForm.controls.recursoTipo.value === 'BIEN') {
                @for (asset of availableAssets(); track asset.bienInventarioId) {
                  <option [value]="asset.bienInventarioId">
                    {{ asset.codigoPatrimonial }} · {{ asset.nombre }}
                  </option>
                }
              } @else {
                @for (supply of availability().suministros; track supply.suministroId) {
                  <option [value]="supply.suministroId">
                    {{ supply.codigo }} · {{ supply.nombre }} · stock {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}
                  </option>
                }
              }
            </select>
            <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Actualizar disponibilidad" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="loadAvailability()">
              @if (loading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }
            </button>
          </div>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.recursoId" fieldLabel="El recurso" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="programmedQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
          <input
            id="programmedQuantity"
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0.001"
            step="0.001"
            formControlName="cantidadProgramada"
          />
          @if (selectedSupply(); as supply) {
            <small class="resource-helper">Disponible: {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}</small>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="programObservation">Observación</label>
          <textarea id="programObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || loading()">
            @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Programando... }
            @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Programar }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else if (loading()) {
      <div class="resource-modal-loading">
        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-lg"></span>
        <strong>Cargando recurso</strong>
        <span>Consultando el estado y sus movimientos.</span>
      </div>
    } @else if (current(); as detail) {
      @if (mode() === 'view') {
        <div class="resource-program-view">
          <section class="admin-detail-grid">
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Recurso</span><strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Destino</span><strong>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Cantidad</span><strong>{{ detail.cantidadProgramada }} {{ detail.unidadMedida || '' }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Estado</span><strong>{{ detail.estadoProceso }}</strong></article>
          </section>
          <section class="admin-surface">
            <div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Historial</p><h2>Movimientos</h2></div><span class="admin-count-badge">{{ detail.movimientos.length }}</span></div>
            <div class="admin-table-wrap">
              <table class="admin-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Movimiento</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Usuario</th><th>Observación</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  @for (movement of detail.movimientos; track movement.recursoMovimientoId) {
                    <tr>
                      <td>{{ movement.tipoMovimiento }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.cantidad }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.fechaHora ? (movement.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.usuario || '—' }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.observacion || '—' }}</td>
                    </tr>
                  } @empty {
                    <tr><td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">No hay movimientos registrados.</td></tr>
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="close()">Cerrar</button></footer>
        </div>
      } @else if (mode() === 'edit') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="editForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · {{ detail.estadoProceso }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="editQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
            <input id="editQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadProgramada" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="editObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="editObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="returnForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · cantidad programada {{ detail.cantidadProgramada }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="returnQuantity">Cantidad a devolver</label>
            <input id="returnQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadDevuelta" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="returnObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="returnObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Registrando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="returnIcon" /> Registrar devolución }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      }
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faEye,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-disponibilidad-recursos.use-case';
import { EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ProgramarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/programar-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-devolucion-recurso.use-case';
import { DisponibilidadRecurso } from '../../../../../domain/disponibilidad-recurso.model';
import {
  RecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
  TipoRecursoProgramable,
} from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';

export type RecursoProgramadoFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'view' | 'return';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurso-programado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './recurso-programado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './recurso-programado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoProgramadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly availabilityUseCase = inject(ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly programUseCase = inject(ProgramarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly returnUseCase = inject(RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly mode = signal<RecursoProgramadoFormMode>('create');
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<RecursoProgramadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly availability = signal<DisponibilidadRecurso>({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly resourceIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    destinoTipo: ['SALIDA' as TipoDestinoRecurso, [Validators.required]],
    destinoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    recursoTipo: ['BIEN' as TipoRecursoProgramable, [Validators.required]],
    recursoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly editForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly returnForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadDevuelta: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly availableAssets = computed(() =>
    this.availability().bienes.filter((item) => item.disponible),
  );

  readonly selectedSupply = computed(() => {
    const id = Number(this.createForm.controls.recursoId.value);
    return this.availability().suministros.find((item) => item.suministroId === id) ?? null;
  });

  async openCreate(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState('create');
    this.createForm.reset({
      destinoTipo: 'SALIDA',
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoTipo: 'BIEN',
      recursoId: 0,
      cantidadProgramada: 1,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loadAvailability();
    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  async openDetail(
    item: RecursoProgramado,
    mode: Exclude<RecursoProgramadoFormMode, 'create'>,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState(mode);
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.current.set(detail);
          this.editForm.reset({
            cantidadProgramada: detail.cantidadProgramada,
            observacion: detail.observacion ?? '',
          });
          this.returnForm.reset({
            cantidadDevuelta: detail.bienInventarioId ? 1 : Math.max(0.001, detail.cantidadProgramada),
            observacion: '',
          });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });

    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  changeResourceType(type: string): void {
    const resourceType = type as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    this.createForm.patchValue({ recursoTipo: resourceType, recursoId: 0 });
    if (resourceType === 'BIEN') {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
    }
  }

  loadAvailability(): void {
    if (this.loading()) return;
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availabilityUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (availability) => this.availability.set(availability),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    const mode = this.mode();
    if (this.saving() || this.loading() || mode === 'view') return;

    if (mode === 'create') {
      this.saveCreate();
    } else if (mode === 'edit') {
      this.saveEdit();
    } else {
      this.saveReturn();
    }
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create': return 'Programar recurso';
      case 'edit': return 'Editar programación';
      case 'return': return 'Registrar devolución';
      default: return 'Detalle del recurso programado';
    }
  }

  icon() {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create': return this.addIcon;
      case 'edit': return this.editIcon;
      case 'return': return this.returnIcon;
      default: return this.viewIcon;
    }
  }

  destinationLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    if (detail.campaniaVentaId) return `Campaña #${detail.campaniaVentaId}`;
    if (detail.operativoVentaId) return `Operativo #${detail.operativoVentaId}`;
    if (detail.salidaCampoId) return `Salida de campo #${detail.salidaCampoId}`;
    return 'Sin destino';
  }

  resourceLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    return detail.bien ?? detail.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  private saveCreate(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const resourceType = raw.recursoTipo as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    const quantity = resourceType === 'BIEN' ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);
    const selectedSupply = this.selectedSupply();

    if (resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' && selectedSupply && quantity > selectedSupply.stockDisponible) {
      this.errorMessage.set(`La cantidad supera el stock disponible (${selectedSupply.stockDisponible} ${selectedSupply.unidadMedida}).`);
      return;
    }

    const destinationId = Number(raw.destinoId);
    const input = {
      campaniaVentaId: raw.destinoTipo === 'CAMPANIA' ? destinationId : undefined,
      operativoVentaId: raw.destinoTipo === 'OPERATIVO' ? destinationId : undefined,
      salidaCampoId: raw.destinoTipo === 'SALIDA' ? destinationId : undefined,
      bienInventarioId: resourceType === 'BIEN' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      suministroId: resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      cantidadProgramada: quantity,
      observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.programUseCase
      .execute(input)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (id) => {
          this.toast.success('Recurso programado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: id });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveEdit(): void {
    this.editForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.editForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.editForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadProgramada: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Programación actualizada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveReturn(): void {
    this.returnForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.returnForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.returnForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadDevuelta);
    const alreadyReturned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);

    if (quantity + alreadyReturned > detail.cantidadProgramada) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La devolución supera la cantidad programada pendiente.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.returnUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadDevuelta: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Devolución registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private resetState(mode: RecursoProgramadoFormMode): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  private resultPromise(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolver = resolve; });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBan,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faCheck,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AsignarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/asignar-recurso.use-case';
import { CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cancelar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-recursos-programados.use-case';
import { RecursoProgramado } from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { RecursoProgramadoFormComponent } from '../recurso-programado-form/recurso-programado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recursos-programados-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoProgramadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './recursos-programados-list.html',
  styleUrl: './recursos-programados-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursosProgramadosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoProgramadoFormComponent)
  private form!: RecursoProgramadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase);
  private readonly assignUseCase = inject(AsignarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly cancelUseCase = inject(CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly actionId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<RecursoProgramado>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly campaignFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly operationFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly fieldTripFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly assignIcon = faCheck;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly cancelIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void { this.load(1); }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoProceso: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        campaniaVentaId: this.campaignFilter() ?? undefined,
        operativoVentaId: this.operationFilter() ?? undefined,
        salidaCampoId: this.fieldTripFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  setNumericFilter(target: 'campaign' | 'operation' | 'fieldTrip', value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    const id = Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
    if (target === 'campaign') this.campaignFilter.set(id);
    if (target === 'operation') this.operationFilter.set(id);
    if (target === 'fieldTrip') this.fieldTripFilter.set(id);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) this.load(1);
  }

  async view(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    await this.form.openDetail(item, 'view');
  }

  async edit(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'edit');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async returnResource(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'return');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async assign(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Asignar recurso',
      message: `El recurso #${item.recursoProgramadoId} pasará a ejecución y quedará asignado al destino programado.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Asignar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.assignUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Recurso asignado'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo asignar el recurso', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async cancel(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Cancelar programación',
      message: `La programación #${item.recursoProgramadoId} quedará cancelada.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Cancelar programación',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la cancelación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.cancelUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Programación cancelada'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo cancelar', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  resourceName(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bien ?? item.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  resourceKind(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bienInventarioId ? 'Bien / vehículo' : 'Suministro';
  }

  destination(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    if (item.campaniaVentaId) return `Campaña #${item.campaniaVentaId}`;
    if (item.operativoVentaId) return `Operativo #${item.operativoVentaId}`;
    if (item.salidaCampoId) return `Salida #${item.salidaCampoId}`;
    return '—';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  RecursosProgramadosService,
  ResourceProgramCancelRequest,
  ResourceProgramProgramRequest,
  ResourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
  ResourceProgramUpdateRequest,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { ProgramadosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/programados.gateway';
import { RecursoProgramadoFiltro } from '../../../domain/recurso-programado-filtro.model';
import {
  RecursoProgramadoCreate,
  RecursoProgramadoDevolucion,
  RecursoProgramadoUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { ProgramadosHttpMapper } from './programados-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ProgramadosHttpAdapter implements ProgramadosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(RecursosProgramadosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(ProgramadosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: RecursoProgramadoFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .recursosListar(
        {
          estadoProceso: filter.estadoProceso,
          campaniaVentaId: filter.campaniaVentaId,
          operativoVentaId: filter.operativoVentaId,
          salidaCampoId: filter.salidaCampoId,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  availability() {
    return this.api
      .recursosDisponibilidad({}, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.availability(response)));
  }

  program(input: RecursoProgramadoCreate) {
    const resourceProgramProgramRequest: ResourceProgramProgramRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosProgramar(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramProgramRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoUpdate) {
    const resourceProgramUpdateRequest: ResourceProgramUpdateRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  assign(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosAsignar(
        { id, xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create() },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  returnResource(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoDevolucion) {
    const resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest: ResourceProgramReturnResourceRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosRegistrarDevolucion(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  cancel(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const resourceProgramCancelRequest: ResourceProgramCancelRequest = { motivo };
    return this.api
      .recursosCancelar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramCancelRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== ''),
    ) as T;
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145204_423142/src/app/infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper.ts`

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

import { ApiError, isApiError } from '../../core/http/models/api-error.model';
import { ApiEnvelopeError } from './api-response-unwrapper';

const DEFAULT_MESSAGE =
  'No fue posible completar la operación. Intente nuevamente.';

export function mapOpenApiError(error: unknown): ApiError {
  if (isApiError(error)) {
    return {
      ...error,
      message: userMessage(error.status, error.message),
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof ApiEnvelopeError) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      code: error.code,
      message: userMessage(400, error.message),
      correlationId: error.correlationId,
      timestamp: null,
      details: null,
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof HttpErrorResponse) {
    const payload =
      error.error && typeof error.error === 'object'
        ? (error.error as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};

    const backendMessage =
      typeof payload['mensaje'] === 'string'
        ? payload['mensaje']
        : null;

    return {
      status: error.status,
      code:
        typeof payload['codigo'] === 'string'
          ? payload['codigo']
          : 'ERROR_HTTP',
      message: userMessage(error.status, backendMessage),
      correlationId:
        typeof payload['correlacionId'] === 'string'
          ? payload['correlacionId']
          : null,
      timestamp:
        typeof payload['fechaHoraUtc'] === 'string'
          ? payload['fechaHoraUtc']
          : null,
      details: error.error,
    };
  }

  return {
    status: 0,
    code: 'ERROR_CLIENTE',
    message: DEFAULT_MESSAGE,
    correlationId: null,
    timestamp: null,
    details: error,
  };
}

function userMessage(
  status: number,
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
): string {
  if (status === 0) {
    return 'No fue posible conectarse al sistema. Verifique su conexión e intente nuevamente.';
  }

  if (status === 401) {
    return 'Su sesión no es válida. Inicie sesión nuevamente.';
  }

  if (status === 403) {
    return 'No cuenta con autorización para realizar esta acción.';
  }

  if (status === 404) {
    return safeCandidate(candidate)
      ?? 'No se encontró la información solicitada.';
  }

  if (status === 409) {
    return safeCandidate(candidate)
      ?? 'No fue posible completar la operación porque la información ya existe o cambió.';
  }

  if (status === 429) {
    return 'Se realizaron demasiadas solicitudes. Intente nuevamente en unos momentos.';
  }

  if (status >= 500) {
    return 'No fue posible completar la operación en este momento. Intente nuevamente.';
  }

  return safeCandidate(candidate) ?? DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
}

function safeCandidate(
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!candidate?.trim()) {
    return null;
  }

  const value = candidate.trim();

  if (isTechnicalMessage(value)) {
    return null;
  }

  return value;
}

function isTechnicalMessage(value: string): boolean {
  const normalized = value.toLowerCase();

  const technicalMarkers = [
    'exception',
    'stacktrace',
    'stack trace',
    'sqlstate',
    'sqlexception',
    'jdbc',
    'simplejdbccall',
    'stored procedure',
    'procedimiento almacenado',
    'constraint',
    'foreign key',
    'primary key',
    'nullpointer',
    'classcastexception',
    'timeout exception',
    'http://',
    'https://',
    '/api/',
    'endpoint',
    'bearer',
    'token',
    'provider',
    'proveedor externo',
    'factiliza',
    'verificape',
    'reniec api',
    'sunat api',
  ];

  return technicalMarkers.some((marker) =>
    normalized.includes(marker)
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { environment } from '../../environments/environment';
import {
  ApiEnvelope,
  unwrapApiResponse,
} from '../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import {
  GeographyItem,
  ReferenceCatalogCode,
  ReferencePage,
} from '../core/reference-data/reference-data.model';
import { ReferenceDataGateway } from '../core/reference-data/reference-data.gateway';
import { ReferenceDataHttpMapper } from './reference-data-http.mapper';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ReferenceDataHttpAdapter implements ReferenceDataGateway {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly baseUrl = environment.apiBaseUrl;

  listCatalog(
    catalog: ReferenceCatalogCode,
    page: number,
    size: number,
  ): Observable<ReferencePage> {
    const params = new HttpParams()
      .set('catalogo', catalog)
      .set('pagina', page)
      .set('tamano', size);

    return this.http
      .get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
        `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/catalogos`,
        {
          params,
          transferCache: false,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) =>
          ReferenceDataHttpMapper.catalogPage(value),
        ),
      );
  }

  listDepartments(): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.http
      .get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
        `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/geografia/departamentos`,
        {
          transferCache: false,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) =>
          ReferenceDataHttpMapper.departments(value),
        ),
      );
  }

  listProvinces(
    departmentCode: string,
  ): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.http
      .get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
        `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/geografia/departamentos/${encodeURIComponent(
          departmentCode,
        )}/provincias`,
        {
          transferCache: false,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) =>
          ReferenceDataHttpMapper.provinces(value),
        ),
      );
  }

  listDistricts(
    provinceCode: string,
  ): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.http
      .get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
        `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/geografia/provincias/${encodeURIComponent(
          provinceCode,
        )}/distritos`,
        {
          transferCache: false,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) =>
          ReferenceDataHttpMapper.districts(value),
        ),
      );
  }

  listPopulationCenters(
    districtCode: string,
  ): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.http
      .get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
        `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/geografia/distritos/${encodeURIComponent(
          districtCode,
        )}/centros-poblados`,
        {
          transferCache: false,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) =>
          ReferenceDataHttpMapper.populationCenters(value),
        ),
      );
  }
}
```

### 192. `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145204_650358/src/app/shared/layout/sidebar/sidebar-item.ts`

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145204_650358/src/app/shared/layout/sidebar/sidebar-item.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260912_145204_650358\src\app\shared\layout\sidebar\sidebar-item.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_145204_650358/src/app/shared/layout/sidebar/sidebar-item.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBuilding,
  faChevronDown,
  faCircle,
  faClipboardList,
  faCoins,
  faFileShield,
  faFolderOpen,
  faGaugeHigh,
  faLeaf,
  faLocationDot,
  faMoneyBillTransfer,
  faRoute,
  faSeedling,
  faShop,
  faTruck,
  faUserGroup,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { NavigationItem } from '../../../core/navigation/navigation-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sidebar-item',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, RouterLinkActive, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './sidebar-item.html',
  styleUrl: './sidebar-item.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SidebarItemComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) item!: NavigationItem;
  @Input() collapsed = false;

  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() requestExpand = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly expanded = signal(false);
  readonly chevronIcon = faChevronDown;
  readonly childIcon = faCircle;

  toggleGroup(): void {
    if (this.item.children.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.collapsed) {
      this.requestExpand.emit();
      this.expanded.set(true);
      return;
    }

    this.expanded.update((value) => !value);
  }

  iconFor(item: NavigationItem): IconDefinition {
    const code = item.code.toUpperCase();

    if (code === 'INICIO') {
      return faGaugeHigh;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_TECNICA')) {
      return faSeedling;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_COMERCIAL')) {
      return faShop;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_FINANZAS')) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_RECURSOS')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_ADMIN')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_REPORTE')) {
      return faFileShield;
    }

    if (code.includes('TIPO') && code.includes('BIEN')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('PRODUCTOR') || code.includes('SOCIO')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (code.includes('PREDIO')) {
      return faLocationDot;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('CULTIVO') ||
      code.includes('PRODUCCION') ||
      code.includes('SANIDAD')
    ) {
      return code.includes('SANIDAD') ? faLeaf : faSeedling;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('SALIDA') ||
      code.includes('VISITA') ||
      code.includes('OPERATIVO')
    ) {
      return faRoute;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('JABA') ||
      code.includes('INVENTARIO') ||
      code.includes('RECURSO')
    ) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('ENTREGA')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('PAGO') ||
      code.includes('COBRO') ||
      code.includes('LIQUID')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (code.includes('GASTO') || code.includes('AJUSTE')) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    if (code.includes('USUARIO') || code.includes('ROL')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (code.includes('ORGANIZ')) {
      return faBuilding;
    }

    if (code.includes('REPORTE') || code.includes('AUDITOR')) {
      return faFileShield;
    }

    if (code.includes('CAMPANIA') || code.includes('PRECIO')) {
      return faShop;
    }

    if (code.includes('CENSO') || code.includes('EVALUACION')) {
      return faClipboardList;
    }

    return faFolderOpen;
  }
}
```

```typescript
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faDisplay,
  faShieldHalved,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../core/access/access.store';
import { BreadcrumbComponent } from '../breadcrumb/breadcrumb';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-topbar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, FaIconComponent, BreadcrumbComponent],
  templateUrl: './topbar.html',
  styleUrl: './topbar.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class TopbarComponent {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  @Output() menuToggle = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly menuIcon = faBars;
  readonly bellIcon = faBell;
  readonly userIcon = faCircleUser;
  readonly sessionsIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly devicesIcon = faDisplay;
  readonly securityIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly chevronIcon = faChevronDown;

  readonly user = this.accessStore.user;

  readonly displayName = computed(
    () =>
      this.user()?.nombreCompleto ||
      this.user()?.nombreUsuario ||
      'Usuario DESCO',
  );

  readonly initials = computed(() => {
    const source = this.displayName().trim();

    return source
      .split(/\s+/)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
      .join('');
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

export type CommercialWorkspace =

  | 'operations'
  | 'deliveries'

  | 'pricing';

export interface CommercialOption {

}

export interface CommercialReferences {

  varieties: readonly CommercialOption[];
  salesModalities: readonly CommercialOption[];
  zones: readonly CommercialOption[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class CommercialApiService {
  private readonly campaignsApi = inject(CampaasDeVentaService);
  private readonly participantsApi = inject(ParticipantesDeCampaaService);
  private readonly operationsApi = inject(OperativosDeVentaService);

  private readonly cratesApi = inject(ControlDeJabasService);
  private readonly pricingApi = inject(CondicionesYPreciosService);
  private readonly organizationsApi = inject(OrganizacionesService);
  private readonly producersApi = inject(ProductoresService);
  private readonly propertiesApi = inject(PrediosService);
  private readonly catalogsApi = inject(CatlogosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(AdminApiMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(
    workspace: CommercialWorkspace,
    page: number,
    size: number,
    filters: Record<string, unknown> = {},
  ) {
    switch (workspace) {
      case 'campaigns':
        return this.campaignsApi.campaniasListar({
          estadoProceso: this.text(filters['state']),
          asociacionId: this.positive(filters['associationId']),
          empresaCompradoraId: this.positive(filters['buyerId']),
          fechaDesde: this.text(filters['from']),
          fechaHasta: this.text(filters['to']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'participants':
        return this.participantsApi.participantesListar({
          campaniaVentaId: this.positive(filters['campaignId']),
          estadoParticipacion: this.text(filters['state']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'operations':
        return this.operationsApi.operativosListar({
          campaniaVentaId: this.positive(filters['campaignId']),
          estadoProceso: this.text(filters['state']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'deliveries':
        return this.deliveriesApi.entregasListar({
          operativoVentaId: this.positive(filters['operationId']),
          socioId: this.positive(filters['producerId']),
          estadoProceso: this.text(filters['state']),
          estadoControlCalidad: this.text(filters['qualityState']),
          fechaDesde: this.text(filters['from']),
          fechaHasta: this.text(filters['to']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'crates':
        return this.cratesApi.jabasListar({
          operativoVentaId: this.positive(filters['operationId']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'pricing':
        return this.pricingApi.preciosListar({
          campaniaVentaId: this.positive(filters['campaignId']),
          operativoVentaId: this.positive(filters['operationId']),
          variedadPaltaId: this.positive(filters['varietyId']),
          condicionComercialId: this.positive(filters['conditionId']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
    }
  }

  listConditions(page: number, size: number) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesListar({ pagina: page, tamano: size }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
  }

  detail(workspace: CommercialWorkspace, id: number) {
    switch (workspace) {
      case 'campaigns': return this.campaignsApi.campaniasVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'participants': return this.participantsApi.participantesVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'operations': return this.operationsApi.operativosVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'deliveries': return this.deliveriesApi.entregasVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'crates': return this.cratesBalance(id);
      case 'pricing': return this.priceHistory(id).pipe(map((items) => ({ historial: items })));
    }
  }

  createCampaign(request: CampaignCreateRequest) {
    return this.campaignsApi.campaniasCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignCreateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'campaniaVentaId')));
  }
  updateCampaign(id: number, request: CampaignUpdateRequest) {
    return this.campaignsApi.campaniasEditar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignUpdateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  activateCampaign(id: number, motivo?: string) { return this.campaignTransition('activate', id, { motivo }); }
  closeCampaign(id: number, motivo?: string) { return this.campaignTransition('close', id, { motivo }); }
  cancelCampaign(id: number, motivo?: string) { return this.campaignTransition('cancel', id, { motivo }); }

  includeParticipant(request: CampaignParticipantIncludeRequest) {
    return this.participantsApi.participantesIncluir({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignParticipantIncludeRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  programParticipant(id: number, request: CampaignParticipantProgramRequest) {
    return this.participantsApi.participantesProgramarOperativo({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignParticipantProgramRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  removeParticipant(id: number, request: CampaignParticipantRemoveRequest) {
    return this.participantsApi.participantesRetirar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignParticipantRemoveRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  createOperation(request: SalesOperationCreateRequest) {
    return this.operationsApi.operativosCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationCreateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'operativoVentaId')));
  }
  updateOperation(id: number, request: SalesOperationUpdateRequest) {
    return this.operationsApi.operativosEditar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationUpdateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  setOperationZones(id: number, request: SalesOperationZonesRequest) {
    return this.operationsApi.operativosAsignarZonas({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationZonesRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  startOperation(id: number, motivo?: string) { return this.operationTransition('start', id, { motivo }); }
  closeOperation(id: number, motivo?: string) { return this.operationTransition('close', id, { motivo }); }
  cancelOperation(id: number, motivo?: string) { return this.operationTransition('cancel', id, { motivo }); }

  createDelivery(request: DeliveryCreateRequest) {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), deliveryCreateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'entregaSocioId')));
  }
  updateDelivery(id: number, request: DeliveryUpdatePreliminaryRequest) {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasEditarPreliminar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), deliveryUpdatePreliminaryRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  confirmDelivery(id: number) {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasConfirmar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key() }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  annulDelivery(id: number, request: DeliveryAnnulRequest) {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasAnular({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), deliveryAnnulRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  receiveCrates(request: CrateReceiveRequest) {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasRegistrarRecepcion({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateReceiveRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  assignCrates(request: CrateAssignRequest) {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasAsignar({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateAssignRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  returnCrates(request: CrateReturnCratesRequest) {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasRegistrarDevolucion({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateReturnCratesRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  annulCrateMovement(request: CrateAnnulRequest) {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasAnularMovimiento({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateAnnulRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  cratesBalance(operationId: number, operationPartnerId?: number) {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasSaldo({ operativoVentaId: operationId, operativoSocioId: operationPartnerId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
  }
  cratesHistory(operationId?: number, operationPartnerId?: number) {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasHistorial({ operativoVentaId: operationId, operativoSocioId: operationPartnerId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataArray(r)));
  }

  createCondition(request: PricingCreateConditionRequest) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingCreateConditionRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  updateCondition(id: number, request: PricingUpdateConditionRequest) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesEditar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingUpdateConditionRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  disableCondition(id: number, request: PricingDisableRequest) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesDeshabilitar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingDisableRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  createPrice(request: PricingCreatePriceRequest) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingCreatePriceRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  versionPrice(id: number, request: PricingVersionPriceRequest) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosVersionar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingVersionPriceRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  priceHistory(id: number) {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosHistorial({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataArray(r)));
  }

  operationPartners(operationId: number) {
    return this.operationsApi
      .operativosVer({ id: operationId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map((response) => {
          const detail = this.dataRecord(response);
          const participants = this.mapper.array(detail['participantes']);
          return participants
            .map((value) => this.mapper.record(value))
            .map((row) => ({
              value: this.num(row['operativoSocioId']),
              label: this.str(row['socioNombre']),
              description: this.str(row['numeroDocumento']) || undefined,
            }))
            .filter((item) => item.value > 0);
        }),
      );
  }

  crateAssignmentOptions(operationId: number) {
    return this.cratesHistory(operationId).pipe(
      map((rows) => {
        const seen = new Set<number>();
        return rows
          .filter((row) => this.str(row['tipoMovimiento']) === 'ASIGNACION')
          .map((row) => ({
            value: this.num(row['jabaAsignacionId']),
            label: `Asignación #${this.num(row['jabaAsignacionId'])}`,
            description: this.str(row['usuario']) || undefined,
          }))
          .filter((item) => {
            if (item.value <= 0 || seen.has(item.value)) return false;
            seen.add(item.value);
            return true;
          });
      }),
    );
  }

  references() {
    return forkJoin({
      organizations: this.organizationsApi.organizacionesListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      producers: this.producersApi.productoresListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      properties: this.propertiesApi.prediosListar({ soloActivos: true, pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      campaigns: this.campaignsApi.campaniasListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      operations: this.operationsApi.operativosListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      conditions: this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      varieties: this.catalogsApi.catalogosListar({ catalogo: 'VARIEDAD_PALTA', pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      modalities: this.catalogsApi.catalogosListar({ catalogo: 'MODALIDAD_VENTA', pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      zones: this.catalogsApi.catalogosListar({ catalogo: 'ZONA_PRODUCTIVA', pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
    }).pipe(map((result): CommercialReferences => {
      const organizations = this.page(result.organizations, 100).items;
      return {
        associations: organizations.filter((row) => this.bool(row['esAsociacion'])).map((row) => this.option(row, 'empresaId', 'razonSocial', 'ruc')),
        buyers: organizations.filter((row) => !this.bool(row['esAsociacion'])).map((row) => this.option(row, 'empresaId', 'razonSocial', 'ruc')),
        producers: this.page(result.producers, 100).items
          .filter((row) => this.num(row['socioAsociacionId']) > 0)
          .map((row) => ({ value: this.num(row['socioAsociacionId']), label: `${this.str(row['nombres'])} ${this.str(row['apellidoPaterno'])}`.trim(), description: this.str(row['numeroDocumento']) })),
        properties: this.page(result.properties, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'predioId', 'nombre', 'codigo')),
        campaigns: this.page(result.campaigns, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'campaniaVentaId', 'nombre', 'codigo')),
        operations: this.page(result.operations, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'operativoVentaId', 'codigo', 'campania')),
        conditions: this.page(result.conditions, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'condicionComercialId', 'nombre', 'codigo')),
        varieties: this.catalogOptions(result.varieties),
        salesModalities: this.catalogOptions(result.modalities),
        zones: this.catalogOptions(result.zones),
      };
    }));
  }

  private campaignTransition(action: 'activate' | 'close' | 'cancel', id: number, request: CampaignTransitionRequest) {
    const params = { id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignTransitionRequest: request };
    const call = action === 'activate'
      ? this.campaignsApi.campaniasActivar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      : action === 'close'
        ? this.campaignsApi.campaniasCerrar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
        : this.campaignsApi.campaniasCancelar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false });
    return call.pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  private operationTransition(action: 'start' | 'close' | 'cancel', id: number, request: SalesOperationTransitionRequest) {
    const params = { id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationTransitionRequest: request };
    const call = action === 'start'
      ? this.operationsApi.operativosIniciarRecepcion(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      : action === 'close'
        ? this.operationsApi.operativosCerrar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
        : this.operationsApi.operativosCancelar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false });
    return call.pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  private page(response: unknown, size: number): PageResult<Record<string, unknown>> {
    return this.mapper.page(response, (row) => row, size);
  }
  private dataRecord(response: unknown): Record<string, unknown> { return this.mapper.record(this.mapper.data<unknown>(response)); }
  private dataArray(response: unknown): readonly Record<string, unknown>[] { return this.mapper.array(this.mapper.data<unknown>(response)).map((row) => this.mapper.record(row)); }
  private createdId(response: unknown, key: string): number { return this.num(this.mapper.record(this.mapper.data<unknown>(response))[key]); }
  private key(): string { return this.idempotency.create(); }
  private text(value: unknown): string | undefined { const result = this.str(value); return result || undefined; }
  private positive(value: unknown): number | undefined { const result = this.num(value); return result > 0 ? result : undefined; }
  private num(value: unknown): number { const result = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(result) ? result : 0; }
  private str(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : String(value ?? '').trim(); }
  private bool(value: unknown): boolean { return value === true || value === 1 || value === '1' || value === 'true'; }
  private option(row: Record<string, unknown>, idKey: string, labelKey: string, descriptionKey: string): CommercialOption {
    return { value: this.num(row[idKey]), label: this.str(row[labelKey]), description: this.str(row[descriptionKey]) || undefined };
  }
  private catalogOptions(response: unknown): readonly CommercialOption[] {
    return this.page(response, 100).items.map((row) => ({ value: this.num(row['id']), label: this.str(row['nombre']), description: this.str(row['codigo']) || undefined })).filter((item) => item.value > 0);
  }
}
```

```typescript
  get deliveryLines(): FormArray { return this.deliveryForm.controls.details; }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const workspace = this.route.snapshot.data['workspace'] as CommercialWorkspace | undefined;
    if (workspace) this.workspace.set(workspace);
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.rows().page, size = this.rows().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const filters = this.filterForm.getRawValue();
    const source = this.workspace() === 'pricing' && this.pricingTab() === 'conditions'
      ? this.api.listConditions(page, size)
      : this.api.list(this.workspace(), page, size, filters);
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (result) => this.rows.set(result),
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.api.references().pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (refs) => this.refs.set(refs),
      error: () => this.refs.set(EMPTY_REFS),
    });
  }

  applyFilters(): void { this.load(1); }
  clearFilters(): void { this.filterForm.reset(); this.load(1); }
  changePricingTab(tab: PricingTab): void { this.pricingTab.set(tab); this.rows.set(emptyPageResult(this.rows().size)); this.load(1); }

  openCreate(): void {
    this.editingId.set(null);
    switch (this.workspace()) {
      case 'campaigns': this.resetCampaign(); this.openEditor('campaign'); break;
      case 'participants': this.participantForm.reset({ campaignId: 0, partnerAssociationId: 0, operationId: 0 }); this.openEditor('participant-include'); break;
      case 'operations': this.resetOperation(); this.openEditor('operation'); break;
      case 'deliveries': this.resetDelivery(); this.openEditor('delivery'); break;
      case 'crates': this.resetCrate(); this.openEditor('crate-receive'); break;
      case 'pricing':
        if (this.pricingTab() === 'conditions') { this.resetCondition(); this.openEditor('condition'); }
        else { this.resetPrice(); this.openEditor('price'); }
        break;
    }
  }

  openEdit(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    if (id <= 0) return;
    this.editingId.set(id);
    if (this.workspace() === 'campaigns') {
      this.campaignForm.reset({
        associationId: this.number(row['asociacionId']), buyerId: this.number(row['empresaCompradoraId']),
        name: this.string(row['nombre']), start: this.dateValue(row['fechaInicio']), end: this.dateValue(row['fechaFin']),
        observation: this.string(row['observacion']),
      });
      this.campaignForm.controls.associationId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.openEditor('campaign');
      return;
    }
    if (this.workspace() === 'operations') {
      this.operationForm.reset({
        campaignId: this.number(row['campaniaVentaId']), start: this.dateTimeValue(row['fechaInicioProgramada']),
        end: this.dateTimeValue(row['fechaFinProgramada']), observation: this.string(row['observacion']),
      });
      this.operationForm.controls.campaignId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.openEditor('operation');
      return;
    }
    if (this.workspace() === 'deliveries') {
      this.openEditor('delivery');
      this.loadDeliveryForEdit(id);
      return;
    }
    if (this.workspace() === 'pricing' && this.pricingTab() === 'conditions') {
      this.conditionForm.reset({
        modalityId: this.number(row['modalidadVentaId']), name: this.string(row['nombre']),
        description: this.string(row['descripcion']), minWeight: this.number(row['pesoMinimoG']), maxWeight: this.number(row['pesoMaximoG']),
      });
      this.conditionForm.controls.modalityId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.openEditor('condition');
    }
  }

  view(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    if (id <= 0) return;
    const key = `view:${id}`;
    this.actionKey.set(key);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.detailDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.detailLoading.set(true);
    this.api.detail(this.workspace(), id).pipe(finalize(() => { this.detailLoading.set(false); this.actionKey.set(null); })).subscribe({
      next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
      error: (error) => { this.detail.set({ mensaje: mapOpenApiError(error).message }); },
    });
  }

  closeDetail(): void { if (this.detailDialog.nativeElement.open) this.detailDialog.nativeElement.close(); this.detail.set(null); }
  closeEditor(): void { if (!this.saving() && this.editorDialog.nativeElement.open) this.editorDialog.nativeElement.close(); }

  saveEditor(): void {
    if (this.saving()) return;
    switch (this.modalKind()) {
      case 'campaign': this.saveCampaign(); break;
      case 'participant-include': this.saveParticipantInclude(); break;
      case 'participant-program': this.saveParticipantProgram(); break;
      case 'operation': this.saveOperation(); break;
      case 'operation-zones': this.saveOperationZones(); break;
      case 'delivery': this.saveDelivery(); break;
      case 'crate-receive': this.saveCrateReceive(); break;
      case 'crate-assign': this.saveCrateAssign(); break;
      case 'crate-return': this.saveCrateReturn(); break;
      case 'crate-annul': this.saveCrateAnnul(); break;
      case 'condition': this.saveCondition(); break;
      case 'price': this.savePrice(); break;
      case 'price-version': this.savePriceVersion(); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }

  async campaignAction(row: Record<string, unknown>, action: 'activate' | 'close' | 'cancel'): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row); if (id <= 0) return;
    const cancel = action === 'cancel';
    const result = await this.confirm.show({
      title: action === 'activate' ? 'Activar campaña' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar campaña' : 'Cancelar campaña',
      message: action === 'activate' ? 'La campaña quedará activa.' : action === 'close' ? 'La campaña quedará cerrada.' : 'La campaña quedará cancelada.',
      tone: cancel ? 'danger' : 'primary', confirmLabel: action === 'activate' ? 'Activar' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar' : 'Cancelar campaña',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: cancel, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: cancel ? 3 : 0,
    });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    const source = action === 'activate' ? this.api.activateCampaign(id, result.reason ?? undefined)
      : action === 'close' ? this.api.closeCampaign(id, result.reason ?? undefined)
      : this.api.cancelCampaign(id, result.reason ?? undefined);
    this.runRowAction(`${action}:${id}`, source, action === 'activate' ? 'Campaña activada' : action === 'close' ? 'Campaña cerrada' : 'Campaña cancelada');
  }

  openParticipantProgram(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.editingId.set(this.idOf(row));
    this.participantForm.patchValue({ campaignId: this.number(row['campaniaVentaId']), operationId: 0 });
    this.openEditor('participant-program');
  }

  async removeParticipant(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Retirar participante', message: 'El participante dejará la campaña.', tone: 'danger', confirmLabel: 'Retirar', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 3 });
    if (!result.confirmed || !result.reason) return;
    this.runRowAction(`remove:${id}`, this.api.removeParticipant(id, { motivo: result.reason }), 'Participante retirado');
  }

  openZones(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.editingId.set(this.idOf(row)); this.selectedZones.set([]); this.openEditor('operation-zones');
  }
  toggleZone(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
    this.selectedZones.update((values) => checked ? [...new Set([...values, id])] : values.filter((value) => value !== id));
  }

  async operationAction(row: Record<string, unknown>, action: 'start' | 'close' | 'cancel'): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row); const cancel = action === 'cancel';
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: action === 'start' ? 'Iniciar recepción' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar operativo' : 'Cancelar operativo', message: action === 'start' ? 'El operativo iniciará recepción.' : action === 'close' ? 'El operativo quedará cerrado.' : 'El operativo quedará cancelado.', tone: cancel ? 'danger' : 'primary', confirmLabel: action === 'start' ? 'Iniciar' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar' : 'Cancelar', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: cancel, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: cancel ? 3 : 0 });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    const source = action === 'start' ? this.api.startOperation(id, result.reason ?? undefined) : action === 'close' ? this.api.closeOperation(id, result.reason ?? undefined) : this.api.cancelOperation(id, result.reason ?? undefined);
    this.runRowAction(`${action}:${id}`, source, action === 'start' ? 'Recepción iniciada' : action === 'close' ? 'Operativo cerrado' : 'Operativo cancelado');
  }

  onDeliveryOperationChange(): void {
    const operationId = Number(this.deliveryForm.controls.operationId.value);
    this.deliveryForm.controls.operationPartnerId.setValue(0);
    this.operationPartners.set([]);
    if (operationId <= 0) return;
    this.api.operationPartners(operationId).subscribe({ next: (items) => this.operationPartners.set(items), error: () => this.operationPartners.set([]) });
  }

  addDeliveryLine(): void { this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup()); }
  removeDeliveryLine(index: number): void { if (this.deliveryLines.length > 1) this.deliveryLines.removeAt(index); }

  async confirmDelivery(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Confirmar entrega', message: 'La entrega quedará confirmada.', tone: 'primary', confirmLabel: 'Confirmar', cancelLabel: 'Volver' });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    this.runRowAction(`confirm:${id}`, this.api.confirmDelivery(id), 'Entrega confirmada');
  }
  async annulDelivery(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Anular entrega', message: 'La entrega quedará anulada.', tone: 'danger', confirmLabel: 'Anular', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 3 });
    if (!result.confirmed || !result.reason) return;
    this.runRowAction(`annul:${id}`, this.api.annulDelivery(id, { motivo: result.reason }), 'Entrega anulada');
  }

  openCrate(mode: 'crate-receive' | 'crate-assign' | 'crate-return' | 'crate-annul'): void {
    this.resetCrate(); this.openEditor(mode);
  }
  onCrateOperationChange(): void {
    const operationId = Number(this.crateForm.controls.operationId.value);
    this.operationPartners.set([]); this.crateAssignments.set([]);
    if (operationId <= 0) return;
    this.api.operationPartners(operationId).subscribe({ next: (items) => this.operationPartners.set(items), error: () => this.operationPartners.set([]) });
    this.api.crateAssignmentOptions(operationId).subscribe({ next: (items) => this.crateAssignments.set(items), error: () => this.crateAssignments.set([]) });
  }
  showCrateHistory(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const operationId = this.number(row['operativoVentaId']); if (operationId <= 0) return;

  cell(row: Record<string, unknown>, column: TableColumn): string {
    const value = row[column.key];
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '—';
    if (column.numeric) return new Intl.NumberFormat('es-PE', { maximumFractionDigits: 3 }).format(this.number(value));

Number(raw.deliveryId) : undefined, cantidadLlenas: Number(raw.filled), cantidadVacias: Number(raw.empty), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Devolución registrada'), error: (e) => this.editorError(e) });

        this.deliveryLines.clear(); for (const line of lines) this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup(this.number(line['variedadPaltaId']), this.number(line['condicionComercialId']), this.number(line['kilogramos']))); if (this.deliveryLines.length === 0) this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup());

  private runRowAction(key: string, source: Observable<unknown>, message: string): void {
```

```typescript
 retire(id:number,fechaRetiro:string,motivo:string){const propertyRetireRequest:PropertyRetireRequest={fechaRetiro,motivo};return this.api.prediosRetirar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),propertyRetireRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.void(r)));}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">

        <div><p>Recursos</p><h2>{{ title() }}</h2></div>

        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>

      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (mode() === 'create') {

          </select>
```
