```html
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationId">Identificador del destino</label>
          <input id="resourceDestinationId" class="admin-input" type="number" min="1" step="1" formControlName="destinoId" />
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.destinoId" fieldLabel="El destino" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceType">Tipo de recurso</label>
          <select
            id="resourceType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="recursoTipo"
            (change)="changeResourceType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="BIEN">Bien / vehículo</option>
            <option value="SUMINISTRO">Suministro</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceId">Recurso disponible</label>
          <div class="resource-select-row">
            <select id="resourceId" class="admin-select" formControlName="recursoId">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @if (createForm.controls.recursoTipo.value === 'BIEN') {
                @for (asset of availableAssets(); track asset.bienInventarioId) {
                  <option [value]="asset.bienInventarioId">
                    {{ asset.codigoPatrimonial }} · {{ asset.nombre }}
                  </option>
                }
              } @else {
                @for (supply of availability().suministros; track supply.suministroId) {
                  <option [value]="supply.suministroId">
                    {{ supply.codigo }} · {{ supply.nombre }} · stock {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}
                  </option>
                }
              }
            </select>
            <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Actualizar disponibilidad" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="loadAvailability()">
              @if (loading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }
            </button>
          </div>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.recursoId" fieldLabel="El recurso" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="programmedQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
          <input

          @if (selectedSupply(); as supply) {
            <small class="resource-helper">Disponible: {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}</small>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="programObservation">Observación</label>
          <textarea id="programObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">

      } @else if (mode() === 'edit') {

            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else if (mode() === 'return') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="returnForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · cantidad programada {{ detail.cantidadProgramada }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="returnQuantity">Cantidad a devolver</label>
            <input id="returnQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadDevuelta" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="returnObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="returnObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Registrando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="returnIcon" /> Registrar devolución }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="consumeForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">

</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from './access.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ModuleAccessService {
  private readonly store = inject(AccessStore);

  has(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();

    return this.store
      .modules()
      .some((module) => module.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized);
  }

  hasRoute(route: string): boolean {
    const normalized = this.normalizeRoute(route);

    return this.store.modules().some((module) => {
      if (!module.ruta) {
        return false;
      }

      return this.normalizeRoute(module.ruta) === normalized;
    });
  }

  private normalizeRoute(route: string): string {
    const trimmed = route.trim();

    if (!trimmed) {
      return '/';
    }

    return (`/${trimmed}`).replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from './access.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PermissionService {
  private readonly store = inject(AccessStore);

  has(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = this.normalize(code);
    return this.store
      .permissions()
      .some((permission) => this.normalize(permission.codigo) === normalized);
  }

  hasAny(codes: readonly string[]): boolean {
    return codes.some((code) => this.has(code));
  }

  hasAll(codes: readonly string[]): boolean {
    return codes.every((code) => this.has(code));
  }

  private normalize(value: string): string {
    return value.trim().toUpperCase();
  }
}
```

### 210. `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_162137_465085/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/out/http/auth-http.mapper.ts`

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260912_162137_465085\src\app\features\acceso\adapter\out\http\auth-http.mapper.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { ApiEnvelope } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import {
  AuthContext,
  AuthFlowResult,
  AuthRefreshResult,
} from '../../../domain/auth-context.model';
import { AuthChallenge } from '../../../domain/auth-challenge.model';
import { AuthStep } from '../../../domain/auth-step.model';
import { AuthToken } from '../../../domain/auth-token.model';

type RecordValue = Record<string, unknown>;

@Injectable()
export class AuthHttpMapper {
  envelopeData<T>(response: unknown): T {
    const envelope = this.record(response) as ApiEnvelope<T>;

    if (envelope.exitoso === false) {
      throw new Error(envelope.mensaje || 'La operación no pudo completarse.');
    }

    return envelope.datos as T;
  }

  flow(response: unknown): AuthFlowResult {
    const data = this.record(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));

    return {
      paso: this.authStep(data['paso']),
      tokens: this.token(data['tokens']),
      contexto: this.context(data['contexto']),
      desafio: this.challenge(data['desafio']),
    };
  }

  refresh(response: unknown): AuthRefreshResult {
    const data = this.record(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));
    const tokens = this.token(data['tokens']);
    const contexto = this.context(data['contexto']);

    if (!tokens || !contexto) {
      throw new Error('No se pudo renovar la sesión.');
    }

    return { tokens, contexto };
  }

  currentContext(response: unknown): AuthContext {
    const context = this.context(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));

    if (!context) {
      throw new Error('No se pudo obtener la información de la sesión.');
    }

    return context;
  }

  challengeResponse(response: unknown): AuthChallenge {
    const challenge = this.challenge(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));

    if (!challenge) {
      throw new Error('No se pudo continuar con la verificación.');
    }

    return challenge;
  }

  voidResponse(response: unknown): void {
    const envelope = this.record(response) as ApiEnvelope<unknown>;

    if (envelope.exitoso === false) {
      throw new Error(envelope.mensaje || 'La operación no pudo completarse.');
    }
  }

  private token(value: unknown): AuthToken | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
      return null;
    }

    const row = this.record(value);
    const accessToken = this.string(row['accessToken']);
    const refreshToken = this.string(row['refreshToken']);

    if (!accessToken || !refreshToken) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      accessToken,
      tokenType: this.string(row['tokenType']) || 'Bearer',
      accessTokenExpiraUtc: this.nullableString(row['accessTokenExpiraUtc']),
      refreshToken,
      refreshTokenExpiraUtc: this.nullableString(row['refreshTokenExpiraUtc']),
      sesionPublicaId: this.nullableString(row['sesionPublicaId']),
    };
  }

  private challenge(value: unknown): AuthChallenge | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
      return null;
    }

    const row = this.record(value);

    return {
      paso: this.authStep(row['paso']),
      usuarioId: this.nullableNumber(row['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.nullableString(row['nombreUsuario']),
      correlacionId: this.nullableString(row['correlacionId']),
      correoEnmascarado: this.nullableString(row['correoEnmascarado']),
    };
  }

  private context(value: unknown): AuthContext | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
      return null;
    }

    const row = this.record(value);
    const user = this.record(row['usuario']);

    return {
      usuario: {
        usuarioId: this.number(user['usuarioId']),
        nombreUsuario: this.string(user['nombreUsuario']),
        estadoCuenta: this.nullableString(user['estadoCuenta']),
        ultimoAccesoCorrectoUtc: this.nullableString(user['ultimoAccesoCorrectoUtc']),
        requiereCambioPassword: this.boolean(user['requiereCambioPassword']),
        segundoFactorHabilitado: this.boolean(user['segundoFactorHabilitado']),
        tokenVersion: this.nullableNumber(user['tokenVersion']),
        personaId: this.nullableNumber(user['personaId']),
        tipoDocumento: this.nullableString(user['tipoDocumento']),
        numeroDocumento: this.nullableString(user['numeroDocumento']),
        nombres: this.nullableString(user['nombres']),
        apellidoPaterno: this.nullableString(user['apellidoPaterno']),
        apellidoMaterno: this.nullableString(user['apellidoMaterno']),
        nombreCompleto: this.nullableString(user['nombreCompleto']),
        telefono: this.nullableString(user['telefono']),
        codigoEmpleado: this.nullableString(user['codigoEmpleado']),
        empresaId: this.nullableNumber(user['empresaId']),
        correoSeguridad: this.nullableString(user['correoSeguridad']),
        correoSeguridadVerificado: this.boolean(user['correoSeguridadVerificado']),
        sesionPublicaId: this.nullableString(user['sesionPublicaId']),
        fechaSesionUtc: this.nullableString(user['fechaSesionUtc']),
        fechaExpiracionRenovacionUtc: this.nullableString(
          user['fechaExpiracionRenovacionUtc'],
        ),
        dispositivoUsuarioId: this.nullableNumber(user['dispositivoUsuarioId']),
        navegador: this.nullableString(user['navegador']),
        sistemaOperativo: this.nullableString(user['sistemaOperativo']),
        dispositivoReconocido: this.boolean(user['dispositivoReconocido']),
      },
      roles: this.array(row['roles']).map((item) => {
        const role = this.record(item);
        return {
          rolId: this.number(role['rolId']),
          codigo: this.string(role['codigo']),
          nombre: this.string(role['nombre']),
          descripcion: this.nullableString(role['descripcion']),
          requiereSegundoFactor: this.boolean(role['requiereSegundoFactor']),
        };
      }),
      modulos: this.array(row['modulos']).map((item) => {
        const module = this.record(item);
        return {
          moduloId: this.number(module['moduloId']),
          moduloPadreId: this.nullableNumber(module['moduloPadreId']),
          codigo: this.string(module['codigo']),
          nombre: this.string(module['nombre']),
          orden: this.number(module['orden']),
          ruta: this.nullableString(module['ruta']),
          icono: this.nullableString(module['icono']),
          visibleMenu: this.boolean(module['visibleMenu']),
          grupo: this.boolean(module['esGrupo']),
        };
      }),
      permisos: this.array(row['permisos']).map((item) => {
        const permission = this.record(item);
        return {
          permisoId: this.nullableNumber(permission['permisoId']),
          moduloId: this.nullableNumber(permission['moduloId']),
          codigoModulo: this.nullableString(permission['codigoModulo']),
          codigo: this.string(permission['codigo']),
          nombre: this.nullableString(permission['nombre']),
          descripcion: this.nullableString(permission['descripcion']),
          accion: this.nullableString(permission['accion']),
          sensible: this.boolean(permission['sensible']),
          requiereMotivo: this.boolean(permission['requiereMotivo']),
        };
      }),
    };
  }

  private authStep(value: unknown): AuthStep {
    switch (value) {
      case 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED':
      case 'TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED':
      case 'AUTHENTICATED':
        return value;
      default:
        throw new Error('No se pudo procesar el estado de autenticación.');
    }
  }

  private record(value: unknown): RecordValue {
    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? (value as RecordValue)
      : {};
  }

  private array(value: unknown): unknown[] {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  }

  private string(value: unknown): string {
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? '');
  }

  private nullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value : null;
  }

  private number(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }

  private nullableNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }

  private boolean(value: unknown): boolean {
    return value === true || value === 1 || value === 'true' || value === '1';
  }
}
```

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
```

```css
/* Tailwind v4 / Flowbite: dark mode controlado por el tema explícito de DESCO. */
@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme=dark], [data-theme=dark] *));

@theme {
  --font-sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --color-desco-page: var(--desco-page-bg);

  --color-desco-text: var(--desco-text);
  --color-desco-muted: var(--desco-text-muted);
  --color-desco-primary: var(--desco-primary);
}

@plugin "daisyui" {
  themes: light --default, dark --prefersdark;
  logs: false;
}

/* Ajuste del tema light de daisyUI a los tokens visuales DESCO. */
@plugin "daisyui/theme" {
  name: "light";
  default: true;
  prefersdark: false;
  color-scheme: light;
  --color-base-100: #ffffff;
  --color-base-200: #f8fafc;

  --noise: 0;
}
```

```css
.desco-page {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 1rem;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .desco-page {
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
}

.desco-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: var(--desco-radius-md);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-sm);
}

.desco-muted {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.desco-scrollbar {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
}

.desco-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0.5rem;
  height: 0.5rem;
}

.desco-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #cbd5e1;
}

.desco-focus-ring:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — SUPERFICIES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-surface {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1.15rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
}

.admin-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
}

.admin-toolbar--end {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.admin-toolbar-field {
  min-width: 13rem;
  flex: 0 1 16rem;
}

.admin-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  margin-left: auto;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.admin-section-header {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
}

.admin-section-header p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-section-header h2 {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — TABS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-bottom: 0;
  border-radius: 1.15rem 1.15rem 0 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.45rem 0;
}

.admin-tabs button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.7rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0 0.9rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease;
}

.admin-tabs button:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-tabs button.active {
  border-bottom-color: #2563eb;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — BOTONES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-primary-button,
.admin-secondary-button,
.admin-danger-button,
.admin-success-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.7rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease,
    transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-primary-button {
  border: 1px solid #2563eb;
  background: #2563eb;
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.14);
}

.admin-primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #1d4ed8;
  background: #1d4ed8;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.18);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.admin-secondary-button {
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #475569;
}

.admin-secondary-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #bfdbfe;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-danger-button {
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-danger-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #fca5a5;
  background: #fee2e2;
  color: #991b1b;
}

.admin-success-button {
  border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-success-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #86efac;
  background: #dcfce7;
  color: #166534;
}

.admin-primary-button:disabled,
.admin-secondary-button:disabled,
.admin-danger-button:disabled,
.admin-success-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.62;
}

.admin-button--disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.admin-primary-button--small,
.admin-secondary-button--small {
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  padding: 0 0.7rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.admin-icon-button {
  display: inline-grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease,
    transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-icon-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #bfdbfe;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.admin-icon-button--danger {
  border-color: #fecaca;
  background: #fffafa;
  color: #dc2626;
}

.admin-icon-button--danger:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #fca5a5;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-icon-button--success {
  border-color: #bbf7d0;
  background: #f7fef9;
  color: #16a34a;
}

.admin-icon-button--success:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #86efac;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-icon-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.52;
}

.admin-icon-button--disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.admin-row-actions {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — FORMULARIOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.15rem 1.15rem;
}

.admin-field {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-field-span-2 {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.admin-field > label,
.admin-field > .admin-field-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.44rem;
  color: #26364d;
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  font-weight: 780;
  transition: color 140ms ease;
}

.admin-field:focus-within > label,
.admin-field:focus-within > .admin-field-label {
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-input,
.admin-select,
.admin-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #d6dfeb;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: #fbfdff;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  outline: none;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.035),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9);
  transition:
    border-color 140ms ease,
    box-shadow 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease;
}

.admin-input,
.admin-select {
  height: 2.9rem;
  padding: 0 0.82rem;
}

.admin-textarea {
  min-height: 5.8rem;
  resize: vertical;
  padding: 0.78rem 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-input::placeholder,
.admin-textarea::placeholder {
  color: #9aa8ba;
}

.admin-input:hover:not(:disabled),
.admin-select:hover:not(:disabled),
.admin-textarea:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #b8c8dc;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.admin-input:focus,
.admin-select:focus,
.admin-textarea:focus {
  border-color: #4f74d9;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.09),
    0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
}

.admin-input:disabled,
.admin-select:disabled,
.admin-textarea:disabled {
  border-color: #e2e8f0;
  background: #f5f7fa;
  color: #64748b;
  box-shadow: none;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.admin-search {
  position: relative;
  min-width: min(100%, 19rem);
}

.admin-search fa-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 0.85rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.admin-search input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 2.65rem;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0 0.8rem 0 2.45rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  outline: none;
}

.admin-search input:focus {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.1);
}

.admin-password-field {
  position: relative;
}

.admin-password-field .admin-input {
  padding-right: 2.8rem;
}

.admin-password-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 0.35rem;
  display: grid;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0.6rem;
  background: transparent;
  color: #64748b;
  cursor: pointer;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.admin-password-toggle:hover {
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-switch-row {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #dce5f0;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #fbfdff;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-row:hover {
  border-color: #c7d7eb;
  background: #f8fbff;
}

.admin-switch-row > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-switch-row strong,
.admin-switch-row span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-switch-row strong {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-switch-row span {
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.admin-switch-control {
  position: relative;
  width: 2.55rem;
  height: 1.45rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #e2e8f0;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
  transition:
    border-color 150ms ease,
    background-color 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-control::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.17rem;
  left: 0.18rem;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.25);
  transition: transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-control:checked {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  background: #2563eb;
}

.admin-switch-control:checked::after {
  transform: translateX(1.06rem);
}

.admin-switch-control:focus-visible {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.12),
    inset 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
}

.admin-switch-control:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.admin-option-grid {
  display: grid;
  max-height: 13rem;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.5rem;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.6rem;
}

.admin-check-option {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.65rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.admin-check-option > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-check-option strong,
.admin-check-option span {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-check-option strong {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-check-option span {
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — MODALES
   ============================================================ */

.desco-modal {
  background: transparent;
}

.desco-modal::backdrop {
  background: rgb(15 23 42 / 0.48);
  backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
}

.admin-modal-box {
  width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 44rem);
  max-width: 44rem;
  max-height: min(88vh, 54rem);
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1.25rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0;
  color: #0f172a;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.22);
}

.admin-modal-box--wide {
  width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 58rem);
  max-width: 58rem;
}

.admin-modal-box--compact {
  width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 34rem);
  max-width: 34rem;
}

.admin-modal-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4.4rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
}

.admin-modal-title-group {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-modal-title-group > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-modal-title-group p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-modal-title-group h2 {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-modal-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.45rem;
  height: 2.45rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding-top: 0.9rem;
}

.admin-inline-error {
  margin: 0.9rem 1.15rem 0;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 0.82rem;
  background: #fef2f2;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem;
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — TABLAS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
}

.admin-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 48rem;
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
}

.admin-table th {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.025em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-table th.text-center,
.admin-table td.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table th.text-right,
.admin-table td.text-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.admin-table td {
  height: 3.65rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.85rem;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table td > .admin-entity,
.admin-table td > .admin-stack-copy,
.admin-table td > .admin-row-actions,
.admin-table td > .admin-status,
.admin-table td > .admin-code,
.admin-table td > .admin-count-badge,
.admin-table td > .admin-muted-badge {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table .admin-row-actions {
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-table tbody tr {
  transition: background 120ms ease;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
}

.admin-table-empty {
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — ENTIDADES Y COPIA
   ============================================================ */

.admin-entity {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 12rem;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 0.72rem;
}

.admin-entity > div,
.admin-stack-copy {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-self: center;
}

.admin-entity > div > strong,
.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy strong,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-entity strong,
.admin-stack-copy strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.08rem 0 0;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 0.95rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon,
.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-entity-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  min-width: 2.25rem;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 2.25rem;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-avatar {
  background: #1d4ed8;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  place-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-code {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge,
.admin-muted-badge,
.admin-count-badge,
.admin-usage-badge,
.admin-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.6rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.52rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge {
  background: #eef2ff;
  color: #4338ca;
}

.admin-muted-badge {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-count-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-usage-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-usage-badge--used {
  background: #fff7ed;
  color: #c2410c;
}

.admin-status {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-status--active {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-status--inactive {
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-status--info {
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-status--warning {
  background: #fffbeb;
  color: #b45309;
}

.admin-status--neutral {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

 .admin-managed-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-field-hint {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: #7b8ba1;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — DETALLE
   ============================================================ */

.admin-detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-detail-card {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.03);
}

.admin-detail-card span,
.admin-detail-card strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-detail-card span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-detail-card strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.22rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-info-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
}

.admin-info-list > div {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.admin-info-list > div:nth-child(-n + 2) {
  border-top: 0;
}

.admin-info-list span,
.admin-info-list strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-info-list span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-info-list strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-chip-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.admin-chip-list article {
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
}

.admin-chip-list strong,
.admin-chip-list span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-chip-list strong {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-chip-list span {
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.admin-empty-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — AVISOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-notice {
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  color: #1e40af;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-notice--warning {
  border-color: #fde68a;
  background: #fffbeb;
  color: #92400e;
}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .admin-toolbar,
  .admin-toolbar--end {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-field {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: none;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-actions {
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .admin-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-field-span-2 {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .admin-option-grid,
  .admin-info-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-info-list > div:nth-child(2) {
    border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions > button,
  .admin-modal-actions > a {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-row-actions {
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .admin-icon-button {
    width: 2.1rem;
    height: 2.1rem;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — CENTRADO NORMALIZADO DE IDENTIFICADORES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table .admin-entity {
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon {
  display: grid;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCircleExclamation } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-form-error',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './form-error.html',
  styleUrl: './form-error.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class FormErrorComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) control: AbstractControl | null = null;
  @Input() fieldLabel = 'Este campo';
  @Input() messages: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {};

  readonly errorIcon = faCircleExclamation;

  get message(): string | null {
    const control = this.control;

    if (!control || !control.invalid || (!control.touched && !control.dirty)) {
      return null;
    }

    const errors = control.errors;

    if (!errors) {
      return null;
    }

    const key = Object.keys(errors)[0];

    if (this.messages[key]) {
      return this.messages[key];
    }

    switch (key) {
      case 'required':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} es obligatorio.`;
      case 'email':
        return 'Ingresa un correo electrónico válido.';
      case 'minlength':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} no cumple la longitud mínima.`;
      case 'maxlength':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} supera la longitud permitida.`;
      case 'min':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} es menor al valor permitido.`;
      case 'max':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} supera el valor permitido.`;
      case 'pattern':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} tiene un formato inválido.`;
      default:
        return `${this.fieldLabel} contiene un valor inválido.`;
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  AbstractControl,
  ValidationErrors,
  ValidatorFn,
} from '@angular/forms';

export type RucNature = 'ANY' | 'NATURAL' | 'JURIDICA';

export const MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE = 18;
export const MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE = 120;

const RUC_WEIGHTS = [5, 4, 3, 2, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2] as const;
const NATURAL_RUC_PREFIXES = new Set(['10', '15', '17']);
const PERSON_NAME_PATTERN = /^[\p{L}\p{M}]+(?:[ \x27\-][\p{L}\p{M}]+)*$/u;
const USERNAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$/;
const PHONE_PATTERN = /^\+?\d{7,15}$/;

export function notBlankValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  return String(value).trim().length > 0
    ? null
    : { blank: true };
}

export function optionalNotBlankValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '');

  if (value.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return value.trim().length > 0
    ? null
    : { blank: true };
}

export function personNameValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return PERSON_NAME_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { personName: true };
}

export function phoneValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return PHONE_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { phone: true };
}

export function usernameValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return USERNAME_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { username: true };
}

export function passwordSafetyValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '');

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (value !== value.trim()) {
    return { passwordOuterWhitespace: true };
  }

  return /[\r\n\t\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(value)
    ? { passwordControlCharacter: true }
    : null;
}

export function dniValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return /^\d{8}$/.test(value)
    ? null
    : { dni: true };
}

export function rucValidator(
  nature: RucNature = 'ANY',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isValidRuc(value)) {
      return { ruc: true };
    }

    const prefix = value.slice(0, 2);

    if (nature === 'JURIDICA' && prefix !== '20') {
      return { rucNature: true };
    }

    if (
      nature === 'NATURAL'
      && !NATURAL_RUC_PREFIXES.has(prefix)
    ) {
      return { rucNature: true };
    }

    return null;
  };
}

export function notFutureDateValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!isValidIsoDate(value)) {
    return { invalidDate: true };
  }

  return value <= todayLocalIsoDate()
    ? null
    : { futureDate: true };
}

export function adultBirthDateValidator(
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
  maximumAge = MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE,
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isValidIsoDate(value)) {
      return { invalidDate: true };
    }

    if (value > maxBirthDateIso(minimumAge)) {
      return { underage: true };
    }

    if (value < minBirthDateIso(maximumAge)) {
      return { ageOutOfRange: true };
    }

    return null;
  };
}

export function dateOrderValidator(
  startControlName: string,
  endControlName: string,
  errorKey = 'dateOrder',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const start = String(control.get(startControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();
    const end = String(control.get(endControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!start || !end) {
      return null;
    }

    return end >= start
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator(
  birthControlName: string,
  eventControlName: string,
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
  errorKey = 'dateBeforeMinimumAge',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const birth = String(control.get(birthControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();
    const event = String(control.get(eventControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!birth || !event || !isValidIsoDate(birth) || !isValidIsoDate(event)) {
      return null;
    }

    const minimumEventDate = addYearsIso(birth, minimumAge);

    return event >= minimumEventDate
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function isValidRuc(value: string): boolean {
  const ruc = value.trim();

  if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(ruc)) {
    return false;
  }

  const sum = RUC_WEIGHTS.reduce(
    (total, weight, index) =>
      total + Number(ruc.charAt(index)) * weight,
    0,
  );

  let checkDigit = 11 - (sum % 11);

  if (checkDigit === 10) {
    checkDigit = 0;
  } else if (checkDigit === 11) {
    checkDigit = 1;
  }

  return checkDigit === Number(ruc.charAt(10));
}

export function sanitizeDocument(
  type: string,
  value: string,
): string {
  const normalizedType = type.trim().toUpperCase();

  if (normalizedType === 'DNI') {
    return value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  }

  if (normalizedType === 'RUC') {
    return value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  }

  return value
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 30);
}

export function sanitizePersonName(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{M} \x27\-]/gu, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s*([-\x27])\s*/g, '$1')
    .replace(/^\s+/, '');
}

export function sanitizePhone(value: string): string {
  const raw = String(value ?? '').trim();
  const hasLeadingPlus = raw.startsWith('+');
  const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 15);

  if (!digits) {
    return '';
  }

  return hasLeadingPlus ? `+${digits}` : digits;
}

export function sanitizeUsername(value: string): string {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]/g, '')
    .replace(/[._-]{2,}/g, '.')
    .replace(/^[._-]+|[._-]+$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 80);
}

export function normalizeText(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

export function normalizeOptionalText(
  value: string,
): string | undefined {
  const normalized = normalizeText(value);
  return normalized || undefined;
}

export function todayLocalIsoDate(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  return isoFromLocalDate(now);
}

export function maxBirthDateIso(
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
): string {
  return yearsAgoIso(minimumAge);
}

export function minBirthDateIso(
  maximumAge = MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE,
): string {
  return yearsAgoIso(maximumAge);
}

function yearsAgoIso(years: number): string {
  const today = new Date();
  const year = today.getFullYear() - Math.max(0, Math.trunc(years));
  const month = today.getMonth();
  const day = clampDay(year, month, today.getDate());
  return formatIsoDate(year, month + 1, day);
}

function addYearsIso(value: string, years: number): string {
  const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);
  const targetYear = year + Math.trunc(years);
  const targetMonthIndex = month - 1;
  const targetDay = clampDay(targetYear, targetMonthIndex, day);
  return formatIsoDate(targetYear, month, targetDay);
}

function isValidIsoDate(value: string): boolean {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    return false;
  }

  const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);

  if (month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1) {
    return false;
  }

  return day <= clampDay(year, month - 1, 31);
}

function clampDay(year: number, monthIndex: number, day: number): number {
  const lastDay = new Date(year, monthIndex + 1, 0).getDate();
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, day), lastDay);
}

function isoFromLocalDate(value: Date): string {
  return formatIsoDate(
    value.getFullYear(),
    value.getMonth() + 1,
    value.getDate(),
  );
}

function formatIsoDate(year: number, month: number, day: number): string {
  return `${String(year).padStart(4, '0')}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function notFutureDateTimeValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return { invalidDateTime: true };
  }

  return parsed.getTime() <= Date.now()
    ? null
    : { futureDateTime: true };
}

export function notPastDateTimeValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return { invalidDateTime: true };
  }

  /*
   * Tolerancia de un minuto para evitar rechazar el mismo valor que el
   * formulario acaba de generar por el tiempo transcurrido hasta el submit.
   */
  return parsed.getTime() >= Date.now() - 60_000
    ? null
    : { pastDateTime: true };
}

export function nonNegativeIntegerValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return null;
  }

  const numberValue = Number(value);

  return Number.isInteger(numberValue) && numberValue >= 0
    ? null
    : { nonNegativeInteger: true };
}

export function positiveIntegerValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return null;
  }

  const numberValue = Number(value);

  return Number.isInteger(numberValue) && numberValue > 0
    ? null
    : { positiveInteger: true };
}

export function decimalPrecisionValidator(
  integerDigits: number,
  fractionDigits: number,
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = control.value;

    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const raw = String(value).trim();

    if (!/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(raw)) {
      return { decimalPrecision: true };
    }

    const unsigned = raw.replace(/^-/, '');
    const [integerPart, fractionPart = ''] = unsigned.split('.');

    return integerPart.length <= integerDigits
      && fractionPart.length <= fractionDigits
      ? null
      : { decimalPrecision: true };
  };
}

export function numberOrderValidator(
  lowerControlName: string,
  upperControlName: string,
  errorKey = 'numberOrder',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const lowerRaw = control.get(lowerControlName)?.value;
    const upperRaw = control.get(upperControlName)?.value;

    if (
      lowerRaw === null
      || lowerRaw === undefined
      || lowerRaw === ''
      || upperRaw === null
      || upperRaw === undefined
      || upperRaw === ''
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    const lower = Number(lowerRaw);
    const upper = Number(upperRaw);

    if (!Number.isFinite(lower) || !Number.isFinite(upper)) {
      return null;
    }

    return lower <= upper
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function localDateTimeInputNow(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const offset = now.getTimezoneOffset();
  return new Date(now.getTime() - offset * 60_000)
    .toISOString()
    .slice(0, 16);
}
```

```typescript
const DEFAULT_MESSAGE = 'No se pudo completar la acción.';

export function safeApiMessage(
  status: number,
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
): string {
  if (status === 0) {
    return 'No se pudo conectar al sistema.';
  }
  if (status === 401) {
    return 'Su sesión no es válida. Inicie sesión nuevamente.';
  }
  if (status === 403) {
    return 'No cuenta con autorización para realizar esta acción.';
  }
  if (status === 404) {
    return safeCandidate(candidate) ?? 'No se encontró la información solicitada.';
  }
  if (status === 409) {
    return safeCandidate(candidate) ?? 'La información ya existe o cambió.';
  }
  if (status === 429) {
    return 'Hay demasiadas solicitudes. Intente nuevamente.';
  }
  if (status >= 500) {
    return 'No se pudo completar la acción en este momento.';
  }
  return safeCandidate(candidate) ?? DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
}

export function safeCandidate(
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  const value = candidate?.trim();
  if (!value || isTechnicalMessage(value)) return null;
  return value.length > 300 ? value.slice(0, 300) : value;
}

function isTechnicalMessage(value: string): boolean {
  const normalized = value.toLowerCase();
  const markers = [
    'exception', 'stacktrace', 'stack trace', 'sqlstate', 'sqlexception',
    'jdbc', 'simplejdbccall', 'stored procedure', 'procedimiento almacenado',
    'constraint', 'foreign key', 'primary key', 'unique index', 'duplicate key',
    'nullpointer', 'classcastexception', 'timeout exception', 'nvarchar',
    'http://', 'https://', '/api/', 'endpoint', 'bearer', 'authorization:',
    'access token', 'refresh token', 'provider', 'proveedor externo',
    'factiliza', 'verificape', 'reniec api', 'sunat api', 'select ', 'insert ',
    'update ', 'delete ', 'merge ', 'create table', 'alter table',
  ];
  return markers.some((marker) => normalized.includes(marker));
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

import { ApiError, isApiError } from '../../core/http/models/api-error.model';
import { safeApiMessage } from '../../core/http/safe-api-message';
import { ApiEnvelopeError } from './api-response-unwrapper';

export function mapOpenApiError(error: unknown): ApiError {
  if (isApiError(error)) {
    return { ...error, message: safeApiMessage(error.status, error.message), details: null };
  }

  if (error instanceof ApiEnvelopeError) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      code: error.code,
      message: safeApiMessage(400, error.message),
      correlationId: error.correlationId,
      timestamp: null,
      details: null,
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof HttpErrorResponse) {
    const payload =
      error.error && typeof error.error === 'object'
        ? (error.error as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};
    const candidate =
      typeof payload['mensaje'] === 'string' ? payload['mensaje'] : null;

    return {
      status: error.status,
      code: typeof payload['codigo'] === 'string' ? payload['codigo'] : 'ERROR_HTTP',
      message: safeApiMessage(error.status, candidate),
      correlationId:
        typeof payload['correlacionId'] === 'string' ? payload['correlacionId'] : null,
      timestamp:
        typeof payload['fechaHoraUtc'] === 'string' ? payload['fechaHoraUtc'] : null,
      details: null,
    };
  }

  return {
    status: 0,
    code: 'ERROR_CLIENTE',
    message: safeApiMessage(0, null),
    correlationId: null,
    timestamp: null,
    details: null,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import {
  CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES,
  CATALOGOS_AGRUPADOS,
  Catalogo,
} from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
import { CatalogoDetailComponent } from '../catalogo-detail/catalogo-detail';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    CatalogoDetailComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './catalogos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(CatalogoDetailComponent)
  private detailModal!: CatalogoDetailComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarCatalogosUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly references = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly catalogCode = signal(CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES[0].codigo);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<CatalogoItem>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly catalogs = CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES;
  readonly catalogGroups = CATALOGOS_AGRUPADOS;
  readonly pageIcon = faLayerGroup;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly selectedCatalog = computed<Catalogo>(
    () =>
      this.catalogs.find((item) => item.codigo === this.catalogCode()) ??
      this.catalogs[0],
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        catalogo: this.catalogCode(),
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeCatalog(value: string): void {
    if (!value || value === this.catalogCode()) {
      return;
    }

    this.catalogCode.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog());

    if (result.saved) {
      this.invalidateSelectedReference();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  async edit(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog(), item);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.invalidateSelectedReference();
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    if (item.enUso || this.disablingId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar valor',
      message: `El valor "${item.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible para nuevos registros.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica por qué debe deshabilitarse este valor.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.disablingId.set(item.id);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(item.id, this.catalogCode(), confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.references.invalidateCatalog(this.catalogCode());
          this.toast.success('Valor deshabilitado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private invalidateSelectedReference(): void {
    this.references.invalidateCatalog(this.catalogCode());
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBuilding,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';
import { OrganizacionFormComponent } from '../organizacion-form/organizacion-form';

type OrganizationTab = 'organizations' | 'areas';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizaciones-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    OrganizacionFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizaciones-list.html',
  styleUrl: './organizaciones-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(OrganizacionFormComponent)
  private formModal!: OrganizacionFormComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly activeTab = signal<OrganizationTab>('organizations');
  readonly organizationsLoading = signal(true);
  readonly areasLoading = signal(false);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly organizationsError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly areasError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly areaCompanyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly organizations = signal<PageResult<Empresa>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly areas = signal<PageResult<Area>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly pageIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly companyOptions = computed<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>(() =>
    this.organizations().items.map((company) => ({
      value: company.empresaId,
      label: company.razonSocial,
      description: company.ruc,
    })),
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  setTab(tab: OrganizationTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  loadOrganizations(
    page = this.organizations().page,
    size = this.organizations().size,
  ): void {
    this.organizationsLoading.set(true);
    this.organizationsError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.organizationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.organizations.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.organizationsError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadAreas(
    page = this.areas().page,
    size = this.areas().size,
  ): void {
    this.areasLoading.set(true);
    this.areasError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .areas(page, size, this.areaCompanyFilter() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.areasLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.areas.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.areasError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeAreaCompany(value: string): void {
    const companyId = Number(value);
    this.areaCompanyFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(companyId) && companyId > 0 ? companyId : null,
    );
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  async createCompany(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openCompany();

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadOrganizations(1);
    }
  }

  async createAssociation(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openAssociation();

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadOrganizations(1);
    }
  }

  editOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase
      .detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.openOrganizationEditor(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private async openOrganizationEditor(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const result = detail.organizacion.esAsociacion
      ? await this.formModal.openAssociation(detail)
      : await this.formModal.openCompany(detail);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadOrganizations();
    }
  }

  async viewOrganization(company: Empresa): Promise<void> {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);

    this.listUseCase
      .detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          void this.formModal.openView(detail);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async createArea(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.companyOptions().length === 0) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Falta una organización',
        'Registra una empresa o asociación antes de crear áreas.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openArea({
      companies: this.companyOptions(),
      areas: this.areas().items,
    });

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadAreas(1);
    }
  }

  async editArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openArea(
      {
        companies: this.companyOptions(),
        areas: this.areas().items,
      },
      area,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadAreas();
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Empresas, asociaciones y áreas"
    subtitle="Administra la estructura organizacional utilizada por los demás procesos."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  />

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5">
    <button
      type="button"
      [class.active]="activeTab() === 'organizations'"
      (click)="setTab('organizations')"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="companyIcon" />
      Organizaciones
    </button>
    <button
      type="button"
      [class.active]="activeTab() === 'areas'"
      (click)="setTab('areas')"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" />
      Áreas
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (activeTab() === 'organizations') {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="organizationsLoading()"
          (click)="loadOrganizations()"
        >
          <fa-icon
            [class.animate-spin]="organizationsLoading()"
            [icon]="refreshIcon"
          />
          Actualizar
        </button>

        <button
          *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          (click)="createCompany()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
          Nueva empresa
        </button>

        <button
          *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          (click)="createAssociation()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" />
          Nueva asociación
        </button>
      </div>

      @if (organizationsLoading()) {
        <app-loading-state
          title="Cargando organizaciones"
          message="Consultando empresas y asociaciones."
        />
      } @else if (organizationsError()) {
        <app-error-state
          [message]="organizationsError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
          (retry)="loadOrganizations()"
        />
      } @else if (organizations().items.length === 0) {
        <app-empty-state
          title="Sin organizaciones"
          message="Todavía no hay empresas o asociaciones disponibles."
        />
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Organización</th>
                <th>RUC</th>
                <th>Tipo</th>
                <th>Contacto</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
                <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (company of organizations().items; track company.empresaId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                        <fa-icon
                          [icon]="company.esAsociacion ? associationIcon : companyIcon"
                        />
                      </span>
                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ company.razonSocial }}</strong>
                        <span>{{ company.nombreComercial || 'Sin nombre comercial' }}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="admin-code">{{ company.ruc }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="admin-type-badge">
                      {{ company.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                      <strong>{{ company.correo || '—' }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ company.telefono || '—' }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="company.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!company.estado"
                    >
                      {{ company.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-row-actions">
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_VER'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Ver detalle"
                        [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId"
                        (click)="viewOrganization(company)"
                      >
                        @if (detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>

                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar"
                        (click)="editOrganization(company)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <app-paginator
          [page]="organizations().page"
          [size]="organizations().size"
          [totalRecords]="organizations().totalRecords"
          [totalPages]="organizations().totalPages"
          (pageChange)="loadOrganizations($event, organizations().size)"
          (sizeChange)="loadOrganizations(1, $event)"
        />
      }
    </section>
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar">
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
          <label for="areaCompanyFilter">Organización</label>

            id="areaCompanyFilter"
            class="admin-select"
            [value]="areaCompanyFilter() ?? 0"

          >
            <option [value]="0">Todas</option>
            @for (company of organizations().items; track company.empresaId) {
              <option [value]="company.empresaId">
                {{ company.razonSocial }}
              </option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-toolbar-actions">
          <button

          </button>

          <button
            *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'"
            type="button"

            (click)="createArea()"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
            Nueva área
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      @if (areasLoading()) {
        <app-loading-state
          title="Cargando áreas"
          message="Consultando la estructura de áreas."
        />
      } @else if (areasError()) {
        <app-error-state
          [message]="areasError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
          (retry)="loadAreas()"
        />
      } @else if (areas().items.length === 0) {
        <app-empty-state
          title="Sin áreas"
          message="No hay áreas para los criterios seleccionados."
        />
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Código</th>
                <th>Área</th>
                <th>Organización</th>
                <th>Área superior</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
                <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (area of areas().items; track area.areaId) {
                <tr>
                  <td><span class="admin-code">{{ area.codigo }}</span></td>
                  <td class="font-semibold text-slate-800">{{ area.nombre }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.empresa }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.areaPadre || '—' }}</td>
                  <td class="text-center">

                      class="admin-status"

                    >
                      {{ area.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}
                    </span>

                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-row-actions">
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar área"

                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <app-paginator
          [page]="areas().page"
          [size]="areas().size"
          [totalRecords]="areas().totalRecords"
          [totalPages]="areas().totalPages"
          (pageChange)="loadAreas($event, areas().size)"
          (sizeChange)="loadAreas(1, $event)"
        />
      }
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-organizacion-form />
```

```typescript
}

export class OrganizacionFormComponent {

    nombreComercial: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],

    numeroPartida: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
```
