```typescript
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],

  });

  openCompany(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onOrganizationPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().empresaId);
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        area.areaId !== currentAreaId &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: sanitizePhone(company?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (company?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.resetState();
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div
    class="modal-box admin-modal-box"
    [class.admin-modal-box--wide]="kind() === 'view'"
  >
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="icon()" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Organizaciones</p>
          <h2>{{ title() }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    @if (kind() === 'view' && detail(); as organizationDetail) {
      <div class="organization-view">
        <section class="organization-summary">
          <div>
            <span>Razón social</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.razonSocial }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>RUC</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.ruc }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Tipo</span>
            <strong>
              {{ organizationDetail.organizacion.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Correo</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.correo || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Teléfono</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.telefono || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Nombre comercial</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.nombreComercial || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Distrito</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.distritoNombre || organizationDetail.distritoCodigo }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Centro poblado</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.centroPobladoNombre || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Referencia</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.referencia || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Áreas</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.areas.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (area of organizationDetail.areas; track area.areaId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ area.nombre }}</strong>
                  <small>{{ area.codigo }}</small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay áreas registradas.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Empleados activos</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.empleados.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (employee of organizationDetail.empleados; track employee.empleadoId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ employee.empleado }}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {{ employee.numeroDocumento || 'Sin documento' }}
                    ·
                    {{ employee.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}
                  </small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay empleados activos.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cerrar
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    } @else if (kind() === 'area') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="areaForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="areaCompany">Organización</label>
          <select
            id="areaCompany"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="empresaId"
          >
            @for (option of companyOptions(); track option.value) {
              <option [value]="option.value">{{ option.label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="areaForm.controls.empresaId"
            fieldLabel="La organización"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="areaParent">Área superior</label>
          <select
            id="areaParent"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="areaPadreId"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Sin área superior</option>
            @for (area of areasForSelectedCompany(); track area.areaId) {
              <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="areaName">Nombre</label>
          <input
            id="areaName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="nombre"
            maxlength="120"
            placeholder="Nombre del área"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="areaForm.controls.nombre"
            fieldLabel="El nombre"
          />
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="companyForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationRuc">RUC</label>
          <div class="identity-document-control">
            <input
              id="organizationRuc"
              class="admin-input"
              type="text"
              formControlName="ruc"
              inputmode="numeric"
              autocomplete="off"
              maxlength="11"
              placeholder="20XXXXXXXXX"
              [readOnly]="identityLoading()"
              (input)="onRucInput()"
            />

            @if (!currentCompany()) {
              <button
                type="button"
                class="identity-search-button"
                [disabled]="!canResolveRuc()"
                [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
                (click)="resolveRuc()"
              >
                @if (identityLoading()) {
                  <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                  Buscando...
                } @else {
                  <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                  Buscar
                }
              </button>
            }
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.ruc"
            fieldLabel="El RUC"
            [messages]="{
              ruc: 'Ingresa un RUC válido de 11 dígitos con dígito verificador correcto.',
              rucNature: 'Para una empresa o asociación se requiere un RUC empresarial válido.'
            }"
          />
        </div>

        @if (identityMessage()) {
          <div
            class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
            [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
            [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
            [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
            role="status"
          >
            {{ identityMessage() }}
          </div>
        }

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="businessName">Razón social</label>
          <input
            id="businessName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="razonSocial"
            maxlength="200"
          [readOnly]="identityLocks().businessName" />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.razonSocial"
            fieldLabel="La razón social"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="tradeName">Nombre comercial</label>
          <input
            id="tradeName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="nombreComercial"
            maxlength="160"
          />
          <app-form-error [control]="companyForm.controls.nombreComercial" fieldLabel="El nombre comercial" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre comercial no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationPhone">Teléfono</label>
          <input
            id="organizationPhone"
            class="admin-input"
            type="tel"
            inputmode="tel"
            formControlName="telefono"
            maxlength="16"
            autocomplete="tel"
            [readOnly]="identityLocks().phone"
            (input)="onOrganizationPhoneInput()"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.telefono"
            fieldLabel="El teléfono"
            [messages]="{ phone: 'Ingrese un teléfono válido de 7 a 15 dígitos.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationEmail">Correo</label>
          <input
            id="organizationEmail"
            class="admin-input"
            type="email"
            formControlName="correo"
            autocomplete="email"
            maxlength="180"
          [readOnly]="identityLocks().email" />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.correo"
            fieldLabel="El correo"
          />
        </div>

        <app-geography-cascade
          [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
          [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
          [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
          [locationLocked]="identityLocks().geography"
          (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
        />


        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo"
            fieldLabel="El distrito"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
          <input
            id="organizationReference"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="referencia"
            maxlength="300"
            placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia"
          [readOnly]="identityLocks().reference" />
        </div>

        @if (kind() === 'association') {
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="foundationDate">Fecha de constitución</label>
            <input
              id="foundationDate"
              class="admin-input"
              type="date"
              formControlName="fechaConstitucion"
              [max]="today"
            />
            <app-form-error
              [control]="companyForm.controls.fechaConstitucion"
              fieldLabel="La fecha de constitución"
              [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de constitución no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="registryNumber">Número de partida</label>
            <input
              id="registryNumber"
              class="admin-input"
              type="text"
              formControlName="numeroPartida"
              maxlength="50"
            />
            <app-form-error [control]="companyForm.controls.numeroPartida" fieldLabel="El número de partida" [messages]="{ blank: 'El número de partida no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
          </div>
        }

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUsers,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { Empleado } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleados-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleados-list.html',
  styleUrl: './empleados-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiringId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly editingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<Empleado>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly areaFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly activeFilter = signal<boolean | null>(true);

  readonly pageIcon = faUsers;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filteredAreas = computed(() => {
    const companyId = this.companyFilter();

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.estado &&
        (companyId === null || area.empresaId === companyId),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      companies: this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100),
      areas: this.organizationsUseCase.areas(1, 100),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, areas }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.items.map((company) => ({
              value: company.empresaId,
              label: company.razonSocial,
              description: company.ruc,
            })),
          );
          this.areas.set(areas.items);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.areas.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        areaId: this.areaFilter() ?? undefined,
        activo: this.activeFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeCompany(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.companyFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);

    if (
      this.areaFilter() !== null &&
      !this.filteredAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === this.areaFilter(),
      )
    ) {
      this.areaFilter.set(null);
    }

    this.load(1);
  }

  changeArea(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.areaFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeActive(value: string): void {
    this.activeFilter.set(
      value === 'true' ? true : value === 'false' ? false : null,
    );
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.companies().length === 0) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Falta una organización',
        'Registra una organización antes de crear empleados.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open({
      companies: this.companies(),
      areas: this.areas(),
    });

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  edit(employee: Empleado): void {
    if (this.editingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.editingId.set(employee.empleadoId);
    this.getUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.editingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (detail) => {
          const result = await this.formModal.open(
            {
              companies: this.companies(),
              areas: this.areas(),
            },
            detail,
          );

          if (result.saved) {
            this.load();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir el empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async retire(employee: Empleado): Promise<void> {
    if (!employee.estado || this.retiringId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName(employee)}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiringId.set(employee.empleadoId);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  fullName(employee: Empleado): string {
    return [
      employee.nombres,
      employee.apellidoPaterno,
      employee.apellidoMaterno,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ');
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Empleados"
    subtitle="Administra los trabajadores y su adscripción organizacional."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
        [attr.title]="companies().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'Primero registra una organización' : 'Crear empleado'"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        @if (referencesLoading()) {
          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        }
        Nuevo empleado
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="employeeCompanyFilter">Organización</label>
        <select
          id="employeeCompanyFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="companyFilter() ?? 0"
          (change)="changeCompany($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Todas</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="employeeAreaFilter">Área</label>
        <select
          id="employeeAreaFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="areaFilter() ?? 0"
          (change)="changeArea($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Todas</option>
          @for (area of filteredAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="employeeActiveFilter">Estado</label>
        <select
          id="employeeActiveFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="activeFilter() === null ? '' : activeFilter()"
          (change)="changeActive($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="true">Activos</option>
          <option value="false">Retirados</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando empleados"
        message="Consultando trabajadores registrados."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin empleados"
        message="No hay empleados para los filtros seleccionados."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Empleado</th>
              <th>Documento</th>
              <th>Organización</th>
              <th>Área / cargo</th>
              <th>Cuenta</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (employee of result().items; track employee.empleadoId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-avatar">
                      {{ employee.nombres.charAt(0) }}{{ employee.apellidoPaterno.charAt(0) }}
                    </span>
                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ fullName(employee) }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ employee.codigoEmpleado }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ employee.numeroDocumento }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ employee.tipoDocumento }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{{ employee.empresa }}</td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ employee.area || 'Sin área' }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ employee.cargo || 'Sin cargo' }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  @if (employee.usuarioId) {
                    <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                      <strong>{{ employee.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ employee.estadoCuenta || '—' }}</span>
                    </div>
                  } @else {
                    <span class="admin-muted-badge">Sin cuenta</span>
                  }
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="employee.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!employee.estado"
                  >
                    {{ employee.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Retirado' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <a
                      *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_VER'"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      [routerLink]="['/administracion/empleados', employee.empleadoId]"
                      title="Ver detalle"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                    </a>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      [attr.title]="employee.estado ? 'Editar' : 'El empleado retirado es solo de consulta'"
                      [disabled]="!employee.estado"
                      (click)="edit(employee)"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                    </button>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_RETIRAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                      [attr.title]="employee.estado ? 'Retirar' : 'El empleado ya está retirado'"
                      [disabled]="!employee.estado || retiringId() === employee.empleadoId"
                      (click)="retire(employee)"
                    >
                      @if (retiringId() === employee.empleadoId) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faBuilding,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faIdCard,
  faPen,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadoDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly employeeId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly identityIcon = faIdCard;
  readonly organizationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly accountIcon = faShieldHalved;

  readonly fullName = computed(() => {
    const value = this.detail();

    return value
      ? [value.nombres, value.apellidoPaterno, value.apellidoMaterno]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      : 'Empleado';
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.employeeId) || this.employeeId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El empleado solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.employeeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      companies: this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100),
      areas: this.organizationsUseCase.areas(1, 100),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, areas }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.items.map((company) => ({
              value: company.empresaId,
              label: company.razonSocial,
              description: company.ruc,
            })),
          );
          this.areas.set(areas.items);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.areas.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open(
      {
        companies: this.companies(),
        areas: this.areas(),
      },
      employee,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.retiring()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName()}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiring.set(true);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,

  ElementRef,

  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faPen,
  faUserPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionService } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  adultBirthDateValidator,
  dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator,
  dateOrderValidator,
  dniValidator,
  maxBirthDateIso,
  minBirthDateIso,
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
  personNameValidator,
  phoneValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
  sanitizePersonName,
  sanitizePhone,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import {
  AdminModalResult,
  AdminSelectOption,
} from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import {
  Empleado,
  EmpleadoDetalle,
  TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
} from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';

interface EmployeeFormOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  names: boolean;
  paternalSurname: boolean;
  maternalSurname: boolean;
  birthDate: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    names: false,
    paternalSurname: false,
    maternalSurname: false,
    birthDate: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityEditingEnabled = signal(false);
  readonly identityRecordLoaded = signal(false);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly maxBirthDate = maxBirthDateIso();
  readonly minBirthDate = minBirthDateIso();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoEmpleado;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [personNameValidator, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [adultBirthDateValidator()]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
        dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator(
          'fechaNacimiento',
          'fechaIngreso',
          18,
          'entryBeforeAdult',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: sanitizePersonName(employee?.nombres ?? '').slice(0, 100),
      apellidoPaterno: sanitizePersonName(employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '').slice(0, 80),
      apellidoMaterno: sanitizePersonName(employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '').slice(0, 80),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(employee?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (employee?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId:
        employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);

    if (employee) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);
      this.identityLocks.set({
        names: true,
        paternalSurname: true,
        maternalSurname: true,
        birthDate: true,
        phone: true,
        email: true,
        geography: true,
        reference: true,
      });

      if (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
        );
      }
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')) {
      this.form.patchValue({
        centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onPersonNameInput(
    field: 'nombres' | 'apellidoPaterno' | 'apellidoMaterno',
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls[field];
    const maxLength = field === 'nombres' ? 100 : 80;
    const sanitized = sanitizePersonName(control.value).slice(0, maxLength);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  onPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  onCompanyChange(): void {
    const selectedArea = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);

    if (
      selectedArea > 0
      && !this.availableAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === selectedArea,
      )
    ) {
      this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
    );
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${values.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'No se puede usar esta persona para el empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            areaId > 0 && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    const current = this.current();

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    if (
      result.isEmployee
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.empleadoId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta persona ya está registrada como empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);

      const resolvedType = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
      const resolvedDocument = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value;

      if (resolvedType === 'DNI' || resolvedType === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(resolvedType, resolvedDocument),
        );
      }

      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set('Datos de la persona cargados.');
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = result.found
      ? {
          names: true,
          paternalSurname: true,
          maternalSurname: true,
          birthDate: true,
          phone: true,
          email: true,
          geography: true,
          reference: true,
        }
      : emptyIdentityFieldLocks();

    this.form.patchValue({
      tipoDocumento:
        result.documentType === 'RUC' ? 'RUC' :
        result.documentType === 'DNI' ? 'DNI' :
        this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      numeroDocumento:
        result.documentNumber?.trim() ||
        this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  canEditIdentityData(): boolean {
    return this.permissions.has('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR');
  }

  canToggleIdentityEditing(): boolean {
    return this.identityRecordLoaded()
      && this.canEditIdentityData();
  }

  toggleIdentityEditing(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(
      enabled && this.canToggleIdentityEditing(),
    );
  }

  isIdentityFieldReadOnly(
    field: keyof IdentityFieldLocks,
  ): boolean {
    return this.identityLocks()[field]
      && !this.identityEditingEnabled();
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(false);
    this.identityRecordLoaded.set(false);
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}
```
