```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Empleados</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar empleado' : 'Registrar empleado' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Identificación</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocumentType">Tipo de documento</label>
        <select
          id="employeeDocumentType"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="tipoDocumento"
          (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()"
        >
          @for (item of documentTypes; track item.value) {
            <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocument">Número de documento</label>
        <div class="identity-document-control">
          <input
            id="employeeDocument"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading() || !!current()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />

          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="identity-search-button"
              [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()"
              [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
              (click)="resolveIdentity()"
            >
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                Buscando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                Buscar
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El número de documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            ruc: 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.',
            rucNature: 'Para una persona se requiere un RUC personal válido.',
            blank: 'El número de documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
        @if (!shouldResolveIdentity()) {
          <small class="identity-help">
            DNI y RUC permiten completar automáticamente los datos disponibles. Los demás documentos se completan manualmente.
          </small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      @if (canToggleIdentityEditing()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              [checked]="identityEditingEnabled()"
              (change)="toggleIdentityEditing($any($event.target).checked)"
            />
            Editar datos de la persona
          </label>
          <small>El número de documento no se puede modificar.</small>
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="employeeNames" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="nombres" maxlength="100" autocomplete="given-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('names')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('nombres')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.', personName: 'Los nombres solo pueden contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeLastName">Apellido paterno</label>
        <input id="employeeLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoPaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="family-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('paternalSurname')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('apellidoPaterno')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoPaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido paterno" [messages]="{ blank: 'El apellido paterno no puede contener solo espacios.', personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeSecondLastName">Apellido materno</label>
        <input id="employeeSecondLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoMaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="additional-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('maternalSurname')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('apellidoMaterno')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoMaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido materno" [messages]="{ personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeBirthDate">Fecha de nacimiento</label>
        <input id="employeeBirthDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaNacimiento" [min]="minBirthDate" [max]="maxBirthDate" autocomplete="bday" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('birthDate')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaNacimiento" fieldLabel="La fecha de nacimiento" [messages]="{ underage: 'La persona debe ser mayor de edad.', ageOutOfRange: 'La fecha de nacimiento está fuera del rango permitido.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
      </div>

      @if (resolvedSex()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeSex">Sexo</label>
          <input id="employeeSex" class="admin-input" type="text" [value]="resolvedSex()" readonly aria-readonly="true" />
        </div>
      }


      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeePhone">Teléfono</label>
        <input id="employeePhone" class="admin-input" type="tel" inputmode="tel" formControlName="telefono" maxlength="16" autocomplete="tel" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('phone')" (input)="onPhoneInput()" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.telefono" fieldLabel="El teléfono" [messages]="{ phone: 'Ingrese un teléfono válido de 7 a 15 dígitos.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="employeeEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" formControlName="correo" maxlength="180" autocomplete="email" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('email')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Ubicación de la persona</span>
      </div>

      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        [locationLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="employeeReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="employeeReference" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('reference')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Información laboral</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeCompany">Organización</label>
        <select id="employeeCompany" class="admin-select" formControlName="empresaId" (change)="onCompanyChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.empresaId" fieldLabel="La organización" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEntryDate">Fecha de ingreso</label>
        <input id="employeeEntryDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaIngreso" [max]="today" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaIngreso" fieldLabel="La fecha de ingreso" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de ingreso no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
        @if (form.hasError('entryBeforeAdult')) {
          <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de ingreso no puede ser anterior a la mayoría de edad de la persona.</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeArea">Área</label>
        <select id="employeeArea" class="admin-select" formControlName="areaId" (change)="onAreaChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Sin área asignada</option>
          @for (area of availableAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeRoleName">
          Cargo
          @if (form.controls.areaId.value > 0) { <span aria-hidden="true">*</span> }
        </label>
        <input id="employeeRoleName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="cargo" maxlength="120" placeholder="Cargo o función" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.cargo" fieldLabel="El cargo" [messages]="{ blank: 'El cargo no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      @if (current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeAreaDate">Fecha de asignación de área</label>
          <input id="employeeAreaDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAsignacionArea" [max]="today" />
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAsignacionArea" fieldLabel="La fecha de asignación" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de asignación no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
          @if (form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
            <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de asignación de área no puede ser anterior a la fecha de ingreso.</small>
          }
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_230910_617524/src/app/features/administracion/usuarios/adapter/in/ui/pages/usuarios-list/usuarios-list.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faRotateLeft,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../../empleados/application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-cuenta.use-case';
import { ListarUsuariosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-usuarios.use-case';
import { ObtenerUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-usuario.use-case';
import { ReactivarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/reactivar-cuenta.use-case';
import { Usuario } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuarioFormComponent } from '../usuario-form/usuario-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuarios-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UsuarioFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuarios-list.html',
  styleUrl: './usuarios-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuariosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UsuarioFormComponent)
  private formModal!: UsuarioFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarUsuariosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly reactivateUseCase = inject(ReactivarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly employeesUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
  private readonly rolesUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly actionUserId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<Usuario>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faUsersGear;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      companies: this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100),
      employees: this.employeesUseCase.execute({
        activo: true,
        page: 1,
        size: 100,
      }),
      roles: this.rolesUseCase.execute(1, 100),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, employees, roles }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.items.map((company) => ({
              value: company.empresaId,
              label: company.razonSocial,
              description: company.ruc,
            })),
          );

          this.employees.set(
            employees.items
              .filter((employee) => !employee.usuarioId)
              .map((employee) => ({
                value: employee.empleadoId,
                label: `${this.employeeName(employee)} · ${employee.numeroDocumento}`,
                description: `${employee.empresa}${employee.area ? ` · ${employee.area}` : ''}`,
              })),
          );

          this.roles.set(
            roles.items
              .filter((role) => role.estado)
              .map((role) => ({
                value: role.rolId,
                label: role.nombre,
                description: role.codigo,
                disabled: role.esSistema && !role.estado,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.employees.set([]);
          this.roles.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoCuenta: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeState(value: string): void {
    this.stateFilter.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeCompany(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.companyFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.employees().length === 0) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Sin empleados disponibles',
        'Todos los empleados activos ya tienen una cuenta.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.roles().length === 0) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Sin roles disponibles',
        'Primero debe existir al menos un rol activo.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openCreate({
      employees: this.employees(),
      roles: this.roles(),
    });

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  edit(user: Usuario): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (detail) => {
          const result = await this.formModal.openEdit(detail);

          if (result.saved) {
            this.load();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async disable(user: Usuario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.actionUserId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" dejará de poder ingresar al sistema.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.actionUserId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionUserId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta deshabilitada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async reactivate(user: Usuario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.actionUserId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Reactivar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" volverá a estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Reactivar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.actionUserId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.reactivateUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionUserId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta reactivada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reactivar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  isDisabled(user: Usuario): boolean {
    return (user.estadoCuenta || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESHABILITADA';
  }

  accountStateLabel(state: string | null): string {
    switch ((state || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ACTIVA':
        return 'Activa';
      case 'DESHABILITADA':
        return 'Deshabilitada';
      case 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION':
        return 'Pendiente de validación';
      case 'BLOQUEADA':
        return 'Bloqueada';
      default:
        return state || 'Sin estado';
    }
  }

  private employeeName(employee: {
    nombres: string;
    apellidoPaterno: string;
    apellidoMaterno: string | null;
  }): string {
    return [
      employee.nombres,
      employee.apellidoPaterno,
      employee.apellidoMaterno,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ');
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Usuarios y accesos"
    subtitle="Administra cuentas, estados y asignaciones de acceso."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
        [attr.title]="employees().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'Todos los empleados activos ya tienen una cuenta' : roles().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'No hay roles activos disponibles' : 'Crear cuenta'"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        @if (referencesLoading()) {
          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        }
        Nueva cuenta
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="userStateFilter">Estado de cuenta</label>
        <select
          id="userStateFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="stateFilter()"
          (change)="changeState($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="PENDIENTE_VALIDACION">Pendiente de validación</option>
          <option value="ACTIVA">Activa</option>
          <option value="DESHABILITADA">Deshabilitada</option>
          <option value="BLOQUEADA">Bloqueada</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="userCompanyFilter">Organización</label>
        <select
          id="userCompanyFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="companyFilter() ?? 0"
          (change)="changeCompany($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Todas</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando usuarios"
        message="Consultando cuentas y accesos activos."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin usuarios"
        message="No hay cuentas para los filtros seleccionados."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Usuario</th>
              <th>Empleado</th>
              <th>Organización</th>
              <th class="text-center">Roles</th>
              <th class="text-center">Sesiones</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (user of result().items; track user.usuarioId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-avatar">
                      {{ user.nombreUsuario.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() }}
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ user.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ user.empleado || '—' }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ user.numeroDocumento || '—' }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{{ user.empresa || '—' }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ user.rolesActivos }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ user.sesionesActivas }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="user.estadoCuenta === 'ACTIVA'"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="isDisabled(user)"
                    [class.admin-status--info]="user.estadoCuenta === 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION'"
                    [class.admin-status--warning]="user.estadoCuenta === 'BLOQUEADA'"
                  >
                    {{ accountStateLabel(user.estadoCuenta) }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <a
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_VER'"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      [routerLink]="['/administracion/usuarios', user.usuarioId]"
                      title="Ver detalle"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                    </a>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar"
                      [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === user.usuarioId"
                      (click)="edit(user)"
                    >
                      @if (detailLoadingId() === user.usuarioId) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>

                    @if (isDisabled(user)) {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CONFIRMAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--success"
                        title="Reactivar"
                        [disabled]="actionUserId() === user.usuarioId"
                        (click)="reactivate(user)"
                      >
                        @if (actionUserId() === user.usuarioId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="reactivateIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    } @else {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_RETIRAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                        title="Deshabilitar"
                        [disabled]="actionUserId() === user.usuarioId"
                        (click)="disable(user)"
                      >
                        @if (actionUserId() === user.usuarioId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-usuario-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faBan,
  faComputer,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faKey,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faRotateLeft,
  faShieldHalved,
  faTrashCan,
  faUser,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { AsignarRolUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/asignar-rol-usuario.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-cuenta.use-case';
import { ObtenerUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-usuario.use-case';
import { ReactivarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/reactivar-cuenta.use-case';
import { RetirarRolUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-rol-usuario.use-case';
import { UsuarioDetalle, UsuarioRol } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuarioFormComponent } from '../usuario-form/usuario-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UsuarioFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuarioDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UsuarioFormComponent)
  private formModal!: UsuarioFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
  private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly reactivateUseCase = inject(ReactivarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly assignRoleUseCase = inject(AsignarRolUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly removeRoleUseCase = inject(RetirarRolUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly rolesUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly userId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly rolesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly accountActionLoading = signal(false);
  readonly roleSaving = signal(false);
  readonly removingRoleId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly roleError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<UsuarioDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly availableRoles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;
  readonly roleIcon = faKey;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly deviceIcon = faComputer;
  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly roleForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    rolId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadRoles();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.userId) || this.userId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El usuario solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.userId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadRoles(): void {
    this.rolesLoading.set(true);

    this.rolesUseCase
      .execute(1, 100)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.rolesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (roles) =>
          this.availableRoles.set(
            roles.items
              .filter((role) => role.estado)
              .map((role) => ({
                value: role.rolId,
                label: role.nombre,
                description: role.codigo,
              })),
          ),
        error: () => this.availableRoles.set([]),
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openEdit(user);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || this.accountActionLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" dejará de poder ingresar al sistema.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.accountActionLoading.set(true);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.accountActionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta deshabilitada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async reactivate(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || this.accountActionLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Reactivar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" volverá a estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Reactivar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.accountActionLoading.set(true);

    this.reactivateUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.accountActionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta reactivada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reactivar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  openAssignRole(): void {
    const selected = new Set(
      this.detail()?.roles
        .filter((role) => role.estado)
        .map((role) => role.rolId) ?? [],
    );

    const firstAvailable = this.availableRoles().find(
      (role) => !selected.has(role.value),
    );

    this.roleForm.reset({ rolId: firstAvailable?.value ?? 0 });
    this.roleError.set(null);
    this.roleDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
  }

  closeRoleDialog(): void {
    if (this.roleSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.roleDialog.nativeElement.close();
    this.roleError.set(null);
  }

  roleOptions(): readonly AdminSelectOption[] {
    const selected = new Set(
      this.detail()?.roles
        .filter((role) => role.estado)
        .map((role) => role.rolId) ?? [],
    );

    return this.availableRoles().filter(
      (role) => !selected.has(role.value),
    );
  }

  assignRole(): void {
    this.roleForm.markAllAsTouched();

    const user = this.detail();
    const roleId = Number(this.roleForm.controls.rolId.value);

    if (!user || this.roleForm.invalid || this.roleSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.roleSaving.set(true);
    this.roleError.set(null);

    this.assignRoleUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.roleSaving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol asignado');
          this.closeRoleDialog();
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.roleError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async removeRole(role: UsuarioRol): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || !role.estado || this.removingRoleId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar rol',
      message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar asignado a la cuenta.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar rol',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro del rol.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.removingRoleId.set(role.rolId);

    this.removeRoleUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.removingRoleId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar el rol',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  isDisabled(): boolean {
    return (this.detail()?.estadoCuenta || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESHABILITADA';
  }

  accountStateLabel(state: string | null): string {
    switch ((state || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ACTIVA':
        return 'Activa';
      case 'DESHABILITADA':
        return 'Deshabilitada';
      case 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION':
        return 'Pendiente de validación';
      case 'BLOQUEADA':
        return 'Bloqueada';
      default:
        return state || 'Sin estado';
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="detail()?.nombreUsuario || 'Detalle del usuario'"
    subtitle="Consulta la cuenta, sus roles y los dispositivos asociados."
    eyebrow="Usuario"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/administracion/usuarios">
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      @if (detail()) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'USUARIOS_EDITAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          (click)="edit()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
          Editar
        </button>

        @if (isDisabled()) {
          <button
            *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CONFIRMAR'"
            type="button"
            class="admin-success-button"
            [disabled]="accountActionLoading()"
            (click)="reactivate()"
          >
            @if (accountActionLoading()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="reactivateIcon" />
            }
            Reactivar
          </button>
        } @else {
          <button
            *appPermission="'USUARIOS_RETIRAR'"
            type="button"
            class="admin-danger-button"
            [disabled]="accountActionLoading()"
            (click)="disable()"
          >
            @if (accountActionLoading()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
            }
            Deshabilitar
          </button>
        }
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando usuario"
        message="Consultando roles, dispositivos y estado de la cuenta."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as user) {
      <section class="admin-detail-grid">
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Usuario</span>
          <strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Empleado</span>
          <strong>{{ user.empleado || '—' }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Documento</span>
          <strong>{{ user.numeroDocumento || '—' }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Estado</span>
          <strong>{{ accountStateLabel(user.estadoCuenta) }}</strong>
        </article>
      </section>

      <div class="user-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Cuenta</p>
              <h2>Configuración actual</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="userIcon" />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-info-list">
            <div>
              <span>Fecha de creación</span>
              <strong>
                {{ user.fechaCreacion ? (user.fechaCreacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}
              </strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Último acceso</span>
              <strong>
                {{ user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto ? (user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}
              </strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Cambio de contraseña requerido</span>
              <strong>{{ user.requiereCambioPassword ? 'Sí' : 'No' }}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Segundo factor</span>
              <strong>{{ user.segundoFactorHabilitado ? 'Habilitado' : 'No habilitado' }}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Roles</p>
              <h2>Accesos asignados</h2>
            </div>

            <button
              *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CREAR'"
              type="button"
              class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small"
              [disabled]="rolesLoading() || roleOptions().length === 0"
              (click)="openAssignRole()"
            >
              @if (rolesLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
              }
              Asignar rol
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="user-role-list">
            @for (role of user.roles; track role.rolId) {
              <article [class.inactive]="!role.estado">
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ role.nombre }}</strong>
                  <span>{{ role.codigo }}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="user-role-actions">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="role.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!role.estado"
                  >
                    {{ role.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Histórico' }}
                  </span>

                  @if (role.estado) {
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_RETIRAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                      title="Retirar rol"
                      [disabled]="removingRoleId() === role.rolId"
                      (click)="removeRole(role)"
                    >
                      @if (removingRoleId() === role.rolId) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="removeIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>
                  }
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="admin-empty-copy p-4">No hay roles asignados.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="admin-section-header">
          <div>
            <p>Dispositivos</p>
            <h2>Dispositivos asociados</h2>
          </div>
          <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="deviceIcon" />
        </div>

        <div class="device-admin-grid">
          @for (device of user.dispositivos; track device.dispositivoUsuarioId) {
            <article>
              <div class="device-admin-icon">
                <fa-icon [icon]="deviceIcon" />
              </div>
              <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <strong>
                  {{ device.navegador || 'Navegador' }}
                  ·
                  {{ device.sistemaOperativo || 'Dispositivo' }}
                </strong>
                <span>
                  Última actividad:
                  {{ device.ultimaActividad ? (device.ultimaActividad | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span
                class="admin-status"
                [class.admin-status--active]="device.esReconocido"
                [class.admin-status--neutral]="!device.esReconocido"
              >
                {{ device.esReconocido ? 'Reconocido' : 'No reconocido' }}
              </span>
            </article>
          } @empty {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy">No hay dispositivos registrados.</p>
          }
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<dialog #roleDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeRoleDialog()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--compact">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="roleIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Usuarios y accesos</p>
          <h2>Asignar rol</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        [disabled]="roleSaving()"
        (click)="closeRoleDialog()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (roleError()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ roleError() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="roleForm" (ngSubmit)="assignRole()">
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="userRole">Rol</label>
        <select id="userRole" class="admin-select" formControlName="rolId">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar rol</option>
          @for (role of roleOptions(); track role.value) {
            <option [value]="role.value">{{ role.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="roleForm.controls.rolId"
          fieldLabel="El rol"
        />
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="roleSaving()"
          (click)="closeRoleDialog()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>
        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="roleSaving()"
        >
          @if (roleSaving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Asignando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Asignar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

<app-usuario-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```css
.permission-option:active .permission-checkbox-box:not(.permission-checkbox-box--readonly) {
  transform: scale(0.94);

.permission-checkbox-box--readonly {
```

```css
.admin-switch-control::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.17rem;
  left: 0.18rem;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.25);
  transition: transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-control:checked {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  background: #2563eb;
}

.admin-switch-control:checked::after {
  transform: translateX(1.06rem);
}

.admin-switch-control:focus-visible {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.12),
    inset 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
}

.admin-switch-control:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.admin-option-grid {

  max-height: 13rem;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.5rem;
  overflow: auto;

  padding: 0.6rem;

  padding: 0.65rem;

.admin-check-option strong,

}
```

### 250. `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_233518_580581/src/app/core/ui/theme.service.ts`

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260912_233518_580581/src/app/core/ui/theme.service.ts`

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_233518_580581/src/app/core/ui/theme.service.ts`

```typescript
import { DOCUMENT, isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { PLATFORM_ID, computed, effect, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

export type AppTheme = 'light' | 'dark';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ThemeService {
  private static readonly storageKey = 'desco.ui.theme';

  private readonly document = inject(DOCUMENT);
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);
  private readonly browser = isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId);
  private readonly themeSignal = signal<AppTheme>(this.initialTheme());

  readonly theme = this.themeSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly isDark = computed(() => this.themeSignal() === 'dark');

  constructor() {
    effect(() => this.apply(this.themeSignal()));
  }

  set(theme: AppTheme): void {
    this.themeSignal.set(theme);
  }

  toggle(): void {
    this.themeSignal.update((theme) => (theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  }

  private initialTheme(): AppTheme {
    if (!this.browser) return 'light';

    const stored = localStorage.getItem(ThemeService.storageKey);
    if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'light') return stored;

    return window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
      ? 'dark'
      : 'light';
  }

  private apply(theme: AppTheme): void {
    const html = this.document.documentElement;
    html.dataset['theme'] = theme;
    html.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark');
    html.style.colorScheme = theme;

    if (this.browser) {
      localStorage.setItem(ThemeService.storageKey, theme);
    }
  }
}
```

```css
}

.admin-table td > .admin-entity,
.admin-table td > .admin-stack-copy,
.admin-table td > .admin-row-actions,
.admin-table td > .admin-status,
.admin-table td > .admin-code,
.admin-table td > .admin-count-badge,
.admin-table td > .admin-muted-badge {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table .admin-row-actions {
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-table tbody tr {
  transition: background 120ms ease;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
}


.admin-table-primary {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-table-muted {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.admin-table-empty {
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — ENTIDADES Y COPIA
   ============================================================ */

.admin-entity {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 12rem;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 0.72rem;
}

.admin-entity > div,
.admin-stack-copy {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-self: center;
}

.admin-entity > div > strong,
.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy strong,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-entity strong,
.admin-stack-copy strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.08rem 0 0;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 0.95rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon,
.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-entity-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  min-width: 2.25rem;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 2.25rem;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-avatar {
  background: #1d4ed8;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  place-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-code {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge,
.admin-muted-badge,
.admin-count-badge,
.admin-usage-badge,
.admin-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.6rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.52rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge {
  background: #eef2ff;
  color: #4338ca;
}

.admin-muted-badge {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-count-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-usage-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-usage-badge--used {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #c2410c;
}

.admin-status {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-status--active {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-status--inactive {
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-status--info {
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-status--warning {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #b45309;
}

.admin-status--neutral {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

 .admin-managed-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-field-hint {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: #7b8ba1;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — DETALLE
   ============================================================ */

.admin-detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-detail-card {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.03);
}

.admin-detail-card span,
.admin-detail-card strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-detail-card span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-detail-card strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.22rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-info-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
}

.admin-info-list > div {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.admin-info-list > div:nth-child(-n + 2) {
  border-top: 0;
}

.admin-info-list span,
.admin-info-list strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-info-list span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-info-list strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-chip-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.admin-chip-list article {
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
}

.admin-chip-list strong,
.admin-chip-list span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-chip-list strong {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-chip-list span {
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.admin-empty-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — AVISOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-notice {
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  color: #1e40af;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-notice--warning {
  border-color: #fde68a;
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #92400e;
}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .admin-toolbar,
  .admin-toolbar--end {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-field {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: none;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-actions {
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .admin-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-field-span-2 {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .admin-option-grid,
  .admin-info-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-info-list > div:nth-child(2) {
    border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions > button,
  .admin-modal-actions > a {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-row-actions {
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .admin-icon-button {
    width: 2.1rem;
    height: 2.1rem;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — CENTRADO NORMALIZADO DE IDENTIFICADORES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table .admin-entity {
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon {
  display: grid;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* GESTION TECNICA - NORMALIZACION TRANSVERSAL */
.technical-toolbar{align-items:flex-end}.technical-search-form{display:flex;min-width:min(100%,28rem);flex:1 1 28rem;align-items:flex-end;gap:.5rem}.technical-search-form .admin-input{min-width:12rem;flex:1 1 18rem}.technical-filter-switch{min-width:11.5rem;flex:0 1 14rem;padding:.62rem .72rem}.technical-filter-switch strong{font-size:.7rem}.technical-filter-switch span{margin-top:.08rem;font-size:.6rem}.technical-table-copy{display:grid;min-width:0;gap:.12rem}.technical-table-copy>strong,.technical-table-copy>span{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.technical-table-copy>strong{color:#0f172a;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800}.technical-table-copy>span{color:#64748b;font-size:.64rem;font-weight:600}.technical-loading-button{min-width:6.5rem}.admin-icon-button--success{border-color:#bbf7d0;background:#f0fdf4;color:#15803d}.admin-icon-button--success:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#86efac;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}.technical-modal-context{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.55rem;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:.85rem;background:#f8fafc;padding:.7rem}.technical-modal-context span,.technical-modal-context strong{display:block}.technical-modal-context span{color:#94a3b8;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.035em}.technical-modal-context strong{margin-top:.16rem;overflow:hidden;color:#334155;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:760px){.technical-search-form{flex-wrap:wrap}.technical-search-form .admin-input{flex-basis:100%}.technical-filter-switch{flex-basis:100%}.technical-modal-context{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260912_233519_336688/src/app/shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCircleExclamation,
  faShieldHalved,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import {
  ActionConfirmConfig,
  ActionConfirmResult,
  ActionConfirmTone,
} from './action-confirm-dialog.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-action-confirm-dialog',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FormsModule, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './action-confirm-dialog.html',
  styleUrl: './action-confirm-dialog.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ActionConfirmDialogComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  readonly config = signal<ActionConfirmConfig | null>(null);
  readonly reason = signal('');
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: ActionConfirmResult) => void) | null = null;

  show(config: ActionConfirmConfig): Promise<ActionConfirmResult> {
    if (this.resolver) {
      this.resolver({ confirmed: false, reason: null });
      this.resolver = null;
    }

    this.config.set({
      confirmLabel: 'Confirmar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      tone: 'primary',
      requiresReason: false,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Describe el motivo de esta acción.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 500,
      ...config,
    });

    this.reason.set('');
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise<ActionConfirmResult>((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  confirm(): void {
    const current = this.config();

    if (!current || !this.canConfirm()) {
      return;
    }

    const reason = this.reason().trim();

    this.finish({
      confirmed: true,
      reason: reason || null,
    });
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.finish({
      confirmed: false,
      reason: null,
    });
  }

  canConfirm(): boolean {
    const current = this.config();

    if (!current?.requiresReason) {
      return true;
    }

    const length = this.reason().trim().length;
    const minimum = current.minimumReasonLength ?? 5;
    const maximum = current.maximumReasonLength ?? 500;

    return length >= minimum && length <= maximum;
  }

  iconFor(tone: ActionConfirmTone | undefined) {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'danger':
        return faCircleExclamation;
      case 'warning':
        return faTriangleExclamation;
      default:
        return faShieldHalved;
    }
  }

  iconClass(tone: ActionConfirmTone | undefined): string {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'danger':
        return 'bg-red-50 text-red-600';
      case 'warning':
        return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600';
      default:
        return 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600';
    }
  }

  confirmButtonClass(tone: ActionConfirmTone | undefined): string {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'danger':
        return 'bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700';
      case 'warning':
        return 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 hover:bg-amber-600';
      default:
        return 'bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: ActionConfirmResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.config.set(null);
    this.reason.set('');
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal modal-bottom sm:modal-middle"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); cancel()"
>
  @if (config(); as current) {
    <div class="modal-box max-w-lg rounded-t-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-0 shadow-2xl sm:rounded-3xl">
      <div class="flex items-start gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 p-6">
        <div
          class="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl"
          [class]="iconClass(current.tone)"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="iconFor(current.tone)" />
        </div>

        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">
            {{ current.title }}
          </h2>
          <p class="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
            {{ current.message }}
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm btn-square rounded-xl text-slate-500"
          aria-label="Cerrar"
          (click)="cancel()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
        </button>
      </div>

      @if (current.requiresReason) {
        <div class="px-6 pt-5">
          <label class="form-control w-full">
            <span class="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
              {{ current.reasonLabel }}
            </span>
            <textarea
              class="textarea textarea-bordered min-h-28 w-full rounded-2xl border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none"
              [placeholder]="current.reasonPlaceholder ?? ''"
              [attr.maxlength]="current.maximumReasonLength ?? 500"
              [ngModel]="reason()"
              (ngModelChange)="reason.set($event)"
            ></textarea>
            <span class="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
              Entre {{ current.minimumReasonLength ?? 5 }} y {{ current.maximumReasonLength ?? 500 }} caracteres.
            </span>
          </label>
        </div>
      }

      <div class="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 p-6 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="btn rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          (click)="cancel()"
        >
          {{ current.cancelLabel }}
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          class="btn rounded-xl border-0"
          [class]="confirmButtonClass(current.tone)"
          [disabled]="!canConfirm()"
          (click)="confirm()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="iconFor(current.tone)" />
          {{ current.confirmLabel }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  }

  <form method="dialog" class="modal-backdrop bg-slate-950/40">
    <button type="button" aria-label="Cerrar" (click)="cancel()">close</button>
  </form>
</dialog>
```
