```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { EditarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { Catalogo } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogo-detail',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './catalogo-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogo-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogoDetailComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly catalog = signal<Catalogo | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<CatalogoItem | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly catalogIcon = faLayerGroup;

  readonly nameMaxLength = computed(
    () => this.catalog()?.nombreMaxLength ?? 150,
  );

  readonly showDescription = computed(
    () => this.catalog()?.admiteDescripcion !== false,
  );

  private resolver:
    | ((result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>) => void)
    | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)],
    ],
    descripcion: [
      '',
      [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
    ],
    categoria: [''],
  });

  open(
    catalog: Catalogo,
    item: CatalogoItem | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>> {
    this.catalog.set(catalog);
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.configureValidators(catalog);

    this.form.reset({
      codigo: item?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item?.nombre ?? '',
      descripcion:
        catalog.requiereCategoria || catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
          ? ''
          : item?.descripcion ?? '',
      categoria: item?.categoria ?? '',
    });

    this.form.controls.codigo[item ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  save(): void {
    const catalog = this.catalog();
    const current = this.current();

    if (catalog && !current) {
      this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          catalog.codigo,
          this.form.controls.nombre.value,
          catalog.codigoMaxLength ?? 40,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!catalog || this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const description =
      catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
        ? undefined
        : normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion);

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.id, {
          catalogo: catalog.codigo,
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: description,
          categoria: raw.categoria.trim() || undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          catalogo: catalog.codigo,
          codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: description,
          categoria: raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Valor actualizado' : 'Valor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: current,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  private configureValidators(catalog: Catalogo): void {
    this.form.controls.codigo.setValidators([
      Validators.required,
      Validators.maxLength(catalog.codigoMaxLength ?? 40),
    ]);

    this.form.controls.nombre.setValidators([
      Validators.required,
      notBlankValidator,
      Validators.maxLength(catalog.nombreMaxLength ?? 150),
    ]);

    this.form.controls.descripcion.setValidators(
      catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
        ? []
        : [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
    );

    this.form.controls.categoria.setValidators(
      catalog.requiereCategoria ? [Validators.required] : [],
    );

    this.form.controls.codigo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.nombre.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.descripcion.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.form.controls.categoria.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.catalog.set(null);
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="pageTitle"

  >

        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />

        (click)="create()"

        {{ createLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">

      <div class="admin-toolbar">
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
          <label for="catalogSelector">Catálogo</label>
          <select
            id="catalogSelector"
            class="admin-select"
            [value]="catalogCode()"
            (change)="changeCatalog($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            @for (group of catalogGroups; track group.codigo) {

                @for (catalog of group.catalogos; track catalog.codigo) {

                }
              </optgroup>
            }
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="catalog-description">
          <div class="catalog-description-heading">
            <strong>{{ selectedCatalog().nombre }}</strong>
            <span class="catalog-group-badge">{{ selectedCatalog().grupoNombre }}</span>
          </div>
          <span>{{ selectedCatalog().descripcion }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    }

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state title="Cargando" message="Consultando información." />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        title="No se pudo cargar"
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state [title]="emptyTitle" [message]="emptyMessage" />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Código</th>
              <th>Nombre</th>

            </tr>

                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td class="admin-table-muted max-w-md">{{ item.descripcion || '—' }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-usage-badge" [class.admin-usage-badge--used]="item.enUso">
                    {{ item.cantidadUso }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!item.estado"
                  >
                    {{ item.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar"
                      [disabled]="disablingId() !== null"
                      (click)="edit(item)"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                    </button>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_RETIRAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                      [attr.title]="item.enUso ? 'Está en uso y no puede deshabilitarse' : 'Deshabilitar'"
                      [disabled]="item.enUso || disablingId() !== null"
                      (click)="disable(item)"
                    >
                      @if (disablingId() === item.id) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {

                      }
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-catalogo-detail />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBuilding,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
  phoneValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
  sanitizePhone,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface AreaModalOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companyOptions = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('JURIDICA'),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    numeroPartida: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onOrganizationPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().empresaId);
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;
    const blockedIds = new Set<number>();

    if (currentAreaId !== null) {
      blockedIds.add(currentAreaId);

      let changed = true;
      while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        for (const area of this.areaOptions()) {
          if (
            area.areaPadreId !== null &&
            blockedIds.has(area.areaPadreId) &&
            !blockedIds.has(area.areaId)
          ) {
            blockedIds.add(area.areaId);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        !blockedIds.has(area.areaId) &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: sanitizePhone(company?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (company?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.resetState();
  }
}
```

```typescript
function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {

}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',

  imports: [

    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,

  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;

  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly maxBirthDate = maxBirthDateIso();
  readonly minBirthDate = minBirthDateIso();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {

    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },

    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [

        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [

          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],

      ],

      telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],

      fechaNacimiento: ['', [adultBirthDateValidator()]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
        dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator(
          'fechaNacimiento',
          'fechaIngreso',
          18,
          'entryBeforeAdult',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.companies.set(options.companies);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: sanitizePersonName(employee?.nombres ?? '').slice(0, 100),
      apellidoPaterno: sanitizePersonName(employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '').slice(0, 80),
      apellidoMaterno: sanitizePersonName(employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '').slice(0, 80),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(employee?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (employee?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      empresaId:
        employee?.empresaId ?? options.companies[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: employee?.areaId ?? 0,
      cargo: employee?.cargo ?? '',
      fechaAsignacionArea: '',
    });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);

    if (employee) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);
      this.identityLocks.set({
        names: true,
        paternalSurname: true,
        maternalSurname: true,
        birthDate: true,
        phone: true,
        email: true,
        geography: true,
        reference: true,
      });

      if (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
        );
      }
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')) {
      this.form.patchValue({
        centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onPersonNameInput(
    field: 'nombres' | 'apellidoPaterno' | 'apellidoMaterno',
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls[field];
    const maxLength = field === 'nombres' ? 100 : 80;
    const sanitized = sanitizePersonName(control.value).slice(0, maxLength);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  onPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  onCompanyChange(): void {
    const selectedArea = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);

    if (
      selectedArea > 0
      && !this.availableAreas().some(
        (area) => area.areaId === selectedArea,
      )
    ) {
      this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    this.syncAreaValidators();
  }

  minimumEntryDate(): string | null {
    return addYearsIsoDate(this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value, 18);
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().empresaId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
    );
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${values.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'No se puede usar esta persona para el empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            areaId > 0 && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    const current = this.current();

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    if (
      result.isEmployee
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.empleadoId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta persona ya está registrada como empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);

      const resolvedType = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
      const resolvedDocument = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value;

      if (resolvedType === 'DNI' || resolvedType === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(resolvedType, resolvedDocument),
        );
      }

      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set('Datos de la persona cargados.');
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = result.found
      ? {
          names: true,
          paternalSurname: true,
          maternalSurname: true,
          birthDate: true,
          phone: true,
          email: true,
          geography: true,
          reference: true,
        }
      : emptyIdentityFieldLocks();

    this.form.patchValue({
      tipoDocumento:
        result.documentType === 'RUC' ? 'RUC' :
        result.documentType === 'DNI' ? 'DNI' :
        this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      numeroDocumento:
        result.documentNumber?.trim() ||
        this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  canEditIdentityData(): boolean {
    return this.permissions.has('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR');
  }

  canToggleIdentityEditing(): boolean {
    return this.identityRecordLoaded()
      && this.canEditIdentityData();
  }

  toggleIdentityEditing(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(
      enabled && this.canToggleIdentityEditing(),
    );
  }

  isIdentityFieldReadOnly(
    field: keyof IdentityFieldLocks,
  ): boolean {
    return this.identityLocks()[field]
      && !this.identityEditingEnabled();
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(false);
    this.identityRecordLoaded.set(false);
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}
```

```typescript
@Component({

export class UsuarioFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

    readonly saving = signal(false);

    readonly current = signal<Usuario | UsuarioDetalle | null>(null);
    readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly selectedRoleIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly eyeIcon = faEye;
    readonly eyeSlashIcon = faEyeSlash;
    private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        empleadoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],

        passwordInicial: [''],

    });
    openCreate(options: UserFormOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.current.set(null);
        this.employees.set(options.employees);
        this.roles.set(options.roles);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(options.roles.length === 1
            ? new Set([Number(options.roles[0].value)])
            : new Set());
        this.errorMessage.set(null);

        const firstEmployee = options.employees[0] ?? null;

        this.form.reset({
            empleadoId: firstEmployee?.value ?? 0,
            nombreUsuario: firstEmployee
                ? buildUsernameSuggestion(firstEmployee.label, Number(firstEmployee.value))
                : '',
            passwordInicial: '',
            correoSeguridad: '',
            requiereCambioPassword: true,
            segundoFactorHabilitado: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.empleadoId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.setValidators([
            Validators.required,
            Validators.minLength(12),
            Validators.maxLength(128),
            passwordSafetyValidator,
        ]);
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.setValidators([
            Validators.required,
            Validators.email,
            Validators.maxLength(200),
        ]);
        this.updateValidators();
        return this.show();
    }
    openEdit(user: Usuario | UsuarioDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.current.set(user);
        this.employees.set([]);
        this.roles.set([]);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(new Set());
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        const detail = 'requiereCambioPassword' in user
            ? (user as UsuarioDetalle)
            : null;
        this.form.reset({
            empleadoId: user.empleadoId,
            nombreUsuario: user.nombreUsuario,
            passwordInicial: '',
            correoSeguridad: '',
            requiereCambioPassword: detail?.requiereCambioPassword ?? false,
            segundoFactorHabilitado: detail?.segundoFactorHabilitado ?? user.segundoFactorHabilitado,
        });
        this.form.controls.empleadoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.clearValidators();
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.clearValidators();
        this.updateValidators();
        return this.show();
    }
    suggestUsername(value: string): void {
        if (this.current()) {
            return;
        }

        const employeeId = Number(value);
        const employee = this.employees().find((item) => Number(item.value) === employeeId);

        if (!employee) {
            this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            return;
        }

        this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.setValue(buildUsernameSuggestion(employee.label, employeeId), {
            emitEvent: false,
        });
    }

    onUsernameInput(): void {
        const control = this.form.controls.nombreUsuario;
        const sanitized = sanitizeUsername(control.value);
        if (sanitized !== control.value) {
            control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    normalizeSecurityEmail(): void {
        const control = this.form.controls.correoSeguridad;
        const normalized = control.value.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 200);
        if (normalized !== control.value) {
            control.setValue(normalized, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    close(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
    toggleRole(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
        const next = new Set(this.selectedRoleIds());
        if (checked) {
            next.add(id);
        }
        else {
            next.delete(id);
        }
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(next);
    }
    roleSelected(id: number): boolean {
        return this.selectedRoleIds().has(id);
    }
    save(): void {
        this.form.markAllAsTouched();
        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        const current = this.current();
        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        if (!current && this.selectedRoleIds().size === 0) {
            this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona al menos un rol para crear la cuenta.');
            return;
        }
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.saving.set(true);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.usuarioId, {
                nombreUsuario: sanitizeUsername(values.nombreUsuario),
                requiereCambioPassword: values.requiereCambioPassword,
                segundoFactorHabilitado: values.segundoFactorHabilitado,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                empleadoId: Number(values.empleadoId),
                nombreUsuario: sanitizeUsername(values.nombreUsuario),
                passwordInicial: values.passwordInicial,
                correoSeguridad: values.correoSeguridad.trim().toLowerCase(),
                requiereCambioPassword: values.requiereCambioPassword,
                rolIds: [...this.selectedRoleIds()],
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Cuenta actualizada' : 'Cuenta registrada');
                this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
            },
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    private updateValidators(): void {
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
    }
    private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.showPassword.set(false);
        this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            this.resolver = resolve;
        });
    }
    private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
        if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
            this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
        }
        this.resolver?.(result);
        this.resolver = null;
        this.current.set(null);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(new Set());
    }
}
```

```typescript
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
  private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly reactivateUseCase = inject(ReactivarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly assignRoleUseCase = inject(AsignarRolUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly removeRoleUseCase = inject(RetirarRolUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly rolesUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly userId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly rolesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly accountActionLoading = signal(false);
  readonly roleSaving = signal(false);
  readonly removingRoleId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly roleError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly rolesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<UsuarioDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly availableRoles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;
  readonly roleIcon = faKey;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly deviceIcon = faComputer;
  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly roleForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    rolId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadRoles();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.userId) || this.userId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El usuario solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.userId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadRoles(): void {
    this.rolesLoading.set(true);
    this.rolesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.rolesUseCase.execute(page, size))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.rolesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (roles) =>
          this.availableRoles.set(
            roles
              .filter((role) => role.estado)
              .map((role) => ({
                value: role.rolId,
                label: role.nombre,
                description: role.codigo,
              })),
          ),
        error: (error) => {
          this.availableRoles.set([]);
          this.rolesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openEdit(user);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || this.accountActionLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" dejará de poder ingresar al sistema.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.accountActionLoading.set(true);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.accountActionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta deshabilitada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async reactivate(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || this.accountActionLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Reactivar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" volverá a estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Reactivar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.accountActionLoading.set(true);

    this.reactivateUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.accountActionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta reactivada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reactivar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  openAssignRole(): void {
    if (this.rolesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.rolesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los roles', this.rolesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const selected = new Set(
      this.detail()?.roles
        .filter((role) => role.estado)
        .map((role) => role.rolId) ?? [],
    );

    const firstAvailable = this.availableRoles().find(
      (role) => !selected.has(role.value),
    );

    this.roleForm.reset({ rolId: firstAvailable?.value ?? 0 });
    this.roleError.set(null);
    this.roleDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
  }

  closeRoleDialog(): void {
    if (this.roleSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.roleDialog.nativeElement.close();
    this.roleError.set(null);
  }

  roleOptions(): readonly AdminSelectOption[] {
    const selected = new Set(
      this.detail()?.roles
        .filter((role) => role.estado)
        .map((role) => role.rolId) ?? [],
    );

    return this.availableRoles().filter(
      (role) => !selected.has(role.value),
    );
  }

  assignRole(): void {
    this.roleForm.markAllAsTouched();

    const user = this.detail();
    const roleId = Number(this.roleForm.controls.rolId.value);

    if (!user || this.roleForm.invalid || this.roleSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.roleSaving.set(true);
    this.roleError.set(null);

    this.assignRoleUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.roleSaving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol asignado');
          this.closeRoleDialog();
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.roleError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async removeRole(role: UsuarioRol): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || !role.estado || this.removingRoleId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar rol',
      message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar asignado a la cuenta.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar rol',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro del rol.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.removingRoleId.set(role.rolId);

    this.removeRoleUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.removingRoleId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar el rol',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  isDisabled(): boolean {
    return (this.detail()?.estadoCuenta || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESHABILITADA';
  }

  accountStateLabel(state: string | null): string {
    switch ((state || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ACTIVA':
        return 'Activa';
      case 'DESHABILITADA':
        return 'Deshabilitada';
      case 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION':
        return 'Pendiente de validación';
      case 'BLOQUEADA':
        return 'Bloqueada';
      default:
        return state || 'Sin estado';
    }
  }
}
```
