import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBan, faEye, faFloppyDisk, faKey, faLock, faPen, faPlus, faRotate, faShieldHalved, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { normalizeOptionalText, normalizeText, notBlankValidator, optionalNotBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { CrearRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-rol.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-rol.use-case';
import { EditarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-rol.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { Rol } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';
@Component({
    selector: 'app-roles-list-page',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [
        ReactiveFormsModule,
        RouterLink,
        FaIconComponent,
        PermissionDirective,
        LoadingStateComponent,
        ErrorStateComponent,
        EmptyStateComponent,
        PaginatorComponent,
        ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
        FormErrorComponent,
        PageHeaderComponent,
    ],
    templateUrl: './roles-list.html',
    styleUrl: './roles-list.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolesListPage implements OnInit {
    @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
    private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
    private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearRolUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRolUseCase);
    private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarRolUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly loading = signal(true);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly modalError = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly currentRole = signal<Rol | null>(null);
    readonly result = signal<PageResult<Rol>>(emptyPageResult(20));
    readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly viewIcon = faEye;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly permissionsIcon = faKey;
    readonly disableIcon = faBan;
    readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly lockIcon = faLock;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
        nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(100)]],
        descripcion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(200)]],
        requiereSegundoFactor: [false],
    });
    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.load(1);
    }
    load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
        this.loading.set(true);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.listUseCase
            .execute(page, size)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    openCreate(): void {
        this.currentRole.set(null);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: '',
            nombre: '',
            descripcion: '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.roleDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    }
    openEdit(role: Rol): void {
        if (role.esSistema) {
            return;
        }
        this.currentRole.set(role);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: role.codigo,
            nombre: role.nombre,
            descripcion: role.descripcion ?? '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: role.requiereSegundoFactor,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.roleDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    }
    closeModal(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        this.roleDialog.nativeElement.close();
        this.currentRole.set(null);
        this.modalError.set(null);
    }
    save(): void {
        const current = this.currentRole();

        if (!current) {
            this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(buildSystemCode('ROL', this.form.controls.nombre.value, 40), {
                emitEvent: false,
            });
        }

        this.form.markAllAsTouched();

        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }

        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        this.saving.set(true);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.rolId, {
                nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(values.descripcion),
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
                nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(values.descripcion),
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Rol actualizado' : 'Rol registrado');
                this.closeModal();
                this.load(current ? this.result().page : 1);
            },
            error: (error) => this.modalError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    async disable(role: Rol): Promise<void> {
        if (role.esSistema || this.disablingId()) {
            return;
        }
        const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
            title: 'Deshabilitar rol',
            message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible para nuevas asignaciones.`,
            tone: 'danger',
            confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
            cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
            requiresReason: true,
            reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
            reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
            minimumReasonLength: 5,
        });
        if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
            return;
        }
        this.disablingId.set(role.rolId);
        this.disableUseCase
            .execute(role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success('Rol deshabilitado');
                this.load();
            },
            error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el rol', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
}

import { DOCUMENT, isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { PLATFORM_ID, computed, effect, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

export type AppTheme = 'light' | 'dark';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ThemeService {
  private static readonly storageKey = 'desco.ui.theme';
  private static readonly transitionClass = 'desco-theme-transition';
  private static readonly transitionMs = 240;

  private readonly document = inject(DOCUMENT);
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);
  private readonly browser = isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId);
  private readonly themeSignal = signal<AppTheme>(this.initialTheme());

  private transitionTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  readonly theme = this.themeSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly isDark = computed(() => this.themeSignal() === 'dark');

  constructor() {
    effect(() => this.apply(this.themeSignal()));
  }

  set(theme: AppTheme): void {
    this.themeSignal.set(theme);
  }

  toggle(): void {
    this.themeSignal.update((theme) => (theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  }

  private initialTheme(): AppTheme {
    if (!this.browser) {
      return 'light';
    }

    const stored = localStorage.getItem(ThemeService.storageKey);

    if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'light') {
      return stored;
    }

    return window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
      ? 'dark'
      : 'light';
  }

  private apply(theme: AppTheme): void {
    const html = this.document.documentElement;
    const current = html.dataset['theme'];
    const shouldAnimate =
      this.browser &&
      (current === 'light' || current === 'dark') &&
      current !== theme &&
      !window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (this.transitionTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.transitionTimer);
      this.transitionTimer = null;
    }

    if (shouldAnimate) {
      html.classList.add(ThemeService.transitionClass);
      // La clase debe existir antes de cambiar los tokens del tema.
      void html.offsetWidth;
    }

    html.dataset['theme'] = theme;
    html.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark');
    html.style.colorScheme = theme;

    if (this.browser) {
      localStorage.setItem(ThemeService.storageKey, theme);
    }

    if (shouldAnimate) {
      this.transitionTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        html.classList.remove(ThemeService.transitionClass);
        this.transitionTimer = null;
      }, ThemeService.transitionMs);
    } else {
      html.classList.remove(ThemeService.transitionClass);
    }
  }
}

  color-scheme: light;
}

html[data-theme='dark'],
html.dark {
  --desco-page-bg: #000000;
  --desco-sidebar-bg: #050505;
  --desco-surface: #080808;
  --desco-surface-soft: #0d0d0d;
  --desco-surface-elevated: #111111;
  --desco-surface-hover: #171717;
  --desco-table-head: #101010;
  --desco-control-bg: #0d0d0d;
  --desco-control-hover: #141414;
  --desco-control-disabled: #151515;
  --desco-border: #292929;
  --desco-border-subtle: #1f1f1f;
  --desco-border-strong: #444444;
  --desco-text: #f5f7fa;
  --desco-text-soft: #d7dce3;
  --desco-text-muted: #a3a3a3;
  --desco-placeholder: #737373;

  --desco-primary: #3b82f6;
  --desco-primary-hover: #60a5fa;
  --desco-primary-soft: #0b1f3a;
  --desco-primary-soft-hover: #10294b;
  --desco-primary-border: #1d4ed8;
  --desco-primary-text: #93c5fd;
  --desco-on-primary: #ffffff;
  --desco-focus-ring: rgb(96 165 250 / 0.34);
  --desco-switch-off-bg: #242424;
  --desco-switch-off-border: #525252;
  --desco-switch-on-bg: #3b82f6;
  --desco-switch-on-border: #60a5fa;
  --desco-switch-thumb: #e5e7eb;
  --desco-switch-thumb-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55);

  --desco-danger: #f87171;
  --desco-danger-soft: #260b0b;
  --desco-danger-border: #7f1d1d;
  --desco-danger-text: #fca5a5;
  --desco-success: #4ade80;
  --desco-success-soft: #071d12;
  --desco-success-border: #166534;
  --desco-success-text: #86efac;
  --desco-warning: #fbbf24;
  --desco-warning-soft: #241704;
  --desco-warning-border: #854d0e;
  --desco-warning-text: #fde68a;
  --desco-info: #60a5fa;
  --desco-info-soft: #0b1f3a;
  --desco-info-border: #1d4ed8;
  --desco-info-text: #93c5fd;

  --desco-nav-hover-bg: #101820;
  --desco-nav-hover-border: #223247;
  --desco-nav-hover-text: #bfdbfe;
  --desco-nav-active-bg: #0b1f3a;
  --desco-nav-active-border: #2563eb;
  --desco-nav-active-text: #bfdbfe;
  --desco-nav-active-icon-bg: #10294b;

  --desco-table-hover: #121212;
  --desco-overlay: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.82);
  --desco-skeleton: #252525;
  --desco-scrollbar: #444444;
  --desco-shadow-sm: none;
  --desco-shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55);

  color-scheme: dark;
  background: #000000;
}

html,
body {
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  background: var(--desco-page-bg);
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--desco-primary);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
}


/* Transición breve y uniforme al alternar tema.
   No se anima layout ni transformaciones para evitar saltos/parpadeos. */
html.desco-theme-transition,
html.desco-theme-transition body,
html.desco-theme-transition body *,
html.desco-theme-transition body *::before,
html.desco-theme-transition body *::after {
  transition-property:
    background-color,
    border-color,
    color,
    outline-color,
    box-shadow,
    fill,
    stroke !important;
  transition-duration: 220ms !important;
  transition-timing-function: ease !important;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html.desco-theme-transition,
  html.desco-theme-transition body,
  html.desco-theme-transition body *,
  html.desco-theme-transition body *::before,
  html.desco-theme-transition body *::after {
    transition-duration: 0ms !important;
  }
}

<header class="sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white">

        [attr.title]="theme.isDark() ? 'Modo claro' : 'Modo oscuro'"
        (click)="theme.toggle()"

          <div class="hidden max-w-44 md:block">

        <ul tabindex="0" class="menu dropdown-content z-[60] mt-2 w-64 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-xl shadow-slate-950/10">

</header>

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import {
  CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES,
  CATALOGOS_AGRUPADOS,
  Catalogo,
} from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
import { CatalogoDetailComponent } from '../catalogo-detail/catalogo-detail';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    CatalogoDetailComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './catalogos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(CatalogoDetailComponent)
  private detailModal!: CatalogoDetailComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarCatalogosUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly references = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  private readonly routeData = this.route.snapshot.data;
  readonly fixedCatalogCode = this.validCatalogCode(this.readRouteText('catalogCode'));
  readonly pageTitle = this.readRouteText('pageTitle') ?? 'Catálogos';
  readonly pageSubtitle =
    this.readRouteText('pageSubtitle') ??
    'Administra los valores utilizados por el sistema.';
  readonly createLabel = this.readRouteText('createLabel') ?? 'Nuevo valor';
  readonly entityLabel = this.readRouteText('entityLabel') ?? 'Valor';
  readonly emptyTitle = this.readRouteText('emptyTitle') ?? 'Sin valores registrados';
  readonly emptyMessage =
    this.readRouteText('emptyMessage') ?? 'No hay valores registrados en este catálogo.';

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly catalogCode = signal(
    this.fixedCatalogCode ?? CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES[0].codigo,
  );
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<CatalogoItem>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly catalogs = CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES;
  readonly catalogGroups = CATALOGOS_AGRUPADOS;
  readonly pageIcon = faLayerGroup;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly selectedCatalog = computed<Catalogo>(
    () =>
      this.catalogs.find((item) => item.codigo === this.catalogCode()) ??
      this.catalogs[0],
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        catalogo: this.catalogCode(),
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeCatalog(value: string): void {
    if (this.fixedCatalogCode) {
      return;
    }

    const next = this.validCatalogCode(value);
    if (!next || next === this.catalogCode()) {
      return;
    }

    this.catalogCode.set(next);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog());

    if (result.saved) {
      this.invalidateSelectedReference();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  async edit(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog(), item);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.invalidateSelectedReference();
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    if (item.enUso || this.disablingId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: `Deshabilitar ${this.entityLabel.toLowerCase()}`,
      message: `“${item.nombre}” dejará de estar disponible para nuevos registros.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.disablingId.set(item.id);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(item.id, this.catalogCode(), confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.references.invalidateCatalog(this.catalogCode());
          this.toast.success(`${this.entityLabel} deshabilitado`);
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            `No se pudo deshabilitar ${this.entityLabel.toLowerCase()}`,
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private readRouteText(key: string): string | null {
    const value = this.routeData[key];
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
  }

  private validCatalogCode(value: string | null): string | null {
    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    return CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES.some((catalog) => catalog.codigo === value)
      ? value
      : null;
  }

  private invalidateSelectedReference(): void {
    this.references.invalidateCatalog(this.catalogCode());
  }
}

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="pageTitle"
    [subtitle]="pageSubtitle"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        {{ createLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div
      class="catalog-workspace"
      [class.catalog-workspace--fixed]="fixedCatalogCode"
    >
      @if (!fixedCatalogCode) {
        <aside class="catalog-navigation" aria-label="Secciones de catálogos">
          <header class="catalog-navigation-header">
            <span class="catalog-navigation-icon">
              <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <strong>Catálogos</strong>
              <span>Selecciona una sección</span>
            </div>
          </header>

          <nav class="catalog-navigation-groups">
            @for (group of catalogGroups; track group.codigo) {
              <section class="catalog-nav-group">
                <h2>{{ group.nombre }}</h2>

                <div class="catalog-nav-items">
                  @for (catalog of group.catalogos; track catalog.codigo) {
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="catalog-nav-item"
                      [class.catalog-nav-item--active]="catalog.codigo === catalogCode()"
                      [attr.aria-current]="catalog.codigo === catalogCode() ? 'page' : null"
                      (click)="changeCatalog(catalog.codigo)"
                    >
                      <span class="catalog-nav-marker" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                      <span>{{ catalog.nombre }}</span>
                    </button>
                  }
                </div>
              </section>
            }
          </nav>
        </aside>
      }

      <div class="catalog-content">
        <header class="catalog-context">
          <div>
            <span class="catalog-context-kicker">
              {{ selectedCatalog().grupoNombre }}
            </span>
            <h2>{{ selectedCatalog().nombre }}</h2>
            <p>{{ selectedCatalog().descripcion }}</p>
          </div>

          @if (!loading() && !errorMessage()) {
            <span class="catalog-context-count">
              {{ result().totalRecords }}
              {{ result().totalRecords === 1 ? 'registro' : 'registros' }}
            </span>
          }
        </header>

        @if (loading()) {
          <app-loading-state title="Cargando" message="Consultando información." />
        } @else if (errorMessage()) {
          <app-error-state
            title="No se pudo cargar"
            [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
            (retry)="load()"
          />
        } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
          <app-empty-state [title]="emptyTitle" [message]="emptyMessage" />
        } @else {
          <div class="admin-table-wrap">
            <table class="admin-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Código</th>
                  <th>Nombre</th>
                  <th>Descripción</th>
                  <th class="text-center">Uso</th>
                  <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
                  <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                @for (item of result().items; track item.id) {
                  <tr>
                    <td>
                      <div class="admin-entity">
                        <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                          <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
                        </span>
                        <div>
                          <strong>{{ item.codigo }}</strong>
                          <span>Código generado</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="admin-table-primary">{{ item.nombre }}</td>
                    <td class="admin-table-muted max-w-md">
                      {{ item.descripcion || '—' }}
                    </td>
                    <td class="text-center">
                      <span
                        class="admin-usage-badge"
                        [class.admin-usage-badge--used]="item.enUso"
                      >
                        {{ item.cantidadUso }}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td class="text-center">
                      <span
                        class="admin-status"
                        [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado"
                        [class.admin-status--inactive]="!item.estado"
                      >
                        {{ item.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <div class="admin-row-actions">
                        <button
                          *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_EDITAR'"
                          type="button"
                          class="admin-icon-button"
                          title="Editar"
                          [disabled]="disablingId() !== null"
                          (click)="edit(item)"
                        >
                          <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                        </button>

                        <button
                          *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_RETIRAR'"
                          type="button"
                          class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                          [attr.title]="
                            item.enUso
                              ? 'Está en uso y no puede deshabilitarse'
                              : 'Deshabilitar'
                          "
                          [disabled]="item.enUso || disablingId() !== null"
                          (click)="disable(item)"
                        >
                          @if (disablingId() === item.id) {
                            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                          } @else {
                            <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                          }
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                }
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <app-paginator
            [page]="result().page"
            [size]="result().size"
            [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
            [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
            (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
            (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
          />
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<app-catalogo-detail />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

import { computed, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from '../access/access.store';
import { AccessModule } from '../access/models/access-module.model';
import { NavigationItem } from './navigation-item.model';

interface FrontendEntry {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  label: string;
  route: string;
  icon: string;
  order: number;
  permission: string;
  group: 'ADMIN' | 'COMERCIAL';
}

const FRONTEND_ENTRIES: readonly FrontendEntry[] = [
  { id: -6001, code: 'TIPOS_BIEN', label: 'Tipos de bien', route: '/administracion/tipos-bien', icon: 'boxes-stacked', order: 90, permission: 'CATALOGOS_LISTAR', group: 'ADMIN' },
  { id: -6101, code: 'CAMPANIAS', label: 'Campañas', route: '/gestion-comercial/campanias', icon: 'calendar-days', order: 10, permission: 'CAMPANIAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6102, code: 'PARTICIPANTES', label: 'Participantes', route: '/gestion-comercial/participantes', icon: 'user-group', order: 20, permission: 'PARTICIPANTES_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6103, code: 'OPERATIVOS', label: 'Operativos', route: '/gestion-comercial/operativos', icon: 'truck', order: 30, permission: 'OPERATIVOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6104, code: 'ENTREGAS', label: 'Entregas', route: '/gestion-comercial/entregas', icon: 'boxes-stacked', order: 40, permission: 'ENTREGAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6105, code: 'JABAS', label: 'Jabas', route: '/gestion-comercial/jabas', icon: 'box', order: 50, permission: 'JABAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6106, code: 'PRECIOS', label: 'Precios', route: '/gestion-comercial/precios', icon: 'coins', order: 60, permission: 'PRECIOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
];

const ROUTES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  INICIO: '/inicio',
  DASHBOARD: '/inicio',
  ORGANIZACIONES: '/administracion/organizaciones',
  ROLES: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  ROLES_PERMISOS: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  CATALOGOS: '/administracion/catalogos',
  TIPOS_BIEN: '/administracion/tipos-bien',
  EMPLEADOS: '/administracion/empleados',
  USUARIOS: '/administracion/usuarios',
  DOCUMENTOS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  EVIDENCIAS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  INVENTARIO: '/recursos/inventario-vehiculos',
  RECURSOS: '/recursos/programados',
  RECURSOS_PROGRAMADOS: '/recursos/programados',
  PRODUCTORES: '/gestion-tecnica/productores',
  PREDIOS: '/gestion-tecnica/predios',
  CULTIVOS: '/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos',
  CENSOS: '/gestion-tecnica/censos',
  SALIDAS: '/gestion-tecnica/salidas',
  VISITAS: '/gestion-tecnica/visitas',
  EVALUACIONES: '/gestion-tecnica/evaluaciones',
  SANIDAD: '/gestion-tecnica/sanidad',
  PRODUCCION: '/gestion-tecnica/produccion',
  CAMPANIAS: '/gestion-comercial/campanias',
  PARTICIPANTES: '/gestion-comercial/participantes',
  OPERATIVOS: '/gestion-comercial/operativos',
  ENTREGAS: '/gestion-comercial/entregas',
  JABAS: '/gestion-comercial/jabas',
  PRECIOS: '/gestion-comercial/precios',
  INCIDENCIAS: '/gestion-comercial/incidencias',
  AJUSTES_PRECIO: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  AJUSTES: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  GASTOS: '/finanzas/gastos',
  LIQUIDACIONES: '/finanzas/liquidaciones',
  PAGOS: '/finanzas/pagos',
  COBROS: '/finanzas/cobros',
  REPORTES: '/reportes',
  AUDITORIA: '/auditoria',
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NavigationService {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly items = computed(() => this.withFrontendEntries(this.buildTree(this.accessStore.modules())));

  private buildTree(modules: readonly AccessModule[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    const moduleById = new Map(modules.map((module) => [module.moduloId, module] as const));
    const includedIds = new Set<number>();

    for (const module of modules) {
      if (!module.visibleMenu) continue;
      includedIds.add(module.moduloId);
      let parentId = module.moduloPadreId;
      while (parentId !== null) {
        const parent = moduleById.get(parentId);
        if (!parent || includedIds.has(parent.moduloId)) break;
        includedIds.add(parent.moduloId);
        parentId = parent.moduloPadreId;
      }
    }

    const byParent = new Map<number | null, AccessModule[]>();
    for (const module of modules.filter((item) => includedIds.has(item.moduloId))) {
      const key = module.moduloPadreId !== null && includedIds.has(module.moduloPadreId)
        ? module.moduloPadreId
        : null;
      const bucket = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
      bucket.push(module);
      byParent.set(key, bucket);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null): NavigationItem[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden || a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre))
        .map((module) => ({
          id: module.moduloId,
          code: module.codigo,
          label: module.nombre,
          route: this.normalizedRoute(module),
          icon: module.icono,
          order: module.orden,
          children: build(module.moduloId),
        }));

    return build(null);
  }

  private withFrontendEntries(items: readonly NavigationItem[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    let result = [...items];
    for (const entry of FRONTEND_ENTRIES) {
      if (!this.hasPermission(entry.permission) || this.containsCode(result, entry.code)) continue;
      result = this.insertEntry(result, entry);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private insertEntry(items: readonly NavigationItem[], entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem[] {
    const groupMatcher = entry.group === 'ADMIN'
      ? (code: string) => code.includes('ADMIN')
      : (code: string) => code.includes('COMERCIAL');
    let inserted = false;

    const visit = (nodes: readonly NavigationItem[]): NavigationItem[] => nodes.map((node) => {
      let children = visit(node.children);
      if (!inserted && groupMatcher(node.code.trim().toUpperCase())) {
        children = [...children, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
        inserted = true;
      }
      return { ...node, children };
    });

    const decorated = visit(items);
    return inserted
      ? decorated
      : [...decorated, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
  }

  private entryNode(entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem {
    return { id: entry.id, code: entry.code, label: entry.label, route: entry.route, icon: entry.icon, order: entry.order, children: [] };
  }

  private containsCode(items: readonly NavigationItem[], code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return items.some((item) => item.code.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized || this.containsCode(item.children, normalized));
  }

  private hasPermission(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return this.accessStore.permissions().some((permission) => permission.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized);
  }

  private normalizedRoute(module: AccessModule): string | null {
    if (!module.visibleMenu) return null;
    const code = module.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();
    return ROUTES[code] ?? module.ruta;
  }
}

  private readonly useCase = inject(ObtenerDashboardUseCase);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly dashboard = signal<Dashboard>(EMPTY_DASHBOARD);

  readonly dashboardIcon = faGaugeHigh;
  readonly filterIcon = faFilter;
  readonly resetIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;

  readonly today = this.localIsoDate(new Date());
  readonly desde = signal(this.offsetDate(-89));
  readonly hasta = signal(this.today);

  readonly greeting = computed(() => {
    const user = this.access.user();
    const firstName = user?.nombres?.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

    return firstName ? `Hola, ${firstName}` : 'Dashboard';
  });

  readonly primaryRole = computed(
    () => this.access.roles()[0]?.nombre ?? 'Perfil autorizado',
  );

  readonly relatedAccesses = computed<readonly AccesoRapido[]>(() => {
    const current = [...this.dashboard().accesosRapidos];

    if (
      !this.hasPermission('CATALOGOS_LISTAR') ||
      current.some((item) => item.ruta === '/administracion/tipos-bien')
    ) {
      return current;
    }

    const catalogAccess = current.find(
      (item) => item.codigoModulo.trim().toUpperCase() === 'CATALOGOS',
    );

    const nextOrder =
      catalogAccess?.orden ??
      current.reduce((max, item) => Math.max(max, item.orden), 0) + 1;

    return [
      ...current,
      {
        moduloId: -6_001,
        codigoModulo: 'TIPOS_BIEN',
        nombreModulo: 'Tipos de bien',
        ruta: '/administracion/tipos-bien',
        icono: 'boxes-stacked',
        orden: catalogAccess ? nextOrder + 1 : nextOrder,
      },
    ].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.orden - b.orden ||
        a.nombreModulo.localeCompare(b.nombreModulo),
    );
  });

  readonly filterError = computed(() => {
    const from = this.parseDate(this.desde());
    const to = this.parseDate(this.hasta());

    if (!from || !to) {
      return 'Selecciona un periodo válido.';
    }

    if (from.getTime() > to.getTime()) {
      return 'La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la fecha final.';
    }

    const days = Math.floor(
      (to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / 86_400_000,
    );

    if (days > 365) {
      return 'El periodo máximo permitido es de 366 días.';
    }

    if (this.hasta() > this.today) {
      return 'La fecha final no puede estar en el futuro.';
    }

    return null;
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (this.filterError()) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.useCase
      .execute(this.currentFilter())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (dashboard) => {
          this.dashboard.set(dashboard);

          if (dashboard.periodo.desde) {
            this.desde.set(dashboard.periodo.desde);
          }

          if (dashboard.periodo.hasta) {
            this.hasta.set(dashboard.periodo.hasta);
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  applyFilters(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  resetFilters(): void {
    this.desde.set(this.offsetDate(-89));
    this.hasta.set(this.today);
    this.load();
  }

  updateDesde(event: Event): void {
    this.desde.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }

  updateHasta(event: Event): void {
    this.hasta.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }

  iconForModule(code: string): IconDefinition {
    const normalized = code.toUpperCase();

    if (normalized.includes('TIPO') && normalized.includes('BIEN')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('PRODUCTOR') || normalized.includes('SOCIO')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('PREDIO')) {
      return faLocationDot;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('CULTIVO') ||
      normalized.includes('PRODUCCION') ||
      normalized.includes('SANIDAD')
    ) {
      return normalized.includes('SANIDAD') ? faLeaf : faSeedling;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('CAMPANIA') ||
      normalized.includes('OPERATIVO') ||
      normalized.includes('SALIDA') ||
      normalized.includes('VISITA')
    ) {
      return faCalendarDays;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('INVENTARIO') ||
      normalized.includes('RECURSO') ||
      normalized.includes('JABA')
    ) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('ENTREGA')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('PAGO') ||
      normalized.includes('COBRO') ||
      normalized.includes('LIQUID')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('GASTO') || normalized.includes('AJUSTE')) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('USUARIO') || normalized.includes('ROL')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('REPORTE') || normalized.includes('AUDITOR')) {
      return faFileLines;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('ORGANIZ')) {
      return faBuilding;
    }

    return faChartLine;
  }

  private hasPermission(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();

    return this.access
      .permissions()
      .some(
        (permission) =>
          permission.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized,
      );
  }

  private currentFilter(): DashboardFilter {
    return {
      desde: this.desde(),
      hasta: this.hasta(),
    };
  }

  private offsetDate(days: number): string {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
    return this.localIsoDate(date);
  }

  private localIsoDate(date: Date): string {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  }

  private parseDate(value: string): Date | null {
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
      return null;
    }

    const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`);

    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  AreaCreateRequest,

  EmpresaCreate,
  EmpresaUpdate,

import { OrganizacionesHttpMapper } from './organizaciones-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class OrganizacionesHttpAdapter implements OrganizacionesGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(OrganizacionesService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(OrganizacionesHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(page: number, size: number) {
    return this.api
      .organizacionesListar(
        { pagina: page, tamano: size },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.organizationsPage(response, size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .organizacionesVer(
        { id },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  createCompany(input: EmpresaCreate) {
    const companyCreateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as CompanyCreateRequest;

    return this.api
      .organizacionesCrearEmpresa(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          companyCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  updateCompany(id: number, input: EmpresaUpdate) {
    const companyUpdateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as CompanyUpdateRequest;

    return this.api
      .organizacionesEditarEmpresa(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          companyUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  createAssociation(input: AsociacionCreate) {
    const associationCreateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as AssociationCreateRequest;

    return this.api
      .organizacionesCrearAsociacion(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          associationCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  updateAssociation(id: number, input: AsociacionUpdate) {
    const associationUpdateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as AssociationUpdateRequest;

    return this.api
      .organizacionesEditarAsociacion(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          associationUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  listAreas(page: number, size: number, empresaId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .organizacionesListarAreas(
        {
          empresaId,
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.areasPage(response, size)));
  }

  createArea(input: AreaCreate) {
    const areaCreateRequest: AreaCreateRequest = this.compact(input);

    return this.api
      .organizacionesCrearArea(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          areaCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  updateArea(id: number, input: AreaUpdate) {
    const areaUpdateRequest: AreaUpdateRequest = this.compact(input);

    return this.api
      .organizacionesEditarArea(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          areaUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(
        ([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== '',
      ),
    ) as T;
  }
}

  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';

  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';
import { OrganizacionFormComponent } from '../organizacion-form/organizacion-form';

type OrganizationTab = 'organizations' | 'areas';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizaciones-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    OrganizacionFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizaciones-list.html',
  styleUrl: './organizaciones-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(OrganizacionFormComponent)
  private formModal!: OrganizacionFormComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly activeTab = signal<OrganizationTab>('organizations');
  readonly organizationsLoading = signal(true);
  readonly areasLoading = signal(false);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly organizationsError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly areasError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referenceOrganizations = signal<readonly Empresa[]>([]);
  readonly referenceAreas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly areaCompanyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly organizations = signal<PageResult<Empresa>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly areas = signal<PageResult<Area>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly pageIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly companyOptions = computed<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>(() =>
    this.referenceOrganizations().filter((company) => company.estado).map((company) => ({
      value: company.empresaId,
      label: company.razonSocial,
      description: company.ruc,
    })),
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      organizations: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.listUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
      areas: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.listUseCase.areas(page, size),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ organizations, areas }) => {
          this.referenceOrganizations.set(organizations);
          this.referenceAreas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado));
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.referenceOrganizations.set([]);
          this.referenceAreas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  setTab(tab: OrganizationTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  loadOrganizations(
    page = this.organizations().page,
    size = this.organizations().size,
  ): void {
    this.organizationsLoading.set(true);
    this.organizationsError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.organizationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.organizations.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.organizationsError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadAreas(
    page = this.areas().page,
    size = this.areas().size,
  ): void {
    this.areasLoading.set(true);
    this.areasError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .areas(page, size, this.areaCompanyFilter() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.areasLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.areas.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.areasError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeAreaCompany(value: string): void {
    const companyId = Number(value);
    this.areaCompanyFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(companyId) && companyId > 0 ? companyId : null,
    );
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  async createCompany(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openCompany();

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.loadOrganizations(1);
    }
  }

  async createAssociation(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openAssociation();

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.loadOrganizations(1);
    }
  }

  editOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase
      .detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.openOrganizationEditor(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private async openOrganizationEditor(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const result = detail.organizacion.esAsociacion
      ? await this.formModal.openAssociation(detail)
      : await this.formModal.openCompany(detail);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.loadOrganizations();
    }
  }

  async viewOrganization(company: Empresa): Promise<void> {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);

    this.listUseCase
      .detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          void this.formModal.openView(detail);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async createArea(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    if (this.companyOptions().length === 0) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Falta una organización',
        'Registra una empresa o asociación antes de crear áreas.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openArea({
      companies: this.companyOptions(),
      areas: this.referenceAreas(),
    });

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.loadAreas(1);
    }
  }

  async editArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openArea(
      {
        companies: this.companyOptions(),
        areas: this.referenceAreas(),
      },
      area,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.loadAreas();
    }
  }
}

import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBan, faEye, faFloppyDisk, faKey, faLock, faPen, faPlus, faRotate, faShieldHalved, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { normalizeOptionalText, normalizeText, notBlankValidator, optionalNotBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { CrearRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-rol.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-rol.use-case';
import { EditarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-rol.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { Rol } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';
@Component({
    selector: 'app-roles-list-page',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [
        ReactiveFormsModule,
        RouterLink,
        FaIconComponent,
        PermissionDirective,
        LoadingStateComponent,
        ErrorStateComponent,
        EmptyStateComponent,
        PaginatorComponent,
        ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
        FormErrorComponent,
        PageHeaderComponent,
    ],
    templateUrl: './roles-list.html',
    styleUrl: './roles-list.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolesListPage implements OnInit {
    @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
    private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
    private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearRolUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRolUseCase);
    private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarRolUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly loading = signal(true);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly modalError = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly currentRole = signal<Rol | null>(null);
    readonly result = signal<PageResult<Rol>>(emptyPageResult(20));
    readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly viewIcon = faEye;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly permissionsIcon = faKey;
    readonly disableIcon = faBan;
    readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly lockIcon = faLock;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
        nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(100)]],
        descripcion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(200)]],
        requiereSegundoFactor: [false],
    });
    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.load(1);
    }
    load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
        this.loading.set(true);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.listUseCase
            .execute(page, size)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    openCreate(): void {
        this.currentRole.set(null);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: '',
            nombre: '',
            descripcion: '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        openAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement);
    }
    openEdit(role: Rol): void {
        if (role.esSistema) {
            return;
        }
        this.currentRole.set(role);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: role.codigo,
            nombre: role.nombre,
            descripcion: role.descripcion ?? '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: role.requiereSegundoFactor,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        openAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement);
    }
    closeModal(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        closeAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement, () => {
            this.currentRole.set(null);
            this.modalError.set(null);
        });
    }
    save(): void {
        const current = this.currentRole();

        if (!current) {
            this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(buildSystemCode('ROL', this.form.controls.nombre.value, 40), {
                emitEvent: false,
            });
        }

        this.form.markAllAsTouched();

        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }

        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        this.saving.set(true);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.rolId, {
                nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(values.descripcion),
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
                nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(values.descripcion),
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Rol actualizado' : 'Rol registrado');
                this.closeModal();
                this.load(current ? this.result().page : 1);
            },
            error: (error) => this.modalError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    async disable(role: Rol): Promise<void> {
        if (role.esSistema || this.disablingId()) {
            return;
        }
        const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
            title: 'Deshabilitar rol',
            message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible para nuevas asignaciones.`,
            tone: 'danger',
            confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
            cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
            requiresReason: true,
            reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
            reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
            minimumReasonLength: 5,
        });
        if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
            return;
        }
        this.disablingId.set(role.rolId);
        this.disableUseCase
            .execute(role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success('Rol deshabilitado');
                this.load();
            },
            error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el rol', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
}

html,
body {
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  background: var(--desco-page-bg);
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--desco-primary);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
}

/* El tema se aplica de forma atómica. Durante el commit se desactivan
   transiciones locales para que ningún componente quede a medio recolorear. */
html.desco-theme-commit,
html.desco-theme-commit body,
html.desco-theme-commit body *,
html.desco-theme-commit body *::before,
html.desco-theme-commit body *::after {
  transition: none !important;
}

/* View Transitions: el navegador captura el estado anterior y el nuevo,
   y hace un único fundido de la aplicación completa. */
::view-transition-old(root),
::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: 280ms;
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

::view-transition-old(root) {
  animation-name: desco-theme-old;
}

::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-name: desco-theme-new;
}

@keyframes desco-theme-old {
  from { opacity: 1; }
  to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes desco-theme-new {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

/* Fallback para navegadores sin View Transitions. El overlay cubre el único
   frame en que se sustituyen los tokens y luego desaparece suavemente. */
.desco-theme-switch-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2147483647;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 110ms ease;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--light {
  background: #f8fafc;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--dark {
  background: #000000;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--visible {
  opacity: 0.96;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  ::view-transition-old(root),
  ::view-transition-new(root),
  .desco-theme-switch-overlay {
    animation-duration: 0ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0ms !important;
  }
}

.desco-modal[open]::backdrop {

}

.desco-modal[open] > .modal-box {
  animation: desco-modal-panel-in 160ms ease-out both;
}

.desco-modal.desco-modal--closing::backdrop {
  animation: desco-modal-backdrop-out 150ms ease-in both;
}

.desco-modal.desco-modal--closing > .modal-box {
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: desco-modal-panel-out 150ms ease-in both;
}

@keyframes desco-modal-panel-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.6rem) scale(0.985);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-panel-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.35rem) scale(0.992);
  }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-backdrop-in {
  from { background: transparent; }
  to { background: var(--desco-overlay); }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-backdrop-out {
  from { background: var(--desco-overlay); }
  to { background: transparent; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .desco-modal[open]::backdrop,
  .desco-modal[open] > .modal-box,
  .desco-modal.desco-modal--closing::backdrop,
  .desco-modal.desco-modal--closing > .modal-box {
    animation-duration: 0ms !important;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — TABLAS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
}

.admin-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 48rem;
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
}

.admin-table th {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.025em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-table th.text-center,
.admin-table td.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table th.text-right,
.admin-table td.text-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.admin-table td {
  height: 3.65rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.85rem;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table td > .admin-entity,
.admin-table td > .admin-stack-copy,
.admin-table td > .admin-row-actions,
.admin-table td > .admin-status,
.admin-table td > .admin-code,
.admin-table td > .admin-count-badge,
.admin-table td > .admin-muted-badge {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table .admin-row-actions {
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-table tbody tr {
  transition: background 120ms ease;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
}


.admin-table-primary {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-table-muted {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.admin-table-empty {
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — ENTIDADES Y COPIA
   ============================================================ */

.admin-entity {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 12rem;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 0.72rem;
}

.admin-entity > div,
.admin-stack-copy {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-self: center;
}

.admin-entity > div > strong,
.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy strong,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-entity strong,
.admin-stack-copy strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text-soft);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.08rem 0 0;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 0.95rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon,
.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-entity-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  min-width: 2.25rem;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 2.25rem;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-avatar {
  background: #1d4ed8;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  place-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-code {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge,
.admin-muted-badge,
.admin-count-badge,
.admin-usage-badge,
.admin-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.6rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.52rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge {
  background: #eef2ff;
  color: #4338ca;
}

.admin-muted-badge {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-count-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-usage-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-usage-badge--used {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #c2410c;
}

.admin-status {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-status--active {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-status--inactive {
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-status--info {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-status--warning {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #b45309;
}

.admin-status--neutral {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

 .admin-managed-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-field-hint {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: #7b8ba1;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — DETALLE
   ============================================================ */

.admin-detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-detail-card {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.03);
}

.admin-detail-card span,
.admin-detail-card strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-detail-card span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-detail-card strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.22rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-info-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
}

.admin-info-list > div {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.admin-info-list > div:nth-child(-n + 2) {
  border-top: 0;
}

.admin-info-list span,
.admin-info-list strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-info-list span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-info-list strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-chip-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.admin-chip-list article {
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
}

.admin-chip-list strong,
.admin-chip-list span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-chip-list strong {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-chip-list span {
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.admin-empty-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — AVISOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-notice {
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  color: #1e40af;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-notice--warning {
  border-color: #fde68a;
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #92400e;
}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .admin-toolbar,
  .admin-toolbar--end {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-field {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: none;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-actions {
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .admin-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-field-span-2 {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .admin-option-grid,
  .admin-info-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-info-list > div:nth-child(2) {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  }

  .admin-modal-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions > button,
  .admin-modal-actions > a {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-row-actions {
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .admin-icon-button {
    width: 2.1rem;
    height: 2.1rem;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — CENTRADO NORMALIZADO DE IDENTIFICADORES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table .admin-entity {
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon {
  display: grid;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}
