- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260913_094213_708848/src/app/shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260913_094213_708848\src\app\shared\forms\geography-cascade\geography-cascade.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260913_094213_708848/src/app/shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnInit,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import {
  GeographyItem,
} from '../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.model';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';

export interface GeographySelection {
  departmentCode: string;
  provinceCode: string;
  districtCode: string;
  populationCenterId: number | null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-geography-cascade',
  standalone: true,
  templateUrl: './geography-cascade.html',
  styleUrl: './geography-cascade.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class GeographyCascadeComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges {
  @Input() districtCode = '';
  @Input() populationCenterId: number | null = null;
  @Input() disabled = false;
  @Input() locationLocked = false;

  @Output() readonly selectionChange =
    new EventEmitter<GeographySelection>();

  private readonly references = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private initialized = false;
  private synchronizationVersion = 0;

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly departments = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);
  readonly provinces = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);
  readonly districts = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);
  readonly populationCenters = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);

  readonly selectedDepartment = signal('');
  readonly selectedProvince = signal('');
  readonly selectedDistrict = signal('');
  readonly selectedPopulationCenter = signal<number | null>(null);

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initialized = true;
    this.synchronizeFromInputs();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (
      this.initialized &&
      (changes['districtCode'] || changes['populationCenterId'])
    ) {
      this.synchronizeFromInputs();
    }
  }

  changeDepartment(value: string): void {
    const departmentCode = value.trim();

    this.selectedDepartment.set(departmentCode);
    this.selectedProvince.set('');
    this.selectedDistrict.set('');
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
    this.provinces.set([]);
    this.districts.set([]);
    this.populationCenters.set([]);
    this.emitSelection();

    if (!departmentCode) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.references
      .provinces(departmentCode)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.provinces.set(items),
        error: () => {
          this.provinces.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar las provincias.');
        },
      });
  }

  changeProvince(value: string): void {
    const provinceCode = value.trim();

    this.selectedProvince.set(provinceCode);
    this.selectedDistrict.set('');
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
    this.districts.set([]);
    this.populationCenters.set([]);
    this.emitSelection();

    if (!provinceCode) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.references
      .districts(provinceCode)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.districts.set(items),
        error: () => {
          this.districts.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los distritos.');
        },
      });
  }

  changeDistrict(value: string): void {
    const districtCode = value.trim();

    this.selectedDistrict.set(districtCode);
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
    this.populationCenters.set([]);
    this.emitSelection();

    if (!districtCode) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.references
      .populationCenters(districtCode)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.populationCenters.set(items),
        error: () => {
          this.populationCenters.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron cargar los centros poblados.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  changePopulationCenter(value: string): void {
    const numeric = Number(value);
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(
      Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric > 0 ? numeric : null,
    );
    this.emitSelection();
  }

  private synchronizeFromInputs(): void {
    const version = ++this.synchronizationVersion;
    const districtCode = (this.districtCode ?? '').trim();
    const departmentCode = districtCode.length >= 2
      ? districtCode.slice(0, 2)
      : '';
    const provinceCode = districtCode.length >= 4
      ? districtCode.slice(0, 4)
      : '';
    const populationCenterId =
      this.populationCenterId && this.populationCenterId > 0
        ? this.populationCenterId
        : null;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    if (!districtCode) {
      this.selectedDepartment.set('');
      this.selectedProvince.set('');
      this.selectedDistrict.set('');
      this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
      this.provinces.set([]);
      this.districts.set([]);
      this.populationCenters.set([]);

      this.references
        .departments()
        .pipe(finalize(() => {
          if (version === this.synchronizationVersion) {
            this.loading.set(false);
          }
        }))
        .subscribe({
          next: (items) => {
            if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
              return;
            }
            this.departments.set(items);
          },
          error: () => {
            if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
              return;
            }
            this.departments.set([]);
            this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo cargar la ubicación.');
          },
        });
      return;
    }

    forkJoin({
      departments: this.references.departments(),
      provinces: this.references.provinces(departmentCode),
      districts: this.references.districts(provinceCode),
      populationCenters: this.references.populationCenters(districtCode),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => {
        if (version === this.synchronizationVersion) {
          this.loading.set(false);
        }
      }))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
            return;
          }

          this.departments.set(result.departments);
          this.provinces.set(result.provinces);
          this.districts.set(result.districts);
          this.populationCenters.set(result.populationCenters);

          /*
           * Aplicar la selección DESPUÉS de poblar las opciones.
           * Esto evita que el navegador deje Provincia/Distrito en el
           * placeholder cuando el código llegó antes que los catálogos.
           */
          this.selectedDepartment.set(departmentCode);
          this.selectedProvince.set(provinceCode);
          this.selectedDistrict.set(districtCode);
          this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(populationCenterId);
        },
        error: () => {
          if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
            return;
          }
          this.departments.set([]);
          this.provinces.set([]);
          this.districts.set([]);
          this.populationCenters.set([]);
          this.selectedDepartment.set('');
          this.selectedProvince.set('');
          this.selectedDistrict.set('');
          this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo cargar la ubicación seleccionada.');
        },
      });
  }

  private emitSelection(): void {
    this.selectionChange.emit({
      departmentCode: this.selectedDepartment(),
      provinceCode: this.selectedProvince(),
      districtCode: this.selectedDistrict(),
      populationCenterId: this.selectedPopulationCenter(),
    });
  }
}
```

```html
<section class="geography-cascade" aria-label="Ubicación geográfica">
  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoDepartment">Departamento</label>
    <select
      id="geoDepartment"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || locationLocked || loading()"
      (change)="changeDepartment($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option value="" [selected]="!selectedDepartment()">Seleccionar departamento</option>
      @for (item of departments(); track item.code) {
        <option [value]="item.code" [selected]="item.code === selectedDepartment()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoProvince">Provincia</label>
    <select
      id="geoProvince"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || locationLocked || loading() || !selectedDepartment()"
      (change)="changeProvince($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option value="" [selected]="!selectedProvince()">Seleccionar provincia</option>
      @for (item of provinces(); track item.code) {
        <option [value]="item.code" [selected]="item.code === selectedProvince()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoDistrict">Distrito <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <select
      id="geoDistrict"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || locationLocked || loading() || !selectedProvince()"
      (change)="changeDistrict($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option value="" [selected]="!selectedDistrict()">Seleccionar distrito</option>
      @for (item of districts(); track item.code) {
        <option [value]="item.code" [selected]="item.code === selectedDistrict()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoPopulationCenter">Centro poblado <span>(opcional)</span></label>
    <select
      id="geoPopulationCenter"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || loading() || !selectedDistrict()"
      (change)="changePopulationCenter($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option [value]="0" [selected]="selectedPopulationCenter() === null">Sin centro poblado</option>
      @for (item of populationCenters(); track item.id) {
        <option [value]="item.id" [selected]="item.id === selectedPopulationCenter()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  @if (loading()) {
    <div class="geography-status" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
      Cargando ubicación...
    </div>
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <div class="geography-status geography-status--error" role="alert">
      {{ errorMessage() }}
    </div>
  }
</section>
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.auth-page {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 100vh;
  place-items: center;
  background: #f4f7fb;
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
}

.auth-card {
  display: grid;
  width: min(100%, 62rem);
  min-height: min(38rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
  grid-template-columns: minmax(19rem, 0.9fr) minmax(24rem, 1.1fr);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #dce5f0;
  border-radius: 1.8rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.1);
}

.auth-info-panel {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-right: 1px solid #dbe7f8;
  background: #eef4ff;
  padding: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.3rem);
  color: #172033;
}

.auth-info-panel::before {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8rem;
  left: -8rem;
  width: 17rem;
  height: 17rem;
  border: 1px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.08);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  content: '';
  pointer-events: none;
}

.auth-info-panel::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: -6rem;
  bottom: -7rem;
  width: 15rem;
  height: 15rem;
  border: 1px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.08);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  content: '';
  pointer-events: none;
}

.auth-brand,
.auth-mobile-brand {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.auth-logo {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.65rem;
  height: 2.65rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #d9e5fb;
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.08);
}

.auth-brand-identity {
  min-width: 0;
}

.auth-brand-name {
  margin: 0;
  color: #172033;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.auth-brand-unit {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: #66758c;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.auth-illustration-area {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  min-height: 0;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 1.25rem 1rem 0.9rem;
}

.auth-illustration {
  display: block;
  width: min(100%, 17.5rem);
  height: auto;
  max-height: min(48vh, 25rem);
}

.auth-info-copy {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 20rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #d8e4f6;
  padding-top: 1.15rem;
}

.auth-info-kicker {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.67rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.auth-info-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: #1e293b;
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.auth-info-location {
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.auth-form-panel {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #fbfdff;
  padding: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.25rem);
}

.auth-card-wrap {
  width: min(100%, 27rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.auth-mobile-brand {
  display: none;
  width: min(100%, 27rem);
  margin: 0 auto 2rem;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .auth-card {
    width: min(100%, 33rem);
    min-height: auto;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .auth-info-panel {
    display: none;
  }

  .auth-form-panel {
    min-height: min(37rem, calc(100vh - 2.5rem));
    background: #fbfdff;
    padding: clamp(1.75rem, 7vw, 3rem);
  }

  .auth-mobile-brand {
    display: flex;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .auth-page {
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .auth-form-panel {
    min-height: 100vh;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .auth-mobile-brand {
    margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
  }

  .auth-card-wrap {
    margin: auto 0;
  }
}

/* Selector de tema: se añade sin alterar la composición original del login. */
.auth-theme-toggle {
  position: fixed;
  top: 1rem;
  right: 1rem;
  z-index: 50;
  display: grid;
  width: 2.8rem;
  height: 2.8rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-elevated);
  color: var(--desco-text);
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.auth-theme-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--desco-surface-hover);
}

.auth-theme-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--desco-focus-ring);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-page {
  background: #000000;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-card {
  border-color: var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-md);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-panel {
  border-right-color: var(--desco-border);
  background: #070707;
  color: var(--desco-text);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-panel::before,
html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-panel::after {
  border-color: rgb(96 165 250 / 0.13);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-logo {
  border-color: #303030;
  background: #111111;
  color: #93c5fd;
  box-shadow: none;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-brand-name,
html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-title {
  color: #f8fafc;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-brand-unit,
html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-location {
  color: #a3a3a3;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-copy {
  border-top-color: #262626;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-info-kicker {
  color: #93c5fd;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-form-panel {
  background: #050505;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .auth-mobile-brand {
  color: var(--desco-text);
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .auth-theme-toggle {
    top: 0.75rem;
    right: 0.75rem;
  }
}
```

```css
  padding:
    clamp(
      1.4rem,

      2rem
    );
  box-shadow:
    0 18px 46px
    rgb(36 62 103 / 0.08);
}

.auth-step-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
  border: 1px solid #dce7fb;
  border-radius: 1.15rem;
  background: #f3f7ff;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.auth-step-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 3.15rem;
  height: 3.15rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #d6e4ff;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  color: #2859dc;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  box-shadow:
    0 7px 18px
    rgb(37 99 235 / 0.08);
}

.auth-step-heading {
  min-width: 0;
}

.auth-step-kicker {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.34rem;
  color: #2859dc;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.auth-step-heading h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #162033;
  font-family:
    'Plus Jakarta Sans',
    'Manrope',
    ui-sans-serif,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  font-size:
    clamp(
      1.45rem,
      4vw,
      1.75rem
    );
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.auth-step-heading p {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: #69788e;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.auth-step-heading strong {
  color: #30425e;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.auth-inline-error {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #fff6f6;
  padding: 0.78rem 0.9rem;
  color: #b42318;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.auth-step-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.05rem;
  margin-top: 1.4rem;
}

.auth-otp-fieldset {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.auth-otp-fieldset legend {
  margin-bottom: 0.62rem;
  color: #2d3a4e;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.auth-otp-group {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: clamp(0.38rem, 1.4vw, 0.58rem);
}

.auth-otp-input {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  border: 1px solid #cdd9e8;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #fbfdff;
  color: #172033;
  font-family:
    'Plus Jakarta Sans',
    'Manrope',
    ui-sans-serif,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  font-size:
    clamp(
      1.05rem,
      4vw,
      1.35rem
    );
  font-weight: 800;
  text-align: center;
  outline: none;
  caret-color: #2859dc;
  transition:
    border-color 150ms ease,
    background 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease,
    transform 150ms ease;
}

.auth-otp-input:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #aebfda;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
}

.auth-otp-input:focus {
  border-color: #4b75e8;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px
      rgb(59 111 226 / 0.1),
    0 8px 18px
      rgb(37 82 160 / 0.07);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.auth-otp-input:not(:placeholder-shown) {
  border-color: #aac0f3;
}

.auth-otp-input:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.auth-security-note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;

}

.auth-security-note-icon {

  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  color: #a56b18;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  box-shadow:
    0 3px 10px
    rgb(165 107 24 / 0.08);
}

.auth-security-note p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #7d5a27;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 620;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.auth-primary-button {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 3.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.62rem;
  border: 1px solid #2453cf;
  border-radius: 0.95rem;
  background: #2859dc;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow:
    0 10px 24px
    rgb(40 89 220 / 0.18);
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease,
    transform 150ms ease;
}

.auth-primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #1f49bd;
  background: #234fc9;
  box-shadow:
    0 13px 27px
    rgb(40 89 220 / 0.22);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.auth-primary-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.68;
}

.auth-step-actions {
  display: flex;
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #e6edf6;
  padding-top: 1rem;
}

.auth-link-button,
.auth-back-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.3rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.42rem;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0 0.45rem;
  color: #2859dc;
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease;
}

.auth-link-button:hover:not(:disabled),
.auth-back-link:hover {
  background: #edf3ff;
  color: #1f49bd;
}

.auth-link-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.auth-link-button:focus-visible,
.auth-back-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid
    rgb(37 99 235 / 0.14);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .auth-step-card {
    border-radius: 1.2rem;
    padding: 1.15rem;
  }

  .auth-step-header {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .auth-step-icon {
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .auth-otp-group {
    gap: 0.32rem;
  }

  .auth-otp-input {
    border-radius: 0.72rem;
  }

  .auth-step-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
  }
}
```

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260913_105515_232795/src/app/features/administracion/usuarios/adapter/in/ui/pages/usuarios-list/usuarios-list.html`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260913_105515_232795\src\app\features\administracion\usuarios\adapter\in\ui\pages\usuarios-list\usuarios-list.html`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260913_105515_232795/src/app/features/administracion/usuarios/adapter/in/ui/pages/usuarios-list/usuarios-list.html`

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Usuarios y accesos"
    subtitle="Administra cuentas, estados y asignaciones de acceso."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="referencesLoading() || referencesError() !== null"
        [attr.title]="referencesError() ? 'No se pudieron cargar las opciones' : employees().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'Todos los empleados activos ya tienen una cuenta' : roles().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'No hay roles activos disponibles' : 'Crear cuenta'"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        @if (referencesLoading()) {
          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        }
        Nueva cuenta
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="userStateFilter">Estado de cuenta</label>
        <select
          id="userStateFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="stateFilter()"
          (change)="changeState($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="PENDIENTE_VALIDACION">Pendiente de validación</option>
          <option value="ACTIVA">Activa</option>
          <option value="DESHABILITADA">Deshabilitada</option>
          <option value="BLOQUEADA">Bloqueada</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="userCompanyFilter">Organización</label>
        <select
          id="userCompanyFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="companyFilter() ?? 0"
          (change)="changeCompany($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Todas</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando usuarios"
        message="Consultando cuentas y accesos activos."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin usuarios"
        message="No hay cuentas para los filtros seleccionados."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Usuario</th>
              <th>Empleado</th>
              <th>Organización</th>
              <th class="text-center">Roles</th>
              <th class="text-center">Sesiones</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (user of result().items; track user.usuarioId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-avatar">
                      {{ user.nombreUsuario.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() }}
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ user.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ user.empleado || '—' }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ user.numeroDocumento || '—' }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{{ user.empresa || '—' }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ user.rolesActivos }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ user.sesionesActivas }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="user.estadoCuenta === 'ACTIVA'"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="isDisabled(user)"
                    [class.admin-status--info]="user.estadoCuenta === 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION'"
                    [class.admin-status--warning]="user.estadoCuenta === 'BLOQUEADA'"
                  >
                    {{ accountStateLabel(user.estadoCuenta) }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <a
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_VER'"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      [routerLink]="['/administracion/usuarios', user.usuarioId]"
                      title="Ver detalle"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                    </a>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar"
                      [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === user.usuarioId"
                      (click)="edit(user)"
                    >
                      @if (detailLoadingId() === user.usuarioId) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>

                    @if (isDisabled(user)) {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CONFIRMAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--success"
                        title="Reactivar"
                        [disabled]="actionUserId() === user.usuarioId"
                        (click)="reactivate(user)"
                      >
                        @if (actionUserId() === user.usuarioId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="reactivateIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    } @else {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_RETIRAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                        title="Deshabilitar"
                        [disabled]="actionUserId() === user.usuarioId"
                        (click)="disable(user)"
                      >
                        @if (actionUserId() === user.usuarioId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-usuario-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faRotateLeft,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../../empleados/application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-cuenta.use-case';
import { ListarUsuariosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-usuarios.use-case';
import { ObtenerUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-usuario.use-case';
import { ReactivarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/reactivar-cuenta.use-case';
import { Usuario } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuarioFormComponent } from '../usuario-form/usuario-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuarios-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UsuarioFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuarios-list.html',
  styleUrl: './usuarios-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuariosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UsuarioFormComponent)
  private formModal!: UsuarioFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarUsuariosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly reactivateUseCase = inject(ReactivarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly employeesUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
  private readonly rolesUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly actionUserId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<Usuario>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faUsersGear;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      companies: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.organizationsUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
      employees: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.employeesUseCase.execute({ activo: true, page, size }),
      ),
      roles: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.rolesUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, employees, roles }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.map((company) => ({
              value: company.empresaId,
              label: company.razonSocial,
              description: company.estado ? company.ruc : `${company.ruc} · Inactiva`,
            })),
          );

          this.employees.set(
            employees
              .filter((employee) => employee.estado && !employee.usuarioId)
              .map((employee) => ({
                value: employee.empleadoId,
                label: `${this.employeeName(employee)} · ${employee.numeroDocumento}`,
                description: `${employee.empresa}${employee.area ? ` · ${employee.area}` : ''}`,
              })),
          );

          this.roles.set(
            roles
              .filter((role) => role.estado)
              .map((role) => ({
                value: role.rolId,
                label: role.nombre,
                description: role.codigo,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.employees.set([]);
          this.roles.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoCuenta: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeState(value: string): void {
    this.stateFilter.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeCompany(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.companyFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    if (this.employees().length === 0) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Sin empleados disponibles',
        'Todos los empleados activos ya tienen una cuenta.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.roles().length === 0) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Sin roles disponibles',
        'Primero debe existir al menos un rol activo.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openCreate({
      employees: this.employees(),
      roles: this.roles(),
    });

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  edit(user: Usuario): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (detail) => {
          const result = await this.formModal.openEdit(detail);

          if (result.saved) {
            this.load();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async disable(user: Usuario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.actionUserId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" dejará de poder ingresar al sistema.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.actionUserId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionUserId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta deshabilitada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async reactivate(user: Usuario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.actionUserId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Reactivar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" volverá a estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Reactivar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.actionUserId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.reactivateUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionUserId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta reactivada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reactivar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  isDisabled(user: Usuario): boolean {
    return (user.estadoCuenta || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESHABILITADA';
  }

  accountStateLabel(state: string | null): string {
    switch ((state || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ACTIVA':
        return 'Activa';
      case 'DESHABILITADA':
        return 'Deshabilitada';
      case 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION':
        return 'Pendiente de validación';
      case 'BLOQUEADA':
        return 'Bloqueada';
      default:
        return state || 'Sin estado';
    }
  }

  private employeeName(employee: {
    nombres: string;
    apellidoPaterno: string;
    apellidoMaterno: string | null;
  }): string {
    return [
      employee.nombres,
      employee.apellidoPaterno,
      employee.apellidoMaterno,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ');
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  UserAssignRoleRequest,
  UserCreateRequest,
  UserDisableRequest,
  UserReactivateRequest,
  UserRemoveRoleRequest,
  UserUpdateRequest,
  UsuariosYAccesosService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { UsuariosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/usuarios.gateway';
import { UsuarioFiltro } from '../../../domain/usuario-filtro.model';
import {
  UsuarioCreate,
  UsuarioUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuariosHttpMapper } from './usuarios-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class UsuariosHttpAdapter implements UsuariosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(UsuariosYAccesosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(UsuariosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: UsuarioFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .usuariosListar(
        {
          estadoCuenta: filter.estadoCuenta,
          empresaId: filter.empresaId,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .usuariosVer(
        { id },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  create(input: UsuarioCreate) {
    const userCreateRequest: UserCreateRequest = {
      empleadoId: input.empleadoId,
      nombreUsuario: input.nombreUsuario,
      passwordInicial: input.passwordInicial,
      correoSeguridad: input.correoSeguridad,
      requiereCambioPassword: input.requiereCambioPassword,
      rolIds: [...input.rolIds],
    };

    return this.api
      .usuariosCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: UsuarioUpdate) {
    const userUpdateRequest: UserUpdateRequest = {
      nombreUsuario: input.nombreUsuario,
      requiereCambioPassword: input.requiereCambioPassword,
      segundoFactorHabilitado: input.segundoFactorHabilitado,
    };

    return this.api
      .usuariosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  disable(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const userDisableRequest: UserDisableRequest = { motivo };

    return this.api
      .usuariosDeshabilitar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userDisableRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  reactivate(id: number, motivo?: string) {
    const userReactivateRequest: UserReactivateRequest = { motivo };

    return this.api
      .usuariosReactivar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userReactivateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  assignRole(id: number, rolId: number) {
    const userAssignRoleRequest: UserAssignRoleRequest = { rolId };

    return this.api
      .usuariosAsignarRol(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userAssignRoleRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  removeRole(id: number, rolId: number, motivo: string) {
    const userRemoveRoleRequest: UserRemoveRoleRequest = {
      rolId,
      motivo,
    };

    return this.api
      .usuariosRetirarRol(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userRemoveRoleRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { UsuarioDispositivo } from '../../../domain/usuario-dispositivo.model';
import {
  Usuario,
  UsuarioDetalle,
  UsuarioRol,
} from '../../../domain/usuario.model';

@Injectable()
export class UsuariosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.user(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): UsuarioDetalle {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));

    return {
      usuarioId: this.api.number(raw['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.api.string(raw['nombreUsuario']),
      estadoCuenta: this.api.nullableString(raw['estadoCuenta']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(raw['estado']),
      fechaCreacion: this.api.nullableString(raw['fechaCreacion']),
      ultimoAccesoCorrecto: this.api.nullableString(raw['ultimoAccesoCorrecto']),
      fechaCambioPassword: this.api.nullableString(raw['fechaCambioPassword']),
      requiereCambioPassword: this.api.boolean(raw['requiereCambioPassword']),
      segundoFactorHabilitado: this.api.boolean(raw['segundoFactorHabilitado']),
      empleadoId: this.api.number(raw['empleadoId']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.nullableString(raw['numeroDocumento']),
      empleado: this.api.nullableString(raw['empleado']),
      roles: this.api
        .array(raw['roles'])
        .map((item) => this.role(this.api.record(item))),
      dispositivos: this.api
        .array(raw['dispositivos'])
        .map((item) => this.device(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(raw['usuarioId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private user(row: Record<string, unknown>): Usuario {
    return {
      usuarioId: this.api.number(row['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.api.string(row['nombreUsuario']),
      estadoCuenta: this.api.nullableString(row['estadoCuenta']),
      fechaCreacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCreacion']),
      ultimoAccesoCorrecto: this.api.nullableString(row['ultimoAccesoCorrecto']),
      intentosFallidos: this.api.number(row['intentosFallidos']),
      bloqueadoHasta: this.api.nullableString(row['bloqueadoHasta']),
      segundoFactorHabilitado: this.api.boolean(row['segundoFactorHabilitado']),
      empleadoId: this.api.number(row['empleadoId']),
      codigoEmpleado: this.api.nullableString(row['codigoEmpleado']),
      empresa: this.api.nullableString(row['empresa']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.nullableString(row['numeroDocumento']),
      empleado: this.api.nullableString(row['empleado']),
      rolesActivos: this.api.number(row['rolesActivos']),
      sesionesActivas: this.api.number(row['sesionesActivas']),
    };
  }

  private role(row: Record<string, unknown>): UsuarioRol {
    return {
      rolId: this.api.number(row['rolId']),
```

```css
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: var(--desco-radius-md);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-sm);
}

.desco-muted {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.desco-scrollbar {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
}

.desco-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0.5rem;
  height: 0.5rem;
}

.desco-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #cbd5e1;
}

.desco-focus-ring:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — SUPERFICIES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-surface {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1.15rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
}

.admin-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
}

.admin-toolbar--end {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.admin-toolbar-field {
  min-width: 13rem;
  flex: 0 1 16rem;
}

.admin-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  margin-left: auto;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.admin-section-header {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
}

.admin-section-header p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-section-header h2 {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — TABS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-bottom: 0;
  border-radius: 1.15rem 1.15rem 0 0;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.45rem 0.45rem 0;
}

.admin-tabs button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.7rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0 0.9rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease;
}

.admin-tabs button:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-tabs button.active {
  border-bottom-color: #2563eb;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — BOTONES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-primary-button,
.admin-secondary-button,
.admin-danger-button,
.admin-success-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.7rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease,
    transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-primary-button {
  border: 1px solid #2563eb;
  background: #2563eb;
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.14);
}

.admin-primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #1d4ed8;
  background: #1d4ed8;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.18);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.admin-secondary-button {
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  color: #475569;
}

.admin-secondary-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #bfdbfe;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-danger-button {
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-danger-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #fca5a5;
  background: #fee2e2;
  color: #991b1b;
}

.admin-success-button {
  border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-success-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #86efac;
  background: #dcfce7;
  color: #166534;
}

.admin-primary-button:disabled,
.admin-secondary-button:disabled,
.admin-danger-button:disabled,
.admin-success-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.62;
}

.admin-button--disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.admin-primary-button--small,
.admin-secondary-button--small {
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  padding: 0 0.7rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.admin-icon-button {
  display: inline-grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background 150ms ease,
    border-color 150ms ease,
    color 150ms ease,
    transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-icon-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #bfdbfe;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.admin-icon-button--danger {
  border-color: #fecaca;
  background: var(--desco-danger-soft);
  color: #dc2626;
}

.admin-icon-button--danger:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #fca5a5;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-icon-button--success {
  border-color: #bbf7d0;
  background: #f7fef9;
  color: #16a34a;
}

.admin-icon-button--success:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #86efac;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-icon-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.52;
}

.admin-icon-button--disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.admin-row-actions {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — FORMULARIOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.15rem 1.15rem;
}

.admin-field {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-field-span-2 {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.admin-field > label,
.admin-field > .admin-field-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.44rem;
  color: #26364d;
  font-size: 0.73rem;
  font-weight: 780;
  transition: color 140ms ease;
}

.admin-field:focus-within > label,
.admin-field:focus-within > .admin-field-label {
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.admin-input,
.admin-select,
.admin-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #d6dfeb;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: var(--desco-control-bg);
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  outline: none;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.035),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9);
  transition:
    border-color 140ms ease,
    box-shadow 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease;
}

.admin-input,
.admin-select {
  height: 2.9rem;
  padding: 0 0.82rem;
}

.admin-textarea {
  min-height: 5.8rem;
  resize: vertical;
  padding: 0.78rem 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-input::placeholder,
.admin-textarea::placeholder {
  color: #9aa8ba;
}

.admin-input:hover:not(:disabled),
.admin-select:hover:not(:disabled),
.admin-textarea:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #b8c8dc;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
}

.admin-input:focus,
.admin-select:focus,
.admin-textarea:focus {
  border-color: #4f74d9;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.09),
    0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
}

.admin-input:disabled,
.admin-select:disabled,
.admin-textarea:disabled {
  border-color: #e2e8f0;
  background: #f5f7fa;
  color: #64748b;
  box-shadow: none;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.admin-search {
  position: relative;
  min-width: min(100%, 19rem);
}

.admin-search fa-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 0.85rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.admin-search input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 2.65rem;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0 0.8rem 0 2.45rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  outline: none;
}

.admin-search input:focus {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.1);
}

.admin-password-field {
  position: relative;
}

.admin-password-field .admin-input {
  padding-right: 2.8rem;
}

.admin-password-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 0.35rem;
  display: grid;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0.6rem;
  background: transparent;
  color: #64748b;
  cursor: pointer;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.admin-password-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-switch-row {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: var(--desco-control-bg);
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 140ms ease,
    background-color 140ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-row:hover {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface-hover);
}

.admin-switch-row > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-switch-row strong,
.admin-switch-row span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-switch-row strong {
  color: var(--desco-text-soft);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.admin-switch-row span {
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.admin-switch-control {
  position: relative;
  width: 2.55rem;
  height: 1.45rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-switch-off-border);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: var(--desco-switch-off-bg);
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
  forced-color-adjust: none;
  transition:
    border-color 150ms ease,
    background-color 150ms ease,
    box-shadow 150ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-control::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.17rem;
  left: 0.18rem;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: var(--desco-switch-thumb-off);
  box-shadow: var(--desco-switch-thumb-shadow);
  transition: transform 150ms ease;
}

.admin-switch-control:checked {
  border-color: var(--desco-switch-on-border);
  background: var(--desco-switch-on-bg);
}

.admin-switch-control:checked::after {
  background: var(--desco-switch-thumb-on);
  transform: translateX(1.06rem);
}

.admin-switch-control:focus-visible {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px var(--desco-focus-ring),
    inset 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
}

.admin-switch-control:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.admin-option-grid {
  display: grid;
  max-height: 13rem;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.5rem;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.6rem;
}

.admin-check-option {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.65rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.admin-check-option > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-check-option strong,
.admin-check-option span {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-check-option strong {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-check-option span {
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — MODALES
   ============================================================ */

.desco-modal {
  background: transparent;
  transition: none !important;
}

.desco-modal::backdrop {
  background: var(--desco-overlay);
  backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
}

.desco-modal > .modal-backdrop {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.admin-modal-box {
  width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 44rem);
  max-width: 44rem;
  max-height: min(88vh, 54rem);
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 1.25rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-md);
  transition: none !important;
}

.admin-modal-box--wide {
  width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 58rem);
  max-width: 58rem;
}

.admin-modal-box--compact {
  width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 34rem);
  max-width: 34rem;
}

.admin-modal-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 4.4rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
}

.admin-modal-title-group {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-modal-title-group > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-modal-title-group p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.admin-modal-title-group h2 {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-modal-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.45rem;
  height: 2.45rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  padding-top: 0.9rem;
}

.admin-inline-error {
  margin: 0.9rem 1.15rem 0;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 0.82rem;
  background: #fef2f2;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem;
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.45;
}



/* Apertura y cierre controlados: evita que el contenido cambie durante
   la salida y elimina el flash del modal al destruir su estado. */
.desco-modal[open]::backdrop {
  animation: desco-modal-backdrop-in 160ms ease-out both;
}

.desco-modal[open] > .modal-box {
  animation: desco-modal-panel-in 160ms ease-out both;
}

.desco-modal.desco-modal--closing::backdrop {
  animation: desco-modal-backdrop-out 150ms ease-in both;
}

.desco-modal.desco-modal--closing > .modal-box {
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: desco-modal-panel-out 150ms ease-in both;
}

@keyframes desco-modal-panel-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.6rem) scale(0.985);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-panel-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.35rem) scale(0.992);
  }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-backdrop-in {
  from { background: transparent; }
  to { background: var(--desco-overlay); }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-backdrop-out {
  from { background: var(--desco-overlay); }
  to { background: transparent; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .desco-modal[open]::backdrop,
  .desco-modal[open] > .modal-box,
  .desco-modal.desco-modal--closing::backdrop,
  .desco-modal.desco-modal--closing > .modal-box {
    animation-duration: 0ms !important;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — TABLAS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
}

.admin-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 48rem;
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
}

.admin-table th {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.025em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-table th.text-center,
.admin-table td.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table th.text-right,
.admin-table td.text-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.admin-table td {
  height: 3.65rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.85rem;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table td > .admin-entity,
.admin-table td > .admin-stack-copy,
.admin-table td > .admin-row-actions,
.admin-table td > .admin-status,
.admin-table td > .admin-code,
.admin-table td > .admin-count-badge,
.admin-table td > .admin-muted-badge {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table .admin-row-actions {
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-table tbody tr {
  transition: background 120ms ease;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
}


.admin-table-primary {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-table-muted {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.admin-table-empty {
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — ENTIDADES Y COPIA
   ============================================================ */

.admin-entity {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 12rem;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 0.72rem;
}

.admin-entity > div,
.admin-stack-copy {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-self: center;
}

.admin-entity > div > strong,
.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy strong,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-entity strong,
.admin-stack-copy strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text-soft);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.08rem 0 0;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 0.95rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon,
.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-entity-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  min-width: 2.25rem;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 2.25rem;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-avatar {
  background: #1d4ed8;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  place-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-code {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge,
.admin-muted-badge,
.admin-count-badge,
.admin-usage-badge,
.admin-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.6rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.52rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge {
  background: #eef2ff;
  color: #4338ca;
}

.admin-muted-badge {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-count-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-usage-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-usage-badge--used {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #c2410c;
}

.admin-status {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-status--active {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-status--inactive {
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-status--info {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-status--warning {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #b45309;
}

.admin-status--neutral {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

 .admin-managed-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-field-hint {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: #7b8ba1;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — DETALLE
   ============================================================ */

.admin-detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-detail-card {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.03);
}

.admin-detail-card span,
.admin-detail-card strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-detail-card span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-detail-card strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.22rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-info-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
}

.admin-info-list > div {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.admin-info-list > div:nth-child(-n + 2) {
  border-top: 0;
}

.admin-info-list span,
.admin-info-list strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-info-list span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-info-list strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-chip-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.admin-chip-list article {
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
}

.admin-chip-list strong,
.admin-chip-list span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-chip-list strong {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-chip-list span {
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.admin-empty-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — AVISOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-notice {
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  color: #1e40af;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-notice--warning {
  border-color: #fde68a;
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #92400e;
}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .admin-toolbar,
  .admin-toolbar--end {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-field {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: none;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-actions {
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .admin-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-field-span-2 {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .admin-option-grid,
  .admin-info-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-info-list > div:nth-child(2) {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  }

  .admin-modal-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions > button,
  .admin-modal-actions > a {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-row-actions {
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .admin-icon-button {
    width: 2.1rem;
    height: 2.1rem;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — CENTRADO NORMALIZADO DE IDENTIFICADORES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table .admin-entity {
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon {
  display: grid;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* GESTION TECNICA - NORMALIZACION TRANSVERSAL */
.technical-toolbar{align-items:flex-end}.technical-search-form{display:flex;min-width:min(100%,28rem);flex:1 1 28rem;align-items:flex-end;gap:.5rem}.technical-search-form .admin-input{min-width:12rem;flex:1 1 18rem}.technical-filter-switch{min-width:11.5rem;flex:0 1 14rem;padding:.62rem .72rem}.technical-filter-switch strong{font-size:.7rem}.technical-filter-switch span{margin-top:.08rem;font-size:.6rem}.technical-table-copy{display:grid;min-width:0;gap:.12rem}.technical-table-copy>strong,.technical-table-copy>span{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.technical-table-copy>strong{color:#0f172a;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800}.technical-table-copy>span{color:#64748b;font-size:.64rem;font-weight:600}.technical-loading-button{min-width:6.5rem}.admin-icon-button--success{border-color:#bbf7d0;background:#f0fdf4;color:#15803d}.admin-icon-button--success:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#86efac;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}.technical-modal-context{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.55rem;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:.85rem;background:#f8fafc;padding:.7rem}.technical-modal-context span,.technical-modal-context strong{display:block}.technical-modal-context span{color:#94a3b8;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.035em}.technical-modal-context strong{margin-top:.16rem;overflow:hidden;color:#334155;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:760px){.technical-search-form{flex-wrap:wrap}.technical-search-form .admin-input{flex-basis:100%}.technical-filter-switch{flex-basis:100%}.technical-modal-context{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
```

```css
html,
body {
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  background: var(--desco-page-bg);
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--desco-primary);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
}

/* El tema se aplica de forma atómica. Durante el commit se desactivan
   transiciones locales para que ningún componente quede a medio recolorear. */
html.desco-theme-commit,
html.desco-theme-commit body,
html.desco-theme-commit body *,
html.desco-theme-commit body *::before,
html.desco-theme-commit body *::after {
  transition: none !important;
}

/* View Transitions: el navegador captura el estado anterior y el nuevo,
   y hace un único fundido de la aplicación completa. */
::view-transition-old(root),
::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: 280ms;
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

::view-transition-old(root) {
  animation-name: desco-theme-old;
}

::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-name: desco-theme-new;
}

@keyframes desco-theme-old {
  from { opacity: 1; }
  to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes desco-theme-new {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

/* Fallback para navegadores sin View Transitions. El overlay cubre el único
   frame en que se sustituyen los tokens y luego desaparece suavemente. */
.desco-theme-switch-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2147483647;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 110ms ease;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--light {
  background: #f8fafc;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--dark {
  background: #000000;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--visible {
  opacity: 0.96;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  ::view-transition-old(root),
  ::view-transition-new(root),
  .desco-theme-switch-overlay {
    animation-duration: 0ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0ms !important;
  }
}
```
