```typescript
import { computed, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from '../access/access.store';
import { AccessModule } from '../access/models/access-module.model';
import { NavigationItem } from './navigation-item.model';

interface FrontendEntry {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  label: string;
  route: string;
  icon: string;
  order: number;
  permission: string;
  group: 'ADMIN' | 'COMERCIAL';
}

const FRONTEND_ENTRIES: readonly FrontendEntry[] = [
  { id: -6101, code: 'CAMPANIAS', label: 'Campañas', route: '/gestion-comercial/campanias', icon: 'calendar-days', order: 10, permission: 'CAMPANIAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6102, code: 'PARTICIPANTES', label: 'Participantes', route: '/gestion-comercial/participantes', icon: 'user-group', order: 20, permission: 'PARTICIPANTES_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6103, code: 'OPERATIVOS', label: 'Operativos', route: '/gestion-comercial/operativos', icon: 'truck', order: 30, permission: 'OPERATIVOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6104, code: 'ENTREGAS', label: 'Entregas', route: '/gestion-comercial/entregas', icon: 'boxes-stacked', order: 40, permission: 'ENTREGAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6105, code: 'JABAS', label: 'Jabas', route: '/gestion-comercial/jabas', icon: 'box', order: 50, permission: 'JABAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6106, code: 'PRECIOS', label: 'Precios', route: '/gestion-comercial/precios', icon: 'coins', order: 60, permission: 'PRECIOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
];

const ROUTES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  INICIO: '/inicio',
  DASHBOARD: '/inicio',
  ORGANIZACIONES: '/administracion/organizaciones',
  ROLES: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  ROLES_PERMISOS: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  CATALOGOS: '/administracion/catalogos',
  TIPOS_BIEN: '/administracion/catalogos',
  EMPLEADOS: '/administracion/empleados',
  USUARIOS: '/administracion/usuarios',
  DOCUMENTOS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  EVIDENCIAS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  INVENTARIO: '/recursos/inventario-vehiculos',
  RECURSOS: '/recursos/programados',
  RECURSOS_PROGRAMADOS: '/recursos/programados',
  PRODUCTORES: '/gestion-tecnica/productores',
  PREDIOS: '/gestion-tecnica/predios',
  CULTIVOS: '/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos',
  CENSOS: '/gestion-tecnica/censos',
  SALIDAS: '/gestion-tecnica/salidas',
  VISITAS: '/gestion-tecnica/visitas',
  EVALUACIONES: '/gestion-tecnica/evaluaciones',
  SANIDAD: '/gestion-tecnica/sanidad',
  PRODUCCION: '/gestion-tecnica/produccion',
  CAMPANIAS: '/gestion-comercial/campanias',
  PARTICIPANTES: '/gestion-comercial/participantes',
  OPERATIVOS: '/gestion-comercial/operativos',
  ENTREGAS: '/gestion-comercial/entregas',
  JABAS: '/gestion-comercial/jabas',
  PRECIOS: '/gestion-comercial/precios',
  INCIDENCIAS: '/gestion-comercial/incidencias',
  AJUSTES_PRECIO: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  AJUSTES: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  GASTOS: '/finanzas/gastos',
  LIQUIDACIONES: '/finanzas/liquidaciones',
  PAGOS: '/finanzas/pagos',
  COBROS: '/finanzas/cobros',
  REPORTES: '/reportes',
  AUDITORIA: '/auditoria',
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NavigationService {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly items = computed(() => this.withFrontendEntries(this.buildTree(this.accessStore.modules())));

  private buildTree(modules: readonly AccessModule[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    const moduleById = new Map(modules.map((module) => [module.moduloId, module] as const));
    const includedIds = new Set<number>();

    for (const module of modules) {
      if (!module.visibleMenu) continue;
      includedIds.add(module.moduloId);
      let parentId = module.moduloPadreId;
      while (parentId !== null) {
        const parent = moduleById.get(parentId);
        if (!parent || includedIds.has(parent.moduloId)) break;
        includedIds.add(parent.moduloId);
        parentId = parent.moduloPadreId;
      }
    }

    const byParent = new Map<number | null, AccessModule[]>();
    for (const module of modules.filter((item) => includedIds.has(item.moduloId))) {
      const key = module.moduloPadreId !== null && includedIds.has(module.moduloPadreId)
        ? module.moduloPadreId
        : null;
      const bucket = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
      bucket.push(module);
      byParent.set(key, bucket);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null): NavigationItem[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden || a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre))
        .map((module) => ({
          id: module.moduloId,
          code: module.codigo,
          label: module.nombre,
          route: this.normalizedRoute(module),
          icon: module.icono,
          order: module.orden,
          children: build(module.moduloId),
        }));

    return build(null);
  }

  private withFrontendEntries(items: readonly NavigationItem[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    let result = [...items];
    for (const entry of FRONTEND_ENTRIES) {
      if (!this.hasPermission(entry.permission) || this.containsCode(result, entry.code)) continue;
      result = this.insertEntry(result, entry);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private insertEntry(items: readonly NavigationItem[], entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem[] {
    const groupMatcher = entry.group === 'ADMIN'
      ? (code: string) => code.includes('ADMIN')
      : (code: string) => code.includes('COMERCIAL');
    let inserted = false;

    const visit = (nodes: readonly NavigationItem[]): NavigationItem[] => nodes.map((node) => {
      let children = visit(node.children);
      if (!inserted && groupMatcher(node.code.trim().toUpperCase())) {
        children = [...children, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
        inserted = true;
      }
      return { ...node, children };
    });

    const decorated = visit(items);
    return inserted
      ? decorated
      : [...decorated, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
  }

  private entryNode(entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem {
    return { id: entry.id, code: entry.code, label: entry.label, route: entry.route, icon: entry.icon, order: entry.order, children: [] };
  }

  private containsCode(items: readonly NavigationItem[], code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return items.some((item) => item.code.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized || this.containsCode(item.children, normalized));
  }

  private hasPermission(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return this.accessStore.permissions().some((permission) => permission.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized);
  }

  private normalizedRoute(module: AccessModule): string | null {
    if (!module.visibleMenu) return null;
    const code = module.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();
    return ROUTES[code] ?? module.ruta;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faChevronLeft,
  faChevronRight,
  faSeedling,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../core/access/access.store';
import { CerrarSesionUseCase } from '../../../features/acceso/application/use-case/cerrar-sesion.use-case';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { NavigationService } from '../../../core/navigation/navigation.service';
import { SidebarItemComponent } from './sidebar-item';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sidebar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent, SidebarItemComponent],
  templateUrl: './sidebar.html',
  styleUrl: './sidebar.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SidebarComponent {
  private readonly navigation = inject(NavigationService);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly logoutUseCase = inject(CerrarSesionUseCase);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  @Input() mobileOpen = false;
  @Input() collapsed = false;

  @Output() mobileOpenChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Output() collapsedChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  readonly items = this.navigation.items;
  readonly loggingOut = signal(false);

  readonly logoIcon = faSeedling;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly collapseIcon = faChevronLeft;
  readonly expandIcon = faChevronRight;
  readonly logoutIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;

  readonly primaryRole = computed(
    () => this.access.roles()[0]?.nombre ?? 'Usuario autorizado',
  );

  closeMobile(): void {
    this.mobileOpenChange.emit(false);
  }

  toggleCollapsed(): void {
    this.collapsedChange.emit(!this.collapsed);
  }

  expandSidebar(): void {
    if (this.collapsed) {
      this.collapsedChange.emit(false);
    }
  }

  async logout(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.loggingOut()) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.alert.question(
      'Cerrar sesión',
      '¿Deseas finalizar la sesión actual?',
      'Cerrar sesión',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!result.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.loggingOut.set(true);
    this.closeMobile();

    this.logoutUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loggingOut.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => void this.router.navigate(['/login']),
        error: () => void this.router.navigate(['/login']),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Output,
  computed,
  inject,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBars,
  faChevronDown,
  faCircleUser,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faDisplay,
  faMoon,
  faShieldHalved,
  faSun,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../core/access/access.store';
import { ThemeService } from '../../../core/ui/theme.service';
import { BreadcrumbComponent } from '../breadcrumb/breadcrumb';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-topbar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, FaIconComponent, BreadcrumbComponent],
  templateUrl: './topbar.html',
  styleUrl: './topbar.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class TopbarComponent {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);
  readonly theme = inject(ThemeService);

  @Output() menuToggle = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly menuIcon = faBars;
  readonly userIcon = faCircleUser;
  readonly sessionsIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly devicesIcon = faDisplay;
  readonly securityIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly chevronIcon = faChevronDown;
  readonly lightIcon = faSun;
  readonly darkIcon = faMoon;
  readonly user = this.accessStore.user;

  readonly displayName = computed(
    () => this.user()?.nombreCompleto || this.user()?.nombreUsuario || 'Usuario DESCO',
  );

  readonly initials = computed(() =>
    this.displayName()
      .trim()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
      .join(''),
  );
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header title="Inventario y vehículos" subtitle="Gestiona bienes, vehículos, suministros y movimientos." eyebrow="Recursos" [icon]="pageIcon" />

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="tab()==='assets'" (click)="setTab('assets')"><fa-icon [icon]="assetIcon" /> Bienes y vehículos</button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="tab()==='supplies'" (click)="setTab('supplies')"><fa-icon [icon]="supplyIcon" /> Suministros</button>
  </div>

  @if (tab()==='assets') {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar">
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Organización</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="companyFilter()??0" (change)="companyFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value||null); loadAssets(1)"><option [value]="0">Todas</option>@for (company of companies(); track company.value) { <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Tipo de bien</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="typeFilter()??0" (change)="typeFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value||null); loadAssets(1)"><option [value]="0">Todos</option>@for (type of types(); track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Estado</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); loadAssets(1)"><option value="">Todos</option><option value="DISPONIBLE">Disponible</option><option value="MANTENIMIENTO">Mantenimiento</option><option value="NO_DISPONIBLE">No disponible</option><option value="BAJA">Baja</option></select></div>
        <div class="admin-toolbar-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="loadAssets()"><fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (click)="createAsset()">@if(referencesLoading()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="addIcon"/>} Nuevo bien</button></div>
      </div>
      @if (loading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando inventario" message="Consultando bienes y vehículos." /> }
      @else if (errorMessage()) { <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage()||'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadAssets()" /> }
      @else if (assets().items.length===0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin bienes" message="No hay bienes para los filtros seleccionados." /> }
      @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Bien</th><th>Código</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Organización</th><th>Vehículo</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for (asset of assets().items; track asset.bienInventarioId) {
            <tr><td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{asset.nombre}}</strong><span>{{asset.marca||'—'}} {{asset.modelo||''}}</span></div></td><td><span class="admin-code">{{asset.codigoPatrimonial}}</span></td><td>{{asset.tipoBien}}</td><td>{{asset.empresa}}</td><td>@if(asset.vehiculo){<span class="admin-type-badge"><fa-icon [icon]="truckIcon"/> {{asset.placa}}</span>}@else{—}</td><td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="asset.estadoBien==='DISPONIBLE'" [class.admin-status--warning]="asset.estadoBien==='MANTENIMIENTO'" [class.admin-status--inactive]="asset.estadoBien==='BAJA'">{{asset.estadoBien}}</span></td><td><div class="admin-row-actions"><a *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos',asset.bienInventarioId]" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon"/></a><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="asset.estadoBien==='BAJA'" title="Editar" (click)="editAsset(asset)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon"/></button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" [disabled]="asset.estadoBien==='BAJA'||retiringId()===asset.bienInventarioId" title="Dar de baja" (click)="retire(asset)">@if(retiringId()===asset.bienInventarioId){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon"/>}</button></div></td></tr>
          }
        </tbody></table></div>
        <app-paginator [page]="assets().page" [size]="assets().size" [totalRecords]="assets().totalRecords" [totalPages]="assets().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAssets($event,assets().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAssets(1,$event)" />
      }
    </section>
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="suppliesLoading()" (click)="loadSupplies()"><fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="suppliesLoading()" [icon]="refreshIcon"/> Actualizar</button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="createSupply()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon"/> Nuevo suministro</button></div>
      @if(suppliesLoading()){<app-loading-state title="Cargando suministros" message="Consultando stock disponible."/>}
      @else if(suppliesError()){<app-error-state [message]="suppliesError()||'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadSupplies()"/>}
      @else if(supplies().items.length===0){<app-empty-state title="Sin suministros" message="No hay suministros registrados."/>}
      @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Suministro</th><th>Unidad</th><th class="text-right">Stock</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for(supply of supplies().items;track supply.suministroId){
            <tr><td><span class="admin-code">{{supply.codigo}}</span></td><td class="font-semibold text-slate-800">{{supply.nombre}}</td><td>{{supply.unidadMedida}}</td><td class="text-right font-semibold">{{supply.stock}}</td><td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="supply.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!supply.estado">{{supply.estado?'Activo':'Inactivo'}}</span></td><td><div class="admin-row-actions"><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver kardex" [disabled]="kardexLoading()&&kardexSupply()?.suministroId===supply.suministroId" (click)="openKardex(supply)">@if(kardexLoading()&&kardexSupply()?.suministroId===supply.suministroId){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="kardexIcon"/>}</button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="editSupply(supply)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon"/></button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small" (click)="movement(supply)">Movimiento</button></div></td></tr>
          }
        </tbody></table></div>
        <app-paginator [page]="supplies().page" [size]="supplies().size" [totalRecords]="supplies().totalRecords" [totalPages]="supplies().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadSupplies($event,supplies().size)" (sizeChange)="loadSupplies(1,$event)"/>
      }
    </section>

    @if(kardexSupply(); as selectedSupply){
      <section class="admin-surface mt-4 inventory-kardex">
        <div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Kardex</p><h2>{{selectedSupply.nombre}}</h2></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Cerrar kardex" (click)="closeKardex()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon"/></button></div>
        @if(kardexLoading()){<app-loading-state title="Cargando kardex" message="Consultando movimientos del suministro."/>}
        @else if(kardexError()){<app-error-state [message]="kardexError()||'No se pudo cargar el kardex.'" (retry)="openKardex(selectedSupply)"/>}
        @else{<div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Tipo</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Documento</th><th>Usuario</th><th>Observación</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>@for(item of kardexItems();track item.suministroMovimientoId){<tr><td><span class="admin-type-badge">{{item.tipoMovimiento}}</span></td><td>{{item.cantidad}} {{item.unidadMedida}}</td><td>{{item.fechaHora?(item.fechaHora|date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'):'—'}}</td><td>{{item.documentoReferencia||'—'}}</td><td>{{item.usuario||'—'}}</td><td>{{item.observacion||'—'}}</td><td><div class="admin-row-actions">@if(canAnnulMovement(item)){<button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" [disabled]="annulMovementId()!==null" (click)="annulMovement(item)">@if(annulMovementId()===item.suministroMovimientoId){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{Anular}</button>}</div></td></tr>}@empty{<tr><td colspan="7" class="admin-table-empty">No hay movimientos para este suministro.</td></tr>}</tbody></table></div>}
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-recurso-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBookOpen,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTrashCan,
  faTruck,
  faWarehouse,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { AnularMovimientoSuministroUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/anular-movimiento-suministro.use-case';
import { ConsultarKardexSuministroUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-kardex-suministro.use-case';
import { ListarBienesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-bienes.use-case';
import { ListarSuministrosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-suministros.use-case';
import { RetirarBienUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-bien.use-case';
import { BienInventario } from '../../../../../domain/bien-inventario.model';
import { MovimientoSuministro } from '../../../../../domain/movimiento-suministro.model';
import { Suministro } from '../../../../../domain/suministro.model';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';

type InventoryTab = 'assets' | 'supplies';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inventario-vehiculos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InventarioVehiculosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private form!: RecursoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listAssetsUseCase = inject(ListarBienesUseCase);
  private readonly listSuppliesUseCase = inject(ListarSuministrosUseCase);
  private readonly kardexUseCase = inject(ConsultarKardexSuministroUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarBienUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly referenceData = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly annulMovementUseCase = inject(AnularMovimientoSuministroUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly tab = signal<InventoryTab>('assets');
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly suppliesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly suppliesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly retiringId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly annulMovementId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly kardexSupply = signal<Suministro | null>(null);
  readonly kardexLoading = signal(false);
  readonly kardexError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly kardexItems = signal<readonly MovimientoSuministro[]>([]);

  readonly assets = signal<PageResult<BienInventario>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly supplies = signal<PageResult<Suministro>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly types = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly typeFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly assetIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly supplyIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly truckIcon = faTruck;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadAssets(1);
    this.loadSupplies(1);
  }

  setTab(tab: InventoryTab): void { this.tab.set(tab); }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      companies: this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100),
      types: this.referenceData.catalog('TIPO_BIEN'),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, types }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.items.map((item) => ({
              value: item.empresaId,
              label: item.razonSocial,
              description: item.ruc,
            })),
          );
          this.types.set(
            types
              .map((item) => ({
                value: Number(item.id),
                label: item.label,
                description: item.code,
              }))
              .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item.value) && item.value > 0),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.types.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  loadAssets(page = this.assets().page, size = this.assets().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.listAssetsUseCase
      .execute({
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        tipoBienId: this.typeFilter() ?? undefined,
        estadoBien: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.assets.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadSupplies(page = this.supplies().page, size = this.supplies().size): void {
    this.suppliesLoading.set(true);
    this.suppliesError.set(null);
    this.listSuppliesUseCase.execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.suppliesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.supplies.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.suppliesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createAsset(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('createAsset', { companies: this.companies(), assetTypes: this.types() });
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets(1);
  }

  async editAsset(asset: BienInventario): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('editAsset', { asset });
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets();
  }

  async createSupply(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('createSupply');
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies(1);
  }

  async editSupply(supply: Suministro): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('editSupply', { supply });
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies();
  }

  async movement(supply: Suministro): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open('movement', { supply });
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadSupplies();
      if (this.kardexSupply()?.suministroId === supply.suministroId) this.openKardex(supply);
    }
  }

  openKardex(supply: Suministro): void {
    this.kardexSupply.set(supply);
    this.kardexItems.set([]);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
    this.kardexLoading.set(true);
    this.kardexUseCase.execute(supply.suministroId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.kardexLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardexItems.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.kardexError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  closeKardex(): void {
    this.kardexSupply.set(null);
    this.kardexItems.set([]);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
  }

  async retire(asset: BienInventario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.retiringId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Dar de baja el bien',
      message: `El bien “${asset.nombre}” quedará fuera de uso.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Dar de baja',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la baja.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.retiringId.set(asset.bienInventarioId);
    this.retireUseCase.execute(asset.bienInventarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Bien dado de baja'); this.loadAssets(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo dar de baja el bien', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  canAnnulMovement(item: MovimientoSuministro): boolean {
    return item.recursoProgramadoId == null
      && ['ENTRADA', 'AJUSTE_ENTRADA', 'AJUSTE_SALIDA'].includes(item.tipoMovimiento);
  }

  async annulMovement(item: MovimientoSuministro): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canAnnulMovement(item) || this.annulMovementId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Anular movimiento',
      message: 'Se registrará un movimiento compensatorio. El kardex original se conservará.',
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Anular movimiento',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.annulMovementId.set(item.suministroMovimientoId);
    this.annulMovementUseCase.execute(item.suministroMovimientoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.annulMovementId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Movimiento anulado');
          if (this.kardexSupply()) this.openKardex(this.kardexSupply()!);
          this.loadSupplies();
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo anular el movimiento', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
            success = m === 'vehicle' ? 'Vehículo registrado' : 'Kilometraje actualizado';
        }
        else if (m === 'createSupply' || m === 'editSupply') {
            this.supplyForm.markAllAsTouched();
            if (this.supplyForm.invalid)
                return;
            const v = this.supplyForm.getRawValue();
            op = m === 'createSupply' ? this.createSupply.execute({ codigo: v.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(), nombre: v.nombre.trim(), unidadMedida: v.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(), stockInicial: Number(v.stockInicial) }) : this.updateSupply.execute(this.supply()!.suministroId, { nombre: v.nombre.trim(), unidadMedida: v.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase() });
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260913_160448_930480/src/app/infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper.ts`

```typescript
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  exitoso?: boolean;
  codigo?: string;
  mensaje?: string;
  datos?: T;
  correlacionId?: string;
  fechaHoraUtc?: string;
}

export class ApiEnvelopeError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly code: string,
    message: string,
    readonly correlationId: string | null,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiEnvelopeError';
  }
}

export function unwrapApiResponse<T>(response: ApiEnvelope<T>): T {
  if (response.exitoso === false) {
    throw new ApiEnvelopeError(
      response.codigo ?? 'OPERACION_NO_COMPLETADA',
      response.mensaje ?? 'La operación no pudo completarse.',
      response.correlacionId ?? null,
    );
  }

  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(response, 'datos')) {
    return undefined as T;
  }

  return response.datos as T;
}
```

```typescript
@Component({
  selector: 'app-productos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    LocalFilePanelComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './productos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly selectedForImages = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faTags;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.products();
    return this.products().filter((item) =>
      [item.codigo, item.nombre, item.categoria, item.unidadMedida].some(
        (value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query),
      ),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .listProducts(unitId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.products.set(items);
          const selectedId = this.selectedForImages()?.productoId;
          if (selectedId) {
            this.selectedForImages(
              items.find((item) => item.productoId === selectedId) ?? null,
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.selectedForImages.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async price(item: ResourceProductResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  selectImages(item: ResourceProductResponse): void {
    this.selectedForImages.set(
      this.selectedForImages()?.productoId === item.productoId ? null : item,
    );
  }

  imageIds(item: ResourceProductResponse): readonly number[] {
    return item.archivoPrincipalId ? [item.archivoPrincipalId] : [];
  }

  selectedUnitId(): number {
    return (
      this.unitFilter() ??
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBuildingCircleCheck, faGlobe } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-context-switcher',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-context-switcher.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-context-switcher.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotContextSwitcherComponent {
  @Input() compact = false;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly changing = signal(false);
  readonly unitIcon = faBuildingCircleCheck;
  readonly generalIcon = faGlobe;

  readonly value = computed(() =>
    this.store.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? 'GENERAL'
      : String(this.store.selectedId() ?? ''),
  );

  readonly disabled = computed(
    () =>
      this.changing() ||
      (!this.store.canUseGeneral() && this.store.memberships().length <= 1),
  );

  change(raw: string): void {
    if (this.changing() || !raw) return;

    const current = this.value();
    if (raw === current) return;

    const general = raw === 'GENERAL';
    const uotId = general ? null : Number(raw);

    if (!general && (!Number.isFinite(uotId) || uotId <= 0)) return;

    this.changing.set(true);

    this.api
      .selectContext(general ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA', uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.changing.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            general
              ? 'Vista general activada'
              : 'Unidad de trabajo actualizada',
          );
          void this.router.navigateByUrl('/inicio');
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo cambiar la UOT',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRight,
  faBuildingCircleCheck,
  faGlobe,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ThemeService } from '../../../../../../../core/ui/theme.service';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-selection-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-selection.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-selection.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotSelectionPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);

  readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly theme = inject(ThemeService);
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly selecting = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly unitIcon = faBuildingCircleCheck;
  readonly generalIcon = faGlobe;
  readonly arrowIcon = faArrowRight;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.api
      .loadContext()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (context) => {
          if (!context.requiereSeleccion && context.uotSeleccionadaId) {
            void this.finishNavigation();
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  select(uotId: number): void {
    this.commit('ESPECIFICA', uotId, String(uotId));
  }

  selectGeneral(): void {
    this.commit('GENERAL', null, 'GENERAL');
  }

  private commit(
    mode: 'ESPECIFICA' | 'GENERAL',
    uotId: number | null,
    key: string,
  ): void {
    if (this.selecting()) return;

    this.selecting.set(key);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.api
      .selectContext(mode, uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.selecting.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => void this.finishNavigation(),
        error: (error) => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private finishNavigation(): Promise<boolean> {
    const returnUrl = this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('returnUrl');
    const safe =
      returnUrl &&
      returnUrl.startsWith('/') &&
      !returnUrl.startsWith('//') &&
      !returnUrl.startsWith('/seleccionar-uot')
        ? returnUrl
        : '/inicio';

    return this.router.navigateByUrl(safe);
  }
}
```

```html
            @if (selecting() === 'GENERAL') {
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowUpRightFromSquare,
  faFileArrowUp,
  faFolderOpen,
  faRotate,
  faTrashCan,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../../../../../../../shared/files/local-document-api.service';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-documentos-locales-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './documentos-locales.html',
  styleUrl: './documentos-locales.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DocumentosLocalesPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly api = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly items = signal<readonly LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>([]);
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly category = signal('DOCUMENTO');
  readonly description = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faFolderOpen;
  readonly uploadIcon = faFileArrowUp;
  readonly viewIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .list(unitId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.items.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load();
  }

  upload(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const file = input.files?.item(0) ?? null;
    input.value = '';
    if (!file || this.uploading()) return;

    const uotId =
      this.unitFilter() ??
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Selecciona una UOT',
        'La carga de documentos requiere una UOT específica.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (file.size <= 0 || file.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Archivo no permitido',
        'El archivo debe tener contenido y no superar 25 MB.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.uploading.set(true);
    this.api
      .upload({
        uotId,
        file,
        category: this.category().trim().toUpperCase() || 'DOCUMENTO',
        description: this.description().trim() || undefined,
        linkType: 'NINGUNO',
        principal: false,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.uploading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.description.set('');
          this.toast.success('Documento guardado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el documento',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  open(item: LocalDocumentFileResponse): void {
    if (!item.archivoId) return;

    this.api.content(item.archivoId).subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
      },
      error: (error) =>
        this.toast.error(
          'No se pudo abrir el archivo',
          mapOpenApiError(error).message,
        ),
    });
  }

  async retire(item: LocalDocumentFileResponse): Promise<void> {
    if (!item.archivoId) return;

    const answer = await this.alert.question(
      'Retirar documento',
      `¿Deseas retirar “${item.nombreOriginal || 'este archivo'}”? El archivo dejará de estar disponible.`,
      'Retirar',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!answer.confirmed) return;

    this.api
      .retire(
        item.archivoId,
        'Retiro solicitado desde el módulo de documentos locales.',
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Documento retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar el documento',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  sizeLabel(bytes?: number): string {
    const value = bytes ?? 0;
    if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
    if (value < 1024 * 1024) return `${(value / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(value / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotUnit } from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';

type UotFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'access';

export interface UotFormOptions {
  units: readonly UotUnit[];
  users?: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  roles?: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-form.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly mode = signal<UotFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<UotUnit | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly users = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly accessIcon = faKey;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  private resolver: ((value: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly unitForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotPadreId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ubicacionId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    estado: [true],
  });

  readonly accessForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    usuarioId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    rolId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    predeterminada: [false],
  });

  openCreate(options: UotFormOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    const parent =
      options.units.find((item) => item.esRaiz && item.estado) ??
      options.units.find((item) => item.estado) ??
      null;

    this.unitForm.reset({
      uotPadreId: parent?.uotId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      estado: true,
    });
    this.unitForm.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(
    unit: UotUnit,
    options: UotFormOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('edit', options, unit);
    this.unitForm.reset({
      uotPadreId: unit.uotPadreId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: unit.ubicacionId ?? 0,
      codigo: unit.codigo,
      nombre: unit.nombre,
      descripcion: unit.descripcion ?? '',
      estado: unit.estado,
    });
    this.unitForm.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openAccess(
    unit: UotUnit,
    options: UotFormOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('access', options, unit);
    this.accessForm.reset({
      usuarioId: options.users?.[0]?.value ?? 0,
      rolId: options.roles?.[0]?.value ?? 0,
      predeterminada: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'access') return 'Asignar acceso UOT';
    return this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Editar UOT' : 'Registrar UOT';
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.saving()) return;

    if (this.mode() === 'access') {
      this.saveAccess();
      return;
    }

    this.saveUnit();
  }

  parentOptions(): readonly UotUnit[] {
    const currentId = this.current()?.uotId ?? null;
    return this.units().filter(
      (item) => item.estado && item.uotId !== currentId,
    );
  }

  private saveUnit(): void {
    this.unitForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.unitForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.unitForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.current();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation = current
      ? this.api.update(current.uotId, {
          uotPadreId:
            Number(raw.uotPadreId) > 0 ? Number(raw.uotPadreId) : undefined,
          ubicacionId:
            Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
          estado: raw.estado,
        })
      : this.api.create({
          uotPadreId: Number(raw.uotPadreId),
          ubicacionId:
            Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
          codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'UOT actualizada' : 'UOT registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo guardar la UOT', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private saveAccess(): void {
    this.accessForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const unit = this.current();

    if (this.accessForm.invalid || !unit) return;

    const raw = this.accessForm.getRawValue();
    const usuarioId = Number(raw.usuarioId);
    const rolId = Number(raw.rolId);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .assignUser(unit.uotId, {
        usuarioId,
        predeterminada: raw.predeterminada,
      })
      .pipe(
        concatMap(() =>
          this.api.assignRole(unit.uotId, {
            usuarioId,
            rolId,
          }),
        ),
        finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Acceso UOT asignado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo asignar el acceso', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: UotFormMode,
    options: UotFormOptions,
    current: UotUnit | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.current.set(current);
    this.units.set(options.units);
    this.users.set(options.users ?? []);
    this.roles.set(options.roles ?? []);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faBuilding,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faIdCard,
  faPen,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadoDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly employeeId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly identityIcon = faIdCard;
  readonly organizationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly accountIcon = faShieldHalved;

  readonly fullName = computed(() => {
    const value = this.detail();

    return value
      ? [value.nombres, value.apellidoPaterno, value.apellidoMaterno]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      : 'Empleado';
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.employeeId) || this.employeeId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El empleado solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.employeeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      companies: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.organizationsUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
      areas: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.organizationsUseCase.areas(page, size),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, areas }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies
              .filter((company) => company.estado)
              .map((company) => ({
                value: company.empresaId,
                label: company.razonSocial,
                description: company.ruc,
              })),
          );
          this.areas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado));
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.areas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open(
      {
        companies: this.companies(),
        areas: this.areas(),
      },
      employee,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.retiring()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName()}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiring.set(true);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Empleados</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar empleado' : 'Registrar empleado' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Identificación</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocumentType">Tipo de documento</label>
        <select
          id="employeeDocumentType"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="tipoDocumento"
          (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()"
        >
          @for (item of documentTypes; track item.value) {
            <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocument">Número de documento</label>
        <div class="identity-document-control">
          <input
            id="employeeDocument"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading() || !!current()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />

          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="identity-search-button"
              [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()"
              [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
              (click)="resolveIdentity()"
            >
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                Buscando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                Buscar
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El número de documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            ruc: 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.',
            rucNature: 'Para una persona se requiere un RUC personal válido.',
            blank: 'El número de documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
        @if (!shouldResolveIdentity()) {
          <small class="identity-help">
            DNI y RUC permiten completar automáticamente los datos disponibles. Los demás documentos se completan manualmente.
          </small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      @if (canToggleIdentityEditing()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              [checked]="identityEditingEnabled()"
              (change)="toggleIdentityEditing($any($event.target).checked)"
            />
            Editar datos de la persona
          </label>
          <small>El número de documento no se puede modificar.</small>
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="employeeNames" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="nombres" maxlength="100" autocomplete="given-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('names')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('nombres')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.', personName: 'Los nombres solo pueden contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />

        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoPaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido paterno" [messages]="{ blank: 'El apellido paterno no puede contener solo espacios.', personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />

        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoMaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido materno" [messages]="{ personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />

        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaNacimiento" fieldLabel="La fecha de nacimiento" [messages]="{ underage: 'La persona debe ser mayor de edad.', ageOutOfRange: 'La fecha de nacimiento está fuera del rango permitido.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />

      @if (resolvedSex()) {

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeePhone">Teléfono</label>
        <input id="employeePhone" class="admin-input" type="tel" inputmode="tel" formControlName="telefono" maxlength="16" autocomplete="tel" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('phone')" (input)="onPhoneInput()" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.telefono" fieldLabel="El teléfono" [messages]="{ phone: 'Ingrese un teléfono válido de 7 a 15 dígitos.' }" />

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="employeeEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" formControlName="correo" maxlength="180" autocomplete="email" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('email')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Ubicación de la persona</span>
      </div>

      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        [locationLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')"

      />

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="employeeReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="employeeReference" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('reference')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Información laboral</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeCompany">Organización</label>
        <select id="employeeCompany" class="admin-select" formControlName="empresaId" (change)="onCompanyChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.empresaId" fieldLabel="La organización" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEntryDate">Fecha de ingreso</label>
        <input id="employeeEntryDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaIngreso" [min]="minimumEntryDate()" [max]="today" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaIngreso" fieldLabel="La fecha de ingreso" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de ingreso no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
        @if (form.hasError('entryBeforeAdult')) {

      <div class="admin-field">

        <select id="employeeArea" class="admin-select" formControlName="areaId" (change)="onAreaChange()">

          @for (area of availableAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeRoleName">

          @if (form.controls.areaId.value > 0) { <span aria-hidden="true">*</span> }
        </label>
        <input id="employeeRoleName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="cargo" maxlength="120" placeholder="Cargo o función" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.cargo" fieldLabel="El cargo" [messages]="{ blank: 'El cargo no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      @if (current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeAreaDate">Fecha de asignación de área</label>
          <input id="employeeAreaDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAsignacionArea" [min]="form.controls.fechaIngreso.value || null" [max]="today" />
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAsignacionArea" fieldLabel="La fecha de asignación" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de asignación no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
          @if (form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
            <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de asignación de área no puede ser anterior a la fecha de ingreso.</small>
          }
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```
