  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
  sanitizePhone,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface AreaModalOptions {
  companies: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly companyOptions = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('JURIDICA'),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    numeroPartida: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    empresaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.companyOptions.set(options.companies);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);
    this.areaForm.reset({
      empresaId: area?.empresaId ?? 0,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.empresaId[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onOrganizationPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedCompany(): readonly Area[] {
    const companyId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().empresaId);
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;
    const blockedIds = new Set<number>();

    if (currentAreaId !== null) {
      blockedIds.add(currentAreaId);

      let changed = true;
      while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        for (const area of this.areaOptions()) {
          if (
            area.areaPadreId !== null &&
            blockedIds.has(area.areaPadreId) &&
            !blockedIds.has(area.areaId)
          ) {
            blockedIds.add(area.areaId);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.empresaId === companyId &&
        !blockedIds.has(area.areaId) &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: sanitizePhone(company?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (company?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.empresaId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          empresaId: Number(values.empresaId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.companyOptions.set([]);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.resetState();
    });
  }
}

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5">

    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'areas'" (click)="setTab('areas')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" /> Áreas
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (activeTab() === 'organizations') {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="organizationsLoading()" (click)="loadOrganizations()">
          @if (organizationsLoading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
          @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }

        <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="createCompany()">
          <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Nueva empresa
        </button>
        <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="createAssociation()">

      @if (organizationsLoading()) {

      } @else if (organizationsError()) {
        <app-error-state [message]="organizationsError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadOrganizations()" />
      } @else if (organizations().items.length === 0) {
        <app-empty-state title="Sin organizaciones" message="Todavía no hay empresas o asociaciones disponibles." />
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">

                  <td><span class="admin-code">{{ company.ruc }}</span></td>

                  <td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="company.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!company.estado">{{ company.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}</span></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-row-actions">

                      @if (detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /> }
                    </button>
                    <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId || disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="editOrganization(company)">
                      @if (detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /> }
                    </button>
                    <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Deshabilitar" [disabled]="disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="disableOrganization(company)">
                      @if (disablingOrganizationId() === company.empresaId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" /> }
                    </button>

        <app-paginator [page]="organizations().page" [size]="organizations().size" [totalRecords]="organizations().totalRecords" [totalPages]="organizations().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadOrganizations($event, organizations().size)" (sizeChange)="loadOrganizations(1, $event)" />

  } @else {

            @if (areaView() === 'table') { <option [value]="0">Todas</option> }
            @for (company of referenceOrganizations(); track company.empresaId) {

        <div class="area-view-switch" role="group" aria-label="Vista de áreas">
          <button type="button" [class.active]="areaView() === 'hierarchy'" (click)="setAreaView('hierarchy')"><fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" /> Jerarquía</button>
          <button type="button" [class.active]="areaView() === 'table'" (click)="setAreaView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /> Tabla</button>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-toolbar-actions">
          <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="areasLoading() || referencesLoading()" (click)="loadReferences(); loadAreas()">

            Actualizar
          </button>
          <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading() || referencesError() !== null || companyOptions().length === 0" (click)="createArea()">
            <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Nueva área
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      @if (referencesLoading() && areaView() === 'hierarchy') {
        <app-loading-state title="Cargando estructura" message="Consultando áreas de la organización." />
      } @else if (referencesError()) {
        <app-error-state [message]="referencesError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadReferences()" />
      } @else if (areaView() === 'hierarchy') {
        @if (hierarchyOrganization(); as company) {
          <div class="area-hierarchy-heading">
            <div><span>Mapa organizacional</span><strong>{{ company.razonSocial }}</strong></div>
            <small>Las áreas principales se conectan a la organización y cada subárea conserva un único superior.</small>
          </div>
          <app-area-hierarchy [companyName]="company.razonSocial" [companyRuc]="company.ruc" [areas]="hierarchyAreas()" />
        } @else {
          <app-empty-state title="Sin organización" message="Registra una organización antes de definir su estructura de áreas." />
        }
      } @else {
        @if (areasLoading()) {
          <app-loading-state title="Cargando áreas" message="Consultando la estructura de áreas." />
        } @else if (areasError()) {
          <app-error-state [message]="areasError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadAreas()" />
        } @else if (areas().items.length === 0) {
          <app-empty-state title="Sin áreas" message="No hay áreas para los criterios seleccionados." />
        } @else {
          <div class="admin-table-wrap">
            <table class="admin-table">
              <thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Área</th><th>Organización</th><th>Área superior</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                @for (area of areas().items; track area.areaId) {
                  <tr>

                    <td><div class="admin-row-actions">
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar área" [disabled]="disablingAreaId() !== null" (click)="editArea(area)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Deshabilitar área" [disabled]="disablingAreaId() !== null" (click)="disableArea(area)">
                        @if (disablingAreaId() === area.areaId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" /> }
                      </button>
                    </div></td>
                  </tr>
                }
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <app-paginator [page]="areas().page" [size]="areas().size" [totalRecords]="areas().totalRecords" [totalPages]="areas().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAreas($event, areas().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAreas(1, $event)" />
        }
      }
    </section>
  }
</div>

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faBuilding,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
  faTable,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { DeshabilitarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-area.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarOrganizacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-organizacion.use-case';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';
import { AreaHierarchyComponent } from '../../components/area-hierarchy/area-hierarchy';
import { OrganizacionFormComponent } from '../organizacion-form/organizacion-form';

type OrganizationTab = 'organizations' | 'areas';
type AreaView = 'hierarchy' | 'table';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizaciones-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AreaHierarchyComponent,
    OrganizacionFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizaciones-list.html',
  styleUrl: './organizaciones-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(OrganizacionFormComponent)
  private formModal!: OrganizacionFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly disableOrganizationUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarOrganizacionUseCase);
  private readonly disableAreaUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly activeTab = signal<OrganizationTab>('organizations');
  readonly areaView = signal<AreaView>('hierarchy');
  readonly organizationsLoading = signal(true);
  readonly areasLoading = signal(false);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly disablingOrganizationId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly disablingAreaId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly organizationsError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly areasError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referenceOrganizations = signal<readonly Empresa[]>([]);
  readonly referenceAreas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly areaCompanyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly organizations = signal<PageResult<Empresa>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly areas = signal<PageResult<Area>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly pageIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly tableIcon = faTable;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly companyOptions = computed<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>(() =>
    this.referenceOrganizations()
      .filter((company) => company.estado)
      .map((company) => ({
        value: company.empresaId,
        label: company.razonSocial,
        description: company.ruc,
      })),
  );

  readonly hierarchyOrganization = computed(() => {
    const companyId = this.areaCompanyFilter();
    return this.referenceOrganizations().find(
      (company) => company.empresaId === companyId && company.estado,
    ) ?? null;
  });

  readonly hierarchyAreas = computed(() => {
    const companyId = this.hierarchyOrganization()?.empresaId;
    return companyId
      ? this.referenceAreas().filter(
          (area) => area.empresaId === companyId && area.estado,
        )
      : [];
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      organizations: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.listUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
      areas: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.listUseCase.areas(page, size),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ organizations, areas }) => {
          const activeOrganizations = organizations.filter((company) => company.estado);
          this.referenceOrganizations.set(organizations);
          this.referenceAreas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado));

          const selectedId = this.areaCompanyFilter();
          if (
            this.areaView() === 'hierarchy'
            && !activeOrganizations.some((company) => company.empresaId === selectedId)
          ) {
            this.areaCompanyFilter.set(activeOrganizations[0]?.empresaId ?? null);
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.referenceOrganizations.set([]);
          this.referenceAreas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  setTab(tab: OrganizationTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
    if (tab === 'areas') {
      this.ensureHierarchyOrganization();
    }
  }

  setAreaView(view: AreaView): void {
    this.areaView.set(view);
    if (view === 'hierarchy') {
      this.ensureHierarchyOrganization();
    }
  }

  loadOrganizations(
    page = this.organizations().page,
    size = this.organizations().size,
  ): void {
    this.organizationsLoading.set(true);
    this.organizationsError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.organizationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.organizations.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.organizationsError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadAreas(
    page = this.areas().page,
    size = this.areas().size,
  ): void {
    this.areasLoading.set(true);
    this.areasError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .areas(page, size, this.areaCompanyFilter() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.areasLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.areas.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.areasError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeAreaCompany(value: string): void {
    const companyId = Number(value);
    this.areaCompanyFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(companyId) && companyId > 0 ? companyId : null,
    );
    if (this.areaView() === 'hierarchy') {
      this.ensureHierarchyOrganization();
    }
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  async createCompany(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openCompany();
    if (result.saved) this.refreshOrganizations();
  }

  async createAssociation(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openAssociation();
    if (result.saved) this.refreshOrganizations();
  }

  editOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) return;

    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase
      .detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.openOrganizationEditor(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private async openOrganizationEditor(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<void> {
    const result = detail.organizacion.esAsociacion
      ? await this.formModal.openAssociation(detail)
      : await this.formModal.openCompany(detail);
    if (result.saved) this.refreshOrganizations();
  }

  viewOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) return;

    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase
      .detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.formModal.openView(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async disableOrganization(company: Empresa): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disablingOrganizationId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: company.esAsociacion ? 'Deshabilitar asociación' : 'Deshabilitar empresa',
      message: 'Se cerrarán áreas, asignaciones, empleados y accesos vinculados. El historial se conservará.',
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 300,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.disablingOrganizationId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.disableOrganizationUseCase
      .execute(company.empresaId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingOrganizationId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Organización deshabilitada');
          this.refreshOrganizations();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la organización',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async createArea(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canUseReferences()) return;

    const companies = this.companyOptions();
    if (companies.length === 0) {
      this.toast.info('Falta una organización', 'Registra una organización antes de crear áreas.');
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openArea({
      companies,
      areas: this.referenceAreas(),
    });

    if (result.saved) this.refreshAreas(true);
  }

  async editArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canUseReferences()) return;

    const result = await this.formModal.openArea(
      { companies: this.companyOptions(), areas: this.referenceAreas() },
      area,
    );

    if (result.saved) this.refreshAreas(false);
  }

  async disableArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disablingAreaId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar área',
      message: 'También se deshabilitarán sus subáreas y se cerrarán sus asignaciones activas.',
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 300,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.disablingAreaId.set(area.areaId);
    this.disableAreaUseCase
      .execute(area.areaId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingAreaId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Área deshabilitada');
          this.refreshAreas(false);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el área', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private canUseReferences(): boolean {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) return false;
    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  private ensureHierarchyOrganization(): void {
    const current = this.areaCompanyFilter();
    const active = this.referenceOrganizations().filter((company) => company.estado);
    if (!active.some((company) => company.empresaId === current)) {
      this.areaCompanyFilter.set(active[0]?.empresaId ?? null);
    }
  }

  private refreshOrganizations(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  private refreshAreas(firstPage: boolean): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadAreas(firstPage ? 1 : this.areas().page);
  }
}

          <h2>{{ mode() === 'create' ? 'Registrar producto' : 'Versionar precio' }}</h2>

        </div>

          <label>Código</label>

          <app-form-error

            fieldLabel="El código"
            [messages]="{ blank: 'El código no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Unidad de medida</label>
          <input class="admin-input" formControlName="unidadMedida" maxlength="40" placeholder="UND, KG, L..." />

          <label>Nombre</label>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2 product-current">

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Precio</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" formControlName="precio" />
          <app-form-error [control]="priceForm.controls.precio" fieldLabel="El precio" />

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Moneda</label>

          </select>

    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>

import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCoins,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(60)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    unidadMedida: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)],
    ],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    alcance: ['UOT' as 'UOT' | 'GLOBAL'],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      unidadMedida: '',
      categoria: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(item: ResourceProductResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      alcance: 'UOT',
      precio: item.precioVenta ?? 0,
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'price') {
      this.savePrice();
      return;
    }
    this.saveProduct();
  }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .createProduct({
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
        categoria: normalizeOptionalText(raw.categoria),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Producto registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!product?.productoId || this.priceForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .versionProductPrice(product.productoId, {
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        uotPrecioId: raw.alcance === 'UOT' ? Number(raw.uotContextoId) : undefined,
        precio: Number(raw.precio),
        moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Nueva versión de precio registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
  }
}

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCoins,
  faImage,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTags,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    LocalFilePanelComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './productos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly selectedForImages = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faTags;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.products();
    return this.products().filter((item) =>
      [item.codigo, item.nombre, item.categoria, item.unidadMedida].some(
        (value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query),
      ),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .listProducts(unitId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.products.set(items);
          const selectedId = this.selectedForImages()?.productoId;
          if (selectedId) {
            this.selectedForImages.set(
              items.find((item) => item.productoId === selectedId) ?? null,
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.selectedForImages.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async price(item: ResourceProductResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  selectImages(item: ResourceProductResponse): void {
    this.selectedForImages.set(
      this.selectedForImages()?.productoId === item.productoId ? null : item,
    );
  }

  imageIds(item: ResourceProductResponse): readonly number[] {
    return item.archivoPrincipalId ? [item.archivoPrincipalId] : [];
  }

  selectedUnitId(): number {
    return (
      this.unitFilter() ??
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0
    );
  }
}

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBuildingCircleCheck, faGlobe } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-context-switcher',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-context-switcher.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-context-switcher.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotContextSwitcherComponent {
  @Input() compact = false;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly changing = signal(false);
  readonly unitIcon = faBuildingCircleCheck;
  readonly generalIcon = faGlobe;

  readonly value = computed(() =>
    this.store.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? 'GENERAL'
      : String(this.store.selectedId() ?? ''),
  );

  readonly disabled = computed(
    () =>
      this.changing() ||
      (!this.store.canUseGeneral() && this.store.memberships().length <= 1),
  );

  change(raw: string): void {
    if (this.changing() || !raw) return;

    const current = this.value();
    if (raw === current) return;

    const general = raw === 'GENERAL';
    const parsedUotId = Number(raw);

    if (!general && (!Number.isFinite(parsedUotId) || parsedUotId <= 0)) {
      return;
    }

    this.changing.set(true);

    this.api
      .selectContext(
        general ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA',
        general ? null : parsedUotId,
      )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.changing.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            general
              ? 'Vista general activada'
              : 'Unidad de trabajo actualizada',
          );
          void this.router.navigateByUrl('/inicio');
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo cambiar la UOT',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}

      @if (detail(); as employee) {

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">

              <p>Roles</p>

          <div class="admin-chip-list">
            @for (role of employee.roles; track role.rolId) {

              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="admin-empty-copy">Sin roles asignados.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faBuilding,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faIdCard,
  faPen,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadoDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly employeeId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly identityIcon = faIdCard;
  readonly organizationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly accountIcon = faShieldHalved;

  readonly fullName = computed(() => {
    const value = this.detail();

    return value
      ? [value.nombres, value.apellidoPaterno, value.apellidoMaterno]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      : 'Empleado';
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.employeeId) || this.employeeId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El empleado solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.employeeId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.organizationsUseCase.areas(page, size))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (areas) => this.areas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado)),
        error: (error) => {
          this.areas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  uotName(): string {
    return this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open(
      { areas: this.areas() },
      employee,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.retiring()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName()}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiring.set(true);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}

```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Empleados</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar empleado' : 'Registrar empleado' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Identificación</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocumentType">Tipo de documento</label>
        <select
          id="employeeDocumentType"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="tipoDocumento"
          (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()"
        >
          @for (item of documentTypes; track item.value) {
            <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeDocument">Número de documento</label>
        <div class="identity-document-control">
          <input
            id="employeeDocument"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading() || !!current()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />

          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="identity-search-button"
              [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()"
              [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
              (click)="resolveIdentity()"
            >
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                Buscando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                Buscar
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El número de documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            ruc: 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.',
            rucNature: 'Para una persona se requiere un RUC personal válido.',
            blank: 'El número de documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
        @if (!shouldResolveIdentity()) {
          <small class="identity-help">
            DNI y RUC permiten completar automáticamente los datos disponibles. Los demás documentos se completan manualmente.
          </small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      @if (canToggleIdentityEditing()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              [checked]="identityEditingEnabled()"
              (change)="toggleIdentityEditing($any($event.target).checked)"
            />
            Editar datos de la persona
          </label>
          <small>El número de documento no se puede modificar.</small>
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="employeeNames" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="nombres" maxlength="100" autocomplete="given-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('names')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('nombres')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.', personName: 'Los nombres solo pueden contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeLastName">Apellido paterno</label>
        <input id="employeeLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoPaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="family-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('paternalSurname')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('apellidoPaterno')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoPaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido paterno" [messages]="{ blank: 'El apellido paterno no puede contener solo espacios.', personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeSecondLastName">Apellido materno</label>
        <input id="employeeSecondLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoMaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="additional-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('maternalSurname')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('apellidoMaterno')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoMaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido materno" [messages]="{ personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeBirthDate">Fecha de nacimiento</label>
        <input id="employeeBirthDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaNacimiento" [min]="minBirthDate" [max]="maxBirthDate" autocomplete="bday" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('birthDate')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaNacimiento" fieldLabel="La fecha de nacimiento" [messages]="{ underage: 'La persona debe ser mayor de edad.', ageOutOfRange: 'La fecha de nacimiento está fuera del rango permitido.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
      </div>

      @if (resolvedSex()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeSex">Sexo</label>
          <input id="employeeSex" class="admin-input" type="text" [value]="resolvedSex()" readonly aria-readonly="true" />
        </div>
      }


      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeePhone">Teléfono</label>
        <input id="employeePhone" class="admin-input" type="tel" inputmode="tel" formControlName="telefono" maxlength="16" autocomplete="tel" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('phone')" (input)="onPhoneInput()" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.telefono" fieldLabel="El teléfono" [messages]="{ phone: 'Ingrese un teléfono válido de 7 a 15 dígitos.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="employeeEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" formControlName="correo" maxlength="180" autocomplete="email" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('email')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Ubicación de la persona</span>
      </div>

      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        [locationLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="employeeReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="employeeReference" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('reference')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Información laboral</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeUot">UOT</label>
        <input id="employeeUot" class="admin-input" type="text" [value]="uotLabel()" readonly />
        <small>El empleado será adscrito a esta UOT.</small>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEntryDate">Fecha de ingreso</label>
        <input id="employeeEntryDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaIngreso" [min]="minimumEntryDate()" [max]="today" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaIngreso" fieldLabel="La fecha de ingreso" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de ingreso no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
        @if (form.hasError('entryBeforeAdult')) {
          <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de ingreso no puede ser anterior a la mayoría de edad de la persona.</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeArea">Área</label>
        <select id="employeeArea" class="admin-select" formControlName="areaId" (change)="onAreaChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Sin área asignada</option>
          @for (area of availableAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeRoleName">
          Cargo
          @if (form.controls.areaId.value > 0) { <span aria-hidden="true">*</span> }
        </label>
        <input id="employeeRoleName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="cargo" maxlength="120" placeholder="Cargo o función" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.cargo" fieldLabel="El cargo" [messages]="{ blank: 'El cargo no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      @if (current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeAreaDate">Fecha de asignación de área</label>
          <input id="employeeAreaDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAsignacionArea" [min]="form.controls.fechaIngreso.value || null" [max]="today" />
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAsignacionArea" fieldLabel="La fecha de asignación" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de asignación no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
          @if (form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
            <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de asignación de área no puede ser anterior a la fecha de ingreso.</small>
          }
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```
