```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Empresas, asociaciones y áreas"
    [subtitle]="hasSpecificUot() ? 'Datos exclusivos de ' + uotName() : 'Selecciona una UOT para administrar sus datos.'"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  />

  @if (!hasSpecificUot()) {
    <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
      <app-empty-state
        title="Selecciona una UOT"
        message="Las empresas, asociaciones y áreas se consultan y administran por UOT. Usa el selector de UOT de la cabecera."
      />
    </section>
  } @else {
    <div class="admin-tabs mt-5">
      <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'organizations'" (click)="setTab('organizations')">
        <fa-icon [icon]="companyIcon" /> Organizaciones
      </button>
      <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'areas'" (click)="setTab('areas')">
        <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" /> Áreas
      </button>
    </div>

    @if (activeTab() === 'organizations') {
      <section class="admin-surface">
        <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end">
          <span class="admin-muted-badge">UOT: {{ uotName() }}</span>
          <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="organizationsLoading()" (click)="loadOrganizations()">
            @if (organizationsLoading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
            @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }
            Actualizar
          </button>
          <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="createCompany()">
            <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Nueva empresa
          </button>
          <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="createAssociation()">
            <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" /> Nueva asociación
          </button>
        </div>

        @if (organizationsLoading()) {
          <app-loading-state title="Cargando organizaciones" [message]="'Consultando contratos de ' + uotName() + '.'" />
        } @else if (organizationsError()) {
          <app-error-state [message]="organizationsError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadOrganizations()" />
        } @else if (organizations().items.length === 0) {
          <app-empty-state title="Sin organizaciones" [message]="'No hay empresas o asociaciones vinculadas a ' + uotName() + '.'" />
        } @else {
          <div class="admin-table-wrap">
            <table class="admin-table">
              <thead><tr><th>Organización</th><th>RUC</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Contacto</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                @for (company of organizations().items; track company.empresaId) {
                  <tr>
                    <td><div class="admin-entity"><span class="admin-entity-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="company.esAsociacion ? associationIcon : companyIcon" /></span><div><strong>{{ company.razonSocial }}</strong><span>{{ company.nombreComercial || 'Sin nombre comercial' }}</span></div></div></td>
                    <td><span class="admin-code">{{ company.ruc }}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="admin-type-badge">{{ company.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}</span></td>
                    <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ company.correo || '—' }}</strong><span>{{ company.telefono || '—' }}</span></div></td>
                    <td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="company.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!company.estado">{{ company.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}</span></td>
                    <td><div class="admin-row-actions">
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver detalle" [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId || disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="viewOrganization(company)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId || disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="editOrganization(company)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Retirar de esta UOT" [disabled]="disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="disableOrganization(company)"><fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" /></button>
                    </div></td>

          </div>
          <app-paginator [page]="organizations().page" [size]="organizations().size" [totalRecords]="organizations().totalRecords" [totalPages]="organizations().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadOrganizations($event, organizations().size)" (sizeChange)="loadOrganizations(1, $event)" />
        }
      </section>
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface area-workspace">
        <div class="area-workspace__toolbar">
          <div class="area-workspace__filter admin-field">
            <label>UOT</label>
            <input class="admin-input" [value]="uotName()" readonly />
          </div>
          <div class="area-view-switch" role="group" aria-label="Vista de áreas">
            <button type="button" [class.active]="areaView() === 'hierarchy'" (click)="setAreaView('hierarchy')"><fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" /> Jerarquía</button>
            <button type="button" [class.active]="areaView() === 'table'" (click)="setAreaView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /> Tabla</button>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-toolbar-actions">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="areasLoading() || referencesLoading()" (click)="loadReferences(); loadAreas()"><fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button>
            <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading() || referencesError() !== null" (click)="createArea()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Nueva área</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        @if (referencesLoading() && areaView() === 'hierarchy') {
          <app-loading-state title="Cargando estructura" [message]="'Consultando áreas de ' + uotName() + '.'" />
        } @else if (referencesError()) {
          <app-error-state [message]="referencesError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadReferences()" />
        } @else if (areaView() === 'hierarchy') {
          <div class="area-hierarchy-heading">
            <div><span>Mapa de áreas</span><strong>{{ uotName() }}</strong></div>
            <small>Las áreas pertenecen a la UOT, no a las empresas o asociaciones contratadas.</small>
          </div>
          <app-area-hierarchy [companyName]="uotName()" [companyRuc]="null" [areas]="hierarchyAreas()" />
        } @else {
          @if (areasLoading()) {
            <app-loading-state title="Cargando áreas" message="Consultando la estructura de la UOT." />
          } @else if (areasError()) {
            <app-error-state [message]="areasError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadAreas()" />
          } @else if (areas().items.length === 0) {
            <app-empty-state title="Sin áreas" [message]="'No hay áreas registradas en ' + uotName() + '.'" />
          } @else {
            <div class="admin-table-wrap">
              <table class="admin-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Área</th><th>UOT</th><th>Área superior</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  @for (area of areas().items; track area.areaId) {
                    <tr>
                      <td><span class="admin-code">{{ area.codigo }}</span></td>
                      <td class="admin-table-primary">{{ area.nombre }}</td>
                      <td>{{ uotName() }}</td>
                      <td>{{ area.areaPadre || 'Área principal' }}</td>
                      <td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="area.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!area.estado">{{ area.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}</span></td>
                      <td><div class="admin-row-actions">
                        <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar área" [disabled]="disablingAreaId() !== null" (click)="editArea(area)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                        <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Deshabilitar área" [disabled]="disablingAreaId() !== null" (click)="disableArea(area)"><fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" /></button>
                      </div></td>
                    </tr>
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <app-paginator [page]="areas().page" [size]="areas().size" [totalRecords]="areas().totalRecords" [totalPages]="areas().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAreas($event, areas().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAreas(1, $event)" />
          }
        }
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-organizacion-form />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faBuilding,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
  faTable,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { DeshabilitarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-area.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarOrganizacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-organizacion.use-case';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';
import { AreaHierarchyComponent } from '../../components/area-hierarchy/area-hierarchy';
import { OrganizacionFormComponent } from '../organizacion-form/organizacion-form';

type OrganizationTab = 'organizations' | 'areas';
type AreaView = 'hierarchy' | 'table';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizaciones-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AreaHierarchyComponent,
    OrganizacionFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizaciones-list.html',
  styleUrl: './organizaciones-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(OrganizacionFormComponent)
  private formModal!: OrganizacionFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly disableOrganizationUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarOrganizacionUseCase);
  private readonly disableAreaUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly activeTab = signal<OrganizationTab>('organizations');
  readonly areaView = signal<AreaView>('hierarchy');
  readonly organizationsLoading = signal(false);
  readonly areasLoading = signal(false);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly disablingOrganizationId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly disablingAreaId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly organizationsError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly areasError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referenceAreas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly organizations = signal<PageResult<Empresa>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly areas = signal<PageResult<Area>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly pageIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly tableIcon = faTable;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly hasSpecificUot = computed(
    () => this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' && (this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0) > 0,
  );
  readonly uotName = computed(() => this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada');
  readonly hierarchyAreas = computed(() =>
    this.referenceAreas().filter((area) => area.estado),
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (!this.hasSpecificUot()) return;
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  setTab(tab: OrganizationTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  setAreaView(view: AreaView): void {
    this.areaView.set(view);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    if (!this.hasSpecificUot()) return;
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.listUseCase.areas(page, size))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.referenceAreas.set(items.filter((area) => area.estado)),
        error: (error) => {
          this.referenceAreas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  loadOrganizations(
    page = this.organizations().page,
    size = this.organizations().size,
  ): void {
    if (!this.hasSpecificUot()) return;
    this.organizationsLoading.set(true);
    this.organizationsError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.organizationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.organizations.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.organizationsError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadAreas(
    page = this.areas().page,
    size = this.areas().size,
  ): void {
    if (!this.hasSpecificUot()) return;
    this.areasLoading.set(true);
    this.areasError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .areas(page, size)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.areasLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.areas.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.areasError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createCompany(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot()) return;
    const result = await this.formModal.openCompany();
    if (result.saved) this.refreshOrganizations();
  }

  async createAssociation(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot()) return;
    const result = await this.formModal.openAssociation();
    if (result.saved) this.refreshOrganizations();
  }

  editOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot() || this.detailLoadingId()) return;
    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase.detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.openOrganizationEditor(detail),
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo abrir la organización', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private async openOrganizationEditor(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<void> {
    const result = detail.organizacion.esAsociacion
      ? await this.formModal.openAssociation(detail)
      : await this.formModal.openCompany(detail);
    if (result.saved) this.refreshOrganizations();
  }

  viewOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot() || this.detailLoadingId()) return;
    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase.detail(company.empresaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.formModal.openView(detail),
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo abrir la organización', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async disableOrganization(company: Empresa): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot() || this.disablingOrganizationId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: company.esAsociacion ? 'Retirar asociación de la UOT' : 'Retirar empresa de la UOT',
      message: `Se retirará el vínculo de ${company.razonSocial} con ${this.uotName()}. El historial se conservará.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 300,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.disablingOrganizationId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.disableOrganizationUseCase.execute(company.empresaId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingOrganizationId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Organización retirada de la UOT');
          this.refreshOrganizations();
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo retirar la organización', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createArea(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot() || !this.canUseReferences()) return;
    const result = await this.formModal.openArea({ areas: this.referenceAreas() });
    if (result.saved) this.refreshAreas(true);
  }

  async editArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot() || !this.canUseReferences()) return;
    const result = await this.formModal.openArea({ areas: this.referenceAreas() }, area);
    if (result.saved) this.refreshAreas(false);
  }

  async disableArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.requireSpecificUot() || this.disablingAreaId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar área',
      message: 'También se cerrarán sus subáreas y asignaciones activas dentro de esta UOT.',
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 300,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.disablingAreaId.set(area.areaId);
    this.disableAreaUseCase.execute(area.areaId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingAreaId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Área deshabilitada');
          this.refreshAreas(false);
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el área', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private requireSpecificUot(): boolean {
    if (this.hasSpecificUot()) return true;
    this.toast.info('Selecciona una UOT', 'Esta operación requiere trabajar dentro de una UOT específica.');
    return false;
  }

  private canUseReferences(): boolean {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) return false;
    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las áreas', this.referencesError()!);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  private refreshOrganizations(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }

  private refreshAreas(firstPage: boolean): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadAreas(firstPage ? 1 : this.areas().page);
  }
}
```

```typescript
        false,
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { Area } from '../../../domain/area.model';
import {
  Empresa,
  OrganizacionDetalle,
  OrganizacionEmpleado,
} from '../../../domain/empresa.model';

@Injectable()
export class OrganizacionesHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  organizationsPage(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.company(row), size);
  }

  areasPage(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.area(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): OrganizacionDetalle {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));

    return {
      organizacion: this.company(this.api.record(raw['organizacion'])),
      distritoCodigo: this.api.string(raw['distritoCodigo']),
      distritoNombre: this.api.nullableString(raw['distritoNombre']),
      centroPobladoId: this.api.nullableNumber(raw['centroPobladoId']),
      centroPobladoNombre: this.api.nullableString(raw['centroPobladoNombre']),
      referencia: this.api.nullableString(raw['referencia']),
      altitudM: this.api.nullableNumber(raw['altitudM']),
      posicionWkt: this.api.nullableString(raw['posicionWkt']),
      posicionSrid: this.api.nullableNumber(raw['posicionSrid']),
      areas: this.api
        .array(raw['areas'])
        .map((item) => this.area(this.api.record(item))),
      empleados: this.api
        .array(raw['empleados'])
        .map((item) => this.employee(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(raw['id']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private company(row: Record<string, unknown>): Empresa {
    return {
      empresaId: this.api.number(row['empresaId']),
      ruc: this.api.string(row['ruc']),
      razonSocial: this.api.string(row['razonSocial']),
      nombreComercial: this.api.nullableString(row['nombreComercial']),
      telefono: this.api.nullableString(row['telefono']),
      correo: this.api.nullableString(row['correo']),
      fechaCreacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCreacion']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      esAsociacion: this.api.boolean(row['esAsociacion']),
      fechaConstitucion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaConstitucion']),
      numeroPartida: this.api.nullableString(row['numeroPartida']),
    };
  }

  private area(row: Record<string, unknown>): Area {
    return {
      areaId: this.api.number(row['areaId']),
      empresaId: this.api.number(row['empresaId']),
      empresa: this.api.string(row['empresa']),
      areaPadreId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['areaPadreId']),
      areaPadre: this.api.nullableString(row['areaPadre']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
    };
  }

  private employee(row: Record<string, unknown>): OrganizacionEmpleado {
    return {
      empleadoId: this.api.number(row['empleadoId']),
      codigoEmpleado: this.api.nullableString(row['codigoEmpleado']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.nullableString(row['numeroDocumento']),
      empleado: this.api.string(row['empleado']),
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faEye,
  faFilter,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceAssetResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inventario-vehiculos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InventarioVehiculosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private form!: RecursoFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly assets = signal<readonly ResourceAssetResponse[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly filterIcon = faFilter;
  readonly incidentIcon = faTriangleExclamation;

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    const state = this.stateFilter().trim().toUpperCase();

    return this.assets().filter((item) => {
      if (state && (item.estadoBien ?? '').toUpperCase() !== state) return false;
      if (!query) return true;
      return [
        item.codigoPatrimonial,
        item.nombre,
        item.marca,
        item.modelo,
        item.serie,
        item.tipoBien,
        item.uotNombre,
      ].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query));
    });
  });

  readonly availableUnits = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const selected = this.uot.selectedId();
    this.unitFilter.set(selected);
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .listAssets(unitId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.assets.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async edit(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openEdit(item);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  stateLabel(value?: string): string {
    return (value ?? 'SIN ESTADO').replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }

  stateClass(value?: string): string {
    const normalized = (value ?? '').toUpperCase();
    if (normalized === 'DISPONIBLE') return 'resource-status resource-status--ok';
    if (normalized === 'BAJA' || normalized === 'INACTIVO') {
      return 'resource-status resource-status--muted';
    }
    if (
      normalized === 'AVERIADO' ||
      normalized === 'MANTENIMIENTO' ||
      normalized === 'NO_DISPONIBLE'
    ) {
      return 'resource-status resource-status--warning';
    }
    return 'resource-status resource-status--info';
  }
}
```

```typescript
  ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum,
} from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetIncidentRequest';
import { ResourceAssetResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetResponse';
import {
  ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum,
} from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetStateChangeRequest';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  localDateTimeInputNow,
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import {
  AdminModalResult,
  AdminSelectOption,
} from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ResourceFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'state' | 'incident';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurso-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './recurso-form.html',
  styleUrl: './recurso-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly listOrganizations = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ResourceFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ResourceAssetResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly assetTypes = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly organizations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly stateIcon = faRotate;
  readonly incidentIcon = faTriangleExclamation;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  readonly states = [
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible, label: 'Disponible' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Asignado, label: 'Asignado' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Mantenimiento, label: 'Mantenimiento' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Averiado, label: 'Averiado' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.NoDisponible, label: 'No disponible' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Inactivo, label: 'Inactivo' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Baja, label: 'Baja' },
  ] as const;

  readonly incidentTypes = [
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia, label: 'Avería' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Accidente, label: 'Accidente' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Perdida, label: 'Pérdida' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Robo, label: 'Robo' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Mantenimiento, label: 'Mantenimiento' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

  private resolver: ((value: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoBienId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigoPatrimonial: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(80)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    marca: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    modelo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    serie: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    fechaAdquisicion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    montoAdquisicion: [0, [Validators.min(0), Validators.max(999999999999)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
    proveedorEmpresaId: [0],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly stateForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    estado: [
      ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,
      [Validators.required],
    ],
    motivo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly incidentForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipo: [ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia, [Validators.required]],
    fechaHora: [localDateTimeInputNow(), [Validators.required]],
    descripcion: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(1000)],
    ],
    costoEstimado: [0, [Validators.min(0), Validators.max(999999999999)]],
  });

  openCreate(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('create');
    const selected = this.uot.selectedId();
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: selected ?? 0,
      tipoBienId: 0,
      codigoPatrimonial: '',
      nombre: '',
      marca: '',
      modelo: '',
      serie: '',
      fechaAdquisicion: '',
      montoAdquisicion: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: 0,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: item.uotId ?? 0,
      tipoBienId: item.tipoBienId ?? 0,
      codigoPatrimonial: item.codigoPatrimonial ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      marca: item.marca ?? '',
      modelo: item.modelo ?? '',
      serie: item.serie ?? '',
      fechaAdquisicion: item.fechaAdquisicion ?? '',
      montoAdquisicion: item.montoAdquisicion ?? 0,
      moneda: item.monedaAdquisicion ?? 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: item.proveedorEmpresaId ?? 0,
      observacion: item.observacion ?? '',
    });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  openState(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('state');
    this.current.set(item);
    const valid = this.states.find((state) => state.value === item.estadoBien);
    this.stateForm.reset({
      estado: valid?.value ?? ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,
      motivo: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openIncident(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('incident');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.incidentForm.reset({
      tipo: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia,
      fechaHora: localDateTimeInputNow(),
      descripcion: '',
      costoEstimado: 0,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'state') {
      this.saveState();
      return;
    }
    if (this.mode() === 'incident') {
      this.saveIncident();
      return;
    }
    this.saveAsset();
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'edit':
        return 'Editar bien';
      case 'state':
        return 'Cambiar estado';
      case 'incident':
        return 'Registrar incidencia';
      default:
        return 'Registrar bien';
    }
  }

  private saveAsset(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const amount = Number(raw.montoAdquisicion);
    const providerId = Number(raw.proveedorEmpresaId);

    const common = {
      tipoBienId: Number(raw.tipoBienId),
      nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
      marca: normalizeOptionalText(raw.marca),
      modelo: normalizeOptionalText(raw.modelo),
      serie: normalizeOptionalText(raw.serie),
      fechaAdquisicion: raw.fechaAdquisicion || undefined,
      montoAdquisicion: amount > 0 ? amount : undefined,
      moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: providerId > 0 ? providerId : undefined,
      observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
    };

    const operation =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.bienInventarioId
        ? this.api.updateAsset(this.current()!.bienInventarioId!, common)
        : this.api.createAsset({
            uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
            codigoPatrimonial: raw.codigoPatrimonial.trim().toUpperCase(),
            ...common,
          });

    this.run(operation, this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Bien actualizado' : 'Bien registrado');
  }

  private saveState(): void {
    const item = this.current();
    this.stateForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!item?.bienInventarioId || this.stateForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.stateForm.getRawValue();
    this.run(
      this.api.changeAssetState(item.bienInventarioId, {
        estado: raw.estado,
        motivo: normalizeOptionalText(raw.motivo),
      }),
      'Estado actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveIncident(): void {
    const item = this.current();
    this.incidentForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!item?.bienInventarioId || this.incidentForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.incidentForm.getRawValue();
    const cost = Number(raw.costoEstimado);
    const body: ResourceAssetIncidentRequest = {
      tipo: raw.tipo,
      fechaHora: raw.fechaHora,
      descripcion: normalizeText(raw.descripcion),
      costoEstimado: cost > 0 ? cost : undefined,
    };

    this.run(
      this.api.reportAssetIncident(item.bienInventarioId, body),
      'Incidencia registrada',
    );
  }

  private run(operation: Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      types: this.refs.catalog('TIPO_BIEN'),
      organizations: this.listOrganizations.execute(1, 200),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ types, organizations }) => {
          this.assetTypes.set(
            types.map((item) => ({
              value: Number(item.id),
              label: item.label,
              description: item.code,
            })),
          );
          this.organizations.set(
            organizations.items
              .filter((item) => item.estado)
              .map((item) => ({
                value: item.empresaId,
                label: item.razonSocial,
                description: item.ruc,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

    <ng-template #actions>

</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';

import {
  faCoins,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';

  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';

import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(60)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    unidadMedida: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)],
    ],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      unidadMedida: '',
      categoria: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(item: ResourceProductResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      precio: item.precioVenta ?? 0,
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });
    this.priceForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  uotLabel(): string {
    return this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'price') {
      this.savePrice();
      return;
    }
    this.saveProduct();
  }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .createProduct({
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
        categoria: normalizeOptionalText(raw.categoria),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Producto registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!product?.productoId || this.priceForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .versionProductPrice(product.productoId, {
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        uotPrecioId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        precio: Number(raw.precio),
        moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Nueva versión de precio registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
  <app-page-header
    title="Productos"
    [subtitle]="hasSpecificUot() ? 'Catálogo y precios vigentes para ' + uotName() : 'Selecciona una UOT para consultar productos y precios.'"

  @if (!hasSpecificUot()) {

        <input class="admin-input" type="search" placeholder="Código, producto, categoría..." [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" />
      </label>
    </section>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state title="Cargando productos" [message]="'Consultando precios de ' + uotName() + '.'" />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los productos.'" (retry)="load()" />
    } @else if (filtered().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin productos" message="No existen productos para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface product-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Precio vigente</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filtered(); track item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="product-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small></td>
                  <td>{{ item.categoria || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.precioVenta != null) { <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong> }
                    @else { <span class="product-help">Sin precio</span> }
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</td>
                  <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Versionar precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_LISTAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Historial de precios" (click)="toggleHistory(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Imágenes" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>

                @if (historyProduct()?.productoId === item.productoId) {
                  <tr class="product-images-row">

                              <tbody>
                                @for (price of priceHistory(); track price.productoPrecioId) {
                                  <tr>

                                    <td><strong>{{ price.moneda }} {{ price.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                                    <td>{{ price.fechaDesde || '—' }}</td>

                                    <td>{{ price.nombreUsuario || 'Sistema' }}</td>

                    </td>

</div>

<app-producto-form />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faCoins,
  faImage,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTags,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import {
  ResourceApiService,
  ResourceProductPriceHistory,
} from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    LocalFilePanelComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './productos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly selectedForImages = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);
  readonly historyProduct = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);
  readonly historyLoading = signal(false);
  readonly historyError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly priceHistory = signal<readonly ResourceProductPriceHistory[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faTags;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly hasSpecificUot = computed(
    () => this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' && (this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0) > 0,
  );
  readonly uotName = computed(() => this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada');

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.products();
    return this.products().filter((item) =>
      [item.codigo, item.nombre, item.categoria, item.unidadMedida].some(
        (value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query),
      ),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.hasSpecificUot()) this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    const uotId = this.selectedUnitId();
    if (!uotId) return;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.listProducts(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.products.set(items);
          const imageId = this.selectedForImages()?.productoId;
          if (imageId) this.selectedForImages.set(items.find((item) => item.productoId === imageId) ?? null);
          const historyId = this.historyProduct()?.productoId;
          if (historyId) this.historyProduct.set(items.find((item) => item.productoId === historyId) ?? null);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.hasSpecificUot()) return;
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async price(item: ResourceProductResponse): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.hasSpecificUot()) return;
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item);
    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
      if (this.historyProduct()?.productoId === item.productoId) this.loadHistory(item);
    }
  }

  toggleHistory(item: ResourceProductResponse): void {
    if (this.historyProduct()?.productoId === item.productoId) {
      this.historyProduct.set(null);
      this.priceHistory.set([]);
      this.historyError.set(null);
      return;
    }
    this.loadHistory(item);
  }

  loadHistory(item: ResourceProductResponse): void {
    const productId = item.productoId;
    const uotId = this.selectedUnitId();
    if (!productId || !uotId) return;

    this.historyProduct.set(item);
    this.historyLoading.set(true);
    this.historyError.set(null);
    this.priceHistory.set([]);

    this.api.listProductPriceHistory(productId, uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.historyLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.priceHistory.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.historyError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  selectImages(item: ResourceProductResponse): void {
    this.selectedForImages.set(
      this.selectedForImages()?.productoId === item.productoId ? null : item,
    );
  }

  imageIds(item: ResourceProductResponse): readonly number[] {
    return item.archivoPrincipalId ? [item.archivoPrincipalId] : [];
  }

  selectedUnitId(): number {
    return this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;
  }
}
```

```html
  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end">
      <label class="admin-switch-row uot-inactive-switch">
        <span>
          <strong>Mostrar inactivas</strong>
          <small>Incluye unidades cerradas o deshabilitadas.</small>
        </span>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="admin-switch-control"
          [checked]="showInactive()"
          (change)="toggleInactive($any($event.target).checked)"
        />
      </label>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando UOT"
        message="Consultando la jerarquía autorizada."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'No se pudo cargar la información.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (units().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin unidades"
        message="No existen UOT visibles para tu contexto."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>UOT</th>
              <th>Superior</th>
              <th class="text-center">Asignación</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ unit.nombre }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ unit.codigo }} · #{{ unit.uotId }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{{ parentName(unit) }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  @if (unit.predeterminada) {
                    <span class="admin-status admin-status--info">Predeterminada</span>
                  } @else if (unit.asignada) {
                    <span class="admin-status admin-status--active">Asignada</span>
                  } @else {
                    <span class="admin-status">No asignada</span>
                  }
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="unit.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!unit.estado"
                  >
                    {{ unit.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'UOT_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar UOT"
                      (click)="edit(unit)"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'UOT_ADMINISTRAR_ACCESOS'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Asignar acceso y rol"
                      [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
                      (click)="access(unit)"
                    >
                      @if (referencesLoading()) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="accessIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-uot-form />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faKey,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../administracion/roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { ListarUsuariosUseCase } from '../../../../../../administracion/usuarios/application/use-case/listar-usuarios.use-case';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotUnit } from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';
import {
  UotFormComponent,
  UotFormOptions,
} from '../uot-form/uot-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-admin-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UotFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './uot-admin.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-admin.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotAdminPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UotFormComponent) private form!: UotFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly listUsers = inject(ListarUsuariosUseCase);
  private readonly listRoles = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly users = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly showInactive = signal(false);

  readonly pageIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly accessIcon = faKey;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
    this.loadReferences();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .list(this.showInactive())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.units.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      users: this.listUsers.execute({ page: 1, size: 200 }),
      roles: this.listRoles.execute(1, 200),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ users, roles }) => {
          this.users.set(
            users.items.map((item) => ({
              value: item.usuarioId,
              label:
                item.empleado?.trim() ||
                item.nombreUsuario ||
                `Usuario ${item.usuarioId}`,
              description: item.nombreUsuario,
            })),
          );
          this.roles.set(
            roles.items
              .filter((item) => item.estado)
              .map((item) => ({
                value: item.rolId,
                label: item.nombre,
                description: item.codigo,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.users.set([]);
          this.roles.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async edit(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openEdit(unit, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async access(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openAccess(unit, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  toggleInactive(value: boolean): void {
    this.showInactive.set(value);
    this.load();
  }

  parentName(unit: UotUnit): string {
    if (!unit.uotPadreId) return 'Raíz';
    return (
      this.units().find((item) => item.uotId === unit.uotPadreId)?.nombre ??
      `UOT #${unit.uotPadreId}`
    );
  }

  private options(): UotFormOptions {
    return {
      units: this.units(),
      users: this.users(),
      roles: this.roles(),
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faKey,
  faPen,
  faSitemap,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { Observable, concatMap, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  AdminModalResult,
  AdminSelectOption,
} from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotUnit } from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';

type UotFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'access';

export interface UotFormOptions {
  units: readonly UotUnit[];
  users?: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  roles?: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-form.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly mode = signal<UotFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<UotUnit | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly users = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly accessIcon = faKey;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  private resolver: ((value: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly unitForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotPadreId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ubicacionId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    estado: [true],
  });

  readonly accessForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    usuarioId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    rolId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    predeterminada: [false],
  });

  openCreate(options: UotFormOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    const parent =
      options.units.find((item) => item.esRaiz && item.estado) ??
      options.units.find((item) => item.estado) ??
      null;

    this.unitForm.reset({
      uotPadreId: parent?.uotId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      estado: true,
    });
    this.unitForm.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(
    unit: UotUnit,
    options: UotFormOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('edit', options, unit);
    this.unitForm.reset({
      uotPadreId: unit.uotPadreId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: unit.ubicacionId ?? 0,
      codigo: unit.codigo,
      nombre: unit.nombre,
      descripcion: unit.descripcion ?? '',
      estado: unit.estado,
    });
    this.unitForm.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openAccess(
    unit: UotUnit,
    options: UotFormOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('access', options, unit);
    this.accessForm.reset({
      usuarioId: options.users?.[0]?.value ?? 0,
      rolId: options.roles?.[0]?.value ?? 0,
      predeterminada: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'access') return 'Asignar acceso UOT';
    return this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Editar UOT' : 'Registrar UOT';
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.saving()) return;

    if (this.mode() === 'access') {
      this.saveAccess();
      return;
    }

    this.saveUnit();
  }

  parentOptions(): readonly UotUnit[] {
    const currentId = this.current()?.uotId ?? null;
    return this.units().filter(
      (item) => item.estado && item.uotId !== currentId,
    );
  }

  private saveUnit(): void {
    this.unitForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.unitForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.unitForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.current();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.api.update(current.uotId, {
          uotPadreId:
            Number(raw.uotPadreId) > 0 ? Number(raw.uotPadreId) : undefined,
          ubicacionId:
            Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
          estado: raw.estado,
        })
      : this.api.create({
          uotPadreId: Number(raw.uotPadreId),
          ubicacionId:
            Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
          codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'UOT actualizada' : 'UOT registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo guardar la UOT', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private saveAccess(): void {
    this.accessForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const unit = this.current();

    if (this.accessForm.invalid || !unit) return;

    const raw = this.accessForm.getRawValue();
    const usuarioId = Number(raw.usuarioId);
    const rolId = Number(raw.rolId);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .assignUser(unit.uotId, {
        usuarioId,
        predeterminada: raw.predeterminada,
      })
      .pipe(
        concatMap(() =>
          this.api.assignRole(unit.uotId, {
            usuarioId,
            rolId,
          }),
        ),
        finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Acceso UOT asignado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo asignar el acceso', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: UotFormMode,
    options: UotFormOptions,
    current: UotUnit | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.current.set(current);
    this.units.set(options.units);
    this.users.set(options.users ?? []);
    this.roles.set(options.roles ?? []);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```
