```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map, switchMap, tap } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { UOTService } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/uOT.service';
import { UotAssignRoleRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotAssignRoleRequest';
import { UotAssignUserRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotAssignUserRequest';
import { UotCreateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotCreateRequest';
import {
  UotSelectContextRequest,
  UotSelectContextRequestModoEnum,
} from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotSelectContextRequest';
import { UotUpdateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotUpdateRequest';
import { UotContextResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotContextResponse';
import { UotUnitResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotUnitResponse';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from '../../../../acceso/application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';
import { UotContext, UotMode, UotUnit } from '../../../domain/uot.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UotApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(UOTService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);
  private readonly accessContext = inject(ObtenerContextoActualUseCase);
  private readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);

  loadContext() {
    return this.api
      .uotContexto({}, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map((response) => this.mapContext(unwrapApiResponse<UotContextResponse>(response))),
        tap((context) => this.store.set(context)),
      );
  }

  selectContext(mode: UotMode, uotId?: number | null) {
    const body: UotSelectContextRequest = {
      modo:
        mode === 'GENERAL'
          ? UotSelectContextRequestModoEnum.General
          : UotSelectContextRequestModoEnum.Especifica,
      uotId: mode === 'ESPECIFICA' ? uotId ?? undefined : undefined,
    };

    return this.api
      .uotSeleccionarContexto(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotSelectContextRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => this.mapContext(unwrapApiResponse<UotContextResponse>(response))),
        tap((context) => this.store.set(context)),
        switchMap((context) =>
          this.accessContext.execute().pipe(map(() => context)),
        ),
      );
  }

  list(includeInactive = false, uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .uotListar(
        { incluirInactivas: includeInactive, uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          (unwrapApiResponse<UotUnitResponse[]>(response) ?? []).map((item) =>
            this.mapUnit(item),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  create(body: UotCreateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotCreateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  update(uotId: number, body: UotUpdateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotEditar(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotUpdateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  assignUser(uotId: number, body: UotAssignUserRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotAsignarUsuario(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotAssignUserRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  assignRole(uotId: number, body: UotAssignRoleRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotAsignarRol(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotAssignRoleRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  private mapContext(value: UotContextResponse | undefined): UotContext {
    const uots = (value?.uots ?? [])
      .filter((item) => Number(item.uotId) > 0)
      .map((item) => ({
        usuarioUotId: item.usuarioUotId ?? null,
        uotId: Number(item.uotId),
        codigo: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
        nombre: item.nombre?.trim() || `UOT ${item.uotId}`,
        predeterminada: item.predeterminada === true,
        roles: [...(item.roles ?? [])],
      }));

    const selected = Number(value?.uotSeleccionadaId);
    const mode: UotMode = value?.modo === 'GENERAL' ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA';

    return {
      modo: mode,
      uotSeleccionadaId:
        Number.isFinite(selected) && selected > 0 ? selected : null,
      requiereSeleccion: value?.requiereSeleccion === true,
      permiteModoGeneral: value?.permiteModoGeneral === true,
      uots,
    };
  }

  private mapUnit(value: UotUnitResponse): UotUnit {
    return {
      uotId: Number(value.uotId ?? 0),
      uotPadreId: value.uotPadreId ?? null,
      ubicacionId: value.ubicacionId ?? null,
      codigo: value.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
      nombre: value.nombre?.trim() ?? '',
      descripcion: value.descripcion?.trim() || null,
      esRaiz: value.esRaiz === true,
      fechaInicio: value.fechaInicio ?? null,
      fechaFin: value.fechaFin ?? null,
      estado: value.estado !== false,
      asignada: value.asignada === true,
      predeterminada: value.predeterminada === true,
    };
  }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260913_195840_678065\src\app\features\recursos\inventario-vehiculos\adapter\in\ui\pages\suministro-form\suministro-form.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';

type SupplyFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'movement';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-suministro-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './suministro-form.html',
  styleUrl: './suministro-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SuministroFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<SupplyFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoMovimiento: ['ENTRADA', [Validators.required]],
    cantidad: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      unidadMedida: 'UND',
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
    });

    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.uotId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      codigo: item.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      unidadMedida: item.unidadMedida ?? 'UND',
      stockInicial: Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0),
      stockMinimo: Number(item.stockMinimo ?? 0),
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('movement');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      tipoMovimiento: 'ENTRADA',
      cantidad: 0,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.movementForm.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return 'Editar suministro';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar suministro';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return this.editIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.addIcon;
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveSupply();
    }
  }

  private saveSupply(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const uotId = Number(raw.uotId);
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.suministroId
        ? this.api.update(Number(this.current()!.suministroId), {
            uotId,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          })
        : this.api.create({
            uotId,
            codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Suministro actualizado' : 'Suministro registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    const supply = this.current();
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!supply?.suministroId || this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .registerMovement(Number(supply.suministroId), {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        tipoMovimiento: raw.tipoMovimiento,
        cantidad: Number(raw.cantidad),
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Movimiento registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
          <label>UOT propietaria</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Ubicación registrada (opcional)</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" formControlName="ubicacionId" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Código</label>
          <input class="admin-input" formControlName="codigo" maxlength="50" />
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.codigo" fieldLabel="El código" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Nombre</label>
          <input class="admin-input" formControlName="nombre" maxlength="160" />
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Descripción</label>
          <textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="descripcion"></textarea>
        </div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else if (mode() === 'share') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="shareForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2 warehouse-current">
          <span>Almacén</span>
          <strong>{{ currentWarehouse()?.nombre }}</strong>
          <small>Propietaria: {{ currentWarehouse()?.uotPropietaria }}</small>
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Compartir con UOT</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
              @if (unit.uotId !== currentWarehouse()?.uotPropietariaId) {
                <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
              }
            }
          </select>
        </div>
        <label class="warehouse-check">
          <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox checkbox-sm" formControlName="permiteEntrada" />
          <span>Permitir entradas</span>
        </label>
        <label class="warehouse-check">
          <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox checkbox-sm" formControlName="permiteSalida" />
          <span>Permitir salidas</span>
        </label>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="warehouse-movement-form" [formGroup]="movementForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-form-grid">
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>UOT</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onMovementUnitChange()">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
                <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
              }
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Almacén</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="almacenId">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @for (warehouse of warehousesForUnit(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
                <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
              }
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Tipo</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipo">
              @for (type of movementTypes; track type.value) {
                <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option>
              }
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Naturaleza</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="naturaleza">
              <option value="E">Entrada</option>
              <option value="S">Salida</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Documento de referencia</label>
            <input class="admin-input" maxlength="100" formControlName="documentoReferencia" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Observación</label>
            <input class="admin-input" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <section class="warehouse-lines" formArrayName="detalle">
          <header>
            <div><p>Detalle</p><h3>Productos del movimiento</h3></div>
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" (click)="addLine()">
              <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
              Agregar línea
            </button>
          </header>

          @for (line of lines.controls; track $index; let index = $index) {
            <div class="warehouse-line" [formGroupName]="index">
              <div class="admin-field warehouse-line-product">
                <label>Producto</label>
                <select class="admin-select" formControlName="productoId">
                  <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                  @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
                    <option [value]="product.productoId">{{ product.nombre }} · {{ product.codigo }}</option>
                  }
                </select>
              </div>
              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Cantidad</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidad" />
              </div>
              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Costo unitario</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="costoUnitario" />
              </div>
              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Moneda</label>
                <select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda">
                  <option value="PEN">PEN</option>
                  <option value="USD">USD</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Lote</label>
                <input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="lote" />
              </div>
              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Vencimiento</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaVencimiento" />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                class="admin-icon-button warehouse-remove"
                title="Quitar línea"
                [disabled]="lines.length <= 1"
                (click)="removeLine(index)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="removeIcon" />
              </button>
            </div>
          }
        </section>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    }

    <ng-template #actions>
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormArray,
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faShareNodes,
  faTrashCan,
  faWarehouse,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import {
  ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum,
  ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum,
} from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceMovementRegisterRequest';
import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type WarehouseFormMode = 'create' | 'share' | 'movement';

export interface WarehouseOperationOptions {
  warehouses: readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[];
  products: readonly ResourceProductResponse[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacen-operation-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './almacen-operation-form.html',
  styleUrl: './almacen-operation-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenOperationFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<WarehouseFormMode>('create');
  readonly currentWarehouse = signal<ResourceWarehouseResponse | null>(null);
  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly movementTypes = [
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, label: 'Compra' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Donacion, label: 'Donación' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Devolucion, label: 'Devolución' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Consumo, label: 'Consumo' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Transferencia, label: 'Transferencia' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Ajuste, label: 'Ajuste' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Merma, label: 'Merma' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ubicacionId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly shareForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    permiteEntrada: [true],
    permiteSalida: [true],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    almacenId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipo: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, [Validators.required]],
    naturaleza: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E, [Validators.required]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.movementForm.controls.detalle;
  }

  openCreate(options: WarehouseOperationOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openShare(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('share', options, warehouse);
    this.shareForm.reset({
      uotId: 0,
      permiteEntrada: true,
      permiteSalida: true,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(options: WarehouseOperationOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('movement', options, null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      almacenId: options.warehouses[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      tipo: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra,
      naturaleza: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') {
      this.saveShare();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveWarehouse();
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return 'Compartir almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar almacén';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return this.shareIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.warehouseIcon;
  }

  warehousesForUnit(): readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[] {
    const unitId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.uotId.value);
    if (unitId <= 0) return this.warehouses();
    return this.warehouses().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.uotPropietariaId === unitId ||
        item.tipoAcceso?.toUpperCase() === 'COMPARTIDO',
    );
  }

  onMovementUnitChange(): void {
    const currentId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.value);
    const valid = this.warehousesForUnit().some((x) => x.almacenId === currentId);
    if (!valid) {
      this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.setValue(
        this.warehousesForUnit()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      );
    }
  }

  private saveWarehouse(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();

    this.run(
      this.api.createWarehouse({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        ubicacionId: Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
        codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
      }),
      'Almacén registrado',
    );
  }

  private saveShare(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.shareForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!warehouse?.almacenId || this.shareForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.shareForm.getRawValue();

    if (Number(raw.uotId) === warehouse.uotPropietariaId) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona una UOT distinta de la propietaria.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.shareWarehouse(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        permiteEntrada: raw.permiteEntrada,
        permiteSalida: raw.permiteSalida,
      }),
      'Acceso de almacén actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro del mismo movimiento.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.registerMovement({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        tipo: raw.tipo,
        naturaleza: raw.naturaleza,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
          costoUnitario:
            Number(line.costoUnitario) > 0
              ? Number(line.costoUnitario)
              : undefined,
          moneda: line.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
          lote: normalizeOptionalText(line.lote),
          fechaVencimiento: line.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        })),
      }),
      'Movimiento registrado',
    );
  }

  private run(operation: import('rxjs').Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
      costoUnitario: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.maxLength(3)]],
      lote: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      fechaVencimiento: [''],
    });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: WarehouseFormMode,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.warehouses.set(options.warehouses);
    this.products.set(options.products);
    this.currentWarehouse.set(warehouse);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.currentWarehouse.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Almacenes y stock"
    subtitle="Stock por almacén/UOT, movimientos y Kardex."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-secondary-button"
      [disabled]="warehouses().length === 0 || products().length === 0"
      (click)="movement()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" />
      Movimiento
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-primary-button"
      (click)="createWarehouse()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
      Registrar almacén
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface warehouse-toolbar">
    @if (uot.modo() === 'GENERAL') {
      <label>
        <span>UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Almacén</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="warehouseFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onWarehouseChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Producto</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="productFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onProductChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
          <option [value]="product.productoId">{{ product.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
  </section>

  <div class="warehouse-tabs" role="tablist">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'warehouses'" (click)="setTab('warehouses')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /> Almacenes
    </button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'stock'" (click)="setTab('stock')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="stockIcon" /> Stock
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_KARDEX'"
      type="button"
      [class.active]="activeTab() === 'kardex'"
      (click)="setTab('kardex')"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="kardexIcon" /> Kardex
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando almacenes" message="Consultando stock y movimientos." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los almacenes.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'warehouses') {
    @if (warehouses().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin almacenes" message="No existen almacenes disponibles para el contexto actual." />
    } @else {
      <section class="warehouse-card-grid">
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <article class="admin-surface warehouse-card">
            <header>
              <span class="warehouse-card-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /></span>
              <div>
                <strong>{{ warehouse.nombre || 'Almacén' }}</strong>
                <small>{{ warehouse.codigo || '—' }}</small>
              </div>
              <span class="warehouse-access">{{ warehouse.tipoAcceso || 'PROPIO' }}</span>
            </header>
            <dl>
              <div><dt>UOT propietaria</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.uotPropietaria || '—' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Entradas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteEntrada === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Salidas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteSalida === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
            </dl>
            @if (warehouse.descripcion) { <p>{{ warehouse.descripcion }}</p> }
            <footer>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                (click)="share(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="shareIcon" />
                Compartir
              </button>
            </footer>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'stock') {
    @if (filteredStock().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin stock" message="No existen saldos para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Almacén</th><th>Producto</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Actualización</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredStock(); track item.almacenId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen }}</td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.producto }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockActual | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockReservado | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td><strong class="stock-value" [class]="stockTone(item)">{{ item.stockDisponible | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaActualizacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  } @else {
    @if (kardex().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin movimientos" message="No existen movimientos en el Kardex para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Fecha</th><th>UOT</th><th>Almacén</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Producto</th><th>Naturaleza</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Referencia</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of kardex(); track item.movimientoInventarioId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.producto || '—' }}</td>
                  <td><span class="warehouse-nature">{{ item.naturaleza === 'E' ? 'Entrada' : 'Salida' }}</span></td>
                  <td>{{ item.cantidad | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-almacen-operation-form />
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBookOpen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faShareNodes,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceKardexResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceKardexResponse';
import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { ResourceStockResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceStockResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import {
  AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  WarehouseOperationOptions,
} from '../almacen-operation-form/almacen-operation-form';

type WarehouseTab = 'warehouses' | 'stock' | 'kardex';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacenes-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './almacenes-list.html',
  styleUrl: './almacenes-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(AlmacenOperationFormComponent)
  private form!: AlmacenOperationFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly activeTab = signal<WarehouseTab>('warehouses');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly warehouseFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly productFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly stock = signal<readonly ResourceStockResponse[]>([]);
  readonly kardex = signal<readonly ResourceKardexResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly stockIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filteredStock = computed(() => {
    const warehouseId = this.warehouseFilter();
    const productId = this.productFilter();
    return this.stock().filter(
      (item) =>
        (!warehouseId || item.almacenId === warehouseId) &&
        (!productId || item.productoId === productId),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const unitId = this.queryUnitId();

    forkJoin({
      warehouses: this.api.listWarehouses(unitId),
      products: this.api.listProducts(unitId),
      stock: this.api.listStock(unitId),
      kardex: this.api.listKardex(
        unitId,
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ warehouses, products, stock, kardex }) => {
          this.warehouses.set(warehouses);
          this.products.set(products);
          this.stock.set(stock);
          this.kardex.set(kardex);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  setTab(tab: WarehouseTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(null);
    this.productFilter.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  onWarehouseChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null,
    );
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  onProductChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.productFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  async createWarehouse(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async share(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openShare(warehouse, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async movement(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openMovement(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  stockTone(item: ResourceStockResponse): string {
    const available = item.stockDisponible ?? 0;
    const minimum = item.stockMinimo ?? 0;
    if (available <= 0) return 'stock-value stock-value--danger';
    if (minimum > 0 && available <= minimum) return 'stock-value stock-value--warning';
    return 'stock-value stock-value--ok';
  }

  private loadKardex(): void {
    this.api
      .listKardex(
        this.queryUnitId(),
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardex.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private queryUnitId(): number | undefined {
    return this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
      : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;
  }

  private options(): WarehouseOperationOptions {
    return {
      warehouses: this.warehouses(),
      products: this.products(),
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
export class RecursoFormComponent {

  readonly mode = signal<ResourceFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ResourceAssetResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly assetTypes = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly organizations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly stateIcon = faRotate;
  readonly incidentIcon = faTriangleExclamation;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  readonly states = [
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible, label: 'Disponible' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Asignado, label: 'Asignado' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Mantenimiento, label: 'Mantenimiento' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Averiado, label: 'Averiado' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.NoDisponible, label: 'No disponible' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Inactivo, label: 'Inactivo' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Baja, label: 'Baja' },
  ] as const;

  readonly incidentTypes = [
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia, label: 'Avería' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Accidente, label: 'Accidente' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Perdida, label: 'Pérdida' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Robo, label: 'Robo' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Mantenimiento, label: 'Mantenimiento' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

  private resolver: ((value: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoBienId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigoPatrimonial: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(80)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    marca: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    modelo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    serie: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    fechaAdquisicion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    montoAdquisicion: [0, [Validators.min(0), Validators.max(999999999999)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
    proveedorEmpresaId: [0],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly stateForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    estado: [
      ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,
      [Validators.required],
    ],
    motivo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly incidentForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipo: [ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia, [Validators.required]],
    fechaHora: [localDateTimeInputNow(), [Validators.required]],
    descripcion: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(1000)],
    ],
    costoEstimado: [0, [Validators.min(0), Validators.max(999999999999)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('create');
    const selected = preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0;
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: selected,
      tipoBienId: 0,
      codigoPatrimonial: '',
      nombre: '',
      marca: '',
      modelo: '',
      serie: '',
      fechaAdquisicion: '',
      montoAdquisicion: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: 0,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId[this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable']({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: item.uotId ?? 0,
      tipoBienId: item.tipoBienId ?? 0,
      codigoPatrimonial: item.codigoPatrimonial ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      marca: item.marca ?? '',
      modelo: item.modelo ?? '',
      serie: item.serie ?? '',
      fechaAdquisicion: item.fechaAdquisicion ?? '',
      montoAdquisicion: item.montoAdquisicion ?? 0,
      moneda: item.monedaAdquisicion ?? 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: item.proveedorEmpresaId ?? 0,
      observacion: item.observacion ?? '',
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  openState(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('state');
    this.current.set(item);
    const valid = this.states.find((state) => state.value === item.estadoBien);
    this.stateForm.reset({
      estado: valid?.value ?? ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,
      motivo: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openIncident(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('incident');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.incidentForm.reset({
      tipo: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia,
      fechaHora: localDateTimeInputNow(),
      descripcion: '',
      costoEstimado: 0,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    this.form.controls.proveedorEmpresaId.setValue(0, { emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'state') {
      this.saveState();
      return;
    }
    if (this.mode() === 'incident') {
      this.saveIncident();
      return;
    }
    this.saveAsset();
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'edit':
        return 'Editar bien';
      case 'state':
        return 'Cambiar estado';
      case 'incident':
        return 'Registrar incidencia';
      default:
        return 'Registrar bien';
    }
  }

  private saveAsset(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const amount = Number(raw.montoAdquisicion);
    const providerId = Number(raw.proveedorEmpresaId);

    const common = {
      tipoBienId: Number(raw.tipoBienId),
      nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
      marca: normalizeOptionalText(raw.marca),
      modelo: normalizeOptionalText(raw.modelo),
      serie: normalizeOptionalText(raw.serie),
      fechaAdquisicion: raw.fechaAdquisicion || undefined,
      montoAdquisicion: amount > 0 ? amount : undefined,
      moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: providerId > 0 ? providerId : undefined,
      observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
    };

    const operation =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.bienInventarioId
        ? this.api.updateAsset(this.current()!.bienInventarioId!, common)
        : this.api.createAsset({
            uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
            codigoPatrimonial: raw.codigoPatrimonial.trim().toUpperCase(),
            ...common,
          });

    this.run(operation, this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Bien actualizado' : 'Bien registrado');
  }

  private saveState(): void {
    const item = this.current();
    this.stateForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!item?.bienInventarioId || this.stateForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.stateForm.getRawValue();
    this.run(
      this.api.changeAssetState(item.bienInventarioId, {
        estado: raw.estado,
        motivo: normalizeOptionalText(raw.motivo),
      }),
      'Estado actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveIncident(): void {
    const item = this.current();
    this.incidentForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!item?.bienInventarioId || this.incidentForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.incidentForm.getRawValue();
    const cost = Number(raw.costoEstimado);
    const body: ResourceAssetIncidentRequest = {
      tipo: raw.tipo,
      fechaHora: raw.fechaHora,
      descripcion: normalizeText(raw.descripcion),
      costoEstimado: cost > 0 ? cost : undefined,
    };

    this.run(
      this.api.reportAssetIncident(item.bienInventarioId, body),
      'Incidencia registrada',
    );
  }

  private run(operation: Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      types: this.refs.catalog('TIPO_BIEN'),
      organizations: this.listOrganizations.execute(1, 200, Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId) || undefined),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ types, organizations }) => {
          this.assetTypes.set(
            types.map((item) => ({
              value: Number(item.id),
              label: item.label,
              description: item.code,
            })),
          );
          this.organizations.set(
            organizations.items
              .filter((item) => item.estado)
              .map((item) => ({
                value: item.empresaId,
                label: item.razonSocial,
                description: item.ruc,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';

type SupplyFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'movement';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-suministro-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './suministro-form.html',
  styleUrl: './suministro-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SuministroFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<SupplyFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoMovimiento: ['ENTRADA', [Validators.required]],
    cantidad: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      unidadMedida: 'UND',
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
    });

    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.uotId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      codigo: item.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      unidadMedida: item.unidadMedida ?? 'UND',
      stockInicial: Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0),
      stockMinimo: Number(item.stockMinimo ?? 0),
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('movement');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      tipoMovimiento: 'ENTRADA',
      cantidad: 0,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.movementForm.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return 'Editar suministro';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar suministro';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return this.editIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.addIcon;
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveSupply();
    }
  }

  private saveSupply(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const uotId = Number(raw.uotId);
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.suministroId
        ? this.api.update(Number(this.current()!.suministroId), {
            uotId,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          })
        : this.api.create({
            uotId,
            codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Suministro actualizado' : 'Suministro registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    const supply = this.current();
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!supply?.suministroId || this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .registerMovement(Number(supply.suministroId), {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        tipoMovimiento: raw.tipoMovimiento,
        cantidad: Number(raw.cantidad),
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Movimiento registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Moneda</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda">
            <option value="PEN">PEN</option>
            <option value="USD">USD</option>
          </select>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">

          @if (saving()) {

            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCoins,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(60)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    unidadMedida: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)],
    ],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      unidadMedida: '',
      categoria: '',
    });
    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(item: ResourceProductResponse, uotId: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: uotId,
      precio: item.precioVenta ?? 0,
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });
    this.priceForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  uotLabel(form: 'create' | 'price' = 'create'): string {
    const id = form === 'price'
      ? Number(this.priceForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId)
      : Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);

    return this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'price') {
      this.savePrice();
      return;
    }
    this.saveProduct();
  }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .createProduct({
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
        categoria: normalizeOptionalText(raw.categoria),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Producto registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!product?.productoId || this.priceForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .versionProductPrice(product.productoId, {
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        uotPrecioId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        precio: Number(raw.precio),
        moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Nueva versión de precio registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
  }
}
```
