```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Productos"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general de catálogo y precios por UOT.' : 'Catálogo y precios vigentes para ' + contextUotName() + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button class="admin-secondary-button" type="button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
    </button>
    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" class="admin-primary-button" type="button" (click)="create()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Registrar producto
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface product-filters">
    <label>
      <span>UOT</span>
      @if (isGeneral()) {
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      } @else {
        <input class="admin-input" [value]="contextUotName()" readonly />
      }
    </label>
    <label class="product-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <input class="admin-input" type="search" placeholder="Código, producto, categoría, UOT..." [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" />
    </label>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando productos" message="Consultando productos y precios por UOT." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los productos.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (filtered().length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin productos" message="No existen productos para los filtros seleccionados." />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface product-table-shell">
      <div class="admin-table-scroll">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead><tr><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Precio vigente</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of filtered(); track rowKey(item)) {
              <tr>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.contextUotNombre }}</strong><span>{{ item.contextUotCodigo }}</span></div></td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</strong></td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="product-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small></td>
                <td>{{ item.categoria || '—' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.unidadMedida || '—' }}</td>
                <td>
                  @if (item.precioVenta != null) { <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong> }
                  @else { <span class="product-help">Sin precio</span> }
                </td>
                <td>{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</td>
                <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                  <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Versionar precio en esta UOT" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                  <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_LISTAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Historial de precios de esta UOT" (click)="toggleHistory(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" /></button>
                  <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Imágenes de esta UOT" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
                </div></td>
              </tr>

              @if (sameRow(historyProduct(), item)) {
                <tr class="product-images-row">
                  <td colspan="8">
                    <div class="p-3">
                      <strong>Historial de precios · {{ item.contextUotNombre }}</strong>
                      @if (historyLoading()) {
                        <app-loading-state title="Cargando historial" message="Consultando versiones de precio." />
                      } @else if (historyError()) {
                        <app-error-state [message]="historyError() || 'No se pudo consultar el historial.'" (retry)="loadHistory(item)" />
                      } @else if (priceHistory().length === 0) {
                        <app-empty-state title="Sin historial" message="Este producto todavía no tiene precios registrados en esta UOT." />
                      } @else {
                        <div class="admin-table-scroll mt-3">
                          <table class="admin-table">
                            <thead><tr><th>Versión</th><th>Precio</th><th>Desde</th><th>Hasta</th><th>Registrado por</th><th>Estado</th></tr></thead>
                            <tbody>
                              @for (price of priceHistory(); track price.productoPrecioId) {
                                <tr>
                                  <td>v{{ price.version }}</td>
                                  <td><strong>{{ price.moneda }} {{ price.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                                  <td>{{ price.fechaDesde || '—' }}</td>
                                  <td>{{ price.fechaHasta || 'Vigente' }}</td>
                                  <td>{{ price.nombreUsuario || 'Sistema' }}</td>
                                  <td><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="price.vigente">{{ price.vigente ? 'Vigente' : 'Histórico' }}</span></td>
                                </tr>
                              }
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      }
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }

              @if (sameRow(selectedForImages(), item)) {
                <tr class="product-images-row">
                  <td colspan="8">
                    <app-local-file-panel [uotId]="item.contextUotId" linkType="PRODUCTO" [linkId]="item.productoId || 0" [fileIds]="imageIds(item)" title="Imagen principal del producto" category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN" accept="image/*" [forcePrincipal]="true" (changed)="load()" />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-producto-form />
```

```html
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationId">Identificador del destino</label>
          <input id="resourceDestinationId" class="admin-input" type="number" min="1" step="1" formControlName="destinoId" />
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.destinoId" fieldLabel="El destino" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceType">Tipo de recurso</label>
          <select
            id="resourceType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="recursoTipo"
            (change)="changeResourceType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="BIEN">Bien / vehículo</option>
            <option value="SUMINISTRO">Suministro</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceId">Recurso disponible</label>
          <div class="resource-select-row">
            <select id="resourceId" class="admin-select" formControlName="recursoId">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @if (createForm.controls.recursoTipo.value === 'BIEN') {
                @for (asset of availableAssets(); track asset.bienInventarioId) {
                  <option [value]="asset.bienInventarioId">
                    {{ asset.codigoPatrimonial }} · {{ asset.nombre }}
                  </option>
                }
              } @else {
                @for (supply of availability().suministros; track supply.suministroId) {
                  <option [value]="supply.suministroId">
                    {{ supply.codigo }} · {{ supply.nombre }} · stock {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}
                  </option>
                }
              }
            </select>
            <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Actualizar disponibilidad" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="loadAvailability()">
              @if (loading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }
            </button>
          </div>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.recursoId" fieldLabel="El recurso" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="programmedQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
          <input
            id="programmedQuantity"
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0.001"
            step="0.001"
            formControlName="cantidadProgramada"
          />
          @if (selectedSupply(); as supply) {
            <small class="resource-helper">Disponible: {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}</small>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="programObservation">Observación</label>
          <textarea id="programObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
          <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || loading()">
            @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Programando... }
            @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Programar }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else if (loading()) {
      <div class="resource-modal-loading">
        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-lg"></span>
        <strong>Cargando recurso</strong>
        <span>Consultando el estado y sus movimientos.</span>
      </div>
    } @else if (current(); as detail) {
      @if (mode() === 'view') {
        <div class="resource-program-view">
          <section class="admin-detail-grid">
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Recurso</span><strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Destino</span><strong>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Cantidad</span><strong>{{ detail.cantidadProgramada }} {{ detail.unidadMedida || '' }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Estado</span><strong>{{ detail.estadoProceso }}</strong></article>
          </section>
          <section class="admin-surface">
            <div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Historial</p><h2>Movimientos</h2></div><span class="admin-count-badge">{{ detail.movimientos.length }}</span></div>
            <div class="admin-table-wrap">
              <table class="admin-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Movimiento</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Usuario</th><th>Observación</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  @for (movement of detail.movimientos; track movement.recursoMovimientoId) {
                    <tr>
                      <td>{{ movement.tipoMovimiento }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.cantidad }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.fechaHora ? (movement.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.usuario || '—' }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.observacion || '—' }}</td>
                    </tr>
                  } @empty {
                    <tr><td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">No hay movimientos registrados.</td></tr>
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="close()">Cerrar</button></footer>
        </div>
      } @else if (mode() === 'edit') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="editForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · {{ detail.estadoProceso }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="editQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
            <input id="editQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadProgramada" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="editObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="editObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else if (mode() === 'return') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="returnForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · cantidad programada {{ detail.cantidadProgramada }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="returnQuantity">Cantidad a devolver</label>
            <input id="returnQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadDevuelta" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="returnObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="returnObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Registrando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="returnIcon" /> Registrar devolución }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="consumeForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong>
            <span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · pendiente {{ pendingQuantity(detail) }} {{ detail.unidadMedida || '' }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="consumeQuantity">Cantidad consumida</label>
            <input id="consumeQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0.001" [max]="pendingQuantity(detail)" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadConsumida" />
            <app-form-error [control]="consumeForm.controls.cantidadConsumida" fieldLabel="La cantidad" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="consumeObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="consumeObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || pendingQuantity(detail) <= 0">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Registrando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="consumeIcon" /> Registrar consumo }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      }
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faUtensils,
  faEye,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-disponibilidad-recursos.use-case';
import { EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ProgramarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/programar-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-devolucion-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-consumo-recurso.use-case';
import { DisponibilidadRecurso } from '../../../../../domain/disponibilidad-recurso.model';
import {
  RecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
  TipoRecursoProgramable,
} from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';

export type RecursoProgramadoFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'view' | 'return' | 'consume';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurso-programado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './recurso-programado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './recurso-programado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoProgramadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly availabilityUseCase = inject(ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly programUseCase = inject(ProgramarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly returnUseCase = inject(RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly consumeUseCase = inject(RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly mode = signal<RecursoProgramadoFormMode>('create');
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<RecursoProgramadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly availability = signal<DisponibilidadRecurso>({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly resourceIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly consumeIcon = faUtensils;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    destinoTipo: ['SALIDA' as TipoDestinoRecurso, [Validators.required]],
    destinoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    recursoTipo: ['BIEN' as TipoRecursoProgramable, [Validators.required]],
    recursoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly editForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly returnForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadDevuelta: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly consumeForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadConsumida: [0, [Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly availableAssets = computed(() =>
    this.availability().bienes.filter((item) => item.disponible),
  );

  readonly selectedSupply = computed(() => {
    const id = Number(this.createForm.controls.recursoId.value);
    return this.availability().suministros.find((item) => item.suministroId === id) ?? null;
  });

  async openCreate(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState('create');
    this.createForm.reset({
      destinoTipo: 'SALIDA',
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoTipo: 'BIEN',
      recursoId: 0,
      cantidadProgramada: 1,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loadAvailability();
    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  async openDetail(
    item: RecursoProgramado,
    mode: Exclude<RecursoProgramadoFormMode, 'create'>,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState(mode);
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.current.set(detail);
          this.editForm.reset({
            cantidadProgramada: detail.cantidadProgramada,
            observacion: detail.observacion ?? '',
          });
          this.returnForm.reset({
            cantidadDevuelta: detail.bienInventarioId ? 1 : Math.max(0.001, detail.cantidadProgramada),
            observacion: '',
          });
          this.consumeForm.reset({
            cantidadConsumida: this.pendingQuantity(detail),
            observacion: '',
          });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });

    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  changeResourceType(type: string): void {
    const resourceType = type as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    this.createForm.patchValue({ recursoTipo: resourceType, recursoId: 0 });
    if (resourceType === 'BIEN') {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
    }
  }

  loadAvailability(): void {
    if (this.loading()) return;
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availabilityUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (availability) => this.availability.set(availability),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    const mode = this.mode();
    if (this.saving() || this.loading() || mode === 'view') return;

    if (mode === 'create') {
      this.saveCreate();
    } else if (mode === 'edit') {
      this.saveEdit();
    } else if (mode === 'return') {
      this.saveReturn();
    } else {
      this.saveConsume();
    }
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create': return 'Programar recurso';
      case 'edit': return 'Editar programación';
      case 'return': return 'Registrar devolución';
      case 'consume': return 'Registrar consumo';
      default: return 'Detalle del recurso programado';
    }
  }

  icon() {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create': return this.addIcon;
      case 'edit': return this.editIcon;
      case 'return': return this.returnIcon;
      case 'consume': return this.consumeIcon;
      default: return this.viewIcon;
    }
  }

  destinationLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    if (detail.campaniaVentaId) return `Campaña #${detail.campaniaVentaId}`;
    if (detail.operativoVentaId) return `Operativo #${detail.operativoVentaId}`;
    if (detail.salidaCampoId) return `Salida de campo #${detail.salidaCampoId}`;
    return 'Sin destino';
  }

  resourceLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    return detail.bien ?? detail.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  private saveCreate(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const resourceType = raw.recursoTipo as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    const quantity = resourceType === 'BIEN' ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);
    const selectedSupply = this.selectedSupply();

    if (resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' && selectedSupply && quantity > selectedSupply.stockDisponible) {
      this.errorMessage.set(`La cantidad supera el stock disponible (${selectedSupply.stockDisponible} ${selectedSupply.unidadMedida}).`);
      return;
    }

    const destinationId = Number(raw.destinoId);
    const input = {
      campaniaVentaId: raw.destinoTipo === 'CAMPANIA' ? destinationId : undefined,
      operativoVentaId: raw.destinoTipo === 'OPERATIVO' ? destinationId : undefined,
      salidaCampoId: raw.destinoTipo === 'SALIDA' ? destinationId : undefined,
      bienInventarioId: resourceType === 'BIEN' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      suministroId: resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      cantidadProgramada: quantity,
      observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.programUseCase
      .execute(input)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (id) => {
          this.toast.success('Recurso programado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: id });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveEdit(): void {
    this.editForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.editForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.editForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadProgramada: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Programación actualizada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveReturn(): void {
    this.returnForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.returnForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.returnForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadDevuelta);
    const alreadyReturned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);

    if (quantity + alreadyReturned > detail.cantidadProgramada) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La devolución supera la cantidad programada pendiente.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.returnUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadDevuelta: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Devolución registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  pendingQuantity(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): number {
    const delivered = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'ENTREGA')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    const returned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    const consumed = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'CONSUMO')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    return Math.max(0, Number((delivered - returned - consumed).toFixed(3)));
  }

  private saveConsume(): void {
    this.consumeForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || detail.bienInventarioId || this.consumeForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.consumeForm.getRawValue();
    const pending = this.pendingQuantity(detail);
    const quantity = Number(raw.cantidadConsumida);

    if (quantity > pending) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La cantidad supera el pendiente por regularizar.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.consumeUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadConsumida: quantity > 0 ? quantity : undefined,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Consumo registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private resetState(mode: RecursoProgramadoFormMode): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  private resultPromise(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolver = resolve; });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBan,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faCheck,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUtensils,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AsignarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/asignar-recurso.use-case';
import { CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cancelar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-recursos-programados.use-case';
import { RecursoProgramado } from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { RecursoProgramadoFormComponent } from '../recurso-programado-form/recurso-programado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recursos-programados-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoProgramadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './recursos-programados-list.html',
  styleUrl: './recursos-programados-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursosProgramadosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoProgramadoFormComponent)
  private form!: RecursoProgramadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase);
  private readonly assignUseCase = inject(AsignarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly cancelUseCase = inject(CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly actionId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<RecursoProgramado>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly campaignFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly operationFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly fieldTripFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly assignIcon = faCheck;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly consumeIcon = faUtensils;
  readonly cancelIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void { this.load(1); }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoProceso: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        campaniaVentaId: this.campaignFilter() ?? undefined,
        operativoVentaId: this.operationFilter() ?? undefined,
        salidaCampoId: this.fieldTripFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  setNumericFilter(target: 'campaign' | 'operation' | 'fieldTrip', value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    const id = Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
    if (target === 'campaign') this.campaignFilter.set(id);
    if (target === 'operation') this.operationFilter.set(id);
    if (target === 'fieldTrip') this.fieldTripFilter.set(id);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) this.load(1);
  }

  async view(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    await this.form.openDetail(item, 'view');
  }

  async edit(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'edit');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async returnResource(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'return');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async consume(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'consume');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async assign(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Asignar recurso',
      message: `El recurso #${item.recursoProgramadoId} pasará a ejecución y quedará asignado al destino programado.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Asignar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.assignUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Recurso asignado'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo asignar el recurso', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async cancel(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Cancelar programación',
      message: `La programación #${item.recursoProgramadoId} quedará cancelada.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Cancelar programación',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la cancelación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.cancelUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Programación cancelada'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo cancelar', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  resourceName(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bien ?? item.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  resourceKind(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bienInventarioId ? 'Bien / vehículo' : 'Suministro';
  }

  destination(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    if (item.campaniaVentaId) return `Campaña #${item.campaniaVentaId}`;
    if (item.operativoVentaId) return `Operativo #${item.operativoVentaId}`;
    if (item.salidaCampoId) return `Salida #${item.salidaCampoId}`;
    return '—';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  RecursosProgramadosService,
  ResourceProgramCancelRequest,
  ResourceProgramConsumeRequest,
  ResourceProgramProgramRequest,
  ResourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
  ResourceProgramUpdateRequest,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { ProgramadosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/programados.gateway';
import { RecursoProgramadoFiltro } from '../../../domain/recurso-programado-filtro.model';
import {
  RecursoProgramadoConsumo,
  RecursoProgramadoCreate,
  RecursoProgramadoDevolucion,
  RecursoProgramadoUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { ProgramadosHttpMapper } from './programados-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ProgramadosHttpAdapter implements ProgramadosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(RecursosProgramadosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(ProgramadosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: RecursoProgramadoFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .recursosListar(
        {
          estadoProceso: filter.estadoProceso,
          campaniaVentaId: filter.campaniaVentaId,
          operativoVentaId: filter.operativoVentaId,
          salidaCampoId: filter.salidaCampoId,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  availability() {
    return this.api
      .recursosDisponibilidad({}, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.availability(response)));
  }

  program(input: RecursoProgramadoCreate) {
    const resourceProgramProgramRequest: ResourceProgramProgramRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosProgramar(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramProgramRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoUpdate) {
    const resourceProgramUpdateRequest: ResourceProgramUpdateRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  assign(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosAsignar(
        { id, xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create() },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  returnResource(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoDevolucion) {
    const resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest: ResourceProgramReturnResourceRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosRegistrarDevolucion(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  consume(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoConsumo) {
    const resourceProgramConsumeRequest: ResourceProgramConsumeRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.api
      .recursosRegistrarConsumo(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramConsumeRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  cancel(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const resourceProgramCancelRequest: ResourceProgramCancelRequest = { motivo };
    return this.api
      .recursosCancelar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          resourceProgramCancelRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== ''),
    ) as T;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { DisponibilidadRecurso } from '../../../domain/disponibilidad-recurso.model';
import {
  RecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  RecursoProgramadoMovimiento,
} from '../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';

@Injectable()
export class ProgramadosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.summary(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): RecursoProgramadoDetalle {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return {
      recursoProgramadoId: this.api.number(row['recursoProgramadoId']),
      campaniaVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['campaniaVentaId']),
      operativoVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['operativoVentaId']),
      salidaCampoId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['salidaCampoId']),
      bienInventarioId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['bienInventarioId']),
      bien: this.api.nullableString(row['bien']),
      estadoBien: this.api.nullableString(row['estadoBien']),
      suministroId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['suministroId']),
      suministro: this.api.nullableString(row['suministro']),
      unidadMedida: this.api.nullableString(row['unidadMedida']),
      cantidadProgramada: this.api.number(row['cantidadProgramada']),
      observacion: this.api.nullableString(row['observacion']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      estadoProceso: this.api.string(row['estadoProceso']),
      usuarioProgramacionId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['usuarioProgramacionId']),
      fechaProgramacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaProgramacion']),
      usuarioCancelacionId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['usuarioCancelacionId']),
      fechaCancelacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCancelacion']),
      motivoCancelacion: this.api.nullableString(row['motivoCancelacion']),
      movimientos: this.api
        .array(row['movimientos'])
        .map((item) => this.movement(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  availability(response: unknown): DisponibilidadRecurso {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return {
      bienes: this.api.array(row['bienes']).map((item) => {
        const value = this.api.record(item);
        return {
          bienInventarioId: this.api.number(value['bienInventarioId']),
          codigoPatrimonial: this.api.string(value['codigoPatrimonial']),
          nombre: this.api.string(value['nombre']),
          estadoBien: this.api.string(value['estadoBien']),
          disponible: this.api.boolean(value['disponible']),
        };
      }),
      suministros: this.api.array(row['suministros']).map((item) => {
        const value = this.api.record(item);
        return {
          suministroId: this.api.number(value['suministroId']),
          codigo: this.api.string(value['codigo']),
          nombre: this.api.string(value['nombre']),
          unidadMedida: this.api.string(value['unidadMedida']),
          stockDisponible: this.api.number(value['stockDisponible']),
        };
      }),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(row['recursoProgramadoId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private summary(row: Record<string, unknown>): RecursoProgramado {
    return {
      recursoProgramadoId: this.api.number(row['recursoProgramadoId']),
      campaniaVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['campaniaVentaId']),
      operativoVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['operativoVentaId']),

      observacion: this.api.nullableString(row['observacion']),
      cantidadEjecutada: this.api.number(row['cantidadEjecutada']),
      cantidadDevuelta: this.api.number(row['cantidadDevuelta']),
    };
  }

  private movement(row: Record<string, unknown>): RecursoProgramadoMovimiento {
    return {
      recursoMovimientoId: this.api.number(row['recursoMovimientoId']),
      tipoMovimiento: this.api.string(row['tipoMovimiento']),

  }
}
```

```typescript
import { PermissionService } from './permission.service';

type PermissionMode = 'all' | 'any';

@Directive({
  selector: '[appPermission]',
  standalone: true,
})
export class PermissionDirective {
  private readonly template = inject(TemplateRef<unknown>);

  private mode: PermissionMode = 'all';
  private rendered = false;

  @Input()
  set appPermission(value: string | readonly string[]) {
    this.permissions =
      typeof value === 'string' ? [value] : [...(value ?? [])];
    this.render();
  }

  @Input()
  set appPermissionMode(value: PermissionMode) {
    this.mode = value ?? 'all';
    this.render();
  }

  private render(): void {
    const allowed =
      this.permissions.length === 0 ||
      (this.mode === 'any'
        ? this.permissionService.hasAny(this.permissions)
        : this.permissionService.hasAll(this.permissions));

    if (allowed && !this.rendered) {
      this.container.clear();
      this.container.createEmbeddedView(this.template);
      this.rendered = true;
      return;
    }

    if (!allowed && this.rendered) {
      this.container.clear();
      this.rendered = false;
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">

        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" /></span>
        <div><p>Ventas</p><h2>Registrar venta o separación</h2></div>

      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">

    @if (errorMessage()) {

    <form class="sale-form" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="admin-form-grid">
        <div class="admin-field">

          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onUnitChange()">

            @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Almacén de salida</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="almacenId" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
              <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.almacenId" fieldLabel="El almacén" />
        </div>

        <label class="sale-separate-toggle admin-field-span-2">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            class="checkbox checkbox-sm"
            formControlName="separar"
            (change)="onSeparatedChange()"
          />
          <div>
            <strong>Separar / reservar stock</strong>
            <span>La operación permanece como venta con reserva hasta su vencimiento.</span>
          </div>
        </label>

        @if (form.controls.separar.value) {
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label>Reserva hasta</label>
            <input
              class="admin-input"
              type="datetime-local"
              formControlName="reservaHasta"
            />
            <app-form-error
              [control]="form.controls.reservaHasta"
              fieldLabel="El vencimiento de la reserva"
            />
          </div>
        }

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Cliente persona ID (opcional)</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" formControlName="clientePersonaId" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Cliente empresa ID (opcional)</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" formControlName="clienteEmpresaId" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Observación</label>
          <textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="2" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section class="sale-lines" formArrayName="detalle">
        <header>
          <div><p>Detalle</p><h3>Productos</h3></div>
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
            [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
            (click)="addLine()"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
            Agregar producto
          </button>
        </header>

        @for (line of lines.controls; track $index; let index = $index) {
          <div class="sale-line" [formGroupName]="index">
            <div class="admin-field">
              <label>Producto</label>
              <select class="admin-select" formControlName="productoId">
                <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
                  <option [value]="product.productoId">
                    {{ product.nombre }} ·
                    @if (product.precioVenta != null) {
                      {{ product.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ product.precioVenta }}
                    } @else {
                      sin precio
                    }
                  </option>
                }
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="admin-field">
              <label>Cantidad</label>
              <input
                class="admin-input"
                type="number"
                min="0.001"
                step="0.001"
                formControlName="cantidad"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-icon-button"
              title="Quitar producto"
              [disabled]="lines.length <= 1"
              (click)="removeLine(index)"
            >
              <fa-icon [icon]="removeIcon" />
            </button>
          </div>
        }
      </section>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Registrando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Registrar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260914_200421_359659\src\app\features\gestion-comercial\ventas\adapter\in\ui\pages\venta-form\venta-form.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormArray,
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCartPlus,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faTrashCan,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  localDateTimeInputNow,
  normalizeOptionalText,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-venta-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './venta-form.html',
  styleUrl: './venta-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentaFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly sales = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faCartPlus;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    almacenId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    separar: [false],
    reservaHasta: [''],
    clientePersonaId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    clienteEmpresaId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.form.controls.detalle;
  }

  open(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());

    const uotId =
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    this.form.reset({
      uotId,
      almacenId: 0,
      separar: false,
      reservaHasta: '',
      clientePersonaId: 0,
      clienteEmpresaId: 0,
      observacion: '',
    });

    this.loadReferences(uotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  onUnitChange(): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.controls.uotId.value);
    this.form.controls.almacenId.setValue(0);
    this.loadReferences(uotId);
  }

  onSeparatedChange(): void {
    const separated = this.form.controls.separar.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.reservaHasta;

    if (separated) {
      control.setValidators([Validators.required]);
      if (!control.value) {
        const now = new Date();
        now.setHours(now.getHours() + 24);
        const local = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
        control.setValue(local.toISOString().slice(0, 16));
      }
    } else {
      control.clearValidators();
      control.setValue('');
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    this.onSeparatedChange();
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro de la misma venta.');
      return;
    }

    if (raw.separar && raw.reservaHasta) {
      const reserveUntil = new Date(raw.reservaHasta);
      if (!Number.isFinite(reserveUntil.getTime()) || reserveUntil <= new Date()) {
        this.errorMessage.set('La reserva debe vencer en una fecha futura.');
        return;
      }
    }

    const personId = Number(raw.clientePersonaId);
    const companyId = Number(raw.clienteEmpresaId);

    if (personId > 0 && companyId > 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona un solo tipo de cliente.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.sales
      .create({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        clientePersonaId: personId > 0 ? personId : undefined,
        clienteEmpresaId: companyId > 0 ? companyId : undefined,
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
        })),
        separar: raw.separar,
        reservaHasta: raw.separar ? raw.reservaHasta : undefined,
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          const id =
            value && typeof value === 'object' && 'ventaId' in value
              ? Number((value as { ventaId?: number }).ventaId)
              : 0;
          this.toast.success(raw.separar ? 'Separación registrada' : 'Venta registrada');
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo registrar la venta', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private loadReferences(uotId: number): void {
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.products.set([]);
      this.warehouses.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      products: this.resources.listProducts(uotId),
      warehouses: this.resources.listWarehouses(uotId),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ products, warehouses }) => {
          this.products.set(products.filter((item) => item.estado !== false));
          this.warehouses.set(
            warehouses.filter(
              (item) => item.estado !== false && item.permiteSalida !== false,
            ),
          );
          this.form.controls.almacenId.setValue(
            this.warehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
          );
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
          <label>UOT propietaria</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onCreateUnitChange()">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>

          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Código</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            formControlName="codigo"
            maxlength="40"
            autocomplete="off"
            placeholder="DESCO propone uno automáticamente"
          />
          <small>
            @if (codeLoading()) {

          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.codigo" fieldLabel="El código" />

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

        <div class="warehouse-form-section admin-field-span-2">

        </div>

        <app-geography-cascade
          [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
          [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <app-form-error
            [control]="createForm.controls.distritoCodigo"
            fieldLabel="El distrito"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Referencia de ubicación</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            formControlName="referencia"
            maxlength="300"
            placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Descripción</label>
          <textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="400" formControlName="descripcion"></textarea>
        </div>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else if (mode() === 'share') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="shareForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2 warehouse-current">

          <app-form-error [control]="shareForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />

        <label class="warehouse-check">

          <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox checkbox-sm" formControlName="permiteSalida" />
          <span>Permitir salidas</span>
        </label>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else if (mode() === 'configure') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="configureForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2 warehouse-current">
          <span>Almacén</span>
          <strong>{{ currentWarehouse()?.nombre }}</strong>
          <small>
            {{ currentWarehouse()?.codigo || 'Sin código' }}
            · Propietaria: {{ currentWarehouse()?.uotPropietaria || '—' }}
          </small>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>UOT que registra la entrada</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onConfigureUnitChange()">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="configureForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Producto</label>
          <select
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="productoId"
            [disabled]="loadingProducts()"
            (change)="onConfigureProductChange()"
          >
            <option [value]="0">
              {{ loadingProducts() ? 'Cargando productos...' : 'Seleccionar' }}
            </option>
            @for (product of configurableProducts(); track product.productoId) {
              <option [value]="product.productoId">
                {{ product.nombre }} · {{ product.codigo || 'sin código' }}
              </option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="configureForm.controls.productoId"
            fieldLabel="El producto"
          />
          @if (!loadingProducts() && configurableProducts().length === 0) {
            <small>No hay productos pendientes de configurar en este almacén para la UOT seleccionada.</small>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="warehouse-form-section admin-field-span-2">
          <span>Stock inicial</span>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Stock inicial</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            step="0.001"

          <app-form-error
            [control]="configureForm.controls.stockInicial"

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Stock mínimo</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            step="0.001"
            formControlName="stockMinimo"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="configureForm.controls.stockMinimo"
            fieldLabel="El stock mínimo"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Costo unitario</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            step="0.0001"
            formControlName="costoUnitario"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Moneda</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda">
            <option value="PEN">PEN</option>
            <option value="USD">USD</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>
            Lote
            @if (selectedConfigureProduct()?.requiereLote) {
              <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
            }
          </label>
          <input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="lote" />
          <app-form-error [control]="configureForm.controls.lote" fieldLabel="El lote" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>
            Fecha de vencimiento
            @if (selectedConfigureProduct()?.controlaVencimiento) {
              <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>
            }
          </label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaVencimiento" />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="configureForm.controls.fechaVencimiento"
            fieldLabel="La fecha de vencimiento"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Documento de referencia</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            maxlength="120"
            formControlName="documentoReferencia"
            placeholder="Factura, guía, acta..."
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Observación</label>
          <textarea
            class="admin-textarea"
            rows="3"
            maxlength="500"
            formControlName="observacion"
          ></textarea>
        </div>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="warehouse-movement-form" [formGroup]="movementForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-form-grid">
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>UOT</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onMovementUnitChange()">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
                <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
              }
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Almacén</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="almacenId">
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @for (warehouse of warehousesForUnit(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
                <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
              }
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Tipo</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipo">
              @for (type of movementTypes; track type.value) {
                <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option>
              }
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Naturaleza</label>
            <select class="admin-select" formControlName="naturaleza">
              <option value="E">Entrada</option>
              <option value="S">Salida</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Documento de referencia</label>
            <input class="admin-input" maxlength="120" formControlName="documentoReferencia" />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Observación</label>
            <input class="admin-input" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <section class="warehouse-lines" formArrayName="detalle">
          <header>
            <div><p>Detalle</p><h3>Productos del movimiento</h3></div>
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" (click)="addLine()">
              <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
              Agregar línea
            </button>
          </header>

          @for (line of lines.controls; track $index; let index = $index) {
            <div class="warehouse-line" [formGroupName]="index">
              <div class="admin-field warehouse-line-product">
                <label>Producto</label>
                <select class="admin-select" formControlName="productoId">
                  <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                  @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
                    <option [value]="product.productoId">
                      {{ product.nombre }} · {{ product.codigo }}
                    </option>
                  }
                </select>
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Cantidad</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidad" />
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Costo unitario</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="costoUnitario" />
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Moneda</label>
                <select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda">
                  <option value="PEN">PEN</option>
                  <option value="USD">USD</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Lote</label>
                <input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="lote" />
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Vencimiento</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaVencimiento" />
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                class="admin-icon-button warehouse-remove"
                title="Quitar línea"
                [disabled]="lines.length <= 1"
                (click)="removeLine(index)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="removeIcon" />
              </button>
            </div>
          }
        </section>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    }

    <ng-template #actions>
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving() || loadingProducts()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```
