```typescript
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type WarehouseFormMode = 'create' | 'share' | 'configure' | 'movement';

export interface WarehouseOperationOptions {
  warehouses: readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[];
  products: readonly ResourceProductResponse[];
  stock: readonly ResourceStockResponse[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacen-operation-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
    NgTemplateOutlet,
  ],
  templateUrl: './almacen-operation-form.html',
  styleUrl: './almacen-operation-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenOperationFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<WarehouseFormMode>('create');
  readonly currentWarehouse = signal<ResourceWarehouseResponse | null>(null);
  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly configureProducts = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly stock = signal<readonly ResourceStockResponse[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly loadingProducts = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly configureIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly movementTypes = [
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, label: 'Compra' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Donacion, label: 'Donación' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Devolucion, label: 'Devolución' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Consumo, label: 'Consumo' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Transferencia, label: 'Transferencia' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Ajuste, label: 'Ajuste' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Merma, label: 'Merma' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

  readonly configurableProducts = computed(() => {
    const warehouseId = Number(this.currentWarehouse()?.almacenId ?? 0);
    const configured = new Set(
      this.stock()
        .filter((item) => Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) === warehouseId)
        .map((item) => Number(item.productoId ?? 0)),
    );

    return this.configureProducts().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.estado !== false &&
        Number(item.productoId ?? 0) > 0 &&
        !configured.has(Number(item.productoId)),
    );
  });

  selectedConfigureProduct(): ResourceProductResponse | null {
    const productId = Number(this.configureForm.controls.productoId.value);
    return (
      this.configureProducts().find(
        (item) => Number(item.productoId ?? 0) === productId,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(400)]],
  });

  readonly shareForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    permiteEntrada: [true],
    permiteSalida: [true],
  });

  readonly configureForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    costoUnitario: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.maxLength(3)]],
    lote: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    fechaVencimiento: [''],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    almacenId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipo: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, [Validators.required]],
    naturaleza: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E, [Validators.required]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.movementForm.controls.detalle;
  }

  openCreate(options: WarehouseOperationOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    const uotId =
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    this.createForm.reset({
      uotId,
      distritoCodigo: '',
      centroPobladoId: 0,
      referencia: '',
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openShare(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('share', options, warehouse);
    this.shareForm.reset({
      uotId: 0,
      permiteEntrada: true,
      permiteSalida: true,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openConfigure(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('configure', options, warehouse);

    const uotId =
      preferredUotId ??
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      warehouse.uotPropietariaId ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    this.configureForm.reset({
      uotId,
      productoId: 0,
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
      costoUnitario: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
      lote: '',
      fechaVencimiento: '',
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });

    this.configureForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadConfigureProducts();
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(options: WarehouseOperationOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('movement', options, null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      almacenId: options.warehouses[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      tipo: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra,
      naturaleza: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.createForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.createForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onCreateUnitChange(): void {
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  onConfigureUnitChange(): void {
    this.configureForm.controls.productoId.setValue(0);
    this.loadConfigureProducts();
  }

  onConfigureProductChange(): void {
    this.syncConfigureProductRules();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') {
      this.saveShare();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'configure') {
      this.saveConfigure();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveWarehouse();
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return 'Compartir almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'configure') return 'Agregar producto al almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar almacén';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return this.shareIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'configure') return this.configureIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.warehouseIcon;
  }

  warehousesForUnit(): readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[] {
    const unitId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.uotId.value);
    if (unitId <= 0) return this.warehouses();
    return this.warehouses().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.uotPropietariaId === unitId ||
        item.tipoAcceso?.toUpperCase() === 'COMPARTIDO',
    );
  }

  onMovementUnitChange(): void {
    const currentId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.value);
    const valid = this.warehousesForUnit().some((x) => x.almacenId === currentId);
    if (!valid) {
      this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.setValue(
        this.warehousesForUnit()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      );
    }
  }

  private saveWarehouse(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const code = raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();

    this.run(
      this.api.createWarehouse({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        ubicacion: {
          distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
          centroPobladoId:
            Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
              ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
              : undefined,
          referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
        },
        codigo: code || undefined,
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
      }),
      'Almacén registrado',
    );
  }

  private saveShare(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.shareForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!warehouse?.almacenId || this.shareForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.shareForm.getRawValue();

    if (Number(raw.uotId) === warehouse.uotPropietariaId) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona una UOT distinta de la propietaria.');
      return;
    }

    if (!raw.permiteEntrada && !raw.permiteSalida) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Habilite entrada, salida o ambas para compartir el almacén.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.shareWarehouse(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        permiteEntrada: raw.permiteEntrada,
        permiteSalida: raw.permiteSalida,
      }),
      'Acceso de almacén actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveConfigure(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.syncConfigureProductRules(false);
    this.configureForm.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.configureForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      !warehouse?.almacenId ||
      this.configureForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.loadingProducts()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.configureForm.getRawValue();
    const cost = Number(raw.costoUnitario);

    this.run(
      this.api.configureWarehouseProduct(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        productoId: Number(raw.productoId),
        stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
        stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
        costoUnitario: cost > 0 ? cost : undefined,
        moneda: cost > 0 ? raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN' : undefined,
        lote: normalizeOptionalText(raw.lote),
        fechaVencimiento: raw.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      }),
      'Producto agregado al almacén',
    );
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro del mismo movimiento.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.registerMovement({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        tipo: raw.tipo,
        naturaleza: raw.naturaleza,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
          costoUnitario:
            Number(line.costoUnitario) > 0
              ? Number(line.costoUnitario)
              : undefined,
          moneda: line.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
          lote: normalizeOptionalText(line.lote),
          fechaVencimiento: line.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        })),
      }),
      'Movimiento registrado',
    );
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'ALMACEN')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private loadConfigureProducts(): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.configureForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
    this.syncConfigureProductRules(false);

    if (uotId <= 0) return;

    this.loadingProducts.set(true);
    this.api
      .listProducts(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingProducts.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.configureProducts.set(items),
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private syncConfigureProductRules(emitEvent = true): void {
    const product = this.selectedConfigureProduct();
    const lot = this.configureForm.controls.lote;
    const expiration = this.configureForm.controls.fechaVencimiento;

    lot.setValidators(
      product?.requiereLote
        ? [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]
        : [Validators.maxLength(80)],
    );
    expiration.setValidators(
      product?.controlaVencimiento ? [Validators.required] : [],
    );

    lot.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
    expiration.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private run(operation: import('rxjs').Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
      costoUnitario: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.maxLength(3)]],
      lote: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      fechaVencimiento: [''],
    });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: WarehouseFormMode,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.warehouses.set(options.warehouses);
    this.products.set(options.products);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
    this.stock.set(options.stock);
    this.currentWarehouse.set(warehouse);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loadingProducts.set(false);
    this.codeLoading.set(false);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.currentWarehouse.set(null);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBookOpen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faShareNodes,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceKardexResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceKardexResponse';
import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { ResourceStockResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceStockResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import {
  AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  WarehouseOperationOptions,
} from '../almacen-operation-form/almacen-operation-form';

type WarehouseTab = 'warehouses' | 'stock' | 'kardex';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacenes-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './almacenes-list.html',
  styleUrl: './almacenes-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(AlmacenOperationFormComponent)
  private form!: AlmacenOperationFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly activeTab = signal<WarehouseTab>('warehouses');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly warehouseFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly productFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductResponse[]>([]);
  readonly stock = signal<readonly ResourceStockResponse[]>([]);
  readonly kardex = signal<readonly ResourceKardexResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly stockIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly configureIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filteredStock = computed(() => {
    const warehouseId = this.warehouseFilter();
    const productId = this.productFilter();
    return this.stock().filter(
      (item) =>
        (!warehouseId || item.almacenId === warehouseId) &&
        (!productId || item.productoId === productId),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const unitId = this.queryUnitId();

    forkJoin({
      warehouses: this.api.listWarehouses(unitId),
      products: this.api.listProducts(unitId),
      stock: this.api.listStock(unitId),
      kardex: this.api.listKardex(
        unitId,
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ warehouses, products, stock, kardex }) => {
          this.warehouses.set(warehouses);
          this.products.set(products);
          this.stock.set(stock);
          this.kardex.set(kardex);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  setTab(tab: WarehouseTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(null);
    this.productFilter.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  onWarehouseChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null,
    );
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  onProductChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.productFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  async createWarehouse(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async share(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openShare(warehouse, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async configureProduct(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openConfigure(
      warehouse,
      this.options(),
      this.queryUnitId(),
    );
    if (result.saved) {
      this.activeTab.set('stock');
      this.warehouseFilter.set(warehouse.almacenId ?? null);
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async movement(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openMovement(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  stockTone(item: ResourceStockResponse): string {
    const available = item.stockDisponible ?? 0;
    const minimum = item.stockMinimo ?? 0;
    if (available <= 0) return 'stock-value stock-value--danger';
    if (minimum > 0 && available <= minimum) return 'stock-value stock-value--warning';
    return 'stock-value stock-value--ok';
  }

  private loadKardex(): void {
    this.api
      .listKardex(
        this.queryUnitId(),
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardex.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private queryUnitId(): number | undefined {
    return this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
      : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;
  }

  private options(): WarehouseOperationOptions {
    return {
      warehouses: this.warehouses(),
      products: this.products(),
      stock: this.stock(),
    };
  }
}
```

```html
    title="Inventario y suministros"
    subtitle="Bienes patrimoniales y consumibles separados por UOT, con Kardex histórico."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">

      <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" /> Bienes
    </button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'supplies'" (click)="setTab('supplies')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="supplyIcon" /> Suministros
    </button>

  <section class="admin-surface resource-filter-bar">

    @if (isGeneral()) {
      <label class="resource-filter-field">

        </select>
      </label>

    <label class="resource-filter-field resource-filter-field--search">

      <input class="admin-input" type="search" [placeholder]="activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Código, bien, marca, serie...' : 'Código, suministro, unidad, UOT...'" [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" />
    </label>

    @if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
      <label class="resource-filter-field">
        <span>Estado</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value)">
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="DISPONIBLE">Disponible</option>
          <option value="ASIGNADO">Asignado</option>
          <option value="MANTENIMIENTO">Mantenimiento</option>
          <option value="AVERIADO">Averiado</option>
          <option value="NO_DISPONIBLE">No disponible</option>
          <option value="INACTIVO">Inactivo</option>
          <option value="BAJA">Baja</option>
        </select>
      </label>
    }
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando inventario" message="Consultando recursos del contexto UOT." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar el inventario.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
    @if (filteredAssets().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin bienes" message="No existen bienes que coincidan con los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead><tr><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Bien</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Identificación</th><th>Estado</th><th>Incidencias</th><th class="resource-actions-column">Acciones</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredAssets(); track item.bienInventarioId) {
                <tr>
                  <td><strong class="resource-uot-name">{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</small></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.marca || '' }} @if (item.modelo) { · {{ item.modelo }} }</small></td>
                  <td>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.serie || 'Sin serie' }}</td>
                  <td><span class="resource-status" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoBien)">{{ stateLabel(item.estadoBien) }}</span></td>
                  <td>
                    @if ((item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0) > 0) { <span class="resource-incident-count"><fa-icon [icon]="incidentIcon" /> {{ item.incidentesAbiertos }}</span> }
                    @else { <span class="resource-cell-help">Sin incidencias</span> }
                  </td>
                  <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <a *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos', item.bienInventarioId]" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a>
                    <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="editAsset(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  } @else {
    @if (filteredSupplies().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin suministros" message="No existen suministros que coincidan con los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead><tr><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Suministro</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Stock actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Reposición</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredSupplies(); track supplyKey(item)) {
                <tr>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</small></td>
                  <td><span class="admin-code">{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</span></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ (item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ (item.stockReservado ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td><strong>{{ (item.stockDisponible ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.requiereReposicion) { <span class="resource-status resource-status--warning">Reponer</span> }
                    @else { <span class="resource-status resource-status--ok">Correcto</span> }
                  </td>
                  <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar suministro" (click)="editSupply(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Registrar movimiento" (click)="movement(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver Kardex" (click)="toggleKardex(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>
                </tr>
                @if (sameSupply(kardexSupply(), item)) {
                  <tr class="resource-kardex-row">
                    <td colspan="9">
                      <div class="resource-kardex-panel">
                        <strong>Kardex · {{ item.uotNombre }} · {{ item.nombre }}</strong>
                        @if (kardexLoading()) {
                          <app-loading-state title="Cargando Kardex" message="Consultando movimientos históricos." />
                        } @else if (kardexError()) {
                          <app-error-state [message]="kardexError() || 'No se pudo consultar el Kardex.'" (retry)="loadKardex(item)" />
                        } @else if (kardex().length === 0) {
                          <app-empty-state title="Sin movimientos" message="El suministro todavía no tiene movimientos." />
                        } @else {
                          <div class="admin-table-scroll mt-3">
                            <table class="admin-table">
                              <thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Saldo</th><th>Documento</th><th>Usuario</th></tr></thead>
                              <tbody>
                                @for (movementItem of kardex(); track movementItem.suministroMovimientoId) {
                                  <tr>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.fechaHora || '—' }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ (movementItem.cantidad ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                                    <td><strong>{{ (movementItem.saldo ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.usuario || 'Sistema' }}</td>
                                  </tr>
                                }
                              </tbody>
                            </table>
                          </div>
                        }
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                }
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-recurso-form />
<app-suministro-form />
```

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faEye,
  faFilter,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceAssetResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetResponse';
import { SupplyMovementResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyMovementResponse';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';
import { SuministroFormComponent } from '../suministro-form/suministro-form';

type InventoryTab = 'assets' | 'supplies';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inventario-vehiculos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoFormComponent,
    SuministroFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InventarioVehiculosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private assetForm!: RecursoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(SuministroFormComponent) private supplyForm!: SuministroFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly suppliesApi = inject(SupplyApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly activeTab = signal<InventoryTab>('assets');
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly assets = signal<readonly ResourceAssetResponse[]>([]);
  readonly supplies = signal<readonly SupplySummaryResponse[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly kardexSupply = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly kardex = signal<readonly SupplyMovementResponse[]>([]);
  readonly kardexLoading = signal(false);
  readonly kardexError = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly filterIcon = faFilter;
  readonly incidentIcon = faTriangleExclamation;
  readonly supplyIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;

  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly availableUnits = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());

  readonly filteredAssets = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    const state = this.stateFilter().trim().toUpperCase();

    return this.assets().filter((item) => {
      if (state && (item.estadoBien ?? '').toUpperCase() !== state) return false;
      if (!query) return true;
      return [
        item.codigoPatrimonial,
        item.nombre,
        item.marca,
        item.modelo,
        item.serie,
        item.tipoBien,
        item.uotNombre,
      ].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query));
    });
  });

  readonly filteredSupplies = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.supplies();

    return this.supplies().filter((item) =>
      [
        item.codigo,
        item.nombre,
        item.unidadMedida,
        item.uotNombre,
        item.uotCodigo,
      ].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query)),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    if (this.isGeneral()) this.unitFilter.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  setTab(tab: InventoryTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
    this.search.set('');
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (this.activeTab() === 'supplies') {
      this.loadSupplies();
    } else {
      this.loadAssets();
    }
  }

  loadAssets(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api
      .listAssets(this.effectiveUotId())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.assets.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadSupplies(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.suppliesApi
      .listAll(this.effectiveUotId())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.supplies.set(items);
          const selected = this.kardexSupply();
          if (selected) {
            this.kardexSupply.set(
              items.find(
                (item) =>
                  item.suministroId === selected.suministroId
                  && item.uotId === selected.uotId,
              ) ?? null,
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.kardexSupply.set(null);
    this.kardex.set([]);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.activeTab() === 'supplies') {
      const result = await this.supplyForm.openCreate(this.effectiveUotId());
      if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies();
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.assetForm.openCreate(this.effectiveUotId());
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets();
  }

  async editAsset(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.assetForm.openEdit(item);
    if (result.saved) this.loadAssets();
  }

  async editSupply(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.supplyForm.openEdit(item);
    if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies();
  }

  async movement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.supplyForm.openMovement(item);
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadSupplies();
      if (this.sameSupply(this.kardexSupply(), item)) this.loadKardex(item);
    }
  }

  toggleKardex(item: SupplySummaryResponse): void {
    if (this.sameSupply(this.kardexSupply(), item)) {
      this.kardexSupply.set(null);
      this.kardex.set([]);
      this.kardexError.set(null);
      return;
    }
    this.loadKardex(item);
  }

  loadKardex(item: SupplySummaryResponse): void {
    if (!item.suministroId) return;

    this.kardexSupply.set(item);
    this.kardexLoading.set(true);
    this.kardexError.set(null);
    this.kardex.set([]);

    this.suppliesApi
      .kardex(Number(item.suministroId), item.uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.kardexLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (movements) => this.kardex.set(movements),
        error: (error) => this.kardexError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  stateLabel(value?: string): string {
    return (value ?? 'SIN ESTADO').replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }

  stateClass(value?: string): string {
    const normalized = (value ?? '').toUpperCase();
    if (normalized === 'DISPONIBLE') return 'resource-status resource-status--ok';
    if (normalized === 'BAJA' || normalized === 'INACTIVO') {
      return 'resource-status resource-status--muted';
    }
    if (
      normalized === 'AVERIADO'
      || normalized === 'MANTENIMIENTO'
      || normalized === 'NO_DISPONIBLE'
    ) {
      return 'resource-status resource-status--warning';
    }
    return 'resource-status resource-status--info';
  }

  sameSupply(
    left: SupplySummaryResponse | null,
    right: SupplySummaryResponse,
  ): boolean {
    return Boolean(
      left
      && left.suministroId === right.suministroId
      && left.uotId === right.uotId,
    );
  }

  supplyKey(item: SupplySummaryResponse): string {
    return `${item.suministroId ?? 0}-${item.uotId ?? 0}`;
  }

  private effectiveUotId(): number | undefined {
    return this.isGeneral()
      ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
      : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Detalle del bien"
    subtitle="Información patrimonial, evidencias, historial e incidencias."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/recursos/inventario-vehiculos">
      <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
      Volver
    </a>
    <button
      type="button"
      class="admin-secondary-button"
      [disabled]="loading()"
      (click)="load()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-secondary-button"
      (click)="edit()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
      Editar
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-secondary-button"
      (click)="changeState()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="stateIcon" />
      Estado
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-primary-button"
      (click)="reportIncident()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="incidentIcon" />
      Incidencia
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state
      title="Cargando bien"
      message="Consultando información patrimonial."
    />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state
      [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible cargar el bien.'"
      (retry)="load()"
    />
  } @else if (detail()?.bien; as item) {
    <section class="resource-detail-grid">
      <article class="admin-surface resource-summary-card">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Identificación</p>
            <h2>{{ item.nombre || 'Bien sin nombre' }}</h2>
          </div>
          <span class="resource-state">{{ item.estadoBien || '—' }}</span>
        </header>

        <dl class="resource-data-grid">
          <div><dt>UOT</dt><dd>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Código patrimonial</dt><dd>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Tipo</dt><dd>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Marca</dt><dd>{{ item.marca || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Modelo</dt><dd>{{ item.modelo || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Serie</dt><dd>{{ item.serie || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Fecha de adquisición</dt><dd>{{ item.fechaAdquisicion || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div>
            <dt>Monto de adquisición</dt>
            <dd>
              @if (item.montoAdquisicion != null) {
                {{ item.monedaAdquisicion || 'PEN' }}
                {{ item.montoAdquisicion | number:'1.2-2' }}
              } @else { — }
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div class="resource-data-wide">
            <dt>Observación</dt>
            <dd>{{ item.observacion || '—' }}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </article>

      <article class="admin-surface resource-summary-card">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Control</p>
            <h2>Estado actual</h2>
          </div>
        </header>
        <div class="resource-control-grid">
          <div>
            <span>Incidencias abiertas</span>
            <strong>{{ item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0 }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Proveedor</span>
            <strong>
              @if (item.proveedorEmpresaId) {
                Empresa #{{ item.proveedorEmpresaId }}
              } @else if (item.proveedorPersonaId) {
                Persona #{{ item.proveedorPersonaId }}
              } @else { — }
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    </section>

    <app-local-file-panel
      class="resource-files"
      [uotId]="item.uotId || 0"
      linkType="BIEN"
      [linkId]="item.bienInventarioId || 0"
      [fileIds]="fileIds()"
      title="Imágenes del bien"
      category="BIEN_IMAGEN"
      accept="image/*"
      [canUpload]="true"
      (changed)="load()"
    />

    <section class="resource-detail-columns">
      <article class="admin-surface resource-list-card">
        <header>
          <p>Historial</p>
          <h2>Estados del bien</h2>
        </header>
        <div class="resource-timeline">
          @for (history of detail()?.historial || []; track history.bienEstadoHistorialId) {
            <div class="resource-timeline-item">
              <span></span>
              <div>
                <strong>{{ history.estadoBien || '—' }}</strong>
                <small>
                  {{ history.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}
                  @if (history.fechaHasta) {
                    · hasta {{ history.fechaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}
                  }
                </small>
                @if (history.motivo) { <p>{{ history.motivo }}</p> }
              </div>
            </div>
          } @empty {
            <p class="resource-empty-copy">Sin historial registrado.</p>
          }
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="admin-surface resource-list-card">
        <header>
          <p>Incidencias</p>
          <h2>Eventos reportados</h2>
        </header>
        <div class="resource-incident-list">
          @for (incident of detail()?.incidentes || []; track incident.bienIncidenteId) {
            <div>
              <header>
                <strong>{{ incident.tipoIncidente || 'Incidencia' }}</strong>
                <span>{{ incident.estadoIncidente || '—' }}</span>
              </header>
              <small>{{ incident.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</small>
              <p>{{ incident.descripcion || '—' }}</p>
              @if (incident.costoEstimado != null) {
                <small>Costo estimado: {{ incident.costoEstimado | number:'1.2-2' }}</small>
              }
            </div>
          } @empty {
            <p class="resource-empty-copy">Sin incidencias registradas.</p>
          }
        </div>
      </article>
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-recurso-form />
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faPen,
  faRotate,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faWrench,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceAssetDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetDetailResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurso-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    LocalFilePanelComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './recurso-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './recurso-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private form!: RecursoFormComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<ResourceAssetDetailResponse | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faWrench;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly stateIcon = faWrench;
  readonly incidentIcon = faTriangleExclamation;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    const id = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));

    if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El identificador del bien no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .getAsset(id)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          if (!detail?.bien) {
            this.errorMessage.set('No se encontró el bien solicitado.');
            return;
          }
          this.detail.set(detail);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const item = this.detail()?.bien;
    if (!item) return;
    const result = await this.form.openEdit(item);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async changeState(): Promise<void> {
    const item = this.detail()?.bien;
    if (!item) return;
    const result = await this.form.openState(item);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async reportIncident(): Promise<void> {
    const item = this.detail()?.bien;
    if (!item) return;
    const result = await this.form.openIncident(item);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  fileIds(): readonly number[] {
    const detail = this.detail();
    if (!detail) return [];
    return detail.archivosImagen ?? [];
  }
}
```

```typescript
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Asignado, label: 'Asignado' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Mantenimiento, label: 'Mantenimiento' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Averiado, label: 'Averiado' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.NoDisponible, label: 'No disponible' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Inactivo, label: 'Inactivo' },
    { value: ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Baja, label: 'Baja' },
  ] as const;

  readonly incidentTypes = [
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia, label: 'Avería' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Accidente, label: 'Accidente' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Perdida, label: 'Pérdida' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Robo, label: 'Robo' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Mantenimiento, label: 'Mantenimiento' },
    { value: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

  private resolver: ((value: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoBienId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigoPatrimonial: ['', [Validators.maxLength(60)]],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)],
    ],
    marca: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    modelo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    serie: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
    fechaAdquisicion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    montoAdquisicion: [0, [Validators.min(0), Validators.max(999999999999)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
    proveedorEmpresaId: [0],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly stateForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    estado: [
      ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,
      [Validators.required],
    ],
    motivo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly incidentForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipo: [ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia, [Validators.required]],
    fechaHora: [localDateTimeInputNow(), [Validators.required]],
    descripcion: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(700)],
    ],
    costoEstimado: [0, [Validators.min(0), Validators.max(999999999999)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('create');
    const selected = preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0;
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: selected,
      tipoBienId: 0,
      codigoPatrimonial: '',
      nombre: '',
      marca: '',
      modelo: '',
      serie: '',
      fechaAdquisicion: '',
      montoAdquisicion: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: 0,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId[this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable']({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: item.uotId ?? 0,
      tipoBienId: item.tipoBienId ?? 0,
      codigoPatrimonial: item.codigoPatrimonial ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      marca: item.marca ?? '',
      modelo: item.modelo ?? '',
      serie: item.serie ?? '',
      fechaAdquisicion: item.fechaAdquisicion ?? '',
      montoAdquisicion: item.montoAdquisicion ?? 0,
      moneda: item.monedaAdquisicion ?? 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: item.proveedorEmpresaId ?? 0,
      observacion: item.observacion ?? '',
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  openState(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('state');
    this.current.set(item);
    const valid = this.states.find((state) => state.value === item.estadoBien);
    this.stateForm.reset({
      estado: valid?.value ?? ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,
      motivo: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openIncident(item: ResourceAssetResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.mode.set('incident');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.incidentForm.reset({
      tipo: ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia,
      fechaHora: localDateTimeInputNow(),
      descripcion: '',
      costoEstimado: 0,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    this.form.controls.proveedorEmpresaId.setValue(0, { emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    if (this.mode() === 'create') this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'state') {
      this.saveState();
      return;
    }
    if (this.mode() === 'incident') {
      this.saveIncident();
      return;
    }
    this.saveAsset();
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'edit':
        return 'Editar bien';
      case 'state':
        return 'Cambiar estado';
      case 'incident':
        return 'Registrar incidencia';
      default:
        return 'Registrar bien';
    }
  }

  private saveAsset(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const amount = Number(raw.montoAdquisicion);
    const providerId = Number(raw.proveedorEmpresaId);

    const common = {
      tipoBienId: Number(raw.tipoBienId),
      nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
      marca: normalizeOptionalText(raw.marca),
      modelo: normalizeOptionalText(raw.modelo),
      serie: normalizeOptionalText(raw.serie),
      fechaAdquisicion: raw.fechaAdquisicion || undefined,
      montoAdquisicion: amount > 0 ? amount : undefined,
      moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
      proveedorEmpresaId: providerId > 0 ? providerId : undefined,
      observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
    };

    const operation =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.bienInventarioId
        ? this.api.updateAsset(this.current()!.bienInventarioId!, common)
        : this.api.createAsset({
            uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
            codigoPatrimonial:
              raw.codigoPatrimonial.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
            ...common,
          });

    this.run(operation, this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Bien actualizado' : 'Bien registrado');
  }

  private saveState(): void {
    const item = this.current();
    this.stateForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!item?.bienInventarioId || this.stateForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.stateForm.getRawValue();
    this.run(
      this.api.changeAssetState(item.bienInventarioId, {
        estado: raw.estado,
        motivo: normalizeOptionalText(raw.motivo),
      }),
      'Estado actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveIncident(): void {
    const item = this.current();
    this.incidentForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!item?.bienInventarioId || this.incidentForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.incidentForm.getRawValue();
    const cost = Number(raw.costoEstimado);
    const body: ResourceAssetIncidentRequest = {
      tipo: raw.tipo,
      fechaHora: raw.fechaHora,
      descripcion: normalizeText(raw.descripcion),
      costoEstimado: cost > 0 ? cost : undefined,
    };

    this.run(
      this.api.reportAssetIncident(item.bienInventarioId, body),
      'Incidencia registrada',
    );
  }

  private run(operation: Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.form.controls.codigoPatrimonial;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'BIEN')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      types: this.refs.catalog('TIPO_BIEN'),
      organizations: this.listOrganizations.execute(1, 200, Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId) || undefined),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ types, organizations }) => {
          this.assetTypes.set(
            types.map((item) => ({
              value: Number(item.id),
              label: item.label,
              description: item.code,
            })),
          );
          this.organizations.set(
            organizations.items
              .filter((item) => item.estado)
              .map((item) => ({
                value: item.empresaId,
                label: item.razonSocial,
                description: item.ruc,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';

type SupplyFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'movement';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-suministro-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './suministro-form.html',
  styleUrl: './suministro-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SuministroFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly resourceApi = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<SupplyFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoMovimiento: ['ENTRADA', [Validators.required]],
    cantidad: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      unidadMedida: 'UND',
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
    });

    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.uotId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.enable({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      codigo: item.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      unidadMedida: item.unidadMedida ?? 'UND',
      stockInicial: Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0),
      stockMinimo: Number(item.stockMinimo ?? 0),
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('movement');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      tipoMovimiento: 'ENTRADA',
      cantidad: 0,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.movementForm.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'create') this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return 'Editar suministro';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar suministro';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return this.editIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.addIcon;
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveSupply();
    }
  }

  private saveSupply(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const uotId = Number(raw.uotId);
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.suministroId
        ? this.api.update(Number(this.current()!.suministroId), {
            uotId,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          })
        : this.api.create({
            uotId,
            codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Suministro actualizado' : 'Suministro registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    const supply = this.current();
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!supply?.suministroId || this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .registerMovement(Number(supply.suministroId), {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        tipoMovimiento: raw.tipoMovimiento,
        cantidad: Number(raw.cantidad),
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Movimiento registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.form.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.resourceApi
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'SUMINISTRO')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
            Guardando...

</dialog>
```
