```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCoins,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ResourceProductResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(700)]],
    unidadMedida: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)],
    ],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(100)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      unidadMedida: '',
      categoria: '',
    });
    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }

    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(item: ResourceProductResponse, uotId: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: uotId,
      precio: item.precioVenta ?? 0,
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });
    this.priceForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onCreateUotChange(): void {
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  uotLabel(form: 'create' | 'price' = 'create'): string {
    const id = form === 'price'
      ? Number(this.priceForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId)
      : Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);

    return this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'price') {
      this.savePrice();
      return;
    }
    this.saveProduct();
  }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const code = raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();

    this.api
      .createProduct({
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        codigo: code || undefined,
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
        categoria: normalizeOptionalText(raw.categoria),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Producto registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!product?.productoId || this.priceForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .versionProductPrice(product.productoId, {
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        uotPrecioId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        precio: Number(raw.precio),
        moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Nueva versión de precio registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'PRODUCTO')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Productos"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general de catálogo y precios por UOT.' : 'Catálogo y precios vigentes para ' + contextUotName() + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button class="admin-secondary-button" type="button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
    </button>
    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" class="admin-primary-button" type="button" (click)="create()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Registrar producto
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface product-filters">
    <label>
      <span>UOT</span>
      @if (isGeneral()) {
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      } @else {
        <input class="admin-input" [value]="contextUotName()" readonly />
      }
    </label>
    <label class="product-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <input class="admin-input" type="search" placeholder="Código, producto, categoría, UOT..." [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" />
    </label>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando productos" message="Consultando productos y precios por UOT." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los productos.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (filtered().length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin productos" message="No existen productos para los filtros seleccionados." />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface product-table-shell">
      <div class="admin-table-scroll">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead><tr><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Precio vigente</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of filtered(); track rowKey(item)) {
              <tr>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.contextUotNombre }}</strong><span>{{ item.contextUotCodigo }}</span></div></td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</strong></td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="product-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small></td>
                <td>{{ item.categoria || '—' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.unidadMedida || '—' }}</td>
                <td>
                  @if (item.precioVenta != null) { <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong> }
                  @else { <span class="product-help">Sin precio</span> }
                </td>
                <td>{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</td>
                <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                  <button
                    *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'"
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                    title="Registrar una nueva versión de precio para esta UOT"
                    (click)="price(item)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /> Precio
                  </button>
                  <button
                    *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_LISTAR'"
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                    title="Ver todas las versiones de precio de esta UOT"
                    (click)="toggleHistory(item)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" /> Historial
                  </button>
                  <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Imágenes de esta UOT" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
                </div></td>
              </tr>

              @if (sameRow(historyProduct(), item)) {
                <tr class="product-images-row">
                  <td colspan="8">
                    <div class="p-3">
                      <strong>Historial de precios · {{ item.contextUotNombre }}</strong>
                      @if (historyLoading()) {
                        <app-loading-state title="Cargando historial" message="Consultando versiones de precio." />
                      } @else if (historyError()) {
                        <app-error-state [message]="historyError() || 'No se pudo consultar el historial.'" (retry)="loadHistory(item)" />
                      } @else if (priceHistory().length === 0) {
                        <app-empty-state title="Sin historial" message="Este producto todavía no tiene precios registrados en esta UOT." />
                      } @else {
                        <div class="admin-table-scroll mt-3">
                          <table class="admin-table">
                            <thead><tr><th>Versión</th><th>Precio</th><th>Desde</th><th>Hasta</th><th>Registrado por</th><th>Estado</th></tr></thead>
                            <tbody>
                              @for (price of priceHistory(); track price.productoPrecioId) {
                                <tr>
                                  <td>v{{ price.version }}</td>
                                  <td><strong>{{ price.moneda }} {{ price.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                                  <td>{{ price.fechaDesde || '—' }}</td>
                                  <td>{{ price.fechaHasta || 'Vigente' }}</td>
                                  <td>{{ price.nombreUsuario || 'Sistema' }}</td>
                                  <td><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="price.vigente">{{ price.vigente ? 'Vigente' : 'Histórico' }}</span></td>
                                </tr>
                              }
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      }
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }

              @if (sameRow(selectedForImages(), item)) {
                <tr class="product-images-row">
                  <td colspan="8">
                    <app-local-file-panel [uotId]="item.contextUotId" linkType="PRODUCTO" [linkId]="item.productoId || 0" [fileIds]="imageIds(item)" title="Imagen principal del producto" category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN" accept="image/*" [forcePrincipal]="true" (changed)="load()" />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-producto-form />
```

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faCoins,
  faImage,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTags,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceProductResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import {
  ResourceApiService,
  ResourceProductPriceHistory,
} from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

interface ProductRow extends ResourceProductResponse {
  contextUotId: number;
  contextUotCodigo: string;
  contextUotNombre: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    LocalFilePanelComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './productos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ProductRow[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly selectedForImages = signal<ProductRow | null>(null);
  readonly historyProduct = signal<ProductRow | null>(null);
  readonly historyLoading = signal(false);
  readonly historyError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly priceHistory = signal<readonly ResourceProductPriceHistory[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faTags;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly units = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());
  readonly contextUotId = computed(() =>
    this.isGeneral() ? this.unitFilter() : this.uot.selectedId(),
  );
  readonly contextUotName = computed(() => {
    const id = this.contextUotId();
    return id
      ? this.units().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre ?? 'UOT'
      : 'Todas mis UOT';
  });

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.products();

    return this.products().filter((item) =>
      [
        item.codigo,
        item.nombre,
        item.categoria,
        item.unidadMedida,
        item.contextUotNombre,
        item.contextUotCodigo,
      ].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query)),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' ? this.uot.selectedId() : null);
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const selectedId = this.contextUotId();
    const units = selectedId
      ? this.units().filter((unit) => unit.uotId === selectedId)
      : this.units();

    const request = units.length === 0
      ? of([] as ProductRow[])
      : forkJoin(
          units.map((unit) =>
            this.api.listProducts(unit.uotId).pipe(
              map((items) =>
                items.map((item) => ({
                  ...item,
                  contextUotId: unit.uotId,
                  contextUotCodigo: unit.codigo,
                  contextUotNombre: unit.nombre,
                }) satisfies ProductRow),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ).pipe(map((groups) => groups.flat()));

    request
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.products.set(items);
          this.reconcileExpandedRows(items);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.historyProduct.set(null);
    this.selectedForImages.set(null);
    this.priceHistory.set([]);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.contextUotId() ?? undefined);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async price(item: ProductRow): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item, item.contextUotId);
    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
      if (this.sameRow(this.historyProduct(), item)) this.loadHistory(item);
    }
  }

  toggleHistory(item: ProductRow): void {
    if (this.sameRow(this.historyProduct(), item)) {
      this.historyProduct.set(null);
      this.priceHistory.set([]);
      this.historyError.set(null);
      return;
    }
    this.loadHistory(item);
  }

  loadHistory(item: ProductRow): void {
    const productId = item.productoId;
    if (!productId || !item.contextUotId) return;

    this.historyProduct.set(item);
    this.historyLoading.set(true);
    this.historyError.set(null);
    this.priceHistory.set([]);

    this.api.listProductPriceHistory(productId, item.contextUotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.historyLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.priceHistory.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.historyError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  selectImages(item: ProductRow): void {
    this.selectedForImages.set(
      this.sameRow(this.selectedForImages(), item) ? null : item,
    );
  }

  imageIds(item: ResourceProductResponse): readonly number[] {
    return item.archivoPrincipalId ? [item.archivoPrincipalId] : [];
  }

  rowKey(item: ProductRow): string {
    return `${item.productoId ?? 0}-${item.contextUotId}`;
  }

  sameRow(left: ProductRow | null, right: ProductRow): boolean {
    return Boolean(
      left
      && left.productoId === right.productoId
      && left.contextUotId === right.contextUotId,
    );
  }

  private reconcileExpandedRows(items: readonly ProductRow[]): void {
    const images = this.selectedForImages();
    if (images) {
      this.selectedForImages.set(
        items.find((item) => this.sameRow(images, item)) ?? null,
      );
    }

    const history = this.historyProduct();
    if (history) {
      this.historyProduct.set(
        items.find((item) => this.sameRow(history, item)) ?? null,
      );
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faPowerOff,
  faRotate,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceAssetResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import {
  closeAnimatedDialog,
  openAnimatedDialog,
} from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../recursos/shared/supply-api.service';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import {
  UotDeactivationImpact,
  UotUnit,
} from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-deactivation-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-deactivation-form.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-deactivation-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotDeactivationFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly suppliesApi = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly current = signal<UotUnit | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly impact = signal<UotDeactivationImpact | null>(null);
  readonly assets = signal<readonly ResourceAssetResponse[]>([]);
  readonly supplies = signal<readonly SupplySummaryResponse[]>([]);
  readonly sourceWarehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly targetWarehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly targetLoading = signal(false);
  readonly transferring = signal(false);
  readonly deactivating = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly transferIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly deactivateIcon = faPowerOff;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly warningIcon = faTriangleExclamation;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotDestinoId: [0],
    almacenOrigenId: [0],
    almacenDestinoId: [0],
    transferirStock: [true],
    motivo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.minLength(5),
        Validators.maxLength(300),
      ],
    ],
  });

  open(
    unit: UotUnit,
    units: readonly UotUnit[],
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(unit);
    this.units.set(units);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.impact.set(null);
    this.assets.set([]);
    this.supplies.set([]);
    this.sourceWarehouses.set([]);
    this.targetWarehouses.set([]);

    const defaultTarget =
      units.find(
        (item) =>
          item.estado &&
          item.uotId !== unit.uotId &&
          !this.isDescendantOf(item, unit.uotId),
      ) ?? null;

    this.form.reset({
      uotDestinoId: defaultTarget?.uotId ?? 0,
      almacenOrigenId: 0,
      almacenDestinoId: 0,
      transferirStock: true,
      motivo: '',
    });

    this.loadSource();
    if (defaultTarget) {
      this.loadTargetWarehouses(defaultTarget.uotId);
    }

    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (
      !this.loading() &&
      !this.transferring() &&
      !this.deactivating()
    ) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  targetOptions(): readonly UotUnit[] {
    const current = this.current();
    if (!current) return [];

    return this.units().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.estado &&
        item.uotId !== current.uotId &&
        !this.isDescendantOf(item, current.uotId),
    );
  }

  onTargetChange(raw: string): void {
    const id = Number(raw);
    this.form.controls.almacenDestinoId.setValue(0);

    if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) {
      this.targetWarehouses.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.loadTargetWarehouses(id);
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this.loadSource();
  }

  transfer(): void {
    const unit = this.current();
    const impact = this.impact();

    if (!unit || !impact || this.transferring()) return;

    this.form.controls.motivo.markAsTouched();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const targetId = Number(raw.uotDestinoId);

    if (targetId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione la UOT que recibirá los recursos.');
      return;
    }

    if (this.form.controls.motivo.invalid) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Indique el motivo de la transferencia.');
      return;
    }

    const transferStock =
      raw.transferirStock &&
      (impact.productosConStock > 0 || impact.stockReservado > 0);

    const sourceWarehouseId = Number(raw.almacenOrigenId);
    const targetWarehouseId = Number(raw.almacenDestinoId);

    if (
      transferStock &&
      (sourceWarehouseId <= 0 || targetWarehouseId <= 0)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'Para transferir stock seleccione el almacén origen y el almacén destino.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const assetIds = this.assets()
      .filter((item) => item.estado !== false)
      .map((item) => Number(item.bienInventarioId))
      .filter((id) => id > 0);

    const supplyIds = this.supplies()
      .filter(
        (item) =>
          item.estado !== false &&
          Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0) > 0,
      )
      .map((item) => Number(item.suministroId))
      .filter((id) => id > 0);

    this.transferring.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .transferResources(unit.uotId, {
        uotDestinoId: targetId,
        almacenOrigenId:
          transferStock && sourceWarehouseId > 0
            ? sourceWarehouseId
            : undefined,
        almacenDestinoId:
          transferStock && targetWarehouseId > 0
            ? targetWarehouseId
            : undefined,
        transferirStock: transferStock,
        bienIds: assetIds.length ? assetIds : undefined,
        suministroIds: supplyIds.length ? supplyIds : undefined,
        motivo: normalizeText(raw.motivo),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.transferring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.toast.success(
            'Recursos transferidos',
            `${result.productosTransferidos} productos, ${result.bienesTransferidos} bienes y ${result.suministrosTransferidos} suministros procesados.`,
          );
          this.loadSource();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudieron transferir los recursos', message);
        },
      });
  }

  deactivate(): void {
    const unit = this.current();
    const impact = this.impact();

    if (
      !unit ||
      !impact?.puedeDeshabilitar ||
      this.deactivating()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.form.controls.motivo.markAsTouched();
    if (this.form.controls.motivo.invalid) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Indique el motivo de la baja de la UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.deactivating.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .deactivate(unit.uotId, normalizeText(this.form.controls.motivo.value))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.deactivating.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('UOT deshabilitada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: unit.uotId });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar la UOT', message);
        },
      });
  }

  requiresResourceTransfer(): boolean {
    const value = this.impact();
    return Boolean(
      value &&
        (value.productosConStock > 0 ||
          value.bienesActivos > 0 ||
          value.suministrosConStock > 0),
    );
  }

  hasOperationalBlocks(): boolean {
    const value = this.impact();
    return Boolean(
      value &&
        (value.ventasAbiertas > 0 ||
          value.campaniasAbiertas > 0 ||
          value.operativosAbiertos > 0 ||
          value.salidasAbiertas > 0 ||
          value.recursosAbiertos > 0 ||
          value.stockReservado > 0 ||
          value.suministrosReservados > 0),
    );
  }

  private loadSource(): void {
    const unit = this.current();
    if (!unit) return;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      impact: this.api.impact(unit.uotId),
      assets: this.resources.listAssets(unit.uotId),
      supplies: this.suppliesApi.listAll(unit.uotId),
      warehouses: this.resources.listWarehouses(unit.uotId),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ impact, assets, supplies, warehouses }) => {
          this.impact.set(impact);
          this.assets.set(assets);
          this.supplies.set(supplies);
          this.sourceWarehouses.set(
            warehouses.filter(
              (item) =>
                item.estado !== false &&
                item.permiteSalida !== false,
            ),
          );

          const sourceId = Number(this.form.controls.almacenOrigenId.value);
          if (
            sourceId <= 0 ||
            !this.sourceWarehouses().some(
              (item) => Number(item.almacenId) === sourceId,
            )
          ) {
            this.form.controls.almacenOrigenId.setValue(
              Number(this.sourceWarehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0),
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
        },
      });
  }

  private loadTargetWarehouses(uotId: number): void {
    this.targetLoading.set(true);

    this.resources
      .listWarehouses(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.targetLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.targetWarehouses.set(
            items.filter(
              (item) =>
                item.estado !== false &&
                item.permiteEntrada !== false,
            ),
          );
          this.form.controls.almacenDestinoId.setValue(
            Number(this.targetWarehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.targetWarehouses.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private isDescendantOf(
    candidate: UotUnit,
    ancestorId: number,
  ): boolean {
    let parentId = candidate.uotPadreId;
    const visited = new Set<number>();

    while (parentId && !visited.has(parentId)) {
      if (parentId === ancestorId) return true;
      visited.add(parentId);
      parentId =
        this.units().find((item) => item.uotId === parentId)
          ?.uotPadreId ?? null;
    }

    return false;
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.current.set(null);
      this.impact.set(null);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
    });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Almacenes y stock"
    subtitle="Stock por almacén/UOT, movimientos y Kardex."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-secondary-button"
      [disabled]="warehouses().length === 0 || products().length === 0"
      (click)="movement()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" />
      Movimiento
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
      type="button"
      class="admin-primary-button"
      (click)="createWarehouse()"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
      Registrar almacén
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface warehouse-toolbar">
    @if (uot.modo() === 'GENERAL') {
      <label>
        <span>UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Almacén</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="warehouseFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onWarehouseChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Producto</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="productFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onProductChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
          <option [value]="product.productoId">{{ product.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
  </section>

  <div class="warehouse-tabs" role="tablist">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'warehouses'" (click)="setTab('warehouses')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /> Almacenes
    </button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'stock'" (click)="setTab('stock')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="stockIcon" /> Stock
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_KARDEX'"
      type="button"
      [class.active]="activeTab() === 'kardex'"
      (click)="setTab('kardex')"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="kardexIcon" /> Kardex
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando almacenes" message="Consultando stock y movimientos." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los almacenes.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'warehouses') {
    @if (warehouses().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin almacenes" message="No existen almacenes disponibles para el contexto actual." />
    } @else {
      <section class="warehouse-card-grid">
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <article class="admin-surface warehouse-card">
            <header>
              <span class="warehouse-card-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /></span>
              <div>
                <strong>{{ warehouse.nombre || 'Almacén' }}</strong>
                <small>{{ warehouse.codigo || '—' }}</small>
              </div>
              <span class="warehouse-access">{{ warehouse.tipoAcceso || 'PROPIO' }}</span>
            </header>
            <dl>
              <div><dt>UOT propietaria</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.uotPropietaria || '—' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Entradas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteEntrada === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Salidas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteSalida === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
            </dl>
            @if (warehouse.descripcion) { <p>{{ warehouse.descripcion }}</p> }
            <footer>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                [disabled]="warehouse.permiteEntrada === false"
                (click)="configureProduct(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="configureIcon" />
                Agregar producto
              </button>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                (click)="share(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="shareIcon" />
                Compartir
              </button>
            </footer>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'stock') {
    @if (filteredStock().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin stock" message="No existen saldos para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Almacén</th><th>Producto</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Actualización</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredStock(); track item.almacenId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen }}</td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.producto }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockActual | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockReservado | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td><strong class="stock-value" [class]="stockTone(item)">{{ item.stockDisponible | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaActualizacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  } @else {
    @if (kardex().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin movimientos" message="No existen movimientos en el Kardex para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Fecha</th><th>UOT</th><th>Almacén</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Producto</th><th>Naturaleza</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Referencia</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of kardex(); track item.movimientoInventarioId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.producto || '—' }}</td>
                  <td><span class="warehouse-nature">{{ item.naturaleza === 'E' ? 'Entrada' : 'Salida' }}</span></td>
                  <td>{{ item.cantidad | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-almacen-operation-form />
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header title="Inventario y suministros" subtitle="Bienes patrimoniales, vehículos y consumibles por UOT, con paginación y trazabilidad." [icon]="pageIcon">
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()"><fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button>
    <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />{{ activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Registrar bien' : 'Registrar suministro' }}</button>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5"><button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'assets'" (click)="setTab('assets')"><fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" /> Bienes y vehículos</button><button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'supplies'" (click)="setTab('supplies')"><fa-icon [icon]="supplyIcon" /> Suministros</button></div>

  <section class="admin-surface resource-filter-bar">
    <div class="resource-filter-title"><fa-icon [icon]="filterIcon" /><span>Filtros</span></div>
    @if (isGeneral()) { <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>UOT</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)"><option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>@for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) { <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option> }</select></label> }
    <label class="resource-filter-field resource-filter-field--search"><span>Buscar</span><div class="resource-search-control"><input class="admin-input" type="search" [placeholder]="activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Código, bien, marca, serie…' : 'Código, suministro, unidad…'" [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" (keyup.enter)="applyFilters()" /><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Buscar" (click)="applyFilters()"><fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" /></button></div></label>
    @if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
```

```html
    <label class="product-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <div class="product-search-control">
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Código o nombre del producto"
          [value]="search()"
          (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
          (keyup.enter)="applyFilters()"
        />
        <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Buscar" (click)="applyFilters()">
          <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Categoría</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="categoryFilter()" (change)="categoryFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()">
        <option value="">Todas</option>
        @for (category of categories(); track category.code) {
          <option [value]="category.code">{{ category.label }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Estado</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()">
        <option value="ACTIVE">Activos</option>
        <option value="INACTIVE">Inactivos</option>
        <option value="ALL">Todos</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <div class="product-view-switch" aria-label="Modo de visualización">
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'table'" title="Vista tabla" (click)="setView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /></button>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'cards'" title="Vista tarjetas" (click)="setView('cards')"><fa-icon [icon]="cardsIcon" /></button>
    </div>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando productos" message="Consultando el catálogo paginado." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los productos.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin productos" message="No existen productos para los filtros seleccionados." />
  } @else {
    @if (viewMode() === 'table') {
      <section class="admin-surface product-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead><tr><th>Imagen</th><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Precio vigente</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of result().items; track rowKey(item)) {
                <tr>
                  <td><app-resource-image variant="thumb" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" /></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><span>{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</span></div></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="product-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small></td>
                  <td>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.precioVigente != null) {
                      <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong>
                      @if (item.precioVersion) { <small class="product-help">Versión {{ item.precioVersion }}</small> }
                    } @else { <span class="product-help">Sin precio vigente</span> }
                  </td>
                  <td><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <a *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/productos', item.productoId]" [queryParams]="detailQuery(item)" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Registrar nueva versión de precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Gestionar imagen" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>
                </tr>
                @if (isImagesSelected(item)) {
                  <tr class="product-images-row"><td colspan="9">
                    <app-local-file-panel
                      [uotId]="item.uotId || 0"
                      linkType="PRODUCTO"
                      [linkId]="item.productoId || 0"
                      [fileIds]="imageIds(item)"
                      title="Imagen principal del producto"
                      category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN"
                      accept="image/*"
                      [forcePrincipal]="true"
                      [canUpload]="canUploadImages()"
                      (changed)="load()"
                    />
                  </td></tr>
                }
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    } @else {
      <section class="product-card-grid">
        @for (item of result().items; track rowKey(item)) {
          <article class="admin-surface product-card">
            <app-resource-image variant="card" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" />
            <div class="product-card-body">
              <div class="product-card-heading"><div><small>{{ item.uotNombre || 'UOT' }}</small><h3>{{ item.nombre || 'Producto' }}</h3><span>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</span></div><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></div>
              <p>{{ item.descripcion || 'Sin descripción.' }}</p>
              <dl><div><dt>Categoría</dt><dd>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Unidad</dt><dd>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div class="product-card-price"><dt>Precio vigente</dt><dd>@if (item.precioVigente != null) { {{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }} } @else { Sin precio }</dd></div></dl>
              <footer>
                <a *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_VER'" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [routerLink]="['/recursos/productos', item.productoId]" [queryParams]="detailQuery(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /> Detalle</a>
                <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Nuevo precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Gestionar imagen" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
              </footer>
              @if (isImagesSelected(item)) {
                <div class="product-card-files"><app-local-file-panel [uotId]="item.uotId || 0" linkType="PRODUCTO" [linkId]="item.productoId || 0" [fileIds]="imageIds(item)" title="Imagen principal" category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN" accept="image/*" [forcePrincipal]="true" [canUpload]="canUploadImages()" (changed)="load()" /></div>
              }
            </div>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }

    <app-paginator
      [page]="result().page"
      [size]="result().size"
      [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
      [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
      (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
      (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
    />
  }
</div>

<app-producto-form />
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  ProducerCreateRequest,
  ProducerRetireRequest,
  ProducerUpdateRequest,
  ProductoresService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { ProductoresGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/productores.gateway';
import { ProductorFiltro } from '../../../domain/productor-filtro.model';
import { ProductorCreate, ProductorUpdate } from '../../../domain/productor.model';
import { ProductoresHttpMapper } from './productores-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ProductoresHttpAdapter implements ProductoresGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(ProductoresService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(ProductoresHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: ProductorFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .productoresListar(
        {
          buscar: filter.buscar,
          asociacionId: filter.asociacionId,
          situacion: filter.situacion,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .productoresVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  create(input: ProductorCreate) {
    const producerCreateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as ProducerCreateRequest;

    return this.api
      .productoresCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          producerCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: ProductorUpdate) {
    const producerUpdateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as ProducerUpdateRequest;

    return this.api
      .productoresEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          producerUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  retire(id: number, fechaRetiro: string, motivo: string) {
    const producerRetireRequest: ProducerRetireRequest = { fechaRetiro, motivo };

    return this.api
      .productoresRetirar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          producerRetireRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(
        ([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== '',
      ),
    ) as T;
  }
}
```

```typescript
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {

import {

} from '../../../../../domain/productor.model';

type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {

}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    names: false,

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productor-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productor-form.html',
  styleUrl: './productor-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductorFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearProductorUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarProductorUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly current = signal<Productor | ProductorDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly associations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityEditingEnabled = signal(false);
  readonly identityRecordLoaded = signal(false);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly maxBirthDate = maxBirthDateIso();
  readonly minBirthDate = minBirthDateIso();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoProductor;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  readonly memberships: readonly {
    value: SituacionMembresia;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'ACTIVO', label: 'Activo' },
    { value: 'SUSPENDIDO', label: 'Suspendido' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoProductor,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [personNameValidator, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(30)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [adultBirthDateValidator()]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      fechaAlta: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      asociacionId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoSocio: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaDesde: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      situacionMembresia: [
        'ACTIVO' as SituacionMembresia,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaAlta',
          'fechaDesde',
          'membershipDateOrder',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    associations: readonly AdminSelectOption[],
    producer: Productor | ProductorDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.associations.set(associations);
    this.current.set(producer);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = producer && 'fechaNacimiento' in producer
      ? (producer as ProductorDetalle)
      : null;
    const today = this.today;
    const type = this.normalizeProducerDocumentType(
      producer?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: producer?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: producer?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: producer?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: producer?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: producer?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaAlta: producer?.fechaAlta ?? today,
      asociacionId:
        producer?.asociacionId ?? associations[0]?.value ?? 0,
      codigoSocio:
        producer?.codigoSocio
          ?? buildSystemCode(
            'SOC',
            producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
            30,
          ),
      fechaDesde:
        detail?.afiliaciones.find((item) => item.estado)?.fechaDesde
        ?? producer?.fechaAlta
        ?? today,
      situacionMembresia:
        (producer?.situacionMembresia as SituacionMembresia)
        || 'ACTIVO',
    });

    this.form.controls.fechaAlta[
      producer ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);

    if (producer) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);
      this.identityLocks.set({
        names: true,
        paternalSurname: true,
        maternalSurname: true,
        birthDate: true,
        phone: true,
        email: true,
        geography: true,
        reference: true,
      });

      if (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(type, producer.numeroDocumento),
        );
      }
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')) {
      this.form.patchValue({
        centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
    this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedPartnerCode();
    }

    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.current();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      raw.tipoDocumento,
      raw.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(raw.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${raw.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'No se puede usar esta persona para el socio.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: raw.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(sanitizePersonName(raw.nombres)),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(sanitizePersonName(raw.apellidoPaterno)),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(sanitizePersonName(raw.apellidoMaterno)),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(sanitizePhone(raw.telefono)),
      correo: raw.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: raw.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      asociacionId: Number(raw.asociacionId),
      codigoSocio: raw.codigoSocio.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaDesde: raw.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: raw.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
      },
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<number | void> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.socioId, common)
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          ...common,
          fechaAlta: raw.fechaAlta,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Productor actualizado'
              : 'Productor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value:
              typeof value === 'number'
                ? value
                : current?.socioId ?? null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el productor'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el productor',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  sanitizePersonInput(
    field: 'nombres' | 'apellidoPaterno' | 'apellidoMaterno',
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls[field];
    const clean = sanitizePersonName(control.value);

    if (clean !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(clean, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  sanitizePhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.telefono;
    const clean = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (clean !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(clean, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedPartnerCode(): void {
    if (this.current()) {
      return;
    }

    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoSocio.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('SOC', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    const current = this.current();

    if (
      result.isPartner
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.socioId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta persona ya está registrada como socio.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);

      const resolvedType = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
      const resolvedDocument = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value;

      if (resolvedType === 'DNI' || resolvedType === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(resolvedType, resolvedDocument),
        );
      }

      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set('Datos de la persona cargados.');
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = result.found
      ? {
          names: true,
          paternalSurname: true,
          maternalSurname: true,
          birthDate: true,
          phone: true,
          email: true,
          geography: true,
          reference: true,
        }
      : emptyIdentityFieldLocks();

    this.form.patchValue({
      tipoDocumento:
        result.documentType === 'RUC' ? 'RUC' :
        result.documentType === 'DNI' ? 'DNI' :
        this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      numeroDocumento:
        result.documentNumber?.trim() ||
        this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone).slice(0, 30)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  canEditIdentityData(): boolean {
    return this.permissions.has('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR');
  }

  canToggleIdentityEditing(): boolean {
    return this.identityRecordLoaded()
      && this.canEditIdentityData();
  }

  toggleIdentityEditing(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(
      enabled && this.canToggleIdentityEditing(),
    );
  }

  isIdentityFieldReadOnly(
    field: keyof IdentityFieldLocks,
  ): boolean {
    return this.identityLocks()[field]
      && !this.identityEditingEnabled();
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(false);
    this.identityRecordLoaded.set(false);
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoProductor,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeProducerDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoProductor {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}
```
