```typescript
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
  phoneValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
  sanitizePhone,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface OrganizationFormOptions {
  preferredUotId?: number;
}

interface AreaModalOptions extends OrganizationFormOptions {
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('JURIDICA'),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    numeroPartida: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    options: OrganizationFormOptions = {},
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail, options.preferredUotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    options: OrganizationFormOptions = {},
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail, options.preferredUotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);

    const uotId = this.resolveTargetUotId(
      area?.uotId ?? options.preferredUotId,
    );

    this.areaForm.reset({
      uotId,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });

    this.configureUotControl(this.areaForm.controls.uotId, Boolean(area));
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.valid
      && this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value.length === 11;
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    const ruc = control.value.trim();

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onOrganizationPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedUot(): readonly Area[] {
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;
    const blockedIds = new Set<number>();

    if (currentAreaId !== null) {
      blockedIds.add(currentAreaId);

      let changed = true;
      while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        for (const area of this.areaOptions()) {
          if (
            area.areaPadreId !== null &&
            blockedIds.has(area.areaPadreId) &&
            !blockedIds.has(area.areaId)
          ) {
            blockedIds.add(area.areaId);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const uotId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().uotId);

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.uotId === uotId &&
        !blockedIds.has(area.areaId) &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      uotId: this.resolveTargetUotId(company?.uotId ?? preferredUotId),
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: sanitizePhone(company?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (company?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.configureUotControl(this.companyForm.controls.uotId, Boolean(company));

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.companyForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          'Valide el RUC antes de guardar.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      uotId: Number(values.uotId),
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.uotId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          uotId: Number(values.uotId),
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          uotId: Number(values.uotId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );
    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed
        ? 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Complete la información manualmente.'
        : 'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.areaForm.controls.areaPadreId.setValue(0);
    }
  }

  uotLabel(uotId?: number | null): string {
    const id = uotId ?? (
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().uotId)
        : Number(this.companyForm.getRawValue().uotId)
    );

    return this.uot.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  private resolveTargetUotId(preferredUotId?: number | null): number {
    return preferredUotId
      ?? this.uot.selectedId()
      ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId
      ?? 0;
  }

  private configureUotControl(
    control: { enable(options?: { emitEvent?: boolean }): void; disable(options?: { emitEvent?: boolean }): void },
    editing: boolean,
  ): void {
    if (editing || this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      control.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.resetState();
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../../../../../../../shared/files/local-document-api.service';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-documentos-locales-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './documentos-locales.html',
  styleUrl: './documentos-locales.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DocumentosLocalesPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly api = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly items = signal<readonly LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>([]);
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly category = signal('DOCUMENTO');
  readonly description = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faFolderOpen;
  readonly uploadIcon = faFileArrowUp;
  readonly viewIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .list(unitId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.items.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load();
  }

  upload(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const file = input.files?.item(0) ?? null;
    input.value = '';
    if (!file || this.uploading()) return;

    const uotId =
      this.unitFilter() ??
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Selecciona una UOT',
        'La carga de documentos requiere una UOT específica.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (file.size <= 0 || file.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Archivo no permitido',
        'El archivo debe tener contenido y no superar 25 MB.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.uploading.set(true);
    this.api
      .upload({
        uotId,
        file,
        category: this.category().trim().toUpperCase() || 'DOCUMENTO',
        description: this.description().trim() || undefined,
        linkType: 'NINGUNO',
        principal: false,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.uploading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.description.set('');
          this.toast.success('Documento guardado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el documento',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  open(item: LocalDocumentFileResponse): void {
    if (!item.archivoId) return;

    this.api.content(item.archivoId).subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
      },
      error: (error) =>
        this.toast.error(
          'No se pudo abrir el archivo',
          mapOpenApiError(error).message,
        ),
    });
  }

  async retire(item: LocalDocumentFileResponse): Promise<void> {
    if (!item.archivoId) return;

    const answer = await this.alert.question(
      'Retirar documento',
      `¿Deseas retirar “${item.nombreOriginal || 'este archivo'}”? El archivo dejará de estar disponible.`,
      'Retirar',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!answer.confirmed) return;

    this.api
      .retire(
        item.archivoId,
        'Retiro solicitado desde el módulo de documentos locales.',
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Documento retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar el documento',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  sizeLabel(bytes?: number): string {
    const value = bytes ?? 0;
    if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
    if (value < 1024 * 1024) return `${(value / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(value / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormArray,
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCartPlus,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faTrashCan,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  localDateTimeInputNow,
  normalizeOptionalText,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-venta-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './venta-form.html',
  styleUrl: './venta-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentaFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly sales = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faCartPlus;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    almacenId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    separar: [false],
    reservaHasta: [''],
    clientePersonaId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    clienteEmpresaId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.form.controls.detalle;
  }

  open(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());

    const uotId =
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    this.form.reset({
      uotId,
      almacenId: 0,
      separar: false,
      reservaHasta: '',
      clientePersonaId: 0,
      clienteEmpresaId: 0,
      observacion: '',
    });

    this.loadReferences(uotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  onUnitChange(): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.controls.uotId.value);
    this.form.controls.almacenId.setValue(0);
    this.loadReferences(uotId);
  }

  onSeparatedChange(): void {
    const separated = this.form.controls.separar.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.reservaHasta;

    if (separated) {
      control.setValidators([Validators.required]);
      if (!control.value) {
        const now = new Date();
        now.setHours(now.getHours() + 24);
        const local = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
        control.setValue(local.toISOString().slice(0, 16));
      }
    } else {
      control.clearValidators();
      control.setValue('');
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    this.onSeparatedChange();
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro de la misma venta.');
      return;
    }

    if (raw.separar && raw.reservaHasta) {
      const reserveUntil = new Date(raw.reservaHasta);
      if (!Number.isFinite(reserveUntil.getTime()) || reserveUntil <= new Date()) {
        this.errorMessage.set('La reserva debe vencer en una fecha futura.');
        return;
      }
    }

    const personId = Number(raw.clientePersonaId);
    const companyId = Number(raw.clienteEmpresaId);

    if (personId > 0 && companyId > 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona un solo tipo de cliente.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.sales
      .create({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        clientePersonaId: personId > 0 ? personId : undefined,
        clienteEmpresaId: companyId > 0 ? companyId : undefined,
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
        })),
        separar: raw.separar,
        reservaHasta: raw.separar ? raw.reservaHasta : undefined,
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          const id =
            value && typeof value === 'object' && 'ventaId' in value
              ? Number((value as { ventaId?: number }).ventaId)
              : 0;
          this.toast.success(raw.separar ? 'Separación registrada' : 'Venta registrada');
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo registrar la venta', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private loadReferences(uotId: number): void {
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.products.set([]);
      this.warehouses.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      products: this.resources.listAllProducts(uotId),
      warehouses: this.resources.listWarehouses(uotId),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ products, warehouses }) => {
          this.products.set(products.filter((item) => item.estado !== false));
          this.warehouses.set(
            warehouses.filter(
              (item) => item.estado !== false && item.permiteSalida !== false,
            ),
          );
          this.form.controls.almacenId.setValue(
            this.warehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
          );
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Ventas"
    subtitle="Ventas, separaciones, pagos, comprobantes y entrega."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
    <button *appPermission="'VENTAS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
      Nueva venta
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface sales-filters">
    @if (uot.modo() === 'GENERAL') {
      <label>
        <span>UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Estado</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="onStateChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option value="">Todos</option>
        <option value="REGISTRADA">Registrada</option>
        <option value="SEPARADA">Separada</option>
        <option value="PAGO_PARCIAL">Pago parcial</option>
        <option value="PAGADA">Pagada</option>
        <option value="ENTREGADA">Entregada</option>
        <option value="ANULADA">Anulada</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="sales-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <input
        class="admin-input"
        type="search"
        placeholder="Venta, cliente, almacén..."
        [value]="search()"
        (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
      />
    </label>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando ventas" message="Consultando las operaciones del contexto actual." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar las ventas.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (filtered().length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin ventas" message="No existen ventas que coincidan con los filtros." />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface sales-table-shell">
      <div class="admin-table-scroll">

          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Venta</th>
              @if (uot.modo() === 'GENERAL') { <th>UOT</th> }
              <th>Fecha</th>
              <th>Cliente</th>
              <th>Almacén</th>
              <th>Estado</th>
              <th>Total</th>
              <th>Pagado</th>
              <th>Saldo</th>
              <th></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of filtered(); track item.ventaId) {
              <tr>
                <td><strong>#{{ item.ventaId }}</strong></td>
                @if (uot.modo() === 'GENERAL') { <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td> }
                <td>{{ item.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.cliente || 'Público general' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.almacen || '—' }}</td>
                <td><span class="sale-state" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoVenta)">{{ stateLabel(item.estadoVenta) }}</span></td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.total | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                <td>{{ item.pagado | number:'1.2-2' }}</td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.saldo | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                <td>
                  <a
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    [routerLink]="['/gestion-comercial/ventas', item.ventaId]"
                    title="Ver detalle"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                  </a>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-venta-form />
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCartShopping,
  faEye,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { SaleSummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleSummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';
import { VentaFormComponent } from '../venta-form/venta-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-ventas-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    VentaFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './ventas-list.html',
  styleUrl: './ventas-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentasListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(VentaFormComponent) private form!: VentaFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly sales = signal<readonly SaleSummaryResponse[]>([]);
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly search = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faCartShopping;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.sales();
    return this.sales().filter((item) =>
      [
        String(item.ventaId ?? ''),
        item.cliente,
        item.almacen,
        item.uotNombre,
      ].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query)),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .list(unitId, this.stateFilter() || undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.sales.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load();
  }

  onStateChange(value: string): void {
    this.stateFilter.set(value);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open();
    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
      if (result.value) {
        void this.router.navigate(['/gestion-comercial/ventas', result.value]);
      }
    }
  }

  stateClass(state?: string): string {
    const value = (state ?? '').toUpperCase();
    if (value === 'ENTREGADA' || value === 'PAGADA') return 'sale-state sale-state--ok';
    if (value === 'ANULADA') return 'sale-state sale-state--muted';
    if (value === 'PAGO_PARCIAL') return 'sale-state sale-state--warning';
    return 'sale-state sale-state--info';
  }

  stateLabel(state?: string): string {
    return (state ?? 'SIN ESTADO').replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }
}
```

```html
        </section>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

    <ng-template #actions>

            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type WarehouseFormMode = 'create' | 'share' | 'configure' | 'movement';

export interface WarehouseOperationOptions {
  warehouses: readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[];
  products: readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[];
  stock: readonly ResourceStockResponse[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacen-operation-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
    NgTemplateOutlet,
  ],
  templateUrl: './almacen-operation-form.html',
  styleUrl: './almacen-operation-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenOperationFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<WarehouseFormMode>('create');
  readonly currentWarehouse = signal<ResourceWarehouseResponse | null>(null);
  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly configureProducts = signal<readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly stock = signal<readonly ResourceStockResponse[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly loadingProducts = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly currencies = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly configureIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly movementTypes = [
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, label: 'Compra' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Donacion, label: 'Donación' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Devolucion, label: 'Devolución' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Consumo, label: 'Consumo' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Transferencia, label: 'Transferencia' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Ajuste, label: 'Ajuste' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Merma, label: 'Merma' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

  readonly configurableProducts = computed(() => {
    const warehouseId = Number(this.currentWarehouse()?.almacenId ?? 0);
    const configured = new Set(
      this.stock()
        .filter((item) => Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) === warehouseId)
        .map((item) => Number(item.productoId ?? 0)),
    );

    return this.configureProducts().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.estado !== false &&
        Number(item.productoId ?? 0) > 0 &&
        !configured.has(Number(item.productoId)),
    );
  });

  selectedConfigureProduct(): ResourceProductListItemResponse | null {
    const productId = Number(this.configureForm.controls.productoId.value);
    return (
      this.configureProducts().find(
        (item) => Number(item.productoId ?? 0) === productId,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(400)]],
  });

  readonly shareForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    permiteEntrada: [true],
    permiteSalida: [true],
  });

  readonly configureForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    costoUnitario: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.maxLength(3)]],
    lote: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    fechaVencimiento: [''],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    almacenId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipo: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, [Validators.required]],
    naturaleza: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E, [Validators.required]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.movementForm.controls.detalle;
  }

  openCreate(options: WarehouseOperationOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    const uotId =
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    this.createForm.reset({
      uotId,
      distritoCodigo: '',
      centroPobladoId: 0,
      referencia: '',
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openShare(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('share', options, warehouse);
    this.shareForm.reset({
      uotId: 0,
      permiteEntrada: true,
      permiteSalida: true,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openConfigure(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('configure', options, warehouse);

    const uotId =
      preferredUotId ??
      this.uot.selectedId() ??
      warehouse.uotPropietariaId ??
      this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ??
      0;

    this.configureForm.reset({
      uotId,
      productoId: 0,
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
      costoUnitario: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
      lote: '',
      fechaVencimiento: '',
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });

    this.configureForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadConfigureProducts();
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(options: WarehouseOperationOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('movement', options, null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      almacenId: options.warehouses[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      tipo: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra,
      naturaleza: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.createForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.createForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onCreateUnitChange(): void {
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  onConfigureUnitChange(): void {
    this.configureForm.controls.productoId.setValue(0);
    this.loadConfigureProducts();
  }

  onConfigureProductChange(): void {
    this.syncConfigureProductRules();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') {
      this.saveShare();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'configure') {
      this.saveConfigure();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveWarehouse();
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return 'Compartir almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'configure') return 'Agregar producto al almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar almacén';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return this.shareIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'configure') return this.configureIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.warehouseIcon;
  }

  warehousesForUnit(): readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[] {
    const unitId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.uotId.value);
    if (unitId <= 0) return this.warehouses();
    return this.warehouses().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.uotPropietariaId === unitId ||
        item.tipoAcceso?.toUpperCase() === 'COMPARTIDO',
    );
  }

  onMovementUnitChange(): void {
    const currentId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.value);
    const valid = this.warehousesForUnit().some((x) => x.almacenId === currentId);
    if (!valid) {
      this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.setValue(
        this.warehousesForUnit()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      );
    }
  }

  private saveWarehouse(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const code = raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();

    this.run(
      this.api.createWarehouse({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        ubicacion: {
          distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
          centroPobladoId:
            Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
              ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
              : undefined,
          referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
        },
        codigo: code || undefined,
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
      }),
      'Almacén registrado',
    );
  }

  private saveShare(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.shareForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!warehouse?.almacenId || this.shareForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.shareForm.getRawValue();

    if (Number(raw.uotId) === warehouse.uotPropietariaId) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona una UOT distinta de la propietaria.');
      return;
    }

    if (!raw.permiteEntrada && !raw.permiteSalida) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Habilite entrada, salida o ambas para compartir el almacén.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.shareWarehouse(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        permiteEntrada: raw.permiteEntrada,
        permiteSalida: raw.permiteSalida,
      }),
      'Acceso de almacén actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveConfigure(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.syncConfigureProductRules(false);
    this.configureForm.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.configureForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      !warehouse?.almacenId ||
      this.configureForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.loadingProducts()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.configureForm.getRawValue();
    const cost = Number(raw.costoUnitario);

    this.run(
      this.api.configureWarehouseProduct(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        productoId: Number(raw.productoId),
        stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
        stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
        costoUnitario: cost > 0 ? cost : undefined,
        moneda: cost > 0 ? raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN' : undefined,
        lote: normalizeOptionalText(raw.lote),
        fechaVencimiento: raw.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      }),
      'Producto agregado al almacén',
    );
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro del mismo movimiento.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.registerMovement({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        tipo: raw.tipo,
        naturaleza: raw.naturaleza,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
          costoUnitario:
            Number(line.costoUnitario) > 0
              ? Number(line.costoUnitario)
              : undefined,
          moneda: line.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
          lote: normalizeOptionalText(line.lote),
          fechaVencimiento: line.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        })),
      }),
      'Movimiento registrado',
    );
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'ALMACEN')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private loadConfigureProducts(): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.configureForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
    this.syncConfigureProductRules(false);

    if (uotId <= 0) return;

    this.loadingProducts.set(true);
    this.api
      .listAllProducts(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingProducts.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.configureProducts.set(items),
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private syncConfigureProductRules(emitEvent = true): void {
    const product = this.selectedConfigureProduct();
    const lot = this.configureForm.controls.lote;
    const expiration = this.configureForm.controls.fechaVencimiento;

    lot.setValidators(
      product?.requiereLote
        ? [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]
        : [Validators.maxLength(80)],
    );
    expiration.setValidators(
      product?.controlaVencimiento ? [Validators.required] : [],
    );

    lot.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
    expiration.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private run(operation: import('rxjs').Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
      costoUnitario: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.maxLength(3)]],
      lote: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      fechaVencimiento: [''],
    });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: WarehouseFormMode,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.warehouses.set(options.warehouses);
    this.products.set(options.products);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
    this.stock.set(options.stock);
    this.currentWarehouse.set(warehouse);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loadingProducts.set(false);
    this.codeLoading.set(false);
    if (this.currencies().length === 0) {
      this.refs.catalog('MONEDA').subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.currencies.set(
          items.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })),
        ),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
    }
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.currentWarehouse.set(null);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Almacenes y stock"
    subtitle="Stock por almacén/UOT, movimientos y Kardex."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>
      <button
        *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="warehouses().length === 0 || products().length === 0"
        (click)="movement()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" />
        Movimiento
      </button>
      <button
        *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="createWarehouse()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        Registrar almacén
      </button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface warehouse-toolbar">
    @if (uot.modo() === 'GENERAL') {
      <label>
        <span>UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Almacén</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="warehouseFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onWarehouseChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Producto</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="productFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onProductChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
          <option [value]="product.productoId">{{ product.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
  </section>

  <div class="warehouse-tabs" role="tablist">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'warehouses'" (click)="setTab('warehouses')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /> Almacenes
    </button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'stock'" (click)="setTab('stock')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="stockIcon" /> Stock
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_KARDEX'"
      type="button"
      [class.active]="activeTab() === 'kardex'"
      (click)="setTab('kardex')"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="kardexIcon" /> Kardex
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando almacenes" message="Consultando stock y movimientos." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los almacenes.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'warehouses') {
    @if (warehouses().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin almacenes" message="No existen almacenes disponibles para el contexto actual." />
    } @else {
      <section class="warehouse-card-grid">
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <article class="admin-surface warehouse-card">
            <header>
              <span class="warehouse-card-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /></span>
              <div>
                <strong>{{ warehouse.nombre || 'Almacén' }}</strong>
                <small>{{ warehouse.codigo || '—' }}</small>
              </div>
              <span class="warehouse-access">{{ warehouse.tipoAcceso || 'PROPIO' }}</span>
            </header>
            <dl>
              <div><dt>UOT propietaria</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.uotPropietaria || '—' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Entradas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteEntrada === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Salidas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteSalida === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
            </dl>
            @if (warehouse.descripcion) { <p>{{ warehouse.descripcion }}</p> }
            <footer>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                [disabled]="warehouse.permiteEntrada === false"
                (click)="configureProduct(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="configureIcon" />
                Agregar producto
              </button>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                (click)="share(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="shareIcon" />
                Compartir
              </button>
            </footer>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'stock') {
    @if (filteredStock().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin stock" message="No existen saldos para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Almacén</th><th>Producto</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Actualización</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredStock(); track item.almacenId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen }}</td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.producto }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockActual | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockReservado | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td><strong class="stock-value" [class]="stockTone(item)">{{ item.stockDisponible | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaActualizacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  } @else {
    @if (kardex().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin movimientos" message="No existen movimientos en el Kardex para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Fecha</th><th>UOT</th><th>Almacén</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Producto</th><th>Naturaleza</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Referencia</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of kardex(); track item.movimientoInventarioId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.producto || '—' }}</td>
                  <td><span class="warehouse-nature">{{ item.naturaleza === 'E' ? 'Entrada' : 'Salida' }}</span></td>
                  <td>{{ item.cantidad | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-almacen-operation-form />
```
