- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260914_214628_319813\src\app\features\recursos\almacenes\adapter\in\ui\pages\almacenes-list\almacenes-list.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260914_214628_319813/src/app/features/recursos/almacenes/adapter/in/ui/pages/almacenes-list/almacenes-list.ts`

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBookOpen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faShareNodes,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceKardexResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceKardexResponse';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { ResourceStockResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceStockResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import {
  AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  WarehouseOperationOptions,
} from '../almacen-operation-form/almacen-operation-form';

type WarehouseTab = 'warehouses' | 'stock' | 'kardex';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacenes-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './almacenes-list.html',
  styleUrl: './almacenes-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(AlmacenOperationFormComponent)
  private form!: AlmacenOperationFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly activeTab = signal<WarehouseTab>('warehouses');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly warehouseFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly productFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly stock = signal<readonly ResourceStockResponse[]>([]);
  readonly kardex = signal<readonly ResourceKardexResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly stockIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly configureIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filteredStock = computed(() => {
    const warehouseId = this.warehouseFilter();
    const productId = this.productFilter();
    return this.stock().filter(
      (item) =>
        (!warehouseId || item.almacenId === warehouseId) &&
        (!productId || item.productoId === productId),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const unitId = this.queryUnitId();

    forkJoin({
      warehouses: this.api.listWarehouses(unitId),
      products: this.api.listAllProducts(unitId),
      stock: this.api.listStock(unitId),
      kardex: this.api.listKardex(
        unitId,
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ warehouses, products, stock, kardex }) => {
          this.warehouses.set(warehouses);
          this.products.set(products);
          this.stock.set(stock);
          this.kardex.set(kardex);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  setTab(tab: WarehouseTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(null);
    this.productFilter.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  onWarehouseChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null,
    );
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  onProductChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.productFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  async createWarehouse(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async share(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openShare(warehouse, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async configureProduct(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openConfigure(
      warehouse,
      this.options(),
      this.queryUnitId(),
    );
    if (result.saved) {
      this.activeTab.set('stock');
      this.warehouseFilter.set(warehouse.almacenId ?? null);
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async movement(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openMovement(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  stockTone(item: ResourceStockResponse): string {
    const available = item.stockDisponible ?? 0;
    const minimum = item.stockMinimo ?? 0;
    if (available <= 0) return 'stock-value stock-value--danger';
    if (minimum > 0 && available <= minimum) return 'stock-value stock-value--warning';
    return 'stock-value stock-value--ok';
  }

  private loadKardex(): void {
    this.api
      .listKardex(
        this.queryUnitId(),
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardex.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private queryUnitId(): number | undefined {
    return this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
      : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;
  }

  private options(): WarehouseOperationOptions {
    return {
      warehouses: this.warehouses(),
      products: this.products(),
      stock: this.stock(),
    };
  }
}
```

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header title="Inventario y suministros" subtitle="Bienes patrimoniales, vehículos y consumibles por UOT, con paginación y trazabilidad." [icon]="pageIcon">
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()"><fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button>
      <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />{{ activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Registrar bien' : 'Registrar suministro' }}</button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5"><button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'assets'" (click)="setTab('assets')"><fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" /> Bienes y vehículos</button><button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'supplies'" (click)="setTab('supplies')"><fa-icon [icon]="supplyIcon" /> Suministros</button></div>

  <section class="admin-surface resource-filter-bar">
    <div class="resource-filter-title"><fa-icon [icon]="filterIcon" /><span>Filtros</span></div>
    @if (isGeneral()) { <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>UOT</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)"><option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>@for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) { <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option> }</select></label> }
    <label class="resource-filter-field resource-filter-field--search"><span>Buscar</span><div class="resource-search-control"><input class="admin-input" type="search" [placeholder]="activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Código, bien, marca, serie…' : 'Código, suministro, unidad…'" [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" (keyup.enter)="applyFilters()" /><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Buscar" (click)="applyFilters()"><fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" /></button></div></label>
    @if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
      <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>Tipo</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="typeFilter() ?? 0" (change)="typeFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value || null); applyFilters()"><option [value]="0">Todos</option>@for (type of assetTypes(); track type.id) { <option [value]="type.id">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select></label>
      <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>Estado</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()"><option value="">Todos</option><option value="DISPONIBLE">Disponible</option><option value="ASIGNADO">Asignado</option><option value="MANTENIMIENTO">Mantenimiento</option><option value="AVERIADO">Averiado</option><option value="NO_DISPONIBLE">No disponible</option><option value="INACTIVO">Inactivo</option><option value="BAJA">Baja</option></select></label>
      <div class="resource-view-switch"><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'table'" title="Vista tabla" (click)="setView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /></button><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'cards'" title="Vista tarjetas" (click)="setView('cards')"><fa-icon [icon]="cardsIcon" /></button></div>
    }
  </section>

  @if (loading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando inventario" message="Consultando recursos del contexto UOT." /> }
  @else if (errorMessage()) { <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar el inventario.'" (retry)="load()" /> }
  @else if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
    @if (assets().items.length === 0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin bienes" message="No existen bienes para los filtros seleccionados." /> }
    @else {
      @if (viewMode() === 'table') {
        <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell"><div class="admin-table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Imagen</th><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Bien</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Vehículo</th><th>Proveedor</th><th>Estado</th><th>Incidencias</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for (item of assets().items; track assetKey(item)) { <tr><td><app-resource-image variant="thumb" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Bien'" /></td><td><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</small></td><td><strong>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</strong></td><td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.marca || '' }} @if (item.modelo) { · {{ item.modelo }} }</small></td><td>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</td><td>@if (item.placa) { <strong>{{ item.placa }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.tipoVehiculo || 'Vehículo' }} · {{ item.kilometrajeKm ?? 0 }} km</small> } @else { <span class="resource-cell-help">No registrado</span> }</td><td>{{ item.proveedorNombre || '—' }}</td><td><span class="resource-status" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoBien)">{{ stateLabel(item.estadoBien) }}</span></td><td>@if ((item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0) > 0) { <span class="resource-incident-count"><fa-icon [icon]="incidentIcon" /> {{ item.incidentesAbiertos }}</span> } @else { <span class="resource-cell-help">Sin incidencias</span> }</td><td><div class="admin-table-actions"><a *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos', item.bienInventarioId]" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="editAsset(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button></div></td></tr> }
        </tbody></table></div></section>
      } @else {

      }
      <app-paginator [page]="assets().page" [size]="assets().size" [totalRecords]="assets().totalRecords" [totalPages]="assets().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAssets($event, assets().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAssets(1, $event)" />
    }
  } @else {
    @if (filteredSupplies().length === 0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin suministros" message="No existen suministros en esta página para la búsqueda indicada." /> }
    @else { <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell"><div class="admin-table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Suministro</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Stock actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Reposición</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      @for (item of filteredSupplies(); track supplyKey(item)) { <tr><td><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</small></td><td><span class="admin-code">{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</span></td><td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong></td><td>{{ item.unidadMedida || '—' }}</td><td>{{ (item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td><td>{{ (item.stockReservado ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td><td><strong>{{ (item.stockDisponible ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td><td>@if (item.requiereReposicion) { <span class="resource-status resource-status--warning">Reponer</span> } @else { <span class="resource-status resource-status--ok">Correcto</span> }</td><td><div class="admin-table-actions"><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar suministro" (click)="editSupply(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Registrar movimiento" (click)="movement(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" /></button><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver Kardex" (click)="toggleKardex(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" /></button></div></td></tr>
        @if (sameSupply(kardexSupply(), item)) { <tr class="resource-kardex-row"><td colspan="9"><div class="resource-kardex-panel"><strong>Kardex · {{ item.uotNombre }} · {{ item.nombre }}</strong>@if (kardexLoading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando Kardex" message="Consultando movimientos históricos." /> } @else if (kardexError()) { <app-error-state [message]="kardexError() || 'No se pudo consultar el Kardex.'" (retry)="loadKardex(item)" /> } @else if (kardex().length === 0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin movimientos" message="El suministro todavía no tiene movimientos." /> } @else { <div class="admin-table-scroll mt-3"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Saldo</th><th>Documento</th><th>Usuario</th></tr></thead><tbody>@for (movementItem of kardex(); track movementItem.suministroMovimientoId) { <tr><td>{{ movementItem.fechaHora || '—' }}</td><td>{{ movementItem.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td><td>{{ (movementItem.cantidad ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td><td><strong>{{ (movementItem.saldo ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td><td>{{ movementItem.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td><td>{{ movementItem.usuario || 'Sistema' }}</td></tr> }</tbody></table></div> }</div></td></tr> }
      }
    </tbody></table></div></section><app-paginator [page]="supplies().page" [size]="supplies().size" [totalRecords]="supplies().totalRecords" [totalPages]="supplies().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadSupplies($event, supplies().size)" (sizeChange)="loadSupplies(1, $event)" /> }
  }
</div>
<app-recurso-form />
<app-suministro-form />

<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"><div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
  <header class="admin-modal-header"><div class="admin-modal-title-group"><span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="icon()" /></span><div><p>Inventario patrimonial</p><h2>{{ title() }}</h2></div></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" aria-label="Cerrar" (click)="close()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" /></button></header>
  @if (errorMessage()) { <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div> }

  @if (mode() === 'state') {
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="stateForm" (ngSubmit)="save()"><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Nuevo estado</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="estado">@for (state of states; track state.value) { <option [value]="state.value">{{ state.label }}</option> }</select></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Motivo</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="4" maxlength="500" formControlName="motivo" placeholder="Motivo u observación del cambio"></textarea></div><ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container></form>
  } @else if (mode() === 'incident') {
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="incidentForm" (ngSubmit)="save()"><div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de incidencia</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipo">@for (type of incidentTypes; track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Fecha y hora</label><input class="admin-input" type="datetime-local" formControlName="fechaHora" /></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Descripción</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="4" maxlength="700" formControlName="descripcion"></textarea><app-form-error [control]="incidentForm.controls.descripcion" fieldLabel="La descripción" [messages]="{ blank: 'La descripción no puede contener solo espacios.' }" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Costo estimado</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="costoEstimado" /></div><ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container></form>
  } @else if (mode() === 'vehicle' || mode() === 'mileage') {
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="vehicleForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      @if (mode() === 'vehicle') { <div class="admin-field"><label>Placa</label><input class="admin-input" maxlength="12" formControlName="placa" autocomplete="off" /><app-form-error [control]="vehicleForm.controls.placa" fieldLabel="La placa" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de vehículo</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipoVehiculo" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option value="">Seleccionar</option>@for (type of vehicleTypes(); track type.code) { <option [value]="type.code">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="vehicleForm.controls.tipoVehiculo" fieldLabel="El tipo de vehículo" /></div> }
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Kilometraje</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.1" formControlName="kilometrajeKm" /><app-form-error [control]="vehicleForm.controls.kilometrajeKm" fieldLabel="El kilometraje" /></div>
      <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
    </form>
  } @else {
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      @if (mode() === 'create') { <div class="admin-field"><label>UOT</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onUotChange()"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) { <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" /></div> }
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de bien</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipoBienId" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for (type of assetTypes(); track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.tipoBienId" fieldLabel="El tipo de bien" /></div>
      @if (mode() === 'create') { <div class="admin-field"><label>Código patrimonial</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="codigoPatrimonial" maxlength="60" autocomplete="off" placeholder="DESCO propone uno automáticamente" /><small>@if (codeLoading()) { Generando código sugerido... } @else { Puede modificar el código sugerido. }</small><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.codigoPatrimonial" fieldLabel="El código patrimonial" /></div> }
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Nombre</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="nombre" maxlength="150" /><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Marca</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="marca" maxlength="80" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Modelo</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="modelo" maxlength="80" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Serie</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="serie" maxlength="100" /></div>
      <div class="resource-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Adquisición</span></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Fecha de adquisición</label><input class="admin-input" type="date" [max]="today" formControlName="fechaAdquisicion" /><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAdquisicion" fieldLabel="La fecha de adquisición" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha no puede ser futura.' }" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Monto de adquisición</label><div class="resource-money-field"><select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (currency of currencies(); track currency.code) { <option [value]="currency.code">{{ currency.code }}</option> }</select><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="montoAdquisicion" /></div></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Proveedor</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="proveedorEmpresaId" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option [value]="0">Sin proveedor registrado</option>@for (organization of organizations(); track organization.value) { <option [value]="organization.value">{{ organization.label }} @if (organization.description) { · {{ organization.description }} }</option> }</select></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea></div>
      <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
    </form>
  }
  <ng-template #actions><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">@if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }</button></footer></ng-template>
</div></dialog>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260914_214628_394076/src/app/features/recursos/inventario-vehiculos/adapter/in/ui/pages/suministro-form/suministro-form.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';

type SupplyFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'movement';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-suministro-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './suministro-form.html',
  styleUrl: './suministro-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SuministroFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly resourceApi = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<SupplyFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly units = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoMovimiento: ['ENTRADA', [Validators.required]],
    cantidad: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      unidadMedida: 'UND',
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
    });

    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.uotId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.enable({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadUnits();
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      codigo: item.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      unidadMedida: item.unidadMedida ?? 'UND',
      stockInicial: Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0),
      stockMinimo: Number(item.stockMinimo ?? 0),
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadUnits();
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('movement');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      tipoMovimiento: 'ENTRADA',
      cantidad: 0,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.movementForm.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'create') this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return 'Editar suministro';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar suministro';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return this.editIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.addIcon;
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveSupply();
    }
  }

  private saveSupply(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const uotId = Number(raw.uotId);
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.suministroId
        ? this.api.update(Number(this.current()!.suministroId), {
            uotId,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          })
        : this.api.create({
            uotId,
            codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Suministro actualizado' : 'Suministro registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    const supply = this.current();
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!supply?.suministroId || this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .registerMovement(Number(supply.suministroId), {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        tipoMovimiento: raw.tipoMovimiento,
        cantidad: Number(raw.cantidad),
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Movimiento registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private loadUnits(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.refs.catalog('UNIDAD_MEDIDA')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.units.set(items.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
          const current = this.form.controls.unidadMedida.value;
          if (!this.units().some((item) => item.code === current)) {
            this.form.controls.unidadMedida.setValue(this.units()[0]?.code ?? 'UND');
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.form.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.resourceApi
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'SUMINISTRO')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowLeft, faClockRotateLeft, faCoins, faImage, faRotate, faRotateLeft } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin, of } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { PermissionService } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.service';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ResourceApiService, ResourceProductPriceHistory } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ResourceImageComponent } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-image/resource-image';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, DecimalPipe, RouterLink, FaIconComponent, PermissionDirective, EmptyStateComponent, ErrorStateComponent, LoadingStateComponent, ActionConfirmDialogComponent, LocalFilePanelComponent, PageHeaderComponent, ResourceImageComponent, ProductoFormComponent],
  templateUrl: './producto-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly historyLoading = signal(false);
  readonly actionLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly historyError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<ResourceProductDetailResponse | null>(null);
  readonly history = signal<readonly ResourceProductPriceHistory[]>([]);

  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;

  readonly productId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly uotId = Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('uotId'));

  ngOnInit(): void { this.load(); }

  load(): void {
    if (!this.productId || !this.uotId) { this.loading.set(false); this.errorMessage.set('No se identificó correctamente el producto y su UOT.'); return; }
    this.loading.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const canHistory = this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL');
    forkJoin({
      detail: this.api.getProduct(this.productId, this.uotId),
      history: canHistory ? this.api.listProductPriceHistory(this.productId, this.uotId) : of([] as ResourceProductPriceHistory[]),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: ({ detail, history }) => { this.detail.set(detail ?? null); this.history.set(history); },
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  loadHistory(): void {
    if (!this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL')) return;
    this.historyLoading.set(true); this.historyError.set(null);
    this.api.listProductPriceHistory(this.productId, this.uotId).pipe(finalize(() => this.historyLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (items) => this.history.set(items),
      error: (error) => this.historyError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  async versionPrice(): Promise<void> {
    const item = this.detail(); if (!item) return;
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item, this.uotId);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async reactivate(price: ResourceProductPriceHistory): Promise<void> {
    if (price.vigente || !price.productoPrecioId || this.actionLoadingId()) return;
    const result = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Reactivar precio histórico',
      message: `Se creará una nueva versión vigente con ${price.moneda} ${price.precioVenta.toFixed(2)}. La versión histórica no será modificada.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Crear versión vigente',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      tone: 'warning',
    });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    this.actionLoadingId.set(price.productoPrecioId);
    this.api.reactivateProductPrice(this.productId, price.productoPrecioId, { uotId: this.uotId })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Precio reactivado como nueva versión'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo reactivar el precio', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  canUploadImages(): boolean { return this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES') && this.permissions.has('ARCHIVOS_CREAR'); }
  imageIds(): readonly number[] { const id = this.detail()?.archivoPrincipalId; return id ? [id] : []; }
}

<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">

        <div class="admin-field"><label>Código</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="codigo" maxlength="50" placeholder="DESCO propone uno automáticamente" autocomplete="off" /><small>@if (codeLoading()) { Generando código sugerido... } @else { Puede modificar el código sugerido. }</small><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.codigo" fieldLabel="El código" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field"><label>Unidad de medida</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="unidadMedida" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (unit of units(); track unit.code) { <option [value]="unit.code">{{ unit.label }} · {{ unit.code }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.unidadMedida" fieldLabel="La unidad de medida" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Nombre</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="nombre" maxlength="180" /><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Categoría</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="categoria" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option value="">Sin categoría</option>@for (category of categories(); track category.code) { <option [value]="category.code">{{ category.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Descripción</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="700" formControlName="descripcion"></textarea></div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

    } @else {

        <div class="admin-field"><label>Precio</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" formControlName="precio" /><app-form-error [control]="priceForm.controls.precio" fieldLabel="El precio" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field"><label>Moneda</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (currency of currencies(); track currency.code) { <option [value]="currency.code">{{ currency.code }} · {{ currency.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    }

    <ng-template #actions><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">@if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }</button></footer></ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>

import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCoins, faFloppyDisk, faPlus, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { normalizeOptionalText, normalizeText, notBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';
type ProductPriceTarget = ResourceProductListItemResponse | ResourceProductDetailResponse;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true }) private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ProductPriceTarget | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly categories = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly currencies = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(700)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: preferredUotId ?? this.uot.selectedId() ?? this.uot.memberships()[0]?.uotId ?? 0,
      codigo: '', nombre: '', descripcion: '', unidadMedida: '', categoria: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId[this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' ? 'disable' : 'enable']({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(item: ProductPriceTarget, uotId: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: uotId,
      precio: item.precioVigente ?? 0,
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });
    this.priceForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() { return this.uot.memberships(); }
  onCreateUotChange(): void { this.loadSuggestedCode(true); }

  uotLabel(form: 'create' | 'price' = 'create'): string {
    const id = form === 'price'
      ? Number(this.priceForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId)
      : Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);
    return this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void { if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
  save(): void { this.mode() === 'price' ? this.savePrice() : this.saveProduct(); }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;
    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) { this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.createProduct({
      uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
      codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
      nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
      descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
      unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
      categoria: raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => { this.toast.success('Producto registrado'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); },
      error: (error) => this.fail(error),
    });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!product?.productoId || this.priceForm.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;
    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) { this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.versionProductPrice(product.productoId, {
      uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
      uotPrecioId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
      precio: Number(raw.precio),
      moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => { this.toast.success('Nueva versión de precio registrada'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); },
      error: (error) => this.fail(error),
    });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) return;
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      units: this.refs.catalog('UNIDAD_MEDIDA'),
      categories: this.refs.catalog('CATEGORIA_PRODUCTO'),
      currencies: this.refs.catalog('MONEDA'),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: ({ units, categories, currencies }) => {
        this.units.set(units.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
        this.categories.set(categories.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
        this.currencies.set(currencies.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
        if (this.mode() === 'create' && !this.createForm.controls.unidadMedida.value) {
          this.createForm.controls.unidadMedida.setValue(this.units()[0]?.code ?? 'UND');
        }
        const currency = this.priceForm.controls.moneda.value;
        if (!this.currencies().some((item) => item.code === currency)) {
          this.priceForm.controls.moneda.setValue(this.currencies()[0]?.code ?? 'PEN');
        }
      },
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;
    if (uotId <= 0) { if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false }); return; }
    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;
    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api.suggestCode(uotId, 'PRODUCTO').pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (code) => { if (code) { control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false }); control.markAsPristine(); } },
      error: () => { if (force) { control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false }); control.markAsPristine(); } },
    });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message); this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }
  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> { this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolver = resolve; }); }
  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void { if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(result); this.resolver = null; this.current.set(null); }
}

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Productos"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general del catálogo y precios vigentes por UOT.' : 'Catálogo y precio vigente para ' + contextUotName() + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button class="admin-secondary-button" type="button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" class="admin-primary-button" type="button" (click)="create()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Registrar producto
      </button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface product-filters">
    @if (isGeneral()) {
      <label>
        <span>UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }

    <label class="product-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <div class="product-search-control">
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Código o nombre del producto"
          [value]="search()"
          (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
          (keyup.enter)="applyFilters()"
        />
        <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Buscar" (click)="applyFilters()">
          <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Categoría</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="categoryFilter()" (change)="categoryFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()">
        <option value="">Todas</option>
        @for (category of categories(); track category.code) {
          <option [value]="category.code">{{ category.label }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Estado</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()">
        <option value="ACTIVE">Activos</option>
        <option value="INACTIVE">Inactivos</option>
        <option value="ALL">Todos</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <div class="product-view-switch" aria-label="Modo de visualización">
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'table'" title="Vista tabla" (click)="setView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /></button>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'cards'" title="Vista tarjetas" (click)="setView('cards')"><fa-icon [icon]="cardsIcon" /></button>
    </div>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando productos" message="Consultando el catálogo paginado." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los productos.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin productos" message="No existen productos para los filtros seleccionados." />
  } @else {
    @if (viewMode() === 'table') {
      <section class="admin-surface product-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead><tr><th>Imagen</th><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Precio vigente</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of result().items; track rowKey(item)) {
                <tr>
                  <td><app-resource-image variant="thumb" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" /></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><span>{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</span></div></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="product-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small></td>
                  <td>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.precioVigente != null) {
                      <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong>
                      @if (item.precioVersion) { <small class="product-help">Versión {{ item.precioVersion }}</small> }
                    } @else { <span class="product-help">Sin precio vigente</span> }
                  </td>
                  <td><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <a *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/productos', item.productoId]" [queryParams]="detailQuery(item)" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Registrar nueva versión de precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Gestionar imagen" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>
                </tr>
                @if (isImagesSelected(item)) {
                  <tr class="product-images-row"><td colspan="9">
                    <app-local-file-panel
                      [uotId]="item.uotId || 0"
                      linkType="PRODUCTO"
                      [linkId]="item.productoId || 0"
                      [fileIds]="imageIds(item)"
                      title="Imagen principal del producto"
                      category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN"
                      accept="image/*"
                      [forcePrincipal]="true"
                      [canUpload]="canUploadImages()"
                      (changed)="load()"
                    />
                  </td></tr>
                }
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    } @else {
      <section class="product-card-grid">
        @for (item of result().items; track rowKey(item)) {
          <article class="admin-surface product-card">
            <app-resource-image variant="card" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" />
            <div class="product-card-body">
              <div class="product-card-heading"><div><small>{{ item.uotNombre || 'UOT' }}</small><h3>{{ item.nombre || 'Producto' }}</h3><span>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</span></div><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></div>
              <p>{{ item.descripcion || 'Sin descripción.' }}</p>
              <dl><div><dt>Categoría</dt><dd>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Unidad</dt><dd>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div class="product-card-price"><dt>Precio vigente</dt><dd>@if (item.precioVigente != null) { {{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }} } @else { Sin precio }</dd></div></dl>
              <footer>
                <a *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_VER'" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [routerLink]="['/recursos/productos', item.productoId]" [queryParams]="detailQuery(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /> Detalle</a>
                <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Nuevo precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Gestionar imagen" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
              </footer>
              @if (isImagesSelected(item)) {
                <div class="product-card-files"><app-local-file-panel [uotId]="item.uotId || 0" linkType="PRODUCTO" [linkId]="item.productoId || 0" [fileIds]="imageIds(item)" title="Imagen principal" category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN" accept="image/*" [forcePrincipal]="true" [canUpload]="canUploadImages()" (changed)="load()" /></div>
              }
            </div>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }

    <app-paginator
      [page]="result().page"
      [size]="result().size"
      [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
      [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
      (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
      (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
    />
  }
</div>

<app-producto-form />

<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="icon()" /></span>
        <div><p>Recursos</p><h2>{{ title() }}</h2></div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (mode() === 'create') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="createForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationType">Tipo de destino</label>
          <select
            id="resourceDestinationType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="destinoTipo"
            [disabled]="loadingDestinations()"
            (change)="changeDestinationType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="SALIDA">Salida de campo</option>
            <option value="OPERATIVO">Operativo de venta</option>
            <option value="CAMPANIA">Campaña de venta</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationId">Destino</label>
          <select
            id="resourceDestinationId"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="destinoId"
            [disabled]="loadingDestinations()"
            (change)="changeDestination($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option [value]="0">
              {{ loadingDestinations() ? 'Cargando destinos...' : 'Seleccionar destino' }}
            </option>
            @for (destination of destinationsForSelectedType(); track destination.tipo + ':' + destination.destinoId) {
              <option [value]="destination.destinoId">
                {{ destinationOptionLabel(destination) }}
              </option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.destinoId" fieldLabel="El destino" />
          @if (selectedDestination(); as destination) {
            <small class="resource-helper">
              UOT: {{ destination.uotNombre || destination.uotCodigo || '—' }}
              @if (destination.estadoProceso) { · {{ destination.estadoProceso }} }
            </small>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceType">Tipo de recurso</label>
          <select
            id="resourceType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="recursoTipo"
            [disabled]="!selectedDestination() || loadingAvailability()"
            (change)="changeResourceType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="BIEN">Bien / vehículo</option>
            <option value="SUMINISTRO">Suministro</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceId">Recurso disponible</label>
          <div class="resource-select-row">
            <select
              id="resourceId"
              class="admin-select"
              formControlName="recursoId"
              [disabled]="!selectedDestination() || loadingAvailability()"
            >
              <option [value]="0">
                {{ !selectedDestination() ? 'Primero seleccione un destino' : loadingAvailability() ? 'Cargando recursos...' : 'Seleccionar recurso' }}
              </option>
              @if (createForm.controls.recursoTipo.value === 'BIEN') {
                @for (asset of availableAssets(); track asset.bienInventarioId) {
                  <option [value]="asset.bienInventarioId">
                    {{ asset.codigoPatrimonial }} · {{ asset.nombre }} · {{ asset.estadoBien }}
                  </option>
                }
              } @else {
                @for (supply of availability().suministros; track supply.suministroId) {
                  <option [value]="supply.suministroId">
                    {{ supply.codigo }} · {{ supply.nombre }} · stock {{ supply.stockDisponible }} {{ supply.unidadMedida }}
                  </option>
                }
              }
            </select>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-icon-button"
              title="Actualizar disponibilidad de la UOT del destino"
              [disabled]="!selectedDestination() || loadingAvailability()"
              (click)="loadAvailability()"
            >
              @if (loadingAvailability()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }
            </button>
          </div>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.recursoId" fieldLabel="El recurso" />
          @if (selectedDestination(); as destination) {
            <small class="resource-helper">
              Solo se muestran recursos disponibles en {{ destination.uotNombre || destination.uotCodigo || 'la UOT del destino' }}.
            </small>

        <div class="admin-field">

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">

            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Cantidad</span><strong>{{ detail.cantidadProgramada }} {{ detail.unidadMedida || '' }}</strong></article>
            <article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Estado</span><strong>{{ detail.estadoProceso }}</strong></article>
          </section>
          <section class="admin-surface">
            <div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Historial</p><h2>Movimientos</h2></div><span class="admin-count-badge">{{ detail.movimientos.length }}</span></div>
            <div class="admin-table-wrap">
              <table class="admin-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Movimiento</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Usuario</th><th>Observación</th></tr></thead>

                    </tr>

              </table>

          </section>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="close()">Cerrar</button></footer>
        </div>
      } @else if (mode() === 'edit') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="editForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · {{ detail.estadoProceso }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="editQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
            <input id="editQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadProgramada" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="editObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="editObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else if (mode() === 'return') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="returnForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · cantidad programada {{ detail.cantidadProgramada }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="returnQuantity">Cantidad a devolver</label>
            <input id="returnQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadDevuelta" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="returnObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="returnObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>

              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="returnIcon" /> Registrar devolución }

      } @else {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="consumeForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong>
            <span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · pendiente {{ pendingQuantity(detail) }} {{ detail.unidadMedida || '' }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="consumeQuantity">Cantidad consumida</label>
            <input id="consumeQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0.001" [max]="pendingQuantity(detail)" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadConsumida" />
            <app-form-error [control]="consumeForm.controls.cantidadConsumida" fieldLabel="La cantidad" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="consumeObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="consumeObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || pendingQuantity(detail) <= 0">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Registrando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="consumeIcon" /> Registrar consumo }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      }
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
