```typescript
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faEye,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUtensils,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-disponibilidad-recursos.use-case';
import { EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-destinos-recursos.use-case';
import { ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ProgramarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/programar-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-consumo-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-devolucion-recurso.use-case';
import { DisponibilidadRecurso } from '../../../../../domain/disponibilidad-recurso.model';
import {
  DestinoRecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
  TipoRecursoProgramable,
} from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';

export type RecursoProgramadoFormMode =
  | 'create'
  | 'edit'
  | 'view'
  | 'return'
  | 'consume';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurso-programado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './recurso-programado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './recurso-programado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoProgramadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly destinationsUseCase = inject(ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly availabilityUseCase = inject(ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly programUseCase = inject(ProgramarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly returnUseCase = inject(RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly consumeUseCase = inject(RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<RecursoProgramadoFormMode>('create');
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly loadingDestinations = signal(false);
  readonly loadingAvailability = signal(false);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<RecursoProgramadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly destinations = signal<readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[]>([]);
  readonly availability = signal<DisponibilidadRecurso>({
    bienes: [],
    suministros: [],
  });

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly resourceIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly consumeIcon = faUtensils;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    destinoTipo: ['SALIDA' as TipoDestinoRecurso, [Validators.required]],
    destinoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    recursoTipo: ['BIEN' as TipoRecursoProgramable, [Validators.required]],
    recursoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly editForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly returnForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadDevuelta: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly consumeForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadConsumida: [0, [Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly availableAssets = computed(() =>
    this.availability().bienes.filter((item) => item.disponible),
  );

  selectedSupply() {
    const id = Number(this.createForm.controls.recursoId.value);
    return (
      this.availability().suministros.find(
        (item) => item.suministroId === id,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }

  async openCreate(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState('create');
    this.createForm.reset({
      destinoTipo: 'SALIDA',
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoTipo: 'BIEN',
      recursoId: 0,
      cantidadProgramada: 1,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loadDestinations();
    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  async openDetail(
    item: RecursoProgramado,
    mode: Exclude<RecursoProgramadoFormMode, 'create'>,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState(mode);
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loadDestinations(false);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.current.set(detail);
          this.editForm.reset({
            cantidadProgramada: detail.cantidadProgramada,
            observacion: detail.observacion ?? '',
          });
          this.returnForm.reset({
            cantidadDevuelta: detail.bienInventarioId
              ? 1
              : Math.max(0.001, detail.cantidadProgramada),
            observacion: '',
          });
          this.consumeForm.reset({
            cantidadConsumida: this.pendingQuantity(detail),
            observacion: '',
          });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });

    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  destinationsForSelectedType(): readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[] {
    const type = this.createForm.controls.destinoTipo.value;
    return this.destinations().filter((item) => item.tipo === type);
  }

  selectedDestination(): DestinoRecursoProgramado | null {
    const type = this.createForm.controls.destinoTipo.value;
    const id = Number(this.createForm.controls.destinoId.value);
    return (
      this.destinations().find(
        (item) => item.tipo === type && item.destinoId === id,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }

  destinationOptionLabel(destination: DestinoRecursoProgramado): string {
    const code = destination.codigo ? `${destination.codigo} · ` : '';
    const unit = destination.uotNombre ? ` · ${destination.uotNombre}` : '';
    return `${code}${destination.nombre}${unit}`;
  }

  changeDestinationType(value: string): void {
    const type = value as TipoDestinoRecurso;
    this.createForm.patchValue({
      destinoTipo: type,
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoId: 0,
    });
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  changeDestination(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.createForm.controls.destinoId.setValue(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0,
    );
    this.createForm.controls.recursoId.setValue(0);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    if (this.selectedDestination()) {
      this.loadAvailability();
    }
  }

  changeResourceType(type: string): void {
    const resourceType = type as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    this.createForm.patchValue({ recursoTipo: resourceType, recursoId: 0 });

    if (resourceType === 'BIEN') {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
    }
  }

  loadDestinations(reportError = true): void {
    if (this.loadingDestinations()) return;

    const uotId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA'
        ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined
        : undefined;

    this.loadingDestinations.set(true);
    this.destinationsUseCase
      .execute(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingDestinations.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (destinations) => this.destinations.set(destinations),
        error: (error) => {
          if (reportError) {
            this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
          }
        },
      });
  }

  loadAvailability(): void {
    const destination = this.selectedDestination();

    if (!destination) {
      this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione un destino antes de consultar recursos.');
      return;
    }

    if (this.loadingAvailability()) return;

    this.loadingAvailability.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availabilityUseCase
      .execute(destination.uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingAvailability.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (availability) => this.availability.set(availability),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    const mode = this.mode();
    if (this.saving() || this.loading() || mode === 'view') return;

    if (mode === 'create') {
      this.saveCreate();
    } else if (mode === 'edit') {
      this.saveEdit();
    } else if (mode === 'return') {
      this.saveReturn();
    } else {
      this.saveConsume();
    }
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create':
        return 'Programar recurso';
      case 'edit':
        return 'Editar programación';
      case 'return':
        return 'Registrar devolución';
      case 'consume':
        return 'Registrar consumo';
      default:
        return 'Detalle del recurso programado';
    }
  }

  icon() {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create':
        return this.addIcon;
      case 'edit':
        return this.editIcon;
      case 'return':
        return this.returnIcon;
      case 'consume':
        return this.consumeIcon;
      default:
        return this.viewIcon;
    }
  }

  destinationLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    const identity = this.destinationIdentity(detail);

    if (identity) {
      const destination = this.destinations().find(
        (item) =>
          item.tipo === identity.tipo && item.destinoId === identity.id,
      );
      if (destination) return this.destinationOptionLabel(destination);

      if (identity.tipo === 'CAMPANIA') return `Campaña #${identity.id}`;
      if (identity.tipo === 'OPERATIVO') return `Operativo #${identity.id}`;
      return `Salida de campo #${identity.id}`;
    }

    return 'Sin destino';
  }

  resourceLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    return detail.bien ?? detail.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  pendingQuantity(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): number {
    const delivered = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'ENTREGA')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    const returned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    const consumed = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'CONSUMO')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);

    return Math.max(0, Number((delivered - returned - consumed).toFixed(3)));
  }

  private saveCreate(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.createForm.invalid ||
      this.loadingDestinations() ||
      this.loadingAvailability()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const destination = this.selectedDestination();
    if (!destination) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione un destino válido.');
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const resourceType = raw.recursoTipo as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    const quantity =
      resourceType === 'BIEN' ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);
    const selectedSupply = this.selectedSupply();

    if (
      resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' &&
      selectedSupply &&
      quantity > selectedSupply.stockDisponible
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `La cantidad supera el stock disponible (${selectedSupply.stockDisponible} ${selectedSupply.unidadMedida}).`,
      );
      return;
    }

    const input = {
      campaniaVentaId:
        destination.tipo === 'CAMPANIA' ? destination.destinoId : undefined,
      operativoVentaId:
        destination.tipo === 'OPERATIVO' ? destination.destinoId : undefined,
      salidaCampoId:
        destination.tipo === 'SALIDA' ? destination.destinoId : undefined,
      bienInventarioId:
        resourceType === 'BIEN' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      suministroId:
        resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      cantidadProgramada: quantity,
      observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.programUseCase
      .execute(input)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (id) => {
          this.toast.success('Recurso programado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: id });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveEdit(): void {
    this.editForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.editForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.editForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId
      ? 1
      : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadProgramada: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Programación actualizada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveReturn(): void {
    this.returnForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.returnForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.returnForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId
      ? 1
      : Number(raw.cantidadDevuelta);
    const alreadyReturned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);

    if (quantity + alreadyReturned > detail.cantidadProgramada) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'La devolución supera la cantidad programada pendiente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.returnUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadDevuelta: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Devolución registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveConsume(): void {
    this.consumeForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || detail.bienInventarioId || this.consumeForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.consumeForm.getRawValue();
    const pending = this.pendingQuantity(detail);
    const quantity = Number(raw.cantidadConsumida);

    if (quantity > pending) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La cantidad supera el pendiente por regularizar.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.consumeUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadConsumida: quantity > 0 ? quantity : undefined,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Consumo registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private destinationIdentity(
    detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  ): { tipo: TipoDestinoRecurso; id: number } | null {
    if (detail.campaniaVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'CAMPANIA', id: detail.campaniaVentaId };
    }
    if (detail.operativoVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'OPERATIVO', id: detail.operativoVentaId };
    }
    if (detail.salidaCampoId) {
      return { tipo: 'SALIDA', id: detail.salidaCampoId };
    }
    return null;
  }

  private resetState(mode: RecursoProgramadoFormMode): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.loading.set(false);
    this.loadingDestinations.set(false);
    this.loadingAvailability.set(false);
    this.current.set(null);
    this.destinations.set([]);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  private resultPromise(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.destinations.set([]);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Recursos programados"
    subtitle="Programa, asigna y controla la devolución de bienes y suministros."
    eyebrow="Recursos"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Programar recurso
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="resourceStateFilter">Estado</label>
        <select id="resourceStateFilter" class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); load(1)">
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="PROGRAMADO">Programado</option>
          <option value="EN_EJECUCION">En ejecución</option>
          <option value="COMPLETADO">Completado</option>
          <option value="CANCELADO">Cancelado</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="resourceDestinationFilter">Destino</label>
        <select
          id="resourceDestinationFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="destinationFilter()"
          [disabled]="destinationsLoading()"
          (change)="onDestinationFilter($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option value="">{{ destinationsLoading() ? 'Cargando destinos...' : 'Todos los destinos' }}</option>
          @for (destination of destinations(); track destination.tipo + ':' + destination.destinoId) {
            <option [value]="destinationKey(destination)">{{ destinationOptionLabel(destination) }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state title="Cargando recursos" message="Consultando programaciones y movimientos." />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="load()" />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin recursos programados" message="No hay programaciones para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table resource-program-table">
          <thead>
            <tr><th>Recurso</th><th>Destino</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Programación</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of result().items; track item.recursoProgramadoId) {
              <tr>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ resourceName(item) }}</strong><span>{{ resourceKind(item) }} · #{{ item.recursoProgramadoId }}</span></div></td>
                <td>{{ destination(item) }}</td>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.cantidadProgramada }}</strong><span>Devuelto: {{ item.cantidadDevuelta }}</span></div></td>
                <td>{{ item.fechaProgramacion ? (item.fechaProgramacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--info]="item.estadoProceso==='PROGRAMADO'" [class.admin-status--warning]="item.estadoProceso==='EN_EJECUCION'" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estadoProceso==='COMPLETADO'" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estadoProceso==='CANCELADO'">
                    {{ item.estadoProceso }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver detalle" (click)="view(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></button>
                    @if (item.estadoProceso === 'PROGRAMADO') {
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="edit(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--success" title="Asignar" [disabled]="actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId" (click)="assign(item)">
                        @if (actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="assignIcon" /> }
                      </button>
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Cancelar" [disabled]="actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId" (click)="cancel(item)">
                        @if (actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="cancelIcon" /> }
                      </button>
                    } @else if (item.estadoProceso === 'EN_EJECUCION') {
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small" (click)="returnResource(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="returnIcon" /> Devolver</button><button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="item.estadoProceso!=='EN_EJECUCION'" title="Registrar consumo" (click)="consume(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="consumeIcon" /></button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"

        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-recurso-programado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBan,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faCheck,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUtensils,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import {
  PageResult,
  emptyPageResult,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { AsignarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/asignar-recurso.use-case';
import { CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cancelar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-destinos-recursos.use-case';
import { ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-recursos-programados.use-case';
import {
  DestinoRecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramado,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
} from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { RecursoProgramadoFormComponent } from '../recurso-programado-form/recurso-programado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recursos-programados-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoProgramadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './recursos-programados-list.html',
  styleUrl: './recursos-programados-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursosProgramadosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoProgramadoFormComponent)
  private form!: RecursoProgramadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase);
  private readonly destinationsUseCase = inject(ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly assignUseCase = inject(AsignarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly cancelUseCase = inject(CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly destinationsLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly actionId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<RecursoProgramado>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly destinations = signal<readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[]>([]);

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly destinationFilter = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly assignIcon = faCheck;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly consumeIcon = faUtensils;
  readonly cancelIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadDestinations();
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const destination = this.selectedFilterDestination();

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoProceso: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        campaniaVentaId:
          destination?.tipo === 'CAMPANIA'
            ? destination.destinoId
            : undefined,
        operativoVentaId:
          destination?.tipo === 'OPERATIVO'
            ? destination.destinoId
            : undefined,
        salidaCampoId:
          destination?.tipo === 'SALIDA'
            ? destination.destinoId
            : undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadDestinations(): void {
    if (this.destinationsLoading()) return;

    const uotId =
      this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA'
        ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined
        : undefined;

    this.destinationsLoading.set(true);
    this.destinationsUseCase
      .execute(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.destinationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.destinations.set(items),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onDestinationFilter(value: string): void {
    this.destinationFilter.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  destinationKey(destination: DestinoRecursoProgramado): string {
    return `${destination.tipo}:${destination.destinoId}`;
  }

  destinationOptionLabel(destination: DestinoRecursoProgramado): string {
    const type = this.destinationTypeLabel(destination.tipo);
    const code = destination.codigo ? `${destination.codigo} · ` : '';
    const unit = destination.uotNombre ? ` · ${destination.uotNombre}` : '';
    return `${type} · ${code}${destination.nombre}${unit}`;
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate();
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadDestinations();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  async view(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    await this.form.openDetail(item, 'view');
  }

  async edit(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'edit');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async returnResource(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'return');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async consume(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'consume');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async assign(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Asignar recurso',
      message: `El recurso ${this.resourceName(item)} pasará a ejecución y quedará asignado a ${this.destination(item)}.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Asignar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.assignUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Recurso asignado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo asignar el recurso',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async cancel(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Cancelar programación',
      message: `La programación de ${this.resourceName(item)} para ${this.destination(item)} quedará cancelada.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Cancelar programación',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la cancelación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.cancelUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Programación cancelada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo cancelar',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  resourceName(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bien ?? item.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  resourceKind(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bienInventarioId ? 'Bien / vehículo' : 'Suministro';
  }

  destination(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    const identity = this.destinationIdentity(item);
    if (!identity) return '—';

    const destination = this.destinations().find(
      (candidate) =>
        candidate.tipo === identity.tipo &&
        candidate.destinoId === identity.id,
    );

    if (destination) {
      const unit = destination.uotNombre ? ` · ${destination.uotNombre}` : '';
      const code = destination.codigo ? `${destination.codigo} · ` : '';
      return `${code}${destination.nombre}${unit}`;
    }

    if (identity.tipo === 'CAMPANIA') return `Campaña #${identity.id}`;
    if (identity.tipo === 'OPERATIVO') return `Operativo #${identity.id}`;
    return `Salida de campo #${identity.id}`;
  }

  private selectedFilterDestination(): DestinoRecursoProgramado | null {
    const key = this.destinationFilter();
    if (!key) return null;
    return this.destinations().find((item) => this.destinationKey(item) === key) ?? null;
  }

  private destinationIdentity(
    item: RecursoProgramado,
  ): { tipo: TipoDestinoRecurso; id: number } | null {
    if (item.campaniaVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'CAMPANIA', id: item.campaniaVentaId };
    }
    if (item.operativoVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'OPERATIVO', id: item.operativoVentaId };
    }
    if (item.salidaCampoId) {
      return { tipo: 'SALIDA', id: item.salidaCampoId };
    }
    return null;
  }

  private destinationTypeLabel(type: TipoDestinoRecurso): string {
    if (type === 'CAMPANIA') return 'Campaña';
    if (type === 'OPERATIVO') return 'Operativo';
    return 'Salida';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBuildingCircleCheck, faGlobe } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-context-switcher',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-context-switcher.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-context-switcher.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotContextSwitcherComponent {
  @Input() compact = false;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly changing = signal(false);
  readonly unitIcon = faBuildingCircleCheck;
  readonly generalIcon = faGlobe;

  readonly value = computed(() =>
    this.store.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? 'GENERAL'
      : String(this.store.selectedId() ?? ''),
  );

  readonly disabled = computed(
    () =>
      this.changing() ||
      (!this.store.canUseGeneral() && this.store.memberships().length <= 1),
  );

  change(raw: string): void {
    if (this.changing() || !raw) return;

    const current = this.value();
    if (raw === current) return;

    const general = raw === 'GENERAL';
    const parsedUotId = Number(raw);

    if (!general && (!Number.isFinite(parsedUotId) || parsedUotId <= 0)) {
      return;
    }

    this.changing.set(true);

    this.api
      .selectContext(
        general ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA',
        general ? null : parsedUotId,
      )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.changing.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            general
              ? 'Vista general activada'
              : 'Unidad de trabajo actualizada',
          );
          globalThis.location.reload();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo cambiar la UOT',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map, switchMap, tap } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { UOTService } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/uOT.service';
import { UotAssignRoleRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotAssignRoleRequest';
import { UotAssignUserRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotAssignUserRequest';
import { UotCreateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotCreateRequest';
import { UotDeactivateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotDeactivateRequest';
import { UotDeactivationImpactResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotDeactivationImpactResponse';
import { UotResourceTransferResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotResourceTransferResponse';
import { UotSelectContextRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotSelectContextRequest';
import { UotTransferResourcesRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotTransferResourcesRequest';
import { UotUpdateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotUpdateRequest';
import { UotContextResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotContextResponse';
import { UotUnitResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotUnitResponse';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from '../../../../acceso/application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';
import {
  UotContext,
  UotDeactivationImpact,
  UotMode,
  UotResourceTransfer,
  UotTransferResources,
  UotUnit,
} from '../../../domain/uot.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UotApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(UOTService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);
  private readonly accessContext = inject(ObtenerContextoActualUseCase);
  private readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);

  loadContext() {
    return this.api
      .uotContexto({}, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map((response) => this.mapContext(unwrapApiResponse<UotContextResponse>(response))),
        tap((context) => this.store.set(context)),
      );
  }

  selectContext(mode: UotMode, uotId?: number | null) {
    const body: UotSelectContextRequest = {
      modo: mode,
      uotId: mode === 'ESPECIFICA' ? uotId ?? undefined : undefined,
    };

    return this.api
      .uotSeleccionarContexto(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotSelectContextRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => this.mapContext(unwrapApiResponse<UotContextResponse>(response))),
        tap((context) => this.store.set(context)),
        switchMap((context) =>
          this.accessContext.execute().pipe(map(() => context)),
        ),
      );
  }

  list(includeInactive = false, uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .uotListar(
        { incluirInactivas: includeInactive, uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          (unwrapApiResponse<UotUnitResponse[]>(response) ?? []).map((item) =>
            this.mapUnit(item),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  create(body: UotCreateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotCreateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  update(uotId: number, body: UotUpdateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotEditar(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotUpdateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  impact(uotId: number) {
    return this.api
      .uotImpactoBaja(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapImpact(
            unwrapApiResponse<UotDeactivationImpactResponse>(response),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  transferResources(uotId: number, input: UotTransferResources) {
    const uotTransferResourcesRequest: UotTransferResourcesRequest = {
      uotDestinoId: input.uotDestinoId,
      almacenOrigenId: input.almacenOrigenId,
      almacenDestinoId: input.almacenDestinoId,
      transferirStock: input.transferirStock,
      bienIds: input.bienIds ? [...input.bienIds] : undefined,
      suministroIds: input.suministroIds ? [...input.suministroIds] : undefined,
      motivo: input.motivo.trim(),
    };

    return this.api
      .uotTransferirRecursos(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotTransferResourcesRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapTransfer(
            unwrapApiResponse<UotResourceTransferResponse>(response),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  deactivate(uotId: number, reason: string) {
    const uotDeactivateRequest: UotDeactivateRequest = {
      motivo: reason.trim(),
    };

    return this.api
      .uotDeshabilitar(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotDeactivateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  assignUser(uotId: number, body: UotAssignUserRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotAsignarUsuario(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotAssignUserRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  assignRole(uotId: number, body: UotAssignRoleRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotAsignarRol(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotAssignRoleRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  private mapContext(value: UotContextResponse | undefined): UotContext {
    const uots = (value?.uots ?? [])
      .filter((item) => Number(item.uotId) > 0)
      .map((item) => ({
        usuarioUotId: item.usuarioUotId ?? null,
        uotId: Number(item.uotId),
        codigo: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
        nombre: item.nombre?.trim() || `UOT ${item.uotId}`,
        predeterminada: item.predeterminada === true,
        roles: [...(item.roles ?? [])],
      }));

    const selected = Number(value?.uotSeleccionadaId);
    const mode: UotMode = value?.modo === 'GENERAL' ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA';

    return {
      modo: mode,
      uotSeleccionadaId:
        Number.isFinite(selected) && selected > 0 ? selected : null,
      requiereSeleccion: value?.requiereSeleccion === true,
      permiteModoGeneral: value?.permiteModoGeneral === true,
      uots,
    };
  }

  private mapUnit(value: UotUnitResponse): UotUnit {
    return {
      uotId: Number(value.uotId ?? 0),
      uotPadreId: value.uotPadreId ?? null,
      ubicacionId: value.ubicacionId ?? null,
      codigo: value.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
      nombre: value.nombre?.trim() ?? '',
      descripcion: value.descripcion?.trim() || null,
      esRaiz: value.esRaiz === true,
      fechaInicio: value.fechaInicio ?? null,
      fechaFin: value.fechaFin ?? null,
      estado: value.estado !== false,
      asignada: value.asignada === true,
      predeterminada: value.predeterminada === true,
    };
  }

  private mapImpact(
    value: UotDeactivationImpactResponse | undefined,
  ): UotDeactivationImpact {
    return {
      uotId: Number(value?.uotId ?? 0),
      uotIncluidas: Number(value?.uotIncluidas ?? 0),
      usuariosActivos: Number(value?.usuariosActivos ?? 0),
      usuariosExclusivos: Number(value?.usuariosExclusivos ?? 0),
      empleadosActivos: Number(value?.empleadosActivos ?? 0),
      areasActivas: Number(value?.areasActivas ?? 0),
      organizacionesActivas: Number(value?.organizacionesActivas ?? 0),
      prediosActivos: Number(value?.prediosActivos ?? 0),
      almacenesActivos: Number(value?.almacenesActivos ?? 0),
      productosConStock: Number(value?.productosConStock ?? 0),
      stockReservado: Number(value?.stockReservado ?? 0),
      suministrosConStock: Number(value?.suministrosConStock ?? 0),
      suministrosReservados: Number(value?.suministrosReservados ?? 0),
      bienesActivos: Number(value?.bienesActivos ?? 0),
      ventasAbiertas: Number(value?.ventasAbiertas ?? 0),
      campaniasAbiertas: Number(value?.campaniasAbiertas ?? 0),
      operativosAbiertos: Number(value?.operativosAbiertos ?? 0),
      salidasAbiertas: Number(value?.salidasAbiertas ?? 0),
      recursosAbiertos: Number(value?.recursosAbiertos ?? 0),
      puedeDeshabilitar: value?.puedeDeshabilitar === true,
      bloqueos: [...(value?.bloqueos ?? [])],
    };
  }

  private mapTransfer(
    value: UotResourceTransferResponse | undefined,
  ): UotResourceTransfer {
    return {
      movimientoSalidaId: value?.movimientoSalidaId ?? null,
      movimientoEntradaId: value?.movimientoEntradaId ?? null,
      productosTransferidos: Number(value?.productosTransferidos ?? 0),
      bienesTransferidos: Number(value?.bienesTransferidos ?? 0),
      suministrosTransferidos: Number(value?.suministrosTransferidos ?? 0),
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { computed, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { UotContext } from '../domain/uot.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UotContextStore {
  private readonly contextSignal = signal<UotContext | null>(null);

  readonly context = this.contextSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly loaded = computed(() => this.contextSignal() !== null);
  readonly modo = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.modo ?? 'ESPECIFICA');
  readonly memberships = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.uots ?? []);
  readonly selectedId = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.uotSeleccionadaId ?? null);
  readonly requiresSelection = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.requiereSeleccion ?? false);
  readonly canUseGeneral = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.permiteModoGeneral ?? false);
  readonly selected = computed(() => {
    const id = this.selectedId();
    return id ? this.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === id) ?? null : null;
  });
  readonly label = computed(() =>
    this.modo() === 'GENERAL'
      ? 'Vista general'
      : this.selected()?.nombre ?? 'Seleccionar UOT',
  );

  set(context: UotContext): void {
    this.contextSignal.set({
      ...context,
      uots: context.uots.map((item) => ({ ...item, roles: [...item.roles] })),
    });
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.contextSignal.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowLeft, faClockRotateLeft, faCoins, faImage, faRotate, faRotateLeft } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin, of } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { PermissionService } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.service';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService, ResourceProductPriceHistory } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ResourceImageComponent } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-image/resource-image';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, DecimalPipe, RouterLink, FaIconComponent, PermissionDirective, EmptyStateComponent, ErrorStateComponent, LoadingStateComponent, ActionConfirmDialogComponent, LocalFilePanelComponent, PageHeaderComponent, ResourceImageComponent, ProductoFormComponent],
  templateUrl: './producto-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly historyLoading = signal(false);
  readonly actionLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly historyError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<ResourceProductDetailResponse | null>(null);
  readonly history = signal<readonly ResourceProductPriceHistory[]>([]);

  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;

  readonly productId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly requestedUotId = Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('uotId')) || null;

  ngOnInit(): void { this.load(); }

  load(): void {
    const uotId = this.targetUotId();
    if (!this.productId || !uotId) { this.loading.set(false); this.errorMessage.set('No se identificó correctamente el producto y su UOT.'); return; }
    this.loading.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const canHistory = this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL');
    forkJoin({
      detail: this.api.getProduct(this.productId, uotId),
      history: canHistory ? this.api.listProductPriceHistory(this.productId, uotId) : of([] as ResourceProductPriceHistory[]),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: ({ detail, history }) => { this.detail.set(detail ?? null); this.history.set(history); },
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  loadHistory(): void {
    if (!this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL')) return;
    this.historyLoading.set(true); this.historyError.set(null);
    const uotId = this.targetUotId();
    if (!uotId) { this.historyLoading.set(false); return; }
    this.api.listProductPriceHistory(this.productId, uotId).pipe(finalize(() => this.historyLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (items) => this.history.set(items),
      error: (error) => this.historyError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  async versionPrice(): Promise<void> {
    const item = this.detail(); if (!item) return;
    const uotId = this.targetUotId(); if (!uotId) return;
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item, uotId);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async reactivate(price: ResourceProductPriceHistory): Promise<void> {
    if (price.vigente || !price.productoPrecioId || this.actionLoadingId()) return;
    const result = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Reactivar precio histórico',
      message: `Se creará una nueva versión vigente con ${price.moneda} ${price.precioVenta.toFixed(2)}. La versión histórica no será modificada.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Crear versión vigente',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      tone: 'warning',
    });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    this.actionLoadingId.set(price.productoPrecioId);
    const uotId = this.targetUotId(); if (!uotId) { this.actionLoadingId.set(null); return; }
    this.api.reactivateProductPrice(this.productId, price.productoPrecioId, { uotId })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Precio reactivado como nueva versión'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo reactivar el precio', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  targetUotId(): number | null {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId();
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotId ?? this.requestedUotId;
  }

  canUploadImages(): boolean { return this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES') && this.permissions.has('ARCHIVOS_CREAR'); }
  imageIds(): readonly number[] { const id = this.detail()?.archivoPrincipalId; return id ? [id] : []; }
}
```

```html
<section class="area-hierarchy" aria-label="Jerarquía de áreas">
  <div class="area-hierarchy__viewport">
    <div class="area-hierarchy__canvas">
      <article class="area-node area-node--company">
        <span class="area-node__icon"><fa-icon [icon]="companyIcon" /></span>
```

```typescript
})
export class AreaHierarchyComponent {
  readonly companyName = input('Organización');
  readonly companyRuc = input<string | null>(null);
  readonly areas = input<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  readonly roots = computed<readonly AreaTreeNode[]>(() => {
    const items = this.areas().filter((area) => area.estado);
    const byParent = new Map<number | null, Area[]>();
    const activeIds = new Set(items.map((area) => area.areaId));

    for (const area of items) {
      const parentId = area.areaPadreId && activeIds.has(area.areaPadreId)
        ? area.areaPadreId
        : null;
      const children = byParent.get(parentId) ?? [];
      children.push(area);
      byParent.set(parentId, children);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null, visited: ReadonlySet<number>): AreaTreeNode[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .filter((area) => !visited.has(area.areaId))
        .sort((a, b) => a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre))
        .map((area) => {
          const nextVisited = new Set(visited);
          nextVisited.add(area.areaId);
          return {
            area,
            children: build(area.areaId, nextVisited),
          };
        });

    return build(null, new Set<number>());
  });
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div
    class="modal-box admin-modal-box"
    [class.admin-modal-box--wide]="kind() === 'view'"
  >
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="icon()" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Organizaciones</p>
          <h2>{{ title() }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    @if (kind() === 'view' && detail(); as organizationDetail) {
      <div class="organization-view">
        <section class="organization-summary">
          <div>
            <span>Razón social</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.razonSocial }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>

            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.ruc }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Tipo</span>
            <strong>
              {{ organizationDetail.organizacion.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>UOT</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.uotNombre }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Correo</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.correo || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Teléfono</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.telefono || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Nombre comercial</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.nombreComercial || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Distrito</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.distritoNombre || organizationDetail.distritoCodigo }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Centro poblado</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.centroPobladoNombre || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Referencia</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.referencia || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Áreas</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.areas.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (area of organizationDetail.areas; track area.areaId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ area.nombre }}</strong>
                  <small>{{ area.codigo }}</small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay áreas registradas.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Empleados activos</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.empleados.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (employee of organizationDetail.empleados; track employee.empleadoId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ employee.empleado }}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {{ employee.numeroDocumento || 'Sin documento' }}
                    ·
                    {{ employee.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}
                  </small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay empleados activos.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cerrar
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    } @else if (kind() === 'area') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="areaForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="areaUot">UOT del área</label>
          <select
            id="areaUot"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="uotId"
            (change)="onUotChange()"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>
            @for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <small>En vista general puede escoger la UOT; al editar permanece fija.</small>
          <app-form-error [control]="areaForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />

        <div class="admin-field">

          <select
            id="areaParent"

            formControlName="areaPadreId"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Sin área superior</option>
            @for (area of areasForSelectedUot(); track area.areaId) {
              <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="areaName">Nombre</label>
          <input
            id="areaName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="nombre"
            maxlength="120"
            placeholder="Nombre del área"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="areaForm.controls.nombre"
            fieldLabel="El nombre"
          />
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button

          >

          <button

            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="companyForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationUot">UOT del contrato</label>
          <select id="organizationUot" class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>
            @for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <small>En vista general puede escoger la UOT; al editar el contrato permanece en su UOT.</small>
          <app-form-error [control]="companyForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationRuc">RUC</label>
          <div class="identity-document-control">
            <input
              id="organizationRuc"
              class="admin-input"
              type="text"
              formControlName="ruc"
              inputmode="numeric"
              autocomplete="off"
              maxlength="11"
              placeholder="20XXXXXXXXX"
              [readOnly]="identityLoading()"
              (input)="onRucInput()"
            />

            @if (!currentCompany()) {
              <button
                type="button"
                class="identity-search-button"
                [disabled]="!canResolveRuc()"
                [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
                (click)="resolveRuc()"
              >
                @if (identityLoading()) {
                  <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                  Buscando...
                } @else {
                  <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                  Buscar
                }
              </button>
            }
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.ruc"
            fieldLabel="El RUC"
            [messages]="{
              ruc: 'Ingresa un RUC válido de 11 dígitos con dígito verificador correcto.',
              rucNature: 'Para una empresa o asociación se requiere un RUC empresarial válido.'
            }"
          />
        </div>

        @if (identityMessage()) {
          <div
            class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
            [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
            [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
            [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
            role="status"
          >
            {{ identityMessage() }}
          </div>
        }

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="businessName">Razón social</label>
          <input
            id="businessName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="razonSocial"
            maxlength="200"
          [readOnly]="identityLocks().businessName" />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.razonSocial"
            fieldLabel="La razón social"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">

          <input
            id="tradeName"

            type="text"
            formControlName="nombreComercial"

          />
          <app-form-error [control]="companyForm.controls.nombreComercial" fieldLabel="El nombre comercial" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre comercial no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />

        <div class="admin-field">

          <app-form-error

            fieldLabel="El correo"

        <app-geography-cascade
          [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
          [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"

        />


        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo"
            fieldLabel="El distrito"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
          <input
            id="organizationReference"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="referencia"
            maxlength="300"
            placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia"
          [readOnly]="identityLocks().reference" />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.referencia"
            fieldLabel="La referencia"
          />
        </div>

        @if (kind() === 'association') {
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="foundationDate">Fecha de constitución</label>
            <input
              id="foundationDate"
              class="admin-input"
              type="date"
              formControlName="fechaConstitucion"
              [max]="today"
            />
            <app-form-error
              [control]="companyForm.controls.fechaConstitucion"
              fieldLabel="La fecha de constitución"
              [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de constitución no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="registryNumber">Número de partida</label>
            <input
              id="registryNumber"
              class="admin-input"
              type="text"
              formControlName="numeroPartida"
              maxlength="50"
            />
            <app-form-error [control]="companyForm.controls.numeroPartida" fieldLabel="El número de partida" [messages]="{ blank: 'El número de partida no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
          </div>
        }

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
            (click)="close()"
          >

          </button>
          <button

              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```
