```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBuilding,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faSitemap,
  faUserGroup,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
  phoneValidator,
  rucValidator,
  sanitizeDocument,
  sanitizePhone,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface OrganizationFormOptions {
  preferredUotId?: number;
}

interface AreaModalOptions extends OrganizationFormOptions {
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('JURIDICA'),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    numeroPartida: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    options: OrganizationFormOptions = {},
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail, options.preferredUotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    options: OrganizationFormOptions = {},
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail, options.preferredUotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);

    const uotId = this.resolveTargetUotId(
      area?.uotId ?? options.preferredUotId,
    );

    this.areaForm.reset({
      uotId,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });

    this.configureUotControl(this.areaForm.controls.uotId, Boolean(area));
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument(
      'RUC',
      this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value,
    );

    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && /^\d{11}$/.test(ruc);
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    control.setValue(ruc, { emitEvent: false });
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(ruc)) {
      const message =
        'Ingrese los 11 dígitos del RUC antes de buscar.';

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(message);
      return;
    }

    if (control.invalid) {
      const message = this.rucValidationMessage();

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(message);
      return;
    }

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando primero en DESCO. Si no existe y la consulta externa está deshabilitada, se habilitará la carga manual.',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;

          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('error');
          this.identityMessage.set(message);
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
        },
      });
  }

  onOrganizationPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedUot(): readonly Area[] {
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;
    const blockedIds = new Set<number>();

    if (currentAreaId !== null) {
      blockedIds.add(currentAreaId);

      let changed = true;
      while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        for (const area of this.areaOptions()) {
          if (
            area.areaPadreId !== null &&
            blockedIds.has(area.areaPadreId) &&
            !blockedIds.has(area.areaId)
          ) {
            blockedIds.add(area.areaId);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const uotId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().uotId);

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.uotId === uotId &&
        !blockedIds.has(area.areaId) &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      uotId: this.resolveTargetUotId(company?.uotId ?? preferredUotId),
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: sanitizePhone(company?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (company?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.configureUotControl(this.companyForm.controls.uotId, Boolean(company));

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    if (this.saving() || this.identityLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.companyForm.invalid) {
      const message = this.organizationValidationMessage();

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.toast.info('Revisa el formulario', message);
      this.focusFirstInvalidControl('form');
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        const message =
          'Primero pulse Buscar. DESCO revisará la base local y, si la consulta externa está deshabilitada, habilitará el ingreso manual.';

        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.identityTone.set('warning');
        this.identityMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.info('Falta validar el RUC', message);
        this.focusFirstInvalidControl(
          '#organizationRuc',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      uotId: Number(values.uotId),
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.uotId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    if (this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.areaForm.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid) {
      const message = this.areaValidationMessage();

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.toast.info('Revisa el formulario', message);
      this.focusFirstInvalidControl('form');
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          uotId: Number(values.uotId),
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          uotId: Number(values.uotId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.queryStatus === 'PROVIDER_DISABLED'
          ? 'El RUC no existe en DESCO y la consulta externa está deshabilitada. Puede completar los datos manualmente y guardar.'
          : 'El RUC no devolvió datos automáticos. Puede completar la información manualmente y guardar.',
      );
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      return;
    }

    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.message ||
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private rucValidationMessage(): string {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;

    if (control.hasError('rucNature')) {
      return 'El RUC debe corresponder a una empresa o asociación con RUC empresarial.';
    }

    if (control.hasError('ruc')) {
      return 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.';
    }

    return 'Ingrese un RUC válido antes de continuar.';
  }

  private organizationValidationMessage(): string {
    const controls = this.companyForm.controls;

    if (controls.uotId.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione la UOT a la que pertenece este contrato.';
    }

    if (controls.ruc.invalid) {
      return this.rucValidationMessage();
    }

    if (controls.razonSocial.invalid) {
      return 'Revise la razón social. Es obligatoria y no puede contener solo espacios.';
    }

    if (controls.telefono.invalid) {
      return 'Revise el teléfono. Use entre 7 y 15 dígitos.';
    }

    if (controls.correo.invalid) {
      return 'Revise el correo electrónico ingresado.';
    }

    if (controls.distritoCodigo.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione un distrito válido.';
    }

    if (controls.fechaConstitucion.invalid) {
      return 'Revise la fecha de constitución.';
    }

    if (
      controls.nombreComercial.invalid ||
      controls.referencia.invalid ||
      controls.numeroPartida.invalid
    ) {
      return 'Revise los campos marcados antes de guardar.';
    }

    return 'Revise los campos obligatorios antes de guardar.';
  }

  private areaValidationMessage(): string {
    const controls = this.areaForm.controls;

    if (controls.uotId.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione la UOT a la que pertenece el área.';
    }

    if (controls.nombre.invalid) {
      return 'Ingrese un nombre válido para el área.';
    }

    if (controls.codigo.invalid) {
      return 'No se pudo generar un código válido para el área.';
    }

    return 'Revise los campos del área antes de guardar.';
  }

  private focusFirstInvalidControl(
    selector: string,
  ): void {
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const dialog = this.dialogRef.nativeElement;
      const explicit = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        selector,
      );

      if (
        explicit &&
        selector.startsWith('#')
      ) {
        explicit.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: 'smooth',
          block: 'center',
        });
        explicit.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }

      const invalid = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        'form .ng-invalid:not(form), form [aria-invalid="true"]',
      );

      invalid?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: 'smooth',
        block: 'center',
      });
      invalid?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.areaForm.controls.areaPadreId.setValue(0);
    }
  }

  uotLabel(uotId?: number | null): string {
    const id = uotId ?? (
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().uotId)
        : Number(this.companyForm.getRawValue().uotId)
    );

    return this.uot.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  private resolveTargetUotId(preferredUotId?: number | null): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? preferredUotId ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0 ? preferredUotId : 0;
  }

  private configureUotControl(
    control: { enable(options?: { emitEvent?: boolean }): void; disable(options?: { emitEvent?: boolean }): void },
    editing: boolean,
  ): void {
    if (editing || this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      control.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.resetState();
    });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Organizaciones"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general: consulta empresas, asociaciones y áreas de todas tus UOT sin mezclar permisos.' : 'Empresas, asociaciones y áreas de ' + contextUotName() + '.'"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="organizationsLoading() || areasLoading()" (click)="reloadAll()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="createCompany()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Nueva empresa
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="createAssociation()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" /> Nueva asociación
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      @if (isGeneral()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationUotFilter">Filtrar por UOT</label>
          <select id="organizationUotFilter" class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="changeUot($any($event.target).value)">
            <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
            @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>
      } @else {
        <span class="admin-muted-badge">UOT: {{ contextUotName() }}</span>
      }
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'organizations'" (click)="setTab('organizations')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="companyIcon" /> Organizaciones
    </button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'areas'" (click)="setTab('areas')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" /> Áreas
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (activeTab() === 'organizations') {
    <section class="admin-surface">
      @if (organizationsLoading()) {
        <app-loading-state title="Cargando organizaciones" message="Consultando los contratos visibles según el contexto UOT." />
      } @else if (organizationsError()) {
        <app-error-state [message]="organizationsError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadOrganizations()" />
      } @else if (organizations().items.length === 0) {
        <app-empty-state title="Sin organizaciones" message="No hay empresas o asociaciones para el filtro UOT seleccionado." />
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Organización</th><th>UOT</th><th>RUC</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Contacto</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (company of organizations().items; track company.empresaId + '-' + company.uotId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span
                        class="admin-entity-icon"
                        [class.organization-entity-icon--association]="company.esAsociacion"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="company.esAsociacion ? associationIcon : companyIcon" />
                      </span>
                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ company.razonSocial }}</strong>
                        <span>{{ company.nombreComercial || 'Sin nombre comercial' }}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="organization-uot-chip">
                      <strong>{{ company.uotNombre }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ company.uotCodigo }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td><span class="admin-code">{{ company.ruc }}</span></td>
                  <td>
                    <span
                      class="organization-type-chip"
                      [class.organization-type-chip--association]="company.esAsociacion"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="company.esAsociacion ? associationIcon : companyIcon" />
                      {{ company.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ company.correo || '—' }}</strong><span>{{ company.telefono || '—' }}</span></div></td>
                  <td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="company.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!company.estado">{{ company.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}</span></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver detalle" [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId || disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="viewOrganization(company)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar en esta UOT" [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === company.empresaId || disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="editOrganization(company)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Retirar de esta UOT" [disabled]="disablingOrganizationId() !== null" (click)="disableOrganization(company)"><fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <app-paginator [page]="organizations().page" [size]="organizations().size" [totalRecords]="organizations().totalRecords" [totalPages]="organizations().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadOrganizations($event, organizations().size)" (sizeChange)="loadOrganizations(1, $event)" />
      }
    </section>
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface area-workspace">
      <div class="area-workspace__toolbar">
        <div class="area-view-switch" role="group" aria-label="Vista de áreas">
          <button type="button" [class.active]="areaView() === 'hierarchy'" (click)="setAreaView('hierarchy')"><fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" /> Jerarquía</button>
          <button type="button" [class.active]="areaView() === 'table'" (click)="setAreaView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /> Tabla</button>
        </div>
        <div class="admin-toolbar-actions">
          <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="areasLoading() || referencesLoading()" (click)="reloadAll()"><fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button>
          <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading() || referencesError() !== null" (click)="createArea()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Nueva área</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      @if (referencesError()) {
        <app-error-state [message]="referencesError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadReferences()" />
      } @else if (areaView() === 'hierarchy') {
        @if (referencesLoading()) {
          <app-loading-state title="Cargando estructura" message="Consultando áreas de la UOT." />
        } @else {
          <div class="area-hierarchy-heading">
            <div>
              <span>Mapa de áreas</span>
              <strong>{{ contextUotName() }}</strong>
            </div>
            <small>
              @if (isGeneral() && !unitFilter()) {
                Se muestran todas tus UOT en ramas independientes. Arrastra el lienzo para recorrer la estructura.
              } @else {
                Arrastra el lienzo para recorrer la jerarquía de la UOT seleccionada.
              }
            </small>
          </div>
          <app-area-hierarchy
            [companyName]="contextUotName()"
            [companyRuc]="null"
            [areas]="hierarchyAreas()"
          />
        }
      } @else {
        @if (areasLoading()) {
          <app-loading-state title="Cargando áreas" message="Consultando la estructura visible." />
        } @else if (areasError()) {
          <app-error-state [message]="areasError() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="loadAreas()" />
        } @else if (areas().items.length === 0) {
          <app-empty-state title="Sin áreas" message="No hay áreas para el filtro UOT seleccionado." />
        } @else {
          <div class="admin-table-wrap">
            <table class="admin-table">
              <thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Área</th><th>UOT</th><th>Área superior</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                @for (area of areas().items; track area.areaId + '-' + area.uotId) {
                  <tr>
                    <td><span class="admin-code">{{ area.codigo }}</span></td>
                    <td class="admin-table-primary">{{ area.nombre }}</td>
                    <td>
                      <div class="organization-uot-chip">
                        <strong>{{ area.uotNombre }}</strong>
                        <span>{{ area.uotCodigo }}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ area.areaPadre || 'Área principal' }}</td>
                    <td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="area.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!area.estado">{{ area.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}</span></td>
                    <td><div class="admin-row-actions">
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar área" [disabled]="disablingAreaId() !== null" (click)="editArea(area)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'ORGANIZACIONES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Deshabilitar área" [disabled]="disablingAreaId() !== null" (click)="disableArea(area)"><fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" /></button>
                    </div></td>
                  </tr>
                }
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <app-paginator [page]="areas().page" [size]="areas().size" [totalRecords]="areas().totalRecords" [totalPages]="areas().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAreas($event, areas().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAreas(1, $event)" />
        }
      }
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-organizacion-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faBuilding,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
  faTable,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { DeshabilitarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-area.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarOrganizacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-organizacion.use-case';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';
import { AreaHierarchyComponent } from '../../components/area-hierarchy/area-hierarchy';
import { OrganizacionFormComponent } from '../organizacion-form/organizacion-form';

type OrganizationTab = 'organizations' | 'areas';
type AreaView = 'hierarchy' | 'table';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizaciones-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AreaHierarchyComponent,
    OrganizacionFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizaciones-list.html',
  styleUrl: './organizaciones-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(OrganizacionFormComponent)
  private formModal!: OrganizacionFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly disableOrganizationUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarOrganizacionUseCase);
  private readonly disableAreaUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly activeTab = signal<OrganizationTab>('organizations');
  readonly areaView = signal<AreaView>('hierarchy');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly organizationsLoading = signal(false);
  readonly areasLoading = signal(false);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly disablingOrganizationId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly disablingAreaId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly organizationsError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly areasError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referenceAreas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly organizations = signal<PageResult<Empresa>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly areas = signal<PageResult<Area>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly pageIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly tableIcon = faTable;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly units = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());
  readonly contextUotId = computed(() =>
    this.isGeneral() ? this.unitFilter() : this.uot.selectedId(),
  );
  readonly contextUotName = computed(() => {
    const id = this.contextUotId();
    return id
      ? this.units().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre ?? 'UOT'
      : 'Todas mis UOT';
  });
  readonly hierarchyAreas = computed(() => {
    const id = this.contextUotId();
    return this.referenceAreas().filter(
      (area) => area.estado && (!id || area.uotId === id),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(
      this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA'
        ? this.uot.selectedId()
        : null,
    );
    this.reloadAll();
  }

  setTab(tab: OrganizationTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  setAreaView(view: AreaView): void {
    this.areaView.set(view);
  }

  changeUot(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.reloadAll();
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);
    const uotId = this.contextUotId() ?? undefined;

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.listUseCase.areas(page, size, uotId))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.referenceAreas.set(items.filter((area) => area.estado)),
        error: (error) => {
          this.referenceAreas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  loadOrganizations(
    page = this.organizations().page,
    size = this.organizations().size,
  ): void {
    this.organizationsLoading.set(true);
    this.organizationsError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute(page, size, this.contextUotId() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.organizationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.organizations.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.organizationsError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadAreas(
    page = this.areas().page,
    size = this.areas().size,
  ): void {
    this.areasLoading.set(true);
    this.areasError.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .areas(page, size, this.contextUotId() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.areasLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.areas.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.areasError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createCompany(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openCompany({
      preferredUotId: this.contextUotId() ?? undefined,
    });
    if (result.saved) this.reloadAll();
  }

  async createAssociation(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.formModal.openAssociation({
      preferredUotId: this.contextUotId() ?? undefined,
    });
    if (result.saved) this.reloadAll();
  }

  editOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) return;
    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase.detail(company.empresaId, company.uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.openOrganizationEditor(detail),
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo abrir la organización', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private async openOrganizationEditor(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<void> {
    const options = { preferredUotId: detail.organizacion.uotId };
    const result = detail.organizacion.esAsociacion
      ? await this.formModal.openAssociation(options, detail)
      : await this.formModal.openCompany(options, detail);
    if (result.saved) this.reloadAll();
  }

  viewOrganization(company: Empresa): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) return;
    this.detailLoadingId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.listUseCase.detail(company.empresaId, company.uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => void this.formModal.openView(detail),
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo abrir la organización', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async disableOrganization(company: Empresa): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disablingOrganizationId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: company.esAsociacion ? 'Retirar asociación de la UOT' : 'Retirar empresa de la UOT',
      message: `Se retirará el vínculo de ${company.razonSocial} con ${company.uotNombre}. El historial se conservará.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 300,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.disablingOrganizationId.set(company.empresaId);
    this.disableOrganizationUseCase.execute(company.empresaId, company.uotId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingOrganizationId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Organización retirada de la UOT');
          this.reloadAll();
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo retirar la organización', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async createArea(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canUseReferences()) return;
    const result = await this.formModal.openArea({
      areas: this.referenceAreas(),
      preferredUotId: this.contextUotId() ?? undefined,
    });
    if (result.saved) this.reloadAll();
  }

  async editArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canUseReferences()) return;
    const result = await this.formModal.openArea(
      { areas: this.referenceAreas(), preferredUotId: area.uotId },
      area,
    );
    if (result.saved) this.reloadAll();
  }

  async disableArea(area: Area): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disablingAreaId()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar área',
      message: `Se deshabilitará ${area.nombre} en ${area.uotNombre}. También se cerrarán sus subáreas y asignaciones activas de esa UOT.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 300,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.disablingAreaId.set(area.areaId);
    this.disableAreaUseCase.execute(area.areaId, area.uotId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingAreaId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Área deshabilitada');
          this.reloadAll();
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el área', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private canUseReferences(): boolean {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) return false;
    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las áreas', this.referencesError()!);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  reloadAll(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadOrganizations(1);
    this.loadAreas(1);
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div
    class="modal-box admin-modal-box"
    [class.admin-modal-box--wide]="kind() === 'view'"
  >
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="icon()" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Organizaciones</p>
          <h2>{{ title() }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div
        class="admin-inline-error organization-form-alert"
        role="alert"
        aria-live="assertive"
      >
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    @if (kind() === 'view' && detail(); as organizationDetail) {
      <div class="organization-view">
        <section class="organization-view-context">
          <div class="organization-view-context__identity">
            <span
              class="organization-view-context__icon"
              [class.organization-view-context__icon--association]="organizationDetail.organizacion.esAsociacion"
            >
              <fa-icon
                [icon]="organizationDetail.organizacion.esAsociacion ? associationIcon : companyIcon"
              />
            </span>
            <div>
              <span>Tipo de organización</span>
              <strong>
                {{ organizationDetail.organizacion.esAsociacion ? 'Asociación' : 'Empresa' }}
              </strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="organization-view-context__uot">
            <span>UOT del contrato</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.uotNombre }}</strong>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-summary">
          <div>
            <span>Razón social</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.razonSocial }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>RUC</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.ruc }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Correo</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.correo || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Teléfono</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.telefono || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Nombre comercial</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.organizacion.nombreComercial || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Distrito</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.distritoNombre || organizationDetail.distritoCodigo }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Centro poblado</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.centroPobladoNombre || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span>Referencia</span>
            <strong>{{ organizationDetail.referencia || '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="organization-view-section">
          <header>
            <h3>Áreas</h3>
            <span>{{ organizationDetail.areas.length }}</span>
          </header>

          <div class="organization-mini-list">
            @for (area of organizationDetail.areas; track area.areaId) {
              <article>
                <span class="organization-mini-icon">
                  <fa-icon [icon]="areaIcon" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ area.nombre }}</strong>
                  <small>{{ area.codigo }}</small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {

                  <fa-icon [icon]="associationIcon" />

                  <strong>{{ employee.empleado }}</strong>
                  <small>

                    ·
                    {{ employee.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}
                  </small>
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="organization-empty">No hay empleados activos.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions organization-view-actions">
          <button
            type="button"

            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cerrar
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    } @else if (kind() === 'area') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="areaForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">

          </select>
          <small>En vista general puede escoger la UOT; al editar permanece fija.</small>
          <app-form-error [control]="areaForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="areaParent">Área superior</label>
          <select
            id="areaParent"
            class="admin-select"

            <option [value]="0">Sin área superior</option>
            @for (area of areasForSelectedUot(); track area.areaId) {
              <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>

          <input
            id="areaName"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"

            maxlength="120"
            placeholder="Nombre del área"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="areaForm.controls.nombre"
            fieldLabel="El nombre"
          />
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button

            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
            (click)="close()"
          >

          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="companyForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">

          <label for="organizationUot">UOT del contrato</label>
          <select id="organizationUot" class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId">

          <small>En vista general puede escoger la UOT; al editar el contrato permanece en su UOT.</small>
          <app-form-error [control]="companyForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationRuc">RUC</label>
          <div class="identity-document-control">

              class="admin-input"
              type="text"

              inputmode="numeric"

              maxlength="11"
              placeholder="XXXXXXXXXXX"
              [readOnly]="identityLoading()"
              (input)="onRucInput()"
            />

            @if (!currentCompany()) {

                @if (identityLoading()) {

          @if (!currentCompany()) {

          }
        </div>

        @if (identityMessage()) {
          <div
            class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
            [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
            [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="businessName">Razón social</label>

        <div class="admin-field">

        <div class="admin-field">

          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.telefono"
            fieldLabel="El teléfono"
            [messages]="{ phone: 'Ingrese un teléfono válido de 7 a 15 dígitos.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="organizationEmail">Correo</label>
          <input
            id="organizationEmail"
            class="admin-input"
            type="email"
            formControlName="correo"
            autocomplete="email"
            maxlength="180"
            [readOnly]="identityLocks().email"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.correo"
            fieldLabel="El correo"
          />
        </div>

        <app-geography-cascade
          [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
          [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
          [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
          [locationLocked]="identityLocks().geography"
          (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
        />

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo"
            fieldLabel="El distrito"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="organizationReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
          <input
            id="organizationReference"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="referencia"
            maxlength="300"
            placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia"
            [readOnly]="identityLocks().reference"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="companyForm.controls.referencia"
            fieldLabel="La referencia"
          />
        </div>

        @if (kind() === 'association') {
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="foundationDate">Fecha de constitución</label>
            <input
              id="foundationDate"
              class="admin-input"
              type="date"
              formControlName="fechaConstitucion"
              [max]="today"
            />
            <app-form-error
              [control]="companyForm.controls.fechaConstitucion"
              fieldLabel="La fecha de constitución"
              [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de constitución no puede ser futura.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="registryNumber">Número de partida</label>
            <input
              id="registryNumber"
              class="admin-input"
              type="text"
              formControlName="numeroPartida"
              maxlength="50"
            />
            <app-form-error
              [control]="companyForm.controls.numeroPartida"
              fieldLabel="El número de partida"
              [messages]="{ blank: 'El número de partida no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
            />
          </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"

            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button

          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```
