```typescript
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { CrearAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-area.use-case';
import { CrearAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-asociacion.use-case';
import { CrearEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empresa.use-case';
import { EditarAreaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-area.use-case';
import { EditarAsociacionUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-asociacion.use-case';
import { EditarEmpresaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empresa.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../domain/area.model';
import { Empresa, OrganizacionDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empresa.model';

type OrganizationFormKind = 'company' | 'association' | 'area' | 'view';
type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  businessName: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    businessName: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

interface OrganizationFormOptions {
  preferredUotId?: number;
}

interface AreaModalOptions extends OrganizationFormOptions {
  areas: readonly Area[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-organizacion-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './organizacion-form.html',
  styleUrl: './organizacion-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class OrganizacionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createCompanyUseCase = inject(CrearEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly updateCompanyUseCase = inject(EditarEmpresaUseCase);
  private readonly createAssociationUseCase = inject(CrearAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly updateAssociationUseCase = inject(EditarAsociacionUseCase);
  private readonly createAreaUseCase = inject(CrearAreaUseCase);
  private readonly updateAreaUseCase = inject(EditarAreaUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly kind = signal<OrganizationFormKind>('company');
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly currentCompany = signal<Empresa | null>(null);
  readonly currentArea = signal<Area | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<OrganizacionDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areaOptions = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly companyIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly associationIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly areaIcon = faSitemap;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly companyForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ruc: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.pattern(/^\d{11}$/),
      ],
    ],
    razonSocial: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    ],
    nombreComercial: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
    correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    distritoCodigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
    ],
    centroPobladoId: [0],
    referencia: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    fechaConstitucion: ['', [notFutureDateValidator]],
    numeroPartida: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
  });

  readonly areaForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    areaPadreId: [0],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
  });

  openCompany(
    options: OrganizationFormOptions = {},
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('company');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail, options.preferredUotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  openAssociation(
    options: OrganizationFormOptions = {},
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('association');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail?.organizacion ?? null);
    this.resetCompanyForm(detail, options.preferredUotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  openArea(
    options: AreaModalOptions,
    area: Area | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('area');
    this.currentArea.set(area);
    this.areaOptions.set(options.areas);

    const uotId = this.resolveTargetUotId(
      area?.uotId ?? options.preferredUotId,
    );

    this.areaForm.reset({
      uotId,
      areaPadreId: area?.areaPadreId ?? 0,
      codigo: area?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: area?.nombre ?? '',
    });

    this.configureUotControl(this.areaForm.controls.uotId, Boolean(area));
    this.areaForm.controls.codigo[area ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openView(detail: OrganizacionDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.resetState();
    this.kind.set('view');
    this.detail.set(detail);
    this.currentCompany.set(detail.organizacion);
    return this.show();
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.identityLocks().geography) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onRucInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  canResolveRuc(): boolean {
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument(
      'RUC',
      this.companyForm.controls.ruc.value,
    );

    return !this.currentCompany()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && /^\d{11}$/.test(ruc);
  }

  resolveRuc(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', control.value);

    control.setValue(ruc, { emitEvent: false });
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(ruc)) {
      const message =
        'Ingrese exactamente 11 dígitos antes de buscar.';

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(message);
      return;
    }

    if (!this.canResolveRuc()) {
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'Buscando primero en DESCO. Si no hay datos automáticos disponibles, podrá continuar con la carga manual.',
    );

    this.identities
      .resolve('EMPRESA', 'RUC', ruc)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.applyCompanyIdentity(result, ruc),
        error: () => {
          /*
           * El alta de organizaciones admite RUC de 11 dígitos.
           * La resolución de identidad es una ayuda para buscar datos,
           * no una condición que deba bloquear la carga manual.
           *
           * Cuando la consulta externa está deshabilitada, o cuando
           * el servicio de identidad no puede resolver el documento,
           * dejamos el RUC como revisado y continuamos manualmente.
           */
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.companyIdentityKey(ruc),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se obtuvieron datos automáticos. Puede completar la organización manualmente y guardar.',
          );
          this.errorMessage.set(null);
        },
      });
  }

  onOrganizationPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.saveArea();
      return;
    }

    this.saveOrganization();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  areasForSelectedUot(): readonly Area[] {
    const currentAreaId = this.currentArea()?.areaId ?? null;
    const blockedIds = new Set<number>();

    if (currentAreaId !== null) {
      blockedIds.add(currentAreaId);

      let changed = true;
      while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        for (const area of this.areaOptions()) {
          if (
            area.areaPadreId !== null &&
            blockedIds.has(area.areaPadreId) &&
            !blockedIds.has(area.areaId)
          ) {
            blockedIds.add(area.areaId);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const uotId = Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().uotId);

    return this.areaOptions().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.uotId === uotId &&
        !blockedIds.has(area.areaId) &&
        area.estado,
    );
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.kind() === 'view') {
      return 'Detalle de organización';
    }

    const editing = Boolean(
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? this.currentArea()
        : this.currentCompany(),
    );

    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return editing
        ? 'Editar asociación'
        : 'Registrar asociación';
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return editing ? 'Editar área' : 'Registrar área';
    }

    return editing ? 'Editar empresa' : 'Registrar empresa';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.kind() === 'association') {
      return this.associationIcon;
    }

    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      return this.areaIcon;
    }

    return this.companyIcon;
  }

  private resetCompanyForm(
    detail: OrganizacionDetalle | null,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): void {
    const company = detail?.organizacion ?? null;

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.companyForm.reset({
      uotId: this.resolveTargetUotId(company?.uotId ?? preferredUotId),
      ruc: company?.ruc ?? '',
      razonSocial: company?.razonSocial ?? '',
      nombreComercial: company?.nombreComercial ?? '',
      telefono: sanitizePhone(company?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (company?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaConstitucion: company?.fechaConstitucion ?? '',
      numeroPartida: company?.numeroPartida ?? '',
    });

    this.configureUotControl(this.companyForm.controls.uotId, Boolean(company));

    this.companyForm.controls.ruc[
      company ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    if (company) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.companyIdentityKey(company.ruc),
      );
    }
  }

  private saveOrganization(): void {
    if (this.saving() || this.identityLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    this.companyForm.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.companyForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.companyForm.invalid) {
      const message = this.organizationValidationMessage();

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.toast.info('Revisa el formulario', message);
      this.focusFirstInvalidControl('form');
      return;
    }

    const values = this.companyForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    const current = this.currentCompany();
    const association = this.kind() === 'association';
    const ruc = sanitizeDocument('RUC', values.ruc);

    if (!current) {
      if (
        this.verifiedIdentityKey() !==
        this.companyIdentityKey(ruc)
      ) {
        const message =
          'Primero pulse Buscar. Se intentará localizar el RUC en DESCO y, si no hay datos automáticos disponibles, podrá continuar con el ingreso manual.';

        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.identityTone.set('warning');
        this.identityMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.info('Falta validar el RUC', message);
        this.focusFirstInvalidControl(
          '#organizationRuc',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (this.identityBlocked()) {
        this.errorMessage.set(
          this.identityMessage() ||
            'No se puede usar esta empresa para el registro.',
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const common = {
      uotId: Number(values.uotId),
      razonSocial: normalizeText(values.razonSocial),
      nombreComercial: normalizeOptionalText(
        values.nombreComercial,
      ),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = association
      ? current
        ? this.updateAssociationUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            {
              ...common,
              fechaConstitucion:
                values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
              numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
                values.numeroPartida,
              ),
            },
          )
        : this.createAssociationUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
            fechaConstitucion:
              values.fechaConstitucion || undefined,
            numeroPartida: normalizeOptionalText(
              values.numeroPartida,
            ),
          })
      : current
        ? this.updateCompanyUseCase.execute(
            current.empresaId,
            common,
          )
        : this.createCompanyUseCase.execute({
            ruc,
            ...common,
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            association
              ? current
                ? 'Asociación actualizada'
                : 'Asociación registrada'
              : current
                ? 'Empresa actualizada'
                : 'Empresa registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar la organización',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private saveArea(): void {
    const current = this.currentArea();

    if (!current) {
      const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
      this.areaForm.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          `AREA_${Number(values.uotId)}`,
          normalizeText(values.nombre),
          30,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    if (this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.areaForm.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.areaForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.areaForm.invalid) {
      const message = this.areaValidationMessage();

      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.toast.info('Revisa el formulario', message);
      this.focusFirstInvalidControl('form');
      return;
    }

    const values = this.areaForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const areaPadreId =
      Number(values.areaPadreId) > 0
        ? Number(values.areaPadreId)
        : undefined;

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateAreaUseCase.execute(current.areaId, {
          uotId: Number(values.uotId),
          areaPadreId,
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        })
      : this.createAreaUseCase.execute({
          uotId: Number(values.uotId),
          areaPadreId,
          codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Área actualizada' : 'Área registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el área',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyCompanyIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    ruc: string,
  ): void {
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(this.companyIdentityKey(ruc));
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);

    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = {
      businessName:
        result.found && Boolean(result.businessName?.trim()),
      phone:
        result.found && Boolean(result.phone?.trim()),
      email:
        result.found && Boolean(result.email?.trim()),
      geography:
        result.found && Boolean(districtCode),
      reference:
        result.found && Boolean(reference?.trim()),
    };

    this.companyForm.patchValue({
      razonSocial:
        result.businessName
          ? normalizeText(result.businessName).slice(0, 200)
          : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }

    if (
      this.kind() === 'association'
      && result.found
      && result.isAssociation
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta asociación ya se encuentra registrada.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Datos de la empresa cargados. Complete los campos faltantes.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityTone.set(
      result.manualEntryAllowed ? 'warning' : 'error',
    );

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityMessage.set(
        result.queryStatus === 'PROVIDER_DISABLED'
          ? 'No se encontraron datos automáticos y la consulta externa está deshabilitada. Puede completar los datos manualmente y guardar.'
          : 'El RUC no devolvió datos automáticos. Puede completar la información manualmente y guardar.',
      );
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      return;
    }

    this.identityMessage.set(
      result.message ||
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la empresa. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private rucValidationMessage(): string {
    const control = this.companyForm.controls.ruc;

    if (control.hasError('required')) {
      return 'Ingrese el RUC de la organización.';
    }

    if (control.hasError('pattern')) {
      return 'El RUC debe contener exactamente 11 dígitos.';
    }

    return 'Revise el RUC antes de continuar.';
  }

  private organizationValidationMessage(): string {
    const controls = this.companyForm.controls;

    if (controls.uotId.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione la UOT a la que pertenece este contrato.';
    }

    if (controls.ruc.invalid) {
      return this.rucValidationMessage();
    }

    if (controls.razonSocial.invalid) {
      return 'Revise la razón social. Es obligatoria y no puede contener solo espacios.';
    }

    if (controls.telefono.invalid) {
      return 'Revise el teléfono. Use entre 7 y 15 dígitos.';
    }

    if (controls.correo.invalid) {
      return 'Revise el correo electrónico ingresado.';
    }

    if (controls.distritoCodigo.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione un distrito válido.';
    }

    if (controls.fechaConstitucion.invalid) {
      return 'Revise la fecha de constitución.';
    }

    if (
      controls.nombreComercial.invalid ||
      controls.referencia.invalid ||
      controls.numeroPartida.invalid
    ) {
      return 'Revise los campos marcados antes de guardar.';
    }

    return 'Revise los campos obligatorios antes de guardar.';
  }

  private areaValidationMessage(): string {
    const controls = this.areaForm.controls;

    if (controls.uotId.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione la UOT a la que pertenece el área.';
    }

    if (controls.nombre.invalid) {
      return 'Ingrese un nombre válido para el área.';
    }

    if (controls.codigo.invalid) {
      return 'No se pudo generar un código válido para el área.';
    }

    return 'Revise los campos del área antes de guardar.';
  }

  private focusFirstInvalidControl(
    selector: string,
  ): void {
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const dialog = this.dialogRef.nativeElement;
      const explicit = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        selector,
      );

      if (
        explicit &&
        selector.startsWith('#')
      ) {
        explicit.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: 'smooth',
          block: 'center',
        });
        explicit.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }

      const invalid = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        'form .ng-invalid:not(form), form [aria-invalid="true"]',
      );

      invalid?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: 'smooth',
        block: 'center',
      });
      invalid?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private companyIdentityKey(ruc: string): string {
    return `EMPRESA:RUC:${ruc.trim()}`;
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    if (this.currentCompany()) {
      return;
    }

    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.companyForm.patchValue(
      {
        razonSocial:
          locks.businessName
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.razonSocial.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.correo.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.companyForm.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.companyForm.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    if (this.kind() === 'area') {
      this.areaForm.controls.areaPadreId.setValue(0);
    }
  }

  uotLabel(uotId?: number | null): string {
    const id = uotId ?? (
      this.kind() === 'area'
        ? Number(this.areaForm.getRawValue().uotId)
        : Number(this.companyForm.getRawValue().uotId)
    );

    return this.uot.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  private resolveTargetUotId(preferredUotId?: number | null): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? preferredUotId ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0 ? preferredUotId : 0;
  }

  private configureUotControl(
    control: { enable(options?: { emitEvent?: boolean }): void; disable(options?: { emitEvent?: boolean }): void },
    editing: boolean,
  ): void {
    if (editing || this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      control.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.currentCompany.set(null);
    this.currentArea.set(null);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.areaOptions.set([]);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.resetState();
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { EditarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { Catalogo } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogo-detail',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './catalogo-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogo-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogoDetailComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly catalog = signal<Catalogo | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<CatalogoItem | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly catalogIcon = faLayerGroup;

  readonly nameMaxLength = computed(
    () => this.catalog()?.nombreMaxLength ?? 150,
  );

  readonly showDescription = computed(
    () => this.catalog()?.admiteDescripcion !== false,
  );

  private resolver:
    | ((result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>) => void)
    | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)],
    ],
    descripcion: [
      '',
      [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
    ],
    categoria: [''],
  });

  open(
    catalog: Catalogo,
    item: CatalogoItem | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>> {
    this.catalog.set(catalog);
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.configureValidators(catalog);

    this.form.reset({
      codigo: item?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item?.nombre ?? '',
      descripcion:
        catalog.requiereCategoria || catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
          ? ''
          : item?.descripcion ?? '',
      categoria: item?.categoria ?? '',
    });

    this.form.controls.codigo[item ? 'disable' : 'enable']({
      emitEvent: false,
    });

    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  save(): void {
    const catalog = this.catalog();
    const current = this.current();

    if (catalog && !current) {
      this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(
        buildSystemCode(
          catalog.codigo,
          this.form.controls.nombre.value,
          catalog.codigoMaxLength ?? 40,
        ),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!catalog || this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const description =
      catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
        ? undefined
        : normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion);

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.id, {
          catalogo: catalog.codigo,
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: description,
          categoria: raw.categoria.trim() || undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          catalogo: catalog.codigo,
          codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: description,
          categoria: raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Valor actualizado' : 'Valor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: current,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  private configureValidators(catalog: Catalogo): void {
    this.form.controls.codigo.setValidators([
      Validators.required,
      Validators.maxLength(catalog.codigoMaxLength ?? 40),
    ]);

    this.form.controls.nombre.setValidators([
      Validators.required,
      notBlankValidator,
      Validators.maxLength(catalog.nombreMaxLength ?? 150),
    ]);

    this.form.controls.descripcion.setValidators(
      catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
        ? []
        : [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
    );

    this.form.controls.categoria.setValidators(
      catalog.requiereCategoria ? [Validators.required] : [],
    );

    this.form.controls.codigo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.nombre.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.descripcion.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.form.controls.categoria.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.catalog.set(null);
      this.current.set(null);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
    });
  }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260927_110624_710707\src\app\features\administracion\catalogos\adapter\in\ui\pages\catalogo-detail\catalogo-detail.html`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_110624_710707/src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/in/ui/pages/catalogo-detail/catalogo-detail.html`

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>{{ catalog()?.nombre || 'Catálogo' }}</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar valor' : 'Registrar valor' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="catalogName">Nombre</label>
        <input
          id="catalogName"
          class="admin-input"
          type="text"
          formControlName="nombre"
          [attr.maxlength]="nameMaxLength()"
          placeholder="Nombre visible"
          autocomplete="off"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombre"
          fieldLabel="El nombre"
          [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
        />
      </div>

      @if (catalog()?.requiereCategoria) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="catalogCategory">Categoría</label>
          <select
            id="catalogCategory"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="categoria"
          >
            <option value="">Seleccionar</option>
            <option value="PLAGA">Plaga</option>
            <option value="ENFERMEDAD">Enfermedad</option>
            <option value="OTRO">Otro</option>
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.categoria"
            fieldLabel="La categoría"
          />
        </div>
      } @else if (showDescription()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="catalogDescription">Descripción</label>
          <textarea
            id="catalogDescription"
            class="admin-textarea"
            formControlName="descripcion"
            maxlength="300"
            rows="3"
            placeholder="Descripción opcional"
          ></textarea>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.descripcion"
            fieldLabel="La descripción"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="close()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_110624_751365/src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/in/ui/pages/catalogos-list/catalogos-list.html`

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="pageTitle"
    [subtitle]="pageSubtitle"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        {{ createLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface catalog-shell mt-5">
    @if (!fixedCatalogCode) {
      <div class="catalog-browser" aria-label="Navegación de catálogos">
        <nav class="catalog-group-tabs" aria-label="Áreas de catálogos">
          @for (group of catalogGroups; track group.codigo) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="catalog-group-tab"
              [class.catalog-group-tab--active]="group.codigo === selectedGroup().codigo"
              [attr.aria-pressed]="group.codigo === selectedGroup().codigo"
              (click)="changeGroup(group.codigo)"
            >
              <span>{{ group.nombre }}</span>
              <span class="catalog-group-count">{{ group.catalogos.length }}</span>
            </button>
          }
        </nav>

        <nav class="catalog-item-tabs" [attr.aria-label]="selectedGroup().nombre">
          @for (catalog of selectedGroup().catalogos; track catalog.codigo) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="catalog-item-tab"
              [class.catalog-item-tab--active]="catalog.codigo === catalogCode()"
              [attr.aria-current]="catalog.codigo === catalogCode() ? 'page' : null"
              (click)="changeCatalog(catalog.codigo)"
            >
              <span class="catalog-item-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              {{ catalog.nombre }}
            </button>
          }
        </nav>
      </div>
    }

    <div class="catalog-content">
      <header class="catalog-context">
        <div class="catalog-context-copy">
          <span class="catalog-context-icon" aria-hidden="true">
            <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
          </span>

          <div>
            <span class="catalog-context-kicker">
              {{ selectedCatalog().grupoNombre }}
            </span>
            <h2>{{ selectedCatalog().nombre }}</h2>
            <p>{{ selectedCatalog().descripcion }}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        @if (!loading() && !errorMessage()) {
          <span class="catalog-context-count">
            {{ result().totalRecords }}
            {{ result().totalRecords === 1 ? 'registro' : 'registros' }}
          </span>
        }
      </header>

      @if (loading()) {
        <app-loading-state title="Cargando" message="Consultando información." />
      } @else if (errorMessage()) {
        <app-error-state
          title="No se pudo cargar"
          [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
          (retry)="load()"
        />
      } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
        <app-empty-state [title]="emptyTitle" [message]="emptyMessage" />
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap catalog-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Código</th>
                <th>Nombre</th>
                <th>Descripción</th>
                <th class="text-center">Uso</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
                <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of result().items; track item.id) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                        <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
                      </span>
                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ item.codigo }}</strong>
                        <span>Código generado</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td class="admin-table-primary">{{ item.nombre }}</td>
                  <td class="admin-table-muted max-w-md">
                    {{ item.descripcion || '—' }}
                  </td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-usage-badge"
                      [class.admin-usage-badge--used]="item.enUso"
                    >
                      {{ item.cantidadUso }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!item.estado"
                    >
                      {{ item.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-row-actions">
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar"
                        [disabled]="disablingId() !== null"
                        (click)="edit(item)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>

                      <button
                        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_RETIRAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                        [attr.title]="
                          item.enUso
                            ? 'Está en uso y no puede deshabilitarse'
                            : 'Deshabilitar'
                        "
                        [disabled]="item.enUso || disablingId() !== null"
                        (click)="disable(item)"
                      >
                        @if (disablingId() === item.id) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <app-paginator
          [page]="result().page"
          [size]="result().size"
          [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
          [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
          (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
          (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
        />
      }
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<app-catalogo-detail />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Unidades operativas territoriales"
    subtitle="Administra la jerarquía, accesos, roles y ciclo de vida de cada UOT."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>
      <button
        *appPermission="'UOT_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        Nueva UOT
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar admin-toolbar--end">
      <label class="admin-switch-row uot-inactive-switch">
        <span>
          <strong>Mostrar inactivas</strong>
          <small>Incluye unidades cerradas o deshabilitadas.</small>
        </span>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="admin-switch-control"
          [checked]="showInactive()"
          (change)="toggleInactive($any($event.target).checked)"
        />
      </label>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando UOT"
        message="Consultando la jerarquía autorizada."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'No se pudo cargar la información.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (units().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin unidades"
        message="No existen UOT visibles para tu contexto."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>UOT</th>
              <th>Superior</th>
              <th class="text-center">Asignación</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ unit.nombre }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ unit.codigo }} · #{{ unit.uotId }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{{ parentName(unit) }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  @if (unit.predeterminada) {
                    <span class="admin-status admin-status--info">Predeterminada</span>
                  } @else if (unit.asignada) {
                    <span class="admin-status admin-status--active">Asignada</span>
                  } @else {
                    <span class="admin-status">No asignada</span>
                  }
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="unit.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!unit.estado"
                  >
                    {{ unit.estado ? 'Activa' : 'Inactiva' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    @if (unit.estado) {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'UOT_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar UOT"
                        (click)="edit(unit)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'UOT_ADMINISTRAR_ACCESOS'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Asignar acceso y rol"
                        [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
                        (click)="access(unit)"
                      >
                        @if (referencesLoading()) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="accessIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                      @if (!unit.esRaiz) {
                        <button
                          *appPermission="'UOT_RETIRAR'"
                          type="button"
                          class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                          title="Analizar y deshabilitar UOT"
                          (click)="deactivate(unit)"
                        >
                          <fa-icon [icon]="deactivateIcon" />
                        </button>
                      }
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-uot-form />
<app-uot-deactivation-form />
```

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260927_113915_390886/src/app/features/uot/adapter/in/ui/pages/uot-admin/uot-admin.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260927_113915_390886\src\app\features\uot\adapter\in\ui\pages\uot-admin\uot-admin.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_113915_390886/src/app/features/uot/adapter/in/ui/pages/uot-admin/uot-admin.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faKey,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faPowerOff,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../administracion/roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { ListarUsuariosUseCase } from '../../../../../../administracion/usuarios/application/use-case/listar-usuarios.use-case';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotUnit } from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';
import { UotDeactivationFormComponent } from '../uot-deactivation-form/uot-deactivation-form';
import {
  UotFormComponent,
  UotFormOptions,
} from '../uot-form/uot-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-admin-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UotFormComponent,
    UotDeactivationFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './uot-admin.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-admin.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotAdminPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UotFormComponent) private form!: UotFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(UotDeactivationFormComponent)
  private deactivationForm!: UotDeactivationFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly listUsers = inject(ListarUsuariosUseCase);
  private readonly listRoles = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly users = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly showInactive = signal(false);

  readonly pageIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly accessIcon = faKey;
  readonly deactivateIcon = faPowerOff;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
    this.loadReferences();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .list(this.showInactive())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.units.set(items),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      users: this.listUsers.execute({ page: 1, size: 200 }),
      roles: this.listRoles.execute(1, 200),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ users, roles }) => {
          this.users.set(
            users.items.map((item) => ({
              value: item.usuarioId,
              label:
                item.empleado?.trim() ||
                item.nombreUsuario ||
                `Usuario ${item.usuarioId}`,
              description: item.nombreUsuario,
            })),
          );
          this.roles.set(
            roles.items
              .filter((item) => item.estado)
              .map((item) => ({
                value: item.rolId,
                label: item.nombre,
                description: item.codigo,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.users.set([]);
          this.roles.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async edit(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openEdit(unit, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async access(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openAccess(unit, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.loadReferences();
  }

  async deactivate(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    if (!unit.estado || unit.esRaiz) return;
    const result = await this.deactivationForm.open(unit, this.units());
    if (result.saved) {
      this.showInactive.set(true);
      this.load();
    }
  }

  toggleInactive(value: boolean): void {
    this.showInactive.set(value);
    this.load();
  }

  parentName(unit: UotUnit): string {
    if (!unit.uotPadreId) return 'Raíz';
    return (
      this.units().find((item) => item.uotId === unit.uotPadreId)?.nombre ??
      `UOT #${unit.uotPadreId}`
    );
  }

  private options(): UotFormOptions {
    return {
      units: this.units(),
      users: this.users(),
      roles: this.roles(),
    };
  }
}
```

```css
:host {
  display: contents;
}

.uot-deactivation-loading {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 10rem;
  align-items: center;

  gap: .65rem;

  display: grid;

  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);

}

.uot-impact-grid strong {
  display: block;
}

  color: var(--desco-text-muted);

}

}

}

@media (max-width: 760px) {

    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260927_113915_438929\src\app\features\uot\adapter\in\ui\pages\uot-form\uot-form.html`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_113915_438929/src/app/features/uot/adapter/in/ui/pages/uot-form/uot-form.html`

```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon
            [icon]="
              mode() === 'access'
                ? accessIcon
                : mode() === 'edit'
                  ? editIcon
                  : addIcon
            "
          />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Administración</p>
          <h2>{{ title() }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (mode() === 'access') {
      <form
        class="admin-form-grid"
        [formGroup]="accessForm"
        (ngSubmit)="save()"
      >
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>UOT</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            [value]="current()?.nombre || ''"
            readonly
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Usuario</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="usuarioId">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (user of users(); track user.value) {
              <option [value]="user.value">{{ user.label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="accessForm.controls.usuarioId"
            fieldLabel="El usuario"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Rol dentro de la UOT</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="rolId">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (role of roles(); track role.value) {
              <option [value]="role.value">{{ role.label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="accessForm.controls.rolId"
            fieldLabel="El rol"
          />
        </div>

        <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
          <span>
            <strong>UOT predeterminada</strong>
            <small>Se propondrá como contexto inicial del usuario.</small>
          </span>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            class="admin-switch-control"
            formControlName="predeterminada"
          />
        </label>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Asignando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Asignar acceso
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="unitForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>UOT superior</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotPadreId">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (unit of parentOptions(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">
                {{ unit.codigo }} · {{ unit.nombre }}
              </option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="unitForm.controls.uotPadreId"
            fieldLabel="La UOT superior"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Ubicación ID</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            formControlName="ubicacionId"
            placeholder="Opcional"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Código</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            formControlName="codigo"
            maxlength="40"
            autocomplete="off"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="unitForm.controls.codigo"
            fieldLabel="El código"
            [messages]="{ blank: 'El código no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Nombre</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            formControlName="nombre"
            maxlength="180"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="unitForm.controls.nombre"
            fieldLabel="El nombre"
            [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Descripción</label>
          <textarea
            class="admin-textarea"
            rows="3"
            maxlength="500"
            formControlName="descripcion"
          ></textarea>
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
            (click)="close()"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [disabled]="saving()"
          >
            @if (saving()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Guardando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
              Guardar
            }
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {

} from '@angular/forms';

  faUserPlus,
```
