      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="employeeEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" formControlName="correo" maxlength="180" autocomplete="email" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('email')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Ubicación de la persona</span>
      </div>

      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        [locationLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')"
        [populationCenterLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('populationCenter')"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="employeeReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="employeeReference" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('reference')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Información laboral</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeUot">UOT del registro</label>
        <select id="employeeUot" class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onUotChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>
          @for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <small>En vista general puede escoger la adscripción; al editar permanece fija.</small>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEntryDate">Fecha de ingreso</label>
        <input id="employeeEntryDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaIngreso" [min]="minimumEntryDate()" [attr.aria-readonly]="current() ? 'true' : null" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaIngreso" fieldLabel="La fecha de ingreso" [messages]="{ pastDate: 'La fecha de ingreso no puede ser anterior a hoy.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
        @if (form.hasError('entryBeforeAdult')) {
          <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de ingreso no puede ser anterior a la mayoría de edad de la persona.</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeArea">Área</label>
        <select id="employeeArea" class="admin-select" formControlName="areaId" (change)="onAreaChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Sin área asignada</option>
          @for (area of availableAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeRoleName">
          Cargo
          @if (form.controls.areaId.value > 0) { <span aria-hidden="true">*</span> }
        </label>
        <select
          id="employeeRoleName"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="cargo"
          [disabled]="form.controls.areaId.value <= 0 || cargoLoading()"
        >
          <option value="">
            {{ cargoLoading() ? 'Cargando...' : 'Seleccionar cargo' }}
          </option>
          @for (cargo of availableCargoOptions(); track cargo.id) {
            <option [value]="cargo.label">{{ cargo.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.cargo"
          fieldLabel="El cargo"
        />
        @if (cargoError()) {
          <small class="employee-form-error">{{ cargoError() }}</small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeAreaDate">Fecha de asignación de área</label>
          <input id="employeeAreaDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAsignacionArea" [min]="form.controls.fechaIngreso.value || null" />
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAsignacionArea" fieldLabel="La fecha de asignación" [messages]="{ invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
          @if (form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
            <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de asignación de área no puede ser anterior a la fecha de ingreso.</small>
          }
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faBuilding,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faIdCard,
  faPen,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadoDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly employeeId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly requestedUotId = Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('uotId')) || null;
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly identityIcon = faIdCard;
  readonly organizationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly accountIcon = faShieldHalved;

  readonly fullName = computed(() => {
    const value = this.detail();

    return value
      ? [value.nombres, value.apellidoPaterno, value.apellidoMaterno]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      : 'Empleado';
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.employeeId) || this.employeeId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El empleado solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.employeeId, this.targetUotId() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.organizationsUseCase.areas(page, size, this.targetUotId() ?? undefined))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (areas) => this.areas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado)),
        error: (error) => {
          this.areas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  uotName(): string {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotNombre
      ?? this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === this.requestedUotId)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  targetUotId(): number | null {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId();
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotId ?? this.requestedUotId;
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open(
      { areas: this.areas(), preferredUotId: employee.uotId },
      employee,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.retiring()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName()}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiring.set(true);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, employee.uotId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="fullName()"
    subtitle="Información personal, adscripción, cuenta y roles del empleado."
    eyebrow="Empleado"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/administracion/empleados">
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      @if (detail(); as employee) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_EDITAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="!employee.estado || referencesLoading()"
          (click)="edit()"
        >
          @if (referencesLoading()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
          }
          Editar
        </button>

        <button
          *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_RETIRAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-danger-button"
          [disabled]="!employee.estado || retiring()"
          (click)="retire()"
        >
          @if (retiring()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon" />
          }
          Retirar
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando empleado"
        message="Consultando su información actual e historial."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as employee) {
      <section class="admin-detail-grid">
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.codigoEmpleado }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Documento</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.tipoDocumento }} {{ employee.numeroDocumento }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>UOT</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.uotNombre || uotName() }}</strong>
          <small>{{ employee.uotCodigo || '' }}</small>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Estado</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Retirado' }}</strong>
        </article>
      </section>

      <div class="employee-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Identificación</p>
              <h2>Datos personales</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="identityIcon" />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-info-list">
            <div><span>Nombres</span><strong>{{ employee.nombres }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Apellido paterno</span><strong>{{ employee.apellidoPaterno }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Apellido materno</span><strong>{{ employee.apellidoMaterno || '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Fecha de nacimiento</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaNacimiento ? (employee.fechaNacimiento | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Teléfono</span><strong>{{ employee.telefono || '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Correo</span><strong>{{ employee.correo || '—' }}</strong></div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Adscripción</p>
              <h2>Situación laboral</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="organizationIcon" />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-info-list">
            <div><span>Área actual</span><strong>{{ employee.area || '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Cargo</span><strong>{{ employee.cargo || '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Fecha de ingreso</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaIngreso ? (employee.fechaIngreso | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Fecha de cese</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaCese ? (employee.fechaCese | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="admin-section-header">
          <div>
            <p>Historial</p>
            <h2>Áreas asignadas</h2>
          </div>
          <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="historyIcon" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Área</th>
                <th>Cargo</th>
                <th>Desde</th>
                <th>Hasta</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (area of employee.areas; track area.empleadoAreaId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                        <fa-icon [icon]="organizationIcon" />
                      </span>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ area.area }}</strong>
                        <span>Área organizacional</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ area.cargo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.fechaDesde ? (area.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.fechaHasta ? (area.fechaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="area.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!area.estado"
                    >
                      {{ area.estado ? 'Actual' : 'Histórico' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              } @empty {
                <tr><td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">No hay historial de áreas.</td></tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="employee-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Cuenta</p>
              <h2>Acceso al sistema</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="accountIcon" />
          </div>

          @if (employee.usuario; as user) {
            <div class="admin-info-list">
              <div><span>Usuario</span><strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Estado</span><strong>{{ user.estadoCuenta || '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Segundo factor</span><strong>{{ user.segundoFactorHabilitado ? 'Habilitado' : 'No habilitado' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Último acceso</span><strong>{{ user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto ? (user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy p-4">El empleado no tiene una cuenta asociada.</p>
          }
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Roles</p>
              <h2>Asignaciones de acceso</h2>
            </div>
            <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ employee.roles.length }}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="admin-chip-list">
            @for (role of employee.roles; track role.rolId) {
              <article>
                <strong>{{ role.nombre }}</strong>
                <span>{{ role.codigo }}</span>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="admin-empty-copy">Sin roles asignados.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';

import {

} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadoDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly employeeId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly requestedUotId = Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('uotId')) || null;
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly identityIcon = faIdCard;
  readonly organizationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly accountIcon = faShieldHalved;

  readonly fullName = computed(() => {
    const value = this.detail();

    return value
      ? [value.nombres, value.apellidoPaterno, value.apellidoMaterno]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      : 'Empleado';
  });

  readonly currentAssignment = computed(() => {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee) {
      return null;
    }

    return employee.areas.find(
      (item) => item.estado && !item.fechaHasta,
    )
      ?? employee.areas.find((item) => item.estado)
      ?? null;
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.employeeId) || this.employeeId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El empleado solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.employeeId, this.targetUotId() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.organizationsUseCase.areas(page, size, this.targetUotId() ?? undefined))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (areas) => this.areas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado)),
        error: (error) => {
          this.areas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  uotName(): string {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotNombre
      ?? this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === this.requestedUotId)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  targetUotId(): number | null {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId();
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotId ?? this.requestedUotId;
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open(
      { areas: this.areas(), preferredUotId: employee.uotId },
      employee,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.retiring()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName()}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiring.set(true);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, employee.uotId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_131328_430574/src/app/features/administracion/empleados/adapter/in/ui/pages/empleado-detail/empleado-detail.html`

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="fullName()"
    subtitle="Información personal, asignación laboral, cuenta y roles del empleado."
    eyebrow="Empleado"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/administracion/empleados">
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      @if (detail(); as employee) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_EDITAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="!employee.estado || referencesLoading()"
          (click)="edit()"
        >
          @if (referencesLoading()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
          }
          Editar
        </button>

        <button
          *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_RETIRAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-danger-button"
          [disabled]="!employee.estado || retiring()"
          (click)="retire()"
        >
          @if (retiring()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon" />
          }
          Retirar
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando empleado"
        message="Consultando su información actual e historial."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as employee) {
      <section class="admin-detail-grid">
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.codigoEmpleado }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Documento</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.tipoDocumento }} {{ employee.numeroDocumento }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>UOT</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.uotNombre || uotName() }}</strong>
          <small>{{ employee.uotCodigo || '' }}</small>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Estado</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Retirado' }}</strong>
        </article>
      </section>

      <div class="employee-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Identificación</p>
              <h2>Datos personales</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="identityIcon" />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-info-list">
            <div><span>Nombres</span><strong>{{ employee.nombres }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Apellido paterno</span><strong>{{ employee.apellidoPaterno }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Apellido materno</span><strong>{{ employee.apellidoMaterno || '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Fecha de nacimiento</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaNacimiento ? (employee.fechaNacimiento | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Teléfono</span><strong>{{ employee.telefono || '—' }}</strong></div>
            <div><span>Correo</span><strong>{{ employee.correo || '—' }}</strong></div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Asignación laboral</p>
              <h2>Situación actual</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="organizationIcon" />
          </div>

          @if (currentAssignment(); as assignment) {
            <div class="admin-info-list">
              <div><span>Área actual</span><strong>{{ assignment.area }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Cargo actual</span><strong>{{ assignment.cargo || '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Desde</span><strong>{{ assignment.fechaDesde ? (assignment.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Fecha de ingreso</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaIngreso ? (employee.fechaIngreso | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Fecha de cese</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaCese ? (employee.fechaCese | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <div class="admin-info-list">
              <div><span>Área actual</span><strong>Sin área asignada</strong></div>
              <div><span>Cargo actual</span><strong>Sin cargo asignado</strong></div>
              <div><span>Fecha de ingreso</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaIngreso ? (employee.fechaIngreso | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Fecha de cese</span><strong>{{ employee.fechaCese ? (employee.fechaCese | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            </div>
          }
        </section>
      </div>

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="admin-section-header">
          <div>
            <p>Historial laboral</p>
            <h2>Áreas y cargos</h2>
          </div>
          <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="historyIcon" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Área</th>
                <th>Cargo</th>
                <th>Desde</th>
                <th>Hasta</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (area of employee.areas; track area.empleadoAreaId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                        <fa-icon [icon]="organizationIcon" />
                      </span>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ area.area }}</strong>
                        <span>Área organizacional</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ area.cargo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.fechaDesde ? (area.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.fechaHasta ? (area.fechaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="area.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!area.estado"
                    >
                      {{ area.estado ? 'Actual' : 'Histórico' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              } @empty {
                <tr><td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">No hay historial de áreas.</td></tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="employee-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Cuenta</p>
              <h2>Acceso al sistema</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="accountIcon" />
          </div>

          @if (employee.usuario; as user) {
            <div class="admin-info-list">
              <div><span>Usuario</span><strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Estado</span><strong>{{ user.estadoCuenta || '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Segundo factor</span><strong>{{ user.segundoFactorHabilitado ? 'Habilitado' : 'No habilitado' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Último acceso</span><strong>{{ user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto ? (user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy p-4">El empleado no tiene una cuenta asociada.</p>
          }
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Roles del sistema</p>
              <h2>Permisos de acceso</h2>
            </div>
            <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ employee.roles.length }}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="admin-chip-list">
            @for (role of employee.roles; track role.rolId) {
              <article>
                <strong>{{ role.nombre }}</strong>
                <span>{{ role.codigo }}</span>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="admin-empty-copy">Sin roles asignados.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                        <fa-icon [icon]="organizationIcon" />
                      </span>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ area.area }}</strong>
                        <span>Área organizacional</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ area.cargo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.fechaDesde ? (area.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ area.fechaHasta ? (area.fechaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy') : '—' }}</td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="area.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!area.estado"
                    >
                      {{ area.estado ? 'Actual' : 'Histórico' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              } @empty {
                <tr><td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">No hay historial de áreas.</td></tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="employee-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Cuenta</p>
              <h2>Acceso al sistema</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="accountIcon" />
          </div>

          @if (employee.usuario; as user) {
            <div class="admin-info-list">
              <div><span>Usuario</span><strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Estado</span><strong>{{ user.estadoCuenta || '—' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Segundo factor</span><strong>{{ user.segundoFactorHabilitado ? 'Habilitado' : 'No habilitado' }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Último acceso</span><strong>{{ user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto ? (user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</strong></div>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy p-4">El empleado no tiene una cuenta asociada.</p>
          }
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Acceso a la UOT</p>
              <h2>Roles del sistema</h2>
            </div>
            <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ activeSystemRoles().length }}</span>
          </div>

          @if (!employee.usuario) {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy p-4">
              Sin cuenta de acceso al sistema.
            </p>
          } @else if (!hasActiveAccount()) {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy p-4">
              La cuenta de acceso está inactiva.
            </p>
          } @else {
            <div class="admin-chip-list">
              @for (role of activeSystemRoles(); track role.rolId) {
                <article>
                  <strong>{{ role.nombre }}</strong>
                  <span>{{ role.codigo }}</span>
                </article>
              } @empty {
                <p class="admin-empty-copy">
                  Sin roles activos en esta UOT.
                </p>
              }
            </div>
          }
        </section>
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="fullName()"
    subtitle="Información personal, asignación laboral, cuenta y roles del empleado."
    eyebrow="Empleado"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/administracion/empleados">
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      @if (detail(); as employee) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_EDITAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="!employee.estado || referencesLoading()"
          (click)="edit()"
        >
          @if (referencesLoading()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
          }
          Editar
        </button>

        <button
          *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_RETIRAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-danger-button"
          [disabled]="!employee.estado || retiring()"
          (click)="retire()"
        >
          @if (retiring()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon" />
          }
          Retirar
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando empleado"
        message="Consultando su información actual e historial."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as employee) {
      <section class="admin-detail-grid">
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.codigoEmpleado }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Documento</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.tipoDocumento }} {{ employee.numeroDocumento }}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>UOT</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.uotNombre || uotName() }}</strong>
          <small>{{ employee.uotCodigo || '' }}</small>
        </article>
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Estado</span>
          <strong>{{ employee.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Retirado' }}</strong>
        </article>
      </section>

      <div class="employee-detail-grid mt-4">
        <section class="admin-surface employee-access-card">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Cuenta</p>
              <h2>Acceso al sistema</h2>
            </div>
            <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="accountIcon" />
          </div>

          @if (employee.usuario; as user) {
            <div class="employee-account-grid">
              <article class="employee-account-item">
                <span>Usuario</span>
                <strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
              </article>
              <article class="employee-account-item">
                <span>Estado</span>
                <strong>{{ user.estadoCuenta || '—' }}</strong>
              </article>
              <article class="employee-account-item">
                <span>Segundo factor</span>
                <strong>{{ user.segundoFactorHabilitado ? 'Habilitado' : 'No habilitado' }}</strong>
              </article>
              <article class="employee-account-item">
                <span>Último acceso</span>
                <strong>{{ user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto ? (user.ultimoAccesoCorrecto | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</strong>
              </article>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <div class="employee-access-empty">
              <p>Sin cuenta de acceso al sistema.</p>
            </div>
          }
        </section>

        <section class="admin-surface employee-access-card">
          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>
              <p>Acceso a la UOT</p>
              <h2>Roles del sistema</h2>
            </div>
            <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ activeSystemRoles().length }}</span>
          </div>

          @if (!employee.usuario) {
            <div class="employee-access-empty">
              <p>Sin cuenta de acceso al sistema.</p>
            </div>
          } @else if (!hasActiveAccount()) {
            <div class="employee-access-empty">
              <p>La cuenta de acceso está inactiva.</p>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <div class="employee-role-grid">
              @for (role of activeSystemRoles(); track role.rolId) {
                <article class="employee-role-card">
                  <span class="employee-role-card__icon">
                    <fa-icon [icon]="accountIcon" />
                  </span>

                  <div class="employee-role-card__body">
                    <span class="employee-role-card__eyebrow">Rol efectivo</span>
                    <strong class="employee-role-card__name">{{ role.nombre }}</strong>
                    <span class="employee-role-card__code">{{ role.codigo }}</span>
                    <span class="employee-role-card__meta">
                      {{ role.fechaDesde ? ('Desde ' + (role.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy')) : 'Activo en la UOT' }}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <span class="employee-role-card__status">Activo</span>
                </article>
              } @empty {
                <div class="employee-access-empty">
                  <p>Sin roles activos en esta UOT.</p>
                </div>
              }
            </div>
          }
        </section>
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

```css
:host {
  display: block;
}

.employee-detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.employee-access-card {
  min-height: 100%;
}

.employee-account-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.employee-account-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.28rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-surface-soft) 82%,
    transparent
  );
  padding: 0.95rem 1rem;
}

.employee-account-item span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.employee-account-item strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.96rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.employee-role-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));
}

.employee-role-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-border-strong) 88%,
    var(--desco-primary) 12%
  );
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-surface-elevated) 88%,
    var(--desco-primary-soft) 12%
  );
  padding: 1rem;
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-sm);
}

.employee-role-card__icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 2.5rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary);
}

.employee-role-card__body {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  gap: 0.2rem;
}

.employee-role-card__eyebrow {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.employee-role-card__name {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.employee-role-card__code {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: fit-content;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-primary) 25%,
    var(--desco-border)
  );
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-primary-soft) 76%,
    transparent
  );
  color: var(--desco-primary);
  padding: 0.18rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.employee-role-card__meta {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.employee-role-card__status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-primary) 16%,
    transparent
  );
  color: var(--desco-primary);
  padding: 0.28rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.employee-access-empty {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 8.25rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px dashed var(--desco-border-strong);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-surface-soft) 78%,
    transparent
  );
  padding: 1rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.employee-access-empty p {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .employee-detail-grid,
  .employee-account-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .employee-role-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .employee-role-card {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .employee-role-card__status {
    margin-left: 3.4rem;
  }
}
```

                  <span>Segundo factor</span>
                  <strong>{{ user.segundoFactorHabilitado ? 'Habilitado' : 'No habilitado' }}</strong>
                </article>

          <div class="admin-section-header">
            <div>

              <h2>Roles del sistema</h2>

          <div class="employee-access-card__body">

              <div class="employee-access-empty">
                Sin cuenta de acceso al sistema.
              </div>
            } @else if (!hasActiveAccount()) {
              <div class="employee-access-empty">
                La cuenta de acceso está inactiva.
              </div>
            } @else {
              <div class="employee-role-list">
                @for (role of activeSystemRoles(); track role.rolId) {
                  <article class="employee-role-item">
                    <span class="employee-role-item__icon">
                      <fa-icon [icon]="accountIcon" />
                    </span>

                    <div class="employee-role-item__content">
                      <span class="employee-role-item__label">Rol efectivo</span>
                      <strong>{{ role.nombre }}</strong>

                      <div class="employee-role-item__meta">
                        <span class="employee-role-code">{{ role.codigo }}</span>

                        @if (role.fechaDesde) {
                          <span class="employee-role-date">
                            Desde {{ role.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy' }}
                          </span>
                        }
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <span class="employee-role-state">Activo</span>
                  </article>
                } @empty {
                  <div class="employee-access-empty">
                    Sin roles activos en esta UOT.
                  </div>
                }
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';

import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faEye,
  faFilter,
  faGrip,
  faList,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { ResourceAssetListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetListItemResponse';
import { SupplyMovementResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyMovementResponse';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ResourceImageComponent } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-image/resource-image';
import { SupplyApiService, SupplyPage } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';
import { SuministroFormComponent } from '../suministro-form/suministro-form';

type InventoryTab = 'assets' | 'supplies';
type InventoryViewMode = 'table' | 'cards';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inventario-vehiculos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DecimalPipe, RouterLink, FaIconComponent, PermissionDirective, EmptyStateComponent, ErrorStateComponent, LoadingStateComponent, PaginatorComponent, PageHeaderComponent, ResourceImageComponent, RecursoFormComponent, SuministroFormComponent],
  templateUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './inventario-vehiculos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InventarioVehiculosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private assetForm!: RecursoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(SuministroFormComponent) private supplyForm!: SuministroFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly suppliesApi = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly activeTab = signal<InventoryTab>('assets');
  readonly viewMode = signal<InventoryViewMode>('table');
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly assets = signal<PageResult<ResourceAssetListItemResponse>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly supplies = signal<SupplyPage>({ items: [], page: 1, size: 20, totalRecords: 0, totalPages: 0 });
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly typeFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly assetTypes = signal<readonly { id: number; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly kardexSupply = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly kardex = signal<readonly SupplyMovementResponse[]>([]);
  readonly kardexLoading = signal(false);
  readonly kardexError = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly filterIcon = faFilter;
  readonly incidentIcon = faTriangleExclamation;
  readonly supplyIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly tableIcon = faList;
  readonly cardsIcon = faGrip;

  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly availableUnits = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());
  readonly filteredSupplies = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.supplies().items;
    return this.supplies().items.filter((item) => [item.codigo, item.nombre, item.unidadMedida, item.uotNombre, item.uotCodigo].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query)));
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.isGeneral() ? null : this.uot.selectedId());
    this.refs.catalog('TIPO_BIEN').subscribe({
      next: (items) => this.assetTypes.set(items.map((item) => ({ id: Number(item.id), label: item.label })).filter((item) => item.id > 0)),
    });
    this.load(1);
  }

  setTab(tab: InventoryTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab); this.search.set(''); this.errorMessage.set(null); this.kardexSupply.set(null); this.kardex.set([]); this.load(1);
  }
  setView(mode: InventoryViewMode): void { this.viewMode.set(mode); }
  applyFilters(): void { this.load(1); }

  load(page?: number, size?: number): void {
    this.activeTab() === 'supplies'
      ? this.loadSupplies(page ?? 1, size ?? this.supplies().size)
      : this.loadAssets(page ?? 1, size ?? this.assets().size);
  }

  loadAssets(page = this.assets().page, size = this.assets().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.listAssets({ uotId: this.effectiveUotId(), search: this.search(), typeId: this.typeFilter() ?? undefined, state: this.stateFilter() || undefined, page, size })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({ next: (result) => this.assets.set(result), error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message) });
  }

  loadSupplies(page = this.supplies().page, size = this.supplies().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.suppliesApi.list(this.effectiveUotId(), page, size).pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (result) => {
        this.supplies.set(result);
        const selected = this.kardexSupply();
        if (selected) this.kardexSupply.set(result.items.find((item) => item.suministroId === selected.suministroId && item.uotId === selected.uotId) ?? null);
      },
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value); this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null); this.kardexSupply.set(null); this.kardex.set([]); this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.activeTab() === 'supplies') { const result = await this.supplyForm.openCreate(this.effectiveUotId()); if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies(1); return; }
    const result = await this.assetForm.openCreate(this.effectiveUotId()); if (result.saved) this.loadAssets(1);
  }
  async editAsset(item: ResourceAssetListItemResponse): Promise<void> { const result = await this.assetForm.openEdit(item); if (result.saved) this.loadAssets(); }
  async editSupply(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<void> { const result = await this.supplyForm.openEdit(item); if (result.saved) this.loadSupplies(); }
  async movement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<void> { const result = await this.supplyForm.openMovement(item); if (result.saved) { this.loadSupplies(); if (this.sameSupply(this.kardexSupply(), item)) this.loadKardex(item); } }

  toggleKardex(item: SupplySummaryResponse): void { if (this.sameSupply(this.kardexSupply(), item)) { this.kardexSupply.set(null); this.kardex.set([]); this.kardexError.set(null); return; } this.loadKardex(item); }
  loadKardex(item: SupplySummaryResponse): void {
    if (!item.suministroId) return;
    this.kardexSupply.set(item); this.kardexLoading.set(true); this.kardexError.set(null); this.kardex.set([]);
    this.suppliesApi.kardex(Number(item.suministroId), item.uotId).pipe(finalize(() => this.kardexLoading.set(false))).subscribe({ next: (movements) => this.kardex.set(movements), error: (error) => this.kardexError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message) });
  }

  stateLabel(value?: string): string { return (value ?? 'SIN ESTADO').replaceAll('_', ' '); }
  stateClass(value?: string): string { const normalized=(value??'').toUpperCase(); if(normalized==='DISPONIBLE')return'resource-status resource-status--ok'; if(normalized==='BAJA'||normalized==='INACTIVO')return'resource-status resource-status--muted'; if(['AVERIADO','MANTENIMIENTO','NO_DISPONIBLE'].includes(normalized))return'resource-status resource-status--warning'; return'resource-status resource-status--info'; }
  sameSupply(left: SupplySummaryResponse | null, right: SupplySummaryResponse): boolean { return Boolean(left && left.suministroId === right.suministroId && left.uotId === right.uotId); }
  supplyKey(item: SupplySummaryResponse): string { return `${item.suministroId ?? 0}-${item.uotId ?? 0}`; }
  assetKey(item: ResourceAssetListItemResponse): string { return `${item.bienInventarioId ?? 0}-${item.uotId ?? 0}`; }
  private effectiveUotId(): number | undefined { return this.isGeneral() ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined; }
}

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Inventario y suministros"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general de bienes, vehículos y suministros de tus UOT.' : 'Bienes, vehículos y suministros de ' + (uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'la UOT activa') + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()"><fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button>
      <button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()"><fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />{{ activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Registrar bien' : 'Registrar suministro' }}</button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="admin-tabs mt-5"><button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'assets'" (click)="setTab('assets')"><fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" /> Bienes y vehículos</button><button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'supplies'" (click)="setTab('supplies')"><fa-icon [icon]="supplyIcon" /> Suministros</button></div>

  <section class="admin-surface resource-filter-bar">
    <div class="resource-filter-title"><fa-icon [icon]="filterIcon" /><span>Filtros</span></div>
    @if (isGeneral()) { <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>Filtrar por UOT</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)"><option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>@for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) { <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option> }</select></label> }
    <label class="resource-filter-field resource-filter-field--search"><span>Buscar</span><div class="resource-search-control"><input class="admin-input" type="search" [placeholder]="activeTab() === 'assets' ? 'Código, bien, marca, serie…' : 'Código, suministro, unidad…'" [value]="search()" (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)" (keyup.enter)="applyFilters()" /><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Buscar" (click)="applyFilters()"><fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" /></button></div></label>
    @if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
      <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>Tipo</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="typeFilter() ?? 0" (change)="typeFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value || null); applyFilters()"><option [value]="0">Todos</option>@for (type of assetTypes(); track type.id) { <option [value]="type.id">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select></label>
      <label class="resource-filter-field"><span>Estado</span><select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()"><option value="">Todos</option><option value="DISPONIBLE">Disponible</option><option value="ASIGNADO">Asignado</option><option value="MANTENIMIENTO">Mantenimiento</option><option value="AVERIADO">Averiado</option><option value="NO_DISPONIBLE">No disponible</option><option value="INACTIVO">Inactivo</option><option value="BAJA">Baja</option></select></label>
      <div class="resource-view-switch"><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'table'" title="Vista tabla" (click)="setView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /></button><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'cards'" title="Vista tarjetas" (click)="setView('cards')"><fa-icon [icon]="cardsIcon" /></button></div>
    }
  </section>

  @if (loading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando inventario" message="Consultando recursos del contexto UOT." /> }
  @else if (errorMessage()) { <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar el inventario.'" (retry)="load()" /> }
  @else if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
    @if (assets().items.length === 0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin bienes" message="No existen bienes para los filtros seleccionados." /> }
    @else {
      @if (viewMode() === 'table') {
        <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell"><div class="admin-table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Imagen</th><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Bien</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Vehículo</th><th>Proveedor</th><th>Estado</th><th>Incidencias</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for (item of assets().items; track assetKey(item)) { <tr><td><app-resource-image variant="thumb" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Bien'" /></td><td><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</small></td><td><strong>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</strong></td><td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.marca || '' }} @if (item.modelo) { · {{ item.modelo }} }</small></td><td>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</td><td>@if (item.placa) { <strong>{{ item.placa }}</strong><small class="resource-cell-help">{{ item.tipoVehiculo || 'Vehículo' }} · {{ item.kilometrajeKm ?? 0 }} km</small> } @else { <span class="resource-cell-help">No registrado</span> }</td><td>{{ item.proveedorNombre || '—' }}</td><td><span class="resource-status" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoBien)">{{ stateLabel(item.estadoBien) }}</span></td><td>@if ((item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0) > 0) { <span class="resource-incident-count"><fa-icon [icon]="incidentIcon" /> {{ item.incidentesAbiertos }}</span> } @else { <span class="resource-cell-help">Sin incidencias</span> }</td><td><div class="admin-table-actions"><a *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos', item.bienInventarioId]" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="editAsset(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button></div></td></tr> }
        </tbody></table></div></section>
      } @else {
        <section class="resource-card-grid">@for (item of assets().items; track assetKey(item)) { <article class="admin-surface resource-card"><app-resource-image variant="card" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Bien'" /><div class="resource-card-body"><header><div><small>{{ item.uotNombre || 'UOT' }}</small><h3>{{ item.nombre || 'Bien' }}</h3><span>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</span></div><span class="resource-status" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoBien)">{{ stateLabel(item.estadoBien) }}</span></header><dl><div><dt>Tipo</dt><dd>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Proveedor</dt><dd>{{ item.proveedorNombre || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Vehículo</dt><dd>{{ item.placa ? item.placa + ' · ' + (item.tipoVehiculo || '') : 'No registrado' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Incidencias</dt><dd>{{ item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0 }}</dd></div></dl><footer><a *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos', item.bienInventarioId]"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /> Detalle</a><button *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="editAsset(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button></footer></div></article> }</section>
      }
      <app-paginator [page]="assets().page" [size]="assets().size" [totalRecords]="assets().totalRecords" [totalPages]="assets().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadAssets($event, assets().size)" (sizeChange)="loadAssets(1, $event)" />
    }
  } @else {
    @if (filteredSupplies().length === 0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin suministros" message="No existen suministros en esta página para la búsqueda indicada." /> }
    @else { <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell"><div class="admin-table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Suministro</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Stock actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Reposición</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>

        @if (sameSupply(kardexSupply(), item)) { <tr class="resource-kardex-row"><td colspan="9"><div class="resource-kardex-panel"><strong>Kardex · {{ item.uotNombre }} · {{ item.nombre }}</strong>@if (kardexLoading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando Kardex" message="Consultando movimientos históricos." /> } @else if (kardexError()) { <app-error-state [message]="kardexError() || 'No se pudo consultar el Kardex.'"       }
    </tbody></table></div></section><app-paginator [page]="supplies().page" [size]="supplies().size" [totalRecords]="supplies().totalRecords" [totalPages]="supplies().totalPages" (pageChange)="loadSupplies($event, supplies().size)" (sizeChange)="loadSupplies(1, $event)" /> }

    </section>
  }
</div>
