```typescript
  readonly vehicleForm=this.fb.nonNullable.group({placa:['',[Validators.required,notBlankValidator,Validators.maxLength(12)]],tipoVehiculo:['',[Validators.required,notBlankValidator,Validators.maxLength(30)]],kilometrajeKm:[0,[Validators.required,Validators.min(0)]]});

  openCreate(preferredUotId?:number):Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.resetState();this.mode.set('create');const selected=this.resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId);this.form.reset({uotId:selected,tipoBienId:0,codigoPatrimonial:'',nombre:'',marca:'',modelo:'',serie:'',fechaAdquisicion:'',montoAdquisicion:0,moneda:'PEN',proveedorEmpresaId:0,observacion:''});this.form.controls.uotId[this.uot.modo()==='GENERAL'?'enable':'disable']({emitEvent:false});this.loadReferences();this.loadSuggestedCode(true);return this.show();}
  openEdit(item:AssetTarget):Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.resetState();this.mode.set('edit');this.current.set(item);this.form.reset({uotId:item.uotId??0,tipoBienId:item.tipoBienId??0,codigoPatrimonial:item.codigoPatrimonial??'',nombre:item.nombre??'',marca:item.marca??'',modelo:item.modelo??'',serie:item.serie??'',fechaAdquisicion:item.fechaAdquisicion??'',montoAdquisicion:item.montoAdquisicion??0,moneda:item.monedaAdquisicion??'PEN',proveedorEmpresaId:item.proveedorEmpresaId??0,observacion:item.observacion??''});this.form.controls.uotId.disable({emitEvent:false});this.loadReferences();return this.show();}
  openState(item:AssetTarget):Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.resetState();this.mode.set('state');this.current.set(item);const valid=this.states.find((state)=>state.value===item.estadoBien);this.stateForm.reset({estado:valid?.value??ResourceAssetStateChangeRequestEstadoEnum.Disponible,motivo:''});return this.show();}
  openIncident(item:AssetTarget):Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.resetState();this.mode.set('incident');this.current.set(item);this.incidentForm.reset({tipo:ResourceAssetIncidentRequestTipoEnum.Averia,fechaHora:localDateTimeInputNow(),descripcion:'',costoEstimado:0});return this.show();}
  openVehicle(item:AssetTarget):Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.resetState();this.mode.set('vehicle');this.current.set(item);this.vehicleForm.reset({placa:'',tipoVehiculo:'',kilometrajeKm:0});this.loadVehicleTypes();return this.show();}
  openMileage(item:AssetTarget,vehicle:Vehiculo):Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.resetState();this.mode.set('mileage');this.current.set(item);this.currentVehicle.set(vehicle);this.vehicleForm.reset({placa:vehicle.placa,tipoVehiculo:vehicle.tipoVehiculo,kilometrajeKm:vehicle.kilometrajeKm});return this.show();}

  availableUnits(){return this.uot.memberships();}
  onUotChange():void{this.form.controls.proveedorEmpresaId.setValue(0,{emitEvent:false});this.loadReferences();if(this.mode()==='create')this.loadSuggestedCode(true);}
  close():void{if(!this.saving())this.finish({saved:false,value:null});}
  save():void{switch(this.mode()){case'state':this.saveState();return;case'incident':this.saveIncident();return;case'vehicle':this.saveVehicle();return;case'mileage':this.saveMileage();return;default:this.saveAsset();}}
  title():string{switch(this.mode()){case'edit':return'Editar bien';case'state':return'Cambiar estado';case'incident':return'Registrar incidencia';case'vehicle':return'Registrar vehículo';case'mileage':return'Actualizar kilometraje';default:return'Registrar bien';}}
  icon(){switch(this.mode()){case'edit':return this.editIcon;case'state':return this.stateIcon;case'incident':return this.incidentIcon;case'vehicle':return this.vehicleIcon;case'mileage':return this.mileageIcon;default:return this.addIcon;}}

  private saveAsset():void{this.form.markAllAsTouched();if(this.form.invalid||this.saving()||this.referencesLoading())return;const raw=this.form.getRawValue(),amount=Number(raw.montoAdquisicion),providerId=Number(raw.proveedorEmpresaId);const common={tipoBienId:Number(raw.tipoBienId),nombre:normalizeText(raw.nombre),marca:normalizeOptionalText(raw.marca),modelo:normalizeOptionalText(raw.modelo),serie:normalizeOptionalText(raw.serie),fechaAdquisicion:raw.fechaAdquisicion||undefined,montoAdquisicion:amount>0?amount:undefined,moneda:raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase()||'PEN',proveedorEmpresaId:providerId>0?providerId:undefined,observacion:normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion)};const operation=this.mode()==='edit'&&this.current()?.bienInventarioId?this.api.updateAsset(this.current()!.bienInventarioId!,common):this.api.createAsset({uotId:Number(raw.uotId),codigoPatrimonial:raw.codigoPatrimonial.trim().toUpperCase()||undefined,...common});this.run(operation,this.mode()==='edit'?'Bien actualizado':'Bien registrado');}
  private saveState():void{const item=this.current();this.stateForm.markAllAsTouched();if(!item?.bienInventarioId||this.stateForm.invalid||this.saving())return;const raw=this.stateForm.getRawValue();this.run(this.api.changeAssetState(item.bienInventarioId,{estado:raw.estado,motivo:normalizeOptionalText(raw.motivo)}),'Estado actualizado');}
  private saveIncident():void{const item=this.current();this.incidentForm.markAllAsTouched();if(!item?.bienInventarioId||this.incidentForm.invalid||this.saving())return;const raw=this.incidentForm.getRawValue(),cost=Number(raw.costoEstimado);const body:ResourceAssetIncidentRequest={tipo:raw.tipo,fechaHora:raw.fechaHora,descripcion:normalizeText(raw.descripcion),costoEstimado:cost>0?cost:undefined};this.run(this.api.reportAssetIncident(item.bienInventarioId,body),'Incidencia registrada');}
  private saveVehicle():void{const item=this.current();this.vehicleForm.markAllAsTouched();if(!item?.bienInventarioId||this.vehicleForm.invalid||this.saving())return;const raw=this.vehicleForm.getRawValue();this.run(this.registerVehicle.execute(item.bienInventarioId,{placa:raw.placa.trim().toUpperCase(),tipoVehiculo:raw.tipoVehiculo.trim().toUpperCase(),kilometrajeKm:Number(raw.kilometrajeKm)}),'Vehículo registrado');}
  private saveMileage():void{const item=this.current();this.vehicleForm.controls.kilometrajeKm.markAsTouched();if(!item?.bienInventarioId||this.vehicleForm.controls.kilometrajeKm.invalid||this.saving())return;this.run(this.updateMileage.execute(item.bienInventarioId,{kilometrajeKm:Number(this.vehicleForm.controls.kilometrajeKm.value)}),'Kilometraje actualizado');}
  private run(operation:Observable<unknown>,success:string):void{this.saving.set(true);this.errorMessage.set(null);operation.pipe(finalize(()=>this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({next:()=>{this.toast.success(success);this.finish({saved:true,value:null});},error:(error)=>{const message=mapOpenApiError(error).message;this.errorMessage.set(message);this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación',message);}});}

  private resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId?:number):number{
    if(this.uot.isSpecific())return this.uot.selectedId()??0;
    return preferredUotId&&preferredUotId>0?preferredUotId:0;
  }
  private loadSuggestedCode(force=false):void{const uotId=Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId),control=this.form.controls.codigoPatrimonial;if(uotId<=0){if(force)control.setValue('',{emitEvent:false});return;}if(!force&&control.dirty&&control.value.trim())return;this.codeLoading.set(true);this.api.suggestCode(uotId,'BIEN').pipe(finalize(()=>this.codeLoading.set(false))).subscribe({next:(code)=>{if(code){control.setValue(code,{emitEvent:false});control.markAsPristine();}},error:()=>{if(force){control.setValue('',{emitEvent:false});control.markAsPristine();}}});}
  private loadReferences():void{this.referencesLoading.set(true);forkJoin({types:this.refs.catalog('TIPO_BIEN'),currencies:this.refs.catalog('MONEDA'),organizations:this.listOrganizations.execute(1,100,Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId)||undefined)}).pipe(finalize(()=>this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({next:({types,currencies,organizations})=>{this.assetTypes.set(types.map((item)=>({value:Number(item.id),label:item.label,description:item.code})).filter((item)=>item.value>0));this.currencies.set(currencies.map((item)=>({code:item.code,label:item.label})));this.organizations.set(organizations.items.filter((item)=>item.estado).map((item)=>({value:item.empresaId,label:item.razonSocial,description:item.ruc})));const current=this.form.controls.moneda.value;if(!this.currencies().some((item)=>item.code===current))this.form.controls.moneda.setValue(this.currencies()[0]?.code??'PEN');},error:(error)=>this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message)});}
  private loadVehicleTypes():void{this.referencesLoading.set(true);this.refs.catalog('TIPO_VEHICULO').pipe(finalize(()=>this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({next:(items)=>{this.vehicleTypes.set(items.map((item)=>({code:item.code,label:item.label})));if(!this.vehicleForm.controls.tipoVehiculo.value)this.vehicleForm.controls.tipoVehiculo.setValue(this.vehicleTypes()[0]?.code??'');},error:(error)=>this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message)});}
  private show():Promise<AdminModalResult>{this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();return new Promise((resolve)=>{this.resolver=resolve;});}
  private finish(result:AdminModalResult):void{if(this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open)this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();this.resolver?.(result);this.resolver=null;this.resetState();}
  private resetState():void{this.current.set(null);this.currentVehicle.set(null);this.errorMessage.set(null);}
}
```

```html
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Monto de adquisición</label><div class="resource-money-field"><select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (currency of currencies(); track currency.code) { <option [value]="currency.code">{{ currency.code }}</option> }</select><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="montoAdquisicion" /></div></div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea></div>
      <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
    </form>
  }
  <ng-template #actions><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">@if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }</button></footer></ng-template>
</div></dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/supply-api.service';

type SupplyFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'movement';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-suministro-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './suministro-form.html',
  styleUrl: './suministro-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SuministroFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly resourceApi = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<SupplyFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<SupplySummaryResponse | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly units = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    stockInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    stockMinimo: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
  });

  readonly movementForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    tipoMovimiento: ['ENTRADA', [Validators.required]],
    cantidad: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: this.resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId),
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      unidadMedida: 'UND',
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
    });

    if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
      this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.uotId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.enable({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadUnits();
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('edit');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      codigo: item.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item.nombre ?? '',
      unidadMedida: item.unidadMedida ?? 'UND',
      stockInicial: Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0),
      stockMinimo: Number(item.stockMinimo ?? 0),
    });
    this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.stockInicial.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadUnits();
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(item: SupplySummaryResponse): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('movement');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      tipoMovimiento: 'ENTRADA',
      cantidad: 0,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.movementForm.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'create') this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return 'Editar suministro';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar suministro';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'edit') return this.editIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.addIcon;
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveSupply();
    }
  }

  private saveSupply(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const uotId = Number(raw.uotId);
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> =
      this.mode() === 'edit' && this.current()?.suministroId
        ? this.api.update(Number(this.current()!.suministroId), {
            uotId,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          })
        : this.api.create({
            uotId,
            codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
            nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
            unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
            stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
            stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
          });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Suministro actualizado' : 'Suministro registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    const supply = this.current();
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!supply?.suministroId || this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .registerMovement(Number(supply.suministroId), {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        tipoMovimiento: raw.tipoMovimiento,
        cantidad: Number(raw.cantidad),
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Movimiento registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private loadUnits(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.refs.catalog('UNIDAD_MEDIDA')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.units.set(items.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
          const current = this.form.controls.unidadMedida.value;
          if (!this.units().some((item) => item.code === current)) {
            this.form.controls.unidadMedida.setValue(this.units()[0]?.code ?? 'UND');
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId?: number): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0 ? preferredUotId : 0;
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.form.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.resourceApi
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'SUMINISTRO')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowLeft, faGaugeHigh, faPen, faRotate, faTriangleExclamation, faTruck, faWrench } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of, switchMap } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { PermissionService } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.service';
import { ResourceAssetDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetDetailResponse';
import { ResourceAssetListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetListItemResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ObtenerVehiculoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-vehiculo.use-case';
import { Vehiculo } from '../../../../../domain/vehiculo.model';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ResourceImageComponent } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-image/resource-image';
import { RecursoFormComponent } from '../recurso-form/recurso-form';

@Component({
  selector:'app-recurso-detail-page', standalone:true,
  imports:[DatePipe,DecimalPipe,RouterLink,FaIconComponent,PermissionDirective,ErrorStateComponent,LoadingStateComponent,LocalFilePanelComponent,PageHeaderComponent,ResourceImageComponent,RecursoFormComponent],
  templateUrl:'./recurso-detail.html', styleUrl:'./recurso-detail.css', changeDetection:ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoFormComponent) private form!:RecursoFormComponent;
  private readonly route=inject(ActivatedRoute); private readonly api=inject(ResourceApiService); private readonly getVehicle=inject(ObtenerVehiculoUseCase); private readonly permissions=inject(PermissionService);
  readonly loading=signal(true); readonly errorMessage=signal<string|null>(null); readonly detail=signal<ResourceAssetDetailResponse|null>(null); readonly summary=signal<ResourceAssetListItemResponse|null>(null); readonly vehicle=signal<Vehiculo|null>(null);
  readonly pageIcon=faWrench; readonly backIcon=faArrowLeft; readonly editIcon=faPen; readonly refreshIcon=faRotate; readonly stateIcon=faWrench; readonly incidentIcon=faTriangleExclamation; readonly vehicleIcon=faTruck; readonly mileageIcon=faGaugeHigh;
  readonly assetId=Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));

  ngOnInit():void{this.load();}
  load():void{
    if(!Number.isFinite(this.assetId)||this.assetId<=0){this.errorMessage.set('El identificador del bien no es válido.');this.loading.set(false);return;}
    this.loading.set(true);this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.getAsset(this.assetId).pipe(
      switchMap((detail)=>{
        const item=detail?.bien;
        const summaryRequest=item?.uotId&&item.codigoPatrimonial
          ? this.api.listAssets({uotId:item.uotId,search:item.codigoPatrimonial,page:1,size:20}).pipe(map((page)=>page.items.find((candidate)=>candidate.bienInventarioId===item.bienInventarioId)??null),catchError(()=>of(null)))
          : of(null);
        const vehicleRequest=this.normalizeResourceText(item?.tipoBien)==='VEHICULO'
          ? this.getVehicle.execute(this.assetId).pipe(catchError(()=>of(null)))
          : of(null);
        return forkJoin({detail:of(detail),summary:summaryRequest,vehicle:vehicleRequest});
      }),
      finalize(()=>this.loading.set(false)),
    ).subscribe({next:({detail,summary,vehicle})=>{if(!detail?.bien){this.errorMessage.set('No se encontró el bien solicitado.');return;}this.detail.set(detail);this.summary.set(summary);this.vehicle.set(vehicle);},error:(error)=>this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message)});
  }
  async edit():Promise<void>{const item=this.detail()?.bien;if(!item)return;const result=await this.form.openEdit(item);if(result.saved)this.load();}
  async changeState():Promise<void>{const item=this.detail()?.bien;if(!item)return;const result=await this.form.openState(item);if(result.saved)this.load();}
  async reportIncident():Promise<void>{const item=this.detail()?.bien;if(!item)return;const result=await this.form.openIncident(item);if(result.saved)this.load();}
  async registerVehicle():Promise<void>{const item=this.detail()?.bien;if(!item||!this.isVehicleAsset())return;const result=await this.form.openVehicle(item);if(result.saved)this.load();}
  async updateMileage():Promise<void>{const item=this.detail()?.bien,vehicle=this.vehicle();if(!item||!vehicle)return;const result=await this.form.openMileage(item,vehicle);if(result.saved)this.load();}
  canUploadImages():boolean{return this.permissions.has('INVENTARIO_EDITAR')&&this.permissions.has('ARCHIVOS_CREAR');}
  fileIds():readonly number[]{return this.detail()?.archivosImagen??[];}
  mainFileId():number|null{return this.summary()?.archivoPrincipalId??this.detail()?.bien?.archivoPrincipalId??null;}
  mainImageUrl():string|null{return this.summary()?.imagenPrincipalUrl??null;}
  providerName():string{return this.summary()?.proveedorNombre??'—';}

  isVehicleAsset(): boolean {
    const name = this.detail()?.bien?.tipoBien ?? '';
    return name
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase() === 'VEHICULO';
  }

  incidentStatusLabel(value?: string | null): string {
    const labels: Record<string, string> = {
      ABIERTO: 'Abierta',
      EN_ATENCION: 'En atención',
      RESUELTO: 'Resuelta',
      CERRADO: 'Cerrada',
      ANULADO: 'Anulada',
    };

    return labels[(value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()] ?? 'Sin estado';
  }

  incidentStatusClass(value?: string | null): string {
    const state = (value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (state === 'RESUELTO' || state === 'CERRADO') {
      return 'resource-incident-state resource-incident-state--ok';
    }
    if (state === 'EN_ATENCION') {
      return 'resource-incident-state resource-incident-state--warning';
    }
    if (state === 'ANULADO') {
      return 'resource-incident-state resource-incident-state--muted';
    }
    return 'resource-incident-state resource-incident-state--danger';
  }
}
}
```

```html
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button resource-search-button"
          title="Buscar"
          aria-label="Buscar"
          (click)="applyFilters()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </label>

    @if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
      <label class="resource-filter-field">
        <span>Tipo</span>
        <select
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="typeFilter() ?? 0"
          (change)="typeFilter.set(+$any($event.target).value || null); applyFilters()"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
          @for (type of assetTypes(); track type.id) {
            <option [value]="type.id">{{ type.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>

      <label class="resource-filter-field">
        <span>Estado</span>
        <select
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="stateFilter()"
          (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()"
        >
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="DISPONIBLE">Disponible</option>
          <option value="ASIGNADO">Asignado</option>
          <option value="MANTENIMIENTO">Mantenimiento</option>
          <option value="AVERIADO">Averiado</option>
          <option value="NO_DISPONIBLE">No disponible</option>
          <option value="INACTIVO">Inactivo</option>
          <option value="BAJA">Baja</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <div class="resource-view-switch">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-icon-button"
          [class.active]="viewMode() === 'table'"
          title="Vista tabla"
          (click)="setView('table')"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-icon-button"
          [class.active]="viewMode() === 'cards'"
          title="Vista tarjetas"
          (click)="setView('cards')"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="cardsIcon" />
        </button>
      </div>
    }
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state
      title="Cargando inventario"
      message="Consultando recursos del contexto UOT."
    />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state
      [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar el inventario.'"
      (retry)="load()"
    />
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'assets') {
    @if (assets().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin bienes"
        message="No existen bienes para los filtros seleccionados."
      />
    } @else if (viewMode() === 'table') {
      <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table resource-assets-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Imagen</th>
                <th>UOT</th>
                <th>Código</th>
                <th>Bien</th>
                <th>Tipo</th>
                <th>Proveedor</th>
                <th>Estado</th>
                <th>Incidencias</th>
                <th class="resource-actions-column">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of assets().items; track assetKey(item)) {
                <tr>
                  <td class="resource-image-cell">
                    <app-resource-image
                      variant="thumb"
                      [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId"
                      [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl"
                      [alt]="item.nombre || 'Bien'"
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="admin-code">{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong>
                    <small class="resource-cell-help">
                      {{ item.marca || '' }}
                      @if (item.modelo) {
                        @if (item.marca) { · }
                        {{ item.modelo }}
                      }
                    </small>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <strong>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</strong>
                    @if (vehicleSummary(item); as vehicleInfo) {
                      <small class="resource-cell-help">{{ vehicleInfo }}</small>
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ item.proveedorNombre || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="resource-status" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoBien)">
                      {{ stateLabel(item.estadoBien) }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    @if ((item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0) > 0) {
                      <span class="resource-incident-count">
                        <fa-icon [icon]="incidentIcon" />
                        {{ item.incidentesAbiertos }}
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <span class="resource-cell-help">Sin incidencias</span>
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td class="resource-actions-column">
                    <div class="admin-table-actions resource-row-actions">
                      <a
                        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos', item.bienInventarioId]"
                        title="Ver detalle"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                      </a>
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar"
                        (click)="editAsset(item)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    } @else {
      <section class="resource-card-grid">
        @for (item of assets().items; track assetKey(item)) {
          <article class="admin-surface resource-card">
            <app-resource-image
              variant="card"
              [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId"
              [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl"
              [alt]="item.nombre || 'Bien'"
            />
            <div class="resource-card-body">
              <header>
                <div>
                  <small>{{ item.uotNombre || 'UOT' }}</small>
                  <h3>{{ item.nombre || 'Bien' }}</h3>
                  <span>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</span>
                </div>
                <span class="resource-status" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoBien)">
                  {{ stateLabel(item.estadoBien) }}
                </span>
              </header>

              <dl>
                <div>
                  <dt>Tipo</dt>
                  <dd>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>Proveedor</dt>
                  <dd>{{ item.proveedorNombre || '—' }}</dd>
                </div>
                @if (vehicleSummary(item); as vehicleInfo) {
                  <div class="resource-card-wide">
                    <dt>Datos vehiculares</dt>
                    <dd>{{ vehicleInfo }}</dd>
                  </div>
                }
                <div>
                  <dt>Incidencias</dt>
                  <dd>{{ item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0 }}</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>

              <footer>
                <a
                  *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'"
                  class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                  [routerLink]="['/recursos/inventario-vehiculos', item.bienInventarioId]"
                >
                  <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                  Detalle
                </a>
                <button
                  *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
                  type="button"
                  class="admin-icon-button"
                  title="Editar"
                  (click)="editAsset(item)"
                >
                  <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                </button>
              </footer>
            </div>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }

    <app-paginator
      [page]="assets().page"
      [size]="assets().size"
      [totalRecords]="assets().totalRecords"
      [totalPages]="assets().totalPages"
      (pageChange)="loadAssets($event, assets().size)"
      (sizeChange)="loadAssets(1, $event)"
    />
  } @else {
    @if (filteredSupplies().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin suministros"
        message="No existen suministros para el contexto seleccionado."
      />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface resource-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table resource-supplies-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>UOT</th>
                <th>Código</th>
                <th>Suministro</th>
                <th>Unidad</th>
                <th>Stock actual</th>
                <th>Reservado</th>
                <th>Disponible</th>
                <th>Reposición</th>
                <th class="resource-actions-column">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredSupplies(); track supplyKey(item)) {
                <tr>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td><span class="admin-code">{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</span></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ (item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ (item.stockReservado ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td><strong>{{ (item.stockDisponible ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.requiereReposicion) {
                      <span class="resource-status resource-status--warning">Reponer</span>
                    } @else {
                      <span class="resource-status resource-status--ok">Correcto</span>
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td class="resource-actions-column">
                    <div class="admin-table-actions resource-row-actions">
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar suministro"
                        (click)="editSupply(item)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Registrar movimiento"
                        (click)="movement(item)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_VER'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Ver Kardex"
                        (click)="toggleKardex(item)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>

                @if (sameSupply(kardexSupply(), item)) {
                  <tr class="resource-kardex-row">
                    <td colspan="9">
                      <div class="resource-kardex-panel">
                        <strong>Kardex · {{ item.uotNombre }} · {{ item.nombre }}</strong>

                        @if (kardexLoading()) {
                          <app-loading-state
                            title="Cargando Kardex"
                            message="Consultando movimientos históricos."
                          />
                        } @else if (kardexError()) {
                          <app-error-state
                            [message]="kardexError() || 'No se pudo consultar el Kardex.'"
                            (retry)="loadKardex(item)"
                          />
                        } @else if (kardex().length === 0) {
                          <app-empty-state
                            title="Sin movimientos"
                            message="El suministro todavía no tiene movimientos."
                          />
                        } @else {
                          <div class="admin-table-scroll resource-kardex-scroll mt-3">
                            <table class="admin-table">
                              <thead>
                                <tr>
                                  <th>Fecha</th>
                                  <th>Tipo</th>
                                  <th>Cantidad</th>
                                  <th>Saldo</th>
                                  <th>Documento</th>
                                  <th>Usuario</th>
                                </tr>
                              </thead>
                              <tbody>
                                @for (movementItem of kardex(); track movementItem.suministroMovimientoId) {
                                  <tr>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.fechaHora || '—' }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ (movementItem.cantidad ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                                    <td><strong>{{ (movementItem.saldo ?? 0) | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td>
                                    <td>{{ movementItem.usuario || 'Sistema' }}</td>
                                  </tr>
                                }
                              </tbody>
                            </table>
                          </div>
                        }
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                }
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="supplies().page"
        [size]="supplies().size"
        [totalRecords]="supplies().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="supplies().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="loadSupplies($event, supplies().size)"
        (sizeChange)="loadSupplies(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  }
</div>

<app-recurso-form />
<app-suministro-form />
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
}

.resource-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.resource-filter-title {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 2.65rem;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.resource-filter-field {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 11rem;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.resource-filter-field--search {
  min-width: min(100%, 20rem);
  flex: 1 1 20rem;
}

.resource-filter-field > span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.resource-filter-field .admin-input,
.resource-filter-field .admin-select,
.resource-search-button,
.resource-view-switch .admin-icon-button {
  min-height: 2.65rem;
}

.resource-search-control {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 2.75rem;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.resource-search-control .admin-input {
  min-width: 0;
}

.resource-search-button {
  width: 2.75rem;
  min-width: 2.75rem;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0;
}

.resource-view-switch {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-left: auto;
}

.resource-view-switch .active {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary);
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.resource-table-shell {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.resource-assets-table {
  min-width: 78rem;
}

.resource-supplies-table {
  min-width: 72rem;
}

.resource-image-cell {
  width: 5rem;
  min-width: 5rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.resource-cell-help {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.resource-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.resource-status--ok {
  background: var(--desco-success-soft);
  color: var(--desco-success-text);
}

.resource-status--warning {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: var(--desco-warning-text);
}

.resource-status--muted {
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.resource-status--info {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.resource-incident-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--desco-danger-soft);
  padding: 0.28rem 0.55rem;
  color: var(--desco-danger-text);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.resource-actions-column {
  min-width: 7rem;
  width: 7rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.resource-row-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.resource-card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(18rem, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.resource-card {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
}

.resource-card-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.resource-card header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.resource-card header small,
.resource-card header span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
}

.resource-card h3 {
  margin: 0.15rem 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.resource-card dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.resource-card dl > div {
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.6rem;
}

.resource-card dl > .resource-card-wide {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.resource-card dt {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.57rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.resource-card dd {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.resource-card footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.resource-kardex-row > td {
  padding: 0 !important;
}

.resource-kardex-panel {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 1rem;
}

.resource-kardex-scroll {
  max-height: 22rem;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .resource-filter-field,
  .resource-filter-field--search {
    min-width: min(100%, 14rem);
    flex: 1 1 14rem;
  }

  .resource-view-switch {
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .resource-card-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .resource-filter-bar {
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .resource-filter-title,
  .resource-filter-field,
  .resource-filter-field--search {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 100%;
  }

  .resource-view-switch {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_180923_874803/src/app/features/recursos/inventario-vehiculos/adapter/in/ui/pages/recurso-detail/recurso-detail.html`

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Detalle del bien"
    subtitle="Información patrimonial, evidencia visual, historial e incidencias."
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        routerLink="/recursos/inventario-vehiculos"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="!detail()?.bien"
        (click)="edit()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
        Editar
      </button>

      @if (
        detail()?.bien
        && isVehicleAsset()
        && !vehicle()
        && detail()?.bien?.estadoBien !== 'BAJA'
      ) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_CREAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          (click)="registerVehicle()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="vehicleIcon" />
          Registrar vehículo
        </button>
      }

      @if (vehicle() && detail()?.bien?.estadoBien !== 'BAJA') {
        <button
          *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          (click)="updateMileage()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="mileageIcon" />
          Kilometraje
        </button>
      }

      <button
        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="!detail()?.bien"
        (click)="changeState()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="stateIcon" />
        Estado
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'INVENTARIO_EDITAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="!detail()?.bien"
        (click)="reportIncident()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="incidentIcon" />
        Incidencia
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state
      title="Cargando bien"
      message="Consultando información patrimonial."
    />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state
      [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible cargar el bien.'"
      (retry)="load()"
    />
  } @else if (detail()?.bien; as item) {
    <section class="resource-hero-grid">
      <article class="admin-surface resource-hero-image">
        <app-resource-image
          variant="hero"
          [fileId]="mainFileId()"
          [imageUrl]="mainImageUrl()"
          [alt]="item.nombre || 'Bien'"
        />
      </article>

      <article class="admin-surface resource-summary-card">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Identificación</p>
            <h2>{{ item.nombre || 'Bien sin nombre' }}</h2>
          </div>
          <span class="resource-state">{{ item.estadoBien || '—' }}</span>
        </header>

        <dl class="resource-data-grid">
          <div><dt>UOT</dt><dd>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Código patrimonial</dt><dd>{{ item.codigoPatrimonial || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Tipo</dt><dd>{{ item.tipoBien || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Proveedor</dt><dd>{{ providerName() }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Marca</dt><dd>{{ item.marca || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Modelo</dt><dd>{{ item.modelo || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Serie</dt><dd>{{ item.serie || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Fecha de adquisición</dt><dd>{{ item.fechaAdquisicion || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div>
            <dt>Monto de adquisición</dt>
            <dd>
              @if (item.montoAdquisicion != null) {
                {{ item.monedaAdquisicion || 'PEN' }}
                {{ item.montoAdquisicion | number:'1.2-2' }}
              } @else {
                —
              }
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div><dt>Incidencias abiertas</dt><dd>{{ item.incidentesAbiertos ?? 0 }}</dd></div>
          <div class="resource-data-wide">
            <dt>Observación</dt>
            <dd>{{ item.observacion || '—' }}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </article>
    </section>

    <section
      class="resource-detail-columns"
      [class.resource-detail-columns--single]="!isVehicleAsset()"
    >
      @if (isVehicleAsset()) {
        <article class="admin-surface resource-list-card resource-vehicle-card">
          <header>
            <div>
              <p>Vehículo</p>
              <h2>Datos vehiculares</h2>
            </div>
          </header>

          @if (vehicle(); as v) {
            <div class="resource-vehicle-grid">
              <div><span>Placa</span><strong>{{ v.placa }}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Tipo</span><strong>{{ v.tipoVehiculo }}</strong></div>
              <div>
                <span>Kilometraje</span>
                <strong>{{ v.kilometrajeKm | number:'1.0-1' }} km</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <p class="resource-empty-copy">
              El bien está clasificado como vehículo y aún no tiene datos vehiculares.
            </p>
          }
        </article>
      }

      <article class="admin-surface resource-list-card">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Imágenes</p>
            <h2>Evidencia visual</h2>
          </div>
        </header>

        <app-local-file-panel
          [uotId]="item.uotId || 0"
          linkType="BIEN"
          [linkId]="item.bienInventarioId || 0"
          [fileIds]="fileIds()"
          title="Imágenes del bien"
          category="BIEN_IMAGEN"
          accept="image/*"
          [canUpload]="canUploadImages()"
          (changed)="load()"
        />
      </article>
    </section>

    <section class="resource-detail-columns">
      <article class="admin-surface resource-list-card">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Historial</p>
            <h2>Estados del bien</h2>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div class="resource-scroll-panel">
          <div class="resource-timeline">
            @for (history of detail()?.historial || []; track history.bienEstadoHistorialId) {
              <article class="resource-timeline-item">
                <span class="resource-timeline-dot"></span>
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ history.estadoBien || '—' }}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {{ history.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}
                    @if (history.fechaHasta) {
                      · hasta {{ history.fechaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}
                    }
                  </small>
                  @if (history.motivo) {
                    <p>{{ history.motivo }}</p>
                  }
                </div>
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="resource-empty-copy">Sin historial registrado.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="admin-surface resource-list-card">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Incidencias</p>
            <h2>Eventos reportados</h2>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div class="resource-scroll-panel">
          <div class="resource-incident-list">
            @for (incident of detail()?.incidentes || []; track incident.bienIncidenteId) {
              <article class="resource-incident-item">
                <header>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{{ incident.tipoIncidente || 'Incidencia' }}</strong>
                    <small>{{ incident.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</small>
                  </div>
                  <span [class]="incidentStatusClass(incident.estadoIncidente)">
                    {{ incidentStatusLabel(incident.estadoIncidente) }}
                  </span>
                </header>

                <p>{{ incident.descripcion || '—' }}</p>

                <div class="resource-incident-meta">
                  @if (incident.costoEstimado != null) {
                    <span>
                      Estimado:
                      {{ incident.costoEstimado | number:'1.2-2' }}
                    </span>
                  }
                  @if (incident.costoReal != null) {
                    <span>
                      Real:
                      {{ incident.costoReal | number:'1.2-2' }}
                    </span>
                  }
                  @if (incident.fechaCierre) {
                    <span>
                      Cierre:
                      {{ incident.fechaCierre | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}
                    </span>
                  }
                </div>

                @if (incident.solucion) {
                  <div class="resource-incident-solution">
                    <span>Solución</span>
                    <p>{{ incident.solucion }}</p>
                  </div>
                }
              </article>
            } @empty {
              <p class="resource-empty-copy">Sin incidencias registradas.</p>
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-recurso-form />
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { DocumentosLocalesService } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/documentosLocales.service';
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';

export interface LocalFileUpload {
  uotId: number;
  file: File;
  category?: string;
  description?: string;
  linkType?: string;
  linkId?: number;
  principal?: boolean;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class LocalDocumentApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(DocumentosLocalesService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesListar(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>(response) ?? [],
        ),
      );
  }

  upload(input: LocalFileUpload) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesSubir(
        {
          uotId: input.uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          archivo: input.file,
          categoria: input.category ?? 'DOCUMENTO',
          descripcion: input.description,
          vinculoTipo: input.linkType ?? 'NINGUNO',
          vinculoId: input.linkId,
          principal: input.principal ?? false,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse>(response),
        ),
      );
  }

  content(archivoId: number) {
    return this.api.documentosLocalesContenido(
      { archivoId },
      'body',
      false,
      { transferCache: false },
    );
  }

  retire(archivoId: number, reason: string) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesRetirar(
        {
          archivoId,
          motivo: reason,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }
}
```

- Ruta: `.reemplazar_backups/20260927_182724_380750/src/app/shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\.reemplazar_backups\20260927_182724_380750\src\app\shared\files\local-file-panel\local-file-panel.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/.reemplazar_backups/20260927_182724_380750/src/app/shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowUpRightFromSquare,
  faFileImage,
  faImage,
  faRotate,
  faUpload,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../local-document-api.service';

interface FilePreview {
  id: number;
  url: string | null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-local-file-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './local-file-panel.html',
  styleUrl: './local-file-panel.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class LocalFilePanelComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input({ required: true }) uotId = 0;
  @Input({ required: true }) linkType = 'NINGUNO';
  @Input({ required: true }) linkId = 0;
  @Input() fileIds: readonly number[] = [];
  @Input() title = 'Imágenes y documentos';
  @Input() accept = 'image/*';
  @Input() category = 'IMAGEN';
  @Input() forcePrincipal = false;
  @Input() canUpload = true;

  @Output() changed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  private readonly api = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);
  readonly previews = signal<readonly FilePreview[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly fileIcon = faFileImage;
  readonly uploadIcon = faUpload;
  readonly viewIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['fileIds']) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.revokeAll();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.revokeAll();
    const ids = [...new Set(this.fileIds.filter((id) => id > 0))];

    if (ids.length === 0) {
      this.previews.set([]);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    forkJoin(
      ids.map((id) =>
        this.api.content(id).pipe(
          map((blob) => ({
            id,
            url: URL.createObjectURL(blob),
          }) satisfies FilePreview),
          catchError(() => of({ id, url: null } satisfies FilePreview)),
        ),
      ),
    )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.previews.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  upload(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const file = input.files?.item(0) ?? null;
    input.value = '';

    if (!file || this.uploading() || !this.canUpload) return;

    if (file.size <= 0) {
      this.toast.error('Archivo vacío', 'Selecciona un archivo con contenido.');
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Archivo demasiado grande',
        'El archivo no puede superar 15 MB.',
```

```typescript
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { DocumentosLocalesService } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/documentosLocales.service';
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import {
  ApiEnvelope,
  unwrapApiResponse,
} from '../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { environment } from '../../../environments/environment';

export interface LocalFileUpload {
  uotId: number;
  file: File;
  category?: string;
  description?: string;
  linkType?: string;
  linkId?: number;
  principal?: boolean;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class LocalDocumentApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(DocumentosLocalesService);
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesListar(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>(response) ?? [],
        ),
      );
  }

  upload(input: LocalFileUpload) {
    const body = new FormData();
    body.append('archivo', input.file, input.file.name);

    let params = new HttpParams()
      .set('uotId', String(input.uotId))
      .set('categoria', this.normalizeCategory(input.category))
      .set(
        'vinculoTipo',
        (input.linkType ?? 'NINGUNO').trim().toUpperCase(),
      )
      .set('principal', String(input.principal ?? false));

    const description = input.description?.trim();
    if (description) {
      params = params.set('descripcion', description);
    }

    if ((input.linkId ?? 0) > 0) {
      params = params.set('vinculoId', String(input.linkId));
    }

    /*
     * No establecer Content-Type manualmente.
     * El navegador agrega multipart/form-data con su boundary real.
     */
    const headers = new HttpHeaders({
      'X-Idempotency-Key': this.idempotency.create(),
    });

    return this.http
      .post<ApiEnvelope<LocalDocumentFileResponse>>(
        `${environment.apiBaseUrl}/api/v1/documentos/local`,
        body,
        {
          params,
          headers,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse>(response),
        ),
      );
  }

  content(archivoId: number) {
    return this.api.documentosLocalesContenido(
      { archivoId },
      'body',
      false,
      { transferCache: false },
    );
  }

  retire(archivoId: number, reason: string) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesRetirar(
        {
          archivoId,
          motivo: reason,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  private normalizeCategory(value?: string): string {
    const category = (value ?? 'DOCUMENTO')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

    if (
      category === 'IMAGEN'
      || category === 'BIEN_IMAGEN'
      || category === 'PRODUCTO_IMAGEN'
    ) {
      return 'FOTOGRAFIA';
    }

    return category || 'DOCUMENTO';
  }

}
```

```typescript
@Component({
  selector: 'app-local-file-panel',

export class LocalFilePanelComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input({ required: true }) uotId = 0;
  @Input({ required: true }) linkType = 'NINGUNO';

  @Input() title = 'Imágenes y documentos';

  @Input() canUpload = true;

    const ids = [...new Set(this.fileIds.filter((id) => id > 0))];

    if (ids.length === 0) {
      this.previews.set([]);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      this.loading.set(false);

      );

    this.api
      .upload({

        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el archivo',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  open(preview: FilePreview): void {
```

```typescript
import { HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';

import { SKIP_CORRELATION_ID } from '../context/http-context.tokens';
import { CorrelationIdService } from '../services/correlation-id.service';

export const correlationIdInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) => {
  if (request.context.get(SKIP_CORRELATION_ID)) {
    return next(request);
  }

  const correlationId = inject(CorrelationIdService).create();

  return next(
    request.clone({
      setHeaders: {
        'X-Correlation-Id': correlationId,
      },
    }),
  );
};
```

```typescript
          input.value = '';
        }),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Archivo guardado');
          this.changed.emit();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el archivo',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  open(preview: FilePreview): void {
    if (!preview.url) return;
    window.open(preview.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }
```

```typescript
import {
  HttpInterceptorFn,
  HttpResponse,
} from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { tap } from 'rxjs';

import { SKIP_CORRELATION_ID } from '../context/http-context.tokens';
import { CorrelationIdService } from '../services/correlation-id.service';

export const correlationIdInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) => {
  if (request.context.get(SKIP_CORRELATION_ID)) {
    return next(request);
  }

  const correlationId = inject(CorrelationIdService).create();

  const tracedRequest = request.clone({
    setHeaders: {
      'X-Correlation-Id': correlationId,
    },
  });

  const localUpload =
    tracedRequest.method === 'POST'
    && tracedRequest.url.includes('/api/v1/documentos/local');

  if (!localUpload) {
    return next(tracedRequest);
  }

  const body = tracedRequest.body;
  const isFormData =
    typeof FormData !== 'undefined'
    && body instanceof FormData;

  console.info(
    '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][HTTP][OUT]',
    {
      method: tracedRequest.method,
      url: tracedRequest.urlWithParams,
      correlationId,
      contentTypeHeader:
        tracedRequest.headers.get('Content-Type'),
      bodyConstructor:
        body && typeof body === 'object'
          ? body.constructor?.name ?? '(desconocido)'
          : typeof body,
      isFormData,
      formDataEntries:
        isFormData
          ? summarizeFormData(body)
          : [],
    },
  );

  return next(tracedRequest).pipe(
    tap({
      next: (event) => {
        if (event instanceof HttpResponse) {
          console.info(
            '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][HTTP][IN]',
            {
              correlationId,
              status: event.status,
              url: event.url,
              responseContentType:
                event.headers.get('Content-Type'),
            },
          );
        }
      },
      error: (error: unknown) => {
        const record =
          error && typeof error === 'object'
            ? error as Record<string, unknown>
            : null;

        console.error(
          '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][HTTP][ERROR]',
          {
            correlationId,
            status:
              typeof record?.['status'] === 'number'
                ? record['status']
                : null,
            statusText:
              typeof record?.['statusText'] === 'string'
                ? record['statusText']
                : null,
            url:
              typeof record?.['url'] === 'string'
                ? record['url']
                : tracedRequest.urlWithParams,
            name:
              error instanceof Error
                ? error.name
                : typeof error,
            message:
              error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : typeof record?.['message'] === 'string'
                  ? record['message']
                  : String(error),
            backendPayload:
              record?.['error'] ?? record?.['details'] ?? null,
          },
        );
      },
    }),
  );
};

function summarizeFormData(
  body: FormData,
): readonly Record<string, unknown>[] {
  return Array.from(body.entries()).map(
    ([key, value]) => {
      if (
        typeof File !== 'undefined'
        && value instanceof File
      ) {
        return {
          key,
          kind: 'File',
          name: value.name,
          size: value.size,
          type: value.type,
          lastModified: value.lastModified,
        };
      }

      if (
        typeof Blob !== 'undefined'
        && value instanceof Blob
      ) {
        return {
          key,
          kind: 'Blob',
          size: value.size,
          type: value.type,
        };
      }

      return {
        key,
        kind: 'text',
        value: String(value),
      };
    },
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map, tap } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { DocumentosLocalesService } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/documentosLocales.service';
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import {
  ApiEnvelope,
  unwrapApiResponse,
} from '../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { environment } from '../../../environments/environment';

export interface LocalFileUpload {
  uotId: number;
  file: File;
  category?: string;
  description?: string;
  linkType?: string;
  linkId?: number;
  principal?: boolean;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class LocalDocumentApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(DocumentosLocalesService);
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesListar(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>(response) ?? [],
        ),
      );
  }

  upload(input: LocalFileUpload) {
    const body = new FormData();
    body.append('archivo', input.file, input.file.name);

    let params = new HttpParams()
      .set('uotId', String(input.uotId))
      .set('categoria', this.normalizeCategory(input.category))
      .set(
        'vinculoTipo',
        (input.linkType ?? 'NINGUNO').trim().toUpperCase(),
      )
      .set('principal', String(input.principal ?? false));

    const description = input.description?.trim();
    if (description) {
      params = params.set('descripcion', description);
    }

    if ((input.linkId ?? 0) > 0) {
      params = params.set('vinculoId', String(input.linkId));
    }

    /*
     * No establecer Content-Type manualmente.
     * El navegador agrega multipart/form-data con su boundary real.
     */
    const idempotencyKey = this.idempotency.create();

    const headers = new HttpHeaders({
      'X-Idempotency-Key': idempotencyKey,
    });

    console.info(
      '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][API][PREPARE]',
      {
        url:
          `${environment.apiBaseUrl}/api/v1/documentos/local`,
        query: params.toString(),
        uotId: input.uotId,
        category: this.normalizeCategory(input.category),
        linkType:
          (input.linkType ?? 'NINGUNO').trim().toUpperCase(),
        linkId: input.linkId ?? null,
        principal: input.principal ?? false,
        file: {
          name: input.file.name,
          size: input.file.size,
          type: input.file.type,
          lastModified: input.file.lastModified,
        },
        bodyIsFormData: body instanceof FormData,
        bodyHasArchivo: body.has('archivo'),
        bodyEntries: this.summarizeFormData(body),
        contentTypeHeader: headers.get('Content-Type'),
        idempotencyPresent: Boolean(idempotencyKey),
      },
    );

    return this.http
      .post<ApiEnvelope<LocalDocumentFileResponse>>(
        `${environment.apiBaseUrl}/api/v1/documentos/local`,
        body,
        {
          params,
          headers,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        tap({
          next: (response) => {
            console.info(
              '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][API][RESPONSE]',
              {
                exitoso: response.exitoso,
                codigo: response.codigo,
                mensaje: response.mensaje,
                correlacionId: response.correlacionId,
              },
            );
          },
          error: (error: unknown) => {
            console.error(
              '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][API][ERROR]',
              error,
            );
          },
        }),
        map((response) =>
          unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse>(response),
        ),
      );
  }

  content(archivoId: number) {
    return this.api.documentosLocalesContenido(
      { archivoId },
      'body',
      false,
      { transferCache: false },
    );
  }

  retire(archivoId: number, reason: string) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesRetirar(
        {
          archivoId,
          motivo: reason,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  private normalizeCategory(value?: string): string {
    const category = (value ?? 'DOCUMENTO')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

    if (
      category === 'IMAGEN'
      || category === 'BIEN_IMAGEN'
      || category === 'PRODUCTO_IMAGEN'
    ) {
      return 'FOTOGRAFIA';
    }

    return category || 'DOCUMENTO';
  }


  private summarizeFormData(
    body: FormData,
  ): readonly Record<string, unknown>[] {
    return Array.from(body.entries()).map(
      ([key, value]) => {
        if (
          typeof File !== 'undefined'
          && value instanceof File
        ) {
          return {
            key,
            kind: 'File',
            name: value.name,
            size: value.size,
            type: value.type,
            lastModified: value.lastModified,
          };
        }

        if (
          typeof Blob !== 'undefined'
          && value instanceof Blob
        ) {
          return {
            key,
            kind: 'Blob',
            size: value.size,
            type: value.type,
          };
        }

        return {
          key,
          kind: 'text',
          value: String(value),
        };
      },
    );
  }

}
```
