```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowUpRightFromSquare,
  faFileImage,
  faImage,
  faRotate,
  faUpload,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../local-document-api.service';

interface FilePreview {
  id: number;
  url: string | null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-local-file-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './local-file-panel.html',
  styleUrl: './local-file-panel.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class LocalFilePanelComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input({ required: true }) uotId = 0;
  @Input({ required: true }) linkType = 'NINGUNO';
  @Input({ required: true }) linkId = 0;
  @Input() fileIds: readonly number[] = [];
  @Input() title = 'Imágenes y documentos';
  @Input() accept = 'image/*';
  @Input() category = 'FOTOGRAFIA';
  @Input() forcePrincipal = false;
  @Input() canUpload = true;

  @Output() changed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  private readonly api = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);
  readonly previews = signal<readonly FilePreview[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly fileIcon = faFileImage;
  readonly uploadIcon = faUpload;
  readonly viewIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['fileIds']) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.revokeAll();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.revokeAll();
    const ids = [...new Set(this.fileIds.filter((id) => id > 0))];

    if (ids.length === 0) {
      this.previews.set([]);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    forkJoin(
      ids.map((id) =>
        this.api.content(id).pipe(
          map((blob) => ({
            id,
            url: URL.createObjectURL(blob),
          }) satisfies FilePreview),
          catchError(() => of({ id, url: null } satisfies FilePreview)),
        ),
      ),
    )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.previews.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  upload(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const fileCount = input.files?.length ?? 0;
    const file = input.files?.item(0) ?? null;

    console.info(
      '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][UI][SELECT]',
      {
        fileCount,
        file:
          file
            ? {
                name: file.name,
                size: file.size,
                type: file.type,
                lastModified: file.lastModified,
              }
            : null,
        uotId: this.uotId,
        linkType: this.linkType,
        linkId: this.linkId,
        category: this.category,
        forcePrincipal: this.forcePrincipal,
        currentFileIds: [...this.fileIds],
        canUpload: this.canUpload,
        alreadyUploading: this.uploading(),
      },
    );

    input.value = '';

    if (!file || this.uploading() || !this.canUpload) {
      console.warn(
        '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][UI][STOP_BEFORE_UPLOAD]',
        {
          filePresent: Boolean(file),
          uploading: this.uploading(),
          canUpload: this.canUpload,
        },
      );
      return;
    }

    if (file.size <= 0) {
      this.toast.error('Archivo vacío', 'Selecciona un archivo con contenido.');
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Archivo demasiado grande',
        'El archivo no puede superar 15 MB.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      this.accept.includes('image') &&
      !file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith('image/')
    ) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Formato no permitido',
        'Selecciona una imagen válida.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.uotId <= 0 || this.linkId <= 0) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Contexto incompleto',
        'No se pudo determinar la UOT o el registro vinculado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.uploading.set(true);

    const principal =
      this.forcePrincipal
      || this.fileIds.length === 0;

    console.info(
      '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][UI][CALL_API]',
      {
        uotId: this.uotId,
        linkType: this.linkType,
        linkId: this.linkId,
        category: this.category,
        principal,
        file: {
          name: file.name,
          size: file.size,
          type: file.type,
        },
      },
    );

    this.api
      .upload({
        uotId: this.uotId,
        file,
        category: this.category,
        linkType: this.linkType,
        linkId: this.linkId,
        principal,
      })
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.uploading.set(false);

          console.info(
            '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][UI][FINALIZE]',
            {
              fileName: file.name,
              uploading: false,
            },
          );
        }),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          console.info(
            '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][UI][SUCCESS]',
            {
              fileName: file.name,
              uotId: this.uotId,
              linkType: this.linkType,
              linkId: this.linkId,
            },
          );

          this.toast.success('Archivo guardado');
          this.changed.emit();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const mapped = mapOpenApiError(error);

          console.error(
            '[DESCO-UPLOAD-TRACE][FRONTEND][UI][ERROR]',
            {
              status: mapped.status,
              code: mapped.code,
              message: mapped.message,
              correlationId: mapped.correlationId,
              raw: error,
            },
          );

          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el archivo',
            mapped.message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  open(preview: FilePreview): void {
    if (!preview.url) return;
    window.open(preview.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }

  private revokeAll(): void {
    for (const item of this.previews()) {
      if (item.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(item.url);
    }
    this.previews.set([]);
  }
}
```

```html
  @if (errorMessage()) { <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div> }

  @if (mode() === 'state') {
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="stateForm" (ngSubmit)="save()"><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Nuevo estado</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="estado">@for (state of states; track state.value) { <option [value]="state.value">{{ state.label }}</option> }</select></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Motivo</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="4" maxlength="500" formControlName="motivo" placeholder="Motivo del cambio"></textarea><app-form-error [control]="stateForm.controls.motivo" fieldLabel="El motivo" [messages]="{ blank: 'El motivo no puede contener solo espacios.' }" /></div><ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container></form>
  } @else if (mode() === 'incident') {

  } @else if (mode() === 'vehicle' || mode() === 'mileage') {
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="vehicleForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      @if (mode() === 'vehicle') { <div class="admin-field"><label>Placa</label><input class="admin-input" maxlength="12" formControlName="placa" autocomplete="off" /><app-form-error [control]="vehicleForm.controls.placa" fieldLabel="La placa" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de vehículo</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipoVehiculo" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option value="">Seleccionar</option>@for (type of vehicleTypes(); track type.code) { <option [value]="type.code">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="vehicleForm.controls.tipoVehiculo" fieldLabel="El tipo de vehículo" /></div> }
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Kilometraje</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.1" formControlName="kilometrajeKm" /><app-form-error [control]="vehicleForm.controls.kilometrajeKm" fieldLabel="El kilometraje" /></div>
      <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

      <div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de bien</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipoBienId" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for (type of assetTypes(); track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.tipoBienId" fieldLabel="El tipo de bien" /></div>
<div class="admin-field"><label>Nombre</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="nombre" maxlength="150" /><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Marca</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="marca" maxlength="80" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Modelo</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="modelo" maxlength="80" /></div><div class="admin-field"><label>Serie</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="serie" maxlength="100" /></div>
      <div class="resource-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Adquisición</span></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Fecha de adquisición</label><input class="admin-input" type="date" [max]="today" formControlName="fechaAdquisicion" /><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAdquisicion" fieldLabel="La fecha de adquisición" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha no puede ser futura.' }" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Monto de adquisición</label><div class="resource-money-field"><select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (currency of currencies(); track currency.code) { <option [value]="currency.code">{{ currency.code }}</option> }</select><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="montoAdquisicion" /></div></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Proveedor</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="proveedorEmpresaId" [disabled]="referencesLoading() || form.controls.uotId.value <= 0"><option [value]="0">Sin proveedor registrado</option>@for (organization of organizations(); track organization.value) { <option [value]="organization.value">{{ organization.label }} @if (organization.description) { · {{ organization.description }} }</option> }</select></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea></div>
      <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
    </form>
  }
  <ng-template #actions><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">@if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }</button></footer></ng-template>
</div></dialog>
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="icon()" /></span>
        <div><p>Ventas</p><h2>{{ title() }}</h2></div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (mode() === 'payment') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="paymentForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Método de pago</label>
          <select
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="metodoPagoId"
            [disabled]="loadingMethods()"
            (change)="onPaymentMethodChange()"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (method of methods(); track method.metodoPagoId) {
              <option [value]="method.metodoPagoId">{{ method.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="paymentForm.controls.metodoPagoId" fieldLabel="El método de pago" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Importe</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" formControlName="importe" />
          <app-form-error [control]="paymentForm.controls.importe" fieldLabel="El importe" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>
            Número de operación
            @if (paymentMethodRequiresOperation()) { * }
          </label>
          <input class="admin-input" maxlength="120" formControlName="numeroOperacion" />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="paymentForm.controls.numeroOperacion"
            fieldLabel="El número de operación"
            [messages]="{ blank: 'El número de operación no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
          />
        </div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else if (mode() === 'receipt') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="receiptForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Tipo</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="tipo">
            <option value="BOLETA">Boleta</option>
            <option value="FACTURA">Factura</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Serie</label>
          <input class="admin-input" maxlength="20" formControlName="serie" />
          <app-form-error [control]="receiptForm.controls.serie" fieldLabel="La serie" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Número</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="1" formControlName="numero" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Documento del cliente</label>
          <input class="admin-input" maxlength="30" formControlName="documentoCliente" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Nombre del cliente</label>
          <input class="admin-input" maxlength="200" formControlName="nombreCliente" />
        </div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="reasonForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        @if (mode() === 'cancel-payment') {
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2 sale-action-current">
            <span>Pago</span>
            <strong>{{ payment()?.metodoPago || 'Pago' }}</strong>
            <small>{{ payment()?.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ payment()?.importe }}</small>
          </div>
        }
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Motivo</label>
          <textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="4" maxlength="500" formControlName="motivo"></textarea>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="reasonForm.controls.motivo"
            fieldLabel="El motivo"
            [messages]="{ blank: 'El motivo no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
          />
        </div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    }

    <ng-template #actions>
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || loadingMethods()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Confirmar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faCreditCard,
  faFileInvoice,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { SalePaymentMethodResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/salePaymentMethodResponse';
import { SalePaymentResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/salePaymentResponse';
import {
  SaleReceiptRequestTipoEnum,
} from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleReceiptRequest';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';

type SaleActionMode = 'payment' | 'receipt' | 'cancel-sale' | 'cancel-payment';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-venta-action-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './venta-action-form.html',
  styleUrl: './venta-action-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentaActionFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly mode = signal<SaleActionMode>('payment');
  readonly saleId = signal(0);
  readonly payment = signal<SalePaymentResponse | null>(null);
  readonly methods = signal<readonly SalePaymentMethodResponse[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly loadingMethods = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly paymentIcon = faCreditCard;
  readonly receiptIcon = faFileInvoice;
  readonly cancelIcon = faBan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly paymentForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    metodoPagoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    importe: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    numeroOperacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
  });

  readonly receiptForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipo: [SaleReceiptRequestTipoEnum.Boleta, [Validators.required]],
    serie: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)],
    ],
    numero: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    documentoCliente: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    nombreCliente: ['', [Validators.maxLength(200)]],
  });

  readonly reasonForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    motivo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(500)],
    ],
  });

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  openPayment(id: number, suggestedAmount = 0): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('payment', id);
    this.paymentForm.reset({
      metodoPagoId: 0,
      importe: Math.max(0, suggestedAmount),
      numeroOperacion: '',
    });
    this.loadMethods();
    return this.show();
  }

  openReceipt(id: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('receipt', id);
    this.receiptForm.reset({
      tipo: SaleReceiptRequestTipoEnum.Boleta,
      serie: '',
      numero: 0,
      documentoCliente: '',
      nombreCliente: '',
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openCancelSale(id: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('cancel-sale', id);
    this.reasonForm.reset({ motivo: '' });
    return this.show();
  }

  openCancelPayment(
    payment: SalePaymentResponse,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('cancel-payment', 0);
    this.payment.set(payment);
    this.reasonForm.reset({ motivo: '' });
    return this.show();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'receipt':
        this.saveReceipt();
        break;
      case 'cancel-sale':
        this.saveCancelSale();
        break;
      case 'cancel-payment':
        this.saveCancelPayment();
        break;
      default:
        this.savePayment();
        break;
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'receipt':
        return 'Emitir comprobante';
      case 'cancel-sale':
        return 'Anular venta';
      case 'cancel-payment':
        return 'Anular pago';
      default:
        return 'Registrar pago';
    }
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'receipt') return this.receiptIcon;
    if (this.mode().startsWith('cancel')) return this.cancelIcon;
    return this.paymentIcon;
  }

  paymentMethodRequiresOperation(): boolean {
    const id = Number(this.paymentForm.controls.metodoPagoId.value);
    return this.methods().find((method) => method.metodoPagoId === id)
      ?.requiereNumeroOperacion === true;
  }

  onPaymentMethodChange(): void {
    const control = this.paymentForm.controls.numeroOperacion;
    if (this.paymentMethodRequiresOperation()) {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }
    control.updateValueAndValidity();
  }

  private savePayment(): void {
    this.onPaymentMethodChange();
    this.paymentForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.paymentForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.paymentForm.getRawValue();
    this.run(
      this.api.pay(this.saleId(), {
        metodoPagoId: Number(raw.metodoPagoId),
        importe: Number(raw.importe),
        numeroOperacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.numeroOperacion),
      }),
      'Pago registrado',
    );
  }

  private saveReceipt(): void {
    this.receiptForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.receiptForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.receiptForm.getRawValue();
    this.run(
      this.api.receipt(this.saleId(), {
        tipo: raw.tipo,
        serie: raw.serie.trim().toUpperCase(),
        numero: Number(raw.numero),
        documentoCliente: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoCliente),
        nombreCliente: normalizeOptionalText(raw.nombreCliente),
      }),
      'Comprobante emitido',
    );
  }

  private saveCancelSale(): void {
    this.reasonForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.reasonForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    this.run(
      this.api.cancel(this.saleId(), {
        motivo: normalizeText(this.reasonForm.controls.motivo.value),
      }),
      'Venta anulada',
    );
  }

  private saveCancelPayment(): void {
    const paymentId = this.payment()?.pagoVentaId;
    this.reasonForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!paymentId || this.reasonForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    this.run(
      this.api.cancelPayment(paymentId, {
        motivo: normalizeText(this.reasonForm.controls.motivo.value),
      }),
      'Pago anulado',
    );
  }

  private loadMethods(): void {
    this.loadingMethods.set(true);
    this.api
      .paymentMethods()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingMethods.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.methods.set(items);
          this.paymentForm.controls.metodoPagoId.setValue(
            items[0]?.metodoPagoId ?? 0,
          );
          this.onPaymentMethodChange();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private run(operation: import('rxjs').Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private prepare(mode: SaleActionMode, saleId: number): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.saleId.set(saleId);
    this.payment.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.payment.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Detalle de venta"
    subtitle="Pagos, comprobante, reserva y entrega."
    [icon]="paymentIcon"
  >
    <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/gestion-comercial/ventas">
      <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
      Volver
    </a>
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
    @if (canPay()) {
      <button *appPermission="'VENTAS_PAGAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="pay()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="paymentIcon" />
        Registrar pago
      </button>
    }
  </app-page-header>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando venta" message="Consultando detalle y pagos." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible cargar la venta.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (detail()?.venta; as sale) {
    <section class="sale-summary-grid">
      <article class="admin-surface sale-summary-main">
        <header>
          <div>
            <p>Venta #{{ sale.ventaId }}</p>
            <h2>{{ sale.cliente || 'Público general' }}</h2>
          </div>
          <span>{{ sale.estadoVenta || '—' }}</span>
        </header>
        <dl>
          <div><dt>UOT</dt><dd>{{ sale.uotNombre || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Almacén</dt><dd>{{ sale.almacen || '—' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Fecha</dt><dd>{{ sale.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Reserva hasta</dt><dd>{{ sale.reservaHasta ? (sale.reservaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </article>

      <article class="admin-surface sale-totals">
        <div><span>Total</span><strong>{{ sale.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ sale.total | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></div>
        <div><span>Pagado</span><strong>{{ sale.pagado | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></div>
        <div><span>Saldo</span><strong>{{ sale.saldo | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></div>
      </article>
    </section>

    <section class="admin-surface sale-detail-card">
      <header><p>Detalle</p><h2>Productos</h2></header>
      <div class="admin-table-scroll">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Producto</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Precio unitario</th><th>Subtotal</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (line of detail()?.detalle || []; track line.detalleVentaId) {
              <tr>
                <td>{{ line.producto || '—' }}</td>
                <td>{{ line.cantidad | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                <td>{{ sale.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ line.precioUnitario | number:'1.2-2' }}</td>
                <td><strong>{{ line.subtotal | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="sale-bottom-grid">
      <article class="admin-surface sale-detail-card">
        <header><p>Pagos</p><h2>Pagos confirmados</h2></header>
        <div class="sale-payments">
          @for (payment of detail()?.pagos || []; track payment.pagoVentaId) {
            <div [class.sale-payment-cancelled]="payment.estadoPago === 'ANULADO'">
              <div>
                <strong>{{ payment.metodoPago || 'Pago' }}</strong>
                <small>{{ payment.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</small>
                @if (payment.numeroOperacion) { <small>Op. {{ payment.numeroOperacion }}</small> }
              </div>
              <strong>{{ payment.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ payment.importe | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong>
              @if (payment.estadoPago !== 'ANULADO') {
                <button
                  *appPermission="'VENTAS_ANULAR'"
                  type="button"
                  class="admin-icon-button"
                  title="Anular pago"
                  (click)="cancelPayment(payment)"
                >
                  <fa-icon [icon]="cancelIcon" />
                </button>
              } @else {
                <span class="sale-cancelled-label">ANULADO</span>
              }
            </div>
          } @empty {
            <p class="sale-empty-copy">Todavía no hay pagos registrados.</p>
          }
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="admin-surface sale-detail-card">
        <header><p>Comprobante</p><h2>Documento de venta</h2></header>
        @if (detail()?.comprobante; as receiptData) {
          <div class="sale-receipt">
            <span>{{ receiptData.tipo }}</span>
            <strong>{{ receiptData.serie }}-{{ receiptData.numero }}</strong>
            <small>{{ receiptData.fechaEmision | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</small>
          </div>
        } @else {
          <p class="sale-empty-copy">Sin comprobante emitido.</p>
          <button
            *appPermission="'VENTAS_COMPROBANTE'"
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
            (click)="receipt()"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="receiptIcon" />
            Emitir comprobante
          </button>
        }
      </article>
    </section>

    <section class="sale-actions">
      @if (canDeliver()) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'VENTAS_ENTREGAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="actionLoading()"
          (click)="deliver()"
        >
          @if (actionLoading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> }
          @else { <fa-icon [icon]="deliverIcon" /> }
          Entregar venta
        </button>
      }
      @if (canCancel()) {
        <button
          *appPermission="'VENTAS_ANULAR'"
          type="button"
          class="admin-danger-button"
          (click)="cancelSale()"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="cancelIcon" />
          Anular venta
        </button>
      }
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-venta-action-form />
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faBan,
  faCreditCard,
  faFileInvoice,
  faRotate,
  faTruck,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { SaleDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleDetailResponse';
import { SalePaymentResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/salePaymentResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';
import { VentaActionFormComponent } from '../venta-action-form/venta-action-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-venta-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    VentaActionFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './venta-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './venta-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentaDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(VentaActionFormComponent)
  private actionForm!: VentaActionFormComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly api = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly actionLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<SaleDetailResponse | null>(null);

  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly paymentIcon = faCreditCard;
  readonly receiptIcon = faFileInvoice;
  readonly deliverIcon = faTruck;
  readonly cancelIcon = faBan;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    const id = this.saleId();
    if (!id) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El identificador de la venta no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .get(id)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async pay(): Promise<void> {
    const sale = this.detail()?.venta;
    if (!sale?.ventaId) return;
    const result = await this.actionForm.openPayment(
      sale.ventaId,
      Math.max(0, sale.saldo ?? 0),
    );
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async receipt(): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.detail()?.venta?.ventaId;
    if (!id) return;
    const result = await this.actionForm.openReceipt(id);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async cancelSale(): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.detail()?.venta?.ventaId;
    if (!id) return;
    const result = await this.actionForm.openCancelSale(id);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async cancelPayment(payment: SalePaymentResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.actionForm.openCancelPayment(payment);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async deliver(): Promise<void> {
    const sale = this.detail()?.venta;
    if (!sale?.ventaId || this.actionLoading()) return;

    const answer = await this.alert.question(
      'Entregar venta',
      'La entrega consumirá definitivamente el stock reservado o disponible. ¿Deseas continuar?',
      'Entregar',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!answer.confirmed) return;

    this.actionLoading.set(true);
    this.api
      .deliver(sale.ventaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Venta entregada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo entregar la venta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  canPay(): boolean {
    const sale = this.detail()?.venta;
    return Boolean(
      sale &&
        (sale.saldo ?? 0) > 0 &&
        sale.estadoVenta !== 'ANULADA' &&
        sale.estadoVenta !== 'ENTREGADA',
    );
  }

  canDeliver(): boolean {
    const sale = this.detail()?.venta;
    return Boolean(
      sale &&
        (sale.saldo ?? 0) === 0 &&
        sale.estadoVenta !== 'ANULADA' &&
        sale.estadoVenta !== 'ENTREGADA',
    );
  }

  canCancel(): boolean {
    const state = this.detail()?.venta?.estadoVenta;
    return Boolean(state && state !== 'ANULADA' && state !== 'ENTREGADA');
  }

  activePayments(): readonly SalePaymentResponse[] {
    return (this.detail()?.pagos ?? []).filter(
      (payment) => payment.estadoPago !== 'ANULADO',
    );
  }

  private saleId(): number | null {
    const id = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
    return Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" /></span>
        <div><p>Ventas</p><h2>Registrar venta o separación</h2></div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="sale-form" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="admin-form-grid">
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>UOT de la venta</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onUnitChange()">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Almacén de salida</label>
          <select class="admin-select" formControlName="almacenId" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
            @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
              <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.almacenId" fieldLabel="El almacén" />
        </div>

        <label class="sale-separate-toggle admin-field-span-2">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            class="checkbox checkbox-sm"
            formControlName="separar"
            (change)="onSeparatedChange()"
          />
          <div>
            <strong>Separar / reservar stock</strong>
            <span>La operación permanece como venta con reserva hasta su vencimiento.</span>
          </div>
        </label>

        @if (form.controls.separar.value) {
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label>Reserva hasta</label>
            <input
              class="admin-input"
              type="datetime-local"
              formControlName="reservaHasta"
            />
            <app-form-error
              [control]="form.controls.reservaHasta"
              fieldLabel="El vencimiento de la reserva"
            />
          </div>
        }

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Cliente persona ID (opcional)</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" formControlName="clientePersonaId" />
        </div>
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Cliente empresa ID (opcional)</label>
          <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" formControlName="clienteEmpresaId" />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Observación</label>
          <textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="2" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section class="sale-lines" formArrayName="detalle">
        <header>
          <div><p>Detalle</p><h3>Productos</h3></div>
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
            [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
            (click)="addLine()"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
            Agregar producto
          </button>
        </header>

        @for (line of lines.controls; track $index; let index = $index) {
          <div class="sale-line" [formGroupName]="index">
            <div class="admin-field">
              <label>Producto</label>
              <select class="admin-select" formControlName="productoId">
                <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
                  <option [value]="product.productoId">
                    {{ product.nombre }} ·
                    @if (product.precioVigente != null) {
                      {{ product.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ product.precioVigente }}
                    } @else {
                      sin precio
                    }
                  </option>
                }
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="admin-field">
              <label>Cantidad</label>
              <input
                class="admin-input"
                type="number"
                min="0.001"
                step="0.001"
                formControlName="cantidad"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-icon-button"
              title="Quitar producto"
              [disabled]="lines.length <= 1"
              (click)="removeLine(index)"
            >
              <fa-icon [icon]="removeIcon" />
            </button>
          </div>
        }
      </section>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Registrando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Registrar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormArray,
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCartPlus,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPlus,
  faTrashCan,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  localDateTimeInputNow,
  normalizeOptionalText,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-venta-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './venta-form.html',
  styleUrl: './venta-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentaFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly sales = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faCartPlus;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    almacenId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    separar: [false],
    reservaHasta: [''],
    clientePersonaId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    clienteEmpresaId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.form.controls.detalle;
  }

  open(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());

    const uotId = this.uot.isSpecific()
      ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0
      : preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0
        ? preferredUotId
        : 0;

    this.form.reset({
      uotId,
      almacenId: 0,
      separar: false,
      reservaHasta: '',
      clientePersonaId: 0,
      clienteEmpresaId: 0,
      observacion: '',
    });

    this.form.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.isSpecific() ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadReferences(uotId);
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  onUnitChange(): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.controls.uotId.value);
    this.form.controls.almacenId.setValue(0);
    this.loadReferences(uotId);
  }

  onSeparatedChange(): void {
    const separated = this.form.controls.separar.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.reservaHasta;

    if (separated) {
      control.setValidators([Validators.required]);
      if (!control.value) {
        const now = new Date();
        now.setHours(now.getHours() + 24);
        const local = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
        control.setValue(local.toISOString().slice(0, 16));
      }
    } else {
      control.clearValidators();
      control.setValue('');
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    this.onSeparatedChange();
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro de la misma venta.');
      return;
    }

    if (raw.separar && raw.reservaHasta) {
      const reserveUntil = new Date(raw.reservaHasta);
      if (!Number.isFinite(reserveUntil.getTime()) || reserveUntil <= new Date()) {
        this.errorMessage.set('La reserva debe vencer en una fecha futura.');
        return;
      }
    }

    const personId = Number(raw.clientePersonaId);
    const companyId = Number(raw.clienteEmpresaId);

    if (personId > 0 && companyId > 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona un solo tipo de cliente.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.sales
      .create({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        clientePersonaId: personId > 0 ? personId : undefined,
        clienteEmpresaId: companyId > 0 ? companyId : undefined,
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
        })),
        separar: raw.separar,
        reservaHasta: raw.separar ? raw.reservaHasta : undefined,
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          const id =
            value && typeof value === 'object' && 'ventaId' in value
              ? Number((value as { ventaId?: number }).ventaId)
              : 0;
          this.toast.success(raw.separar ? 'Separación registrada' : 'Venta registrada');
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo registrar la venta', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private loadReferences(uotId: number): void {
    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.products.set([]);
      this.warehouses.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      products: this.resources.listAllProducts(uotId),
      warehouses: this.resources.listWarehouses(uotId),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ products, warehouses }) => {
          this.products.set(products.filter((item) => item.estado !== false));
          this.warehouses.set(
            warehouses.filter(
              (item) => item.estado !== false && item.permiteSalida !== false,
            ),
          );
          this.form.controls.almacenId.setValue(
            this.warehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
          );
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    });
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Ventas"
    [subtitle]="uot.isGeneral() ? 'Vista general de ventas de tus UOT.' : 'Ventas y separaciones de ' + (uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'la UOT activa') + '.'" 
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >

      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
    <button *appPermission="'VENTAS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
      Nueva venta
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface sales-filters">
    @if (uot.isGeneral()) {
      <label>
        <span>Filtrar por UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Estado</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="onStateChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option value="">Todos</option>
        <option value="REGISTRADA">Registrada</option>
        <option value="SEPARADA">Separada</option>
        <option value="PAGO_PARCIAL">Pago parcial</option>
        <option value="PAGADA">Pagada</option>
        <option value="ENTREGADA">Entregada</option>
        <option value="ANULADA">Anulada</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="sales-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <input
        class="admin-input"
        type="search"
        placeholder="Venta, cliente, almacén..."
        [value]="search()"
        (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
      />
    </label>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando ventas" message="Consultando las operaciones del contexto actual." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar las ventas.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (filtered().length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin ventas" message="No existen ventas que coincidan con los filtros." />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface sales-table-shell">
      <div class="admin-table-scroll">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Venta</th>
              @if (uot.isGeneral()) { <th>UOT</th> }
              <th>Fecha</th>
              <th>Cliente</th>
              <th>Almacén</th>
              <th>Estado</th>
              <th>Total</th>
              <th>Pagado</th>
              <th>Saldo</th>
              <th></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of filtered(); track item.ventaId) {
              <tr>
                <td><strong>#{{ item.ventaId }}</strong></td>
                @if (uot.isGeneral()) { <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td> }
                <td>{{ item.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.cliente || 'Público general' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.almacen || '—' }}</td>
                <td><span class="sale-state" [class]="stateClass(item.estadoVenta)">{{ stateLabel(item.estadoVenta) }}</span></td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.total | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                <td>{{ item.pagado | number:'1.2-2' }}</td>
                <td><strong>{{ item.saldo | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong></td>
                <td>
                  <a
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    [routerLink]="['/gestion-comercial/ventas', item.ventaId]"
                    title="Ver detalle"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                  </a>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  }
</div>

<app-venta-form />
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCartShopping,
  faEye,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { SaleSummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleSummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { VentasApiService } from '../../../../../shared/ventas-api.service';
import { VentaFormComponent } from '../venta-form/venta-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-ventas-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    VentaFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './ventas-list.html',
  styleUrl: './ventas-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class VentasListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(VentaFormComponent) private form!: VentaFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(VentasApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly sales = signal<readonly SaleSummaryResponse[]>([]);
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly search = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faCartShopping;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;

  readonly filtered = computed(() => {
    const query = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return this.sales();
    return this.sales().filter((item) =>
      [
        String(item.ventaId ?? ''),
        item.cliente,
        item.almacen,
        item.uotNombre,
      ].some((value) => (value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query)),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.isGeneral() ? null : this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.isGeneral()
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .list(unitId, this.stateFilter() || undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.sales.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load();
  }

  onStateChange(value: string): void {
    this.stateFilter.set(value);
    this.load();
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open(this.uot.isGeneral() ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined);
    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
      if (result.value) {
        void this.router.navigate(['/gestion-comercial/ventas', result.value]);
      }
    }
  }

  stateClass(state?: string): string {
    const value = (state ?? '').toUpperCase();
    if (value === 'ENTREGADA' || value === 'PAGADA') return 'sale-state sale-state--ok';
    if (value === 'ANULADA') return 'sale-state sale-state--muted';
    if (value === 'PAGO_PARCIAL') return 'sale-state sale-state--warning';
    return 'sale-state sale-state--info';
  }

  stateLabel(state?: string): string {
    return (state ?? 'SIN ESTADO').replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { VentasService } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/ventas.service';
import { SaleCancelRequest } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleCancelRequest';
import { SaleCreateRequest } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleCreateRequest';
import { SaleDetailResponse } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleDetailResponse';
import { SalePaymentCancelRequest } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/salePaymentCancelRequest';
import { SalePaymentMethodResponse } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/salePaymentMethodResponse';
import { SalePaymentRequest } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/salePaymentRequest';
import { SaleReceiptRequest } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleReceiptRequest';
import { SaleSummaryResponse } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleSummaryResponse';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class VentasApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(VentasService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(uotId?: number, estado?: string) {
    return this.api
      .ventasListar({ uotId, estado }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<SaleSummaryResponse[]>(response) ?? [],
        ),
      );
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .ventasVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse<SaleDetailResponse>(response)));
  }

  paymentMethods() {
    return this.api
      .ventasMetodosPagoListar({}, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<SalePaymentMethodResponse[]>(response) ?? [],
        ),
      );
  }

  create(body: SaleCreateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .ventasCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          saleCreateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  pay(id: number, body: SalePaymentRequest) {
    return this.api
      .ventasRegistrarPago(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          salePaymentRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  cancelPayment(id: number, body: SalePaymentCancelRequest) {
    return this.api
      .ventasPagoAnular(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          salePaymentCancelRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  deliver(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .ventasEntregar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  cancel(id: number, body: SaleCancelRequest) {
    return this.api
      .ventasAnular(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          saleCancelRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  receipt(id: number, body: SaleReceiptRequest) {
    return this.api
      .ventasComprobanteEmitir(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          saleReceiptRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }
}
```

```typescript
  { id: -6103, code: 'OPERATIVOS', label: 'Operativos', route: '/gestion-comercial/operativos', icon: 'truck', order: 30, permission: 'OPERATIVOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6104, code: 'ENTREGAS', label: 'Entregas', route: '/gestion-comercial/entregas', icon: 'boxes-stacked', order: 40, permission: 'ENTREGAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },

];

const ROUTES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  INICIO: '/inicio',
  DASHBOARD: '/inicio',
  ORGANIZACIONES: '/administracion/organizaciones',
  ROLES: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  ROLES_PERMISOS: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  CATALOGOS: '/administracion/catalogos',
  TIPOS_BIEN: '/administracion/catalogos',
  EMPLEADOS: '/administracion/empleados',
  USUARIOS: '/administracion/usuarios',
  UOT: '/administracion/uot',
  DOCUMENTOS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  EVIDENCIAS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  INVENTARIO: '/recursos/inventario-vehiculos',
  PRODUCTOS: '/recursos/productos',
  ALMACENES: '/recursos/almacenes',
  RECURSOS: '/recursos/programados',
  RECURSOS_PROGRAMADOS: '/recursos/programados',
  PRODUCTORES: '/gestion-tecnica/productores',
  PREDIOS: '/gestion-tecnica/predios',
  CULTIVOS: '/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos',
  CENSOS: '/gestion-tecnica/censos',
  SALIDAS: '/gestion-tecnica/salidas',
  VISITAS: '/gestion-tecnica/visitas',
  EVALUACIONES: '/gestion-tecnica/evaluaciones',
  SANIDAD: '/gestion-tecnica/sanidad',
  PRODUCCION: '/gestion-tecnica/produccion',
  CAMPANIAS: '/gestion-comercial/campanias',
  PARTICIPANTES: '/gestion-comercial/participantes',
  OPERATIVOS: '/gestion-comercial/operativos',
  ENTREGAS: '/gestion-comercial/entregas',
  JABAS: '/gestion-comercial/jabas',
  PRECIOS: '/gestion-comercial/precios',
  VENTAS: '/gestion-comercial/ventas',
  INCIDENCIAS: '/gestion-comercial/incidencias',
  AJUSTES_PRECIO: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  AJUSTES: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  GASTOS: '/finanzas/gastos',
  LIQUIDACIONES: '/finanzas/liquidaciones',
  PAGOS: '/finanzas/pagos',
  COBROS: '/finanzas/cobros',
  REPORTES: '/reportes',
  AUDITORIA: '/auditoria',
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NavigationService {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly items = computed(() => this.withFrontendEntries(this.buildTree(this.accessStore.modules())));

  private buildTree(modules: readonly AccessModule[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    const moduleById = new Map(modules.map((module) => [module.moduloId, module] as const));
    const includedIds = new Set<number>();

    for (const module of modules) {
      if (!module.visibleMenu) continue;
      includedIds.add(module.moduloId);
      let parentId = module.moduloPadreId;
      while (parentId !== null) {
        const parent = moduleById.get(parentId);
        if (!parent || includedIds.has(parent.moduloId)) break;
        includedIds.add(parent.moduloId);
        parentId = parent.moduloPadreId;
      }
    }

    const byParent = new Map<number | null, AccessModule[]>();
    for (const module of modules.filter((item) => includedIds.has(item.moduloId))) {
      const key = module.moduloPadreId !== null && includedIds.has(module.moduloPadreId)
        ? module.moduloPadreId
        : null;
      const bucket = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
      bucket.push(module);
      byParent.set(key, bucket);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null): NavigationItem[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden || a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre))
        .map((module) => ({
          id: module.moduloId,
          code: module.codigo,
          label: module.nombre,
          route: this.normalizedRoute(module),
          icon: module.icono,
          order: module.orden,
          children: build(module.moduloId),
        }));

    return build(null);
  }

  private withFrontendEntries(items: readonly NavigationItem[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    let result = [...items];
    for (const entry of FRONTEND_ENTRIES) {
      if (!this.hasPermission(entry.permission) || this.containsCode(result, entry.code)) continue;
      result = this.insertEntry(result, entry);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private insertEntry(items: readonly NavigationItem[], entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem[] {
    const groupMatcher = entry.group === 'ADMIN'
      ? (code: string) => code.includes('ADMIN')
      : (code: string) => code.includes('COMERCIAL');
    let inserted = false;

    const visit = (nodes: readonly NavigationItem[]): NavigationItem[] => nodes.map((node) => {
      let children = visit(node.children);
      if (!inserted && groupMatcher(node.code.trim().toUpperCase())) {
        children = [...children, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
        inserted = true;
      }
      return { ...node, children };
    });

    const decorated = visit(items);
    return inserted
      ? decorated
      : [...decorated, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
  }

  private entryNode(entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem {
    return { id: entry.id, code: entry.code, label: entry.label, route: entry.route, icon: entry.icon, order: entry.order, children: [] };
  }

  private containsCode(items: readonly NavigationItem[], code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return items.some((item) => item.code.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized || this.containsCode(item.children, normalized));
  }

  private hasPermission(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return this.accessStore.permissions().some((permission) => permission.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized);
  }

  private normalizedRoute(module: AccessModule): string | null {
    if (!module.visibleMenu) return null;
    const code = module.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();
    return ROUTES[code] ?? module.ruta;
  }
}
```
