```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCoins, faFloppyDisk, faPlus, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { normalizeOptionalText, normalizeText, notBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';
type ProductPriceTarget = ResourceProductListItemResponse | ResourceProductDetailResponse;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent, NgTemplateOutlet],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true }) private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ProductPriceTarget | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly categories = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly currencies = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(700)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: this.resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId),
      codigo: '', nombre: '', descripcion: '', unidadMedida: '', categoria: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId[this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' ? 'disable' : 'enable']({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(item: ProductPriceTarget, uotId: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: uotId,
      precio: item.precioVigente ?? 0,
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });
    this.priceForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.loadReferences();
    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() { return this.uot.memberships(); }
  onCreateUotChange(): void { this.loadSuggestedCode(true); }

  uotLabel(form: 'create' | 'price' = 'create'): string {
    const id = form === 'price'
      ? Number(this.priceForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId)
      : Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);
    return this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void { if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
  save(): void { this.mode() === 'price' ? this.savePrice() : this.saveProduct(); }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;
    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) { this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.createProduct({
      uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
      codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
      nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
      descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
      unidadMedida: raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
      categoria: raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => { this.toast.success('Producto registrado'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); },
      error: (error) => this.fail(error),
    });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (!product?.productoId || this.priceForm.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) return;
    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();
    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) { this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.api.versionProductPrice(product.productoId, {
      uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
      uotPrecioId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
      precio: Number(raw.precio),
      moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => { this.toast.success('Nueva versión de precio registrada'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); },
      error: (error) => this.fail(error),
    });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) return;
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    forkJoin({
      units: this.refs.catalog('UNIDAD_MEDIDA'),
      categories: this.refs.catalog('CATEGORIA_PRODUCTO'),
      currencies: this.refs.catalog('MONEDA'),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: ({ units, categories, currencies }) => {
        this.units.set(units.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
        this.categories.set(categories.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
        this.currencies.set(currencies.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })));
        if (this.mode() === 'create' && !this.createForm.controls.unidadMedida.value) {
          this.createForm.controls.unidadMedida.setValue(this.units()[0]?.code ?? 'UND');
        }
        const currency = this.priceForm.controls.moneda.value;
        if (!this.currencies().some((item) => item.code === currency)) {
          this.priceForm.controls.moneda.setValue(this.currencies()[0]?.code ?? 'PEN');
        }
      },
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  private resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId?: number): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0 ? preferredUotId : 0;
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;
    if (uotId <= 0) { if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false }); return; }
    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;
    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api.suggestCode(uotId, 'PRODUCTO').pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (code) => { if (code) { control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false }); control.markAsPristine(); } },
      error: () => { if (force) { control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false }); control.markAsPristine(); } },
    });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
    this.errorMessage.set(message); this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
  }
  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> { this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolver = resolve; }); }
  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void { if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(result); this.resolver = null; this.current.set(null); }
}
```

```html
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" /></button>
    </header>
    @if (errorMessage()) { <div class="admin-inline-error">{{ errorMessage() }}</div> }

    @if (mode() === 'create') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="createForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>UOT del producto</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="uotContextoId" (change)="onCreateUotChange()"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>@for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) { <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option> }</select><small>En vista general puede elegir la UOT del registro.</small><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.uotContextoId" fieldLabel="La UOT" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field"><label>Código</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="codigo" maxlength="50" placeholder="DESCO propone uno automáticamente" autocomplete="off" /><small>@if (codeLoading()) { Generando código sugerido... } @else { Puede modificar el código sugerido. }</small><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.codigo" fieldLabel="El código" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field"><label>Unidad de medida</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="unidadMedida" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (unit of units(); track unit.code) { <option [value]="unit.code">{{ unit.label }} · {{ unit.code }}</option> }</select><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.unidadMedida" fieldLabel="La unidad de medida" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Nombre</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="nombre" maxlength="180" /><app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Categoría</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="categoria" [disabled]="referencesLoading()"><option value="">Sin categoría</option>@for (category of categories(); track category.code) { <option [value]="category.code">{{ category.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Descripción</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="700" formControlName="descripcion"></textarea></div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    } @else {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="priceForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2 product-current"><span>Producto</span><strong>{{ current()?.nombre }}</strong><small>{{ current()?.codigo }} · {{ uotLabel('price') }}</small></div>
        <div class="admin-field"><label>Precio</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" formControlName="precio" /><app-form-error [control]="priceForm.controls.precio" fieldLabel="El precio" /></div>
        <div class="admin-field"><label>Moneda</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda" [disabled]="referencesLoading()">@for (currency of currencies(); track currency.code) { <option [value]="currency.code">{{ currency.code }} · {{ currency.label }}</option> }</select></div>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    }

    <ng-template #actions><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()">@if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }</button></footer></ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
export class ResourceApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(RecursosService);

  suggestCode(uotId: number, tipo: ResourceCodeKind) {
    return this.api
      .recursosCodigoSugerido({ uotId, tipo }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })

      .recursosBienesListar(

          uotId: query.uotId,
          buscar: query.search?.trim() || undefined,
          tipoBienId: query.typeId,
          estado: query.state?.trim() || undefined,
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,

        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },

      .pipe(

  private mapProductPriceHistory(item: ResourceProductPriceHistoryResponse): ResourceProductPriceHistory {
    return {
      productoPrecioId: Number(item.productoPrecioId ?? 0),
      productoId: Number(item.productoId ?? 0),
      productoCodigo: item.productoCodigo ?? null,
      producto: item.producto ?? null,
      uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? 0),
      uotCodigo: item.uotCodigo ?? null,
      uotNombre: item.uotNombre ?? null,

      version: Number(item.version ?? 0),

      fechaHasta: item.fechaHasta ?? null,
      vigente: item.vigente === true,

  private mapProductPage(
    value: PageResponseResourceProductListItemResponse | undefined,
    requestedPage: number,
    requestedSize: number,

      items: [...(value?.items ?? [])],
      page: Number(value?.pagina ?? requestedPage),
      size: Number(value?.tamanio ?? requestedSize),
      totalRecords: Number(value?.totalRegistros ?? 0),
      totalPages: Number(value?.totalPaginas ?? 0),
    };
  }

  private mapAssetPage(
    value: PageResponseResourceAssetListItemResponse | undefined,
    requestedPage: number,
    requestedSize: number,

      size: Number(value?.tamanio ?? requestedSize),

    };
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { forkJoin, map } from 'rxjs';

import { POSVentasService } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/pOSVentas.service';
import { SaleCreateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleCreateRequest';
import { SaleManualCustomerRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleManualCustomerRequest';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { IdentityResolverService } from '../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import {
  PosCustomer,
  PosCustomerResolution,
  PosDocumentType,
  PosManualCustomerInput,
  PosPaymentMethod,
  PosProduct,
  PosSaleCreateInput,
  PosSaleSnapshot,
  PosWarehouse,
  PosCustomerType,
} from '../../../domain/pos.model';
import { PosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/pos.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class PosHttpAdapter implements PosGateway {
  private readonly sales = inject(POSVentasService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);

  listWarehouses(uotId: number) {
    return this.resources
      .listWarehouses(uotId)
      .pipe(
        map((items) =>
          items
            .filter(
              (item) =>
                item.estado !== false
                && item.permiteSalida !== false
                && Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) > 0,
            )
            .map(
              (item): PosWarehouse => ({
                warehouseId: Number(item.almacenId),
                code: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
                name: item.nombre?.trim() ?? 'Almacén',
              }),
            )
            .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
        ),
      );
  }

  listCatalog(uotId: number, warehouseId: number) {
    return forkJoin({
      products: this.resources.listAllProducts(uotId),
      stock: this.resources.listStock(uotId, warehouseId),
    }).pipe(
      map(({ products, stock }) => {
        const stockByProduct = new Map(
          stock
            .filter(
              (item) =>
                Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) === warehouseId
                && Number(item.productoId ?? 0) > 0,
            )
            .map(
              (item) => [
                Number(item.productoId),
                Number(item.stockDisponible ?? 0),
              ] as const,
            ),
        );

        return products
          .map((item): PosProduct => ({
            productId: Number(item.productoId ?? 0),
            code: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
            name: item.nombre?.trim() ?? 'Producto',
            description: item.descripcion?.trim() || null,
            unit:
              item.unidadMedidaNombre?.trim()
              || item.unidadMedidaCodigo?.trim()
              || 'UND',
            category:
              item.categoriaNombre?.trim()
              || item.categoriaCodigo?.trim()
              || null,
            unitPrice: Number(item.precioVigente ?? 0),
            initialPrice: Number(item.precioInicial ?? 0),
            currency: item.moneda?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
            stockAvailable:
              stockByProduct.get(Number(item.productoId ?? 0)) ?? 0,
            imageFileId:
              Number(item.archivoPrincipalId ?? 0) > 0
                ? Number(item.archivoPrincipalId)
                : null,
            imageUrl: item.imagenPrincipalUrl?.trim() || null,
          }))
          .filter(
            (item) =>
              item.productId > 0
              && item.unitPrice > 0
              && item.stockAvailable > 0,
          )
          .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
      }),
    );
  }

  listPaymentMethods() {
    return this.sales
      .ventasMetodosPagoListar(
        {},
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            (unwrapApiResponse(response) ?? [])
              .map(
                (item): PosPaymentMethod => ({
                  paymentMethodId: Number(item.metodoPagoId ?? 0),
                  code: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
                  name: item.nombre?.trim() ?? 'Método de pago',
                  requiresOperationNumber:
                    item.requiereNumeroOperacion === true,
                }),
              )
              .filter((item) => item.paymentMethodId > 0),
        ),
      );
  }

  resolveCustomer(
    type: PosCustomerType,
    documentType: PosDocumentType,
    documentNumber: string,
  ) {
    return this.identities
      .resolve(
        type,
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
      )
      .pipe(
        map((result): PosCustomerResolution => {
          const customer =
            result.found && result.entityId
              ? {
                  type,
                  personId:
                    type === 'PERSONA'
                      ? result.entityId
                      : null,
                  companyId:
                    type === 'EMPRESA'
                      ? result.entityId
                      : null,
                  documentType,
                  documentNumber:
                    result.documentNumber ?? documentNumber,
                  displayName:
                    type === 'EMPRESA'
                      ? result.businessName
                        ?? result.message
                        ?? documentNumber
                      : this.personName(result)
                        || result.message
                        || documentNumber,
                }
              : null;

          return {
            customer,
            found: result.found,
            manualEntryAllowed: result.manualEntryAllowed,
            message: result.message,
          };
        }),
      );
  }

  registerManualCustomer(input: PosManualCustomerInput) {
    const body: SaleManualCustomerRequest = {
      uotId: input.uotId,
      tipoCliente: input.type,
      tipoDocumento: input.documentType,
      numeroDocumento: input.documentNumber,
      nombres: input.names,
      apellidoPaterno: input.paternalSurname,
      apellidoMaterno: input.maternalSurname,
      razonSocial: input.businessName,
      telefono: input.phone,
      correo: input.email,
    };

    return this.sales
      .ventasClientesRegistrarManual(
        {
          saleManualCustomerRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response): PosCustomer => {
          const item = unwrapApiResponse(response);

          if (!item) {
            throw new Error(
              'El backend no devolvió el cliente registrado.',
            );
          }

          const personId =
            Number(item.clientePersonaId ?? 0) > 0
              ? Number(item.clientePersonaId)
              : null;
          const companyId =
            Number(item.clienteEmpresaId ?? 0) > 0
              ? Number(item.clienteEmpresaId)
              : null;

          return {
            type: item.tipoCliente === 'EMPRESA'
              ? 'EMPRESA'
              : 'PERSONA',
            personId,
            companyId,
            documentType:
              item.tipoDocumento === 'RUC'
                ? 'RUC'
                : 'DNI',
            documentNumber:
              item.numeroDocumento?.trim()
              || input.documentNumber,
            displayName:
              item.nombreCliente?.trim()
              || input.businessName
              || [
                input.names,
                input.paternalSurname,
                input.maternalSurname,
              ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' ')
              || input.documentNumber,
          };
        }),
      );
  }

  createSale(
    input: PosSaleCreateInput,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ) {
    const body: SaleCreateRequest = {
      uotId: input.uotId,
      almacenId: input.warehouseId,
      clientePersonaId:
        input.customer.personId ?? undefined,
      clienteEmpresaId:
        input.customer.companyId ?? undefined,
      detalle: input.items.map((item) => ({
        productoId: item.productId,
        cantidad: item.quantity,
      })),
      separar: false,
      observacion: input.observation?.trim() || undefined,
    };

    return this.sales
      .ventasCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
          saleCreateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => {
          const saleId =
            Number(
              unwrapApiResponse(response)?.ventaId ?? 0,
            );

          if (saleId <= 0) {
            throw new Error(
              'El backend no devolvió el identificador de la venta.',
            );
          }

          return saleId;
        }),
      );
  }

  getSale(saleId: number) {
    return this.sales
      .ventasVer(
        { id: saleId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response): PosSaleSnapshot => {
          const detail = unwrapApiResponse(response);
          const sale = detail?.venta;

          if (!sale?.ventaId) {
            throw new Error(
              'No fue posible recuperar la venta.',
            );
          }

          return {
            saleId: Number(sale.ventaId),
            total: Number(sale.total ?? 0),
            paid: Number(sale.pagado ?? 0),
            balance: Number(sale.saldo ?? 0),
            state: sale.estadoVenta?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'REGISTRADA',
            currency: sale.moneda?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
          };
        }),
      );
  }

  paySale(
    saleId: number,
    paymentMethodId: number,
    amount: number,
    operationNumber: string | undefined,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ) {
    return this.sales
      .ventasRegistrarPago(
        {
          id: saleId,
          xIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
          salePaymentRequest: {
            metodoPagoId: paymentMethodId,
            importe: amount,
            numeroOperacion:
              operationNumber?.trim() || undefined,
          },
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map(() => void 0));
  }

  deliverSale(
    saleId: number,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ) {
    return this.sales
      .ventasEntregar(
        {
          id: saleId,
          xIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map(() => void 0));
  }

  private personName(
    result: {
      names: string | null;
      paternalSurname: string | null;
      maternalSurname: string | null;
    },
  ): string {
    return [
      result.names,
      result.paternalSurname,
      result.maternalSurname,
    ]
      .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value?.trim()))
      .join(' ')
      .trim();
  }
}
```

```typescript
export class PosPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('manualCustomerDialog', { static: true })
  private readonly manualCustomerDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly loadPos = inject(CargarPosUseCase);
  private readonly resolveCustomerUseCase = inject(ResolverClientePosUseCase);

  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly contextLoading = signal(false);

  readonly customerLoading = signal(false);

  readonly catalogError = signal<string | null>(null);

    code: string;
    name: string;
  }[]>([]);
  readonly paymentMethods = signal<readonly PosPaymentMethod[]>([]);
  readonly catalog = signal<readonly PosProduct[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faCashRegister;
  readonly cartIcon = faCartShopping;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly minusIcon = faMinus;
  readonly trashIcon = faTrash;
  readonly customerIcon = faUserCheck;
  readonly paymentIcon = faCreditCard;
  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly filteredCatalog = computed(() => {
    const term = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) {
      return this.catalog();
    }

    return this.catalog().filter((product) =>
      [
        product.code,
        product.name,
        product.description ?? '',
        product.category ?? '',
      ].some((value) =>
        value.toLowerCase().includes(term),
      ),
    );
  });

  readonly customerForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    type: ['PERSONA' as PosCustomerType, [Validators.required]],
    documentType: ['DNI' as PosDocumentType, [Validators.required]],
    documentNumber: ['', [Validators.required]],
  });

  readonly manualForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    names: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    paternalSurname: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    maternalSurname: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    businessName: ['', [Validators.maxLength(200)]],
    phone: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    email: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
  });

  readonly paymentForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    paymentMethodId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    operationNumber: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observation: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const uotId = this.uot.selectedId();
    const userId = this.access.user()?.usuarioId ?? 0;

    if (
      this.uot.isGeneral()
      || !uotId
      || uotId <= 0
      || userId <= 0
    ) {
      this.contextError.set(
        'El POS requiere una UOT específica. Seleccione una UOT antes de vender.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.cart.initialize(userId, uotId);
    this.loadContext();
  }

  loadContext(): void {
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();

    if (!uotId) {
      return;
    }

    this.contextLoading.set(true);
    this.contextError.set(null);

    this.loadPos
      .context(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.contextLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ warehouses, paymentMethods }) => {
          this.warehouses.set(warehouses);
          this.paymentMethods.set(paymentMethods);

          const paymentId =
            this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value;

          if (
            !paymentMethods.some(
              (item) => item.paymentMethodId === paymentId,
            )
          ) {
            this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.setValue(
              paymentMethods[0]?.paymentMethodId ?? 0,
            );
          }

          const currentWarehouseId = this.cart.warehouseId();
          const currentExists = warehouses.some(
            (item) => item.warehouseId === currentWarehouseId,
          );

          if (currentExists && currentWarehouseId) {
            this.loadCatalog();
            return;
          }

          if (this.cart.items().length > 0) {
            this.contextError.set(
              'El almacén guardado en el carrito ya no está disponible. No se modificó el borrador para evitar inconsistencias.',
            );
            return;
          }

          const firstWarehouseId =
            warehouses[0]?.warehouseId ?? 0;

          if (firstWarehouseId > 0) {
            this.cart.setWarehouse(firstWarehouseId);
            this.loadCatalog();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.contextError.set(
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  loadCatalog(): void {
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();
    const warehouseId = this.cart.warehouseId();

    if (!uotId || !warehouseId) {
      this.catalog.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.catalogLoading.set(true);
    this.catalogError.set(null);

    this.loadPos
      .catalog(uotId, warehouseId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.catalogLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (products) => {
          this.catalog.set(products);
          this.cart.syncCatalog(products);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.catalogError.set(
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  changeWarehouse(value: string): void {
    const warehouseId = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(warehouseId) || warehouseId <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (!this.cart.setWarehouse(warehouseId)) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Carrito activo',
        'Vacíe el carrito antes de cambiar de almacén.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.loadCatalog();
  }

  add(product: PosProduct): void {
    const error = this.cart.add(product);

    if (error) {
      this.toast.warning('No se agregó el producto', error);
    }
  }

  increment(productId: number): void {
    const item = this.cart.items().find(
      (candidate) => candidate.productId === productId,
    );

    if (!item) {
      return;
    }

    const error = this.cart.setQuantity(
      productId,
      item.quantity + 1,
    );

    if (error) {
      this.toast.warning('Cantidad no disponible', error);
    }
  }

  decrement(productId: number): void {
    const item = this.cart.items().find(
      (candidate) => candidate.productId === productId,
    );

    if (!item) {
      return;
    }

    this.cart.setQuantity(
      productId,
      item.quantity - 1,
    );
  }

  changeQuantity(productId: number, value: string): void {
    const quantity = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity)) {
      return;
    }

    const error = this.cart.setQuantity(
      productId,
      quantity,
    );

    if (error) {
      this.toast.warning('Cantidad no disponible', error);
    }
  }

  clearCart(): void {
    if (!this.cart.clearEditableCart()) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Venta en proceso',
        'No se puede vaciar un carrito que ya inició el registro de la venta.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.customerMessage.set(null);
    this.checkoutError.set(null);
  }

  onCustomerTypeChange(): void {
    const type = this.customerForm.controls.type.value;

    if (type === 'EMPRESA') {
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.setValue('RUC');
    } else if (
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value !== 'DNI'
      && this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value !== 'RUC'
    ) {
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.setValue('DNI');
    }

    this.resetCustomerSelection();
  }

  onCustomerDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    if (this.customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA') {
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.setValue('RUC');
    }

    this.resetCustomerSelection();
  }

  onCustomerDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value;
    const control = this.customerForm.controls.documentNumber;
    const sanitized = control.value.replace(/\D+/g, '').slice(
      0,
      type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11,
    );

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    this.resetCustomerSelection();
  }

  resolveCustomer(): void {
    const type = this.customerForm.controls.type.value;
    const documentType =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value;
    const documentNumber =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentNumber.value.trim();

    if (
      !this.validDocument(
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
      )
    ) {
      this.customerMessage.set(
        documentType === 'DNI'
          ? 'El DNI debe contener 8 dígitos.'
          : 'El RUC debe contener 11 dígitos.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.customerLoading.set(true);
    this.customerMessage.set(null);

    this.resolveCustomerUseCase
      .resolve(
        type,
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
      )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.customerLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.customerMessage.set(result.message);

          if (result.customer) {
            this.cart.setCustomer(result.customer);
            this.toast.success(
              'Cliente seleccionado',
              result.customer.displayName,
            );
            return;
          }

          if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
            this.openManualCustomer();
            return;
          }

          this.cart.setCustomer(null);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.customerMessage.set(message);
          this.cart.setCustomer(null);
        },
      });
  }

  openManualCustomer(): void {
    if (this.cart.locked()) {
      return;
    }

    this.manualForm.reset({
      names: '',
      paternalSurname: '',
      maternalSurname: '',
      businessName: '',
      phone: '',
      email: '',
    });

    this.manualCustomerDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
  }

  closeManualCustomer(): void {
    if (
      !this.manualSaving()
      && this.manualCustomerDialog.nativeElement.open
    ) {
      this.manualCustomerDialog.nativeElement.close();
    }
  }

  saveManualCustomer(): void {
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();

    if (!uotId || this.manualSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.manualForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.manualForm.invalid) {
      return;
    }

    const type = this.customerForm.controls.type.value;
    const documentType =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value;
    const documentNumber =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentNumber.value.trim();
    const raw = this.manualForm.getRawValue();

    if (type === 'PERSONA') {
      if (!raw.names.trim() || !raw.paternalSurname.trim()) {
        this.toast.warning(
          'Datos incompletos',
          'Ingrese nombres y apellido paterno del cliente.',
        );
        return;
      }
    } else if (!raw.businessName.trim()) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Datos incompletos',
        'Ingrese la razón social del cliente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.manualSaving.set(true);

    this.resolveCustomerUseCase
      .registerManual({
        uotId,
        type,
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
        names: raw.names.trim() || undefined,
        paternalSurname:
          raw.paternalSurname.trim() || undefined,
        maternalSurname:
          raw.maternalSurname.trim() || undefined,
        businessName:
          raw.businessName.trim() || undefined,
        phone: raw.phone.trim() || undefined,
        email:
          raw.email.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.manualSaving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (customer) => {
          this.cart.setCustomer(customer);
          this.customerMessage.set(
            'Cliente registrado y seleccionado para la venta.',
          );
          this.closeManualCustomer();
          this.toast.success(
            'Cliente registrado',
            customer.displayName,
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo registrar el cliente',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  checkout(): void {
    const draft = this.cart.draft();
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();
    const warehouseId = this.cart.warehouseId();
    const customer = this.cart.customer();
    const paymentMethodId =
      Number(this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value);
    const method = this.selectedPaymentMethod();

    this.checkoutError.set(null);

    if (
      !draft
      || !uotId
      || !warehouseId
      || !customer
      || this.cart.items().length === 0
      || paymentMethodId <= 0
    ) {
      this.checkoutError.set(
        'Seleccione almacén, cliente, productos y método de pago antes de finalizar.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      this.cart.items().some(
        (item) =>
          item.quantity <= 0
          || item.quantity > item.stockAvailable,
      )
    ) {
      this.checkoutError.set(
        'Revise las cantidades del carrito. Uno o más productos ya no tienen stock suficiente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const operationNumber =
      this.paymentForm.controls.operationNumber.value.trim();

    if (
      method?.requiresOperationNumber
      && !operationNumber
    ) {
      this.checkoutError.set(
        'El método de pago seleccionado requiere número de operación.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.processing.set(true);

    this.checkoutUseCase
      .execute({
        uotId,
        warehouseId,
        customer,
        items: this.cart.items(),
        paymentMethodId,
        paymentOperation:
          operationNumber || undefined,
        observation:
          this.paymentForm.controls.observation.value.trim()
          || undefined,
        pendingSaleId: draft.pendingSaleId,
        createIdempotencyKey:
          draft.createIdempotencyKey,
        paymentIdempotencyKey:
          draft.paymentIdempotencyKey,
        deliveryIdempotencyKey:
          draft.deliveryIdempotencyKey,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.processing.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.lastSaleId.set(result.saleId);

          this.toast.success(
            `Venta #${result.saleId} completada`,
            `${result.currency} ${result.total.toFixed(2)} · ${result.state}`,
          );

          this.cart.clearAfterSuccess();
          this.customerForm.reset({
            type: 'PERSONA',
            documentType: 'DNI',
            documentNumber: '',
          });
          this.customerMessage.set(null);
          this.paymentForm.controls.operationNumber.setValue('');
          this.paymentForm.controls.observation.setValue('');
          this.loadCatalog();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const baseMessage = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          const recovery = this.cart.locked()
            ? ' La venta quedó protegida para reintento; vuelva a pulsar “Reanudar venta” sin modificar el carrito.'
            : '';

          this.checkoutError.set(
            `${baseMessage}${recovery}`,
          );

          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo completar la venta',
            `${baseMessage}${recovery}`,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  selectedPaymentMethod(): PosPaymentMethod | null {
    const id =
      Number(this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value);

    return this.paymentMethods().find(
      (method) => method.paymentMethodId === id,
    ) ?? null;
  }

  customerDocumentMaxLength(): number {
    return this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value === 'DNI'
      ? 8
      : 11;
  }

  checkoutLabel(): string {
    if (this.processing()) {
      return 'Procesando venta...';
    }

    const saleId = this.cart.pendingSaleId();

    if (saleId) {
      return `Reanudar venta #${saleId}`;
    }

    if (this.cart.creationUncertain()) {
      return 'Reanudar venta';
    }

    return 'Cobrar y entregar';
  }

  canCheckout(): boolean {
    return !this.processing()
      && this.currentUotId() !== null
      && this.cart.warehouseId() !== null
      && this.cart.customer() !== null
      && this.cart.items().length > 0
      && Number(
        this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value,
      ) > 0;
  }

  private currentUotId(): number | null {
    const id = this.uot.selectedId();

    return id && id > 0
      ? id
      : null;
  }

  private validDocument(
    type: PosDocumentType,
    value: string,
  ): boolean {
    return type === 'DNI'
      ? /^\d{8}$/.test(value)
      : /^\d{11}$/.test(value);
  }

  private resetCustomerSelection(): void {
    if (this.cart.locked()) {
      return;
    }

    this.cart.setCustomer(null);
    this.customerMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page pos-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Punto de venta"
    eyebrow="POS"
    [subtitle]="'Venta directa de productos con stock disponible en ' + uot.label() + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="contextLoading() || catalogLoading() || processing()"
        (click)="loadContext()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  @if (contextError()) {
    <app-error-state
      [message]="contextError() || 'No fue posible preparar el POS.'"
      (retry)="loadContext()"
    />
  } @else if (contextLoading()) {
    <app-loading-state
      title="Preparando POS"
      message="Consultando almacenes y métodos de pago."
    />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface pos-toolbar">
      <div class="pos-toolbar__field">
        <span class="pos-toolbar__label">
          <fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" />
          Almacén de salida
        </span>

        <select
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="cart.warehouseId() ?? 0"
          [disabled]="processing() || cart.locked() || cart.items().length > 0"
          (change)="changeWarehouse($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar almacén</option>
          @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.warehouseId) {
            <option [value]="warehouse.warehouseId">
              {{ warehouse.name }}
              @if (warehouse.code) {
                · {{ warehouse.code }}
              }
            </option>
          }
        </select>

        @if (cart.items().length > 0) {
          <small>
            Vacíe el carrito antes de cambiar de almacén.
          </small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="pos-toolbar__field pos-toolbar__field--grow">
        <span class="pos-toolbar__label">
          <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
          Buscar producto
        </span>

        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Código, nombre o categoría"
          [value]="search()"
          (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="pos-toolbar__summary">
        <span>Productos</span>
        <strong>{{ filteredCatalog().length }}</strong>
      </div>

      <div class="pos-toolbar__summary">
        <span>Carrito</span>
        <strong>{{ cart.itemCount() }}</strong>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="pos-layout">
      <main class="pos-catalog">
        <section class="admin-surface pos-customer">
          <header class="pos-section-header">
            <div>
              <span class="pos-section-icon">
                <fa-icon [icon]="customerIcon" />
              </span>
              <div>
                <small>Cliente</small>
                <strong>Identificación de la venta</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            @if (cart.customer(); as customer) {
              <span class="pos-chip pos-chip--success">
                {{ customer.documentType }} {{ customer.documentNumber }}
              </span>
            }
          </header>

          @if (cart.customer(); as customer) {
            <div class="pos-customer-selected">
              <div>
                <span>Cliente seleccionado</span>
                <strong>{{ customer.displayName }}</strong>
                <small>
                  {{ customer.type === 'EMPRESA' ? 'Empresa' : 'Persona' }}
                  · {{ customer.documentType }} {{ customer.documentNumber }}
                </small>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                (click)="cart.setCustomer(null); customerMessage.set(null)"
              >
                Cambiar
              </button>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <form
              class="pos-customer-search"
              [formGroup]="customerForm"
              (ngSubmit)="resolveCustomer()"
            >
              <label>
                <span>Tipo</span>
                <select
                  class="admin-select"
                  formControlName="type"
                  [disabled]="customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
                  (change)="onCustomerTypeChange()"
                >
                  <option value="PERSONA">Persona</option>
                  <option value="EMPRESA">Empresa</option>
                </select>
              </label>

              <label>
                <span>Documento</span>
                <select
                  class="admin-select"
                  formControlName="documentType"
                  [disabled]="customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA' || customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
                  (change)="onCustomerDocumentTypeChange()"
                >
                  <option value="DNI">DNI</option>
                  <option value="RUC">RUC</option>
                </select>
              </label>

              <label class="pos-customer-search__document">
                <span>Número</span>
                <input
                  class="admin-input"
                  type="text"
                  inputmode="numeric"
                  autocomplete="off"
                  formControlName="documentNumber"
                  [attr.maxlength]="customerDocumentMaxLength()"
                  [readOnly]="customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
                  (input)="onCustomerDocumentInput()"
                />
              </label>

              <button
                type="submit"
                class="admin-primary-button"
                [disabled]="customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
              >
                @if (customerLoading()) {
                  <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
                  Buscando...
                } @else {
                  <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                  Buscar cliente
                }
              </button>
            </form>
          }

          @if (customerMessage()) {
            <div class="pos-inline-note">
              {{ customerMessage() }}
            </div>
          }
        </section>

        <section class="pos-catalog-panel">
          <header class="pos-catalog-heading">
            <div>
              <small>Catálogo disponible</small>
              <h2>Productos con stock</h2>
            </div>
            <span>
              {{ warehouses().length > 0 ? 'Stock del almacén seleccionado' : 'Sin almacenes' }}
            </span>
          </header>

          @if (!cart.warehouseId()) {
            <app-empty-state
              title="Seleccione un almacén"
              message="El catálogo del POS se habilita cuando existe un almacén de salida."
            />
          } @else if (catalogLoading()) {
            <app-loading-state
              title="Cargando catálogo"
              message="Consultando precios vigentes y stock disponible."
            />
          } @else if (catalogError()) {
            <app-error-state
              [message]="catalogError() || 'No fue posible consultar el catálogo.'"
              (retry)="loadCatalog()"
            />
          } @else if (filteredCatalog().length === 0) {
            <app-empty-state
              title="Sin productos disponibles"
              message="No hay productos con precio vigente y stock para la búsqueda actual."
            />
          } @else {
            <div class="pos-product-grid">
              @for (product of filteredCatalog(); track product.productId) {
                <article class="admin-surface pos-product-card">
                  <app-pos-product-image
                    [fileId]="product.imageFileId"
                    [imageUrl]="product.imageUrl"
                    [alt]="product.name"
                  />

                  <div class="pos-product-card__body">
                    <div class="pos-product-card__heading">
                      <div>
                        <small>{{ product.code || 'SIN CÓDIGO' }}</small>
                        <h3>{{ product.name }}</h3>
                      </div>

                      <span class="pos-stock">
                        {{ product.stockAvailable | number:'1.0-3' }}
                        {{ product.unit }}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p>
                      {{ product.description || product.category || 'Producto disponible para venta.' }}
                    </p>

                    <div class="pos-product-card__footer">
                      <div>
                        <small>Precio de venta</small>
                        <strong>
                          {{ product.currency }}
                          {{ product.unitPrice | number:'1.2-2' }}
                        </strong>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small"
                        [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                        (click)="add(product)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="plusIcon" />
                        Agregar
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </article>
              }
            </div>
          }
        </section>
      </main>

      <aside class="admin-surface pos-cart">
        <header class="pos-cart__header">
          <div>
            <span class="pos-section-icon">
              <fa-icon [icon]="cartIcon" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <small>Venta actual</small>
              <strong>Carrito</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-icon-button"
            title="Vaciar carrito"
            [disabled]="cart.items().length === 0 || cart.locked() || processing()"
            (click)="clearCart()"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="trashIcon" />
          </button>
        </header>

        @if (cart.locked()) {
          <div class="pos-recovery-note">
            @if (cart.pendingSaleId()) {
              <strong>Venta #{{ cart.pendingSaleId() }} en proceso.</strong>
            } @else {
              <strong>Registro de venta pendiente de confirmar.</strong>
            }
            <span>
              El carrito está bloqueado para evitar duplicados. Use el botón de reanudación.
            </span>
          </div>
        }

        <div class="pos-cart__items">
          @for (item of cart.items(); track item.productId) {
            <article class="pos-cart-item">
              <app-pos-product-image
                [fileId]="item.imageFileId"
                [imageUrl]="item.imageUrl"
                [alt]="item.name"
              />

              <div class="pos-cart-item__body">
                <div class="pos-cart-item__heading">
                  <div>
                    <strong>{{ item.name }}</strong>
                    <small>{{ item.code }} · {{ item.unit }}</small>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    title="Quitar"
                    [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                    (click)="cart.remove(item.productId)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div class="pos-cart-item__controls">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                    (click)="decrement(item.productId)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="minusIcon" />
                  </button>

                  <input
                    class="admin-input"
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    step="1"
                    [max]="item.stockAvailable"
                    [value]="item.quantity"
                    [readOnly]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                    (change)="changeQuantity(item.productId, $any($event.target).value)"
                  />

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing() || item.quantity >= item.stockAvailable"
                    (click)="increment(item.productId)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="plusIcon" />
                  </button>

                  <div class="pos-cart-item__price">
                    <small>{{ item.currency }} {{ item.unitPrice | number:'1.2-2' }} c/u</small>
                    <strong>
                      {{ item.currency }}
                      {{ item.unitPrice * item.quantity | number:'1.2-2' }}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                </div>

                @if (item.quantity > item.stockAvailable) {
                  <small class="pos-cart-item__error">
                    Stock actual: {{ item.stockAvailable | number:'1.0-3' }}.
                  </small>
                }
              </div>
            </article>
          } @empty {
            <div class="pos-cart-empty">
              <fa-icon [icon]="cartIcon" />
              <strong>Carrito vacío</strong>
              <span>Agregue productos desde el catálogo.</span>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <section class="pos-payment" [formGroup]="paymentForm">
          <div class="pos-payment__heading">
            <fa-icon [icon]="paymentIcon" />
            <strong>Cobro</strong>
          </div>

          <label>
            <span>Método de pago</span>
            <select
              class="admin-select"
              formControlName="paymentMethodId"
              [disabled]="processing()"
            >
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @for (method of paymentMethods(); track method.paymentMethodId) {
                <option [value]="method.paymentMethodId">
                  {{ method.name }}
                </option>
              }
            </select>
          </label>

          @if (selectedPaymentMethod()?.requiresOperationNumber) {
            <label>
              <span>Número de operación</span>
              <input
                class="admin-input"
                type="text"
                maxlength="120"
                formControlName="operationNumber"
                [readOnly]="processing()"
              />
            </label>
          }

          <label>
            <span>Observación</span>
            <textarea
              class="admin-textarea"
              rows="2"
              maxlength="500"
              formControlName="observation"
              [readOnly]="processing() || cart.locked()"
            ></textarea>
          </label>
        </section>

        <section class="pos-cart__totals">
          <div>
            <span>Ítems</span>
            <strong>{{ cart.itemCount() }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="pos-cart__grand-total">
            <span>Total estimado</span>
            <strong>
              {{ cart.currency() }}
              {{ cart.total() | number:'1.2-2' }}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <small>
            El backend vuelve a validar precio vigente y stock antes de cobrar.
          </small>
        </section>

        @if (checkoutError()) {
          <div class="admin-inline-error">
            {{ checkoutError() }}
          </div>
        }

        @if (lastSaleId()) {
          <div class="pos-success-note">
            Última venta completada: #{{ lastSaleId() }}
          </div>
        }

        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-primary-button pos-checkout-button"
          [disabled]="!canCheckout()"
          (click)="checkout()"
        >
          @if (processing()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
          }
          {{ checkoutLabel() }}
        </button>
      </aside>
    </div>
  }
</div>

<dialog
  #manualCustomerDialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeManualCustomer()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">

        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="customerIcon" />

      <button
        type="button"

    <div class="pos-manual-document">
      <span>
        {{ customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA' ? 'Empresa' : 'Persona' }}
      </span>
      <strong>
        {{ customerForm.controls.documentType.value }}

      </strong>

    <form
      class="admin-form-grid"
      [formGroup]="manualForm"

      @if (customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA') {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

            maxlength="200"
            formControlName="businessName"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="manualForm.controls.businessName"
            fieldLabel="La razón social"
          />
        </div>
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Nombres</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            maxlength="120"
            formControlName="names"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="manualForm.controls.names"
            fieldLabel="Los nombres"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Apellido paterno</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            maxlength="80"
            formControlName="paternalSurname"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Apellido materno</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            maxlength="80"
            formControlName="maternalSurname"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Teléfono</label>
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="tel"
          maxlength="30"
          formControlName="phone"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Correo</label>
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="email"
          maxlength="180"
          formControlName="email"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="manualForm.controls.email"
          fieldLabel="El correo"
        />
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="manualSaving()"
          (click)="closeManualCustomer()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="manualSaving()"
        >
          @if (manualSaving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="customerIcon" />
            Registrar cliente
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```css
}

  display: grid;

}

.pos-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(21rem, 25rem);
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}

.pos-catalog {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.pos-customer {
  padding: 0.9rem;
}

.pos-section-header,
.pos-cart__header,
.pos-catalog-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

.pos-section-header > div,
.pos-cart__header > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.pos-section-header small,
.pos-cart__header small,
.pos-catalog-heading small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.pos-section-header strong,
.pos-cart__header strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.pos-section-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.2rem;
  height: 2.2rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.pos-customer-search {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 8rem 8rem minmax(10rem, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  align-items: end;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
}

.pos-customer-search label,
.pos-payment label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.pos-customer-search label > span,
.pos-payment label > span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.pos-customer-selected {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-customer-selected span,
.pos-customer-selected small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
}

.pos-customer-selected strong {
  display: block;
  margin: 0.18rem 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.pos-inline-note,
.pos-recovery-note,
.pos-success-note {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.pos-recovery-note {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.2rem;
}

.pos-recovery-note strong,
.pos-success-note {
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.pos-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.pos-chip--success {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.pos-catalog-panel {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-catalog-heading {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-catalog-heading h2 {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-catalog-heading > span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
}

.pos-product-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(14.5rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.pos-product-card {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
}

.pos-product-card__body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-product-card__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.pos-product-card__heading small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.pos-product-card__heading h3 {
  margin: 0.12rem 0 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.pos-stock {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.45rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.pos-product-card__body > p {
  min-height: 2.2rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.pos-product-card__footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.pos-product-card__footer small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
}

.pos-product-card__footer strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.pos-cart {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0.75rem;
  display: grid;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 6rem);
  grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(7rem, 1fr) auto auto auto auto;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0.85rem;
}

.pos-cart__items {
  min-height: 7rem;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 0.15rem;
}

.pos-cart-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 3.8rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding: 0.7rem 0;
}

.pos-cart-item:first-child {
  padding-top: 0;
}

.pos-cart-item app-pos-product-image {
  width: 3.8rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__body {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading strong {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 3.6rem auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__controls .admin-input {
  min-width: 0;
  padding-inline: 0.35rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.pos-cart-item__price {
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: right;
}

.pos-cart-item__price small,
.pos-cart-item__price strong {
  display: block;
}

.pos-cart-item__price small {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__price strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__error {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--desco-danger, #b91c1c);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
}

.pos-cart-empty {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 8rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  text-align: center;
}

.pos-cart-empty fa-icon {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.pos-cart-empty strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-cart-empty span {
  font-size: 0.64rem;
}

.pos-payment {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding-top: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-payment__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding-top: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.pos-cart__grand-total strong {
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals > small {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.pos-checkout-button {
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 2.7rem;
}

.pos-manual-document {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.7rem;
}

.pos-manual-document span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.pos-manual-document strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .pos-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 22rem;
  }

  .pos-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(12rem, 17rem) minmax(14rem, 1fr) auto;
  }

  .pos-toolbar__summary:last-child {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 920px) {
  .pos-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-cart {
    position: static;
    max-height: none;
  }

  .pos-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .pos-toolbar__summary {
    display: none;
  }

  .pos-customer-search {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .pos-customer-search__document {
    grid-column: 1 / 2;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .pos-toolbar,
  .pos-customer-search {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-product-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-customer-selected,
  .pos-section-header,
  .pos-catalog-heading {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .pos-cart-item__controls {
    grid-template-columns: auto 3.5rem auto;
  }

  .pos-cart-item__price {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    text-align: left;
  }
}
```

```json
{

          "options": {

            "assets": [
              {
                "glob": "**/*",
                "input": "public"
              }
            ],
            "styles": [
              "src/styles.css"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "cli": {
    "analytics": false
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { mergeApplicationConfig, ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideServerRendering, withRoutes } from '@angular/ssr';
import { appConfig } from './app.config';
import { serverRoutes } from './app.routes.server';

const serverConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideServerRendering(withRoutes(serverRoutes))
  ]
};

export const config = mergeApplicationConfig(appConfig, serverConfig);
```

```typescript
import { ApplicationConfig, ErrorHandler, provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners, provideZonelessChangeDetection, } from '@angular/core';
import { provideHttpClient, withFetch, withInterceptors, } from '@angular/common/http';
import { provideClientHydration, withEventReplay, } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import { GlobalErrorHandler } from './core/errors/global-error-handler';
import { apiErrorInterceptor } from './core/http/interceptors/api-error.interceptor';
import { correlationIdInterceptor } from './core/http/interceptors/correlation-id.interceptor';
import { deviceIdInterceptor } from './core/http/interceptors/device-id.interceptor';
import { provideDescoFontAwesome } from './core/ui/fontawesome.config';
import { accessTokenInterceptor } from './features/acceso/adapter/out/http/interceptors/access-token.interceptor';
import { sessionRefreshInterceptor } from './features/acceso/adapter/out/http/interceptors/session-refresh.interceptor';
import { provideAcceso } from './features/acceso/acceso.providers';
import { provideCatalogos } from './features/administracion/catalogos/catalogos.providers';
import { provideEmpleados } from './features/administracion/empleados/empleados.providers';
import { provideOrganizaciones } from './features/administracion/organizaciones/organizaciones.providers';
import { provideRolesPermisos } from './features/administracion/roles-permisos/roles-permisos.providers';
import { provideUsuarios } from './features/administracion/usuarios/usuarios.providers';
import { provideDocumentosEvidencias } from './features/documentos-evidencias/documentos-evidencias.providers';
import { provideCobrosCompradores } from './features/finanzas/cobros-compradores/cobros-compradores.providers';
import { provideGastos } from './features/finanzas/gastos/gastos.providers';
import { provideLiquidaciones } from './features/finanzas/liquidaciones/liquidaciones.providers';
import { providePagosSocios } from './features/finanzas/pagos-socios/pagos-socios.providers';
import { provideAjustesPrecio } from './features/gestion-comercial/ajustes-precio/ajustes-precio.providers';
import { provideIncidencias } from './features/gestion-comercial/incidencias/incidencias.providers';
import { provideCensos } from './features/gestion-tecnica/censos/censos.providers';
import { provideEvaluaciones } from './features/gestion-tecnica/evaluaciones/evaluaciones.providers';
import { provideParcelasCultivos } from './features/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos/parcelas-cultivos.providers';
import { providePredios } from './features/gestion-tecnica/predios/predios.providers';
import { provideProductores } from './features/gestion-tecnica/productores/productores.providers';
import { provideSalidas } from './features/gestion-tecnica/salidas/salidas.providers';
import { provideSanidad } from './features/gestion-tecnica/sanidad/sanidad.providers';
import { provideVisitas } from './features/gestion-tecnica/visitas/visitas.providers';
import { provideInicio } from './features/inicio/inicio.providers';
import { provideMiCuenta } from './features/mi-cuenta/mi-cuenta.providers';
import { provideInventarioVehiculos } from './features/recursos/inventario-vehiculos/inventario-vehiculos.providers';
import { provideProgramados } from './features/recursos/programados/programados.providers';
import { provideAuditoria } from './features/reportes-control/auditoria/auditoria.providers';
import { provideReportes } from './features/reportes-control/reportes/reportes.providers';
import { provideOpenApi } from './infrastructure/openapi/openapi.providers';
import { provideReferenceData } from './reference-data/reference-data.providers';
import { routes } from './app.routes';
export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
    providers: [
        provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners(),
        provideZonelessChangeDetection(),
        provideRouter(routes),
        provideClientHydration(withEventReplay()),
        provideHttpClient(withFetch(), withInterceptors([
            correlationIdInterceptor,
            deviceIdInterceptor,
            apiErrorInterceptor,
            sessionRefreshInterceptor,
            accessTokenInterceptor,
        ])),
        provideDescoFontAwesome(),
        ...provideOpenApi(),
        ...provideReferenceData(),
        ...provideAcceso(),
        ...provideInicio(),
        ...provideMiCuenta(),
        ...provideOrganizaciones(),
        ...provideRolesPermisos(),
        ...provideCatalogos(),
        ...provideEmpleados(),
        ...provideUsuarios(),
        ...provideDocumentosEvidencias(),
        ...provideInventarioVehiculos(),
        ...provideProgramados(),
        ...provideProductores(),
        ...providePredios(),
        ...provideParcelasCultivos(),
        ...provideCensos(),
        ...provideSalidas(),
        ...provideVisitas(),
        ...provideEvaluaciones(),
        ...provideSanidad(),
        ...provideIncidencias(),
        ...provideAjustesPrecio(),
        ...provideGastos(),
        ...provideLiquidaciones(),
        ...providePagosSocios(),
        ...provideCobrosCompradores(),
        ...provideReportes(),
        ...provideAuditoria(),
        { provide: ErrorHandler, useClass: GlobalErrorHandler },
    ],
};
```

```typescript
import { computed, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessContext } from './models/access-context.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class AccessStore {
  private readonly contextSignal = signal<AccessContext | null>(null);

  readonly context = this.contextSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly loaded = computed(() => this.contextSignal() !== null);
  readonly user = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.usuario ?? null);
  readonly roles = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.roles ?? []);
  readonly modules = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.modulos ?? []);
  readonly permissions = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.permisos ?? []);

  set(context: AccessContext): void {
    this.contextSignal.set({
      usuario: context.usuario,
      roles: [...context.roles],
      modulos: [...context.modulos],
      permisos: [...context.permisos],
    });
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.contextSignal.set(null);
  }

  snapshot(): AccessContext | null {
    return this.contextSignal();
  }
}
```
