```typescript
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivateFn, Router } from '@angular/router';

import { ModuleAccessService } from './module-access.service';

export const moduleAccessGuard: CanActivateFn = (route) => {
  const moduleAccess = inject(ModuleAccessService);
  const router = inject(Router);
  const moduleCode = route.data['module'] as string | undefined;

  if (!moduleCode) {
    return true;
  }

  return moduleAccess.has(moduleCode)
    ? true
    : router.createUrlTree(['/forbidden']);
};
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from './access.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ModuleAccessService {
  private readonly store = inject(AccessStore);

  has(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();

    const moduleMatch = this.store.modules().some(
      (module) => module.codigo?.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized,
    );
    if (moduleMatch) return true;

    return this.store.permissions().some(
      (permission) => permission.codigoModulo?.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized,
    );
  }

  hasRoute(route: string): boolean {
    const normalized = this.normalizeRoute(route);
    return this.store.modules().some((module) =>
      module.ruta ? this.normalizeRoute(module.ruta) === normalized : false,
    );
  }

  private normalizeRoute(route: string): string {
    const trimmed = route.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return '/';
    return (`/${trimmed}`).replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  Directive,
  Input,
  TemplateRef,
  ViewContainerRef,
  effect,
  inject,
} from '@angular/core';

import { PermissionService } from './permission.service';

type PermissionMode = 'all' | 'any';

@Directive({
  selector: '[appPermission]',
  standalone: true,
})
export class PermissionDirective {
  private readonly template = inject(TemplateRef<unknown>);
  private readonly container = inject(ViewContainerRef);
  private readonly permissionService = inject(PermissionService);

  private permissions: readonly string[] = [];
  private mode: PermissionMode = 'all';
  private rendered = false;

  constructor() {
    effect(() => {
      this.render();
    });
  }

  @Input()
  set appPermission(value: string | readonly string[]) {
    this.permissions =
      typeof value === 'string' ? [value] : [...(value ?? [])];
    this.render();
  }

  @Input()
  set appPermissionMode(value: PermissionMode) {
    this.mode = value ?? 'all';
    this.render();
  }

  private render(): void {
    const allowed =
      this.permissions.length === 0 ||
      (this.mode === 'any'
        ? this.permissionService.hasAny(this.permissions)
        : this.permissionService.hasAll(this.permissions));

    if (allowed && !this.rendered) {
      this.container.clear();
      this.container.createEmbeddedView(this.template);
      this.rendered = true;
      return;
    }

    if (!allowed && this.rendered) {
      this.container.clear();
      this.rendered = false;
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivateFn, Router } from '@angular/router';

import { PermissionService } from './permission.service';

export const permissionGuard: CanActivateFn = (route) => {
  const permissionService = inject(PermissionService);
  const router = inject(Router);

  const permission = route.data['permission'] as string | undefined;
  const permissions = (route.data['permissions'] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
  const mode = (route.data['permissionMode'] as 'all' | 'any' | undefined) ?? 'all';

  const allowed = permission
    ? permissionService.has(permission)
    : permissions.length === 0
      ? true
      : mode === 'any'
        ? permissionService.hasAny(permissions)
        : permissionService.hasAll(permissions);

  return allowed ? true : router.createUrlTree(['/forbidden']);
};
```

### 633. `src/app/core/access/permission.service.ts`

- Ruta: `src/app/core/access/permission.service.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\core\access\permission.service.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/core/access/permission.service.ts`

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessPermission } from './models/access-permission.model';
import { AccessStore } from './access.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PermissionService {
  private readonly store = inject(AccessStore);

  has(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = this.normalize(code);
    return this.store.permissions().some((permission) =>
      this.effectiveCodes(permission).includes(normalized),
    );
  }

  hasAny(codes: readonly string[]): boolean {
    return codes.some((code) => this.has(code));
  }

  hasAll(codes: readonly string[]): boolean {
    return codes.every((code) => this.has(code));
  }

  private effectiveCodes(permission: AccessPermission): readonly string[] {
    const codes = new Set<string>();
    if (permission.codigo?.trim()) codes.add(this.normalize(permission.codigo));

    const module = permission.codigoModulo?.trim();
    const action = permission.accion?.trim();
    if (module && action) {
      const normalizedModule = this.normalize(module);
      const normalizedAction = this.normalize(action);
      codes.add(`${normalizedModule}_${normalizedAction}`);

      if (normalizedModule === 'VALIDACION_IDENTIDAD') {
        if (normalizedAction === 'VER') codes.add('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_CONSULTAR');
        if (normalizedAction === 'CREAR') codes.add('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_IMPORTAR');
        if (normalizedAction === 'EDITAR') codes.add('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR');
      }
    }

    return Array.from(codes);
  }

  private normalize(value: string): string {
    return value.trim().toUpperCase();
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { inject, Injectable, PLATFORM_ID } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class CameraService {
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);

  async open(
    constraints: MediaStreamConstraints = {
      video: {
        facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' },
      },
      audio: false,
    },
  ): Promise<MediaStream> {
    if (
      !isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId) ||
      !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia
    ) {
      throw new Error('La cámara no está disponible en este dispositivo.');
    }

    return navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
  }

  stop(stream: MediaStream | null | undefined): void {
    stream?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
  }

  capture(video: HTMLVideoElement, mimeType = 'image/jpeg'): Promise<Blob> {
    if (!isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)) {
      return Promise.reject(
        new Error('La captura de cámara no está disponible en este entorno.'),
      );
    }

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;

    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');

    if (!context) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('No se pudo preparar la captura.'));
    }

    context.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      canvas.toBlob(
        (blob) =>
          blob
            ? resolve(blob)
            : reject(new Error('No se pudo generar la fotografía.')),
        mimeType,
        0.92,
      );
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { inject, Injectable, PLATFORM_ID } from '@angular/core';

export interface BrowserCoordinates {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  accuracy: number;
  capturedAt: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class GeolocationService {
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);

  current(
    options: PositionOptions = {
      enableHighAccuracy: true,
      timeout: 15000,
      maximumAge: 0,
    },
  ): Promise<BrowserCoordinates> {
    if (!isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId) || !navigator.geolocation) {
      return Promise.reject(
        new Error('La geolocalización no está disponible en este dispositivo.'),
      );
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        (position) =>
          resolve({
            latitude: position.coords.latitude,
            longitude: position.coords.longitude,
            accuracy: position.coords.accuracy,
            capturedAt: new Date(position.timestamp).toISOString(),
          }),
        (error) => reject(error),
        options,
      );
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { inject, Injectable, PLATFORM_ID } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class FileDownloadService {
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);

  downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
    if (!isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)) {
      return;
    }

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');

    try {
      anchor.href = url;
      anchor.download = filename;
      anchor.rel = 'noopener';
      anchor.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.appendChild(anchor);
      anchor.click();
    } finally {
      anchor.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
  }

  openUrl(url: string): void {
    if (!isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)) {
      return;
    }

    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';

import { safeApiMessage } from '../safe-api-message';
import { ApiError } from '../models/api-error.model';

interface BackendErrorEnvelope {
  codigo?: unknown;
  mensaje?: unknown;
  correlacionId?: unknown;
  fechaHoraUtc?: unknown;
}

export const apiErrorInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) =>
  next(request).pipe(
    catchError((error: unknown) => {
      if (!(error instanceof HttpErrorResponse)) {
        return throwError(() => error);
      }

      const payload =
        error.error && typeof error.error === 'object'
          ? (error.error as BackendErrorEnvelope)
          : null;
      const candidate =
        typeof payload?.mensaje === 'string' ? payload.mensaje : null;

      const normalized: ApiError = {
        status: error.status,
        code:
          typeof payload?.codigo === 'string'
            ? payload.codigo
            : error.status === 0
              ? 'SERVICIO_NO_DISPONIBLE'
              : 'ERROR_HTTP',
        message: safeApiMessage(error.status, candidate),
        correlationId:
          typeof payload?.correlacionId === 'string'
            ? payload.correlacionId
            : null,
        timestamp:
          typeof payload?.fechaHoraUtc === 'string'
            ? payload.fechaHoraUtc
            : null,
        details: null,
      };

      return throwError(() => normalized);
    }),
  );
```

```typescript
import { HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';

import { SKIP_CORRELATION_ID } from '../context/http-context.tokens';
import { CorrelationIdService } from '../services/correlation-id.service';

export const correlationIdInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) => {
  if (request.context.get(SKIP_CORRELATION_ID)) {
    return next(request);
  }

  const correlationId = inject(CorrelationIdService).create();

  return next(
    request.clone({
      setHeaders: {
        'X-Correlation-Id': correlationId,
      },
    }),
  );
};
```

```typescript
export interface ApiError {
  status: number;
  code: string;
  message: string;
  correlationId: string | null;
  timestamp: string | null;
  details: unknown;
}

export function isApiError(value: unknown): value is ApiError {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false;
  }

  const candidate = value as Partial<ApiError>;
  return (
    typeof candidate.status === 'number' &&
    typeof candidate.code === 'string' &&
    typeof candidate.message === 'string'
  );
}
```

```typescript
const DEFAULT_MESSAGE = 'No se pudo completar la acción.';

const CODE_MESSAGES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  CORREO_DUPLICADO: 'El correo ya está registrado.',
  CORREO_EMPRESA_DUPLICADO: 'El correo ya está registrado.',
  CORREO_PERSONA_DUPLICADO: 'El correo ya está registrado.',
  CORREO_SEGURIDAD_DUPLICADO: 'El correo ya está registrado.',
  CORREO_PRINCIPAL_DUPLICADO: 'La cuenta ya tiene un correo principal.',
  ROL_DUPLICADO: 'El rol ya está asignado.',
  ROL_VIGENTE_DUPLICADO: 'El rol ya está asignado.',
  EMPLEADO_DUPLICADO: 'La persona ya está registrada como empleado.',
  CODIGO_AREA_DUPLICADO: 'Ya existe un área con ese nombre o código en la organización.',
  CODIGO_EMPLEADO_DUPLICADO: 'Ya existe un empleado con ese código en la organización.',
  VALOR_DUPLICADO: 'El valor ya está registrado.',
  USUARIO_DUPLICADO: 'El nombre de usuario ya está registrado.',
  DOCUMENTO_DUPLICADO: 'El documento ya está registrado.',
  DATO_DUPLICADO: 'La información ya está registrada.',
  REGISTRO_DUPLICADO: 'La información ya está registrada.',
  REGISTRO_NO_ENCONTRADO: 'No se encontró la información seleccionada.',
  RECURSO_NO_ENCONTRADO: 'No se encontró la información seleccionada.',
  DOCUMENTO_INVALIDO: 'El documento ingresado no es válido.',
  SOLICITUD_NO_VALIDA: 'Revisa la información ingresada.',
};

export function safeApiMessage(
  status: number,
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
  code?: string | null,
): string {
  if (status === 0) {
    return 'No se pudo conectar al sistema.';
  }
  if (status === 401) {
    return 'Su sesión no es válida. Inicie sesión nuevamente.';
  }
  if (status === 403) {
    return 'No cuenta con autorización para realizar esta acción.';
  }

  const safe = safeCandidate(candidate);
  if (safe) {
    return safe;
  }

  const known = code ? CODE_MESSAGES[code.trim().toUpperCase()] : null;
  if (known) {
    return known;
  }

  if (status === 404) {
    return 'No se encontró la información solicitada.';
  }
  if (status === 409) {
    return 'La información ya existe o cambió.';
  }
  if (status === 422) {
    return 'Revisa la información ingresada.';
  }
  if (status === 429) {
    return 'Hay demasiadas solicitudes. Intente nuevamente.';
  }
  if (status >= 500) {
    return 'No se pudo completar la acción en este momento.';
  }
  return DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
}

export function safeCandidate(
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  const value = candidate?.trim();
  if (!value || isTechnicalMessage(value)) return null;
  return value.length > 300 ? value.slice(0, 300) : value;
}

function isTechnicalMessage(value: string): boolean {
  const normalized = value.toLowerCase();
  const markers = [
    'exception', 'stacktrace', 'stack trace', 'sqlstate', 'sqlexception',
    'jdbc', 'simplejdbccall', 'stored procedure', 'procedimiento almacenado',
    'constraint', 'foreign key', 'primary key', 'unique index', 'duplicate key',
    'nullpointer', 'classcastexception', 'timeout exception', 'nvarchar',
    'http://', 'https://', '/api/', 'endpoint', 'bearer', 'authorization:',
    'access token', 'refresh token', 'provider', 'proveedor externo',
    'factiliza', 'verificape', 'reniec api', 'sunat api', 'select ', 'insert ',
    'update ', 'delete ', 'merge ', 'create table', 'alter table',
  ];
  return markers.some((marker) => normalized.includes(marker));
}
```

```typescript
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })

  create(): string {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
```

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, tap } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class IdempotencyKeyService {
  private readonly pending = new Map<string, string>();

  create(): string {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
      return crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.getRandomValues === 'function') {
      crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
    } else {
      for (let index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 1) {
        bytes[index] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
      }
    }

    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;

    const hex = Array.from(bytes, (value) => value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
  }

  /**
   * Reutiliza la misma clave al reintentar exactamente la misma escritura
   * después de un error técnico/transitorio.
   *
   * Si cambia el scope o el payload se genera otra clave. Los errores
   * funcionales 4xx (excepto los transitorios indicados abajo) liberan la
   * clave para que una corrección posterior sea una operación nueva.
   */
  idempotent<T>(
    scope: string,
    payload: unknown,
    request: (key: string) => Observable<T>,
  ): Observable<T> {
    const cacheKey = this.cacheKey(scope, payload);
    const key = this.pending.get(cacheKey) ?? this.store(cacheKey);

    return request(key).pipe(
      tap({
        next: () => this.pending.delete(cacheKey),
        error: (error) => {
          if (!this.shouldReuseAfterError(error)) {
            this.pending.delete(cacheKey);
          }
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  private store(cacheKey: string): string {
    const key = this.create();
    this.pending.set(cacheKey, key);
    return key;
  }

  private cacheKey(scope: string, payload: unknown): string {
    const normalizedScope = scope.trim();
    let serialized = 'null';

    try {
      serialized = JSON.stringify(payload) ?? 'null';
    } catch {
      serialized = String(payload);
    }

    return `${normalizedScope}\n${serialized}`;
  }

  private shouldReuseAfterError(error: unknown): boolean {
    const status = this.httpStatus(error);

    if (status === 409) {
      const code = this.errorCode(error);
      return code === 'OPERACION_EN_PROCESO'
        || code?.startsWith('IDEMPOTENCIA_') === true;
    }

    return status === 0
      || status === 408
      || status === 425
      || status === 429
      || (status != null && status >= 500);
  }

  private errorCode(error: unknown): string | null {
    if (!error || typeof error !== 'object' || !('code' in error)) {
      return null;
    }

    const code = (error as { code?: unknown }).code;
    return typeof code === 'string' && code.trim()
      ? code.trim().toUpperCase()
      : null;
  }

  private httpStatus(error: unknown): number | null {
    if (!error || typeof error !== 'object' || !('status' in error)) {
      return null;
    }

    const status = Number((error as { status?: unknown }).status);
    return Number.isFinite(status) ? status : null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRouteSnapshot } from '@angular/router';

import { BreadcrumbItem } from './navigation-item.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BreadcrumbService {
  build(snapshot: ActivatedRouteSnapshot): readonly BreadcrumbItem[] {
    const result: BreadcrumbItem[] = [];
    let current: ActivatedRouteSnapshot | null = snapshot.root;
    let url = '';

    while (current) {
      const segment = current.url.map((part) => part.path).join('/');

      if (segment) {
        url += `/${segment}`;
      }

      const label = current.data['breadcrumb'] as string | undefined;

      if (label) {
        result.push({
          label,
          url: url || '/',
        });
      }

      current = current.firstChild;
    }

    return result;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { computed, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AccessStore } from '../access/access.store';
import { AccessModule } from '../access/models/access-module.model';
import { NavigationItem } from './navigation-item.model';

interface FrontendEntry {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  label: string;
  route: string;
  icon: string;
  order: number;
  permission: string;
  group: 'ADMIN' | 'COMERCIAL';
}

const FRONTEND_ENTRIES: readonly FrontendEntry[] = [
  { id: -6101, code: 'CAMPANIAS', label: 'Campañas', route: '/gestion-comercial/campanias', icon: 'calendar-days', order: 10, permission: 'CAMPANIAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6102, code: 'PARTICIPANTES', label: 'Participantes', route: '/gestion-comercial/participantes', icon: 'user-group', order: 20, permission: 'PARTICIPANTES_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6103, code: 'OPERATIVOS', label: 'Operativos', route: '/gestion-comercial/operativos', icon: 'truck', order: 30, permission: 'OPERATIVOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6104, code: 'ENTREGAS', label: 'Entregas', route: '/gestion-comercial/entregas', icon: 'boxes-stacked', order: 40, permission: 'ENTREGAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6105, code: 'JABAS', label: 'Jabas', route: '/gestion-comercial/jabas', icon: 'box', order: 50, permission: 'JABAS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
  { id: -6106, code: 'PRECIOS', label: 'Precios', route: '/gestion-comercial/precios', icon: 'coins', order: 60, permission: 'PRECIOS_LISTAR', group: 'COMERCIAL' },
];

const ROUTES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  INICIO: '/inicio',
  DASHBOARD: '/inicio',
  ORGANIZACIONES: '/administracion/organizaciones',
  ROLES: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  ROLES_PERMISOS: '/administracion/roles-permisos',
  CATALOGOS: '/administracion/catalogos',
  TIPOS_BIEN: '/administracion/catalogos',
  EMPLEADOS: '/administracion/empleados',
  USUARIOS: '/administracion/usuarios',
  UOT: '/administracion/uot',
  DOCUMENTOS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  EVIDENCIAS: '/documentos-evidencias',
  INVENTARIO: '/recursos/inventario-vehiculos',
  PRODUCTOS: '/recursos/productos',
  ALMACENES: '/recursos/almacenes',
  RECURSOS: '/recursos/programados',
  RECURSOS_PROGRAMADOS: '/recursos/programados',
  PRODUCTORES: '/gestion-tecnica/productores',
  PREDIOS: '/gestion-tecnica/predios',
  CULTIVOS: '/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos',
  CENSOS: '/gestion-tecnica/censos',
  SALIDAS: '/gestion-tecnica/salidas',
  VISITAS: '/gestion-tecnica/visitas',
  EVALUACIONES: '/gestion-tecnica/evaluaciones',
  SANIDAD: '/gestion-tecnica/sanidad',
  PRODUCCION: '/gestion-tecnica/produccion',
  CAMPANIAS: '/gestion-comercial/campanias',
  PARTICIPANTES: '/gestion-comercial/participantes',
  OPERATIVOS: '/gestion-comercial/operativos',
  ENTREGAS: '/gestion-comercial/entregas',
  JABAS: '/gestion-comercial/jabas',
  PRECIOS: '/gestion-comercial/precios',
  POS: '/pos',
  VENTAS: '/pos',
  INCIDENCIAS: '/gestion-comercial/incidencias',
  AJUSTES_PRECIO: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  AJUSTES: '/gestion-comercial/ajustes',
  GASTOS: '/finanzas/gastos',
  LIQUIDACIONES: '/finanzas/liquidaciones',
  PAGOS: '/finanzas/pagos',
  COBROS: '/finanzas/cobros',
  REPORTES: '/reportes',
  AUDITORIA: '/auditoria',
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NavigationService {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly items = computed(() => this.withFrontendEntries(this.buildTree(this.accessStore.modules())));

  private buildTree(modules: readonly AccessModule[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    const moduleById = new Map(modules.map((module) => [module.moduloId, module] as const));
    const includedIds = new Set<number>();

    for (const module of modules) {
      if (!module.visibleMenu) continue;
      includedIds.add(module.moduloId);
      let parentId = module.moduloPadreId;
      while (parentId !== null) {
        const parent = moduleById.get(parentId);
        if (!parent || includedIds.has(parent.moduloId)) break;
        includedIds.add(parent.moduloId);
        parentId = parent.moduloPadreId;
      }
    }

    const byParent = new Map<number | null, AccessModule[]>();
    for (const module of modules.filter((item) => includedIds.has(item.moduloId))) {
      const key = module.moduloPadreId !== null && includedIds.has(module.moduloPadreId)
        ? module.moduloPadreId
        : null;
      const bucket = byParent.get(key) ?? [];
      bucket.push(module);
      byParent.set(key, bucket);
    }

    const build = (parentId: number | null): NavigationItem[] =>
      (byParent.get(parentId) ?? [])
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden || a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre))
        .map((module) => ({
          id: module.moduloId,
          code: module.codigo,
          label: module.nombre,
          route: this.normalizedRoute(module),
          icon: module.icono,
          order: module.orden,
          children: build(module.moduloId),
        }));

    return build(null);
  }

  private withFrontendEntries(items: readonly NavigationItem[]): readonly NavigationItem[] {
    let result = [...items];
    for (const entry of FRONTEND_ENTRIES) {
      if (!this.hasPermission(entry.permission) || this.containsCode(result, entry.code)) continue;
      result = this.insertEntry(result, entry);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private insertEntry(items: readonly NavigationItem[], entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem[] {
    const groupMatcher = entry.group === 'ADMIN'
      ? (code: string) => code.includes('ADMIN')
      : (code: string) => code.includes('COMERCIAL');
    let inserted = false;

    const visit = (nodes: readonly NavigationItem[]): NavigationItem[] => nodes.map((node) => {
      let children = visit(node.children);
      if (!inserted && groupMatcher(node.code.trim().toUpperCase())) {
        children = [...children, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
        inserted = true;
      }
      return { ...node, children };
    });

    const decorated = visit(items);
    return inserted
      ? decorated
      : [...decorated, this.entryNode(entry)].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
  }

  private entryNode(entry: FrontendEntry): NavigationItem {
    return { id: entry.id, code: entry.code, label: entry.label, route: entry.route, icon: entry.icon, order: entry.order, children: [] };
  }

  private containsCode(items: readonly NavigationItem[], code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return items.some((item) => item.code.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized || this.containsCode(item.children, normalized));
  }

  private hasPermission(code: string): boolean {
    const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    return this.accessStore.permissions().some((permission) => permission.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() === normalized);
  }

  private normalizedRoute(module: AccessModule): string | null {
    if (!module.visibleMenu) return null;
    const code = module.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();
    return ROUTES[code] ?? module.ruta;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable, of, tap } from 'rxjs';

import {
  REFERENCE_DATA_GATEWAY,
  ReferenceDataGateway,
} from './reference-data.gateway';
import {
  GeographyItem,
  ReferenceCatalogCode,
  ReferenceItem,
} from './reference-data.model';
import { ReferenceDataStore } from './reference-data.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ReferenceDataService {
  private readonly gateway: ReferenceDataGateway = inject(REFERENCE_DATA_GATEWAY);
  private readonly store = inject(ReferenceDataStore);

  catalog(
    code: ReferenceCatalogCode,
    force = false,
  ): Observable<readonly ReferenceItem[]> {
    const cached = this.store.get(code);

    if (!force && cached) {
      return of(cached);
    }

    return this.gateway.listCatalog(code, 1, 100).pipe(
      map((page) => page.items.filter((item) => item.active)),
      tap((items) => this.store.set(code, items)),
    );
  }

  invalidateCatalog(code: ReferenceCatalogCode): void {
    this.store.remove(code);
  }

  departments(): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listDepartments();
  }

  provinces(departmentCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listProvinces(departmentCode);
  }

  districts(provinceCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listDistricts(provinceCode);
  }

  populationCenters(
    districtCode: string,
  ): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.gateway.listPopulationCenters(districtCode);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { ReferenceCatalogCode, ReferenceItem } from './reference-data.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ReferenceDataStore {
  private readonly catalogsSignal = signal<
    Readonly<Record<string, readonly ReferenceItem[]>>
  >({});

  readonly catalogs = this.catalogsSignal.asReadonly();

  get(code: ReferenceCatalogCode): readonly ReferenceItem[] | null {
    return this.catalogsSignal()[code] ?? null;
  }

  set(code: ReferenceCatalogCode, items: readonly ReferenceItem[]): void {
    this.catalogsSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [code]: [...items],
    }));
  }

  remove(code: ReferenceCatalogCode): void {
    this.catalogsSignal.update((current) => {
      const next = { ...current };
      delete next[code];
      return next;
    });
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.catalogsSignal.set({});
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { inject, Injectable, PLATFORM_ID } from '@angular/core';

import { DEVICE_STORAGE_KEY } from './session.constants';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DeviceIdService {
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);
  private memoryId: string | null = null;

  getOrCreate(): string {
    if (!isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)) {
      return this.memoryId ?? (this.memoryId = this.createId());
    }

    const existing = localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_STORAGE_KEY);

    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    const created = this.createId();
    localStorage.setItem(DEVICE_STORAGE_KEY, created);
    return created;
  }

  reset(): string {
    const created = this.createId();
    this.memoryId = created;

    if (isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)) {
      localStorage.setItem(DEVICE_STORAGE_KEY, created);
    }

    return created;
  }

  private createId(): string {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
      return crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}-${Math.random()
      .toString(36)
      .slice(2)}`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { computed, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import {
  EMPTY_SESSION_STATE,
  SessionState,
  SessionTokens,
} from './session-state.model';
import { TokenStorageService } from './token-storage.service';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SessionStore {
  private readonly storage = inject(TokenStorageService);
  private readonly stateSignal = signal<SessionState>(this.restore());

  readonly state = this.stateSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly authenticated = computed(() => this.stateSignal().authenticated);
  readonly tokens = computed(() => this.stateSignal().tokens);
  readonly accessToken = computed(
    () => this.stateSignal().tokens?.accessToken ?? null,
  );
  readonly refreshToken = computed(
    () => this.stateSignal().tokens?.refreshToken ?? null,
  );

  setTokens(tokens: SessionTokens): void {
    this.storage.write(tokens);
    this.stateSignal.set({
      authenticated: true,
      tokens,
    });
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.storage.clear();
    this.stateSignal.set(EMPTY_SESSION_STATE);
  }

  snapshot(): SessionState {
    return this.stateSignal();
  }

  private restore(): SessionState {
    const tokens = this.storage.read();

    if (!tokens) {
      return EMPTY_SESSION_STATE;
    }

    return {
      authenticated: true,
      tokens,
    };
  }
}
```

### 666. `src/app/core/session/token-storage.service.ts`

- Ruta: `src/app/core/session/token-storage.service.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\core\session\token-storage.service.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/core/session/token-storage.service.ts`

```typescript
import { isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { inject, Injectable, PLATFORM_ID } from '@angular/core';

import { SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS } from './session.constants';
import { SessionTokens } from './session-state.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class TokenStorageService {
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);

  read(): SessionTokens | null {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) {
      return null;
    }

    const accessToken = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.accessToken);
    const refreshToken = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.refreshToken);

    if (!accessToken || !refreshToken) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      accessTokenExpiresAt: sessionStorage.getItem(
        SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.accessTokenExpiresAt,
      ),
      refreshTokenExpiresAt: sessionStorage.getItem(
        SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.refreshTokenExpiresAt,
      ),
    };
  }

  write(tokens: SessionTokens): void {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) {
      return;
    }

    sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.accessToken, tokens.accessToken);
    sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.refreshToken, tokens.refreshToken);

    this.setOptional(
      SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.accessTokenExpiresAt,
      tokens.accessTokenExpiresAt,
    );
    this.setOptional(
      SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.refreshTokenExpiresAt,
      tokens.refreshTokenExpiresAt,
    );
  }

  clear(): void {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) {
      return;
    }

    Object.values(SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS).forEach((key) => {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
    });
  }

  private setOptional(key: string, value: string | null): void {
    if (value) {
      sessionStorage.setItem(key, value);
      return;
    }

    sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
  }

  private isBrowser(): boolean {
    return isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId);
  }
}
```

- Ruta: `src/app/core/ui/theme.service.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\core\ui\theme.service.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/core/ui/theme.service.ts`

```typescript
import { DOCUMENT, isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import { PLATFORM_ID, computed, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

export type AppTheme = 'light' | 'dark';

type DescoViewTransition = {
  finished: Promise<unknown>;
};

type ViewTransitionDocument = Document & {
  startViewTransition?: (updateCallback: () => void) => DescoViewTransition;
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ThemeService {
  private static readonly storageKey = 'desco.ui.theme';
  private static readonly commitClass = 'desco-theme-commit';
  private static readonly overlayClass = 'desco-theme-switch-overlay';

  private readonly document = inject(DOCUMENT);
  private readonly platformId = inject(PLATFORM_ID);
  private readonly browser = isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId);
  private readonly themeSignal = signal<AppTheme>(this.initialTheme());
  private readonly switchingSignal = signal(false);

  readonly theme = this.themeSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly isDark = computed(() => this.themeSignal() === 'dark');
  readonly switching = this.switchingSignal.asReadonly();

  constructor() {
    this.commit(this.themeSignal(), false);
  }

  set(theme: AppTheme): void {
    if (this.switchingSignal() || theme === this.themeSignal()) {
      return;
    }

    if (!this.browser || this.prefersReducedMotion()) {
      this.commit(theme);
      return;
    }

    this.switchingSignal.set(true);

    const transitionDocument = this.document as ViewTransitionDocument;

    if (typeof transitionDocument.startViewTransition === 'function') {
      this.runViewTransition(transitionDocument, theme);
      return;
    }

    this.runFallbackTransition(theme);
  }

  toggle(): void {
    this.set(this.themeSignal() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  }

  private initialTheme(): AppTheme {
    if (!this.browser) {
      return 'light';
    }

    const stored = localStorage.getItem(ThemeService.storageKey);

    if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'light') {
      return stored;
    }

    return window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
      ? 'dark'
      : 'light';
  }

  private runViewTransition(
    transitionDocument: ViewTransitionDocument,
    theme: AppTheme,
  ): void {
    try {
      const transition = transitionDocument.startViewTransition?.(() => {
        this.commit(theme);
      });

      if (!transition) {
        this.commit(theme);
        this.switchingSignal.set(false);
        return;
      }

      transition.finished
        .catch(() => undefined)
        .finally(() => this.switchingSignal.set(false));
    } catch {
      this.runFallbackTransition(theme);
    }
  }

  private runFallbackTransition(theme: AppTheme): void {
    const overlay = this.document.createElement('div');
    overlay.className = [
      ThemeService.overlayClass,
      `${ThemeService.overlayClass}--${theme}`,
    ].join(' ');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

    this.document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      overlay.classList.add(`${ThemeService.overlayClass}--visible`);

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        this.commit(theme);

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          overlay.classList.remove(`${ThemeService.overlayClass}--visible`);

          window.setTimeout(() => {
            overlay.remove();
            this.switchingSignal.set(false);
          }, 160);
        });
      }, 110);
    });
  }

  private commit(theme: AppTheme, persist = true): void {
    const html = this.document.documentElement;

    html.classList.add(ThemeService.commitClass);
    html.dataset['theme'] = theme;
    html.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark');
    html.style.colorScheme = theme;
    this.themeSignal.set(theme);

    if (this.browser && persist) {
      localStorage.setItem(ThemeService.storageKey, theme);
    }

    if (this.browser) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          html.classList.remove(ThemeService.commitClass);
        });
      });
    } else {
      html.classList.remove(ThemeService.commitClass);
    }
  }

  private prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
    return Boolean(
      this.browser &&
        window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches,
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Provider } from '@angular/core';

import { AUTH_GATEWAY } from './application/port/out/auth.gateway';
import { CerrarOtrasSesionesUseCase } from './application/use-case/cerrar-otras-sesiones.use-case';
import { CerrarSesionUseCase } from './application/use-case/cerrar-sesion.use-case';
import { ConfirmarValidacionCorreoUseCase } from './application/use-case/confirmar-validacion-correo.use-case';
import { LoginUseCase } from './application/use-case/login.use-case';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from './application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';
import { RefrescarSesionUseCase } from './application/use-case/refrescar-sesion.use-case';
import { RestablecerPasswordUseCase } from './application/use-case/restablecer-password.use-case';
import { SolicitarRecuperacionPasswordUseCase } from './application/use-case/solicitar-recuperacion-password.use-case';
import { SolicitarSegundoFactorUseCase } from './application/use-case/solicitar-segundo-factor.use-case';
import { SolicitarValidacionCorreoUseCase } from './application/use-case/solicitar-validacion-correo.use-case';
import { VerificarSegundoFactorUseCase } from './application/use-case/verificar-segundo-factor.use-case';
import { AuthFlowStore } from './adapter/in/ui/state/auth-flow.store';
import { AuthHttpAdapter } from './adapter/out/http/auth-http.adapter';
import { AuthHttpMapper } from './adapter/out/http/auth-http.mapper';

export function provideAcceso(): Provider[] {
  return [
    AuthFlowStore,
    AuthHttpMapper,
    AuthHttpAdapter,
    {
      provide: AUTH_GATEWAY,
      useExisting: AuthHttpAdapter,
    },
    LoginUseCase,
    SolicitarValidacionCorreoUseCase,
    ConfirmarValidacionCorreoUseCase,
    SolicitarSegundoFactorUseCase,
    VerificarSegundoFactorUseCase,
    SolicitarRecuperacionPasswordUseCase,
    RestablecerPasswordUseCase,
    RefrescarSesionUseCase,
    ObtenerContextoActualUseCase,
    CerrarSesionUseCase,
    CerrarOtrasSesionesUseCase,
  ];
}
```

```typescript
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivateFn, Router, Routes } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../core/access/access.service';
import { AccessStore } from '../../core/access/access.store';
import { SessionStore } from '../../core/session/session.store';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from './application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';

export const publicOnlyGuard: CanActivateFn = () => {
  const session = inject(SessionStore);
  const router = inject(Router);

  return session.authenticated()
    ? router.createUrlTree(['/inicio'])
    : true;
};

export const authenticatedGuard: CanActivateFn = (_route, state) => {
  const session = inject(SessionStore);
  const accessStore = inject(AccessStore);
  const accessService = inject(AccessService);
  const contextUseCase = inject(ObtenerContextoActualUseCase);
  const router = inject(Router);

  if (!session.authenticated()) {
    return router.createUrlTree(['/login']);
  }

  const mandatoryRoute = state.url.startsWith('/cambio-password-obligatorio');

  if (accessStore.loaded()) {
    const requiresChange = accessStore.user()?.requiereCambioPassword ?? false;

    return requiresChange && !mandatoryRoute
      ? router.createUrlTree(['/cambio-password-obligatorio'])
      : true;
  }

  return contextUseCase.execute().pipe(
    map((context) =>
      context.usuario.requiereCambioPassword && !mandatoryRoute
        ? router.createUrlTree(['/cambio-password-obligatorio'])
        : true,
    ),
    catchError(() => {
      session.clear();
      accessService.clear();
      return of(router.createUrlTree(['/login']));
    }),
  );
};

export const accesoRoutes: Routes = [
  {
    path: 'login',
    canActivate: [publicOnlyGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/login/login').then((m) => m.LoginPage),
  },
  {
    path: 'validacion-correo',
    canActivate: [publicOnlyGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/validacion-correo/validacion-correo').then(
        (m) => m.ValidacionCorreoPage,
      ),
  },
  {
    path: 'segundo-factor',
    canActivate: [publicOnlyGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/segundo-factor/segundo-factor').then(
        (m) => m.SegundoFactorPage,
      ),
  },
  {
    path: 'recuperar-password',
    canActivate: [publicOnlyGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/recuperar-password/recuperar-password').then(
        (m) => m.RecuperarPasswordPage,
      ),
  },
  {
    path: 'restablecer-password',
    canActivate: [publicOnlyGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import(
        './adapter/in/ui/pages/restablecer-password/restablecer-password'
      ).then((m) => m.RestablecerPasswordPage),
  },
  {
    path: 'cambio-password-obligatorio',
    canActivate: [authenticatedGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import(
        './adapter/in/ui/pages/cambio-password-obligatorio/cambio-password-obligatorio'
      ).then((m) => m.CambioPasswordObligatorioPage),
  },
];
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.auth-page {
  --auth-page-bg: #f4f7fb;
  --auth-card-bg: #ffffff;
  --auth-info-bg: #eef4ff;
  --auth-form-bg: #fbfdff;
  --auth-surface: #ffffff;
  --auth-surface-soft: #f8fafc;
  --auth-surface-hover: #f1f5f9;
  --auth-text: #172033;
  --auth-text-soft: #344054;
  --auth-muted: #667085;
  --auth-placeholder: #98a2b3;
  --auth-border: #d0d5dd;
  --auth-border-soft: #dce5f0;
  --auth-primary: #2563eb;
  --auth-primary-hover: #1d4ed8;
  --auth-primary-pressed: #1e40af;
  --auth-primary-text: #1d4ed8;
  --auth-primary-soft: #eff6ff;
  --auth-primary-border: #bfdbfe;
  --auth-error-bg: #fef2f2;
  --auth-error-border: #fecaca;
  --auth-error-text: #b91c1c;
  --auth-warning-bg: #fff7ed;
  --auth-warning-border: #fed7aa;
  --auth-warning-text: #9a3412;
  --auth-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.1);
  --auth-shadow-soft: 0 12px 30px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
  --auth-focus: rgb(37 99 235 / 0.16);

  display: grid;
  min-height: 100vh;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--auth-page-bg);
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
  color-scheme: light;
}

:host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .auth-page,
:host-context(html.dark) .auth-page {
  --auth-page-bg: #000000;
  --auth-card-bg: #080808;
  --auth-info-bg: #050505;
  --auth-form-bg: #050505;
  --auth-surface: #0d0d0d;
  --auth-surface-soft: #111111;
  --auth-surface-hover: #171717;
  --auth-text: #f8fafc;
  --auth-text-soft: #e5e7eb;
  --auth-muted: #a3a3a3;
  --auth-placeholder: #737373;
  --auth-border: #404040;
  --auth-border-soft: #262626;
  --auth-primary: #2563eb;
  --auth-primary-hover: #3b82f6;
  --auth-primary-pressed: #1d4ed8;
  --auth-primary-text: #60a5fa;
  --auth-primary-soft: #0b1f3a;
  --auth-primary-border: #1d4ed8;
  --auth-error-bg: #220b0b;
  --auth-error-border: #7f1d1d;
  --auth-error-text: #fca5a5;
  --auth-warning-bg: #211609;
  --auth-warning-border: #854d0e;
  --auth-warning-text: #facc15;
  --auth-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5);
  --auth-shadow-soft: 0 12px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);
  --auth-focus: rgb(59 130 246 / 0.24);
  color-scheme: dark;
}

.auth-card {
  display: grid;
  width: min(100%, 62rem);
  min-height: min(38rem, calc(100vh - 3rem));
  grid-template-columns: minmax(19rem, 0.9fr) minmax(24rem, 1.1fr);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--auth-border-soft);
  border-radius: 1.8rem;
  background: var(--auth-card-bg);
  box-shadow: var(--auth-shadow);
}

.auth-info-panel {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--auth-border-soft);
  background: var(--auth-info-bg);
  padding: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.3rem);
  color: var(--auth-text);
}

.auth-info-panel::before,
.auth-info-panel::after {
  position: absolute;
  border: 1px solid var(--auth-primary-border);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  content: '';
  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.auth-info-panel::before {
  top: -8rem;
  left: -8rem;
  width: 17rem;
  height: 17rem;
}

.auth-info-panel::after {
  right: -6rem;
  bottom: -7rem;
  width: 15rem;
  height: 15rem;
}

.auth-brand,
.auth-mobile-brand {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.auth-logo {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.65rem;
  height: 2.65rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--auth-primary-border);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--auth-surface);
  color: var(--auth-primary-text);
  box-shadow: var(--auth-shadow-soft);
}

.auth-brand-identity {
  min-width: 0;
}

.auth-brand-name {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--auth-text);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.auth-brand-unit {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: var(--auth-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.auth-illustration-area {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  min-height: 0;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 1.25rem 1rem 0.9rem;
}

.auth-illustration {
  display: block;
  width: min(100%, 17.5rem);
  height: auto;
  max-height: min(48vh, 25rem);
}

.auth-info-copy {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 20rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--auth-border-soft);
  padding-top: 1.15rem;
}

.auth-info-kicker {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--auth-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.67rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.auth-info-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--auth-text);
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.auth-info-location {
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  color: var(--auth-muted);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.auth-form-panel {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--auth-form-bg);
  padding: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.25rem);
}

.auth-card-wrap {
  width: min(100%, 27rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.auth-mobile-brand {
  display: none;
  width: min(100%, 27rem);
  margin: 0 auto 2rem;
}

.auth-theme-toggle {
  position: fixed;
  top: 1rem;
  right: 1rem;
  z-index: 50;
  display: grid;
  width: 2.8rem;
  height: 2.8rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--auth-border);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--auth-surface);
  color: var(--auth-text);
  box-shadow: var(--auth-shadow-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.auth-theme-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--auth-primary-border);
  background: var(--auth-surface-hover);
  color: var(--auth-primary-text);
}

.auth-theme-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--auth-focus);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.auth-theme-toggle:disabled {
  cursor: wait;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .auth-card {
    width: min(100%, 33rem);
    min-height: auto;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .auth-info-panel {
    display: none;
  }

  .auth-form-panel {
    min-height: min(37rem, calc(100vh - 2.5rem));
    padding: clamp(1.75rem, 7vw, 3rem);
  }

  .auth-mobile-brand {
    display: flex;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .auth-page {
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .auth-form-panel {
    min-height: 100vh;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .auth-mobile-brand {
    margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
  }

  .auth-card-wrap {
    margin: auto 0;
  }

  .auth-theme-toggle {
    top: 0.75rem;
    right: 0.75rem;
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/in/ui/pages/cambio-password-obligatorio/cambio-password-obligatorio.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCheck,
  faKey,
  faLock,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { CambiarPasswordUseCase } from '../../../../../../mi-cuenta/application/use-case/cambiar-password.use-case';
import { AuthLayoutComponent } from '../../layout/auth-layout/auth-layout';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-cambio-password-obligatorio-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    AuthLayoutComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './cambio-password-obligatorio.html',
  styleUrl: './cambio-password-obligatorio.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CambioPasswordObligatorioPage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly useCase = inject(CambiarPasswordUseCase);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionStore);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly keyIcon = faKey;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly checkIcon = faCheck;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    passwordActual: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(128)]],
    nuevoPassword: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(12), Validators.maxLength(128)],
    ],
    confirmarPassword: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(12), Validators.maxLength(128)],
    ],
  });

  submit(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();

    if (values.nuevoPassword !== values.confirmarPassword) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Las contraseñas deben coincidir.');
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.useCase
      .execute(values)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.session.clear();
          this.access.clear();
          this.toast.success(
            'Contraseña actualizada',
            'Inicia sesión nuevamente para continuar.',
          );
          void this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
<app-auth-layout>
  <section class="auth-form-card">
    <header class="auth-form-header">
      <h1>Iniciar sesión</h1>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div
        class="auth-inline-error"
        role="alert"
      >
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form
      class="auth-login-form"
      [formGroup]="form"
      (ngSubmit)="submit()"
      autocomplete="on"
    >
      <div class="auth-field">
        <label
          class="auth-label"
          for="nombreUsuario"
        >
          Usuario
        </label>

        <div class="auth-input-wrap">
          <span
            class="auth-input-icon"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="userIcon" />
          </span>

          <input
            id="nombreUsuario"
            name="username"
            type="text"
            class="auth-input"
            formControlName="nombreUsuario"
            autocomplete="username"
            autocapitalize="none"
            spellcheck="false"
            placeholder="Nombre de usuario"
            [readOnly]="loading()"
          />
        </div>

        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombreUsuario"
          fieldLabel="El usuario"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="auth-field">
        <div class="auth-password-row">
          <label
            class="auth-label"
            for="current-password"
          >
            Contraseña
          </label>

          <a
            routerLink="/recuperar-password"
            class="auth-forgot-link"
          >
            Olvidé mi contraseña
          </a>
        </div>

        <div class="auth-input-wrap">
          <span
            class="auth-input-icon"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
          </span>

          <input
            id="current-password"
            name="password"
            [type]="passwordVisible() ? 'text' : 'password'"
            class="auth-input auth-input-password"
            formControlName="password"
            autocomplete="current-password"
            placeholder="Contraseña"
            [readOnly]="loading()"
          />

          <button
            type="button"
            class="auth-password-toggle"
            [disabled]="loading()"
            [attr.aria-label]="passwordVisible() ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Mostrar contraseña'"
            [attr.aria-pressed]="passwordVisible()"
            (click)="passwordVisible.set(!passwordVisible())"
          >
            <fa-icon
              [icon]="passwordVisible() ? eyeSlashIcon : eyeIcon"
            />
          </button>
        </div>

        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.password"
          fieldLabel="La contraseña"
        />
      </div>

      <button
        type="submit"
        class="auth-primary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        [attr.aria-busy]="loading()"
      >
        @if (loading()) {

            class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"
          ></span>
          <span>Ingresando...</span>
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\acceso\adapter\in\ui\pages\login\login.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/in/ui/pages/login/login.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRight,
  faEye,
  faEyeSlash,
  faLock,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { LoginUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/login.use-case';
import { AuthLayoutComponent } from '../../layout/auth-layout/auth-layout';
import { AuthFlowStore } from '../../state/auth-flow.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-login-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    AuthLayoutComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './login.html',
  styleUrl: './login.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class LoginPage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly loginUseCase = inject(LoginUseCase);
  private readonly flow = inject(AuthFlowStore);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly passwordVisible = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly continueIcon = faArrowRight;
  readonly eyeIcon = faEye;
  readonly eyeSlashIcon = faEyeSlash;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    nombreUsuario: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.maxLength(80),
      ],
    ],
    password: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.maxLength(128),
      ],
    ],
  });

  submit(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.loginUseCase
      .execute(this.form.getRawValue())
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          if (
            result.paso ===
            'EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'
          ) {
            this.flow.setChallenge(result.desafio);
            this.toast.info(
              'Verifica tu correo',
              'Ingresa el código enviado a tu correo de seguridad.',
            );
            void this.router.navigate([
              '/validacion-correo',
            ]);
            return;
          }

          if (
            result.paso ===
            'TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED'
          ) {
            this.flow.setChallenge(result.desafio);
            this.toast.info(
              'Verificación adicional',
              'Te enviamos un código de seguridad para completar el acceso.',
            );
            void this.router.navigate([
              '/segundo-factor',
            ]);
            return;
          }

          this.flow.clear();

          if (
            result.contexto?.usuario
              .requiereCambioPassword
          ) {
            this.toast.success(
              'Credenciales verificadas',
              'Actualiza tu contraseña para terminar de configurar el acceso.',
            );
            void this.router.navigate([
              '/cambio-password-obligatorio',
            ]);
            return;
          }

          this.toast.success(
            'Bienvenido',
            'Inicio de sesión exitoso.',
          );

          void this.router.navigate(['/inicio']);
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message =
            mapOpenApiError(error).message;

          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo iniciar sesión',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faEnvelope,
  faKey,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { SolicitarRecuperacionPasswordUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/solicitar-recuperacion-password.use-case';
import { AuthLayoutComponent } from '../../layout/auth-layout/auth-layout';
import { AuthFlowStore } from '../../state/auth-flow.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recuperar-password-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    AuthLayoutComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './recuperar-password.html',
  styleUrl: './recuperar-password.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecuperarPasswordPage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly useCase = inject(SolicitarRecuperacionPasswordUseCase);
  private readonly flow = inject(AuthFlowStore);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly keyIcon = faKey;
  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly mailIcon = faEnvelope;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    nombreUsuario: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
  });

  submit(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    const nombreUsuario = this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.value.trim();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.useCase
      .execute(nombreUsuario)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.flow.setRecoveryUser(nombreUsuario);
          void this.router.navigate(['/restablecer-password'], {
            queryParams: { usuario: nombreUsuario },
          });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
      <h2>Nueva contraseña</h2>
      <p>Ingresa el código recibido y define una nueva contraseña.</p>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="auth-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>

    <form class="mt-6 space-y-4" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="submit()">
      <div>

          <fa-icon class="auth-input-icon" [icon]="userIcon" />

            class="auth-control auth-control-icon"
            type="text"
            formControlName="nombreUsuario"
            autocomplete="username"
          />
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombreUsuario"
          fieldLabel="El usuario"
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <label class="auth-label" for="codigoReset">Código</label>
        <input
          id="codigoReset"
          class="auth-control auth-code"
          type="text"
          formControlName="codigo"
          inputmode="numeric"
          autocomplete="one-time-code"
          maxlength="8"
          placeholder="000000"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.codigo"
          fieldLabel="El código"
          [messages]="{ pattern: 'Ingresa un código válido de 6 a 8 dígitos.' }"
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <label class="auth-label" for="nuevoPassword">Nueva contraseña</label>
        <div class="auth-input-wrap">
          <fa-icon class="auth-input-icon" [icon]="lockIcon" />
          <input
            id="nuevoPassword"
            class="auth-control auth-control-icon auth-control-password"
            [type]="showPassword() ? 'text' : 'password'"
            formControlName="nuevoPassword"
            autocomplete="new-password"
            placeholder="Mínimo 12 caracteres"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            class="auth-password-toggle"
            (click)="showPassword.set(!showPassword())"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="showPassword() ? eyeSlashIcon : eyeIcon" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nuevoPassword"
          fieldLabel="La nueva contraseña"
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <label class="auth-label" for="confirmarPassword">Confirmar contraseña</label>
        <div class="auth-input-wrap">
          <fa-icon class="auth-input-icon" [icon]="checkIcon" />
          <input
            id="confirmarPassword"
            class="auth-control auth-control-icon"
            [type]="showPassword() ? 'text' : 'password'"
            formControlName="confirmarPassword"
            autocomplete="new-password"
          />
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.confirmarPassword"
          fieldLabel="La confirmación"

    </form>

      Volver
    </a>
  </section>
</app-auth-layout>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faCheck,
  faEye,
  faEyeSlash,
  faKey,
  faLock,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { RestablecerPasswordUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/restablecer-password.use-case';
import { AuthLayoutComponent } from '../../layout/auth-layout/auth-layout';
import { AuthFlowStore } from '../../state/auth-flow.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-restablecer-password-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    AuthLayoutComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './restablecer-password.html',
  styleUrl: './restablecer-password.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RestablecerPasswordPage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly useCase = inject(RestablecerPasswordUseCase);
  private readonly flow = inject(AuthFlowStore);
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly showPassword = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly keyIcon = faKey;
  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly checkIcon = faCheck;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly eyeIcon = faEye;
  readonly eyeSlashIcon = faEyeSlash;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    nombreUsuario: [
      this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('usuario') ||
        this.flow.recoveryUser() ||
        '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)],
    ],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6,8}$/)]],
    nuevoPassword: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(12), Validators.maxLength(128)],
    ],
    confirmarPassword: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(12), Validators.maxLength(128)],
    ],
  });

  submit(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();

    if (values.nuevoPassword !== values.confirmarPassword) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Las contraseñas deben coincidir.');
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.useCase
      .execute(values)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.flow.clear();
          this.toast.success(
            'Contraseña actualizada',
            'Ya puedes iniciar sesión con tu nueva contraseña.',
          );
          void this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
<app-auth-layout>
  <section class="auth-step-card">
    <header class="auth-step-header">
      <div class="auth-step-icon">
        <fa-icon [icon]="shieldIcon" />
      </div>

      <div class="auth-step-heading">
        <span class="auth-step-kicker">
          Verificación de seguridad
        </span>
        <h1>Confirma tu acceso</h1>
        <p>
          Ingresa el código de 6 dígitos enviado a
          <strong>
            {{
              challenge()?.correoEnmascarado ||
              'tu correo de seguridad'
            }}
          </strong>.
        </p>
      </div>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div
        class="auth-inline-error"
        role="alert"
      >
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form
      class="auth-step-form"
      [formGroup]="form"
      (ngSubmit)="submit()"
    >
      <fieldset
        class="auth-otp-fieldset"
        [disabled]="loading() || resending()"
      >
        <legend>Código de seguridad</legend>

        <div
          class="auth-otp-group"
          role="group"
          aria-label="Código de seguridad de 6 dígitos"
          (paste)="onPaste($event)"
        >
          @for (
            index of otpIndexes;
            track index
          ) {
            <input
              #otpInput
              class="auth-otp-input"
              type="text"
              inputmode="numeric"
              [attr.autocomplete]="index === 0 ? 'one-time-code' : 'off'"
              maxlength="1"
              [value]="digitAt(index)"
              [attr.aria-label]="'Dígito ' + (index + 1)"
              (input)="onDigitInput($event, index)"
              (keydown)="onDigitKeydown($event, index)"
            />
          }
        </div>

        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.codigo"
          fieldLabel="El código"
          [messages]="{
            pattern: 'Ingresa los 6 dígitos del código de seguridad.'
          }"
        />
      </fieldset>

      <div class="auth-security-note">
        <span
          class="auth-security-note-icon"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="mailIcon" />
        </span>
        <p>
          Usa siempre el último código recibido.
          Los códigos anteriores dejan de ser válidos.
        </p>
      </div>

      <button
        class="auth-primary-button"
        type="submit"
        [disabled]="loading() || resending()"
        [attr.aria-busy]="loading()"
      >
        @if (loading()) {
          <span
            class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"
          ></span>
          <span>Verificando...</span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="shieldIcon" />
          <span>Verificar y continuar</span>
        }
      </button>
    </form>

    <div class="auth-step-actions">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="auth-link-button"
        [disabled]="resending() || loading()"
        [attr.aria-busy]="resending()"
        (click)="resend()"
      >
        @if (resending()) {
          <span
            class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"
          ></span>
          <span>Enviando...</span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="resendIcon" />
          <span>Reenviar código</span>
        }
      </button>

      <a
        routerLink="/login"
        class="auth-back-link"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        <span>Volver</span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </section>
</app-auth-layout>
```
