```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  OnInit,
  QueryList,
  ViewChildren,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faEnvelope,
  faRotateRight,
  faShieldHalved,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { SolicitarSegundoFactorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/solicitar-segundo-factor.use-case';
import { VerificarSegundoFactorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/verificar-segundo-factor.use-case';
import { AuthLayoutComponent } from '../../layout/auth-layout/auth-layout';
import { AuthFlowStore } from '../../state/auth-flow.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-segundo-factor-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    AuthLayoutComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './segundo-factor.html',
  styleUrl: './segundo-factor.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SegundoFactorPage
  implements OnInit
{
  @ViewChildren('otpInput')
  private readonly otpInputs!:
    QueryList<ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly verifyUseCase =
    inject(VerificarSegundoFactorUseCase);
  private readonly requestUseCase =
    inject(SolicitarSegundoFactorUseCase);
  private readonly flow = inject(AuthFlowStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly resending = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage =
    signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly challenge = this.flow.challenge;

  readonly otpIndexes =
    [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as const;

  readonly shieldIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly mailIcon = faEnvelope;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly resendIcon = faRotateRight;

  readonly form =
    this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      codigo: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/),
        ],
      ],
    });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const challenge = this.challenge();

    if (
      !challenge?.usuarioId ||
      !challenge.correlacionId
    ) {
      void this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    }
  }

  digitAt(index: number): string {
    return this.form.controls.codigo
      .value
      .charAt(index);
  }

  onDigitInput(
    event: Event,
    index: number,
  ): void {
    const input =
      event.target as HTMLInputElement;

    const raw =
      input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');

    if (raw.length > 1) {
      this.applyCode(raw);
      return;
    }

    const digit = raw.slice(-1);
    const digits = this.currentDigits();

    digits[index] = digit;

    this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(
      digits.join(''),
    );

    input.value = digit;

    if (
      digit &&
      index < this.otpIndexes.length - 1
    ) {
      this.focusInput(index + 1);
    }
  }

  onDigitKeydown(
    event: KeyboardEvent,
    index: number,
  ): void {
    const input =
      event.target as HTMLInputElement;

    if (
      event.key === 'Backspace' &&
      !input.value &&
      index > 0
    ) {
      event.preventDefault();

      const digits = this.currentDigits();
      digits[index - 1] = '';

      this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(
        digits.join(''),
      );

      this.focusInput(index - 1);
      return;
    }

    if (
      event.key === 'ArrowLeft' &&
      index > 0
    ) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusInput(index - 1);
      return;
    }

    if (
      event.key === 'ArrowRight' &&
      index <
        this.otpIndexes.length - 1
    ) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusInput(index + 1);
    }
  }

  onPaste(event: ClipboardEvent): void {
    const clipboard =
      event.clipboardData
        ?.getData('text') ?? '';

    const code =
      clipboard
        .replace(/\D/g, '')
        .slice(0, 6);

    if (!code) {
      return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    this.applyCode(code);
  }

  submit(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    const challenge = this.challenge();

    if (
      this.form.invalid ||
      this.loading() ||
      this.resending() ||
      !challenge?.usuarioId ||
      !challenge.correlacionId
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.verifyUseCase
      .execute({
        usuarioId: challenge.usuarioId,
        correlacionId:
          challenge.correlacionId,
        codigo:
          this.form.controls.codigo.value,
      })
      .pipe(
        finalize(() =>
          this.loading.set(false),
        ),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.flow.clearChallenge();

          this.toast.success(
            'Acceso verificado',
            'El código es correcto y tu sesión se inició correctamente.',
          );

          if (
            result.contexto?.usuario
              .requiereCambioPassword
          ) {
            void this.router.navigate([
              '/cambio-password-obligatorio',
            ]);
            return;
          }

          void this.router.navigate(['/inicio']);
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message =
            mapOpenApiError(error).message;

          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'Código no válido',
            message,
          );

          this.selectFirstInput();
        },
      });
  }

  resend(): void {
    const challenge = this.challenge();

    if (
      this.resending() ||
      this.loading() ||
      !challenge?.usuarioId ||
      !challenge.correlacionId
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resending.set(true);

    this.requestUseCase
      .execute({
        usuarioId: challenge.usuarioId,
        correlacionId:
          challenge.correlacionId,
      })
      .pipe(
        finalize(() =>
          this.resending.set(false),
        ),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (nextChallenge) => {
          this.flow.setChallenge(
            nextChallenge,
          );
          this.clearCode();

          this.toast.success(
            'Nuevo código enviado',
            'Revisa tu correo de seguridad e ingresa el último código recibido.',
          );
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message =
            mapOpenApiError(error).message;

          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reenviar el código',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private currentDigits(): string[] {
    const value =
      this.form.controls.codigo.value;

    return Array.from(
      {
        length:
          this.otpIndexes.length,
      },
      (_, index) =>
        value.charAt(index),
    );
  }

  private applyCode(value: string): void {
    const code =
      value
        .replace(/\D/g, '')
        .slice(0, 6);

    this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(
      code,
    );

    this.otpInputs.forEach(
      (reference, index) => {
        reference.nativeElement.value =
          code.charAt(index);
      },
    );

    this.focusInput(
      Math.min(
        code.length,
        this.otpIndexes.length - 1,
      ),
    );
  }

  private clearCode(): void {
    this.form.controls.codigo.setValue('');

    this.otpInputs.forEach(
      (reference) => {
        reference.nativeElement.value = '';
      },
    );

    this.focusInput(0);
  }

  private selectFirstInput(): void {
    const first =
      this.otpInputs.get(0)
        ?.nativeElement;

    first?.focus();
    first?.select();
  }

  private focusInput(index: number): void {
    const input =
      this.otpInputs.get(index)
        ?.nativeElement;

    input?.focus();
    input?.select();
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faEnvelopeCircleCheck,
  faPaperPlane,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { ConfirmarValidacionCorreoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/confirmar-validacion-correo.use-case';
import { SolicitarValidacionCorreoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/solicitar-validacion-correo.use-case';
import { AuthLayoutComponent } from '../../layout/auth-layout/auth-layout';
import { AuthFlowStore } from '../../state/auth-flow.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-validacion-correo-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    AuthLayoutComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './validacion-correo.html',
  styleUrl: './validacion-correo.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ValidacionCorreoPage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly confirmUseCase = inject(ConfirmarValidacionCorreoUseCase);
  private readonly requestUseCase = inject(SolicitarValidacionCorreoUseCase);
  private readonly flow = inject(AuthFlowStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly resending = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly challenge = this.flow.challenge;

  readonly mailIcon = faEnvelopeCircleCheck;
  readonly sendIcon = faPaperPlane;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    nombreUsuario: [
      this.challenge()?.nombreUsuario ?? '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)],
    ],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6,8}$/)]],
  });

  submit(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loading.set(true);

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();
    const challenge = this.challenge();

    this.confirmUseCase
      .execute({
        usuarioId: challenge?.usuarioId,
        nombreUsuario: values.nombreUsuario,
        correlacionId: challenge?.correlacionId,
        codigo: values.codigo,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.flow.clearChallenge();
          this.toast.success(
            'Correo verificado',
            'Ya puedes iniciar sesión con tu cuenta.',
          );
          void this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  resend(): void {
    const nombreUsuario = this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.value.trim();

    if (!nombreUsuario || this.resending()) {
      this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.markAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.resending.set(true);

    this.requestUseCase
      .execute(nombreUsuario)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.resending.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () =>
          this.toast.info(
            'Código enviado',
            'Revisa tu correo de seguridad.',
          ),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { AuthChallenge } from '../../../../domain/auth-challenge.model';

@Injectable()
export class AuthFlowStore {
  private readonly challengeSignal = signal<AuthChallenge | null>(null);
  private readonly recoveryUserSignal = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly challenge = this.challengeSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly recoveryUser = this.recoveryUserSignal.asReadonly();

  setChallenge(challenge: AuthChallenge | null): void {
    this.challengeSignal.set(challenge);
  }

  clearChallenge(): void {
    this.challengeSignal.set(null);
  }

  setRecoveryUser(nombreUsuario: string | null): void {
    this.recoveryUserSignal.set(nombreUsuario?.trim() || null);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.challengeSignal.set(null);
    this.recoveryUserSignal.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpContext } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import {
  SKIP_ACCESS_TOKEN,
  SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH,
} from '../../../../../core/http/context/http-context.tokens';
import {
  AutenticacinService,
  EmailVerificationConfirmRequest,
  EmailVerificationRequest,
  LoginRequest,
  PasswordRecoveryRequest,
  PasswordResetRequest,
  RefreshTokenRequest,
  TwoFactorRequest,
  TwoFactorVerifyRequest,
} from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import {
  AuthGateway,
  EmailVerificationConfirmation,
  LoginCredentials,
  PasswordResetInput,
  TwoFactorChallengeInput,
  TwoFactorVerificationInput,
} from '../../../application/port/out/auth.gateway';
import { AuthHttpMapper } from './auth-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class AuthHttpAdapter implements AuthGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(AutenticacinService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(AuthHttpMapper);

  login(credentials: LoginCredentials) {
    const loginRequest: LoginRequest = credentials;

    return this.api
      .authLogin(
        { loginRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.flow(response)));
  }

  requestEmailVerification(nombreUsuario: string) {
    const emailVerificationRequest: EmailVerificationRequest = {
      nombreUsuario,
    };

    return this.api
      .authRequestEmailVerification(
        { emailVerificationRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  confirmEmailVerification(input: EmailVerificationConfirmation) {
    const emailVerificationConfirmRequest: EmailVerificationConfirmRequest = {
      usuarioId: input.usuarioId ?? undefined,
      nombreUsuario: input.nombreUsuario ?? undefined,
      correlacionId: input.correlacionId ?? undefined,
      codigo: input.codigo,
    };

    return this.api
      .authConfirmEmailVerification(
        { emailVerificationConfirmRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  requestTwoFactor(input: TwoFactorChallengeInput) {
    const twoFactorRequest: TwoFactorRequest = input;

    return this.api
      .authRequestTwoFactor(
        { twoFactorRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.challengeResponse(response)));
  }

  verifyTwoFactor(input: TwoFactorVerificationInput) {
    const twoFactorVerifyRequest: TwoFactorVerifyRequest = input;

    return this.api
      .authVerifyTwoFactor(
        { twoFactorVerifyRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.flow(response)));
  }

  requestPasswordRecovery(nombreUsuario: string) {
    const passwordRecoveryRequest: PasswordRecoveryRequest = {
      nombreUsuario,
    };

    return this.api
      .authRequestPasswordRecovery(
        { passwordRecoveryRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  resetPassword(input: PasswordResetInput) {
    const passwordResetRequest: PasswordResetRequest = input;

    return this.api
      .authResetPassword(
        { passwordResetRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  refresh(refreshToken: string) {
    const refreshTokenRequest: RefreshTokenRequest = { refreshToken };

    return this.api
      .authRefresh(
        { refreshTokenRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        this.publicOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.refresh(response)));
  }

  currentContext() {
    return this.api
      .authGetCurrentUser(
        undefined,
        'body',
        false,
        this.privateOptions(),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.currentContext(response)));
  }

  logout() {
    return this.api
      .authLogout(
        undefined,
        'body',
        false,
        this.privateOptions(true),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  logoutOthers() {
    return this.api
      .authLogoutOthers(
        undefined,
        'body',
        false,
        this.privateOptions(true),
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  private publicOptions() {
    return {
      context: new HttpContext()
        .set(SKIP_ACCESS_TOKEN, true)
        .set(SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH, true),
      transferCache: false,
    };
  }

  private privateOptions(skipRefresh = false) {
    const context = new HttpContext();

    if (skipRefresh) {
      context.set(SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH, true);
    }

    return {
      context,
      transferCache: false,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { ApiEnvelope } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import {
  AuthContext,
  AuthFlowResult,
  AuthRefreshResult,
} from '../../../domain/auth-context.model';
import { AuthChallenge } from '../../../domain/auth-challenge.model';
import { AuthStep } from '../../../domain/auth-step.model';
import { AuthToken } from '../../../domain/auth-token.model';

type RecordValue = Record<string, unknown>;

@Injectable()
export class AuthHttpMapper {
  envelopeData<T>(response: unknown): T {
    const envelope = this.record(response) as ApiEnvelope<T>;
    if (envelope.exitoso === false) {
      throw new Error(envelope.mensaje || 'La operación no pudo completarse.');
    }
    return envelope.datos as T;
  }

  flow(response: unknown): AuthFlowResult {
    const data = this.record(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));
    return {
      paso: this.authStep(data['paso']),
      tokens: this.token(data['tokens']),
      contexto: this.context(data['contexto']),
      desafio: this.challenge(data['desafio']),
    };
  }

  refresh(response: unknown): AuthRefreshResult {
    const data = this.record(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));
    const tokens = this.token(data['tokens']);
    const contexto = this.context(data['contexto']);
    if (!tokens || !contexto) throw new Error('No se pudo renovar la sesión.');
    return { tokens, contexto };
  }

  currentContext(response: unknown): AuthContext {
    const context = this.context(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));
    if (!context) throw new Error('No se pudo obtener la información de la sesión.');
    return context;
  }

  challengeResponse(response: unknown): AuthChallenge {
    const challenge = this.challenge(this.envelopeData<unknown>(response));
    if (!challenge) throw new Error('No se pudo continuar con la verificación.');
    return challenge;
  }

  voidResponse(response: unknown): void {
    const envelope = this.record(response) as ApiEnvelope<unknown>;
    if (envelope.exitoso === false) {
      throw new Error(envelope.mensaje || 'La operación no pudo completarse.');
    }
  }

  private token(value: unknown): AuthToken | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return null;
    const row = this.record(value);
    const accessToken = this.string(row['accessToken']);
    const refreshToken = this.string(row['refreshToken']);
    if (!accessToken || !refreshToken) return null;
    return {
      accessToken,
      tokenType: this.string(row['tokenType']) || 'Bearer',
      accessTokenExpiraUtc: this.nullableString(row['accessTokenExpiraUtc']),
      refreshToken,
      refreshTokenExpiraUtc: this.nullableString(row['refreshTokenExpiraUtc']),
      sesionPublicaId: this.nullableString(row['sesionPublicaId']),
    };
  }

  private challenge(value: unknown): AuthChallenge | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return null;
    const row = this.record(value);
    return {
      paso: this.authStep(row['paso']),
      usuarioId: this.nullableNumber(row['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.nullableString(row['nombreUsuario']),
      correlacionId: this.nullableString(row['correlacionId']),
      correoEnmascarado: this.nullableString(row['correoEnmascarado']),
    };
  }

  private context(value: unknown): AuthContext | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return null;

    const row = this.record(value);
    const user = this.record(row['usuario']);

    const permissions = this.array(row['permisos']).map((item) => {
      const permission = this.record(item);
      const moduleCode = this.firstString(permission, 'codigoModulo', 'moduloCodigo');
      const action = this.firstString(permission, 'accion');
      const code =
        this.firstString(permission, 'codigo', 'codigoPermiso') ||
        this.derivedPermissionCode(moduleCode, action);

      return {
        permisoId: this.nullableNumber(permission['permisoId']),
        moduloId: this.nullableNumber(permission['moduloId']),
        codigoModulo: moduleCode,
        codigo: code,
        nombre: this.firstNullableString(permission, 'nombre', 'nombrePermiso'),
        descripcion: this.nullableString(permission['descripcion']),
        accion: action,
        sensible: this.boolean(permission['sensible'] ?? permission['esSensible']),
        requiereMotivo: this.boolean(permission['requiereMotivo']),
      };
    });

    const moduleCodes = new Map<number, string>();
    for (const permission of permissions) {
      if (permission.moduloId && permission.codigoModulo) {
        moduleCodes.set(permission.moduloId, permission.codigoModulo);
      }
    }

    const modules = this.array(row['modulos']).map((item) => {
      const module = this.record(item);
      const moduleId = this.number(module['moduloId']);
      const code =
        this.firstString(module, 'codigo', 'codigoModulo') ||
        moduleCodes.get(moduleId) ||
        '';
      const name = this.firstString(module, 'nombre', 'nombreModulo') || this.humanize(code);

      return {
        moduloId: moduleId,
        moduloPadreId: this.nullableNumber(module['moduloPadreId']),
        codigo: code,
        nombre: name,
        orden: this.number(module['orden']),
        ruta: this.nullableString(module['ruta']),
        icono: this.nullableString(module['icono']),
        visibleMenu: this.boolean(module['visibleMenu']),
        grupo: this.boolean(module['grupo'] ?? module['esGrupo']),
      };
    });

    return {
      usuario: {
        usuarioId: this.number(user['usuarioId']),
        nombreUsuario: this.string(user['nombreUsuario']),
        estadoCuenta: this.nullableString(user['estadoCuenta']),
        ultimoAccesoCorrectoUtc: this.nullableString(user['ultimoAccesoCorrectoUtc']),
        requiereCambioPassword: this.boolean(user['requiereCambioPassword']),
        segundoFactorHabilitado: this.boolean(user['segundoFactorHabilitado']),
        tokenVersion: this.nullableNumber(user['tokenVersion']),
        personaId: this.nullableNumber(user['personaId']),
        tipoDocumento: this.nullableString(user['tipoDocumento']),
        numeroDocumento: this.nullableString(user['numeroDocumento']),
        nombres: this.nullableString(user['nombres']),
        apellidoPaterno: this.nullableString(user['apellidoPaterno']),
        apellidoMaterno: this.nullableString(user['apellidoMaterno']),
        nombreCompleto: this.nullableString(user['nombreCompleto']),
        telefono: this.nullableString(user['telefono']),
        codigoEmpleado: this.nullableString(user['codigoEmpleado']),
        empresaId: this.nullableNumber(user['empresaId']),
        correoSeguridad: this.nullableString(user['correoSeguridad']),
        correoSeguridadVerificado: this.boolean(user['correoSeguridadVerificado']),
        sesionPublicaId: this.nullableString(user['sesionPublicaId']),
        fechaSesionUtc: this.nullableString(user['fechaSesionUtc']),
        fechaExpiracionRenovacionUtc: this.nullableString(user['fechaExpiracionRenovacionUtc']),
        dispositivoUsuarioId: this.nullableNumber(user['dispositivoUsuarioId']),
        navegador: this.nullableString(user['navegador']),
        sistemaOperativo: this.nullableString(user['sistemaOperativo']),
        dispositivoReconocido: this.boolean(user['dispositivoReconocido']),
      },
      roles: this.array(row['roles']).map((item) => {
        const role = this.record(item);
        const roleId = this.number(role['rolId']);
        return {
          rolId: roleId,
          codigo: this.firstString(role, 'codigo', 'codigoRol') || `ROL_${roleId}`,
          nombre: this.firstString(role, 'nombre', 'nombreRol') || 'Perfil de acceso',
          descripcion: this.nullableString(role['descripcion']),
          requiereSegundoFactor: this.boolean(role['requiereSegundoFactor']),
        };
      }),
      modulos: modules,
      permisos: permissions,
    };
  }

  private derivedPermissionCode(moduleCode: string | null, action: string | null): string {
    if (!moduleCode || !action) return '';
    const module = this.normalize(moduleCode);
    const normalizedAction = this.normalize(action);
    if (module === 'VALIDACION_IDENTIDAD') {
      if (normalizedAction === 'VER') return 'VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_CONSULTAR';
      if (normalizedAction === 'CREAR') return 'VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_IMPORTAR';
      if (normalizedAction === 'EDITAR') return 'VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR';
    }
    return `${module}_${normalizedAction}`;
  }

  private humanize(value: string): string {
    if (!value) return 'Acceso';
    return value
      .toLowerCase()
      .split('_')
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))
      .join(' ');
  }

  private firstString(row: RecordValue, ...keys: string[]): string {
    for (const key of keys) {
      const value = this.string(row[key]).trim();
      if (value) return value;
    }
    return '';
  }

  private firstNullableString(row: RecordValue, ...keys: string[]): string | null {
    const value = this.firstString(row, ...keys);
    return value || null;
  }

  private normalize(value: string): string {
    return value.trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  private authStep(value: unknown): AuthStep {
    switch (value) {
      case 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED':
      case 'TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED':
      case 'AUTHENTICATED':
        return value;
      default:
        throw new Error('No se pudo procesar el estado de autenticación.');
    }
  }

  private record(value: unknown): RecordValue {
    return value && typeof value === 'object' ? (value as RecordValue) : {};
  }

  private array(value: unknown): unknown[] {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  }

  private string(value: unknown): string {
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? '');
  }

  private nullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value : null;
  }

  private number(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }

  private nullableNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }

  private boolean(value: unknown): boolean {
    return value === true || value === 1 || value === 'true' || value === '1';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';

import { SKIP_ACCESS_TOKEN } from '../../../../../../core/http/context/http-context.tokens';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../../../core/session/session.store';

export const accessTokenInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) => {
  if (request.context.get(SKIP_ACCESS_TOKEN)) {
    return next(request);
  }

  const token = inject(SessionStore).accessToken();

  if (!token) {
    return next(request);
  }

  return next(
    request.clone({
      setHeaders: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
    }),
  );
};
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/acceso/adapter/out/http/interceptors/session-refresh.interceptor.ts`

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import {
  Observable,
  catchError,
  defer,
  finalize,
  shareReplay,
  switchMap,
  throwError,
} from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH } from '../../../../../../core/http/context/http-context.tokens';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { RefrescarSesionUseCase } from '../../../../application/use-case/refrescar-sesion.use-case';
import { AuthRefreshResult } from '../../../../domain/auth-context.model';

let refreshInFlight$: Observable<AuthRefreshResult> | null = null;

export const sessionRefreshInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (request, next) => {
  if (request.context.get(SKIP_SESSION_REFRESH)) return next(request);

  const session = inject(SessionStore);
  const access = inject(AccessService);
  const refreshUseCase = inject(RefrescarSesionUseCase);

  return next(request).pipe(
    catchError((error: unknown) => {
      if (
        !(error instanceof HttpErrorResponse) ||
        error.status !== 401 ||
        !session.refreshToken()
      ) {
        return throwError(() => error);
      }

      if (!refreshInFlight$) {
        refreshInFlight$ = defer(() => refreshUseCase.execute()).pipe(
          catchError((refreshError) => {
            session.clear();
            access.clear();
            return throwError(() => refreshError);
          }),
          finalize(() => {
            refreshInFlight$ = null;
          }),
          shareReplay({ bufferSize: 1, refCount: false }),
        );
      }

      return refreshInFlight$.pipe(
        switchMap(() => next(request)),
      );
    }),
  );
};
```

```typescript
import {

  logoutOthers(): Observable<void>;
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { tap } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { AuthFlowResult } from '../../domain/auth-context.model';
import { AUTH_GATEWAY, AuthGateway, LoginCredentials } from '../port/out/auth.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class LoginUseCase {
  private readonly gateway: AuthGateway = inject(AUTH_GATEWAY);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionStore);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessService);

  execute(credentials: LoginCredentials) {
    return this.gateway.login(credentials).pipe(
      tap((result) => this.commitIfAuthenticated(result)),
    );
  }

  private commitIfAuthenticated(result: AuthFlowResult): void {
    if (result.paso !== 'AUTHENTICATED' || !result.tokens || !result.contexto) {
      return;
    }

    this.session.setTokens({
      accessToken: result.tokens.accessToken,
      refreshToken: result.tokens.refreshToken,
      accessTokenExpiresAt: result.tokens.accessTokenExpiraUtc,
      refreshTokenExpiresAt: result.tokens.refreshTokenExpiraUtc,
    });
    this.access.hydrate(result.contexto);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { throwError, tap } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { AUTH_GATEWAY, AuthGateway } from '../port/out/auth.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class RefrescarSesionUseCase {
  private readonly gateway: AuthGateway = inject(AUTH_GATEWAY);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionStore);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessService);

  execute() {
    const refreshToken = this.session.refreshToken();

    if (!refreshToken) {
      return throwError(() => new Error('La sesión ya no está disponible.'));
    }

    return this.gateway.refresh(refreshToken).pipe(
      tap((result) => {
        this.session.setTokens({
          accessToken: result.tokens.accessToken,
          refreshToken: result.tokens.refreshToken,
          accessTokenExpiresAt: result.tokens.accessTokenExpiraUtc,
          refreshTokenExpiresAt: result.tokens.refreshTokenExpiraUtc,
        });
        this.access.hydrate(result.contexto);
      }),
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { tap } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { AuthFlowResult } from '../../domain/auth-context.model';
import {
  AUTH_GATEWAY,
  AuthGateway,
  TwoFactorVerificationInput,
} from '../port/out/auth.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class VerificarSegundoFactorUseCase {
  private readonly gateway: AuthGateway = inject(AUTH_GATEWAY);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionStore);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessService);

  execute(input: TwoFactorVerificationInput) {
    return this.gateway.verifyTwoFactor(input).pipe(
      tap((result) => this.commitIfAuthenticated(result)),
    );
  }

  private commitIfAuthenticated(result: AuthFlowResult): void {
    if (result.paso !== 'AUTHENTICATED' || !result.tokens || !result.contexto) {
      return;
    }

    this.session.setTokens({
      accessToken: result.tokens.accessToken,
      refreshToken: result.tokens.refreshToken,
      accessTokenExpiresAt: result.tokens.accessTokenExpiraUtc,
      refreshTokenExpiresAt: result.tokens.refreshTokenExpiraUtc,
    });
    this.access.hydrate(result.contexto);
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>{{ catalog()?.nombre || 'Catálogo' }}</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar valor' : 'Registrar valor' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      @if (requiresExplicitCode()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="catalogCode">{{ codeLabel() }}</label>
          <input
            id="catalogCode"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="codigo"
            [attr.maxlength]="catalog()?.codigoMaxLength ?? 40"
            [placeholder]="codePlaceholder()"
            [readOnly]="!!current()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.codigo"
            [fieldLabel]="codeLabel()"
            [messages]="{
              pattern:
                catalog()?.codigo === 'MONEDA'
                  ? 'Ingrese un código ISO de tres letras.'
                  : 'Use letras, números, punto, guion o guion bajo.'
            }"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="catalogName">Nombre</label>
        <input
          id="catalogName"
          class="admin-input"
          type="text"
          formControlName="nombre"
          [attr.maxlength]="nameMaxLength()"
          placeholder="Nombre visible"
          autocomplete="off"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombre"
          fieldLabel="El nombre"
          [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
        />
      </div>

      @if (catalog()?.requiereCategoria) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="catalogCategory">Categoría</label>
          <select
            id="catalogCategory"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="categoria"
          >
            <option value="">Seleccionar</option>
            <option value="PLAGA">Plaga</option>
            <option value="ENFERMEDAD">Enfermedad</option>
            <option value="OTRO">Otro</option>
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.categoria"
            fieldLabel="La categoría"
          />
        </div>
      } @else if (showDescription()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="catalogDescription">Descripción</label>
          <textarea
            id="catalogDescription"
            class="admin-textarea"
            formControlName="descripcion"
            maxlength="300"
            rows="3"
            placeholder="Descripción opcional"
          ></textarea>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.descripcion"
            fieldLabel="La descripción"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="close()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { EditarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { Catalogo } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogo-detail',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './catalogo-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogo-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogoDetailComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly catalog = signal<Catalogo | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<CatalogoItem | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly catalogIcon = faLayerGroup;

  readonly nameMaxLength = computed(
    () => this.catalog()?.nombreMaxLength ?? 150,
  );

  readonly showDescription = computed(
    () => this.catalog()?.admiteDescripcion !== false,
  );

  readonly requiresExplicitCode = computed(() => {
    const code = this.catalog()?.codigo;
    return code === 'MONEDA' || code === 'UNIDAD_MEDIDA';
  });

  readonly codeLabel = computed(() =>
    this.catalog()?.codigo === 'MONEDA'
      ? 'Código ISO'
      : 'Código',
  );

  readonly codePlaceholder = computed(() =>
    this.catalog()?.codigo === 'MONEDA'
      ? 'PEN'
      : 'KG',
  );

  private resolver:
    | ((result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>) => void)
    | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)],
    ],
    descripcion: [
      '',
      [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
    ],
    categoria: [''],
  });

  open(
    catalog: Catalogo,
    item: CatalogoItem | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>> {
    this.catalog.set(catalog);
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.configureValidators(catalog);

    this.form.reset({
      codigo: item?.codigo ?? '',
      nombre: item?.nombre ?? '',
      descripcion:
        catalog.requiereCategoria || catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
          ? ''
          : item?.descripcion ?? '',
      categoria: item?.categoria ?? '',
    });

    if (this.requiresExplicitCode()) {
      this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    }

    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  save(): void {
    const catalog = this.catalog();
    const current = this.current();

    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!catalog || this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const description =
      catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
        ? undefined
        : normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion);

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.id, {
          catalogo: catalog.codigo,
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: description,
          categoria: raw.categoria.trim() || undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          catalogo: catalog.codigo,
          codigo: this.requiresExplicitCode()
            ? raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase()
            : 'AUTO',
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: description,
          categoria: raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'Valor actualizado' : 'Valor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: current,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  private configureValidators(catalog: Catalogo): void {
    if (catalog.codigo === 'MONEDA') {
      this.form.controls.codigo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        Validators.pattern(/^[A-Za-z]{3}$/),
        Validators.maxLength(3),
      ]);
    } else if (catalog.codigo === 'UNIDAD_MEDIDA') {
      this.form.controls.codigo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        Validators.pattern(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/),
        Validators.maxLength(catalog.codigoMaxLength ?? 20),
      ]);
    } else {
      this.form.controls.codigo.clearValidators();
    }

    this.form.controls.nombre.setValidators([
      Validators.required,
      notBlankValidator,
      Validators.maxLength(catalog.nombreMaxLength ?? 150),
    ]);

    this.form.controls.descripcion.setValidators(
      catalog.admiteDescripcion === false
        ? []
        : [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
    );

    this.form.controls.categoria.setValidators(
      catalog.requiereCategoria ? [Validators.required] : [],
    );

    this.form.controls.codigo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.nombre.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.controls.descripcion.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
    this.form.controls.categoria.updateValueAndValidity({
      emitEvent: false,
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<CatalogoItem>): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.catalog.set(null);
      this.current.set(null);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
    });
  }
}
```

```css
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: var(--desco-surface-elevated);
  padding: 0.34rem 0.62rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.63rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.catalog-table-wrap {
  border-radius: 0;
}


.catalog-status-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
}

.catalog-status-tab {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.15rem;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: var(--desco-surface-elevated);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.catalog-status-tab:hover {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary-border);
  color: var(--desco-text);
}

.catalog-status-tab--active {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary);
  background: var(--desco-primary);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
}

.catalog-status-count {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.catalog-status-tab--active .catalog-status-count {
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
}

.catalog-no-actions {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  text-align: right;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .catalog-group-tabs {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .catalog-browser {
    padding: 0.75rem;
  }

  .catalog-group-tabs {
    display: flex;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }

  .catalog-group-tab {
    min-width: 9.5rem;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
  }

  .catalog-item-tabs {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    overflow-x: auto;
    padding-bottom: 0.15rem;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }

  .catalog-item-tab {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .catalog-context {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.8rem;
  }

  .catalog-context-count {
    align-self: flex-start;
  }

  .catalog-status-tabs {
    overflow-x: auto;
    padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
  }

  .catalog-status-tab {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="pageTitle"
    [subtitle]="pageSubtitle"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        {{ createLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface catalog-shell mt-5">
    @if (!fixedCatalogCode) {
      <div class="catalog-browser" aria-label="Navegación de catálogos">
        <nav class="catalog-group-tabs" aria-label="Áreas de catálogos">
          @for (group of catalogGroups; track group.codigo) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="catalog-group-tab"
              [class.catalog-group-tab--active]="group.codigo === selectedGroup().codigo"
              [attr.aria-pressed]="group.codigo === selectedGroup().codigo"
              (click)="changeGroup(group.codigo)"
            >
              <span>{{ group.nombre }}</span>
              <span class="catalog-group-count">{{ group.catalogos.length }}</span>
            </button>
          }
        </nav>

        <nav class="catalog-item-tabs" [attr.aria-label]="selectedGroup().nombre">
          @for (catalog of selectedGroup().catalogos; track catalog.codigo) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="catalog-item-tab"
              [class.catalog-item-tab--active]="catalog.codigo === catalogCode()"
              [attr.aria-current]="catalog.codigo === catalogCode() ? 'page' : null"
              (click)="changeCatalog(catalog.codigo)"
            >
              <span class="catalog-item-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              {{ catalog.nombre }}
            </button>
          }
        </nav>
      </div>
    }

    <div class="catalog-content">
      <header class="catalog-context">
        <div class="catalog-context-copy">
          <span class="catalog-context-icon" aria-hidden="true">
            <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
          </span>

          <div>
            <span class="catalog-context-kicker">
              {{ selectedCatalog().grupoNombre }}
            </span>
            <h2>{{ selectedCatalog().nombre }}</h2>
            <p>{{ selectedCatalog().descripcion }}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        @if (!loading() && !errorMessage()) {
          <span class="catalog-context-count">
            {{ result().totalRecords }}
            {{ result().totalRecords === 1 ? 'registro' : 'registros' }}
          </span>
        }
      </header>

      @if (!loading() && !errorMessage()) {
        <nav class="catalog-status-tabs" aria-label="Estado de valores">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="catalog-status-tab"
            [class.catalog-status-tab--active]="statusView() === 'ACTIVE'"
            [attr.aria-pressed]="statusView() === 'ACTIVE'"
            (click)="changeStatus('ACTIVE')"
          >
            <span>Activos</span>
            <span class="catalog-status-count">{{ activeCount() }}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            class="catalog-status-tab"
            [class.catalog-status-tab--active]="statusView() === 'INACTIVE'"
            [attr.aria-pressed]="statusView() === 'INACTIVE'"
            (click)="changeStatus('INACTIVE')"
          >
            <span>Inactivos</span>
            <span class="catalog-status-count">{{ inactiveCount() }}</span>
          </button>
        </nav>
      }

      @if (loading()) {
        <app-loading-state title="Cargando" message="Consultando información." />
      } @else if (errorMessage()) {
        <app-error-state
          title="No se pudo cargar"
          [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
          (retry)="load()"
        />
      } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
        <app-empty-state
          [title]="statusView() === 'ACTIVE' ? emptyTitle : 'Sin valores inactivos'"
          [message]="
            statusView() === 'ACTIVE'
              ? emptyMessage
              : 'No hay valores deshabilitados en este catálogo.'
          "
        />
      } @else {
        <div class="admin-table-wrap catalog-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Código</th>
                <th>Nombre</th>
                <th>Descripción</th>
                <th class="text-center">Uso</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
                <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of result().items; track item.id) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <span class="admin-code">{{ item.codigo }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td class="admin-table-primary">{{ item.nombre }}</td>
                  <td class="admin-table-muted max-w-md">
                    {{ item.descripcion || '—' }}
                  </td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-usage-badge"
                      [class.admin-usage-badge--used]="item.enUso"
                    >
                      {{ item.cantidadUso }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!item.estado"
                    >
                      {{ item.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.estado) {
                      <div class="admin-row-actions">
                        <button
                          *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_EDITAR'"
                          type="button"
                          class="admin-icon-button"
                          title="Editar"
                          [disabled]="disablingId() !== null"
                          (click)="edit(item)"
                        >
                          <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                        </button>

                        <button
                          *appPermission="'CATALOGOS_RETIRAR'"
                          type="button"
                          class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                          title="Deshabilitar"
                          [disabled]="disablingId() !== null"
                          (click)="disable(item)"
                        >
                          @if (disablingId() === item.id) {
                            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                          } @else {
                            <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                          }
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    } @else {
                      <div class="catalog-no-actions" aria-label="Sin acciones disponibles">
                        —
                      </div>
                    }
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <app-paginator
          [page]="result().page"
          [size]="result().size"
          [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
          [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
          (pageChange)="changePage($event)"
          (sizeChange)="changePageSize($event)"
        />
      }
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<app-catalogo-detail />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

- Ruta: `src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/in/ui/pages/catalogos-list/catalogos-list.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\administracion\catalogos\adapter\in\ui\pages\catalogos-list\catalogos-list.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/in/ui/pages/catalogos-list/catalogos-list.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { PageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import {
  CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES,
  CATALOGOS_AGRUPADOS,
  Catalogo,
} from '../../../../../domain/catalogo.model';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
import { CatalogoDetailComponent } from '../catalogo-detail/catalogo-detail';

type CatalogStatusView = 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    CatalogoDetailComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './catalogos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CatalogosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(CatalogoDetailComponent)
  private detailModal!: CatalogoDetailComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarCatalogosUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase);
  private readonly references = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  private readonly routeData = this.route.snapshot.data;
  readonly fixedCatalogCode = this.validCatalogCode(this.readRouteText('catalogCode'));
  readonly pageTitle = this.readRouteText('pageTitle') ?? 'Catálogos';
  readonly pageSubtitle =
    this.readRouteText('pageSubtitle') ??
    'Administra los valores utilizados por el sistema.';
  readonly createLabel = this.readRouteText('createLabel') ?? 'Nuevo valor';
  readonly entityLabel = this.readRouteText('entityLabel') ?? 'Valor';
  readonly emptyTitle = this.readRouteText('emptyTitle') ?? 'Sin valores registrados';
  readonly emptyMessage =
    this.readRouteText('emptyMessage') ?? 'No hay valores registrados en este catálogo.';

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly catalogCode = signal(
    this.fixedCatalogCode ?? CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES[0].codigo,
  );
  readonly allItems = signal<readonly CatalogoItem[]>([]);
  readonly statusView = signal<CatalogStatusView>('ACTIVE');
  readonly currentPage = signal(1);
  readonly pageSize = signal(20);

  readonly catalogs = CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES;
  readonly catalogGroups = CATALOGOS_AGRUPADOS;
  readonly pageIcon = faLayerGroup;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly selectedCatalog = computed<Catalogo>(
    () =>
      this.catalogs.find((item) => item.codigo === this.catalogCode()) ??
      this.catalogs[0],
  );

  readonly selectedGroup = computed(
    () =>
      this.catalogGroups.find(
        (group) => group.codigo === this.selectedCatalog().grupoCodigo,
      ) ?? this.catalogGroups[0],
  );

  readonly activeCount = computed(
    () => this.allItems().filter((item) => item.estado).length,
  );

  readonly inactiveCount = computed(
    () => this.allItems().filter((item) => !item.estado).length,
  );

  readonly filteredItems = computed<readonly CatalogoItem[]>(() =>
    this.allItems().filter((item) =>
      this.statusView() === 'ACTIVE' ? item.estado : !item.estado,
    ),
  );

  readonly result = computed<PageResult<CatalogoItem>>(() => {
    const items = this.filteredItems();
    const size = Math.max(1, this.pageSize());
    const totalRecords = items.length;
    const totalPages =
      totalRecords === 0
        ? 0
        : Math.ceil(totalRecords / size);
    const page =
      totalPages === 0
        ? 1
        : Math.min(Math.max(1, this.currentPage()), totalPages);
    const start = (page - 1) * size;

    return {
      items: items.slice(start, start + size),
      page,
      size,
      totalRecords,
      totalPages,
    };
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
      this.listUseCase.execute({
        catalogo: this.catalogCode(),
        page,
        size,
      }),
    )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.allItems.set(items);
          this.currentPage.set(1);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.allItems.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  changeCatalog(value: string): void {
    if (this.fixedCatalogCode) {
      return;
    }

    const next = this.validCatalogCode(value);
    if (!next || next === this.catalogCode()) {
      return;
    }

    this.catalogCode.set(next);
    this.statusView.set('ACTIVE');
    this.currentPage.set(1);
    this.load();
  }

  changeGroup(groupCode: string): void {
    if (this.fixedCatalogCode) {
      return;
    }

    const group = this.catalogGroups.find((item) => item.codigo === groupCode);
    const firstCatalog = group?.catalogos[0];

    if (!firstCatalog || group?.codigo === this.selectedGroup().codigo) {
      return;
    }

    this.changeCatalog(firstCatalog.codigo);
  }

  changeStatus(view: CatalogStatusView): void {
    if (view === this.statusView()) {
      return;
    }

    this.statusView.set(view);
    this.currentPage.set(1);
  }

  changePage(page: number): void {
    this.currentPage.set(Math.max(1, page));
  }

  changePageSize(size: number): void {
    this.pageSize.set(Math.max(1, size));
    this.currentPage.set(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog());

    if (result.saved) {
      this.statusView.set('ACTIVE');
      this.invalidateSelectedReference();
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async edit(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    if (!item.estado) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.detailModal.open(this.selectedCatalog(), item);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.invalidateSelectedReference();
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(item: CatalogoItem): Promise<void> {
    if (!item.estado || this.disablingId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: `Deshabilitar ${this.entityLabel.toLowerCase()}`,
      message: `“${item.nombre}” dejará de estar disponible para nuevos registros.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.disablingId.set(item.id);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(item.id, this.catalogCode(), confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.references.invalidateCatalog(this.catalogCode());
          this.toast.success(`${this.entityLabel} deshabilitado`);
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            `No se pudo deshabilitar ${this.entityLabel.toLowerCase()}`,
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private readRouteText(key: string): string | null {
    const value = this.routeData[key];
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
  }

  private validCatalogCode(value: string | null): string | null {
    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    return CATALOGOS_ADMINISTRABLES.some((catalog) => catalog.codigo === value)
      ? value
      : null;
  }

  private invalidateSelectedReference(): void {
    this.references.invalidateCatalog(this.catalogCode());
  }
}
```

### 721. `src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/out/http/catalogos-http.adapter.ts`

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/out/http/catalogos-http.adapter.ts`

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  CatalogCreateRequest,
  CatalogDisableRequest,
  CatalogUpdateRequest,
  CatlogosService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { CatalogosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/catalogos.gateway';
import { CatalogoFiltro } from '../../../domain/catalogo-filtro.model';
import {
  CatalogoItemCreate,
  CatalogoItemUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';
import { CatalogosHttpMapper } from './catalogos-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class CatalogosHttpAdapter implements CatalogosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(CatlogosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(CatalogosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: CatalogoFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .catalogosListar(
        {
          catalogo: filter.catalogo,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  create(input: CatalogoItemCreate) {
    const catalogCreateRequest: CatalogCreateRequest = this.compact(input);

    return this.api
      .catalogosCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          catalogCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: CatalogoItemUpdate) {
    const catalogUpdateRequest: CatalogUpdateRequest = this.compact(input);

    return this.api
      .catalogosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          catalogUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  disable(id: number, catalogo: string, motivo: string) {
    const catalogDisableRequest: CatalogDisableRequest = {
      catalogo,
      motivo,
    };

    return this.api
      .catalogosDeshabilitar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          catalogDisableRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(
        ([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== '',
      ),
    ) as T;
  }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\administracion\catalogos\adapter\out\http\catalogos-http.mapper.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/administracion/catalogos/adapter/out/http/catalogos-http.mapper.ts`

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { CatalogoItem } from '../../../domain/catalogo-item.model';

@Injectable()
export class CatalogosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.item(row), size);
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(row['id']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private item(row: Record<string, unknown>): CatalogoItem {
    const description = this.api.nullableString(row['descripcion']);

    return {
      id: this.api.number(row['id']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      descripcion: description,
      categoria: this.categoryFromDescription(description),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      cantidadUso: this.api.number(row['cantidadUso']),
      enUso: this.api.boolean(row['enUso']),
    };
  }

  private categoryFromDescription(description: string | null): string | null {
    if (!description) {
      return null;
    }

    const match = /^Categor[ií]a:\s*(.+)$/i.exec(description.trim());
    return match?.[1]?.trim().toUpperCase() || null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { InjectionToken } from '@angular/core';
```

```typescript
import { Provider } from '@angular/core';

import { CATALOGOS_GATEWAY } from './application/port/out/catalogos.gateway';
import { CrearItemCatalogoUseCase } from './application/use-case/crear-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase } from './application/use-case/deshabilitar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { EditarItemCatalogoUseCase } from './application/use-case/editar-item-catalogo.use-case';
import { ListarCatalogosUseCase } from './application/use-case/listar-catalogos.use-case';
import { CatalogosHttpAdapter } from './adapter/out/http/catalogos-http.adapter';
import { CatalogosHttpMapper } from './adapter/out/http/catalogos-http.mapper';

export function provideCatalogos(): Provider[] {
  return [
    CatalogosHttpMapper,
    CatalogosHttpAdapter,
    {
      provide: CATALOGOS_GATEWAY,
      useExisting: CatalogosHttpAdapter,
    },
    ListarCatalogosUseCase,
    CrearItemCatalogoUseCase,
    EditarItemCatalogoUseCase,
    DeshabilitarItemCatalogoUseCase,
  ];
}
```

```css
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.employee-access-empty {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 6.5rem;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px dashed var(--desco-border-strong);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 1rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .employee-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .employee-detail-section > .admin-info-list {
    margin: 0.75rem;
  }

  .employee-history-section > .admin-table-wrap {
    margin: 0 0.75rem 0.75rem;
  }

  .employee-access-card__body {
    padding: 0.75rem;
  }

  .employee-account-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .employee-role-item {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .employee-role-state {
    grid-column: 2;
    width: fit-content;
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">

        (click)="load()"
      >

      </button>

      @if (detail(); as employee) {
        <button

              </div>
            }
          </div>
        </section>
```

- Ruta: `src/app/features/administracion/empleados/adapter/in/ui/pages/empleado-detail/empleado-detail.ts`
