```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faBuilding,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faIdCard,
  faPen,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUser,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadoDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly employeeId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly requestedUotId = Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('uotId')) || null;
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly identityIcon = faIdCard;
  readonly organizationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly accountIcon = faShieldHalved;

  readonly fullName = computed(() => {
    const value = this.detail();

    return value
      ? [value.nombres, value.apellidoPaterno, value.apellidoMaterno]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      : 'Empleado';
  });

  readonly currentAssignment = computed(() => {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee) {
      return null;
    }

    return employee.areas.find(
      (item) => item.estado && !item.fechaHasta,
    )
      ?? employee.areas.find((item) => item.estado)
      ?? null;
  });

  readonly activeSystemRoles = computed(() =>
    (this.detail()?.roles ?? []).filter(
      (role) => role.estado && !role.fechaHasta,
    ),
  );

  readonly hasActiveAccount = computed(() => {
    const account = this.detail()?.usuario;

    return !!account
      && account.estadoCuenta?.trim().toUpperCase() === 'ACTIVA';
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.employeeId) || this.employeeId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El empleado solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.employeeId, this.targetUotId() ?? undefined)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.organizationsUseCase.areas(page, size, this.targetUotId() ?? undefined))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (areas) => this.areas.set(areas.filter((area) => area.estado)),
        error: (error) => {
          this.areas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  uotName(): string {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotNombre
      ?? this.uot.memberships().find((unit) => unit.uotId === this.requestedUotId)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  targetUotId(): number | null {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId();
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotId ?? this.requestedUotId;
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open(
      { areas: this.areas(), preferredUotId: employee.uotId },
      employee,
    );

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const employee = this.detail();

    if (!employee || !employee.estado || this.retiring()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName()}.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiring.set(true);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(employee.empleadoId, employee.uotId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Empleado retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al empleado',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```css
:host {
  display: contents;
}

  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--desco-primary);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 850;

.identity-search-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.65rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-primary-border);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  padding: 0 0.8rem;
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.identity-search-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft-hover);
}

.identity-search-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.identity-feedback {

  color: var(--desco-warning-text);
}

.identity-feedback--error {
  border-color: var(--desco-danger-border);
  background: var(--desco-danger-soft);
  color: var(--desco-danger-text);
}

.identity-help,
.employee-form-error {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.38rem;

  font-size: 0.68rem;

}

@media (max-width: 640px) {

  }

}
```

```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">

        </div>

      <button

        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">
        {{ errorMessage() }}
      </div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Identificación</span>

      <div class="admin-field">

          (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()"
        >
          @for (item of documentTypes; track item.value) {

          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">

        <div class="identity-document-control">

            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading() || !!current()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />

          @if (shouldResolveIdentity() && !current()) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="identity-search-button"
              [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()"
              [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()"
              (click)="resolveIdentity()"
            >
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                Buscando...

                Buscar

            </button>

        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El número de documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            ruc: 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.',
            rucNature: 'El RUC debe corresponder a una persona natural.',
            pattern: 'Para empleados se admite RUC10.',
            blank: 'El número de documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
</div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="employeeNames" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="nombres" maxlength="100" autocomplete="given-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('names')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('nombres')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.', personName: 'Los nombres solo pueden contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeLastName">Apellido paterno</label>
        <input id="employeeLastName" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="apellidoPaterno" maxlength="80" autocomplete="family-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('paternalSurname')" (input)="onPersonNameInput('apellidoPaterno')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoPaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido paterno" [messages]="{ blank: 'El apellido paterno no puede contener solo espacios.', personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />

        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoMaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido materno" [messages]="{ personName: 'El apellido solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.' }" />

      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="employeeEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" formControlName="correo" maxlength="180" autocomplete="email" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('email')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">

      <app-geography-cascade

        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"

        [populationCenterLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('populationCenter')"

      />

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="employeeReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="employeeReference" class="admin-input" type="text" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle o referencia" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('reference')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="employee-form-section admin-field-span-2">
        <span>Información laboral</span>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeUot">UOT del registro</label>
        <select id="employeeUot" class="admin-select" formControlName="uotId" (change)="onUotChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>
          @for (unit of availableUnits(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
        <small>En vista general puede escoger la adscripción; al editar permanece fija.</small>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeEntryDate">Fecha de ingreso</label>
        <input id="employeeEntryDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaIngreso" [min]="minimumEntryDate()" [attr.aria-readonly]="current() ? 'true' : null" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaIngreso" fieldLabel="La fecha de ingreso" [messages]="{ pastDate: 'La fecha de ingreso no puede ser anterior a hoy.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }" />
        @if (form.hasError('entryBeforeAdult')) {
          <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha de ingreso no puede ser anterior a la mayoría de edad de la persona.</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeArea">Área</label>
        <select id="employeeArea" class="admin-select" formControlName="areaId" (change)="onAreaChange()">
          <option [value]="0">Sin área asignada</option>
          @for (area of availableAreas(); track area.areaId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeRoleName">
          Cargo
          @if (form.controls.areaId.value > 0) { <span aria-hidden="true">*</span> }
        </label>
        <select
          id="employeeRoleName"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="cargo"
          [disabled]="form.controls.areaId.value <= 0 || cargoLoading()"
          (change)="onCargoChange()"
        >
          <option value="">
            {{ cargoLoading() ? 'Cargando...' : 'Seleccionar cargo' }}
          </option>
          @for (cargo of availableCargoOptions(); track cargo.id) {
            <option [value]="cargo.label">{{ cargo.label }}</option>

        </select>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.cargo"
          fieldLabel="El cargo"
        />
        @if (cargoError()) {
          <small class="employee-form-error">{{ cargoError() }}</small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (current() && (currentAssignmentDate() || assignmentChanged())) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="employeeAreaDate">
            {{ assignmentChanged() ? 'Fecha efectiva del cambio' : 'Fecha de asignación actual' }}
          </label>
          <input
            id="employeeAreaDate"
            class="admin-input"
            type="date"
            formControlName="fechaAsignacionArea"
            [min]="assignmentChangeMinimumDate()"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.fechaAsignacionArea"
            fieldLabel="La fecha de asignación"
            [messages]="{ required: 'Indique la fecha efectiva del cambio.', invalidDate: 'Ingrese una fecha válida.' }"
          />
          @if (form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
            <small class="employee-form-error">La fecha no puede ser anterior al ingreso.</small>
          }
        </div>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
} from '@angular/core';

} from '@angular/forms';

import {

} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { ReferenceItem } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.model';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import {
  adultBirthDateValidator,
  addYearsIsoDate,

  maxBirthDateIso,
  minBirthDateIso,
  normalizeOptionalText,

  notBlankValidator,
  personNameValidator,

  sanitizeDocument,

  sanitizePhone,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  IdentityResolution,
  IdentityResolverService,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import {
  Empleado,
  EmpleadoDetalle,
  TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
} from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';

interface EmployeeFormOptions {
  areas: readonly Area[];
  preferredUotId?: number;
}

type IdentityFeedbackTone = 'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface IdentityFieldLocks {
  names: boolean;
  paternalSurname: boolean;
  maternalSurname: boolean;
  birthDate: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
  email: boolean;
  geography: boolean;
  populationCenter: boolean;
  reference: boolean;
}

function emptyIdentityFieldLocks(): IdentityFieldLocks {
  return {
    names: false,
    paternalSurname: false,
    maternalSurname: false,
    birthDate: false,
    phone: false,
    email: false,
    geography: false,
    populationCenter: false,
    reference: false,
  };
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly references = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly cargoOptions = signal<readonly ReferenceItem[]>([]);
  readonly cargoLoading = signal(false);
  readonly cargoError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly assignmentChanged = signal(false);
  readonly currentAssignmentDate = signal('');

  private initialAssignmentAreaId = 0;
  private initialAssignmentCargo = '';
  private initialAssignmentDate = '';

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly maxBirthDate = maxBirthDateIso();
  readonly minBirthDate = minBirthDateIso();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoEmpleado;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  private readonly notPastEntryDateValidator: ValidatorFn = (
    control: AbstractControl,
  ): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value || this.current()) {
      return null;
    }

    return value < this.today ? { pastDate: true } : null;
  };

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [personNameValidator, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(16)]],
      correo: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.email,
          Validators.pattern(/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/),
          Validators.maxLength(180),
        ],
      ],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [adultBirthDateValidator()]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      codigoEmpleado: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fechaIngreso: ['', [Validators.required]],
      areaId: [0],
      cargo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      fechaAsignacionArea: [''],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaIngreso',
          'fechaAsignacionArea',
          'areaDateBeforeEntry',
        ),
        dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator(
          'fechaNacimiento',
          'fechaIngreso',
          18,
          'entryBeforeAdult',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    options: EmployeeFormOptions,
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(employee);
    this.areas.set(options.areas);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loadCargoOptions();

    const detail = employee && 'fechaNacimiento' in employee
      ? (employee as EmpleadoDetalle)
      : null;

    const currentAssignment =
      detail?.areas.find(
        (item) => item.estado && !item.fechaHasta,
      ) ?? null;

    this.initialAssignmentAreaId =
      currentAssignment?.areaId
      ?? employee?.areaId
      ?? 0;
    this.initialAssignmentCargo =
      currentAssignment?.cargo
      ?? employee?.cargo
      ?? '';
    this.initialAssignmentDate =
      currentAssignment?.fechaDesde
      ?? '';

    this.currentAssignmentDate.set(
      this.initialAssignmentDate,
    );
    this.assignmentChanged.set(false);

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    const type = this.normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
      employee?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: employee?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: sanitizePersonName(employee?.nombres ?? '').slice(0, 100),
      apellidoPaterno: sanitizePersonName(employee?.apellidoPaterno ?? '').slice(0, 80),
      apellidoMaterno: sanitizePersonName(employee?.apellidoMaterno ?? '').slice(0, 80),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(employee?.telefono ?? ''),
      correo: (employee?.correo ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180),
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      uotId: this.resolveTargetUotId(employee?.uotId ?? options.preferredUotId),
      codigoEmpleado: employee?.codigoEmpleado ?? '',
      fechaIngreso: employee?.fechaIngreso ?? '',
      areaId: this.initialAssignmentAreaId,
      cargo: this.initialAssignmentCargo,
      fechaAsignacionArea: this.initialAssignmentDate,
    });

    this.applyEntryDateValidators(false);

    if (employee) {
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.form.controls.fechaIngreso.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.form.controls.fechaIngreso.enable({ emitEvent: false });

      if (this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA') {
        this.form.controls.uotId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      } else {
        this.form.controls.uotId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      }
    }

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);
    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.syncAssignmentDateState(false);

    if (employee && (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC')) {
      this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
        this.identityKey(type, employee.numeroDocumento),
      );
      this.loadExistingIdentityPolicy(
        employee,
        type,
      );
    } else {
      this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    }

    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    const geographyLocked =
      this.isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography');
    const populationCenterLocked =
      this.isIdentityFieldReadOnly('populationCenter');

    if (geographyLocked && populationCenterLocked) {
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo:
        geographyLocked
          ? this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value
          : selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterLocked
          ? this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value
          : selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });

    if (!geographyLocked) {
      this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
    }
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  onPersonNameInput(
    field: 'nombres' | 'apellidoPaterno' | 'apellidoMaterno',
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls[field];
    const maxLength = field === 'nombres' ? 100 : 80;
    const sanitized = sanitizePersonName(control.value).slice(0, maxLength);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  onPhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.telefono;
    const sanitized = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  onAreaChange(): void {
    if (Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) <= 0) {
      this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators();
    this.syncAssignmentDateState();
  }

  onCargoChange(): void {
    this.syncAssignmentDateState();
  }

  minimumEntryDate(): string | null {
    const adulthoodDate = addYearsIsoDate(
      this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      18,
    );

    if (this.current()) {
      return adulthoodDate;
    }

    if (!adulthoodDate) {
      return this.today;
    }

    return adulthoodDate > this.today
      ? adulthoodDate
      : this.today;
  }

  availableCargoOptions(): readonly ReferenceItem[] {
    const options = this.cargoOptions();
    const currentCargo = this.form.controls.cargo.value.trim();

    if (
      !currentCargo
      || options.some(
        (item) =>
          item.label.localeCompare(
            currentCargo,
            undefined,
            { sensitivity: 'accent' },
          ) === 0,
      )
    ) {
      return options;
    }

    return [
      {
        id: `current:${currentCargo}`,
        code: currentCargo,
        label: currentCargo,
        description: null,
        active: true,
        inUse: true,
        usageCount: 1,
      },
      ...options,
    ];
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onUotChange(): void {
    this.form.controls.areaId.setValue(0);
    this.form.controls.cargo.setValue('');
    this.syncAreaValidators();
    this.syncAssignmentDateState();
  }

  availableAreas(): readonly Area[] {
    const uotId = Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId);

    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) =>
        area.uotId === uotId
        && (
          area.estado
          || area.areaId === this.initialAssignmentAreaId
        ),
    );
  }

  assignmentChangeMinimumDate(): string | null {
    const entryDate =
      this.form.controls.fechaIngreso.value.trim();
    const assignmentDate =
      this.initialAssignmentDate.trim();

    if (!entryDate) {
      return assignmentDate || null;
    }

    if (!assignmentDate) {
      return entryDate;
    }

    return assignmentDate > entryDate
      ? assignmentDate
      : entryDate;
  }

  uotLabel(): string {
    const id = Number(this.form.getRawValue().uotId);
    return this.uot.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode();
    }

    this.syncAreaValidators(false);
    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.saving() || this.identityLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      const message = this.validationMessage();
      this.errorMessage.set(message);
      this.focusFirstInvalidControl();
      return;
    }

    const values = this.form.getRawValue();

    if (
      Number(values.areaId) > 0
      && this.cargoError()
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(this.cargoError());
      return;
    }

    if (Number(values.uotId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.');
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      values.tipoDocumento,
      values.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      !current
      && this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(values.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${values.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'No se puede usar esta persona para el empleado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    const areaId = Number(values.areaId);

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: values.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(values.nombres),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(values.apellidoPaterno),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(values.apellidoMaterno),
      telefono: sanitizePhone(values.telefono) || undefined,
      correo: values.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: values.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      uotId: Number(values.uotId),
      codigoEmpleado: values.codigoEmpleado.trim().toUpperCase(),
      fechaIngreso: values.fechaIngreso,
      areaId: areaId > 0 ? areaId : undefined,
      cargo:
        areaId > 0
          ? normalizeOptionalText(values.cargo)
          : undefined,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: values.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(values.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(values.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(values.referencia),
      },
    };

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.empleadoId, {
          ...common,
          fechaAsignacionArea:
            this.assignmentChanged()
            && values.fechaAsignacionArea
              ? values.fechaAsignacionArea
              : undefined,
        })
      : this.createUseCase.execute(common);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Empleado actualizado'
              : 'Empleado registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el empleado'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el empleado',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private validationMessage(): string {
    const controls = this.form.controls;

    if (
      controls.tipoDocumento.invalid
      || controls.numeroDocumento.invalid
    ) {
      return 'Revise el documento.';
    }

    if (
      controls.nombres.invalid
      || controls.apellidoPaterno.invalid
      || controls.apellidoMaterno.invalid
    ) {
      return 'Revise los nombres y apellidos.';
    }

    if (controls.fechaNacimiento.invalid) {
      return 'Revise la fecha de nacimiento.';
    }

    if (controls.telefono.invalid) {
      return 'Revise el teléfono.';
    }

    if (controls.correo.invalid) {
      return 'Ingrese un correo válido.';
    }

    if (controls.distritoCodigo.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione un distrito válido.';
    }

    if (controls.uotId.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione una UOT.';
    }

    if (controls.fechaIngreso.invalid) {
      return 'Revise la fecha de ingreso.';
    }

    if (this.form.hasError('entryBeforeAdult')) {
      return 'La fecha de ingreso no es válida.';
    }

    if (this.form.hasError('areaDateBeforeEntry')) {
      return 'Revise la fecha de asignación del área.';
    }

    if (controls.cargo.invalid) {
      return 'Seleccione un cargo.';
    }

    if (
      this.assignmentChanged()
      && controls.fechaAsignacionArea.invalid
    ) {
      return 'Indique la fecha efectiva del cambio.';
    }

    return 'Revise los campos obligatorios.';
  }

  private focusFirstInvalidControl(): void {
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const invalid =
        this.dialogRef.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
          'form .ng-invalid:not(form), form [aria-invalid="true"]',
        );

      invalid?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: 'smooth',
        block: 'center',
      });
      invalid?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
        ...(this.current()
          ? []
          : [Validators.pattern(/^10\d{9}$/)]),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAreaValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const areaSelected = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value) > 0;
    const cargo = this.form.controls.cargo;

    if (areaSelected) {
      cargo.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ]);
    } else {
      cargo.setValidators([Validators.maxLength(120)]);
    }

    cargo.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private syncAssignmentDateState(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.fechaAsignacionArea;
    const current = this.current();

    if (!current) {
      this.assignmentChanged.set(false);
      this.currentAssignmentDate.set('');
      control.clearValidators();
      control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
      return;
    }

    const areaId = Number(this.form.controls.areaId.value);
    const cargo =
      normalizeOptionalText(this.form.controls.cargo.value)
      ?? '';

    const changed =
      areaId !== this.initialAssignmentAreaId
      || cargo.localeCompare(
        this.initialAssignmentCargo,
        undefined,
        { sensitivity: 'accent' },
      ) !== 0;

    this.assignmentChanged.set(changed);

    if (!changed) {
      this.currentAssignmentDate.set(
        this.initialAssignmentDate,
      );
      control.clearValidators();
      control.setValue(
        this.initialAssignmentDate,
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
      control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
      return;
    }

    this.currentAssignmentDate.set('');
    control.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    control.setValidators([Validators.required]);

    if (
      !control.value
      || control.value === this.initialAssignmentDate
    ) {
      const minimum =
        this.assignmentChangeMinimumDate();
      const suggested =
        minimum && minimum > this.today
          ? minimum
          : this.today;

      control.setValue(
        suggested,
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private refreshGeneratedEmployeeCode(): void {
    const document = sanitizeDocument(
      this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
    );

    this.form.controls.codigoEmpleado.setValue(
      buildSystemCode('EMP', document, 30),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );
  }

  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);

    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      const resolvedType = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
      const resolvedDocument = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value;

      if (resolvedType === 'DNI' || resolvedType === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(resolvedType, resolvedDocument),
        );
      }

      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set('Datos de la persona cargados.');
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks = this.factilizaFieldLocks(result);

    this.form.patchValue({
      tipoDocumento:
        result.documentType === 'RUC' ? 'RUC' :
        result.documentType === 'DNI' ? 'DNI' :
        this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      numeroDocumento:
        result.documentNumber?.trim() ||
        this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? sanitizePersonName(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  isIdentityFieldReadOnly(
    field: keyof IdentityFieldLocks,
  ): boolean {
    return this.identityLocks()[field];
  }

  private loadExistingIdentityPolicy(
    employee: Empleado | EmpleadoDetalle,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
  ): void {
    const documentNumber =
      sanitizeDocument(type, employee.numeroDocumento);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          if (
            result.entityId !== null
            && result.entityId !== employee.empleadoId
          ) {
            this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
            return;
          }

          this.identityLocks.set(
            this.factilizaFieldLocks(result),
          );
          this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
        },
      });
  }

  private factilizaFieldLocks(
    result: IdentityResolution,
  ): IdentityFieldLocks {
    const status =
      (result.queryStatus ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (!status.startsWith('EXITO')) {
      return emptyIdentityFieldLocks();
    }

    const separator = status.indexOf('|');
    const encodedFields =
      separator >= 0
        ? status.slice(separator + 1)
        : '';

    const fields = new Set(
      encodedFields
        .split(',')
        .map((item) => item.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    );

    if (fields.size === 0) {
      return {
        names: Boolean(result.names?.trim()),
        paternalSurname: Boolean(result.paternalSurname?.trim()),
        maternalSurname: Boolean(result.maternalSurname?.trim()),
        birthDate: Boolean(result.birthDate),
        phone: false,
        email: false,
        geography: Boolean(result.districtCode?.trim()),
        populationCenter:
          result.populationCenterId !== null
          && result.populationCenterId > 0,
        reference: Boolean(
          result.locationReference?.trim()
          || result.suggestedFiscalAddress?.trim(),
        ),
      };
    }

    return {
      names: fields.has('NOMBRES'),
      paternalSurname: fields.has('APELLIDO_PATERNO'),
      maternalSurname: fields.has('APELLIDO_MATERNO'),
      birthDate: fields.has('FECHA_NACIMIENTO'),
      phone: fields.has('TELEFONO'),
      email: fields.has('CORREO'),
      geography: fields.has('GEOGRAFIA'),
      populationCenter: fields.has('CENTRO_POBLADO'),
      reference: fields.has('REFERENCIA'),
    };
  }

  private loadCargoOptions(): void {
    this.cargoLoading.set(true);
    this.cargoError.set(null);

    this.references
      .catalog('CARGO_EMPLEADO', true)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.cargoLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.cargoOptions.set(items),
        error: () => {
          this.cargoOptions.set([]);
          this.cargoError.set(
            'No se pudieron cargar los cargos.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private applyEntryDateValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.fechaIngreso;

    control.setValidators(
      this.current()
        ? [Validators.required]
        : [
            Validators.required,
            this.notPastEntryDateValidator,
          ],
    );

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.populationCenter
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    }

    if (locks.populationCenter) {
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoEmpleado,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeEmployeeDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoEmpleado {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private resolveTargetUotId(preferredUotId?: number | null): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? preferredUotId ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0 ? preferredUotId : 0;
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.current.set(null);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      this.initialAssignmentAreaId = 0;
      this.initialAssignmentCargo = '';
      this.initialAssignmentDate = '';
      this.assignmentChanged.set(false);
      this.currentAssignmentDate.set('');
      this.resetIdentityState();
    });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Empleados"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general del personal de todas tus UOT; cada fila conserva su adscripción.' : 'Personal adscrito a ' + contextUotName() + '.'"
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (click)="create()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Registrar empleado
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeUotFilter">{{ isGeneral() ? 'Filtrar por UOT' : 'UOT activa' }}</label>
        @if (isGeneral()) {
          <select id="employeeUotFilter" class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="changeUot($any($event.target).value)">
            <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
            @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        } @else {
          <input id="employeeUotFilter" class="admin-input" [value]="contextUotName()" readonly />
        }
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeAreaFilter">Área</label>
        <select id="employeeAreaFilter" class="admin-select" [value]="areaFilter() ?? 0" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (change)="changeArea($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas las áreas</option>
          @for (area of activeAreas(); track area.areaId + '-' + area.uotId) {
            <option [value]="area.areaId">{{ isGeneral() && !unitFilter() ? area.uotNombre + ' · ' : '' }}{{ area.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="employeeActiveFilter">Estado</label>
        <select id="employeeActiveFilter" class="admin-select" [value]="activeFilter() === null ? '' : activeFilter()" (change)="changeActive($any($event.target).value)">
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="true">Activos</option>
          <option value="false">Retirados</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (referencesError()) {
      <app-error-state [message]="referencesError() || 'No se pudieron cargar las áreas.'" (retry)="loadReferences()" />
    } @else if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state title="Cargando empleados" message="Consultando el personal visible para el contexto UOT." />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="load()" />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin empleados" message="No hay empleados para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr><th>Empleado</th><th>Documento</th><th>UOT</th><th>Área / cargo</th><th>Cuenta</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (employee of result().items; track rowKey(employee)) {
              <tr>

                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ employee.numeroDocumento }}</strong><span>{{ employee.tipoDocumento }}</span></div></td>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ employee.uotNombre }}</strong><span>{{ employee.uotCodigo }}</span></div></td>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ employee.area || 'Sin área' }}</strong><span>{{ employee.cargo || 'Sin cargo' }}</span></div></td>
                <td>
                  @if (employee.usuarioId) { <div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ employee.nombreUsuario }}</strong><span>{{ employee.estadoCuenta || '—' }}</span></div> }
                  @else { <span class="admin-muted-badge">Sin cuenta</span> }
                </td>
                <td class="text-center"><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="employee.estado" [class.admin-status--inactive]="!employee.estado">{{ employee.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Retirado' }}</span></td>
                <td><div class="admin-row-actions">
                  <a *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/administracion/empleados', employee.empleadoId]" [queryParams]="{ uotId: employee.uotId }" title="Ver esta adscripción"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a>
                  <button *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="!employee.estado || editingId() !== null" title="Editar esta adscripción" (click)="edit(employee)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                  <button *appPermission="'EMPLEADOS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" [disabled]="!employee.estado || retiringId() !== null" title="Retirar de esta UOT" (click)="retire(employee)"><fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon" /></button>
                </div></td>

            }

        </table>
      </div>
      <app-paginator [page]="result().page" [size]="result().size" [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords" [totalPages]="result().totalPages" (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)" (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)" />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-empleado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUsers,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { Area } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/domain/area.model';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { Empleado } from '../../../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadoFormComponent } from '../empleado-form/empleado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleados-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    EmpleadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleados-list.html',
  styleUrl: './empleados-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EmpleadosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EmpleadoFormComponent)
  private formModal!: EmpleadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarEmpleadoUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly retiringId = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly editingId = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<Empleado>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly areas = signal<readonly Area[]>([]);

  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly areaFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly activeFilter = signal<boolean | null>(true);

  readonly pageIcon = faUsers;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly units = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());
  readonly contextUotId = computed(() =>
    this.isGeneral() ? this.unitFilter() : this.uot.selectedId(),
  );
  readonly contextUotName = computed(() => {
    const id = this.contextUotId();
    return id
      ? this.units().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre ?? 'UOT'
      : 'Todas mis UOT';
  });
  readonly activeAreas = computed(() => {
    const uotId = this.contextUotId();
    return this.areas().filter(
      (area) => area.estado && (!uotId || area.uotId === uotId),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' ? this.uot.selectedId() : null);
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
      this.organizationsUseCase.areas(page, size, this.contextUotId() ?? undefined),
    )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (areas) => this.areas.set(areas),
        error: (error) => {
          this.areas.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        uotId: this.contextUotId() ?? undefined,
        areaId: this.areaFilter() ?? undefined,
        activo: this.activeFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeUot(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.areaFilter.set(null);
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeArea(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.areaFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeActive(value: string): void {
    this.activeFilter.set(value === 'true' ? true : value === 'false' ? false : null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) return;
    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las áreas', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.open({
      areas: this.areas().filter((area) => area.estado),
      preferredUotId: this.contextUotId() ?? undefined,
    });
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  edit(employee: Empleado): void {
    const key = this.rowKey(employee);
    if (this.editingId()) return;
    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las áreas', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    this.editingId.set(key);
    this.getUseCase.execute(employee.empleadoId, employee.uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.editingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (detail) => {
          const result = await this.formModal.open(
            {
              areas: this.areas().filter((area) => area.estado),
              preferredUotId: employee.uotId,
            },
            detail,
          );
          if (result.saved) this.load();
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo abrir el empleado', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async retire(employee: Empleado): Promise<void> {
    const key = this.rowKey(employee);
    if (!employee.estado || this.retiringId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar empleado de la UOT',
      message: `Se cerrará la adscripción de ${this.fullName(employee)} en ${employee.uotNombre}. Si trabaja en otra UOT, su cuenta seguirá activa allí.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.retiringId.set(key);
    this.retireUseCase.execute(employee.empleadoId, employee.uotId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Adscripción del empleado retirada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo retirar al empleado', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  fullName(employee: Empleado): string {
    return [employee.nombres, employee.apellidoPaterno, employee.apellidoMaterno]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ');
  }

  rowKey(employee: Empleado): string {
    return `${employee.empleadoId}-${employee.uotId}`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  EmployeeCreateRequest,
  EmployeeRetireRequest,
  EmployeeUpdateRequest,
  EmpleadosService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { EmpleadosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/empleados.gateway';
import { EmpleadoFiltro } from '../../../domain/empleado-filtro.model';
import {
  EmpleadoCreate,
  EmpleadoUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/empleado.model';
import { EmpleadosHttpMapper } from './empleados-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class EmpleadosHttpAdapter implements EmpleadosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(EmpleadosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(EmpleadosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: EmpleadoFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .empleadosListar(
        {
          uotId: filter.uotId,
          empresaId: filter.empresaId,
          areaId: filter.areaId,
          activo: filter.activo,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number, uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .empleadosVer(
        { id, uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  create(input: EmpleadoCreate) {
    const employeeCreateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as EmployeeCreateRequest;

    return this.api
      .empleadosCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          employeeCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: EmpleadoUpdate) {
    const employeeUpdateRequest = this.compact(input) as unknown as EmployeeUpdateRequest;

    return this.api
      .empleadosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          employeeUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  retire(id: number, uotId: number, motivo: string, fechaCese?: string) {
    const employeeRetireRequest: EmployeeRetireRequest = {
      uotId,
      motivo,
      fechaCese,
    };

    return this.api
      .empleadosRetirar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          employeeRetireRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(
        ([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== '',
      ),
    ) as T;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../shared/admin-api.mapper';
import {
  Empleado,
  EmpleadoAreaHistorial,
  EmpleadoDetalle,
  EmpleadoRol,
  EmpleadoUsuario,
} from '../../../domain/empleado.model';

@Injectable()
export class EmpleadosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.employee(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): EmpleadoDetalle {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    const userRaw = this.api.record(raw['usuario']);

    return {
      ...this.employee(raw),
      fechaNacimiento: this.api.nullableString(raw['fechaNacimiento']),
      distritoCodigo: this.api.string(raw['distritoCodigo']),
      distritoNombre: this.api.nullableString(raw['distritoNombre']),
      centroPobladoId: this.api.nullableNumber(raw['centroPobladoId']),
      centroPobladoNombre: this.api.nullableString(raw['centroPobladoNombre']),
      referencia: this.api.nullableString(raw['referencia']),
      areas: this.api
        .array(raw['areas'])
        .map((item) => this.areaHistory(this.api.record(item))),
      usuario:
        this.api.nullableNumber(userRaw['usuarioId']) === null
          ? null
          : this.user(userRaw),
      roles: this.api
        .array(raw['roles'])
        .map((item) => this.role(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(raw['empleadoId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private employee(row: Record<string, unknown>): Empleado {
    return {
      empleadoId: this.api.number(row['empleadoId']),
      uotId: this.api.number(row['uotId']),

}
```

```typescript
import { Provider } from '@angular/core';

import { EMPLEADOS_GATEWAY } from './application/port/out/empleados.gateway';
import { CrearEmpleadoUseCase } from './application/use-case/crear-empleado.use-case';
import { EditarEmpleadoUseCase } from './application/use-case/editar-empleado.use-case';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from './application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase } from './application/use-case/obtener-empleado.use-case';
import { RetirarEmpleadoUseCase } from './application/use-case/retirar-empleado.use-case';
import { EmpleadosHttpAdapter } from './adapter/out/http/empleados-http.adapter';
import { EmpleadosHttpMapper } from './adapter/out/http/empleados-http.mapper';

export function provideEmpleados(): Provider[] {
  return [
    EmpleadosHttpMapper,
    EmpleadosHttpAdapter,
    {
      provide: EMPLEADOS_GATEWAY,
      useExisting: EmpleadosHttpAdapter,
    },
    ListarEmpleadosUseCase,
    ObtenerEmpleadoUseCase,
    CrearEmpleadoUseCase,
    EditarEmpleadoUseCase,
    RetirarEmpleadoUseCase,
  ];
}
```

```typescript
import { Routes } from '@angular/router';

import { moduleAccessGuard } from '../../../core/access/module-access.guard';
import { permissionGuard } from '../../../core/access/permission.guard';

export const empleadosRoutes: Routes = [
  {
    path: 'empleados',
    data: {
      breadcrumb: 'Empleados',
      module: 'EMPLEADOS',
      permission: 'EMPLEADOS_LISTAR',
    },
    canActivate: [moduleAccessGuard, permissionGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/empleados-list/empleados-list').then(
        (m) => m.EmpleadosListPage,
      ),
  },
  {
    path: 'empleados/:id',
    data: {
      breadcrumb: 'Detalle del empleado',
      module: 'EMPLEADOS',
      permission: 'EMPLEADOS_VER',
    },
    canActivate: [moduleAccessGuard, permissionGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/empleado-detail/empleado-detail').then(
        (m) => m.EmpleadoDetailPage,
      ),
  },
];
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
}

.area-hierarchy {
  min-width: 0;

  background: var(--desco-surface);
}

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);

}

}

  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.area-hierarchy__toolbar span {

}

  background: var(--desco-surface-elevated);
  padding: 0 0.7rem;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.area-hierarchy__center-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary-border);
  color: var(--desco-primary);
}

.area-hierarchy__viewport {
  max-height: 36rem;
  min-height: 22rem;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  cursor: grab;
  touch-action: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.area-hierarchy__viewport--panning {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.area-hierarchy__canvas {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%;
  min-height: 18rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 2rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem 2rem;
}

.area-hierarchy__canvas--multiple {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.area-uot-lane {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 18rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);

  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--desco-surface-soft) 72%,
    transparent
  );
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem 1.5rem;
}

.area-node {
  display: flex;
  width: 13.5rem;
  min-height: 4.4rem;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border-strong);
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-elevated);
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: var(--desco-shadow-sm);
}

  width: 16rem;
  border-color: color-mix(
    in srgb,

    var(--desco-border)
  );

    color-mix(
      in srgb,
      var(--desco-primary) 10%,
      transparent
    );
}

.area-node__icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;

  flex: 0 0 auto;

}

.area-node > div {

}

  display: block;

  font-weight: 700;

}

.area-hierarchy__empty--global {
  margin: auto;
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .area-hierarchy__toolbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .area-hierarchy__toolbar span {
    max-width: 15rem;
  }

    gap: 1rem;

  .area-uot-lane {
```
