```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Detalle del rol"
    subtitle="Consulta permisos y usuarios vinculados al rol."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <a
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        routerLink="/administracion/roles-permisos"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" />
        Volver
      </a>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      @if (detail(); as value) {
        @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
          <span
            class="admin-managed-badge"
            [attr.title]="systemRoleReason"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
            Rol base
          </span>

          <button
            *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_CREAR'"
            type="button"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            disabled
            [attr.title]="systemRoleReason"
            aria-describedby="system-role-reason"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="permissionsIcon" />
            Administrar permisos
          </button>

          <button
            *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_RETIRAR'"
            type="button"
            class="admin-danger-button"
            disabled
            [attr.title]="systemRoleReason"
            aria-describedby="system-role-reason"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
            Deshabilitar
          </button>
        } @else {
          <a
            *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_CREAR'"
            class="admin-primary-button"
            [routerLink]="[
              '/administracion/roles-permisos',
              value.rol.rolId,
              'permisos'
            ]"
          >
            <fa-icon [icon]="permissionsIcon" />
            Administrar permisos
          </a>

          <button
            *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_RETIRAR'"
            type="button"
            class="admin-danger-button"
            [disabled]="disabling()"
            (click)="disable(confirmDialog)"
          >
            @if (disabling()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              Deshabilitando...
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
              Deshabilitar
            }
          </button>
        }
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando rol"
        message="Consultando permisos y usuarios asociados."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as value) {
      <section class="admin-detail-grid">
        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.codigo }}</strong>
        </article>

        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Nombre</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.nombre }}</strong>
        </article>

        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Permisos activos</span>
          <strong>{{ activePermissions().length }}</strong>
        </article>

        <article class="admin-detail-card">
          <span>Usuarios</span>
          <strong>{{ users().length }}</strong>
        </article>
      </section>

      @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
        <div
          id="system-role-reason"
          class="system-role-notice mt-4"
          role="note"
        >
          <fa-icon [icon]="infoIcon" />
          <div>
            <strong>Rol base protegido</strong>
            <span>
              Sus datos, permisos y estado se mantienen desde la configuración
              oficial del sistema, por eso estas acciones están disponibles
              solo como consulta.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      }

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="admin-section-header">
          <div>
            <p>Autorización</p>
            <h2>Permisos asignados</h2>
          </div>

          <span class="admin-count-badge">
            {{ activePermissions().length }}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div class="permission-chip-grid">
          @for (permission of pagedPermissions(); track permission.permisoId) {
            <article class="permission-chip">
              <div>
                <strong>{{ permission.nombre }}</strong>
                <span>{{ permission.moduloNombre }}</span>
              </div>
              <small>{{ permission.accion || permission.codigo }}</small>
            </article>
          } @empty {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy">El rol no tiene permisos activos.</p>
          }
        </div>

        @if (activePermissions().length > 0) {
          <app-paginator
            [page]="permissionPage()"
            [size]="permissionSize()"
            [totalRecords]="activePermissions().length"
            [totalPages]="permissionTotalPages()"
            [pageSizes]="[10, 20, 50]"
            (pageChange)="changePermissionPage($event)"
            (sizeChange)="changePermissionSize($event)"
          />
        }
      </section>

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="admin-section-header">
          <div>
            <p>Asignaciones</p>
            <h2>Usuarios con este rol</h2>
          </div>

          <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ users().length }}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-table-wrap">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Usuario</th>
                <th>Empleado</th>
                <th>Documento</th>
                <th>Desde</th>
                <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>
              @for (user of pagedUsers(); track user.usuarioId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-entity">
                      <span class="admin-avatar">
                        {{ user.nombreUsuario.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() }}
                      </span>

                      <div>
                        <strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
                        <span>Cuenta asignada</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td>
                    <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                      <strong>{{ user.empleado || 'Sin empleado' }}</strong>
                      <span>Empleado</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td>{{ user.numeroDocumento || '—' }}</td>

                  <td>
                    {{
                      user.fechaDesde
                        ? (user.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')
                        : '—'
                    }}
                  </td>

                  <td class="text-center">
                    <span
                      class="admin-status"
                      [class.admin-status--active]="user.estado"
                      [class.admin-status--inactive]="!user.estado"
                    >
                      {{ user.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              } @empty {
                <tr>
                  <td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">
                    No hay usuarios asignados.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        @if (users().length > 0) {
          <app-paginator
            [page]="userPage()"
            [size]="userSize()"
            [totalRecords]="users().length"
            [totalPages]="userTotalPages()"
            [pageSizes]="[10, 20, 50]"
            (pageChange)="changeUserPage($event)"
            (sizeChange)="changeUserSize($event)"
          />
        }
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<app-action-confirm-dialog #confirmDialog />
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/administracion/roles-permisos/adapter/in/ui/pages/rol-detail/rol-detail.ts`

```typescript
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faBan,
  faCircleInfo,
  faKey,
  faLock,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { DeshabilitarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-rol.use-case';
import { ObtenerRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-rol.use-case';
import { RolDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-rol-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './rol-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './rol-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolDetailPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRolUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarRolUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly disabling = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<RolDetalle | null>(null);

  readonly permissionPage = signal(1);
  readonly permissionSize = signal(10);
  readonly userPage = signal(1);
  readonly userSize = signal(10);

  readonly roleId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));

  readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly permissionsIcon = faKey;
  readonly usersIcon = faUserGroup;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly infoIcon = faCircleInfo;

  readonly activePermissions = computed(
    () => this.detail()?.permisos.filter((permission) => permission.estado) ?? [],
  );

  readonly permissionTotalPages = computed(() =>
    this.totalPages(this.activePermissions().length, this.permissionSize()),
  );

  readonly pagedPermissions = computed(() =>
    this.slicePage(
      this.activePermissions(),
      this.permissionPage(),
      this.permissionSize(),
    ),
  );

  readonly users = computed(() => this.detail()?.usuarios ?? []);

  readonly userTotalPages = computed(() =>
    this.totalPages(this.users().length, this.userSize()),
  );

  readonly pagedUsers = computed(() =>
    this.slicePage(this.users(), this.userPage(), this.userSize()),
  );

  readonly systemRoleReason =
    'Este es un rol base administrado por el sistema. Su definición está protegida para mantener estable la matriz oficial de acceso.';

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.roleId) || this.roleId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El rol solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.detail.set(detail);
          this.permissionPage.set(1);
          this.userPage.set(1);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changePermissionPage(page: number): void {
    this.permissionPage.set(this.safePage(page, this.permissionTotalPages()));
  }

  changePermissionSize(size: number): void {
    this.permissionSize.set(size);
    this.permissionPage.set(1);
  }

  changeUserPage(page: number): void {
    this.userPage.set(this.safePage(page, this.userTotalPages()));
  }

  changeUserSize(size: number): void {
    this.userSize.set(size);
    this.userPage.set(1);
  }

  async disable(dialog: ActionConfirmDialogComponent): Promise<void> {
    const role = this.detail()?.rol;

    if (!role || this.disabling()) {
      return;
    }

    if (role.esSistema) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Rol base protegido',
        'Los roles base no pueden deshabilitarse desde la interfaz porque forman parte de la matriz oficial de acceso.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await dialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar rol',
      message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica por qué debe deshabilitarse este rol.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.disabling.set(true);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.disabling.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol deshabilitado');
          void this.router.navigate(['/administracion/roles-permisos']);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar el rol',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private totalPages(totalRecords: number, size: number): number {
    return totalRecords === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(totalRecords / size);
  }

  private safePage(page: number, totalPages: number): number {
    if (totalPages <= 0) {
      return 1;
    }

    return Math.min(Math.max(1, page), totalPages);
  }

  private slicePage<T>(
    values: readonly T[],
    page: number,
    size: number,
  ): readonly T[] {
    const start = (page - 1) * size;
    return values.slice(start, start + size);
  }
}
```

```css
:host {
  display: block;
}

.role-permission-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.role-permission-summary > div {
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);

  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.9rem;
}

.permission-group header span {

  font-weight: 700;
}

.role-permission-summary strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.permission-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding: 1rem;
}

.permission-count {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.permission-groups {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.permission-group {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 1rem;
}

.permission-group > header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

}

.permission-group h2 {

  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.permission-options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.permission-option {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.permission-option:nth-child(odd) {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
}

.permission-option:has(.permission-checkbox-native:checked) {
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
}

.permission-option:focus-within {
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
}

.permission-checkbox-native {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.permission-option .permission-checkbox-box {
  display: grid;
  width: 1.25rem;
  height: 1.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  margin-top: 0.02rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--desco-text-muted);
  border-radius: 0.35rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  color: transparent;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    border-color 120ms ease,
    background-color 120ms ease,
    box-shadow 120ms ease,
    transform 120ms ease;
}

.permission-option .permission-checkbox-box--selected {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary);
  background: var(--desco-primary);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.28);
}

.permission-option .permission-checkbox-check {

}

.permission-checkbox-native:focus-visible + .permission-checkbox-box {
  outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.22);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.permission-option:hover .permission-checkbox-box:not(.permission-checkbox-box--selected) {
  border-color: var(--desco-primary);
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
}

.permission-option:active .permission-checkbox-box:not(.permission-checkbox-box--readonly) {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}

.permission-checkbox-box--readonly {
  cursor: default;
}

.permission-option:has(.permission-checkbox-box--readonly) {
  cursor: default;
}

.permission-option > div {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.permission-option strong,
.permission-option span,
.permission-option small {
  display: block;
}

.permission-option strong {

}

.permission-option em {

}

.permission-reason {

.permission-reason label {

}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .role-permission-summary,
  .permission-options {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
```

```html
      <button

            Guardando...
          } @else {

            Guardar permisos
          }
        </button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando permisos"
        message="Preparando los permisos disponibles para este rol."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (detail(); as value) {
      <section class="role-permission-summary">
        <div>
          <span>Rol</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.nombre }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Código</span>
          <strong>{{ value.rol.codigo }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Seleccionados</span>
          <strong>{{ selectedIds().size }}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
        <div class="admin-notice admin-notice--warning mt-4">
          Este rol es administrado por el sistema y sus permisos no pueden modificarse desde esta pantalla.
        </div>
      }

      <section class="admin-surface mt-4">
        <div class="permission-toolbar">
          <div class="admin-search">
            <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
            <input
              type="search"
              placeholder="Buscar permiso o módulo"
              [value]="search()"
              (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="permission-count">
            {{ assignable().length }} permisos disponibles
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="permission-groups">
          @for (group of groups(); track group.moduleCode) {
            <section class="permission-group">
              <header>
                <div>
                  <h2>{{ group.moduleName }}</h2>
                  <span>{{ group.moduleCode }}</span>
                </div>

                @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                  <span class="admin-managed-badge">
                    <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
                    Base
                  </span>
                } @else {
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                    (click)="toggleGroup(group)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="selectIcon" />
                    Alternar grupo
                  </button>
                }
              </header>

              <div class="permission-options">
                @for (permission of group.permissions; track permission.permisoId) {
                  <label class="permission-option">
                    @if (value.rol.esSistema) {
                      <span
                        class="permission-checkbox-box permission-checkbox-box--readonly"
                        [class.permission-checkbox-box--selected]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        @if (isSelected(permission.permisoId)) {
                          <span class="permission-checkbox-check">✓</span>
                        }
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        class="permission-checkbox-native"
                        [checked]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        [attr.aria-label]="'Permiso ' + permission.nombre"
                        (change)="toggle(permission.permisoId, $any($event.target).checked)"
                      />
                      <span
                        class="permission-checkbox-box"
                        [class.permission-checkbox-box--selected]="isSelected(permission.permisoId)"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        @if (isSelected(permission.permisoId)) {
                          <span class="permission-checkbox-check">✓</span>
                        }
                      </span>
                    }
                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ permission.nombre }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ permission.codigo }}</span>
                      @if (permission.descripcion) {
                        <small>{{ permission.descripcion }}</small>
                      }
                    </div>
                    @if (permission.sensible) {
                      <em>Sensible</em>
                    }
                  </label>
                }
              </div>
            </section>
          } @empty {
            <div class="admin-table-empty">No hay permisos para el filtro indicado.</div>
          }
        </div>

        @if (!value.rol.esSistema) {
          <div class="permission-reason">
            <label for="permissionReason">Motivo del cambio</label>
            <textarea
              id="permissionReason"
              class="admin-textarea"
              rows="3"
              maxlength="500"
              [placeholder]="reasonRequired() ? 'Indique el motivo del cambio' : 'Opcional'"
              [value]="reason()"
              (input)="onReasonInput($any($event.target).value)"
            ></textarea>
            <small>{{ reason().length }}/500 caracteres</small>
            @if (reasonError()) {
              <small class="text-red-600">{{ reasonError() }}</small>
            } @else if (reasonRequired()) {
              <small>Este cambio requiere un motivo.</small>
            }
          </div>
        }
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/administracion/roles-permisos/adapter/in/ui/pages/rol-permisos/rol-permisos.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faCheckDouble,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faKey,
  faLock,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faRotate,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { normalizeOptionalText } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ActualizarPermisosRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/actualizar-permisos-rol.use-case';
import { ObtenerRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-rol.use-case';
import { PermisoAsignable } from '../../../../../domain/rol-permiso.model';
import { RolDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';

interface PermissionGroup {
  moduleCode: string;
  moduleName: string;
  permissions: readonly PermisoAsignable[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-rol-permisos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './rol-permisos.html',
  styleUrl: './rol-permisos.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolPermisosPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRolUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(ActualizarPermisosRolUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly roleId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<RolDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly selectedIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
  readonly initialSelectedIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly reason = signal('');
  readonly reasonError = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faKey;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly selectIcon = faCheckDouble;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;

  readonly assignable = computed<readonly PermisoAsignable[]>(() => {
    const unique = new Map<number, PermisoAsignable>();

    for (const permission of this.access.permissions()) {
      if (!permission.permisoId) {
        continue;
      }

      unique.set(permission.permisoId, {
        permisoId: permission.permisoId,
        codigo: permission.codigo,
        nombre: permission.nombre || permission.codigo,
        descripcion: permission.descripcion,
        accion: permission.accion,
        moduloCodigo: permission.codigoModulo || 'GENERAL',
        moduloNombre:
          this.access
            .modules()
            .find((module) => module.codigo === permission.codigoModulo)
            ?.nombre ||
          permission.codigoModulo ||
          'General',
        sensible: permission.sensible,
        requiereMotivo: permission.requiereMotivo,
      });
    }

    return [...unique.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.moduloNombre.localeCompare(b.moduloNombre) ||
        a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre),
    );
  });

  readonly groups = computed<readonly PermissionGroup[]>(() => {
    const term = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    const grouped = new Map<string, PermissionGroup>();

    for (const permission of this.assignable()) {
      const searchable =
        `${permission.nombre} ${permission.codigo} ${permission.moduloNombre}`.toLowerCase();

      if (term && !searchable.includes(term)) {
        continue;
      }

      const current = grouped.get(permission.moduloCodigo);

      if (current) {
        grouped.set(permission.moduloCodigo, {
          ...current,
          permissions: [...current.permissions, permission],
        });
      } else {
        grouped.set(permission.moduloCodigo, {
          moduleCode: permission.moduloCodigo,
          moduleName: permission.moduloNombre,
          permissions: [permission],
        });
      }
    }

    return [...grouped.values()];
  });

  readonly hasPermissionChanges = computed(() => {
    const initial = this.initialSelectedIds();
    const current = this.selectedIds();

    if (initial.size !== current.size) {
      return true;
    }

    return [...initial].some((id) => !current.has(id));
  });

  readonly reasonRequired = computed(() => {
    const initial = this.initialSelectedIds();
    const current = this.selectedIds();
    const changed = new Set<number>();

    for (const id of initial) {
      if (!current.has(id)) changed.add(id);
    }
    for (const id of current) {
      if (!initial.has(id)) changed.add(id);
    }

    return this.assignable().some(
      (permission) => changed.has(permission.permisoId) && permission.requiereMotivo,
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.detail.set(detail);
          const selected = new Set(
            detail.permisos
              .filter((permission) => permission.estado)
              .map((permission) => permission.permisoId),
          );
          this.selectedIds.set(new Set(selected));
          this.initialSelectedIds.set(new Set(selected));
          this.reason.set('');
          this.reasonError.set(null);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  isSelected(id: number): boolean {
    return this.selectedIds().has(id);
  }

  toggle(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedIds());

    if (checked) {
      next.add(id);
    } else {
      next.delete(id);
    }

    this.selectedIds.set(next);
  }

  toggleGroup(group: PermissionGroup): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedIds());
    const allSelected = group.permissions.every((permission) =>
      next.has(permission.permisoId),
    );

    for (const permission of group.permissions) {
      if (allSelected) {
        next.delete(permission.permisoId);
      } else {
        next.add(permission.permisoId);
      }
    }

    this.selectedIds.set(next);
  }

  onReasonInput(value: string): void {
    this.reason.set(value.slice(0, 500));
    this.reasonError.set(null);
  }

  save(): void {
    const role = this.detail()?.rol;

    if (!role || role.esSistema || this.saving() || !this.hasPermissionChanges()) {
      return;
    }

    const reason = normalizeOptionalText(this.reason());

    if (this.reasonRequired() && (!reason || reason.length < 5)) {
      this.reasonError.set('Indique un motivo de al menos 5 caracteres para este cambio.');
      return;
    }

    if (reason && reason.length > 500) {
      this.reasonError.set('El motivo no puede superar 500 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    this.reasonError.set(null);
    this.saving.set(true);

    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(role.rolId, {
        permisoIds: [...this.selectedIds()],
        motivo: reason,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Permisos actualizados');
          void this.router.navigate([
            '/administracion/roles-permisos',
            role.rolId,
          ]);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudieron actualizar los permisos',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Roles y permisos"
    subtitle="Administra roles y la asignación de permisos disponibles."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="openCreate()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        Nuevo rol
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando roles"
        message="Consultando roles y asignaciones activas."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin roles"
        message="No hay roles disponibles."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Rol</th>
              <th>Código</th>
              <th class="text-center">Permisos</th>
              <th class="text-center">Usuarios</th>
              <th class="text-center">Segundo factor</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (role of result().items; track role.rolId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-entity-icon">
                      <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ role.nombre }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ role.descripcion || 'Sin descripción' }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <span class="admin-code">{{ role.codigo }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ role.permisosActivos }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ role.usuariosActivos }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--info]="role.requiereSegundoFactor"
                    [class.admin-status--neutral]="!role.requiereSegundoFactor"
                  >
                    {{ role.requiereSegundoFactor ? 'Requerido' : 'No requerido' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="role.estado"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="!role.estado"
                  >
                    {{ role.estado ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo' }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <a
                      *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_VER'"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      [routerLink]="['/administracion/roles-permisos', role.rolId]"
                      title="Ver detalle"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                    </a>

                    @if (role.esSistema) {
                      <span
                        class="admin-managed-badge"
                        title="Rol base administrado por el sistema"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
                        Base
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_EDITAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        title="Editar"
                        (click)="openEdit(role)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      </button>

                      <a
                        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_CREAR'"
                        class="admin-icon-button"
                        [routerLink]="['/administracion/roles-permisos', role.rolId, 'permisos']"
                        title="Administrar permisos"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="permissionsIcon" />
                      </a>

                      <button
                        *appPermission="'ROLESPERMISOS_RETIRAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                        title="Deshabilitar"
                        [disabled]="disablingId() === role.rolId"
                        (click)="disable(role)"
                      >
                        @if (disablingId() === role.rolId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<dialog #roleDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeModal()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="currentRole() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Roles y permisos</p>
          <h2>{{ currentRole() ? 'Editar rol' : 'Registrar rol' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="closeModal()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (modalError()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ modalError() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="roleName">Nombre</label>
        <input
          id="roleName"
          class="admin-input"
          type="text"
          formControlName="nombre"
          maxlength="100"
        />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre" [messages]="{ blank: 'El nombre no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="roleDescription">Descripción</label>
        <textarea
          id="roleDescription"
          class="admin-textarea"
          formControlName="descripcion"
          maxlength="200"
          rows="3"
        ></textarea>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.descripcion" fieldLabel="La descripción" [messages]="{ blank: 'La descripción no puede contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>

      <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
        <div>
          <strong>Requerir segundo factor</strong>
          <span>El usuario deberá completar una verificación adicional al ingresar.</span>
        </div>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="admin-switch-control"
          formControlName="requiereSegundoFactor"
        />
      </label>

        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="closeModal()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>
        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBan, faEye, faFloppyDisk, faKey, faLock, faPen, faPlus, faRotate, faShieldHalved, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { normalizeOptionalText, normalizeText, notBlankValidator, optionalNotBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildSystemCode } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { CrearRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-rol.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-rol.use-case';
import { EditarRolUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-rol.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { Rol } from '../../../../../domain/rol.model';
@Component({
    selector: 'app-roles-list-page',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [
        ReactiveFormsModule,
        RouterLink,
        FaIconComponent,
        PermissionDirective,
        LoadingStateComponent,
        ErrorStateComponent,
        EmptyStateComponent,
        PaginatorComponent,
        ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
        FormErrorComponent,
        PageHeaderComponent,
    ],
    templateUrl: './roles-list.html',
    styleUrl: './roles-list.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RolesListPage implements OnInit {
    @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
    private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
    private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearRolUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRolUseCase);
    private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarRolUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly loading = signal(true);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly disablingId = signal<number | null>(null);
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly modalError = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly currentRole = signal<Rol | null>(null);
    readonly result = signal<PageResult<Rol>>(emptyPageResult(20));
    readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly viewIcon = faEye;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly permissionsIcon = faKey;
    readonly disableIcon = faBan;
    readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly lockIcon = faLock;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        codigo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(40)]],
        nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(100)]],
        descripcion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(200)]],
        requiereSegundoFactor: [false],
    });
    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.load(1);
    }
    load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
        this.loading.set(true);
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.listUseCase
            .execute(page, size)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    openCreate(): void {
        this.currentRole.set(null);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: '',
            nombre: '',
            descripcion: '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        openAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement);
    }
    openEdit(role: Rol): void {
        if (role.esSistema) {
            return;
        }
        this.currentRole.set(role);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        this.form.reset({
            codigo: role.codigo,
            nombre: role.nombre,
            descripcion: role.descripcion ?? '',
            requiereSegundoFactor: role.requiereSegundoFactor,
        });
        this.form.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        openAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement);
    }
    closeModal(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        closeAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement, () => {
            this.currentRole.set(null);
            this.modalError.set(null);
        });
    }
    save(): void {
        const current = this.currentRole();

        if (!current) {
            this.form.controls.codigo.setValue(buildSystemCode('ROL', this.form.controls.nombre.value, 40), {
                emitEvent: false,
            });
        }

        this.form.markAllAsTouched();

        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }

        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        this.saving.set(true);
        this.modalError.set(null);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.rolId, {
                nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(values.descripcion),
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                codigo: values.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
                nombre: normalizeText(values.nombre),
                descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(values.descripcion),
                requiereSegundoFactor: values.requiereSegundoFactor,
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Rol actualizado' : 'Rol registrado');
                this.closeModal();
                this.load(current ? this.result().page : 1);
            },
            error: (error) => this.modalError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    async disable(role: Rol): Promise<void> {
        if (role.esSistema || this.disablingId()) {
            return;
        }
        const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
            title: 'Deshabilitar rol',
            message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" se deshabilitará y sus asignaciones activas serán retiradas.`,
            tone: 'danger',
            confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
            cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
            requiresReason: true,
            reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
            reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
            minimumReasonLength: 5,
        });
        if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
            return;
        }
        this.disablingId.set(role.rolId);
        this.disableUseCase
            .execute(role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.disablingId.set(null)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success('Rol deshabilitado');
                this.load();
            },
            error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar el rol', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  RoleCreateRequest,
  RoleDisableRequest,
  RolePermissionsUpdateRequest,
  RoleUpdateRequest,
  RolesYPermisosService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { RolesPermisosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/roles-permisos.gateway';
import { RolPermisoUpdate } from '../../../domain/rol-permiso.model';
import { RolCreate, RolUpdate } from '../../../domain/rol.model';
import { RolesPermisosHttpMapper } from './roles-permisos-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class RolesPermisosHttpAdapter implements RolesPermisosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(RolesYPermisosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(RolesPermisosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(page: number, size: number) {
    return this.api
      .rolesListar(
        { pagina: page, tamano: size },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .rolesVer(
        { id },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  create(input: RolCreate) {
    const roleCreateRequest: RoleCreateRequest = {
      codigo: input.codigo,
      nombre: input.nombre,
      descripcion: input.descripcion,
      requiereSegundoFactor: input.requiereSegundoFactor,
    };

    return this.api
      .rolesCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          roleCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: RolUpdate) {
    const roleUpdateRequest: RoleUpdateRequest = {
      nombre: input.nombre,
      descripcion: input.descripcion,
      requiereSegundoFactor: input.requiereSegundoFactor,
    };

    return this.api
      .rolesEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          roleUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  disable(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const roleDisableRequest: RoleDisableRequest = { motivo };

    return this.api
      .rolesDeshabilitar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          roleDisableRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  updatePermissions(id: number, input: RolPermisoUpdate) {
    const rolePermissionsUpdateRequest: RolePermissionsUpdateRequest = {
      permisoIds: [...input.permisoIds],
      motivo: input.motivo,
    };

    return this.api
      .rolesActualizarPermisos(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          rolePermissionsUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { Permiso } from '../../../domain/permiso.model';
import {
  Rol,
  RolDetalle,
  RolUsuario,
} from '../../../domain/rol.model';

@Injectable()
export class RolesPermisosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.role(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): RolDetalle {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));

    return {
      rol: this.role(this.api.record(raw['rol'])),
      permisos: this.api
        .array(raw['permisos'])
        .map((item) => this.permission(this.api.record(item))),
      usuarios: this.api
        .array(raw['usuarios'])
        .map((item) => this.user(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(raw['rolId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private role(row: Record<string, unknown>): Rol {
    return {
      rolId: this.api.number(row['rolId']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      descripcion: this.api.nullableString(row['descripcion']),
      requiereSegundoFactor: this.api.boolean(row['requiereSegundoFactor']),
      esSistema: this.api.boolean(row['esSistema']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      usuariosActivos: this.api.number(row['usuariosActivos']),
      permisosActivos: this.api.number(row['permisosActivos']),
    };
  }

  private permission(row: Record<string, unknown>): Permiso {
    return {
      permisoId: this.api.number(row['permisoId']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      accion: this.api.nullableString(row['accion']),
      esSensible: this.api.boolean(row['esSensible']),
      requiereMotivo: this.api.boolean(row['requiereMotivo']),
      moduloCodigo: this.api.string(row['moduloCodigo']),
      moduloNombre: this.api.string(row['moduloNombre']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
    };
  }

  private user(row: Record<string, unknown>): RolUsuario {
    return {
      usuarioId: this.api.number(row['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.api.string(row['nombreUsuario']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.nullableString(row['numeroDocumento']),
      empleado: this.api.nullableString(row['empleado']),
      fechaDesde: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaDesde']),
      fechaHasta: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaHasta']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import {
  ApiEnvelope,
  unwrapApiResponse,
} from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { PageResult } from '../../../shared/models/page-result.model';

type UnknownRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

interface RawPage {
  items?: unknown;
  pagina?: unknown;
  tamanio?: unknown;
  totalRegistros?: unknown;
  totalPaginas?: unknown;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class AdminApiMapper {
  data<T>(response: unknown): T {
    return unwrapApiResponse<T>(response as ApiEnvelope<T>);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    unwrapApiResponse<unknown>(response as ApiEnvelope<unknown>);
  }

  page<T>(
    response: unknown,
    mapper: (row: UnknownRecord) => T,
    fallbackSize = 20,
  ): PageResult<T> {
    const raw = this.record(this.data<unknown>(response)) as RawPage;
    const items = this.array(raw.items).map((item) => mapper(this.record(item)));

    return {
      items,
      page: this.positiveInteger(raw.pagina, 1),
      size: this.positiveInteger(raw.tamanio, fallbackSize),
      totalRecords: this.nonNegativeInteger(raw.totalRegistros),
      totalPages: this.nonNegativeInteger(raw.totalPaginas),
    };
  }

  record(value: unknown): UnknownRecord {
    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? (value as UnknownRecord)
      : {};
  }

  array(value: unknown): unknown[] {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  }

  string(value: unknown): string {
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? '');
  }

  nullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value : null;
  }

  number(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }

  nullableNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }

  boolean(value: unknown): boolean {
    return value === true || value === 1 || value === 'true' || value === '1';
  }

  private positiveInteger(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0
      ? Math.trunc(parsed)
      : fallback;
  }

  private nonNegativeInteger(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0
      ? Math.trunc(parsed)
      : 0;
  }
}
```

```typescript
export function buildSystemCode(
  prefix: string,
  source: string,
  maxLength: number,
): string {
  const normalizedPrefix = normalizeCodePart(prefix) || 'SYS';
  const normalizedSource = normalizeCodePart(source) || 'REGISTRO';
  const raw = `${normalizedPrefix}_${normalizedSource}`;

  return raw.slice(0, Math.max(1, maxLength)).replace(/_+$/g, '');
}

export function buildUsernameSuggestion(
  label: string,
  entityId: number,
  maxLength = 80,
): string {
  const displayName = label.split('·')[0]?.trim() || 'usuario';
  const normalized = normalizeText(displayName)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  const parts = normalized.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const first = parts[0] || 'usuario';
  const last = parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : '';
  const base = [first, last, String(entityId)]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join('.');

  return base.slice(0, Math.max(1, maxLength)).replace(/[._-]+$/g, '');
}

function normalizeCodePart(value: string): string {
  return normalizeText(value)
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')
    .replace(/_+/g, '_');
}

function normalizeText(value: string): string {
  return (value || '')
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
}
```

- Ruta: `src/app/features/administracion/shared/admin-reference.util.ts`

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/administracion/shared/admin-reference.util.ts`

```typescript
import { Observable, forkJoin, map, of, switchMap } from 'rxjs';

import { PageResult } from '../../../shared/models/page-result.model';

/**
 * Carga todas las páginas de una referencia administrativa usando el tamaño
 * máximo habitual del backend. Los formularios nunca deben obligar al usuario
 * a conocer un FK porque una referencia quedó fuera de la primera página.
 */
export function loadAllAdminPages<T>(
  loader: (page: number, size: number) => Observable<PageResult<T>>,
  pageSize = 100,
): Observable<readonly T[]> {
  return loader(1, pageSize).pipe(
    switchMap((first) => {
      const totalPages = Math.max(1, first.totalPages || 1);

      if (totalPages <= 1) {
        return of(first.items);
      }

      const remaining = Array.from(
        { length: totalPages - 1 },
        (_, index) => loader(index + 2, pageSize),
      );

      return forkJoin(remaining).pipe(
        map((pages) => [
          ...first.items,
          ...pages.flatMap((page) => page.items),
        ]),
      );
    }),
  );
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faShieldHalved,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { ActualizarPoliticaSeguridadUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/actualizar-politica-seguridad.use-case';
import { PoliticaSeguridadDispositivo } from '../../../../../domain/politica-seguridad.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-politica-seguridad-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './politica-seguridad-form.html',
  styleUrl: './politica-seguridad-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PoliticaSeguridadFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(ActualizarPoliticaSeguridadUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly shieldIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    diasDispositivoReconocido: [
      7,
      [Validators.required, Validators.min(1), Validators.max(365)],
    ],
  });

  private resolver: ((saved: boolean) => void) | null = null;
  private closing = false;

  open(policy: PoliticaSeguridadDispositivo): Promise<boolean> {
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({
      diasDispositivoReconocido: policy.diasDispositivoReconocido || 7,
    });
    this.closing = false;
    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.closing) {
      return;
    }

    const days = Number(this.form.controls.diasDispositivoReconocido.value);
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(days)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Política de acceso actualizada');
          this.finish(true);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo actualizar la política', message);
        },
      });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.closing) {
      this.finish(false);
    }
  }

  private finish(saved: boolean): void {
    if (this.closing) return;
    this.closing = true;

    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(saved);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      this.closing = false;
    });
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="detail()?.nombreUsuario || 'Detalle del usuario'"

    eyebrow="Usuario"

            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="reactivateIcon" />
            }

          </button>

          <button
            *appPermission="'USUARIOS_RETIRAR'"

            class="admin-danger-button"
            [disabled]="accountActionLoading()"

            } @else {

        }
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {

          <fa-icon class="text-blue-600" [icon]="deviceIcon" />
        </div>

        <div class="device-admin-grid">
          @for (device of user.dispositivos; track device.dispositivoUsuarioId) {
            <article>
              <div class="device-admin-icon">
                <fa-icon [icon]="deviceIcon" />
              </div>
              <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <strong>
                  {{ device.navegador || 'Navegador' }}
                  ·
                  {{ device.sistemaOperativo || 'Dispositivo' }}
                </strong>
                <span>
                  Última actividad:
                  {{ device.ultimaActividad ? (device.ultimaActividad | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span
                class="admin-status"

                [class.admin-status--neutral]="!device.esReconocido"

                {{ device.esReconocido ? 'Reconocido' : 'No reconocido' }}
              </span>
            </article>
          } @empty {
            <p class="admin-empty-copy">No hay dispositivos registrados.</p>
          }
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  </div>
</div>

<dialog #roleDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeRoleDialog()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--compact">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="roleIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Usuarios y accesos</p>
          <h2>Asignar rol</h2>

      <button
        type="button"

    @if (roleError()) {

          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Asignar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

<app-usuario-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```
