```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  FormBuilder,
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  Validators,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faBan,
  faComputer,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faKey,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faRotateLeft,
  faShieldHalved,
  faTrashCan,
  faUser,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { AsignarRolUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/asignar-rol-usuario.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-cuenta.use-case';
import { ObtenerUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-usuario.use-case';
import { ReactivarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/reactivar-cuenta.use-case';
import { RetirarRolUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-rol-usuario.use-case';
import { UsuarioDetalle, UsuarioRol } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuarioFormComponent } from '../usuario-form/usuario-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UsuarioFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuarioDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UsuarioFormComponent)
  private formModal!: UsuarioFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  @ViewChild('roleDialog', { static: true })
  private readonly roleDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly reactivateUseCase = inject(ReactivarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly assignRoleUseCase = inject(AsignarRolUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly removeRoleUseCase = inject(RetirarRolUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly rolesUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly userId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly rolesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly accountActionLoading = signal(false);
  readonly roleSaving = signal(false);
  readonly removingRoleId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly roleError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly rolesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<UsuarioDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly availableRoles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;
  readonly roleIcon = faKey;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly deviceIcon = faComputer;
  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly roleForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    rolId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadRoles();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.userId) || this.userId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El usuario solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(this.userId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadRoles(): void {
    this.rolesLoading.set(true);
    this.rolesError.set(null);

    loadAllAdminPages((page, size) => this.rolesUseCase.execute(page, size))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.rolesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (roles) =>
          this.availableRoles.set(
            roles
              .filter((role) => role.estado)
              .map((role) => ({
                value: role.rolId,
                label: role.nombre,
                description: role.codigo,
              })),
          ),
        error: (error) => {
          this.availableRoles.set([]);
          this.rolesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openEdit(user);

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async disable(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || this.accountActionLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" dejará de poder ingresar al sistema.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.accountActionLoading.set(true);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.accountActionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta deshabilitada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async reactivate(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || this.accountActionLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Reactivar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" volverá a estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Reactivar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.accountActionLoading.set(true);

    this.reactivateUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.accountActionLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta reactivada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reactivar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  openAssignRole(): void {
    if (this.rolesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.rolesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los roles', this.rolesError()!);
      return;
    }

    const selected = new Set(
      this.detail()?.roles
        .filter((role) => role.estado)
        .map((role) => role.rolId) ?? [],
    );

    const firstAvailable = this.availableRoles().find(
      (role) => !selected.has(role.value),
    );

    this.roleForm.reset({ rolId: firstAvailable?.value ?? 0 });
    this.roleError.set(null);
    openAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement);
  }

  closeRoleDialog(): void {
    if (this.roleSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    closeAnimatedDialog(this.roleDialog.nativeElement, () => {
      this.roleError.set(null);
    });
  }

  roleOptions(): readonly AdminSelectOption[] {
    const selected = new Set(
      this.detail()?.roles
        .filter((role) => role.estado)
        .map((role) => role.rolId) ?? [],
    );

    return this.availableRoles().filter(
      (role) => !selected.has(role.value),
    );
  }

  assignRole(): void {
    this.roleForm.markAllAsTouched();

    const user = this.detail();
    const roleId = Number(this.roleForm.controls.rolId.value);

    if (!user || this.roleForm.invalid || this.roleSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.roleSaving.set(true);
    this.roleError.set(null);

    this.assignRoleUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, roleId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.roleSaving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol asignado');
          this.closeRoleDialog();
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.roleError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async removeRole(role: UsuarioRol): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.detail();

    if (!user || !role.estado || this.removingRoleId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Retirar rol',
      message: `El rol "${role.nombre}" dejará de estar asignado a la cuenta.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar rol',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro del rol.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.removingRoleId.set(role.rolId);

    this.removeRoleUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, role.rolId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.removingRoleId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Rol retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar el rol',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  isDisabled(): boolean {
    return (this.detail()?.estadoCuenta || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESHABILITADA';
  }

  accountStateLabel(state: string | null): string {
    switch ((state || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ACTIVA':
        return 'Activa';
      case 'DESHABILITADA':
        return 'Deshabilitada';
      case 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION':
        return 'Pendiente de validación';
      case 'BLOQUEADA':
        return 'Bloqueada';
      default:
        return state || 'Sin estado';
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Usuarios y accesos</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar cuenta' : 'Crear cuenta' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      @if (!current()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="userEmployee">Empleado</label>
          <select
            id="userEmployee"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="empleadoId"
            (change)="suggestUsername($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar empleado</option>
            @for (employee of employees(); track employee.value) {
              <option [value]="employee.value">{{ employee.label }}</option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.empleadoId"
            fieldLabel="El empleado"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="username">Nombre de usuario</label>
        <input
          id="username"
          class="admin-input"
          type="text"
          formControlName="nombreUsuario"
          minlength="3"
          maxlength="80"
          autocomplete="off"
          autocapitalize="none"
          spellcheck="false"
          (input)="onUsernameInput()"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombreUsuario"
          fieldLabel="El nombre de usuario"
          [messages]="{ username: 'Use solo letras minúsculas, números, punto, guion o guion bajo, sin espacios.', minlength: 'El nombre de usuario debe tener al menos 3 caracteres.' }"
        />
      </div>

      @if (!current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="initialPassword">Contraseña inicial</label>
          <div class="admin-password-field">
            <input
              id="initialPassword"
              class="admin-input"
              [type]="showPassword() ? 'text' : 'password'"
              formControlName="passwordInicial"
              minlength="12"
              maxlength="128"
              autocomplete="new-password"
              autocapitalize="off"
              spellcheck="false"
              placeholder="Mínimo 12 caracteres"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-password-toggle"
              [attr.aria-label]="showPassword() ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Mostrar contraseña'"
              (click)="showPassword.set(!showPassword())"
            >
              <fa-icon [icon]="showPassword() ? eyeSlashIcon : eyeIcon" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.passwordInicial"
            fieldLabel="La contraseña inicial"
            [messages]="{ minlength: 'La contraseña debe tener al menos 12 caracteres.', passwordOuterWhitespace: 'La contraseña no puede comenzar ni terminar con espacios.', passwordControlCharacter: 'La contraseña contiene caracteres no permitidos.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="securityEmail">Correo de seguridad</label>
          <input
            id="securityEmail"
            class="admin-input"
            type="email"
            formControlName="correoSeguridad"
            maxlength="200"
            autocomplete="email"
            autocapitalize="none"
            spellcheck="false"
            (blur)="normalizeSecurityEmail()"
          />
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.correoSeguridad"
            fieldLabel="El correo de seguridad"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Roles iniciales</label>
          <div class="admin-option-grid">
            @for (role of roles(); track role.value) {
              <label class="admin-check-option">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  class="checkbox checkbox-primary checkbox-sm"
                  [checked]="roleSelected(role.value)"
                  (change)="toggleRole(role.value, $any($event.target).checked)"
                />
                <div>
                  <strong>{{ role.label }}</strong>
                  @if (role.description) {
                    <span>{{ role.description }}</span>
                  }
                </div>
              </label>
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      }

      <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
        <div>
          <strong>Cambio de contraseña requerido</strong>
          <span>Solicitar una nueva contraseña en el siguiente acceso.</span>
        </div>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="admin-switch-control"
          formControlName="requiereCambioPassword"
        />
      </label>

      @if (current()) {
        <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
          <div>
            <strong>Segundo factor</strong>
            <span>Solicitar una verificación adicional durante el acceso.</span>
          </div>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            class="admin-switch-control"
            formControlName="segundoFactorHabilitado"
          />
        </label>
      }

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="close()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal, } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators, } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faEye, faEyeSlash, faFloppyDisk, faPen, faUserPlus, faXmark, } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { passwordSafetyValidator, sanitizeUsername, usernameValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { buildUsernameSuggestion } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-code.util';
import { closeAnimatedDialog, openAnimatedDialog } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption, } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-cuenta.use-case';
import { EditarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-cuenta.use-case';
import { Usuario, UsuarioDetalle, } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
interface UserFormOptions {
    employees: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
    roles: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
}
@Component({
    selector: 'app-usuario-form',
    standalone: true,
    imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
    templateUrl: './usuario-form.html',
    styleUrl: './usuario-form.css',
    changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuarioFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearCuentaUseCase);
    private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarCuentaUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly showPassword = signal(false);
    readonly current = signal<Usuario | UsuarioDetalle | null>(null);
    readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly selectedRoleIds = signal<Set<number>>(new Set());
    readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly eyeIcon = faEye;
    readonly eyeSlashIcon = faEyeSlash;
    private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
        empleadoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
        nombreUsuario: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(3), Validators.maxLength(80), usernameValidator]],
        passwordInicial: [''],
        correoSeguridad: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(200)]],
        requiereCambioPassword: [true],
        segundoFactorHabilitado: [false],
    });
    openCreate(options: UserFormOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.current.set(null);
        this.employees.set(options.employees);
        this.roles.set(options.roles);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(options.roles.length === 1
            ? new Set([Number(options.roles[0].value)])
            : new Set());
        this.errorMessage.set(null);

        const firstEmployee = options.employees[0] ?? null;

        this.form.reset({
            empleadoId: firstEmployee?.value ?? 0,
            nombreUsuario: firstEmployee
                ? buildUsernameSuggestion(firstEmployee.label, Number(firstEmployee.value))
                : '',
            passwordInicial: '',
            correoSeguridad: '',
            requiereCambioPassword: true,
            segundoFactorHabilitado: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.empleadoId.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.setValidators([
            Validators.required,
            Validators.minLength(12),
            Validators.maxLength(128),
            passwordSafetyValidator,
        ]);
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.setValidators([
            Validators.required,
            Validators.email,
            Validators.maxLength(200),
        ]);
        this.updateValidators();
        return this.show();
    }
    openEdit(user: Usuario | UsuarioDetalle): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.current.set(user);
        this.employees.set([]);
        this.roles.set([]);
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(new Set());
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        const detail = 'requiereCambioPassword' in user
            ? (user as UsuarioDetalle)
            : null;
        this.form.reset({
            empleadoId: user.empleadoId,
            nombreUsuario: user.nombreUsuario,
            passwordInicial: '',
            correoSeguridad: '',
            requiereCambioPassword: detail?.requiereCambioPassword ?? false,
            segundoFactorHabilitado: detail?.segundoFactorHabilitado ?? user.segundoFactorHabilitado,
        });
        this.form.controls.empleadoId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.clearValidators();
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.clearValidators();
        this.updateValidators();
        return this.show();
    }
    suggestUsername(value: string): void {
        if (this.current()) {
            return;
        }

        const employeeId = Number(value);
        const employee = this.employees().find((item) => Number(item.value) === employeeId);

        if (!employee) {
            this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            return;
        }

        this.form.controls.nombreUsuario.setValue(buildUsernameSuggestion(employee.label, employeeId), {
            emitEvent: false,
        });
    }

    onUsernameInput(): void {
        const control = this.form.controls.nombreUsuario;
        const sanitized = sanitizeUsername(control.value);
        if (sanitized !== control.value) {
            control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    normalizeSecurityEmail(): void {
        const control = this.form.controls.correoSeguridad;
        const normalized = control.value.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 200);
        if (normalized !== control.value) {
            control.setValue(normalized, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    }
    close(): void {
        if (this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
    toggleRole(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
        const next = new Set(this.selectedRoleIds());
        if (checked) {
            next.add(id);
        }
        else {
            next.delete(id);
        }
        this.selectedRoleIds.set(next);
    }
    roleSelected(id: number): boolean {
        return this.selectedRoleIds().has(id);
    }
    save(): void {
        this.form.markAllAsTouched();
        if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
            return;
        }
        const current = this.current();
        const values = this.form.getRawValue();
        if (!current && this.selectedRoleIds().size === 0) {
            this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona al menos un rol para crear la cuenta.');
            return;
        }
        this.errorMessage.set(null);
        this.saving.set(true);
        const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
            ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.usuarioId, {
                nombreUsuario: sanitizeUsername(values.nombreUsuario),
                requiereCambioPassword: values.requiereCambioPassword,
                segundoFactorHabilitado: values.segundoFactorHabilitado,
            })
            : this.createUseCase.execute({
                empleadoId: Number(values.empleadoId),
                nombreUsuario: sanitizeUsername(values.nombreUsuario),
                passwordInicial: values.passwordInicial,
                correoSeguridad: values.correoSeguridad.trim().toLowerCase(),
                requiereCambioPassword: values.requiereCambioPassword,
                rolIds: [...this.selectedRoleIds()],
            });
        operation
            .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
            .subscribe({
            next: () => {
                this.toast.success(current ? 'Cuenta actualizada' : 'Cuenta registrada');
                this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
            },
            error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
        });
    }
    private updateValidators(): void {
        this.form.controls.passwordInicial.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
        this.form.controls.correoSeguridad.updateValueAndValidity({
            emitEvent: false,
        });
    }
    private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
        this.showPassword.set(false);
        openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            this.resolver = resolve;
        });
    }
    private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
        closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
            this.resolver?.(result);
            this.resolver = null;
            this.current.set(null);
            this.errorMessage.set(null);
            this.selectedRoleIds.set(new Set());
        });
    }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Usuarios y accesos"
    subtitle="Administra cuentas, estados y asignaciones de acceso."
    eyebrow="Administración"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="loading()"
        (click)="load()"
      >
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_ADMINISTRAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="policyLoading()"
        (click)="openSecurityPolicy()"
      >
        @if (policyLoading()) {
          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="policyIcon" />
        }
        Política de acceso
      </button>

      <button
        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        [disabled]="referencesLoading() || referencesError() !== null"
        [attr.title]="referencesError() ? 'No se pudieron cargar las opciones' : employees().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'Todos los empleados activos ya tienen una cuenta' : roles().length === 0 && !referencesLoading() ? 'No hay roles activos disponibles' : 'Crear cuenta'"
        (click)="create()"
      >
        @if (referencesLoading()) {
          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
        } @else {
          <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        }
        Nueva cuenta
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="userStateFilter">Estado de cuenta</label>
        <select
          id="userStateFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="stateFilter()"
          (change)="changeState($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="PENDIENTE_VALIDACION">Pendiente de validación</option>
          <option value="ACTIVA">Activa</option>
          <option value="DESHABILITADA">Deshabilitada</option>
          <option value="BLOQUEADA">Bloqueada</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="userCompanyFilter">Organización</label>
        <select
          id="userCompanyFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="companyFilter() ?? 0"
          (change)="changeCompany($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Todas</option>
          @for (company of companies(); track company.value) {
            <option [value]="company.value">{{ company.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state
        title="Cargando usuarios"
        message="Consultando cuentas y accesos activos."
      />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state
        [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'"
        (retry)="load()"
      />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state
        title="Sin usuarios"
        message="No hay cuentas para los filtros seleccionados."
      />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Usuario</th>
              <th>Empleado</th>
              <th>Organización</th>
              <th class="text-center">Roles</th>
              <th class="text-center">Sesiones</th>
              <th class="text-center">Estado</th>
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (user of result().items; track user.usuarioId) {
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-entity">
                    <span class="admin-avatar">
                      {{ user.nombreUsuario.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() }}
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <strong>{{ user.nombreUsuario }}</strong>
                      <span>{{ user.codigoEmpleado || 'Sin código' }}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-stack-copy">
                    <strong>{{ user.empleado || '—' }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ user.numeroDocumento || '—' }}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{{ user.empresa || '—' }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ user.rolesActivos }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-count-badge">{{ user.sesionesActivas }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span
                    class="admin-status"
                    [class.admin-status--active]="user.estadoCuenta === 'ACTIVA'"
                    [class.admin-status--inactive]="isDisabled(user)"
                    [class.admin-status--info]="user.estadoCuenta === 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION'"
                    [class.admin-status--warning]="user.estadoCuenta === 'BLOQUEADA'"
                  >
                    {{ accountStateLabel(user.estadoCuenta) }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <a
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_VER'"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      [routerLink]="['/administracion/usuarios', user.usuarioId]"
                      title="Ver detalle"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                    </a>

                    <button
                      *appPermission="'USUARIOS_EDITAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Editar"
                      [disabled]="detailLoadingId() === user.usuarioId"
                      (click)="edit(user)"
                    >
                      @if (detailLoadingId() === user.usuarioId) {
                        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                      } @else {
                        <fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" />
                      }
                    </button>

                    @if (isDisabled(user)) {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_CONFIRMAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--success"
                        title="Reactivar"
                        [disabled]="actionUserId() === user.usuarioId"
                        (click)="reactivate(user)"
                      >
                        @if (actionUserId() === user.usuarioId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="reactivateIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    } @else {
                      <button
                        *appPermission="'USUARIOS_RETIRAR'"
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger"
                        title="Deshabilitar"
                        [disabled]="actionUserId() === user.usuarioId"
                        (click)="disable(user)"
                      >
                        @if (actionUserId() === user.usuarioId) {
                          <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                        } @else {
                          <fa-icon [icon]="disableIcon" />
                        }
                      </button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-usuario-form />
<app-politica-seguridad-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBan,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faRotateLeft,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-modal.types';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../shared/admin-reference.util';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../../empleados/application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/deshabilitar-cuenta.use-case';
import { ListarUsuariosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-usuarios.use-case';
import { ObtenerUsuarioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-usuario.use-case';
import { ObtenerPoliticaSeguridadUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-politica-seguridad.use-case';
import { ReactivarCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/reactivar-cuenta.use-case';
import { Usuario } from '../../../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuarioFormComponent } from '../usuario-form/usuario-form';
import { PoliticaSeguridadFormComponent } from '../politica-seguridad-form/politica-seguridad-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuarios-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UsuarioFormComponent,
    PoliticaSeguridadFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuarios-list.html',
  styleUrl: './usuarios-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UsuariosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UsuarioFormComponent)
  private formModal!: UsuarioFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirmDialog!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  @ViewChild(PoliticaSeguridadFormComponent)
  private policyModal!: PoliticaSeguridadFormComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarUsuariosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerUsuarioUseCase);
  private readonly getPolicyUseCase = inject(ObtenerPoliticaSeguridadUseCase);
  private readonly disableUseCase = inject(DeshabilitarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly reactivateUseCase = inject(ReactivarCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly employeesUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
  private readonly rolesUseCase = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly actionUserId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly detailLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly policyLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly referencesError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<Usuario>>(emptyPageResult(20));

  readonly companies = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly companyFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faUsersGear;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly disableIcon = faBan;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly policyIcon = faShieldHalved;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.referencesError.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      companies: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.organizationsUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
      employees: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.employeesUseCase.execute({ activo: true, page, size }),
      ),
      roles: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.rolesUseCase.execute(page, size),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ companies, employees, roles }) => {
          this.companies.set(
            companies.map((company) => ({
              value: company.empresaId,
              label: company.razonSocial,
              description: company.estado ? company.ruc : `${company.ruc} · Inactiva`,
            })),
          );

          this.employees.set(
            employees
              .filter((employee) => employee.estado && !employee.usuarioId)
              .map((employee) => ({
                value: employee.empleadoId,
                label: `${this.employeeName(employee)} · ${employee.numeroDocumento}`,
                description: `${employee.empresa}${employee.area ? ` · ${employee.area}` : ''}`,
              })),
          );

          this.roles.set(
            roles
              .filter((role) => role.estado)
              .map((role) => ({
                value: role.rolId,
                label: role.nombre,
                description: role.codigo,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.companies.set([]);
          this.employees.set([]);
          this.roles.set([]);
          this.referencesError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoCuenta: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        empresaId: this.companyFilter() ?? undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  changeState(value: string): void {
    this.stateFilter.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeCompany(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.companyFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  openSecurityPolicy(): void {
    if (this.policyLoading()) return;

    this.policyLoading.set(true);
    this.getPolicyUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.policyLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (policy) => {
          const saved = await this.policyModal.open(policy);
          if (saved) {
            this.toast.info(
              'Vigencia aplicada',
              'Los dispositivos vencidos volverán a solicitar un código en el próximo acceso.',
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la política de acceso',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.referencesError()) {
      this.toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las opciones', this.referencesError()!);
      return;
    }

    if (this.employees().length === 0) {
      this.toast.info(
        'Sin empleados disponibles',
        'Todos los empleados activos ya tienen una cuenta.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.roles().length === 0) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Sin roles disponibles',
        'Primero debe existir al menos un rol activo.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.formModal.openCreate({
      employees: this.employees(),
      roles: this.roles(),
    });

    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadReferences();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  edit(user: Usuario): void {
    if (this.detailLoadingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.detailLoadingId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (detail) => {
          const result = await this.formModal.openEdit(detail);

          if (result.saved) {
            this.load();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async disable(user: Usuario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.actionUserId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Deshabilitar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" dejará de poder ingresar al sistema.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la deshabilitación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.actionUserId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.disableUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionUserId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta deshabilitada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo deshabilitar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async reactivate(user: Usuario): Promise<void> {
    if (this.actionUserId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirmDialog.show({
      title: 'Reactivar cuenta',
      message: `La cuenta "${user.nombreUsuario}" volverá a estar disponible.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Reactivar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.actionUserId.set(user.usuarioId);

    this.reactivateUseCase
      .execute(user.usuarioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionUserId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Cuenta reactivada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo reactivar la cuenta',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  isDisabled(user: Usuario): boolean {
    return (user.estadoCuenta || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESHABILITADA';
  }

  accountStateLabel(state: string | null): string {
    switch ((state || '').toUpperCase()) {
      case 'ACTIVA':
        return 'Activa';
      case 'DESHABILITADA':
        return 'Deshabilitada';
      case 'PENDIENTE_VALIDACION':
        return 'Pendiente de validación';
      case 'BLOQUEADA':
        return 'Bloqueada';
      default:
        return state || 'Sin estado';
    }
  }

  private employeeName(employee: {
    nombres: string;
    apellidoPaterno: string;
    apellidoMaterno: string | null;
  }): string {
    return [
      employee.nombres,
      employee.apellidoPaterno,
      employee.apellidoMaterno,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ');
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  UserAssignRoleRequest,
  UserCreateRequest,
  UserDisableRequest,
  UserReactivateRequest,
  UserRemoveRoleRequest,
  UserUpdateRequest,
  SecurityPolicyDeviceTrustUpdateRequest,
  UsuariosYAccesosService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { UsuariosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/usuarios.gateway';
import { UsuarioFiltro } from '../../../domain/usuario-filtro.model';
import {
  UsuarioCreate,
  UsuarioUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/usuario.model';
import { UsuariosHttpMapper } from './usuarios-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class UsuariosHttpAdapter implements UsuariosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(UsuariosYAccesosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(UsuariosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: UsuarioFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .usuariosListar(
        {
          estadoCuenta: filter.estadoCuenta,
          empresaId: filter.empresaId,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .usuariosVer(
        { id },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  getSecurityPolicy() {
    return this.api
      .usuariosPoliticaSeguridadVer(
        {},
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.securityPolicy(response)));
  }

  updateSecurityPolicy(diasDispositivoReconocido: number) {
    const securityPolicyDeviceTrustUpdateRequest:
      SecurityPolicyDeviceTrustUpdateRequest = {
        diasDispositivoReconocido,
      };

    return this.api
      .usuariosPoliticaSeguridadActualizar(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          securityPolicyDeviceTrustUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  create(input: UsuarioCreate) {
    const userCreateRequest: UserCreateRequest = {
      empleadoId: input.empleadoId,
      nombreUsuario: input.nombreUsuario,
      passwordInicial: input.passwordInicial,
      correoSeguridad: input.correoSeguridad,
      requiereCambioPassword: input.requiereCambioPassword,
      rolIds: [...input.rolIds],
    };

    return this.api
      .usuariosCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: UsuarioUpdate) {
    const userUpdateRequest: UserUpdateRequest = {
      nombreUsuario: input.nombreUsuario,
      requiereCambioPassword: input.requiereCambioPassword,
      segundoFactorHabilitado: input.segundoFactorHabilitado,
    };

    return this.api
      .usuariosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  disable(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const userDisableRequest: UserDisableRequest = { motivo };

    return this.api
      .usuariosDeshabilitar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userDisableRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  reactivate(id: number, motivo?: string) {
    const userReactivateRequest: UserReactivateRequest = { motivo };

    return this.api
      .usuariosReactivar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userReactivateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  assignRole(id: number, rolId: number) {
    const userAssignRoleRequest: UserAssignRoleRequest = { rolId };

    return this.api
      .usuariosAsignarRol(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userAssignRoleRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  removeRole(id: number, rolId: number, motivo: string) {
    const userRemoveRoleRequest: UserRemoveRoleRequest = {
      rolId,
      motivo,
    };

    return this.api
      .usuariosRetirarRol(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          userRemoveRoleRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { UsuarioDispositivo } from '../../../domain/usuario-dispositivo.model';
import { PoliticaSeguridadDispositivo } from '../../../domain/politica-seguridad.model';
import {
  Usuario,
  UsuarioDetalle,
  UsuarioRol,
} from '../../../domain/usuario.model';

@Injectable()
export class UsuariosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.user(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): UsuarioDetalle {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));

    return {
      usuarioId: this.api.number(raw['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.api.string(raw['nombreUsuario']),
      estadoCuenta: this.api.nullableString(raw['estadoCuenta']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(raw['estado']),
      fechaCreacion: this.api.nullableString(raw['fechaCreacion']),
      ultimoAccesoCorrecto: this.api.nullableString(raw['ultimoAccesoCorrecto']),
      fechaCambioPassword: this.api.nullableString(raw['fechaCambioPassword']),
      requiereCambioPassword: this.api.boolean(raw['requiereCambioPassword']),
      segundoFactorHabilitado: this.api.boolean(raw['segundoFactorHabilitado']),
      empleadoId: this.api.number(raw['empleadoId']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.nullableString(raw['numeroDocumento']),
      empleado: this.api.nullableString(raw['empleado']),
      roles: this.api
        .array(raw['roles'])
        .map((item) => this.role(this.api.record(item))),
      dispositivos: this.api
        .array(raw['dispositivos'])
        .map((item) => this.device(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  securityPolicy(response: unknown): PoliticaSeguridadDispositivo {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));

    return {
      diasDispositivoReconocido: this.api.number(
        raw['diasDispositivoReconocido'],
      ),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const raw = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(raw['usuarioId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private user(row: Record<string, unknown>): Usuario {
    return {
      usuarioId: this.api.number(row['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.api.string(row['nombreUsuario']),
      estadoCuenta: this.api.nullableString(row['estadoCuenta']),
      fechaCreacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCreacion']),
      ultimoAccesoCorrecto: this.api.nullableString(row['ultimoAccesoCorrecto']),
      intentosFallidos: this.api.number(row['intentosFallidos']),
      bloqueadoHasta: this.api.nullableString(row['bloqueadoHasta']),
      segundoFactorHabilitado: this.api.boolean(row['segundoFactorHabilitado']),
      empleadoId: this.api.number(row['empleadoId']),
      codigoEmpleado: this.api.nullableString(row['codigoEmpleado']),
      empresa: this.api.nullableString(row['empresa']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.nullableString(row['numeroDocumento']),
      empleado: this.api.nullableString(row['empleado']),
      rolesActivos: this.api.number(row['rolesActivos']),
      sesionesActivas: this.api.number(row['sesionesActivas']),
    };
  }

  private role(row: Record<string, unknown>): UsuarioRol {
    return {
      rolId: this.api.number(row['rolId']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      fechaDesde: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaDesde']),
      fechaHasta: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaHasta']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
    };
  }

  private device(row: Record<string, unknown>): UsuarioDispositivo {
    return {
      dispositivoUsuarioId: this.api.number(row['dispositivoUsuarioId']),
      navegador: this.api.nullableString(row['navegador']),
      sistemaOperativo: this.api.nullableString(row['sistemaOperativo']),
      primeraDeteccion: this.api.nullableString(row['primeraDeteccion']),
      ultimaActividad: this.api.nullableString(row['ultimaActividad']),
      esReconocido: this.api.boolean(row['esReconocido']),
      fechaReconocimiento: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaReconocimiento']),
      fechaRetiroReconocimiento: this.api.nullableString(
        row['fechaRetiroReconocimiento'],
      ),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
```

```typescript
  removeRole(id: number, rolId: number, motivo: string): Observable<void>;
}
```

```typescript
}
```

```typescript
import { Routes } from '@angular/router';

import { moduleAccessGuard } from '../../../core/access/module-access.guard';
import { permissionGuard } from '../../../core/access/permission.guard';

export const usuariosRoutes: Routes = [
  {
    path: 'usuarios',
    data: {
      breadcrumb: 'Usuarios y accesos',
      module: 'USUARIOS',
      permission: 'USUARIOS_LISTAR',
    },
    canActivate: [moduleAccessGuard, permissionGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/usuarios-list/usuarios-list').then(
        (m) => m.UsuariosListPage,
      ),
  },
  {
    path: 'usuarios/:id',
    data: {
      breadcrumb: 'Detalle del usuario',
      module: 'USUARIOS',
      permission: 'USUARIOS_VER',
    },
```

```typescript
  readonly cameraIcon = faCamera; readonly closeIcon = faXmark; readonly retryIcon = faRotate; readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  private stream: MediaStream | null = null; private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;
  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ tipoEvidencia: ['FOTOGRAFIA', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(50)]], descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(1000)]] });

  async open(context: EvidenciaContexto): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.context.set(context); this.captured.set(null); this.releasePreview(); this.errorMessage.set(null); this.location.set(null); this.form.reset({ tipoEvidencia: 'FOTOGRAFIA', descripcion: '' }); this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    await this.startCamera(); void this.resolveLocation();
    return new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolver = resolve; });
  }
  async startCamera(): Promise<void> {
    this.stopCamera(); this.starting.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) throw new Error('La cámara no está disponible en este dispositivo o navegador.');
      this.stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' } }, audio: false });
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve));
      const video = this.videoRef?.nativeElement; if (video) { video.srcObject = this.stream; await video.play(); }
    } catch (error) { this.errorMessage.set(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'No se pudo iniciar la cámara.'); }
    finally { this.starting.set(false); }
  }
  capture(): void {
    const video = this.videoRef?.nativeElement; const canvas = this.canvasRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!video || !canvas || !video.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight) { this.errorMessage.set('La cámara todavía no está lista para capturar.'); return; }
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth; canvas.height = video.videoHeight; canvas.getContext('2d')?.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => { if (!blob) { this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo generar la fotografía.'); return; } this.captured.set(blob); this.releasePreview(); this.previewUrl.set(URL.createObjectURL(blob)); this.stopCamera(); }, 'image/jpeg', 0.9);
  }
  retake(): void { this.captured.set(null); this.releasePreview(); void this.startCamera(); }
  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched(); const blob = this.captured(); const context = this.context(); if (!blob || !context || this.form.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue(); const file = new File([blob], `foto-${Date.now()}.jpg`, { type: 'image/jpeg' }); const location = this.location(); this.saving.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.useCase.execute({ file, tipoEvidencia: raw.tipoEvidencia.trim().toUpperCase(), descripcion: raw.descripcion.trim() || undefined, fechaCaptura: new Date().toISOString(), latitudCaptura: location?.latitude, longitudCaptura: location?.longitude, contexto: context })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: ({ archivoId }) => { this.toast.success('Fotografía registrada'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: archivoId }); }, error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message) });
  }
  close(): void { if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
  private resolveLocation(): Promise<void> { return new Promise((resolve) => { if (!navigator.geolocation) { resolve(); return; } navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition((position) => { this.location.set({ latitude: position.coords.latitude, longitude: position.coords.longitude }); resolve(); }, () => resolve(), { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000, maximumAge: 30000 }); }); }

  private releasePreview(): void { const url = this.previewUrl(); if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url); this.previewUrl.set(null); }
  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void { this.stopCamera(); this.releasePreview(); if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(result); this.resolver = null; this.context.set(null); }
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, Input, OnChanges, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCamera, faEye, faFileArrowUp, faFolderOpen, faRotate, faTrashCan } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';
import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { ListarDocumentosEvidenciasUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-documentos-evidencias.use-case';
import { RetirarDocumentoEvidenciaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-documento-evidencia.use-case';
import { DocumentoEvidencia } from '../../../../../domain/documento-evidencia.model';
import { EvidenciaContexto } from '../../../../../domain/evidencia-contexto.model';
import { EvidenceCameraComponent } from '../evidence-camera/evidence-camera';
import { EvidencePreviewComponent } from '../evidence-preview/evidence-preview';
import { EvidenceUploaderComponent } from '../evidence-uploader/evidence-uploader';

@Component({ selector: 'app-evidence-panel', standalone: true, imports: [DatePipe, FaIconComponent, PermissionDirective, LoadingStateComponent, EmptyStateComponent, ActionConfirmDialogComponent, EvidenceCameraComponent, EvidencePreviewComponent, EvidenceUploaderComponent], templateUrl: './evidence-panel.html', styleUrl: './evidence-panel.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class EvidencePanelComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input({ required: true }) context!: EvidenciaContexto;
  @Input() title = 'Documentos y evidencias';
  @ViewChild(EvidenceUploaderComponent) private uploader!: EvidenceUploaderComponent;
  @ViewChild(EvidenceCameraComponent) private camera!: EvidenceCameraComponent;
  @ViewChild(EvidencePreviewComponent) private preview!: EvidencePreviewComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;
  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarDocumentosEvidenciasUseCase); private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarDocumentoEvidenciaUseCase); private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly loading = signal(true); readonly retiringId = signal<number | null>(null); readonly items = signal<readonly DocumentoEvidencia[]>([]); readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly folderIcon = faFolderOpen; readonly uploadIcon = faFileArrowUp; readonly cameraIcon = faCamera; readonly viewIcon = faEye; readonly refreshIcon = faRotate; readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;
  ngOnChanges(): void { if (this.context?.id > 0) this.load(); }
  load(): void { if (!this.context?.id) return; this.loading.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null); this.listUseCase.execute({ contextoTipo: this.context.tipo, contextoId: this.context.id, page: 1, size: 100 }).pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({ next: (result) => this.items.set(result.items), error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message) }); }
  async upload(): Promise<void> { const result = await this.uploader.open(this.context); if (result.saved) this.load(); }
  async capture(): Promise<void> { const result = await this.camera.open(this.context); if (result.saved) this.load(); }
  openPreview(item: DocumentoEvidencia): void { this.preview.open(item); }
  async retire(item: DocumentoEvidencia): Promise<void> { const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Retirar evidencia', message: `La evidencia “${item.nombreOriginal}” dejará de estar disponible en el sistema.`, tone: 'danger', confirmLabel: 'Retirar', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 5 }); if (!result.confirmed || !result.reason) return; this.retiringId.set(item.archivoId); this.retireUseCase.execute(item.archivoId, result.reason).pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success('Evidencia retirada'); this.load(); }, error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo retirar la evidencia', mapOpenApiError(error).message) }); }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { DomSanitizer, SafeResourceUrl } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowUpRightFromSquare, faFile, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { DocumentoEvidencia, DocumentoEvidenciaDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/documento-evidencia.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-evidence-preview',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './evidence-preview.html',
  styleUrl: './evidence-preview.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class EvidencePreviewComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);

  readonly evidence = signal<DocumentoEvidencia | DocumentoEvidenciaDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly safeDocumentUrl = signal<SafeResourceUrl | null>(null);
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly fileIcon = faFile;
  readonly openIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;

  open(evidence: DocumentoEvidencia | DocumentoEvidenciaDetalle): void {
    this.evidence.set(evidence);
    this.safeDocumentUrl.set(
      evidence.mimeType === 'application/pdf'
        ? this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl(evidence.secureUrl)
        : null,
    );
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.evidence.set(null);
    this.safeDocumentUrl.set(null);
  }

  isImage(): boolean {
    return this.evidence()?.mimeType?.startsWith('image/') ?? false;
  }

  isPdf(): boolean {
    return this.evidence()?.mimeType === 'application/pdf';
  }

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const index = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
    return `${(bytes / 1024 ** index).toFixed(index === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[index]}`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCloudArrowUp, faFileArrowUp, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { SubirDocumentoEvidenciaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/subir-documento-evidencia.use-case';
import { EvidenciaCategoria } from '../../../../../domain/documento-evidencia.model';
import { EVIDENCIA_CONTEXTOS, EvidenciaContexto, EvidenciaContextoTipo } from '../../../../../domain/evidencia-contexto.model';

@Component({ selector: 'app-evidence-uploader', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent], templateUrl: './evidence-uploader.html', styleUrl: './evidence-uploader.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class EvidenceUploaderComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true }) private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly useCase = inject(SubirDocumentoEvidenciaUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly progress = signal(0);
  readonly file = signal<File | null>(null);
  readonly fixedContext = signal<EvidenciaContexto | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly contexts = EVIDENCIA_CONTEXTOS;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark; readonly uploadIcon = faCloudArrowUp; readonly fileIcon = faFileArrowUp;
  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;
  readonly categories: readonly EvidenciaCategoria[] = ['DOCUMENTO','FOTOGRAFIA','TICKET','COMPROBANTE','OTRO'];
  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    tipoEvidencia: ['DOCUMENTO', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    categoria: ['DOCUMENTO' as EvidenciaCategoria, [Validators.required]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(1000)]],
    fechaCaptura: [''],
    contextoTipo: ['SOCIO' as EvidenciaContextoTipo, [Validators.required]],
    contextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
  });

  open(context: EvidenciaContexto | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.fixedContext.set(context); this.file.set(null); this.progress.set(0); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.form.reset({ tipoEvidencia: 'DOCUMENTO', categoria: 'DOCUMENTO', descripcion: '', fechaCaptura: '', contextoTipo: context?.tipo ?? 'SOCIO', contextoId: context?.id ?? 0 });
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolver = resolve; });
  }
  selectFile(event: Event): void { const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement; this.file.set(input.files?.[0] ?? null); this.progress.set(0); }
  close(): void { if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    const file = this.file();
    if (!file) { this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona un archivo antes de continuar.'); return; }
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const context = this.fixedContext() ?? { tipo: raw.contextoTipo, id: Number(raw.contextoId) };
    if (context.id <= 0) { this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona un contexto válido para la evidencia.'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.progress.set(10); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.useCase.execute({
      file,
      tipoEvidencia: raw.tipoEvidencia.trim().toUpperCase(),
      categoria: raw.categoria,
      descripcion: raw.descripcion.trim() || undefined,
      fechaCaptura: raw.fechaCaptura ? new Date(raw.fechaCaptura).toISOString() : undefined,
      contexto: context,
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: ({ archivoId }) => { this.progress.set(100); this.toast.success('Documento registrado'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: archivoId }); },
      error: (error) => { this.progress.set(0); this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message); },
    });
  }
  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void { if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(result); this.resolver = null; this.fixedContext.set(null); }
}
```

FOTOGRAFIA" /></div><div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Origen</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="originFilter()" (change)="originFilter.set($any($event.target).value);load(1)"><option value="">Todos</option><option value="CARGA">Carga</option><option value="CAMARA">Cámara</option></select></div><div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>Contexto</label><select class="admin-select" [value]="contextType()||''" (change)="setContext($any($event.target).value)"><option value="">Todos</option>@for(c of contexts;track c.tipo){<option [value]="c.tipo">{{c.etiqueta}}</option>}</select></div>@if(contextType()){<div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field"><label>ID del contexto</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" min="1" [value]="contextId()||''" (change)="setContextId($any($event.target).value)" /></div>}</div>
