```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Documentos locales"
    [subtitle]="uot.isGeneral() ? 'Documentos de todas tus UOT autorizadas.' : 'Documentos de ' + (uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'la UOT activa') + '.'" 
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
      <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface local-doc-upload">
    @if (uot.isGeneral()) {
      <label>
        <span>UOT del listado</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>

      <label>
        <span>UOT para la carga</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="uploadUotId() ?? 0" (change)="onUploadUotChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Categoría</span>
      <input
        class="admin-input"
        maxlength="80"
        [value]="category()"
        (input)="category.set($any($event.target).value)"
      />
    </label>
    <label class="local-doc-description">
      <span>Descripción</span>
      <input
        class="admin-input"
        maxlength="300"
        placeholder="Descripción opcional"
        [value]="description()"
        (input)="description.set($any($event.target).value)"
      />
    </label>
    <label *appPermission="'ARCHIVOS_CREAR'" class="admin-primary-button local-doc-file-button">
      @if (uploading()) {
        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
      } @else {
        <fa-icon [icon]="uploadIcon" />
      }
      {{ uploading() ? 'Subiendo...' : 'Subir archivo' }}
      <input
        #fileInput
        type="file"
        [disabled]="uploading() || (uot.isGeneral() && !uploadUotId())"
        (change)="upload(fileInput)"
      />
    </label>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando documentos" message="Consultando archivos locales." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los documentos.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (items().length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin documentos" message="No existen archivos locales en el contexto seleccionado." />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface local-doc-table-shell">
      <div class="admin-table-scroll">
        <table class="admin-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              @if (uot.isGeneral()) { <th>UOT</th> }
              <th>Archivo</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Tamaño</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of items(); track item.archivoId) {
              <tr>
                @if (uot.isGeneral()) { <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td> }
                <td>
                  <strong>{{ item.nombreOriginal || 'Archivo' }}</strong>
                  <small class="local-doc-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small>
                </td>
                <td>{{ item.categoria || '—' }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.mimeType || '—' }}</td>
                <td>{{ sizeLabel(item.tamanoBytes) }}</td>
                <td>{{ item.fechaCarga | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Abrir" (click)="open(item)">
                      <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      *appPermission="'ARCHIVOS_RETIRAR'"
                      type="button"
                      class="admin-icon-button"
                      title="Retirar"
                      (click)="retire(item)"
                    >
                      <fa-icon [icon]="retireIcon" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  }
</div>
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/documentos-evidencias/adapter/in/ui/pages/documentos-locales/documentos-locales.ts`

```typescript
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowUpRightFromSquare,
  faFileArrowUp,
  faFolderOpen,
  faRotate,
  faTrashCan,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../../../../../../../shared/files/local-document-api.service';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-documentos-locales-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './documentos-locales.html',
  styleUrl: './documentos-locales.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DocumentosLocalesPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly api = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly items = signal<readonly LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>([]);
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly uploadUotId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly category = signal('DOCUMENTO');
  readonly description = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faFolderOpen;
  readonly uploadIcon = faFileArrowUp;
  readonly viewIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly retireIcon = faTrashCan;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const selected = this.uot.isGeneral() ? null : this.uot.selectedId();
    this.unitFilter.set(selected);
    this.uploadUotId.set(selected);
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const unitId =
      this.uot.isGeneral()
        ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
        : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;

    this.api
      .list(unitId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.items.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    const selected = Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
    this.unitFilter.set(selected);

    if (this.uot.isGeneral() && selected) {
      this.uploadUotId.set(selected);
    }

    this.load();
  }

  onUploadUotChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.uploadUotId.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
  }

  upload(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const file = input.files?.item(0) ?? null;
    input.value = '';
    if (!file || this.uploading()) return;

    const uotId = this.uot.isGeneral()
      ? this.uploadUotId() ?? 0
      : this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Selecciona una UOT',
        'La carga de documentos requiere una UOT específica.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (file.size <= 0 || file.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Archivo no permitido',
        'El archivo debe tener contenido y no superar 25 MB.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.uploading.set(true);
    this.api
      .upload({
        uotId,
        file,
        category: this.category().trim().toUpperCase() || 'DOCUMENTO',
        description: this.description().trim() || undefined,
        linkType: 'NINGUNO',
        principal: false,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.uploading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.description.set('');
          this.toast.success('Documento guardado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el documento',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  open(item: LocalDocumentFileResponse): void {
    if (!item.archivoId) return;

    this.api.content(item.archivoId).subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
      },
      error: (error) =>
        this.toast.error(
          'No se pudo abrir el archivo',
          mapOpenApiError(error).message,
        ),
    });
  }

  async retire(item: LocalDocumentFileResponse): Promise<void> {
    if (!item.archivoId) return;

    const answer = await this.alert.question(
      'Retirar documento',
      `¿Deseas retirar “${item.nombreOriginal || 'este archivo'}”? El archivo dejará de estar disponible.`,
      'Retirar',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!answer.confirmed) return;

    this.api
      .retire(
        item.archivoId,
        'Retiro solicitado desde el módulo de documentos locales.',
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Documento retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar el documento',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  sizeLabel(bytes?: number): string {
    const value = bytes ?? 0;
    if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
    if (value < 1024 * 1024) return `${(value / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(value / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';
import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { DocumentosYEvidenciasService, DocumentRetireRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { DocumentosEvidenciasGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/documentos-evidencias.gateway';
import { DocumentoEvidenciaRegistro } from '../../../domain/documento-evidencia.model';
import { EvidenciaFiltro } from '../../../domain/evidencia-filtro.model';
import { DocumentosEvidenciasHttpMapper } from './documentos-evidencias-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class DocumentosEvidenciasHttpAdapter implements DocumentosEvidenciasGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(DocumentosYEvidenciasService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(DocumentosEvidenciasHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: EvidenciaFiltro) {
    return this.api.documentosListar({
      tipoEvidencia: filter.tipoEvidencia,
      origenCaptura: filter.origenCaptura,
      usuarioId: filter.usuarioId,
      contextoTipo: filter.contextoTipo,
      contextoId: filter.contextoId,
      fechaDesde: filter.fechaDesde,
      fechaHasta: filter.fechaHasta,
      pagina: filter.page,
      tamano: filter.size,
    }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(archivoId: number) {
    return this.api.documentosVer({ archivoId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  register(input: DocumentoEvidenciaRegistro) {
    return this.api.documentosRegistrar({
      xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
      documentRegisterRequest: this.mapper.request(input),
    }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  retire(archivoId: number, motivo: string) {
    const documentRetireRequest: DocumentRetireRequest = { motivo };
    return this.api.documentosRetirar({
      archivoId,
      xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
      documentRetireRequest,
    }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { DocumentLinkRequest, DocumentRegisterRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../administracion/shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { DocumentoEvidencia, DocumentoEvidenciaDetalle, DocumentoEvidenciaRegistro } from '../../../domain/documento-evidencia.model';
import { EVIDENCIA_CONTEXTOS } from '../../../domain/evidencia-contexto.model';

@Injectable()
export class DocumentosEvidenciasHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) { return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.summary(row), size); }
  detail(response: unknown): DocumentoEvidenciaDetalle {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return {
      ...this.summary(row),
      cloudinaryPublicId: this.api.string(row['cloudinaryPublicId']),
      vinculos: this.api.array(row['vinculos']).map((item) => {
        const link = this.api.record(item);
        return {
          archivoVinculoId: this.api.number(link['archivoVinculoId']),
          tipoContexto: this.api.string(link['tipoContexto']),
          contextoId: this.api.number(link['contextoId']),
        };
      }),
    };
  }
  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(row['archivoId']);
  }
  void(response: unknown): void { this.api.void(response); }

  request(input: DocumentoEvidenciaRegistro): DocumentRegisterRequest {
    return {
      nombreOriginal: input.nombreOriginal,
      mimeType: input.mimeType,
      cloudinaryPublicId: input.cloudinaryPublicId,
      secureUrl: input.secureUrl,
      tamanoBytes: input.tamanoBytes,
      tipoEvidencia: input.tipoEvidencia,
      categoria: input.categoria,
      origenCaptura: input.origenCaptura,
      descripcion: input.descripcion,
      fechaCaptura: input.fechaCaptura,
      latitudCaptura: input.latitudCaptura,
      longitudCaptura: input.longitudCaptura,
      vinculo: this.link(input),
    };
  }

  private link(input: DocumentoEvidenciaRegistro): DocumentLinkRequest {
    const descriptor = EVIDENCIA_CONTEXTOS.find((item) => item.tipo === input.contexto.tipo);
    if (!descriptor || input.contexto.id <= 0) throw new Error('El contexto de la evidencia no es válido.');
    return { [descriptor.campoVinculo]: input.contexto.id } as DocumentLinkRequest;
  }

  private summary(row: Record<string, unknown>): DocumentoEvidencia {
    return {
      archivoId: this.api.number(row['archivoId']),
      nombreOriginal: this.api.string(row['nombreOriginal']),
      mimeType: this.api.string(row['mimeType']),
      secureUrl: this.api.string(row['secureUrl']),
      tamanoBytes: this.api.number(row['tamanoBytes']),
      categoria: this.api.nullableString(row['categoria']),
      tipoEvidencia: this.api.string(row['tipoEvidencia']),
      origenCaptura: this.api.string(row['origenCaptura']),
      descripcion: this.api.nullableString(row['descripcion']),
      fechaCaptura: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCaptura']),
      latitudCaptura: this.api.nullableNumber(row['latitudCaptura']),
      longitudCaptura: this.api.nullableNumber(row['longitudCaptura']),
      fechaCarga: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCarga']),
      usuarioId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['usuarioId']),
      nombreUsuario: this.api.nullableString(row['nombreUsuario']),
      tipoContexto: this.api.nullableString(row['tipoContexto']),
      contextoId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['contextoId']),
    };
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/documentos-evidencias/adapter/out/storage/cloudinary-evidence-storage.adapter.ts`

```typescript
import { HttpBackend, HttpClient, HttpEventType, HttpRequest } from '@angular/common/http';
import { InjectionToken, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { EvidenceStorageGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/evidence-storage.gateway';
import { EvidenceStorageEvent } from '../../../domain/documento-evidencia.model';

export interface CloudinaryEvidenceStorageConfig {
  cloudName: string;
  uploadPreset: string;
  folder: string;
}

export const CLOUDINARY_EVIDENCE_STORAGE_CONFIG =
  new InjectionToken<CloudinaryEvidenceStorageConfig>('CLOUDINARY_EVIDENCE_STORAGE_CONFIG');

export function runtimeCloudinaryEvidenceStorageConfig(): CloudinaryEvidenceStorageConfig {
  const runtime = (globalThis as {
    __DESCO_CONFIG__?: { cloudinary?: Partial<CloudinaryEvidenceStorageConfig> };
  }).__DESCO_CONFIG__?.cloudinary;

  return {
    cloudName: runtime?.cloudName?.trim() ?? '',
    uploadPreset: runtime?.uploadPreset?.trim() ?? '',
    folder: runtime?.folder?.trim() || 'desco/evidencias',
  };
}

interface CloudinaryUploadResponse {
  public_id?: string;
  secure_url?: string;
  bytes?: number;
  resource_type?: string;
  format?: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class CloudinaryEvidenceStorageAdapter implements EvidenceStorageGateway {
  private readonly http = new HttpClient(inject(HttpBackend));
  private readonly config = inject(CLOUDINARY_EVIDENCE_STORAGE_CONFIG);

  upload(file: File): Observable<EvidenceStorageEvent> {
    this.assertConfigured();
    if (!file || file.size <= 0) throw new Error('Selecciona un archivo válido antes de continuar.');

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file, file.name);
    formData.append('upload_preset', this.config.uploadPreset);
    if (this.config.folder) formData.append('folder', this.config.folder);

    const request = new HttpRequest<FormData>(
      'POST',
      `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${encodeURIComponent(this.config.cloudName)}/auto/upload`,
      formData,
      { reportProgress: true },
    );

    return this.http.request<CloudinaryUploadResponse>(request).pipe(
      map((event) => {
        if (event.type === HttpEventType.UploadProgress) {
          const total = event.total ?? file.size;
          const progress = total > 0 ? Math.round((event.loaded / total) * 100) : 0;
          return { kind: 'progress', progress } as EvidenceStorageEvent;
        }
        if (event.type === HttpEventType.Response) {
          const body = event.body;
          if (!body?.public_id || !body.secure_url) throw new Error('El almacenamiento externo no devolvió una referencia válida.');
          return {
            kind: 'completed',
            result: {
              publicId: body.public_id,
              secureUrl: body.secure_url,
              bytes: body.bytes ?? file.size,
              mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
              originalName: file.name,
            },
          } as EvidenceStorageEvent;
        }
        return { kind: 'progress', progress: 0 } as EvidenceStorageEvent;
      }),
    );
  }

  private assertConfigured(): void {
    if (!this.config.cloudName || !this.config.uploadPreset) {
      throw new Error(
        'El almacenamiento de evidencias todavía no está configurado. Define window.__DESCO_CONFIG__.cloudinary.cloudName y uploadPreset antes de subir archivos.',
      );
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
export function evidenciaContextoLabel(tipo: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!tipo) return 'Sin contexto';
  const descriptor = EVIDENCIA_CONTEXTOS.find((item) => item.tipo === tipo);
```

```typescript
@Component({selector:'app-cobro-comprador-detail-page',standalone:true,imports:[DecimalPipe,RouterLink,FaIconComponent,ErrorStateComponent,LoadingStateComponent,PageHeaderComponent],templateUrl:'./cobro-comprador-detail.html',styleUrl:'./cobro-comprador-detail.css',changeDetection:ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush})
export class CobroCompradorDetailPage implements OnInit{private readonly route=inject(ActivatedRoute);private readonly balanceUseCase=inject(ConsultarSaldoCompradorUseCase);readonly campaniaVentaId=Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('campaniaVentaId'));readonly operativoVentaId=Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('operativoVentaId'))||undefined;readonly loading=signal(true);readonly error=signal<string|null>(null);readonly saldo=signal<SaldoComprador|null>(null);readonly pageIcon=faChartLine;readonly backIcon=faArrowLeft;readonly refreshIcon=faRotate;ngOnInit(){this.load();}load(){this.loading.set(true);this.error.set(null);this.balanceUseCase.execute(this.campaniaVentaId,this.operativoVentaId).pipe(finalize(()=>this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({next:s=>this.saldo.set(s),error:e=>this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(e).message)});}}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCashRegister, faFloppyDisk, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { RegistrarCobroCompradorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-cobro-comprador.use-case';
export interface CobroCompradorFormResult {
    saved: boolean;
    id?: number;
}
@Component({ selector: 'app-cobro-comprador-form', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent], templateUrl: './cobro-comprador-form.html', styleUrl: './cobro-comprador-form.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class CobroCompradorFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly create = inject(RegistrarCobroCompradorUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    private resolver: ((r: CobroCompradorFormResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly pageIcon = faCashRegister;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ campaniaVentaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], operativoVentaId: [0], importe: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(.01)]], moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(10)]], medioPago: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(60)]], numeroOperacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]] });
    open(campaniaVentaId = 0, operativoVentaId = 0): Promise<CobroCompradorFormResult> { this.form.reset({ campaniaVentaId, operativoVentaId, importe: 0, moneda: 'PEN', medioPago: '', numeroOperacion: '' }); this.error.set(null); this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise(r => this.resolver = r); }
    close() { if (!this.saving())
        this.finish({ saved: false }); }
    submit() { if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
        this.form.markAllAsTouched();
        return;
    } const v = this.form.getRawValue(); this.saving.set(true); this.create.execute({ campaniaVentaId: v.campaniaVentaId, operativoVentaId: v.operativoVentaId > 0 ? v.operativoVentaId : undefined, importe: v.importe, moneda: v.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(), medioPago: v.medioPago.trim(), numeroOperacion: v.numeroOperacion.trim() || undefined }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: id => { this.toast.success('Cobro registrado'); this.finish({ saved: true, id }); }, error: e => { const m = mapOpenApiError(e).message; this.error.set(m); this.toast.error('No se pudo registrar el cobro', m); } }); }
    private finish(r: CobroCompradorFormResult) { if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open)
        this.dialog.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(r); this.resolver = null; }
}
```

```typescript
import { InjectionToken } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { PageResult } from '../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';

import { CobroComprador, CobroCompradorCreate } from '../../../domain/cobro-comprador.model';

export interface CobrosCompradoresGateway {
    list(f: CobroCompradorFiltro): Observable<PageResult<CobroComprador>>;
    balance(campaniaVentaId: number, operativoVentaId?: number): Observable<SaldoComprador>;
    create(i: CobroCompradorCreate): Observable<number>;
    confirm(id: number): Observable<void>;
    cancel(id: number, motivo: string): Observable<void>;
}
export const COBROS_COMPRADORES_GATEWAY = new InjectionToken<CobrosCompradoresGateway>('COBROS_COMPRADORES_GATEWAY');
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal">
  <div class="modal-box max-w-4xl bg-white">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-heading">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <h3>{{ current() ? 'Editar gasto' : 'Registrar gasto' }}</h3>
          <p>Completa los datos requeridos.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        class="admin-icon-button"
        type="button"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (error()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error">{{ error() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="submit()">
      @if (!current()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Campaña</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="1"
            step="1"
            formControlName="campaniaVentaId"
          />
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>Operativo</label>
          <input
            class="admin-input"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            step="1"
            formControlName="operativoVentaId"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="expenseType">Tipo de gasto</label>
        <select
          id="expenseType"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="tipoGastoId"
          [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
        >
          <option [ngValue]="0">
            {{ referencesLoading() ? 'Cargando...' : 'Seleccionar' }}
          </option>
          @for (item of expenseTypes(); track item.value) {
            <option [ngValue]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="distributionRule">Regla de distribución</label>
        <select
          id="distributionRule"
          class="admin-select"
          formControlName="reglaProrrateoId"
          [disabled]="referencesLoading()"
        >
          <option [ngValue]="0">
            {{ referencesLoading() ? 'Cargando...' : 'Seleccionar' }}
          </option>
          @for (item of distributionRules(); track item.value) {
            <option [ngValue]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Fecha</label>
        <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fecha" />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Importe</label>
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="number"
          min="0.01"
          step="0.01"
          formControlName="importe"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Moneda</label>
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          maxlength="3"
          formControlName="moneda"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label>Concepto</label>
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          maxlength="250"
          formControlName="concepto"
        />
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          type="button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="close()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          class="admin-primary-button"
          type="submit"
          [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
export interface GastoFormResult {
  saved: boolean;
  id?: number;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-gasto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './gasto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './gasto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class GastoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly create = inject(CrearGastoUseCase);
  private readonly update = inject(EditarGastoUseCase);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  private resolver: ((r: GastoFormResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly current = signal<Gasto | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly expenseTypes = signal<readonly CatalogOption[]>([]);
  readonly distributionRules = signal<readonly CatalogOption[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faReceipt;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    campaniaVentaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    operativoVentaId: [0],
    tipoGastoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    reglaProrrateoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    fecha: ['', Validators.required],
    concepto: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(250)]],
    importe: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  open(x?: Gasto): Promise<GastoFormResult> {
    this.current.set(x ?? null);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.form.reset({
      campaniaVentaId: x?.campaniaVentaId ?? 0,
      operativoVentaId: x?.operativoVentaId ?? 0,
      tipoGastoId: x?.tipoGastoId ?? 0,
      reglaProrrateoId: x?.reglaProrrateoId ?? 0,
      fecha: x?.fecha ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      concepto: x?.concepto ?? '',
      importe: x?.importe ?? 0,
      moneda: x?.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });

    this.loadReferences();
    this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false });
    }
  }

  submit(): void {
    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving() || this.referencesLoading()) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const v = this.form.getRawValue();
    const x = this.current();
    const common = {
      tipoGastoId: Number(v.tipoGastoId),
      reglaProrrateoId: Number(v.reglaProrrateoId),
      fecha: v.fecha,
      concepto: v.concepto.trim(),
      importe: Number(v.importe),
      moneda: v.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
    };

    this.saving.set(true);

    const op: Observable<number | void> = x
      ? this.update.execute(x.gastoCampaniaId, common)
      : this.create.execute({
          ...common,
          campaniaVentaId: Number(v.campaniaVentaId),
          operativoVentaId:
            Number(v.operativoVentaId) > 0
              ? Number(v.operativoVentaId)
              : undefined,
        });

    op.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (id) => {
        this.toast.success(x ? 'Gasto actualizado' : 'Gasto registrado');
        this.finish({
          saved: true,
          id: typeof id === 'number' ? id : x?.gastoCampaniaId,
        });
      },
      error: (e) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(e).message;
        this.error.set(message);
        this.toast.error(
          x ? 'No se pudo actualizar el gasto' : 'No se pudo registrar el gasto',
          message,
        );
      },
    });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      types: this.refs.catalog('TIPO_GASTO'),
      rules: this.refs.catalog('REGLA_PRORRATEO'),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ types, rules }) => {
          this.expenseTypes.set(
            types
              .map((item) => ({
                value: Number(item.id),
                label: item.label,
                code: item.code,
              }))
              .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item.value) && item.value > 0),
          );

          this.distributionRules.set(
            rules
              .map((item) => ({
                value: Number(item.id),
                label: item.label,
                code: item.code,
              }))
              .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item.value) && item.value > 0),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.expenseTypes.set([]);
          this.distributionRules.set([]);
          this.error.set(
            'No se pudieron cargar las opciones necesarias para registrar el gasto.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private finish(r: GastoFormResult): void {
    if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialog.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(r);
    this.resolver = null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowLeft, faBan, faCoins, faRotate } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';
import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { AnularAjustePrecioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/anular-ajuste-precio.use-case';
import { VerImpactoAjusteUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/ver-impacto-ajuste.use-case';
import { ImpactoAjuste } from '../../../../../domain/impacto-ajuste.model';
@Component({ selector: 'app-ajuste-precio-detail-page', standalone: true, imports: [DecimalPipe, RouterLink, FaIconComponent, PermissionDirective, ErrorStateComponent, LoadingStateComponent, ActionConfirmDialogComponent, PageHeaderComponent], templateUrl: './ajuste-precio-detail.html', styleUrl: './ajuste-precio-detail.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class AjustePrecioDetailPage implements OnInit {
    @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
    private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;
    private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
    private readonly get = inject(VerImpactoAjusteUseCase);
    private readonly cancelUseCase = inject(AnularAjustePrecioUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly id = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
    readonly loading = signal(true);
    readonly cancelling = signal(false);
    readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
    readonly item = signal<ImpactoAjuste | null>(null);
    readonly pageIcon = faCoins;
    readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
    readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
    readonly cancelIcon = faBan;
    ngOnInit() { this.load(); }
    load() { this.loading.set(true); this.error.set(null); this.get.execute(this.id).pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({ next: x => this.item.set(x), error: e => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(e).message) }); }
    async cancel() { if (this.cancelling())
        return; const r = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Anular ajuste', message: 'El ajuste dejará de aplicarse según el estado del proceso.', confirmLabel: 'Anular', tone: 'danger', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 5 }); if (!r.confirmed || !r.reason)
        return; this.cancelling.set(true); this.cancelUseCase.execute(this.id, r.reason).pipe(finalize(() => this.cancelling.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success('Ajuste anulado'); this.load(); }, error: e => this.toast.error('No se pudo anular el ajuste', mapOpenApiError(e).message) }); }
}
```

```typescript
import{inject,Injectable}from'@angular/core';import{map}from'rxjs';import{IdempotencyKeyService}from'../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';import{AjustesDePrecioService,PriceAdjustmentCancelRequest,PriceAdjustmentCreateRequest}from'../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';import{AjustesPrecioGateway}from'../../../application/port/out/ajustes-precio.gateway';import{AjustePrecioFiltro}from'../../../domain/ajuste-precio-filtro.model';import{AjustePrecioCreate}from'../../../domain/ajuste-precio.model';import{AjustesPrecioHttpMapper}from'./ajustes-precio-http.mapper';@Injectable()export class AjustesPrecioHttpAdapter implements AjustesPrecioGateway{private readonly api=inject(AjustesDePrecioService);private readonly m=inject(AjustesPrecioHttpMapper);private readonly idem=inject(IdempotencyKeyService);list(f:AjustePrecioFiltro){return this.api.ajustesListar({participacionId:f.participacionId,operativoVentaId:f.operativoVentaId,pagina:f.page,tamano:f.size},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.page(r,f.size)));}impact(id:number){return this.api.ajustesVerImpacto({id},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.impact(r)));}create(i:AjustePrecioCreate){const priceAdjustmentCreateRequest:PriceAdjustmentCreateRequest=i;return this.api.ajustesCrear({xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),priceAdjustmentCreateRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.created(r)));}cancel(id:number,motivo:string){const priceAdjustmentCancelRequest:PriceAdjustmentCancelRequest={motivo};return this.api.ajustesAnular({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),priceAdjustmentCancelRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.void(r)));}}
```

```typescript
import { Routes } from '@angular/router';

import { permissionGuard } from '../../core/access/permission.guard';
import { ajustesPrecioRoutes } from './ajustes-precio/ajustes-precio.routes';
import { incidenciasRoutes } from './incidencias/incidencias.routes';

const commercialWorkspace = () =>
  import('./shared/ui/commercial-workspace/commercial-workspace').then(
    (module) => module.CommercialWorkspacePage,
  );

export const gestionComercialRoutes: Routes = [
  {
    path: 'gestion-comercial',
    data: { breadcrumb: 'Gestión comercial' },
    children: [
      {
        path: 'campanias',
        data: {
          breadcrumb: 'Campañas',
          workspace: 'campaigns',
          permission: 'CAMPANIAS_LISTAR',
        },
        canActivate: [permissionGuard],
        loadComponent: commercialWorkspace,
      },
      {
        path: 'participantes',
        data: {
          breadcrumb: 'Participantes',
          workspace: 'participants',
          permission: 'PARTICIPANTES_LISTAR',
        },
        canActivate: [permissionGuard],
        loadComponent: commercialWorkspace,
      },
      {
        path: 'operativos',
        data: {
          breadcrumb: 'Operativos',
          workspace: 'operations',
          permission: 'OPERATIVOS_LISTAR',
        },
        canActivate: [permissionGuard],
        loadComponent: commercialWorkspace,
      },
      {
        path: 'entregas',
        data: {
          breadcrumb: 'Entregas',
          workspace: 'deliveries',
          permission: 'ENTREGAS_LISTAR',
        },
        canActivate: [permissionGuard],
        loadComponent: commercialWorkspace,
      },
      {
        path: 'jabas',
        data: {
          breadcrumb: 'Jabas',
          workspace: 'crates',
          permission: 'JABAS_LISTAR',
        },
        canActivate: [permissionGuard],
        loadComponent: commercialWorkspace,
      },
      {
        path: 'precios',
        data: {
          breadcrumb: 'Precios',
          workspace: 'pricing',
          permission: 'PRECIOS_LISTAR',
        },
        canActivate: [permissionGuard],
        loadComponent: commercialWorkspace,
      },
      { path: 'campanas', redirectTo: 'campanias', pathMatch: 'full' },
      { path: 'acopio-entregas', redirectTo: 'entregas', pathMatch: 'full' },
      { path: 'control-jabas', redirectTo: 'jabas', pathMatch: 'full' },
      { path: 'condiciones-precios', redirectTo: 'precios', pathMatch: 'full' },
      { path: 'ajustes-precio', redirectTo: 'ajustes', pathMatch: 'full' },
      ...incidenciasRoutes,
      ...ajustesPrecioRoutes,
    ],
  },
];
```

```typescript
import{inject,Injectable}from'@angular/core';import{map}from'rxjs';import{IdempotencyKeyService}from'../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';import{IncidentCancelRequest,IncidentCreateRequest,IncidentResolveRequest,IncidentReviewRequest,IncidenciasOperativasService}from'../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';import{IncidenciasGateway}from'../../../application/port/out/incidencias.gateway';import{IncidenciaFiltro}from'../../../domain/incidencia-filtro.model';import{IncidenciaCreate,IncidenciaReview}from'../../../domain/incidencia-operativa.model';import{IncidenciasHttpMapper}from'./incidencias-http.mapper';
@Injectable()export class IncidenciasHttpAdapter implements IncidenciasGateway{private readonly api=inject(IncidenciasOperativasService);private readonly m=inject(IncidenciasHttpMapper);private readonly idem=inject(IdempotencyKeyService);list(f:IncidenciaFiltro){return this.api.incidenciasListar({operativoVentaId:f.operativoVentaId,entregaSocioId:f.entregaSocioId,estadoIncidencia:f.estadoIncidencia,tipoIncidencia:f.tipoIncidencia,severidad:f.severidad,pagina:f.page,tamano:f.size},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.page(r,f.size)));}get(id:number){return this.api.incidenciasVer({id},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.detail(r)));}create(i:IncidenciaCreate){const incidentCreateRequest:IncidentCreateRequest=i;return this.api.incidenciasCrear({xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),incidentCreateRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.created(r)));}review(id:number,i:IncidenciaReview){const incidentReviewRequest:IncidentReviewRequest=i;return this.api.incidenciasRevisar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),incidentReviewRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.void(r)));}resolve(id:number,motivo:string){const incidentResolveRequest:IncidentResolveRequest={motivo};return this.api.incidenciasResolver({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),incidentResolveRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.void(r)));}cancel(id:number,motivo:string){const incidentCancelRequest:IncidentCancelRequest={motivo};return this.api.incidenciasAnular({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),incidentCancelRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.m.void(r)));}}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, forkJoin, map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  AcopioYEntregasService,
  CampaignCreateRequest,
  CampaignParticipantIncludeRequest,
  CampaignParticipantProgramRequest,
  CampaignParticipantRemoveRequest,
  CampaignTransitionRequest,
  CampaignUpdateRequest,
  CampaasDeVentaService,
  CatlogosService,
  CondicionesYPreciosService,
  ControlDeJabasService,
  CrateAnnulRequest,
  CrateAssignRequest,
  CrateReceiveRequest,
  CrateReturnCratesRequest,
  DeliveryAnnulRequest,
  DeliveryCreateRequest,
  DeliveryUpdatePreliminaryRequest,
  OperativosDeVentaService,
  OrganizacionesService,
  ParticipantesDeCampaaService,
  PrediosService,
  PricingCreateConditionRequest,
  PricingCreatePriceRequest,
  PricingDisableRequest,
  PricingUpdateConditionRequest,
  PricingVersionPriceRequest,
  ProductoresService,
  SalesOperationCreateRequest,
  SalesOperationTransitionRequest,
  SalesOperationUpdateRequest,
  SalesOperationZonesRequest,
} from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { PageResult } from '../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../administracion/shared/admin-api.mapper';

export type CommercialWorkspace =
  | 'campaigns'
  | 'participants'
  | 'operations'
  | 'deliveries'
  | 'crates'
  | 'pricing';

export interface CommercialOption {
  value: number;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface CommercialReferences {
  associations: readonly CommercialOption[];
  buyers: readonly CommercialOption[];
  producers: readonly CommercialOption[];
  properties: readonly CommercialOption[];
  campaigns: readonly CommercialOption[];
  operations: readonly CommercialOption[];
  conditions: readonly CommercialOption[];
  varieties: readonly CommercialOption[];
  salesModalities: readonly CommercialOption[];
  zones: readonly CommercialOption[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class CommercialApiService {
  private readonly campaignsApi = inject(CampaasDeVentaService);
  private readonly participantsApi = inject(ParticipantesDeCampaaService);
  private readonly operationsApi = inject(OperativosDeVentaService);
  private readonly deliveriesApi = inject(AcopioYEntregasService);
  private readonly cratesApi = inject(ControlDeJabasService);
  private readonly pricingApi = inject(CondicionesYPreciosService);
  private readonly organizationsApi = inject(OrganizacionesService);
  private readonly producersApi = inject(ProductoresService);
  private readonly propertiesApi = inject(PrediosService);
  private readonly catalogsApi = inject(CatlogosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(AdminApiMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(
    workspace: CommercialWorkspace,
    page: number,
    size: number,
    filters: Record<string, unknown> = {},
  ): Observable<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
    switch (workspace) {
      case 'campaigns':
        return this.campaignsApi.campaniasListar({
          estadoProceso: this.text(filters['state']),
          asociacionId: this.positive(filters['associationId']),
          empresaCompradoraId: this.positive(filters['buyerId']),
          fechaDesde: this.text(filters['from']),
          fechaHasta: this.text(filters['to']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'participants':
        return this.participantsApi.participantesListar({
          campaniaVentaId: this.positive(filters['campaignId']),
          estadoParticipacion: this.text(filters['state']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'operations':
        return this.operationsApi.operativosListar({
          campaniaVentaId: this.positive(filters['campaignId']),
          estadoProceso: this.text(filters['state']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'deliveries':
        return this.deliveriesApi.entregasListar({
          operativoVentaId: this.positive(filters['operationId']),
          socioId: this.positive(filters['producerId']),
          estadoProceso: this.text(filters['state']),
          estadoControlCalidad: this.text(filters['qualityState']),
          fechaDesde: this.text(filters['from']),
          fechaHasta: this.text(filters['to']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'crates':
        return this.cratesApi.jabasListar({
          operativoVentaId: this.positive(filters['operationId']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
      case 'pricing':
        return this.pricingApi.preciosListar({
          campaniaVentaId: this.positive(filters['campaignId']),
          operativoVentaId: this.positive(filters['operationId']),
          variedadPaltaId: this.positive(filters['varietyId']),
          condicionComercialId: this.positive(filters['conditionId']),
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
    }
  }

  listConditions(page: number, size: number): Observable<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesListar({ pagina: page, tamano: size }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((r) => this.page(r, size)));
  }

  detail(workspace: CommercialWorkspace, id: number): Observable<Record<string, unknown>> {
    switch (workspace) {
      case 'campaigns': return this.campaignsApi.campaniasVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'participants': return this.participantsApi.participantesVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'operations': return this.operationsApi.operativosVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'deliveries': return this.deliveriesApi.entregasVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
      case 'crates': return this.cratesBalance(id);
      case 'pricing': return this.priceHistory(id).pipe(map((items) => ({ historial: items })));
    }
  }

  createCampaign(request: CampaignCreateRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.campaignsApi.campaniasCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignCreateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'campaniaVentaId')));
  }
  updateCampaign(id: number, request: CampaignUpdateRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.campaignsApi.campaniasEditar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignUpdateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  activateCampaign(id: number, motivo?: string): Observable<void> { return this.campaignTransition('activate', id, { motivo }); }
  closeCampaign(id: number, motivo?: string): Observable<void> { return this.campaignTransition('close', id, { motivo }); }
  cancelCampaign(id: number, motivo?: string): Observable<void> { return this.campaignTransition('cancel', id, { motivo }); }

  includeParticipant(request: CampaignParticipantIncludeRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.participantsApi.participantesIncluir({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignParticipantIncludeRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  programParticipant(id: number, request: CampaignParticipantProgramRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.participantsApi.participantesProgramarOperativo({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignParticipantProgramRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  removeParticipant(id: number, request: CampaignParticipantRemoveRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.participantsApi.participantesRetirar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignParticipantRemoveRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  createOperation(request: SalesOperationCreateRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.operationsApi.operativosCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationCreateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'operativoVentaId')));
  }
  updateOperation(id: number, request: SalesOperationUpdateRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.operationsApi.operativosEditar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationUpdateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  setOperationZones(id: number, request: SalesOperationZonesRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.operationsApi.operativosAsignarZonas({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationZonesRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  startOperation(id: number, motivo?: string): Observable<void> { return this.operationTransition('start', id, { motivo }); }
  closeOperation(id: number, motivo?: string): Observable<void> { return this.operationTransition('close', id, { motivo }); }
  cancelOperation(id: number, motivo?: string): Observable<void> { return this.operationTransition('cancel', id, { motivo }); }

  createDelivery(request: DeliveryCreateRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), deliveryCreateRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'entregaSocioId')));
  }
  updateDelivery(id: number, request: DeliveryUpdatePreliminaryRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasEditarPreliminar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), deliveryUpdatePreliminaryRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  confirmDelivery(id: number): Observable<void> {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasConfirmar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key() }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  annulDelivery(id: number, request: DeliveryAnnulRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.deliveriesApi.entregasAnular({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), deliveryAnnulRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  receiveCrates(request: CrateReceiveRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasRegistrarRecepcion({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateReceiveRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  assignCrates(request: CrateAssignRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasAsignar({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateAssignRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  returnCrates(request: CrateReturnCratesRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasRegistrarDevolucion({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateReturnCratesRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  annulCrateMovement(request: CrateAnnulRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasAnularMovimiento({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), crateAnnulRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  cratesBalance(operationId: number, operationPartnerId?: number): Observable<Record<string, unknown>> {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasSaldo({ operativoVentaId: operationId, operativoSocioId: operationPartnerId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataRecord(r)));
  }
  cratesHistory(operationId?: number, operationPartnerId?: number): Observable<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    return this.cratesApi.jabasHistorial({ operativoVentaId: operationId, operativoSocioId: operationPartnerId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataArray(r)));
  }

  createCondition(request: PricingCreateConditionRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingCreateConditionRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  updateCondition(id: number, request: PricingUpdateConditionRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesEditar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingUpdateConditionRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  disableCondition(id: number, request: PricingDisableRequest): Observable<void> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesDeshabilitar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingDisableRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }
  createPrice(request: PricingCreatePriceRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosCrear({ xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingCreatePriceRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  versionPrice(id: number, request: PricingVersionPriceRequest): Observable<number> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosVersionar({ id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), pricingVersionPriceRequest: request }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.createdId(r, 'id')));
  }
  priceHistory(id: number): Observable<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    return this.pricingApi.preciosHistorial({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }).pipe(map((r) => this.dataArray(r)));
  }

  operationPartners(operationId: number): Observable<readonly CommercialOption[]> {
    return this.operationsApi
      .operativosVer({ id: operationId }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map((response) => {
          const detail = this.dataRecord(response);
          const participants = this.mapper.array(detail['participantes']);
          return participants
            .map((value) => this.mapper.record(value))
            .map((row) => ({
              value: this.num(row['operativoSocioId']),
              label: this.str(row['socioNombre']),
              description: this.str(row['numeroDocumento']) || undefined,
            }))
            .filter((item) => item.value > 0);
        }),
      );
  }

  crateAssignmentOptions(operationId: number): Observable<readonly CommercialOption[]> {
    return this.cratesHistory(operationId).pipe(
      map((rows) => {
        const seen = new Set<number>();
        return rows
          .filter((row) => this.str(row['tipoMovimiento']) === 'ASIGNACION')
          .map((row) => ({
            value: this.num(row['jabaAsignacionId']),
            label: `Asignación #${this.num(row['jabaAsignacionId'])}`,
            description: this.str(row['usuario']) || undefined,
          }))
          .filter((item) => {
            if (item.value <= 0 || seen.has(item.value)) return false;
            seen.add(item.value);
            return true;
          });
      }),
    );
  }

  references(): Observable<CommercialReferences> {
    return forkJoin({
      organizations: this.organizationsApi.organizacionesListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      producers: this.producersApi.productoresListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      properties: this.propertiesApi.prediosListar({ soloActivos: true, pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      campaigns: this.campaignsApi.campaniasListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      operations: this.operationsApi.operativosListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      conditions: this.pricingApi.preciosCondicionesListar({ pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      varieties: this.catalogsApi.catalogosListar({ catalogo: 'VARIEDAD_PALTA', pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      modalities: this.catalogsApi.catalogosListar({ catalogo: 'MODALIDAD_VENTA', pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
      zones: this.catalogsApi.catalogosListar({ catalogo: 'ZONA_PRODUCTIVA', pagina: 1, tamano: 100 }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false }),
    }).pipe(map((result): CommercialReferences => {
      const organizations = this.page(result.organizations, 100).items;
      return {
        associations: organizations.filter((row) => this.bool(row['esAsociacion'])).map((row) => this.option(row, 'empresaId', 'razonSocial', 'ruc')),
        buyers: organizations.filter((row) => !this.bool(row['esAsociacion'])).map((row) => this.option(row, 'empresaId', 'razonSocial', 'ruc')),
        producers: this.page(result.producers, 100).items
          .filter((row) => this.num(row['socioAsociacionId']) > 0)
          .map((row) => ({ value: this.num(row['socioAsociacionId']), label: `${this.str(row['nombres'])} ${this.str(row['apellidoPaterno'])}`.trim(), description: this.str(row['numeroDocumento']) })),
        properties: this.page(result.properties, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'predioId', 'nombre', 'codigo')),
        campaigns: this.page(result.campaigns, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'campaniaVentaId', 'nombre', 'codigo')),
        operations: this.page(result.operations, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'operativoVentaId', 'codigo', 'campania')),
        conditions: this.page(result.conditions, 100).items.map((row) => this.option(row, 'condicionComercialId', 'nombre', 'codigo')),
        varieties: this.catalogOptions(result.varieties),
        salesModalities: this.catalogOptions(result.modalities),
        zones: this.catalogOptions(result.zones),
      };
    }));
  }

  private campaignTransition(action: 'activate' | 'close' | 'cancel', id: number, request: CampaignTransitionRequest): Observable<void> {
    const params = { id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), campaignTransitionRequest: request };
    const call = action === 'activate'
      ? this.campaignsApi.campaniasActivar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      : action === 'close'
        ? this.campaignsApi.campaniasCerrar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
        : this.campaignsApi.campaniasCancelar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false });
    return call.pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  private operationTransition(action: 'start' | 'close' | 'cancel', id: number, request: SalesOperationTransitionRequest): Observable<void> {
    const params = { id, xIdempotencyKey: this.key(), salesOperationTransitionRequest: request };
    const call = action === 'start'
      ? this.operationsApi.operativosIniciarRecepcion(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      : action === 'close'
        ? this.operationsApi.operativosCerrar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
        : this.operationsApi.operativosCancelar(params, 'body', false, { transferCache: false });
    return call.pipe(map((r) => this.mapper.void(r)));
  }

  private page(response: unknown, size: number): PageResult<Record<string, unknown>> {
    return this.mapper.page(response, (row) => row, size);
  }
  private dataRecord(response: unknown): Record<string, unknown> { return this.mapper.record(this.mapper.data<unknown>(response)); }
  private dataArray(response: unknown): readonly Record<string, unknown>[] { return this.mapper.array(this.mapper.data<unknown>(response)).map((row) => this.mapper.record(row)); }
  private createdId(response: unknown, key: string): number { return this.num(this.mapper.record(this.mapper.data<unknown>(response))[key]); }
  private key(): string { return this.idempotency.create(); }
  private text(value: unknown): string | undefined { const result = this.str(value); return result || undefined; }
  private positive(value: unknown): number | undefined { const result = this.num(value); return result > 0 ? result : undefined; }
  private num(value: unknown): number { const result = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(result) ? result : 0; }
  private str(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : String(value ?? '').trim(); }
  private bool(value: unknown): boolean { return value === true || value === 1 || value === '1' || value === 'true'; }
  private option(row: Record<string, unknown>, idKey: string, labelKey: string, descriptionKey: string): CommercialOption {
    return { value: this.num(row[idKey]), label: this.str(row[labelKey]), description: this.str(row[descriptionKey]) || undefined };
  }
  private catalogOptions(response: unknown): readonly CommercialOption[] {
    return this.page(response, 100).items.map((row) => ({ value: this.num(row['id']), label: this.str(row['nombre']), description: this.str(row['codigo']) || undefined })).filter((item) => item.value > 0);
  }
}
```

```css
:host { display:block; }
.commercial-page { display:grid; gap:1rem; }
.commercial-tabs { display:flex; width:max-content; max-width:100%; gap:.25rem; border:1px solid var(--desco-border); border-radius:.85rem; background:var(--desco-surface); padding:.25rem; overflow:auto; }
.commercial-tabs button { border:0; border-radius:.65rem; background:transparent; padding:.55rem .9rem; color:var(--desco-text-muted); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }
.commercial-tabs button.is-active { background:var(--desco-primary); color:#fff; }
.commercial-filters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(10rem,1fr)); gap:.65rem; align-items:end; border:1px solid var(--desco-border); border-radius:1rem; background:var(--desco-surface); padding:.85rem; }
.commercial-table { min-width:58rem; }
.commercial-table td { max-width:18rem; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.commercial-detail-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:.65rem; }
.commercial-detail-grid > div { min-width:0; border:1px solid var(--desco-border); border-radius:.8rem; background:var(--desco-surface-soft); padding:.75rem; }
.commercial-detail-grid span { display:block; color:var(--desco-text-muted); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:700; }
.commercial-detail-grid strong { display:block; margin-top:.2rem; overflow-wrap:anywhere; color:var(--desco-text); font-size:.78rem; }
.commercial-detail-counts { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.45rem; margin-top:.8rem; }.commercial-detail-counts span{border:1px solid var(--desco-border);border-radius:999px;padding:.35rem .65rem;color:var(--desco-text-muted);font-size:.7rem}.commercial-detail-counts strong{color:var(--desco-text)}
.commercial-check-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(12rem,1fr)); gap:.5rem; }.commercial-check-grid label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--desco-border);border-radius:.7rem;padding:.6rem;color:var(--desco-text);font-size:.76rem;cursor:pointer}
.commercial-lines-header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:.75rem; margin-bottom:.55rem; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:800; }
.commercial-line { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(9rem,1fr) minmax(9rem,1fr) minmax(7rem,.7fr) auto; gap:.5rem; margin-bottom:.5rem; }
.admin-text-button { border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--desco-primary); font-size:.7rem; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }.admin-text-button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.admin-text-button--danger{color:var(--desco-danger)}
@media (max-width:720px){.commercial-filters{grid-template-columns:1fr}.commercial-detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.commercial-line{grid-template-columns:1fr}.commercial-line .admin-icon-button{justify-self:end}}
```
