### 1009. `src/app/features/gestion-comercial/shared/ui/commercial-workspace/commercial-workspace.html`

- Ruta: `src/app/features/gestion-comercial/shared/ui/commercial-workspace/commercial-workspace.html`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\gestion-comercial\shared\ui\commercial-workspace\commercial-workspace.html`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/gestion-comercial/shared/ui/commercial-workspace/commercial-workspace.html`

```html
<section class="desco-page commercial-page">
  <app-page-header
    [title]="title()"
    eyebrow="Gestión comercial"
    [icon]="icon()"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        @if (loading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> }
        Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="primaryPermission()" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (click)="openCreate()">
        @if (referencesLoading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> }
        Nuevo
      </button>
      @if (workspace() === 'crates') {
        <button *appPermission="'JABAS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="openCrate('crate-assign')">Asignar</button>
        <button *appPermission="'JABAS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="openCrate('crate-return')">Devolver</button>
        <button *appPermission="'JABAS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="openCrate('crate-annul')">Anular</button>
      }
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  @if (workspace() === 'pricing') {
    <nav class="commercial-tabs" aria-label="Secciones de precios">
      <button type="button" [class.is-active]="pricingTab() === 'prices'" (click)="changePricingTab('prices')">Precios</button>
      <button type="button" [class.is-active]="pricingTab() === 'conditions'" (click)="changePricingTab('conditions')">Condiciones</button>
    </nav>
  }

  <form class="commercial-filters" [formGroup]="filterForm" (ngSubmit)="applyFilters()">
    @if (workspace() === 'campaigns') {
      <select class="admin-select" formControlName="associationId" aria-label="Asociación">
        <option [value]="0">Todas las asociaciones</option>
        @for (item of refs().associations; track item.value) { <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option> }
      </select>
      <select class="admin-select" formControlName="buyerId" aria-label="Comprador">
        <option [value]="0">Todos los compradores</option>
        @for (item of refs().buyers; track item.value) { <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option> }
      </select>
    }
    @if (workspace() === 'participants' || workspace() === 'operations' || workspace() === 'pricing') {
      <select class="admin-select" formControlName="campaignId" aria-label="Campaña">
        <option [value]="0">Todas las campañas</option>
        @for (item of refs().campaigns; track item.value) { <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option> }
      </select>
    }
    @if (workspace() === 'deliveries' || workspace() === 'crates' || (workspace() === 'pricing' && pricingTab() === 'prices')) {
      <select class="admin-select" formControlName="operationId" aria-label="Operativo">
        <option [value]="0">Todos los operativos</option>
        @for (item of refs().operations; track item.value) { <option [value]="item.value">{{ item.label }}</option> }
      </select>
    }
    @if (workspace() === 'deliveries') {
      <select class="admin-select" formControlName="qualityState" aria-label="Calidad">
        <option value="">Toda calidad</option>
        @for (state of qualityStates; track state) { <option [value]="state">{{ state }}</option> }
      </select>
    }
    @if (workspace() !== 'crates' && !(workspace() === 'pricing' && pricingTab() === 'conditions')) {
      <input class="admin-input" type="text" maxlength="30" formControlName="state" placeholder="Estado" aria-label="Estado" />
    }
    @if (workspace() === 'campaigns' || workspace() === 'deliveries') {
      <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="from" aria-label="Desde" [max]="filterForm.controls.to.value || today()" />
      <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="to" aria-label="Hasta" [min]="filterForm.controls.from.value" [attr.max]="workspace() === 'deliveries' ? today() : null" />
    }
    <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small" [disabled]="loading()">
      @if (loading()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } Filtrar
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="clearFilters()">Limpiar</button>
  </form>

  @if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage()!" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando" variant="table" [rows]="6" />
  } @else if (rows().items.length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin registros" message="No hay información para los filtros seleccionados." />
  } @else {
    <section class="desco-card overflow-hidden">
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table commercial-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              @for (column of columns(); track column.key) { <th [class.text-right]="column.numeric">{{ column.label }}</th> }
              <th class="text-right">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (row of rows().items; track idOf(row)) {
              <tr>
                @for (column of columns(); track column.key) {
                  <td [class.text-right]="column.numeric">{{ cell(row, column) }}</td>
                }
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions justify-end">
                      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Ver" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="workspace() === 'crates' ? showCrateHistory(row) : view(row)">
                        @if (actionKey() === 'view:' + idOf(row) || actionKey() === 'history:' + idOf(row)) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /> }
                      </button>

                    @if (workspace() === 'campaigns') {
                      <button *appPermission="'CAMPANIAS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Editar" (click)="openEdit(row)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="['CAMPANIAS_CONFIRMAR','CAMPANIAS_APROBAR']; mode: 'any'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="campaignAction(row,'activate')">Activar</button>
                      <button *appPermission="['CAMPANIAS_CONFIRMAR','CAMPANIAS_APROBAR']; mode: 'any'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="campaignAction(row,'close')">Cerrar</button>
                      <button *appPermission="'CAMPANIAS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button admin-text-button--danger" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="campaignAction(row,'cancel')">Cancelar</button>
                    } @else if (workspace() === 'participants') {
                      <button *appPermission="'PARTICIPANTES_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" (click)="openParticipantProgram(row)">Programar</button>
                      <button *appPermission="'PARTICIPANTES_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button admin-text-button--danger" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="removeParticipant(row)">Retirar</button>
                    } @else if (workspace() === 'operations') {
                      <button *appPermission="'OPERATIVOS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Editar" (click)="openEdit(row)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'OPERATIVOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" (click)="openZones(row)">Zonas</button>
                      <button *appPermission="'OPERATIVOS_CONFIRMAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="operationAction(row,'start')">Iniciar</button>
                      <button *appPermission="['OPERATIVOS_CONFIRMAR','OPERATIVOS_APROBAR']; mode: 'any'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="operationAction(row,'close')">Cerrar</button>
                      <button *appPermission="'OPERATIVOS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button admin-text-button--danger" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="operationAction(row,'cancel')">Cancelar</button>
                    } @else if (workspace() === 'deliveries') {
                      <button *appPermission="'ENTREGAS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Editar" (click)="openEdit(row)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'ENTREGAS_CONFIRMAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="confirmDelivery(row)">Confirmar</button>
                      <button *appPermission="'ENTREGAS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button admin-text-button--danger" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="annulDelivery(row)">Anular</button>
                    } @else if (workspace() === 'pricing' && pricingTab() === 'conditions') {
                      <button *appPermission="'PRECIOS_ADMINISTRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Editar" (click)="openEdit(row)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'PRECIOS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button admin-text-button--danger" [disabled]="actionKey() !== null" (click)="disableCondition(row)">Deshabilitar</button>
                    } @else if (workspace() === 'pricing') {
                      <button *appPermission="'PRECIOS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-text-button" (click)="openPriceVersion(row)">Versionar</button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <app-paginator [page]="rows().page" [size]="rows().size" [totalRecords]="rows().totalRecords" [totalPages]="rows().totalPages" (pageChange)="load($event, rows().size)" (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)" />
    </section>
  }

  <app-action-confirm-dialog />

  <dialog #detailDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeDetail()">
    <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
      <header class="admin-modal-header"><div class="admin-modal-title-group"><span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></span><div><p>{{ title() }}</p><h2>Detalle</h2></div></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" (click)="closeDetail()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" /></button></header>
      @if (detailLoading()) {
        <app-loading-state title="Cargando" variant="detail" [rows]="6" />
      } @else {
        <div class="commercial-detail-grid">
          @for (pair of detailPairs(); track pair.label) { <div><span>{{ pair.label }}</span><strong>{{ pair.value }}</strong></div> }
        </div>
        @if (detailLists().length) {
          <div class="commercial-detail-counts">
            @for (item of detailLists(); track item.label) { <span>{{ item.label }} <strong>{{ item.count }}</strong></span> }
          </div>
        }
      }
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="closeDetail()">Cerrar</button></footer>
    </div>
  </dialog>

  <dialog #editorDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeEditor()">
    <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
      <header class="admin-modal-header"><div class="admin-modal-title-group"><span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="editingId() ? editIcon : addIcon" /></span><div><p>{{ title() }}</p><h2>{{ modalTitle() }}</h2></div></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="closeEditor()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" /></button></header>

      @switch (modalKind()) {
        @case ('campaign') {
          <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="campaignForm" (ngSubmit)="saveEditor()">
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Asociación</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="associationId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().associations;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select><app-form-error [control]="campaignForm.controls.associationId" fieldLabel="La asociación" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Comprador</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="buyerId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().buyers;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select><app-form-error [control]="campaignForm.controls.buyerId" fieldLabel="El comprador" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Nombre</label><input class="admin-input" type="text" maxlength="180" formControlName="name" autocomplete="off" /><app-form-error [control]="campaignForm.controls.name" fieldLabel="El nombre" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Inicio</label><input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="start" [max]="campaignForm.controls.end.value || undefined" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Fin</label><input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="end" [min]="campaignForm.controls.start.value" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="400" formControlName="observation"></textarea></div>
            <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="modalActions"></ng-container>
          </form>
        }
        @case ('participant-include') {
          <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="participantForm" (ngSubmit)="saveEditor()">
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Campaña</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="campaignId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().campaigns;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Productor</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="partnerAssociationId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().producers;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}} · {{item.description}}</option>}</select></div>
            <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="modalActions"></ng-container>
          </form>
        }
        @case ('participant-program') {
          <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="participantForm" (ngSubmit)="saveEditor()"><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Operativo</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="operationId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().operations;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select></div><ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="modalActions"></ng-container></form>
        }
        @case ('operation') {
          <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="operationForm" (ngSubmit)="saveEditor()">
            <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Campaña</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="campaignId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().campaigns;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Inicio programado</label><input class="admin-input" type="datetime-local" formControlName="start" [max]="operationForm.controls.end.value || undefined" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Fin programado</label><input class="admin-input" type="datetime-local" formControlName="end" [min]="operationForm.controls.start.value" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="400" formControlName="observation"></textarea></div>
            <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="modalActions"></ng-container>
          </form>
        }
        @case ('operation-zones') {
          <form class="admin-form-grid" (ngSubmit)="saveEditor()"><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><span class="admin-field-label">Zonas</span><div class="commercial-check-grid">@for(item of refs().zones;track item.value){<label><input type="checkbox" [checked]="selectedZones().includes(item.value)" (change)="toggleZone(item.value,$any($event.target).checked)"/> <span>{{item.label}}</span></label>}</div></div><ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="modalActions"></ng-container></form>
        }
        @case ('delivery') {
          <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="deliveryForm" (ngSubmit)="saveEditor()">
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Operativo</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="operationId" (change)="onDeliveryOperationChange()"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().operations;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Productor programado</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="operationPartnerId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of operationPartners();track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Predio</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="propertyId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>@for(item of refs().properties;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Fecha y hora</label><input class="admin-input" type="datetime-local" formControlName="dateTime" [max]="nowDateTime()" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Peso bruto (kg)</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="grossKg" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Tara (kg)</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0" step="0.001" [max]="deliveryForm.controls.grossKg.value" formControlName="tareKg" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Rechazado (kg)</label><input class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0" step="0.001" [max]="deliveryForm.controls.grossKg.value - deliveryForm.controls.tareKg.value" formControlName="rejectedKg" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Control de calidad</label><select class="admin-select" formControlName="qualityState">@for(state of qualityStates;track state){<option [value]="state">{{state}}</option>}</select></div>
            <div class="admin-field"><label>Ticket de balanza</label><input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="ticket" /></div>
            <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="2" maxlength="400" formControlName="observation"></textarea></div>
            <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2" formArrayName="details"><div class="commercial-lines-header"><span>Detalle</span><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" (click)="addDeliveryLine()">Agregar línea</button></div>@for(group of deliveryLines.controls;track $index;let i=$index){<div class="commercial-line" [formGroupName]="i"><select class="admin-select" formControlName="varietyId"><option [value]="0">Variedad</option>@for(item of refs().varieties;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select><select class="admin-select" formControlName="conditionId"><option [value]="0">Condición</option>@for(item of refs().conditions;track item.value){<option [value]="item.value">{{item.label}}</option>}</select><input class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="kg" placeholder="Kg"/><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="deliveryLines.length===1" aria-label="Quitar línea" (click)="removeDeliveryLine(i)"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon"/></button></div>}</div>
            <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="modalActions"></ng-container>
          </form>
        }
        @case ('crate-receive') {

        }
      }
    </div>
  </dialog>

  <ng-template #modalActions>
    <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="closeEditor()">Cancelar</button>
      <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || referencesLoading() || detailLoading()">
        @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
      </button>
    </footer>
  </ng-template>
</section>
```

```typescript
export class CommercialWorkspacePage implements OnInit {

    operationId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],

    tareKg: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    rejectedKg: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],

    ticket: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],

    details: this.fb.array([this.deliveryLineGroup()]),
  });

  readonly crateForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    operationId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    operationPartnerId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    assignmentId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],

  });

  readonly conditionForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    modalityId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    name: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(160)]],
    description: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    minWeight: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    maxWeight: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],

    operationId: [0],
    varietyId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    conditionId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    price: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.0001)]],
    currency: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^[A-Z]{3}$/)]],
    unit: ['KG', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(10)]],
    validFrom: ['', [Validators.required]],
  });

  readonly qualityStates = ['PENDIENTE', 'CONFORME', 'OBSERVADO', 'RECHAZADO'] as const;

  readonly title = computed(() => ({
    campaigns: 'Campañas',
    participants: 'Participantes',
    operations: 'Operativos',
    deliveries: 'Entregas',
    crates: 'Jabas',
    pricing: 'Precios',
  })[this.workspace()]);

  readonly icon = computed(() => ({
    campaigns: faCalendarDays,
    participants: faUserGroup,
    operations: faTruck,
    deliveries: faReceipt,
    crates: faBoxesStacked,
    pricing: faCoins,
  })[this.workspace()]);

  readonly columns = computed<readonly TableColumn[]>(() => {
    if (this.workspace() === 'pricing' && this.pricingTab() === 'conditions') {
      return [
        { key: 'codigo', label: 'Código' },
        { key: 'nombre', label: 'Condición' },
        { key: 'modalidad', label: 'Modalidad' },
        { key: 'pesoMinimoG', label: 'Mín. g', numeric: true },
        { key: 'pesoMaximoG', label: 'Máx. g', numeric: true },
        { key: 'estado', label: 'Estado' },
      ];

    return ({

      participants: [
        { key: 'numeroDocumento', label: 'Documento' }, { key: 'socioNombre', label: 'Productor' },
        { key: 'campaniaVentaId', label: 'Campaña', numeric: true }, { key: 'estadoParticipacion', label: 'Estado' },
        { key: 'operativos', label: 'Operativos', numeric: true }, { key: 'entregasConfirmadas', label: 'Entregas', numeric: true },
      ],
      operations: [
        { key: 'codigo', label: 'Código' }, { key: 'campania', label: 'Campaña' },
        { key: 'fechaInicioProgramada', label: 'Inicio' }, { key: 'fechaFinProgramada', label: 'Fin' },
        { key: 'participantes', label: 'Participantes', numeric: true }, { key: 'entregas', label: 'Entregas', numeric: true },
        { key: 'estadoProceso', label: 'Estado' },
      ],
      deliveries: [
        { key: 'codigoLote', label: 'Lote' }, { key: 'socioNombre', label: 'Productor' },
        { key: 'operativo', label: 'Operativo' }, { key: 'fechaHora', label: 'Fecha' },
        { key: 'pesoAceptadoKg', label: 'Kg aceptados', numeric: true }, { key: 'estadoControlCalidad', label: 'Calidad' },
        { key: 'estadoProceso', label: 'Estado' },
      ],
      crates: [
        { key: 'codigo', label: 'Operativo' }, { key: 'cantidadJabasRecibidas', label: 'Recibidas', numeric: true },
        { key: 'jabasAsignadas', label: 'Asignadas', numeric: true }, { key: 'jabasDevueltas', label: 'Devueltas', numeric: true },
        { key: 'jabasDisponibles', label: 'Disponibles', numeric: true }, { key: 'jabasPendientes', label: 'Pendientes', numeric: true },
        { key: 'estadoProceso', label: 'Estado' },
      ],
      pricing: [
        { key: 'campania', label: 'Campaña' }, { key: 'operativo', label: 'Operativo' },
        { key: 'variedad', label: 'Variedad' }, { key: 'condicion', label: 'Condición' },
        { key: 'precio', label: 'Precio', numeric: true }, { key: 'moneda', label: 'Moneda' },
        { key: 'fechaVigenciaDesde', label: 'Vigencia' }, { key: 'vigente', label: 'Estado' },
      ],
    } as const)[this.workspace()];
  });

  get deliveryLines(): FormArray { return this.deliveryForm.controls.details; }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const workspace = this.route.snapshot.data['workspace'] as CommercialWorkspace | undefined;
    if (workspace) this.workspace.set(workspace);
    this.loadReferences();
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.rows().page, size = this.rows().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const filters = this.filterForm.getRawValue();
    const source = this.workspace() === 'pricing' && this.pricingTab() === 'conditions'
      ? this.api.listConditions(page, size)
      : this.api.list(this.workspace(), page, size, filters);
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (result) => this.rows.set(result),
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.api.references().pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (refs) => this.refs.set(refs),
      error: () => this.refs.set(EMPTY_REFS),
    });
  }

  applyFilters(): void { this.load(1); }
  clearFilters(): void { this.filterForm.reset(); this.load(1); }
  changePricingTab(tab: PricingTab): void { this.pricingTab.set(tab); this.rows.set(emptyPageResult(this.rows().size)); this.load(1); }

  openCreate(): void {
    this.editingId.set(null);
    switch (this.workspace()) {
      case 'campaigns': this.resetCampaign(); this.openEditor('campaign'); break;
      case 'participants': this.participantForm.reset({ campaignId: 0, partnerAssociationId: 0, operationId: 0 }); this.openEditor('participant-include'); break;
      case 'operations': this.resetOperation(); this.openEditor('operation'); break;
      case 'deliveries': this.resetDelivery(); this.openEditor('delivery'); break;
      case 'crates': this.resetCrate(); this.openEditor('crate-receive'); break;
      case 'pricing':
        if (this.pricingTab() === 'conditions') { this.resetCondition(); this.openEditor('condition'); }
        else { this.resetPrice(); this.openEditor('price'); }
        break;
    }
  }

  openEdit(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    if (id <= 0) return;
    this.editingId.set(id);
    if (this.workspace() === 'campaigns') {
      this.campaignForm.reset({
        associationId: this.number(row['asociacionId']), buyerId: this.number(row['empresaCompradoraId']),
        name: this.string(row['nombre']), start: this.dateValue(row['fechaInicio']), end: this.dateValue(row['fechaFin']),
        observation: this.string(row['observacion']),
      });
      this.campaignForm.controls.associationId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.openEditor('campaign');
      return;
    }
    if (this.workspace() === 'operations') {
      this.operationForm.reset({
        campaignId: this.number(row['campaniaVentaId']), start: this.dateTimeValue(row['fechaInicioProgramada']),
        end: this.dateTimeValue(row['fechaFinProgramada']), observation: this.string(row['observacion']),
      });
      this.operationForm.controls.campaignId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.openEditor('operation');
      return;
    }
    if (this.workspace() === 'deliveries') {
      this.openEditor('delivery');
      this.loadDeliveryForEdit(id);
      return;
    }
    if (this.workspace() === 'pricing' && this.pricingTab() === 'conditions') {
      this.conditionForm.reset({
        modalityId: this.number(row['modalidadVentaId']), name: this.string(row['nombre']),
        description: this.string(row['descripcion']), minWeight: this.number(row['pesoMinimoG']), maxWeight: this.number(row['pesoMaximoG']),
      });
      this.conditionForm.controls.modalityId.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.openEditor('condition');
    }
  }

  view(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    if (id <= 0) return;
    const key = `view:${id}`;
    this.actionKey.set(key);
    this.detail.set(null);
    this.detailDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.detailLoading.set(true);
    this.api.detail(this.workspace(), id).pipe(finalize(() => { this.detailLoading.set(false); this.actionKey.set(null); })).subscribe({
      next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
      error: (error) => { this.detail.set({ mensaje: mapOpenApiError(error).message }); },
    });
  }

  closeDetail(): void { if (this.detailDialog.nativeElement.open) this.detailDialog.nativeElement.close(); this.detail.set(null); }
  closeEditor(): void { if (!this.saving() && this.editorDialog.nativeElement.open) this.editorDialog.nativeElement.close(); }

  saveEditor(): void {
    if (this.saving()) return;
    switch (this.modalKind()) {
      case 'campaign': this.saveCampaign(); break;
      case 'participant-include': this.saveParticipantInclude(); break;
      case 'participant-program': this.saveParticipantProgram(); break;
      case 'operation': this.saveOperation(); break;
      case 'operation-zones': this.saveOperationZones(); break;
      case 'delivery': this.saveDelivery(); break;
      case 'crate-receive': this.saveCrateReceive(); break;
      case 'crate-assign': this.saveCrateAssign(); break;
      case 'crate-return': this.saveCrateReturn(); break;
      case 'crate-annul': this.saveCrateAnnul(); break;
      case 'condition': this.saveCondition(); break;
      case 'price': this.savePrice(); break;
      case 'price-version': this.savePriceVersion(); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }

  async campaignAction(row: Record<string, unknown>, action: 'activate' | 'close' | 'cancel'): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row); if (id <= 0) return;
    const cancel = action === 'cancel';
    const result = await this.confirm.show({
      title: action === 'activate' ? 'Activar campaña' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar campaña' : 'Cancelar campaña',
      message: action === 'activate' ? 'La campaña quedará activa.' : action === 'close' ? 'La campaña quedará cerrada.' : 'La campaña quedará cancelada.',
      tone: cancel ? 'danger' : 'primary', confirmLabel: action === 'activate' ? 'Activar' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar' : 'Cancelar campaña',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: cancel, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: cancel ? 3 : 0,
    });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    const source = action === 'activate' ? this.api.activateCampaign(id, result.reason ?? undefined)
      : action === 'close' ? this.api.closeCampaign(id, result.reason ?? undefined)
      : this.api.cancelCampaign(id, result.reason ?? undefined);
    this.runRowAction(`${action}:${id}`, source, action === 'activate' ? 'Campaña activada' : action === 'close' ? 'Campaña cerrada' : 'Campaña cancelada');
  }

  openParticipantProgram(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.editingId.set(this.idOf(row));
    this.participantForm.patchValue({ campaignId: this.number(row['campaniaVentaId']), operationId: 0 });
    this.openEditor('participant-program');
  }

  async removeParticipant(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Retirar participante', message: 'El participante dejará la campaña.', tone: 'danger', confirmLabel: 'Retirar', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 3 });
    if (!result.confirmed || !result.reason) return;
    this.runRowAction(`remove:${id}`, this.api.removeParticipant(id, { motivo: result.reason }), 'Participante retirado');
  }

  openZones(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.editingId.set(this.idOf(row)); this.selectedZones.set([]); this.openEditor('operation-zones');
  }
  toggleZone(id: number, checked: boolean): void {
    this.selectedZones.update((values) => checked ? [...new Set([...values, id])] : values.filter((value) => value !== id));
  }

  async operationAction(row: Record<string, unknown>, action: 'start' | 'close' | 'cancel'): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row); const cancel = action === 'cancel';
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: action === 'start' ? 'Iniciar recepción' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar operativo' : 'Cancelar operativo', message: action === 'start' ? 'El operativo iniciará recepción.' : action === 'close' ? 'El operativo quedará cerrado.' : 'El operativo quedará cancelado.', tone: cancel ? 'danger' : 'primary', confirmLabel: action === 'start' ? 'Iniciar' : action === 'close' ? 'Cerrar' : 'Cancelar', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: cancel, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: cancel ? 3 : 0 });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    const source = action === 'start' ? this.api.startOperation(id, result.reason ?? undefined) : action === 'close' ? this.api.closeOperation(id, result.reason ?? undefined) : this.api.cancelOperation(id, result.reason ?? undefined);
    this.runRowAction(`${action}:${id}`, source, action === 'start' ? 'Recepción iniciada' : action === 'close' ? 'Operativo cerrado' : 'Operativo cancelado');
  }

  onDeliveryOperationChange(): void {
    const operationId = Number(this.deliveryForm.controls.operationId.value);
    this.deliveryForm.controls.operationPartnerId.setValue(0);
    this.operationPartners.set([]);
    if (operationId <= 0) return;
    this.api.operationPartners(operationId).subscribe({ next: (items) => this.operationPartners.set(items), error: () => this.operationPartners.set([]) });
  }

  addDeliveryLine(): void { this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup()); }
  removeDeliveryLine(index: number): void { if (this.deliveryLines.length > 1) this.deliveryLines.removeAt(index); }

  async confirmDelivery(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Confirmar entrega', message: 'La entrega quedará confirmada.', tone: 'primary', confirmLabel: 'Confirmar', cancelLabel: 'Volver' });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    this.runRowAction(`confirm:${id}`, this.api.confirmDelivery(id), 'Entrega confirmada');
  }
  async annulDelivery(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Anular entrega', message: 'La entrega quedará anulada.', tone: 'danger', confirmLabel: 'Anular', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 3 });
    if (!result.confirmed || !result.reason) return;
    this.runRowAction(`annul:${id}`, this.api.annulDelivery(id, { motivo: result.reason }), 'Entrega anulada');
  }

  openCrate(mode: 'crate-receive' | 'crate-assign' | 'crate-return' | 'crate-annul'): void {
    this.resetCrate(); this.openEditor(mode);
  }
  onCrateOperationChange(): void {
    const operationId = Number(this.crateForm.controls.operationId.value);
    this.operationPartners.set([]); this.crateAssignments.set([]);
    if (operationId <= 0) return;
    this.api.operationPartners(operationId).subscribe({ next: (items) => this.operationPartners.set(items), error: () => this.operationPartners.set([]) });
    this.api.crateAssignmentOptions(operationId).subscribe({ next: (items) => this.crateAssignments.set(items), error: () => this.crateAssignments.set([]) });
  }
  showCrateHistory(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const operationId = this.number(row['operativoVentaId']); if (operationId <= 0) return;
    this.actionKey.set(`history:${operationId}`); this.detailDialog.nativeElement.showModal(); this.detailLoading.set(true);
    this.api.cratesHistory(operationId).pipe(finalize(() => { this.detailLoading.set(false); this.actionKey.set(null); })).subscribe({
      next: (items) => this.detail.set({ movimientos: items }),
      error: (error) => this.detail.set({ mensaje: mapOpenApiError(error).message }),
    });
  }

  openPriceVersion(row: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.editingId.set(this.idOf(row)); this.priceForm.reset({ campaignId: this.number(row['campaniaVentaId']), operationId: this.number(row['operativoVentaId']), varietyId: this.number(row['variedadPaltaId']), conditionId: this.number(row['condicionComercialId']), price: this.number(row['precio']), currency: this.string(row['moneda']) || 'PEN', unit: this.string(row['unidadMedida']) || 'KG', validFrom: this.nowDateTime() }); this.openEditor('price-version');
  }
  async disableCondition(row: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.idOf(row);
    const result = await this.confirm.show({ title: 'Deshabilitar condición', message: 'La condición dejará de estar disponible.', tone: 'danger', confirmLabel: 'Deshabilitar', cancelLabel: 'Volver', requiresReason: true, reasonLabel: 'Motivo', minimumReasonLength: 3 });
    if (!result.confirmed || !result.reason) return;
    this.runRowAction(`disable:${id}`, this.api.disableCondition(id, { motivo: result.reason }), 'Condición deshabilitada');
  }

  idOf(row: Record<string, unknown>): number {
    const key = this.workspace() === 'campaigns' ? 'campaniaVentaId'
      : this.workspace() === 'participants' ? 'participacionId'
      : this.workspace() === 'operations' ? 'operativoVentaId'
      : this.workspace() === 'deliveries' ? 'entregaSocioId'
      : this.workspace() === 'crates' ? 'operativoVentaId'
      : this.pricingTab() === 'conditions' ? 'condicionComercialId' : 'precioComercialId';
    return this.number(row[key]);
  }

  cell(row: Record<string, unknown>, column: TableColumn): string {
    const value = row[column.key];
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '—';
    if (column.numeric) return new Intl.NumberFormat('es-PE', { maximumFractionDigits: 3 }).format(this.number(value));
    const text = this.string(value);
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(text)) {
      const date = new Date(text); if (!Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-PE', { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' }).format(date);
    }
    return text;
  }

  detailPairs(): readonly { label: string; value: string }[] {
    const raw = this.detail(); if (!raw) return [];
    const nested = ['campania', 'operativo', 'entrega'].map((key) => raw[key]).find((value) => value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value));
    const source = nested ? nested as Record<string, unknown> : raw;
    return Object.entries(source)
      .filter(([, value]) => !Array.isArray(value) && (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null))
      .slice(0, 18)
      .map(([key, value]) => ({ label: this.label(key), value: this.cell({ [key]: value }, { key, label: key, numeric: typeof value === 'number' }) }));
  }

  detailLists(): readonly { label: string; count: number }[] {
    const raw = this.detail(); if (!raw) return [];
    return Object.entries(raw).filter(([, value]) => Array.isArray(value)).map(([key, value]) => ({ label: this.label(key), count: (value as unknown[]).length }));
  }

  primaryPermission(): string {
    return ({ campaigns: 'CAMPANIAS_CREAR', participants: 'PARTICIPANTES_CREAR', operations: 'OPERATIVOS_CREAR', deliveries: 'ENTREGAS_CREAR', crates: 'JABAS_CREAR', pricing: 'PRECIOS_CREAR' })[this.workspace()];
  }

  modalTitle(): string {
    const editing = this.editingId() !== null;
    return ({
      campaign: editing ? 'Editar campaña' : 'Registrar campaña',
      'participant-include': 'Incluir participante', 'participant-program': 'Programar participante',
      operation: editing ? 'Editar operativo' : 'Registrar operativo', 'operation-zones': 'Asignar zonas',
      delivery: editing ? 'Editar entrega' : 'Registrar entrega', 'crate-receive': 'Registrar recepción',
      'crate-assign': 'Asignar jabas', 'crate-return': 'Registrar devolución', 'crate-annul': 'Anular movimiento',
      condition: editing ? 'Editar condición' : 'Registrar condición', price: 'Registrar precio', 'price-version': 'Nueva versión de precio', detail: 'Detalle',
    } as Record<ModalKind, string>)[this.modalKind()];
  }

  private openEditor(kind: ModalKind): void { this.modalKind.set(kind); this.editorDialog.nativeElement.showModal(); }

  private saveCampaign(): void {
    this.campaignForm.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.campaignForm.invalid) return;
    const raw = this.campaignForm.getRawValue(); if (raw.end < raw.start) { this.toast.error('Revise las fechas', 'La fecha final debe ser igual o posterior a la inicial.'); return; }
    const id = this.editingId(); this.saving.set(true);
    const source: Observable<unknown> = id
      ? this.api.updateCampaign(id, { empresaCompradoraId: Number(raw.buyerId), nombre: normalizeText(raw.name), fechaInicio: raw.start, fechaFin: raw.end, observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) })
      : this.api.createCampaign({ asociacionId: Number(raw.associationId), empresaCompradoraId: Number(raw.buyerId), codigo: buildSystemCode('CAM', raw.name, 40), nombre: normalizeText(raw.name), fechaInicio: raw.start, fechaFin: raw.end, observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) });
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved(id ? 'Campaña actualizada' : 'Campaña registrada'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveParticipantInclude(): void {
    this.participantForm.controls.campaignId.markAsTouched(); this.participantForm.controls.partnerAssociationId.markAsTouched();
    if (this.participantForm.controls.campaignId.invalid || this.participantForm.controls.partnerAssociationId.invalid) return;
    const raw = this.participantForm.getRawValue(); this.saving.set(true);
    this.api.includeParticipant({ campaniaVentaId: Number(raw.campaignId), socioAsociacionId: Number(raw.partnerAssociationId) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Participante incluido'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveParticipantProgram(): void {
    const id = this.editingId(); this.participantForm.controls.operationId.markAsTouched(); if (!id || this.participantForm.controls.operationId.invalid) return;
    this.saving.set(true); this.api.programParticipant(id, { operativoVentaId: Number(this.participantForm.controls.operationId.value) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Participante programado'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveOperation(): void {
    this.operationForm.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.operationForm.invalid) return;
    const raw = this.operationForm.getRawValue(); if (raw.end <= raw.start) { this.toast.error('Revise las fechas', 'La fecha final debe ser posterior a la inicial.'); return; }
    const id = this.editingId(); this.saving.set(true);
    const source: Observable<unknown> = id
      ? this.api.updateOperation(id, { fechaInicioProgramada: new Date(raw.start).toISOString(), fechaFinProgramada: new Date(raw.end).toISOString(), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) })
      : this.api.createOperation({ campaniaVentaId: Number(raw.campaignId), codigo: buildSystemCode('OP', `${raw.campaignId}-${raw.start}`, 40), fechaInicioProgramada: new Date(raw.start).toISOString(), fechaFinProgramada: new Date(raw.end).toISOString(), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) });
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved(id ? 'Operativo actualizado' : 'Operativo registrado'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveOperationZones(): void {
    const id = this.editingId(); const zones = [...this.selectedZones()]; if (!id || zones.length === 0) { this.toast.error('Seleccione una zona'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.api.setOperationZones(id, { zonas: zones }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Zonas actualizadas'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveDelivery(): void {
    this.deliveryForm.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.deliveryForm.invalid) return;
    const raw = this.deliveryForm.getRawValue();
    const accepted = Number(raw.grossKg) - Number(raw.tareKg) - Number(raw.rejectedKg);
    if (accepted <= 0) { this.toast.error('Revise los pesos', 'El peso aceptado debe ser mayor que cero.'); return; }
    const details: DeliveryLineRequest[] = raw.details.map((line) => ({ variedadPaltaId: Number(line.varietyId), condicionComercialId: Number(line.conditionId), kilogramos: Number(line.kg) }));
    const detailKg = details.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.kilogramos, 0);
    if (detailKg > accepted + 0.001) { this.toast.error('Revise el detalle', 'Los kilogramos del detalle superan el peso aceptado.'); return; }
    const id = this.editingId(); this.saving.set(true);
    const common = { pesoBrutoKg: Number(raw.grossKg), taraKg: Number(raw.tareKg), pesoRechazadoKg: Number(raw.rejectedKg), estadoControlCalidad: raw.qualityState, ticketBalanza: normalizeOptionalText(raw.ticket), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation), detalles: details };
    const source: Observable<unknown> = id
      ? this.api.updateDelivery(id, common satisfies DeliveryUpdatePreliminaryRequest)
      : this.api.createDelivery({ operativoSocioId: Number(raw.operationPartnerId), predioId: Number(raw.propertyId), codigoLote: buildSystemCode('LOT', `${raw.operationPartnerId}-${raw.dateTime}`, 60), fechaHora: new Date(raw.dateTime).toISOString(), ...common } satisfies DeliveryCreateRequest);
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved(id ? 'Entrega actualizada' : 'Entrega registrada'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveCrateReceive(): void {
    const raw = this.crateForm.getRawValue(); if (Number(raw.operationId) <= 0 || Number(raw.quantity) <= 0) { this.crateForm.markAllAsTouched(); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.api.receiveCrates({ operativoVentaId: Number(raw.operationId), cantidad: Number(raw.quantity), referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.reference), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Recepción registrada'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }
  private saveCrateAssign(): void {
    const raw = this.crateForm.getRawValue(); if (Number(raw.operationPartnerId) <= 0 || Number(raw.quantity) <= 0) { this.crateForm.markAllAsTouched(); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.api.assignCrates({ operativoSocioId: Number(raw.operationPartnerId), cantidad: Number(raw.quantity), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Jabas asignadas'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }
  private saveCrateReturn(): void {
    const raw = this.crateForm.getRawValue(); if (Number(raw.assignmentId) <= 0 || Number(raw.filled) + Number(raw.empty) <= 0) { this.toast.error('Revise la devolución', 'Ingrese al menos una jaba devuelta.'); return; }
    this.saving.set(true); this.api.returnCrates({ jabaAsignacionId: Number(raw.assignmentId), entregaSocioId: Number(raw.deliveryId) > 0 ? Number(raw.deliveryId) : undefined, cantidadLlenas: Number(raw.filled), cantidadVacias: Number(raw.empty), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observation) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Devolución registrada'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }
  private saveCrateAnnul(): void {
    const raw = this.crateForm.getRawValue(); this.crateForm.controls.movementId.markAsTouched(); this.crateForm.controls.reason.markAsTouched(); if (this.crateForm.controls.movementId.invalid || this.crateForm.controls.reason.invalid) return;
    this.saving.set(true); this.api.annulCrateMovement({ tipo: raw.movementType, movimientoId: Number(raw.movementId), motivo: normalizeText(raw.reason) }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Movimiento anulado'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private saveCondition(): void {
    this.conditionForm.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.conditionForm.invalid) return;
    const raw = this.conditionForm.getRawValue(); if (raw.maxWeight > 0 && raw.minWeight > raw.maxWeight) { this.toast.error('Revise los pesos', 'El peso máximo debe ser mayor o igual al mínimo.'); return; }
    const id = this.editingId(); this.saving.set(true);
    const source: Observable<unknown> = id
      ? this.api.updateCondition(id, { nombre: normalizeText(raw.name), descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.description), pesoMinimoG: raw.minWeight > 0 ? Number(raw.minWeight) : undefined, pesoMaximoG: raw.maxWeight > 0 ? Number(raw.maxWeight) : undefined })
      : this.api.createCondition({ modalidadVentaId: Number(raw.modalityId), codigo: buildSystemCode('COND', raw.name, 40), nombre: normalizeText(raw.name), descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.description), pesoMinimoG: raw.minWeight > 0 ? Number(raw.minWeight) : undefined, pesoMaximoG: raw.maxWeight > 0 ? Number(raw.maxWeight) : undefined });
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved(id ? 'Condición actualizada' : 'Condición registrada'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.priceForm.invalid) return; const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue(); this.saving.set(true);
    this.api.createPrice({ campaniaVentaId: Number(raw.campaignId), operativoVentaId: Number(raw.operationId) > 0 ? Number(raw.operationId) : undefined, variedadPaltaId: Number(raw.varietyId), condicionComercialId: Number(raw.conditionId), precio: Number(raw.price), moneda: raw.currency.trim().toUpperCase(), unidadMedida: normalizeText(raw.unit).toUpperCase(), fechaVigenciaDesde: new Date(raw.validFrom).toISOString() }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Precio registrado'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }
  private savePriceVersion(): void {
    const id = this.editingId(); this.priceForm.controls.price.markAsTouched(); this.priceForm.controls.validFrom.markAsTouched(); if (!id || this.priceForm.controls.price.invalid || this.priceForm.controls.validFrom.invalid) return; const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue(); this.saving.set(true);
    this.api.versionPrice(id, { precio: Number(raw.price), fechaVigenciaDesde: new Date(raw.validFrom).toISOString() }).pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => this.saved('Versión registrada'), error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e) });
  }

  private loadDeliveryForEdit(id: number): void {
    this.detailLoading.set(true); this.api.detail('deliveries', id).pipe(finalize(() => this.detailLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (detail) => {
        const header = this.record(detail['entrega']); const lines = Array.isArray(detail['detalles']) ? detail['detalles'] as Record<string, unknown>[] : [];
        this.deliveryLines.clear(); for (const line of lines) this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup(this.number(line['variedadPaltaId']), this.number(line['condicionComercialId']), this.number(line['kilogramos']))); if (this.deliveryLines.length === 0) this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup());
        this.deliveryForm.reset({ operationId: this.number(header['operativoVentaId']), operationPartnerId: 0, propertyId: this.number(header['predioId']), dateTime: this.dateTimeValue(header['fechaHora']), grossKg: this.number(header['pesoBrutoKg']), tareKg: this.number(header['taraKg']), rejectedKg: this.number(header['pesoRechazadoKg']), qualityState: this.string(header['estadoControlCalidad']) || 'PENDIENTE', ticket: this.string(header['ticketBalanza']), observation: this.string(header['observacion']), details: this.deliveryLines.getRawValue() });
        this.deliveryForm.controls.operationId.disable({ emitEvent: false }); this.deliveryForm.controls.operationPartnerId.disable({ emitEvent: false }); this.deliveryForm.controls.propertyId.disable({ emitEvent: false }); this.deliveryForm.controls.dateTime.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      },
      error: (e: unknown) => this.editorError(e),
    });
  }

  private deliveryLineGroup(varietyId = 0, conditionId = 0, kg = 0) {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({ varietyId: [varietyId, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], conditionId: [conditionId, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], kg: [kg, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]] });
  }
  private resetCampaign(): void { this.campaignForm.controls.associationId.enable({ emitEvent: false }); this.campaignForm.reset({ associationId: 0, buyerId: 0, name: '', start: this.today(), end: this.today(), observation: '' }); }
  private resetOperation(): void { this.operationForm.controls.campaignId.enable({ emitEvent: false }); const now = this.nowDateTime(); this.operationForm.reset({ campaignId: 0, start: now, end: now, observation: '' }); }
  private resetDelivery(): void { this.deliveryForm.enable({ emitEvent: false }); this.deliveryLines.clear(); this.deliveryLines.push(this.deliveryLineGroup()); this.deliveryForm.reset({ operationId: 0, operationPartnerId: 0, propertyId: 0, dateTime: this.nowDateTime(), grossKg: 0, tareKg: 0, rejectedKg: 0, qualityState: 'PENDIENTE', ticket: '', observation: '', details: this.deliveryLines.getRawValue() }); this.operationPartners.set([]); }
  private resetCrate(): void { this.crateForm.reset({ operationId: 0, operationPartnerId: 0, assignmentId: 0, deliveryId: 0, quantity: 1, filled: 0, empty: 0, reference: '', observation: '', movementType: 'ASIGNACION', movementId: 0, reason: '' }); this.operationPartners.set([]); this.crateAssignments.set([]); }
  private resetCondition(): void { this.conditionForm.controls.modalityId.enable({ emitEvent: false }); this.conditionForm.reset({ modalityId: 0, name: '', description: '', minWeight: 0, maxWeight: 0 }); }
  private resetPrice(): void { this.priceForm.enable({ emitEvent: false }); this.priceForm.reset({ campaignId: 0, operationId: 0, varietyId: 0, conditionId: 0, price: 0, currency: 'PEN', unit: 'KG', validFrom: this.nowDateTime() }); }
  private saved(message: string): void { this.toast.success(message); this.closeEditor(); this.load(); this.loadReferences(); }
  private editorError(error: unknown): void { this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la acción', mapOpenApiError(error).message); }
  private runRowAction(key: string, source: Observable<unknown>, message: string): void {
    this.actionKey.set(key);
    source.pipe(finalize(() => this.actionKey.set(null))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(message);
        this.load();
        this.loadReferences();
      },
      error: (error: unknown) =>
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la acción', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }
  private number(value: unknown): number { const parsed = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0; }
  private string(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : String(value ?? '').trim(); }
  private record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> { return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {}; }
  private label(key: string): string { return key.replace(/Id$/, '').replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2').replace(/^./, (value) => value.toUpperCase()); }
  private dateValue(value: unknown): string { return this.string(value).slice(0, 10); }
  private dateTimeValue(value: unknown): string { const text = this.string(value); if (!text) return ''; const date = new Date(text); if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return text.slice(0, 16); const local = new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000); return local.toISOString().slice(0, 16); }
```

```typescript
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faSeedling, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { nonNegativeIntegerValidator, normalizeOptionalText, notFutureDateValidator, optionalNotBlankValidator, todayLocalIsoDate } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';

@Component({ selector: 'app-censo-form', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent], templateUrl: './censo-form.html', styleUrl: './censo-form.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class CensoFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly create = inject(CrearCensoUseCase);
    private readonly update = inject(EditarCensoUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly current = signal<Censo | null>(null);
    readonly crops = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
    private resolver: ((r: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly addIcon = faSeedling;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      parcelaCultivoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      fechaCenso: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      plantasTotales: [0, [Validators.required, nonNegativeIntegerValidator]],
      plantasProductivas: [0, [Validators.required, nonNegativeIntegerValidator]],
      plantasNoProductivas: [0, [Validators.required, nonNegativeIntegerValidator]],
      plantasNuevas: [0, [Validators.required, nonNegativeIntegerValidator]],
      plantasMuertas: [0, [Validators.required, nonNegativeIntegerValidator]],
      plantasAfectadas: [0, [Validators.required, nonNegativeIntegerValidator]],
      observacion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)]],
    });
    open(crops: readonly AdminSelectOption[], current: Censo | null = null) { this.current.set(current); this.crops.set(crops); this.error.set(null); this.form.reset({ parcelaCultivoId: current?.parcelaCultivoId ?? crops[0]?.value ?? 0, fechaCenso: current?.fechaCenso?.slice(0, 10) ?? this.today, plantasTotales: current?.plantasTotales ?? 0, plantasProductivas: current?.plantasProductivas ?? 0, plantasNoProductivas: current?.plantasNoProductivas ?? 0, plantasNuevas: current?.plantasNuevas ?? 0, plantasMuertas: current?.plantasMuertas ?? 0, plantasAfectadas: current?.plantasAfectadas ?? 0, observacion: current?.observacion ?? '' }); this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise<AdminModalResult>(r => this.resolver = r); }
    close() { if (!this.saving())
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
    save() { this.form.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.form.invalid || this.saving())
        return; const v = this.form.getRawValue(); if ([v.plantasTotales, v.plantasProductivas, v.plantasNoProductivas, v.plantasNuevas, v.plantasMuertas, v.plantasAfectadas].some(value => Number(value) > 2147483647)) {
        this.error.set('Las cantidades ingresadas son demasiado grandes.');
        return;
    } if (v.plantasProductivas + v.plantasNoProductivas > v.plantasTotales) {
        this.error.set('Las plantas productivas y no productivas no pueden superar el total.');
        return;
    } if (v.plantasAfectadas > v.plantasTotales) {
        this.error.set('Las plantas afectadas no pueden superar el total.');
        return;
    } if (v.fechaCenso > new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)) {
        this.error.set('La fecha del censo no puede ser futura.');
        return;
    } const input = { parcelaCultivoId: Number(v.parcelaCultivoId), fechaCenso: v.fechaCenso, plantasTotales: Number(v.plantasTotales), plantasProductivas: Number(v.plantasProductivas), plantasNoProductivas: Number(v.plantasNoProductivas), plantasNuevas: Number(v.plantasNuevas), plantasMuertas: Number(v.plantasMuertas), plantasAfectadas: Number(v.plantasAfectadas), observacion: normalizeOptionalText(v.observacion) }; this.saving.set(true); this.error.set(null); const op: Observable<unknown> = this.current() ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.censoPlantasId, input) : this.create.execute(input); op.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success(this.current() ? 'Censo actualizado' : 'Censo registrado'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); }, error: e => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(e).message) }); }
    private finish(r: AdminModalResult) { if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open)
        this.dialog.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(r); this.resolver = null; this.current.set(null); }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faSeedling, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { notFutureDateValidator, todayLocalIsoDate } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearCultivoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-cultivo.use-case';
import { EditarCultivoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-cultivo.use-case';
import { Cultivo } from '../../../../../domain/cultivo.model';
@Component({ selector: 'app-cultivo-form', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent], templateUrl: './cultivo-form.html', styleUrl: './cultivo-form.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class CultivoFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
    private readonly create = inject(CrearCultivoUseCase);
    private readonly update = inject(EditarCultivoUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
    readonly current = signal<Cultivo | null>(null);
    readonly parcelaId = signal(0);
    readonly varieties = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
    private resolver: ((r: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly addIcon = faSeedling;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ variedadPaltaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], fechaInicio: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]] });
    open(parcelaId: number, current: Cultivo | null = null) { this.parcelaId.set(parcelaId); this.current.set(current); this.error.set(null); this.form.reset({ variedadPaltaId: current?.variedadPaltaId ?? 0, fechaInicio: current?.fechaInicio?.slice(0, 10) ?? this.today }); this.loadVarieties(); this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise<AdminModalResult>(r => this.resolver = r); }
    close() { if (!this.saving())
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
    save() { this.form.markAllAsTouched(); if (this.form.invalid || this.saving())
        return; const v = this.form.getRawValue(); this.saving.set(true); const op: Observable<unknown> = this.current() ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.parcelaCultivoId, { variedadPaltaId: Number(v.variedadPaltaId), fechaInicio: v.fechaInicio }) : this.create.execute(this.parcelaId(), { parcelaId: this.parcelaId(), variedadPaltaId: Number(v.variedadPaltaId), fechaInicio: v.fechaInicio }); op.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success(this.current() ? 'Cultivo actualizado' : 'Cultivo registrado'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); }, error: e => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(e).message) }); }
    private loadVarieties() { this.referencesLoading.set(true); this.refs.catalog('VARIEDAD_PALTA').pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false))).subscribe({ next: r => { this.varieties.set(r.map(x => ({ value: Number(x.id), label: x.label, description: x.code }))); if (!this.current() && this.varieties()[0])
            this.form.patchValue({ variedadPaltaId: this.varieties()[0].value }); }, error: () => this.varieties.set([]) }); }
    private finish(r: AdminModalResult) { if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open)
        this.dialog.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(r); this.resolver = null; this.current.set(null); }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon">
          <fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : pageIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Parcelas</p>
          <h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar parcela' : 'Registrar parcela' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        class="admin-icon-button"
        type="button"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (error()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error">{{ error() }}</div>
    }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label>Predio</label>
        <select class="admin-select" formControlName="predioId">
          @for (property of options(); track property.id) {
            <option [value]="property.id">
              {{ property.codigo }} · {{ property.label }}
            </option>
          }
        </select>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.predioId"
          fieldLabel="El predio"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label>Nombre</label>
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          formControlName="nombre"
          maxlength="120"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.nombre"
          fieldLabel="El nombre"
        />
        @if (current(); as plot) {
          <small>Código asignado: {{ plot.codigo }}</small>
        } @else {
          <small>El código de la parcela se generará automáticamente al registrar.</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label>Área (ha)</label>
        <input
          type="number"
          class="admin-input"
          formControlName="areaHa"
          min="0.0001"
          max="999999.9999"
          step="0.0001"
        />
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.areaHa"
          fieldLabel="El área"
        />
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="saving()"
          (click)="close()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>
        <button
          class="admin-primary-button"
          type="submit"
          [disabled]="saving()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

### 1060. `src/app/features/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos/adapter/in/ui/pages/parcela-form/parcela-form.ts`

- Ruta: `src/app/features/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos/adapter/in/ui/pages/parcela-form/parcela-form.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\gestion-tecnica\parcelas-cultivos\adapter\in\ui\pages\parcela-form\parcela-form.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/gestion-tecnica/parcelas-cultivos/adapter/in/ui/pages/parcela-form/parcela-form.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faLayerGroup,
  faPen,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  decimalPrecisionValidator,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { CrearParcelaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-parcela.use-case';
import { EditarParcelaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-parcela.use-case';
import { Parcela } from '../../../../../domain/parcela.model';

interface PredioOption {
  id: number;
  label: string;
  codigo: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-parcela-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './parcela-form.html',
  styleUrl: './parcela-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ParcelaFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly create = inject(CrearParcelaUseCase);
  private readonly update = inject(EditarParcelaUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly current = signal<Parcela | null>(null);
  readonly options = signal<readonly PredioOption[]>([]);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly pageIcon = faLayerGroup;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    predioId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(120),
      ],
    ],
    areaHa: [
      0,
      [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.min(0.0001),
        Validators.max(999999.9999),
        decimalPrecisionValidator(6, 4),
      ],
    ],
  });

  open(
    options: readonly PredioOption[],
    current: Parcela | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(current);
    this.options.set(options);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.form.reset({
      predioId: current?.predioId ?? options[0]?.id ?? 0,
      nombre: current?.nombre ?? '',
      areaHa: current?.areaHa ?? 0,
    });

    this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const value = this.form.getRawValue();
    const input = {
      predioId: Number(value.predioId),
      nombre: normalizeText(value.nombre),
      areaHa: Number(value.areaHa),
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = this.current()
      ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.parcelaId, input)
      : this.create.execute(input);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            this.current()
              ? 'Parcela actualizada'
              : 'Parcela registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialog.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.error.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  CropCreateRequest,
  CropFinishRequest,
  CropUpdateRequest,
  ParcelasYCultivosService,
  PlotCreateRequest,
  PlotUpdateRequest,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { ParcelasCultivosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/parcelas-cultivos.gateway';
import {
  CultivoFiltro,
  CultivoInput,
  CultivoUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/cultivo.model';
import { ParcelaInput } from '../../../domain/parcela.model';
import { ParcelasCultivosHttpMapper } from './parcelas-cultivos-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ParcelasCultivosHttpAdapter implements ParcelasCultivosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(ParcelasYCultivosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(ParcelasCultivosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: CultivoFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .cultivosListar(
        {
          predioId: filter.predioId,
          socioId: filter.socioId,
          variedadPaltaId: filter.variedadPaltaId,
          situacionCultivo: filter.situacionCultivo,
          buscar: filter.buscar,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  getExpediente(parcelaId?: number, cultivoId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .cultivosVerExpediente(
        {
          parcelaId,
          parcelaCultivoId: cultivoId,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  createPlot(input: ParcelaInput) {
    const plotCreateRequest: PlotCreateRequest = {
      predioId: input.predioId,
      nombre: input.nombre,
      areaHa: input.areaHa,
    };

    return this.api
      .parcelasCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          plotCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.created(response)));
  }

  updatePlot(id: number, input: ParcelaInput) {
    const plotUpdateRequest: PlotUpdateRequest = {
      predioId: input.predioId,
      nombre: input.nombre,
      areaHa: input.areaHa,
    };

    return this.api
      .parcelasEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          plotUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  createCrop(parcelaId: number, input: CultivoInput) {
    const cropCreateRequest: CropCreateRequest = {
      parcelaId,
      variedadPaltaId: input.variedadPaltaId,
      fechaInicio: input.fechaInicio,
    };

    return this.api
      .cultivosCrear(
        {
          id: parcelaId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          cropCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.created(response)));
  }

  updateCrop(id: number, input: CultivoUpdate) {
    const cropUpdateRequest: CropUpdateRequest = {
      variedadPaltaId: input.variedadPaltaId,
      fechaInicio: input.fechaInicio,
    };

    return this.api
      .cultivosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          cropUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  finishCrop(id: number, fechaFin: string, motivo: string) {
    const cropFinishRequest: CropFinishRequest = {
      fechaFin,
      motivo,
    };

    return this.api
      .cultivosFinalizar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          cropFinishRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}
```
