```typescript
import {isPlatformBrowser} from '@angular/common';
import {AfterViewInit,ChangeDetectionStrategy,Component,ElementRef,EventEmitter,Input,OnChanges,OnDestroy,Output,PLATFORM_ID,SimpleChanges,ViewChild,inject,signal} from '@angular/core';
import {ToastService} from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';import {FaIconComponent} from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {faLocationCrosshairs,faMapLocationDot} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import type {CircleMarker,Map} from 'leaflet';
@Component({selector:'app-predio-map',standalone:true,imports:[FaIconComponent],templateUrl:'./predio-map.html',styleUrl:'./predio-map.css',changeDetection:ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush})
export class PredioMapComponent implements AfterViewInit,OnChanges,OnDestroy{
 @ViewChild('mapHost',{static:true}) private host!:ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>;
 @Input() latitude:number|null=null;@Input() longitude:number|null=null;@Input() editable=false;@Input() height='18rem';
 @Output() locationChange=new EventEmitter<{latitude:number;longitude:number}>();
 private readonly platformId=inject(PLATFORM_ID);private readonly toast=inject(ToastService);private map:Map|null=null;private marker:CircleMarker|null=null;private leaflet:any;readonly locating=signal(false);
 readonly mapIcon=faMapLocationDot;readonly locateIcon=faLocationCrosshairs;
 ngAfterViewInit(){if(isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)) void this.ensureMap();}
 ngOnChanges(_:SimpleChanges){if(this.map) this.syncMarker();}
 ngOnDestroy(){this.map?.remove();this.map=null;this.marker=null;}
 async useCurrentLocation(){if(!isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)||!navigator.geolocation||this.locating())return;this.locating.set(true);navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(p=>{this.setPoint(p.coords.latitude,p.coords.longitude);this.locating.set(false);this.toast.success('Ubicación actualizada');},()=>{this.locating.set(false);this.toast.error('No se pudo obtener la ubicación');},{enableHighAccuracy:true,timeout:15000,maximumAge:0});}
 private async ensureMap(){if(this.map)return;const L=await import('leaflet');this.leaflet=L;const lat=this.latitude??-15.2497,lng=this.longitude??-73.2478;this.map=L.map(this.host.nativeElement,{zoomControl:true}).setView([lat,lng],this.latitude!=null&&this.longitude!=null?16:11);L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',{maxZoom:19,attribution:'© OpenStreetMap'}).addTo(this.map);if(this.editable)this.map.on('click',(e:any)=>this.setPoint(e.latlng.lat,e.latlng.lng));this.syncMarker();setTimeout(()=>this.map?.invalidateSize(),0);}
 private setPoint(latitude:number,longitude:number){this.latitude=latitude;this.longitude=longitude;this.syncMarker();this.locationChange.emit({latitude,longitude});}
 private syncMarker(){if(!this.map||!this.leaflet)return;const has=this.latitude!=null&&this.longitude!=null;if(!has){if(this.marker){this.marker.remove();this.marker=null;}return;}const point:[number,number]=[this.latitude!,this.longitude!];if(!this.marker)this.marker=this.leaflet.circleMarker(point,{radius:8,weight:3,fillOpacity:.85}).addTo(this.map);else this.marker.setLatLng(point);this.map.setView(point,16);}
}

<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault();close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group"><span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="current()?editIcon:addIcon"/></span><div><p>Predios</p><h2>{{current()?'Editar predio':'Registrar predio'}}</h2></div></div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon"/></button>
    </header>
    @if(error()){<div class="admin-inline-error">{{error()}}</div>}
    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label>Nombre</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="nombre" maxlength="150" /><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombre" fieldLabel="El nombre"/>
        @if (current(); as property) {
          <small>Código asignado: {{ property.codigo }}</small>
        } @else {
          <small>El código del predio se generará automáticamente al registrar.</small>
        }
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Fecha de registro</label><input type="date" class="admin-input" formControlName="fechaRegistro" [max]="today" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Referencia</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="referencia" maxlength="300"/></div>

      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving()"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito"/></div>

      <div class="admin-field"><label>Área total (ha)</label><input type="number" step="0.0001" class="admin-input" formControlName="areaTotalHa" min="0.0001"  max="999999.9999" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Área cultivable (ha)</label><input type="number" step="0.0001" min="0" class="admin-input" formControlName="areaCultivableHa" max="999999.9999" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Tipo de riego</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="tipoRiego" placeholder="Ej. Goteo" maxlength="30" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Fuente de agua</label><input class="admin-input" formControlName="fuenteAgua" maxlength="150"/></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Infraestructura</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" formControlName="infraestructura" rows="2" maxlength="300"></textarea></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Vigencia de características</label><input type="date" class="admin-input" formControlName="fechaDesde" [max]="today" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field"><label>Altitud (m)</label><input type="number" class="admin-input" formControlName="altitudM" min="-500"  max="7000"  step="0.01" /></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Ubicación en mapa</label><app-predio-map [latitude]="latitude()" [longitude]="longitude()" [editable]="true" height="16rem" (locationChange)="setLocation($event)"/></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Titulares</label><div class="owner-editor"><select class="admin-select" formControlName="ownerSocioId"><option [value]="0">Seleccionar socio</option>@for(p of producers();track p.id){<option [value]="p.id">{{p.label}} · {{p.document}}</option>}</select><select class="admin-select" formControlName="ownerTipo">@for(t of ownershipTypes;track t){<option [value]="t">{{t}}</option>}</select><input type="number" min=".01" max="100" step=".01" class="admin-input" formControlName="ownerPorcentaje"/><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="referencesLoading()" (click)="addOwner()">@if(referencesLoading()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="addIcon"/>} Agregar</button></div><div class="owner-list">@for(o of owners();track o.socioId;let i=$index){<article><div><strong>{{producerLabel(o.socioId)}}</strong><span>{{o.tipoTitularidad}} · {{o.porcentaje}}%</span></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" (click)="removeOwner(i)"><fa-icon [icon]="deleteIcon"/></button></article>}@empty{<p>Agrega al menos un titular.</p>}</div><div class="owner-total">Total: <strong>{{totalOwnership() | number:'1.0-2'}}%</strong></div></div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Observación</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" formControlName="observacion" rows="3" maxlength="500"></textarea></div>
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">@if(saving()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando...}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon"/> Guardar}</button></footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/gestion-tecnica/predios/adapter/in/ui/pages/predio-form/predio-form.ts`

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faPlus, faTrashCan, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import {
  dateOrderValidator,
  decimalPrecisionValidator,
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
  notFutureDateValidator,
  optionalNotBlankValidator,
  todayLocalIsoDate,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  GeographyCascadeComponent,
  GeographySelection,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarProductoresUseCase } from '../../../../../../productores/application/use-case/listar-productores.use-case';
import { CrearPredioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/crear-predio.use-case';
import { EditarPredioUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-predio.use-case';
import { PredioDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/predio-detalle.model';
import { TipoTitularidad, TitularidadInput } from '../../../../../domain/titularidad.model';
import { PredioMapComponent } from '../../components/predio-map/predio-map';

interface ProducerOption {
  id: number;
  label: string;
  document: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-predio-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    GeographyCascadeComponent,
    PredioMapComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './predio-form.html',
  styleUrl: './predio-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PredioFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly create = inject(CrearPredioUseCase);
  private readonly update = inject(EditarPredioUseCase);
  private readonly producersUseCase = inject(ListarProductoresUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly current = signal<PredioDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly producers = signal<readonly ProducerOption[]>([]);
  readonly owners = signal<readonly TitularidadInput[]>([]);
  readonly latitude = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly longitude = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly deleteIcon = faTrashCan;

  readonly ownershipTypes: readonly TipoTitularidad[] = [
    'PROPIETARIO',
    'COPROPIETARIO',
    'POSESIONARIO',
    'ARRENDATARIO',
    'OTRO',
  ];

  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      nombre: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(150),
        ],
      ],
      fechaRegistro: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator],
      ],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      referencia: [
        '',
        [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
      ],
      altitudM: [
        0,
        [
          Validators.min(-500),
          Validators.max(7000),
          decimalPrecisionValidator(6, 2),
        ],
      ],
      areaTotalHa: [
        0,
        [
          Validators.required,
          Validators.min(0.0001),
          Validators.max(999999.9999),
          decimalPrecisionValidator(6, 4),
        ],
      ],
      areaCultivableHa: [
        0,
        [
          Validators.required,
          Validators.min(0),
          Validators.max(999999.9999),
          decimalPrecisionValidator(6, 4),
        ],
      ],
      tipoRiego: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(30),
        ],
      ],
      fuenteAgua: [
        '',
        [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(150)],
      ],
      infraestructura: [
        '',
        [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(300)],
      ],
      observacion: [
        '',
        [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(500)],
      ],
      fechaDesde: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator],
      ],
      ownerSocioId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      ownerTipo: ['PROPIETARIO' as TipoTitularidad],
      ownerPorcentaje: [
        100,
        [
          Validators.min(0.01),
          Validators.max(100),
          decimalPrecisionValidator(3, 2),
        ],
      ],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaRegistro',
          'fechaDesde',
          'characteristicsBeforeRegistration',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(detail: PredioDetalle | null = null): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(detail);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.owners.set(
      detail?.titulares
        .filter((item) => item.estado)
        .map((item) => ({
          socioId: item.socioId,
          tipoTitularidad: item.tipoTitularidad as TipoTitularidad,
          porcentaje: item.porcentaje,
        })) ?? [],
    );
    this.latitude.set(detail?.latitud ?? null);
    this.longitude.set(detail?.longitud ?? null);
    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null);

    const today = this.today;
    this.form.reset({
      nombre: detail?.nombre ?? '',
      fechaRegistro: detail?.fechaRegistro?.slice(0, 10) ?? today,
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      altitudM: detail?.altitudM ?? 0,
      areaTotalHa: detail?.areaTotalHa ?? 0,
      areaCultivableHa: detail?.areaCultivableHa ?? 0,
      tipoRiego: detail?.tipoRiego ?? '',
      fuenteAgua: detail?.fuenteAgua ?? '',
      infraestructura: detail?.infraestructura ?? '',
      observacion: detail?.observacion ?? '',
      fechaDesde: detail?.fechaDesde?.slice(0, 10) ?? today,
      ownerSocioId: 0,
      ownerTipo: 'PROPIETARIO',
      ownerPorcentaje: 100,
    });

    this.form.controls.fechaRegistro[
      detail ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadProducers();
    this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  setLocation(point: { latitude: number; longitude: number }): void {
    this.latitude.set(point.latitude);
    this.longitude.set(point.longitude);
  }

  addOwner(): void {
    const value = this.form.getRawValue();
    const id = Number(value.ownerSocioId);
    const percentage = Number(value.ownerPorcentaje);

    if (!id || percentage <= 0 || percentage > 100) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.owners().some((item) => item.socioId === id)) {
      this.error.set('El socio ya forma parte de la titularidad.');
      return;
    }
    if (this.totalOwnership() + percentage > 100.0001) {
      this.error.set('La suma de porcentajes no puede superar el 100 %.');
      return;
    }

    this.error.set(null);
    this.owners.set([
      ...this.owners(),
      {
        socioId: id,
        tipoTitularidad: value.ownerTipo,
        porcentaje: percentage,
      },
    ]);
    this.form.patchValue({
      ownerSocioId: 0,
      ownerPorcentaje: Math.max(0, 100 - this.totalOwnership()),
    });
  }

  removeOwner(index: number): void {
    this.owners.set(this.owners().filter((_, current) => current !== index));
  }

  totalOwnership(): number {
    return this.owners().reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.porcentaje, 0);
  }

  producerLabel(id: number): string {
    return this.producers().find((item) => item.id === id)?.label ?? `Socio ${id}`;
  }

  save(): void {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    const value = this.form.getRawValue();

    if (this.form.invalid || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }
    if (value.areaCultivableHa > value.areaTotalHa) {
      this.error.set('El área cultivable no puede superar el área total.');
      return;
    }
    if (this.owners().length === 0) {
      this.error.set('Agrega al menos un titular.');
      return;
    }

    if (this.totalOwnership() > 100.0001) {
      this.error.set('La suma de porcentajes no puede superar el 100 %.');
      return;
    }

    const lat = this.latitude();
    const lon = this.longitude();

    if (
      (lat === null) !== (lon === null)
      || (lat !== null && (lat < -90 || lat > 90))
      || (lon !== null && (lon < -180 || lon > 180))
    ) {
      this.error.set('La ubicación geográfica no es válida.');
      return;
    }

    const base = {
      nombre: normalizeText(value.nombre),
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: value.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(value.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(value.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(value.referencia),
        latitud: this.latitude() ?? undefined,
        longitud: this.longitude() ?? undefined,
        altitudM: Number(value.altitudM) || undefined,
      },
      caracteristicas: {
        areaTotalHa: Number(value.areaTotalHa),
        areaCultivableHa: Number(value.areaCultivableHa),
        tipoRiego: normalizeText(value.tipoRiego).toUpperCase(),
        fuenteAgua: normalizeOptionalText(value.fuenteAgua),
        infraestructura: normalizeOptionalText(value.infraestructura),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(value.observacion),
        fechaDesde: value.fechaDesde,
      },
      titulares: this.owners(),
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = this.current()
      ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.predioId, {
          nombre: base.nombre,
          fechaTitularidad: value.fechaDesde,
          ubicacion: base.ubicacion,
          caracteristicas: base.caracteristicas,
          titulares: base.titulares,
        })
      : this.create.execute({ ...base, fechaRegistro: value.fechaRegistro });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            this.current() ? 'Predio actualizado' : 'Predio registrado',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.error.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            this.current()
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el predio'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el predio',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private loadProducers(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.producersUseCase
      .execute({ situacion: 'ACTIVO', page: 1, size: 200 })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.producers.set(
            result.items.map((item) => ({
              id: item.socioId,
              label: [item.nombres, item.apellidoPaterno, item.apellidoMaterno]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' '),
              document: item.numeroDocumento,
            })),
          ),
        error: () => this.producers.set([]),
      });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialog.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.error.set(null);
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  PrediosService,
  PropertyCharacteristicsRequest,
  PropertyCreateRequest,
  PropertyLocationRequest,
  PropertyOwnerRequest,
  PropertyRetireRequest,
  PropertyUpdateRequest,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { PrediosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/predios.gateway';
import { PredioCreate, PredioUpdate } from '../../../domain/predio.model';
import { PredioFiltro } from '../../../domain/predio-filtro.model';
import { PrediosHttpMapper } from './predios-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class PrediosHttpAdapter implements PrediosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(PrediosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(PrediosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: PredioFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .prediosListar(
        {
          buscar: filter.buscar,
          socioId: filter.socioId,
          distritoCodigo: filter.distritoCodigo,
          soloActivos: filter.soloActivos,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .prediosVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  create(input: PredioCreate) {
    const ubicacion: PropertyLocationRequest = { ...input.ubicacion };
    const caracteristicas: PropertyCharacteristicsRequest = {
      ...input.caracteristicas,
    };
    const titulares: PropertyOwnerRequest[] = input.titulares.map((value) => ({
      ...value,
    }));

    const propertyCreateRequest: PropertyCreateRequest = {
      nombre: input.nombre,
      fechaRegistro: input.fechaRegistro,
      ubicacion,
      caracteristicas,
      titulares,
    };

    return this.api
      .prediosCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          propertyCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.created(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: PredioUpdate) {
    const ubicacion: PropertyLocationRequest | undefined = input.ubicacion
      ? { ...input.ubicacion }
      : undefined;
    const caracteristicas: PropertyCharacteristicsRequest | undefined =
      input.caracteristicas ? { ...input.caracteristicas } : undefined;
    const titulares: PropertyOwnerRequest[] | undefined = input.titulares
      ? input.titulares.map((value) => ({ ...value }))
      : undefined;

    const propertyUpdateRequest: PropertyUpdateRequest = {
      nombre: input.nombre,
      fechaTitularidad: input.fechaTitularidad,
      ubicacion,
      caracteristicas,
      titulares,
    };

    return this.api
      .prediosEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          propertyUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  retire(id: number, fechaRetiro: string, motivo: string) {
    const propertyRetireRequest: PropertyRetireRequest = {
      fechaRetiro,
      motivo,
    };

    return this.api
      .prediosRetirar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          propertyRetireRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}

preliminar.',tone:'warning',confirmLabel:'Confirmar',cancelLabel:'Cancelar'});if(!c.confirmed)return;this.actionId.set(x.disponibilidadProduccionId);this.confirmUseCase.execute(x.disponibilidadProduccionId).pipe(finalize(()=>this.actionId.set(null))).subscribe({next:()=>{this.toast.success('Producción confirmada');this.load();},error:e=>this.toast.error('No se pudo confirmar la producción',mapOpenApiError(e).message)});}async discard(x:ProduccionDisponible){if(!this.isEstimated(x)||this.actionId())return;const c=await this.confirmDialog.show({title:'Descartar estimación',message:'La estimación será retirada del flujo disponible.',tone:'danger',confirmLabel:'Descartar',cancelLabel:'Cancelar',requiresReason:true,reasonLabel:'Motivo',reasonPlaceholder:'Indica el motivo del descarte.',minimumReasonLength:5});if(!c.confirmed||!c.reason)return;this.actionId.set(x.disponibilidadProduccionId);this.discardUseCase.execute(x.disponibilidadProduccionId,c.reason).pipe(finalize(()=>this.actionId.set(null))).subscribe({next:()=>{this.toast.success('Estimación descartada');this.load();},error:e=>this.toast.error('No se pudo descartar la estimación',mapOpenApiError(e).message)});}isEstimated(x:ProduccionDisponible){return x.estadoEstimacion==='ESTIMADA';}}

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/gestion-tecnica/productores/adapter/in/ui/pages/productor-detail/productor-detail.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowLeft, faArrowRightFromBracket, faBuilding, faLeaf, faPen, faRotate, faSeedling, faUser } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { EvidencePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../documentos-evidencias/adapter/in/ui/components/evidence-panel/evidence-panel';
import { ObtenerProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-productor.use-case';
import { RetirarProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-productor.use-case';
import { ProductorDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/productor-detalle.model';
import { ProductorFormComponent } from '../productor-form/productor-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productor-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductorFormComponent,
    EvidencePanelComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productor-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './productor-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductorDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductorFormComponent) private form!: ProductorFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerProductorUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarProductorUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly producerId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiring = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<ProductorDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly associations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faUser;
  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly affiliationIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly propertyIcon = faSeedling;
  readonly campaignIcon = faLeaf;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadAssociations();
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.producerId) || this.producerId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El productor solicitado no es válido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.getUseCase.execute(this.producerId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => this.detail.set(detail),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadAssociations(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);
    this.organizationsUseCase.execute(1, 100)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.associations.set(
          result.items
            .filter((item) => item.esAsociacion && item.estado)
            .map((item) => ({ value: item.empresaId, label: item.razonSocial, description: item.ruc })),
        ),
        error: () => this.associations.set([]),
      });
  }

  async edit(): Promise<void> {
    const producer = this.detail();
    if (!producer || !producer.estado || this.referencesLoading()) return;
    const result = await this.form.open(this.associations(), producer);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async retire(): Promise<void> {
    const producer = this.detail();
    if (!producer || !producer.estado || this.retiring()) return;
    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Retirar productor',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName(producer)} con la fecha de hoy.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar productor',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.retiring.set(true);
    this.retireUseCase.execute(producer.socioId, this.today(), confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Productor retirado'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo retirar al productor', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  fullName(producer: ProductorDetalle): string {
    return [producer.nombres, producer.apellidoPaterno, producer.apellidoMaterno].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  }

  private today(): string {
    const now = new Date();
    const local = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000);
    return local.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="current() ? editIcon : addIcon" /></span>
        <div><p>Productores</p><h2>{{ current() ? 'Editar productor' : 'Registrar productor' }}</h2></div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" aria-label="Cerrar" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" /></button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) { <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div> }

    <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="save()">
      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Identificación</span></div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerDocumentType">Tipo de documento</label>
        <select id="producerDocumentType" class="admin-select" formControlName="tipoDocumento" [disabled]="!!current()" (change)="onDocumentTypeChange()">
          @for (type of documentTypes; track type.value) { <option [value]="type.value">{{ type.label }}</option> }
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerDocument">Número de documento</label>
        <div class="identity-document-control">
          <input
            id="producerDocument"
            class="admin-input"
            type="text"
            formControlName="numeroDocumento"
            [attr.maxlength]="documentMaxLength()"
            [attr.inputmode]="documentInputMode()"
            autocomplete="off"
            autocapitalize="characters"
            spellcheck="false"
            [readOnly]="saving() || identityLoading() || !!current()"
            (input)="onDocumentInput()"
          />
          @if (shouldResolveIdentity()) {
            <button type="button" class="identity-search-button" [disabled]="!canResolveIdentity()" [attr.aria-busy]="identityLoading()" (click)="resolveIdentity()">
              @if (identityLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> Buscando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" /> Buscar
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>
        <app-form-error
          [control]="form.controls.numeroDocumento"
          fieldLabel="El documento"
          [messages]="{
            dni: 'El DNI debe contener exactamente 8 dígitos.',
            ruc: 'El RUC no es válido. Verifique los 11 dígitos y el dígito verificador.',
            rucNature: 'Para una persona se requiere un RUC personal válido.',
            blank: 'El documento no puede contener solo espacios.'
          }"
        />
        @if (!shouldResolveIdentity()) {
          <small class="identity-help">Los documentos distintos de DNI o RUC se completan manualmente.</small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (identityMessage()) {
        <div
          class="identity-feedback admin-field-span-2"
          [class.identity-feedback--success]="identityTone() === 'success'"
          [class.identity-feedback--warning]="identityTone() === 'warning'"
          [class.identity-feedback--error]="identityTone() === 'error'"
          role="status"
        >
          {{ identityMessage() }}
        </div>
      }

      @if (canToggleIdentityEditing()) {
        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              [checked]="identityEditingEnabled()"
              (change)="toggleIdentityEditing($any($event.target).checked)"
            />
            Editar datos de la persona
          </label>
          <small>El número de documento no se puede modificar.</small>
        </div>
      }

      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerNames">Nombres</label>
        <input id="producerNames" class="admin-input" type="text" maxlength="100" formControlName="nombres" autocomplete="given-name" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('names')"  (input)="sanitizePersonInput('nombres')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.nombres" fieldLabel="Los nombres" [messages]="{ blank: 'Los nombres no pueden contener solo espacios.' }" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerLastName">Apellido paterno</label>

        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.apellidoMaterno" fieldLabel="El apellido materno" />

        <input id="producerBirthDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaNacimiento" autocomplete="bday" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('birthDate')"  [min]="minBirthDate"  [max]="maxBirthDate" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaNacimiento" fieldLabel="La fecha de nacimiento" [messages]="{ futureDate: 'La fecha de nacimiento no puede ser futura.' }" />
      </div>
      @if (resolvedSex()) {
        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="producerSex">Sexo</label>
          <input id="producerSex" class="admin-input" type="text" [value]="resolvedSex()" readonly aria-readonly="true" />
        </div>
      }


      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerPhone">Teléfono</label>
        <input id="producerPhone" class="admin-input" type="tel" maxlength="30" formControlName="telefono" autocomplete="tel" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('phone')"  (input)="sanitizePhoneInput()"  inputmode="tel" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.telefono" fieldLabel="El teléfono" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerEmail">Correo</label>
        <input id="producerEmail" class="admin-input" type="email" maxlength="180" formControlName="correo" autocomplete="email" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('email')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.correo" fieldLabel="El correo" />
      </div>

      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Ubicación</span></div>
      <app-geography-cascade
        [districtCode]="initialDistrictCode()"
        [populationCenterId]="initialPopulationCenterId()"
        [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()"
        [locationLocked]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')"
        (selectionChange)="setGeography($event)"
      />
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.distritoCodigo" fieldLabel="El distrito" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        <label for="producerReference">Referencia de ubicación</label>
        <input id="producerReference" class="admin-input" maxlength="300" formControlName="referencia" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Sector, calle, referencia u otra indicación" [readOnly]="isIdentityFieldReadOnly('reference')" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.referencia" fieldLabel="La referencia" />
      </div>

      <div class="producer-form-section admin-field-span-2"><span>Afiliación</span></div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerRegistrationDate">Fecha de alta</label>
        <input id="producerRegistrationDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaAlta"  [max]="today" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaAlta" fieldLabel="La fecha de alta" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerAssociation">Asociación</label>
        <select id="producerAssociation" class="admin-select" formControlName="asociacionId">
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
          @for (association of associations(); track association.value) { <option [value]="association.value">{{ association.label }}</option> }
        </select>
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.asociacionId" fieldLabel="La asociación" />
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
        @if (current()?.codigoSocio; as partnerCode) {
          <small class="identity-help">Código de socio asignado: {{ partnerCode }}</small>
        } @else {
          <small class="identity-help">
            El código de socio lo genera DESCO automáticamente al registrar la afiliación.
          </small>
        }
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerMembershipDate">Fecha desde</label>
        <input id="producerMembershipDate" class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaDesde"  [max]="today" />
        <app-form-error [control]="form.controls.fechaDesde" fieldLabel="La fecha de afiliación" />
        @if (form.hasError('membershipDateOrder')) {
          <small class="producer-form-error">La fecha de afiliación no puede ser anterior a la fecha de alta.</small>
        }
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field">
        <label for="producerMembershipStatus">Situación de membresía</label>
        <select id="producerMembershipStatus" class="admin-select" formControlName="situacionMembresia">
          @for (membership of memberships; track membership.value) { <option [value]="membership.value">{{ membership.label }}</option> }
        </select>
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || identityLoading() || identityBlocked()">
          @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
          @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>

@Component({

export class ProductorFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly createUseCase = inject(CrearProductorUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarProductorUseCase);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly current = signal<Productor | ProductorDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly associations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly identityLoading = signal(false);
  readonly identityMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityTone = signal<IdentityFeedbackTone>('neutral');
  readonly identityBlocked = signal(false);
  readonly verifiedIdentityKey = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly initialDistrictCode = signal('');
  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly identityLocks = signal<IdentityFieldLocks>(
    emptyIdentityFieldLocks(),
  );
  readonly resolvedSex = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly identityEditingEnabled = signal(false);
  readonly identityRecordLoaded = signal(false);

  readonly addIcon = faUserPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly today = todayLocalIsoDate();
  readonly maxBirthDate = maxBirthDateIso();
  readonly minBirthDate = minBirthDateIso();

  readonly documentTypes: readonly {
    value: TipoDocumentoProductor;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'DNI', label: 'DNI' },
    { value: 'RUC', label: 'RUC de persona natural' },
    { value: 'CE', label: 'Carné de extranjería' },
    { value: 'PASAPORTE', label: 'Pasaporte' },
    { value: 'OTRO', label: 'Otro' },
  ];

  readonly memberships: readonly {
    value: SituacionMembresia;
    label: string;
  }[] = [
    { value: 'ACTIVO', label: 'Activo' },
    { value: 'SUSPENDIDO', label: 'Suspendido' },
  ];

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group(
    {
      tipoDocumento: [
        'DNI' as TipoDocumentoProductor,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
      numeroDocumento: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, dniValidator],
      ],
      nombres: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(100),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoPaterno: [
        '',
        [
          Validators.required,
          notBlankValidator,
          personNameValidator,
          Validators.maxLength(80),
        ],
      ],
      apellidoMaterno: ['', [personNameValidator, Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      telefono: ['', [phoneValidator, Validators.maxLength(30)]],
      correo: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
      fechaNacimiento: ['', [adultBirthDateValidator()]],
      distritoCodigo: [
        '',
        [Validators.required, Validators.pattern(/^\d{6}$/)],
      ],
      centroPobladoId: [0],
      referencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
      fechaAlta: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      asociacionId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      fechaDesde: ['', [Validators.required, notFutureDateValidator]],
      situacionMembresia: [
        'ACTIVO' as SituacionMembresia,
        [Validators.required],
      ],
    },
    {
      validators: [
        dateOrderValidator(
          'fechaAlta',
          'fechaDesde',
          'membershipDateOrder',
        ),
      ],
    },
  );

  open(
    associations: readonly AdminSelectOption[],
    producer: Productor | ProductorDetalle | null = null,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.associations.set(associations);
    this.current.set(producer);
    this.resetIdentityState();
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const detail = producer && 'fechaNacimiento' in producer
      ? (producer as ProductorDetalle)
      : null;
    const today = this.today;
    const type = this.normalizeProducerDocumentType(
      producer?.tipoDocumento,
    );

    this.initialDistrictCode.set(detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
      detail?.centroPobladoId ?? null,
    );

    this.form.reset({
      tipoDocumento: type,
      numeroDocumento: producer?.numeroDocumento ?? '',
      nombres: producer?.nombres ?? '',
      apellidoPaterno: producer?.apellidoPaterno ?? '',
      apellidoMaterno: producer?.apellidoMaterno ?? '',
      telefono: producer?.telefono ?? '',
      correo: producer?.correo ?? '',
      fechaNacimiento: detail?.fechaNacimiento ?? '',
      distritoCodigo: detail?.distritoCodigo ?? '',
      centroPobladoId: detail?.centroPobladoId ?? 0,
      referencia: detail?.referencia ?? '',
      fechaAlta: producer?.fechaAlta ?? today,
      asociacionId:
        producer?.asociacionId ?? associations[0]?.value ?? 0,
      fechaDesde:
        detail?.afiliaciones.find((item) => item.estado)?.fechaDesde
        ?? producer?.fechaAlta
        ?? today,
      situacionMembresia:
        (producer?.situacionMembresia as SituacionMembresia)
        || 'ACTIVO',
    });

    this.form.controls.fechaAlta[
      producer ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.applyDocumentValidators(false);

    if (producer) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);
      this.identityLocks.set({
        names: true,
        paternalSurname: true,
        maternalSurname: true,
        birthDate: true,
        phone: true,
        email: true,
        geography: true,
        reference: true,
      });

      if (type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(type, producer.numeroDocumento),
        );
      }
    }

    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    if (this.isIdentityFieldReadOnly('geography')) {
      this.form.patchValue({
        centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.form.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    control.setValue(
      sanitizeDocument(type, control.value),
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    this.applyDocumentValidators();
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  onDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    const sanitized = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.resetIdentityLookup();

    if (!this.current()) {
      }
  }

  documentMaxLength(): number {
    switch (this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value) {
      case 'DNI':
        return 8;
      case 'RUC':
        return 11;
      default:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  documentInputMode(): 'numeric' | 'text' {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC'
      ? 'numeric'
      : 'text';
  }

  shouldResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    return type === 'DNI' || type === 'RUC';
  }

  canResolveIdentity(): boolean {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const expectedLength = type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11;

    return this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && !this.saving()
      && !this.identityLoading()
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.valid
      && this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value.length
        === expectedLength;
  }

  resolveIdentity(): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;

    if (type !== 'DNI' && type !== 'RUC') {
      return;
    }

    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;
    control.markAsTouched();
    control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (!this.canResolveIdentity()) {
      return;
    }

    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(type, control.value);

    this.identityLoading.set(true);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);

    this.identities
      .resolve('PERSONA', type, documentNumber)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.identityLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.applyPersonIdentity(result, type, documentNumber),
        error: () => {
          this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
            this.identityKey(type, documentNumber),
          );
          this.identityBlocked.set(false);
          this.identityTone.set('warning');
          this.identityMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (!this.current()) {
      }

    this.form.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.form.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.identityLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.current();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const documentNumber = sanitizeDocument(
      raw.tipoDocumento,
      raw.numeroDocumento,
    );

    if (
      this.shouldResolveIdentity()
      && this.verifiedIdentityKey()
        !== this.identityKey(raw.tipoDocumento, documentNumber)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `Valide el ${raw.tipoDocumento} antes de guardar.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.identityBlocked()) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        this.identityMessage()
          || 'No se puede usar esta persona para el socio.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const common = {
      tipoDocumento: raw.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber,
      nombres: normalizeText(sanitizePersonName(raw.nombres)),
      apellidoPaterno: normalizeText(sanitizePersonName(raw.apellidoPaterno)),
      apellidoMaterno: normalizeOptionalText(sanitizePersonName(raw.apellidoMaterno)),
      telefono: normalizeOptionalText(sanitizePhone(raw.telefono)),
      correo: raw.correo.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      fechaNacimiento: raw.fechaNacimiento || undefined,
      asociacionId: Number(raw.asociacionId),
      fechaDesde: raw.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: raw.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: {
        distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
        centroPobladoId:
          Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
            ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
            : undefined,
        referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
      },
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<number | void> = current
      ? this.updateUseCase.execute(current.socioId, common)
      : this.createUseCase.execute({
          ...common,
          fechaAlta: raw.fechaAlta,
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (value) => {
          this.toast.success(
            current
              ? 'Productor actualizado'
              : 'Productor registrado',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value:
              typeof value === 'number'
                ? value
                : current?.socioId ?? null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error(
            current
              ? 'No se pudo actualizar el productor'
              : 'No se pudo registrar el productor',
            message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  sanitizePersonInput(
    field: 'nombres' | 'apellidoPaterno' | 'apellidoMaterno',
  ): void {
    const control = this.form.controls[field];
    const clean = sanitizePersonName(control.value);

    if (clean !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(clean, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  sanitizePhoneInput(): void {
    const control = this.form.controls.telefono;
    const clean = sanitizePhone(control.value);

    if (clean !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(clean, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving() && !this.identityLoading()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  private applyDocumentValidators(
    emitEvent = true,
  ): void {
    const type = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
    const control = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento;

    if (type === 'DNI') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        dniValidator,
      ]);
    } else if (type === 'RUC') {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        rucValidator('NATURAL'),
      ]);
    } else {
      control.setValidators([
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.maxLength(30),
      ]);
    }

    control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }


  private applyPersonIdentity(
    result: IdentityResolution,
    type: 'DNI' | 'RUC',
    documentNumber: string,
  ): void {
    const key = this.identityKey(type, documentNumber);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(key);

    const current = this.current();

    if (
      result.isPartner
      && (!current || result.entityId !== current.socioId)
    ) {
      this.identityBlocked.set(true);
      this.identityTone.set('error');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'Esta persona ya está registrada como socio.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.prefillPerson(result);

    if (result.found) {
      this.identityRecordLoaded.set(true);

      const resolvedType = this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value;
      const resolvedDocument = this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value;

      if (resolvedType === 'DNI' || resolvedType === 'RUC') {
        this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(
          this.identityKey(resolvedType, resolvedDocument),
        );
      }

      this.identityTone.set('success');
      this.identityMessage.set('Datos de la persona cargados.');
      return;
    }

    if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
      this.identityTone.set('warning');
      this.identityMessage.set(
        'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Complete la información manualmente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.identityBlocked.set(true);
    this.identityTone.set('error');
    this.identityMessage.set(
      'No se pudieron obtener los datos de la persona. Intente nuevamente.',
    );
  }

  private prefillPerson(result: IdentityResolution): void {
    const districtCode = result.districtCode?.trim() ?? '';
    const populationCenterId = result.populationCenterId;
    const reference =
      result.locationReference
      ?? result.suggestedFiscalAddress;

    const locks: IdentityFieldLocks = result.found
      ? {
          names: true,
          paternalSurname: true,
          maternalSurname: true,
          birthDate: true,
          phone: true,
          email: true,
          geography: true,
          reference: true,
        }
      : emptyIdentityFieldLocks();

    this.form.patchValue({
      tipoDocumento:
        result.documentType === 'RUC' ? 'RUC' :
        result.documentType === 'DNI' ? 'DNI' :
        this.form.controls.tipoDocumento.value,
      numeroDocumento:
        result.documentNumber?.trim() ||
        this.form.controls.numeroDocumento.value,
      nombres:
        result.names
          ? normalizeText(result.names).slice(0, 100)
          : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
      apellidoPaterno:
        result.paternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.paternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
      apellidoMaterno:
        result.maternalSurname
          ? normalizeText(result.maternalSurname).slice(0, 80)
          : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
      telefono:
        result.phone
          ? sanitizePhone(result.phone).slice(0, 30)
          : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
      correo:
        result.email
          ? result.email.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180)
          : this.form.controls.correo.value,
      fechaNacimiento:
        result.birthDate
          ? result.birthDate
          : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
      distritoCodigo:
        districtCode
          ? districtCode
          : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
      centroPobladoId:
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
      referencia:
        reference
          ? normalizeText(reference).slice(0, 300)
          : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
    });

    this.resolvedSex.set(result.sex?.trim() || null);
    this.identityLocks.set(locks);

    if (districtCode) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set(districtCode);
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(
        populationCenterId && populationCenterId > 0
          ? populationCenterId
          : null,
      );
    }
  }

  canEditIdentityData(): boolean {
    return this.permissions.has('VALIDACIONIDENTIDAD_EDITAR');
  }

  canToggleIdentityEditing(): boolean {
    return this.identityRecordLoaded()
      && this.canEditIdentityData();
  }

  toggleIdentityEditing(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(
      enabled && this.canToggleIdentityEditing(),
    );
  }

  isIdentityFieldReadOnly(
    field: keyof IdentityFieldLocks,
  ): boolean {
    return this.identityLocks()[field]
      && !this.identityEditingEnabled();
  }

  private resetIdentityLookup(): void {
    const locks = this.identityLocks();

    this.form.patchValue(
      {
        nombres: locks.names ? '' : this.form.controls.nombres.value,
        apellidoPaterno:
          locks.paternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoPaterno.value,
        apellidoMaterno:
          locks.maternalSurname
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.apellidoMaterno.value,
        telefono:
          locks.phone ? '' : this.form.controls.telefono.value,
        correo:
          locks.email ? '' : this.form.controls.correo.value,
        fechaNacimiento:
          locks.birthDate
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.fechaNacimiento.value,
        distritoCodigo:
          locks.geography
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.distritoCodigo.value,
        centroPobladoId:
          locks.geography
            ? 0
            : this.form.controls.centroPobladoId.value,
        referencia:
          locks.reference
            ? ''
            : this.form.controls.referencia.value,
      },
      { emitEvent: false },
    );

    if (locks.geography) {
      this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
      this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    }

    this.identityLocks.set(emptyIdentityFieldLocks());
    this.identityEditingEnabled.set(false);
    this.identityRecordLoaded.set(false);
    this.resolvedSex.set(null);
    this.verifiedIdentityKey.set(null);
    this.identityBlocked.set(false);
    this.identityTone.set('neutral');
    this.identityMessage.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private resetIdentityState(): void {
    this.identityLoading.set(false);
    this.resetIdentityLookup();
  }

  private identityKey(
    type: TipoDocumentoProductor,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): string {
    return `${type}:${sanitizeDocument(type, documentNumber)}`;
  }

  private normalizeProducerDocumentType(
    value: string | null | undefined,
  ): TipoDocumentoProductor {
    switch ((value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) {
      case 'RUC':
        return 'RUC';
      case 'CE':
        return 'CE';
      case 'PASAPORTE':
        return 'PASAPORTE';
      case 'OTRO':
        return 'OTRO';
      default:
        return 'DNI';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.resetIdentityState();
  }
}

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUsers,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import {
  PageResult,
  emptyPageResult,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarOrganizacionesUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/organizaciones/application/use-case/listar-organizaciones.use-case';
import { ListarProductoresUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-productores.use-case';
import { ObtenerProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-productor.use-case';
import { RetirarProductorUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/retirar-productor.use-case';
import { Productor } from '../../../../../domain/productor.model';
import { ProductorFormComponent } from '../productor-form/productor-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productores-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductorFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productores-list.html',
  styleUrl: './productores-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoresListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductorFormComponent)
  private form!: ProductorFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarProductoresUseCase);
  private readonly retireUseCase = inject(RetirarProductorUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerProductorUseCase);
  private readonly organizationsUseCase = inject(ListarOrganizacionesUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly retiringId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly editingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<Productor>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly associations = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);

  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly associationFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly situationFilter = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faUsers;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly retireIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadAssociations();
    this.load(1);
  }

  loadAssociations(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    this.organizationsUseCase
      .execute(1, 100)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) =>
          this.associations.set(
            result.items
              .filter(
                (organization) =>
                  organization.esAsociacion && organization.estado,
              )
              .map((association) => ({
                value: association.empresaId,
                label: association.razonSocial,
                description: association.ruc,
              })),
          ),
        error: () => this.associations.set([]),
      });
  }

  load(
    page = this.result().page,
    size = this.result().size,
  ): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        buscar: this.search().trim() || undefined,
        asociacionId: this.associationFilter() ?? undefined,
        situacion: this.situationFilter() || undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  submitSearch(): void {
    this.load(1);
  }

  clearSearch(): void {
    this.search.set('');
    this.load(1);
  }

  changeAssociation(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);

    this.associationFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null,
    );

    this.load(1);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.open(this.associations());

    if (result.saved) {
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  edit(producer: Productor): void {
    if (!producer.estado || this.editingId()) {
      return;
    }

    this.editingId.set(producer.socioId);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(producer.socioId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.editingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: async (detail) => {
          const result = await this.form.open(
            this.associations(),
            detail,
          );

          if (result.saved) {
            this.load();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo abrir el productor',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async retire(producer: Productor): Promise<void> {
    if (!producer.estado || this.retiringId()) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Retirar productor',
      message: `Se registrará el retiro de ${this.fullName(
        producer,
      )} con la fecha de hoy.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Retirar productor',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo del retiro.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });

    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) {
      return;
    }

    this.retiringId.set(producer.socioId);

    this.retireUseCase
      .execute(
        producer.socioId,
        this.today(),
        confirmation.reason,
      )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.retiringId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Productor retirado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo retirar al productor',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  fullName(producer: Productor): string {
    return [
      producer.nombres,
      producer.apellidoPaterno,
      producer.apellidoMaterno,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ');
  }

  private today(): string {
    const now = new Date();
    const local = new Date(
      now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000,
    );

    return local.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  ProducerCreateRequest,
  ProducerRetireRequest,
  ProducerUpdateRequest,
  ProductoresService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { ProductoresGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/productores.gateway';
import { ProductorFiltro } from '../../../domain/productor-filtro.model';
import { ProductorCreate, ProductorUpdate } from '../../../domain/productor.model';
import { ProductoresHttpMapper } from './productores-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ProductoresHttpAdapter implements ProductoresGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(ProductoresService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(ProductoresHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: ProductorFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .productoresListar(
        {
          buscar: filter.buscar,
          asociacionId: filter.asociacionId,
          situacion: filter.situacion,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .productoresVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  create(input: ProductorCreate) {
    const producerCreateRequest: ProducerCreateRequest = {
      tipoDocumento: input.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: input.numeroDocumento,
      nombres: input.nombres,
      apellidoPaterno: input.apellidoPaterno,
      apellidoMaterno: input.apellidoMaterno,
      telefono: input.telefono,
      correo: input.correo,
      fechaNacimiento: input.fechaNacimiento,
      fechaAlta: input.fechaAlta,
      asociacionId: input.asociacionId,
      fechaDesde: input.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: input.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: { ...input.ubicacion },
    };

    return this.api
      .productoresCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          producerCreateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: ProductorUpdate) {
    const producerUpdateRequest: ProducerUpdateRequest = {
      tipoDocumento: input.tipoDocumento,
      numeroDocumento: input.numeroDocumento,
      nombres: input.nombres,
      apellidoPaterno: input.apellidoPaterno,
      apellidoMaterno: input.apellidoMaterno,
      telefono: input.telefono,
      correo: input.correo,
      fechaNacimiento: input.fechaNacimiento,
      asociacionId: input.asociacionId,
      fechaDesde: input.fechaDesde,
      situacionMembresia: input.situacionMembresia,
      ubicacion: { ...input.ubicacion },
    };

    return this.api
      .productoresEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          producerUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  retire(id: number, fechaRetiro: string, motivo: string) {
    const producerRetireRequest: ProducerRetireRequest = { fechaRetiro, motivo };

    return this.api
      .productoresRetirar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          producerRetireRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

}
```
