```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-api.mapper';
import {
  ProductorAfiliacion,
  ProductorCampania,
  ProductorDetalle,
  ProductorPredio,
} from '../../../domain/productor-detalle.model';
import { Productor } from '../../../domain/productor.model';

@Injectable()
export class ProductoresHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.summary(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): ProductorDetalle {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    const memberships = this.api
      .array(row['afiliaciones'])
      .map((item) => this.membership(this.api.record(item)));
    const currentMembership =
      memberships.find((item) => item.estado && !item.fechaHasta) ??
      memberships.find((item) => item.estado) ??
      memberships[0] ??
      null;

    return {
      ...this.summary(row),
      socioAsociacionId: currentMembership?.socioAsociacionId ?? null,
      asociacionId: currentMembership?.asociacionId ?? null,
      codigoSocio: currentMembership?.codigoSocio ?? null,
      situacionMembresia: currentMembership?.situacionMembresia ?? null,
      asociacionNombre: currentMembership?.asociacionNombre ?? null,
      fechaNacimiento: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaNacimiento']),
      distritoCodigo: this.api.string(row['distritoCodigo']),
      distritoNombre: this.api.nullableString(row['distritoNombre']),
      centroPobladoId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['centroPobladoId']),
      centroPobladoNombre: this.api.nullableString(row['centroPobladoNombre']),
      referencia: this.api.nullableString(row['referencia']),
      afiliaciones: memberships,
      predios: this.api.array(row['predios']).map((item) => this.property(this.api.record(item))),
      campanias: this.api.array(row['campanias']).map((item) => this.campaign(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(row['socioId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void { this.api.void(response); }

  private summary(row: Record<string, unknown>): Productor {
    return {
      socioId: this.api.number(row['socioId']),
      tipoDocumento: this.api.string(row['tipoDocumento']),
      numeroDocumento: this.api.string(row['numeroDocumento']),
      nombres: this.api.string(row['nombres']),
      apellidoPaterno: this.api.string(row['apellidoPaterno']),
      apellidoMaterno: this.api.nullableString(row['apellidoMaterno']),
      telefono: this.api.nullableString(row['telefono']),
      correo: this.api.nullableString(row['correo']),
      fechaAlta: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaAlta']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      socioAsociacionId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['socioAsociacionId']),
      asociacionId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['asociacionId']),
      codigoSocio: this.api.nullableString(row['codigoSocio']),
      situacionMembresia: this.api.nullableString(row['situacionMembresia']),
      asociacionNombre: this.api.nullableString(row['asociacionNombre']),
    };
  }

  private membership(row: Record<string, unknown>): ProductorAfiliacion {
    return {
      socioAsociacionId: this.api.number(row['socioAsociacionId']),
      asociacionId: this.api.number(row['asociacionId']),
      asociacionNombre: this.api.string(row['asociacionNombre']),
      codigoSocio: this.api.string(row['codigoSocio']),
      fechaDesde: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaDesde']),
      fechaHasta: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaHasta']),
      situacionMembresia: this.api.string(row['situacionMembresia']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
    };
  }

  private property(row: Record<string, unknown>): ProductorPredio {
    return {
      predioId: this.api.number(row['predioId']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      fechaRegistro: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaRegistro']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      tipoTitularidad: this.api.nullableString(row['tipoTitularidad']),
      porcentaje: this.api.nullableNumber(row['porcentaje']),
      fechaDesde: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaDesde']),
      fechaHasta: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaHasta']),
    };
  }

  private campaign(row: Record<string, unknown>): ProductorCampania {
    return {
      participacionCampaniaSocioId: this.api.number(row['participacionCampaniaSocioId']),
      campaniaVentaId: this.api.number(row['campaniaVentaId']),
      codigo: this.api.string(row['codigo']),
      nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
      fechaInicio: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaInicio']),
      fechaFin: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaFin']),
      estadoProceso: this.api.string(row['estadoProceso']),
      estadoParticipacion: this.api.string(row['estadoParticipacion']),
      fechaRegistro: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaRegistro']),
    };
  }
}
```

import { InjectionToken } from '@angular/core';

import { Provider } from '@angular/core';
import { PRODUCTORES_GATEWAY } from './application/port/out/productores.gateway';
import { CrearProductorUseCase } from './application/use-case/crear-productor.use-case';
import { EditarProductorUseCase } from './application/use-case/editar-productor.use-case';
import { ListarProductoresUseCase } from './application/use-case/listar-productores.use-case';
import { ObtenerProductorUseCase } from './application/use-case/obtener-productor.use-case';
import { RetirarProductorUseCase } from './application/use-case/retirar-productor.use-case';
import { ProductoresHttpAdapter } from './adapter/out/http/productores-http.adapter';
import { ProductoresHttpMapper } from './adapter/out/http/productores-http.mapper';

export function provideProductores(): Provider[] {
  return [
    ProductoresHttpMapper,
    ProductoresHttpAdapter,
    { provide: PRODUCTORES_GATEWAY, useExisting: ProductoresHttpAdapter },
    ListarProductoresUseCase,
    ObtenerProductorUseCase,
    CrearProductorUseCase,
    EditarProductorUseCase,
    RetirarProductorUseCase,
  ];
}

import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faFloppyDisk, faPen, faPlus, faRoute, faTrashCan, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { localDateTimeInputNow, normalizeOptionalText, notPastDateTimeValidator, optionalNotBlankValidator } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { AdminModalResult, AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ListarEmpleadosUseCase } from '../../../../../../../administracion/empleados/application/use-case/listar-empleados.use-case';
import { EditarSalidaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-salida.use-case';
import { ProgramarSalidaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/programar-salida.use-case';
import { SalidaDetalle } from '../../../../../domain/salida-campo.model';
import { SalidaParticipanteInput } from '../../../../../domain/salida-participante.model';
interface ParticipantRow extends SalidaParticipanteInput {
    label: string;
}
@Component({ selector: 'app-salida-form', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent], templateUrl: './salida-form.html', styleUrl: './salida-form.css', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })
export class SalidaFormComponent {
    @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
    private dialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;
    private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
    private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
    private readonly employeesUseCase = inject(ListarEmpleadosUseCase);
    private readonly program = inject(ProgramarSalidaUseCase);
    private readonly update = inject(EditarSalidaUseCase);
    private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
    readonly saving = signal(false);
    readonly refsLoading = signal(false);
    readonly current = signal<SalidaDetalle | null>(null);
    readonly motives = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly employees = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
    readonly participants = signal<readonly ParticipantRow[]>([]);
    readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
    private resolver: ((r: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;
    readonly pageIcon = faRoute;
    readonly editIcon = faPen;
    readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
    readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
    readonly addIcon = faPlus;
    readonly deleteIcon = faTrashCan;
    readonly minimumScheduleDateTime = localDateTimeInputNow();
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      motivoSalidaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      fechaHoraProgramada: ['', [Validators.required, notPastDateTimeValidator]],
      descripcion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(400)]],
      empleadoId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      funcion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(120)]],
      esResponsable: [false],
    });
    open(detail: SalidaDetalle | null = null) { this.current.set(detail); this.error.set(null); this.participants.set(detail?.participantes.filter(x => x.estado).map(x => ({ empleadoId: x.empleadoId, funcion: x.funcion ?? undefined, esResponsable: x.esResponsable, label: this.personName(x) })) ?? []); this.form.reset({ motivoSalidaId: detail?.salida.motivoSalidaId ?? 0, fechaHoraProgramada: this.toLocal(detail?.salida.fechaHoraProgramada), descripcion: detail?.salida.descripcion ?? '', empleadoId: 0, funcion: '', esResponsable: false }); this.loadReferences(); this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise<AdminModalResult>(r => this.resolver = r); }
    close() { if (!this.saving())
        this.finish({ saved: false, value: null }); }
    addParticipant() {
        const v = this.form.getRawValue();
        const id = Number(v.empleadoId);

        if (!id) {
            this.error.set('Seleccione un empleado.');
            return;
        }

        if (this.participants().some(x => x.empleadoId === id)) {
            this.error.set('El empleado ya forma parte de la salida.');
            return;
        }

        const option = this.employees().find(x => x.value === id);
        const currentRows = v.esResponsable
            ? this.participants().map(item => ({ ...item, esResponsable: false }))
            : this.participants();

        this.participants.set([
            ...currentRows,
            {
                empleadoId: id,
                funcion: normalizeOptionalText(v.funcion),
                esResponsable: v.esResponsable,
                label: option?.label ?? `Empleado ${id}`,
            },
        ]);
        this.form.patchValue({ empleadoId: 0, funcion: '', esResponsable: false });
        this.error.set(null);
    }
    removeParticipant(index: number) { this.participants.set(this.participants().filter((_, i) => i !== index)); }
    save() { this.form.markAllAsTouched(); const v = this.form.getRawValue(); if (this.form.invalid || this.saving())
        return; if (this.participants().length === 0) {
        this.error.set('Agrega al menos un participante.');
        return;
    }
    if (this.participants().filter(item => item.esResponsable).length !== 1) {
        this.error.set('Seleccione exactamente un responsable para la salida.');
        return;
    }
    const input = {
        motivoSalidaId: Number(v.motivoSalidaId),
        fechaHoraProgramada: new Date(v.fechaHoraProgramada).toISOString(),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(v.descripcion),
        participantes: this.participants().map(({ label, ...participant }) => ({
            ...participant,
            funcion: participant.funcion?.trim() || undefined,
        })),
    }; this.saving.set(true); this.error.set(null); const op: Observable<unknown> = this.current() ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.salida.salidaCampoId, input) : this.program.execute(input); op.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success(this.current() ? 'Salida actualizada' : 'Salida programada'); this.finish({ saved: true, value: null }); }, error: e => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(e).message) }); }
    private loadReferences() { this.refsLoading.set(true); let pending = 2; const done = () => { pending--; if (pending === 0)
        this.refsLoading.set(false); }; this.refs.catalog('MOTIVO_SALIDA').subscribe({ next: r => { this.motives.set(r.map(x => ({ value: Number(x.id), label: x.label, description: x.code }))); if (!this.current() && this.motives()[0])
            this.form.patchValue({ motivoSalidaId: this.motives()[0].value }); done(); }, error: () => { this.motives.set([]); done(); } }); this.employeesUseCase.execute({ activo: true, page: 1, size: 200 }).subscribe({ next: r => { this.employees.set(r.items.map(x => ({ value: x.empleadoId, label: [x.nombres, x.apellidoPaterno, x.apellidoMaterno].filter(Boolean).join(' '), description: x.cargo || x.area }))); done(); }, error: () => { this.employees.set([]); done(); } }); }
    private personName(x: {
        nombres: string;
        apellidoPaterno: string;
        apellidoMaterno: string | null;
    }) { return [x.nombres, x.apellidoPaterno, x.apellidoMaterno].filter(Boolean).join(' '); }
    private toLocal(value: string | null | undefined) { const d = value ? new Date(value) : new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000); const off = d.getTimezoneOffset(); return new Date(d.getTime() - off * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16); }
    private finish(r: AdminModalResult) { if (this.dialog.nativeElement.open)
        this.dialog.nativeElement.close(); this.resolver?.(r); this.resolver = null; this.current.set(null); this.error.set(null); }
}

export class SalidasHttpAdapter implements SalidasGateway{private readonly api=inject(SalidasDeCampoService);private readonly mapper=inject(SalidasHttpMapper);private readonly idem=inject(IdempotencyKeyService);list(f:SalidaFiltro){return this.api.salidasListar({estadoProceso:f.estadoProceso,motivoSalidaId:f.motivoSalidaId,fechaDesde:f.fechaDesde,fechaHasta:f.fechaHasta,pagina:f.page,tamano:f.size},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.page(r,f.size)));}get(id:number){return this.api.salidasProgramar({xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),fieldTripProgramRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.created(r)));}update(id:number,i:SalidaInput){const fieldTripUpdateRequest:FieldTripUpdateRequest={...i,participantes:i.participantes.map(v=>({...v}))};return fieldTripFinishRequest:FieldTripFinishRequest={fechaHoraRetornoReal,motivo};return this.api.salidasFinalizar({id,xIdempotencyKey:this.idem.create(),fieldTripFinishRequest},'body',false,{transferCache:false}).pipe(map(r=>this.mapper.void(r)));}}

export class CasoSanitarioFormComponent {

    readonly maximumDateTime = localDateTimeInputNow();
    readonly severities = ['BAJA', 'MEDIA', 'ALTA'] as const;
    readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ parcelaCultivoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], tipoProblemaId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], visitaDeteccionId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]], fechaDeteccion: [this.maximumDateTime, [Validators.required, notFutureDateTimeValidator]], plantasAfectadas: [0, [nonNegativeIntegerValidator]], cantidadEstimada: [false], severidad: ['BAJA', Validators.required], observacion: ['', [optionalNotBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(500)]] });
    open(current: CasoSanitarioCabecera | null = null) { this.current.set(current); this.error.set(null); this.form.reset({ parcelaCultivoId: current?.parcelaCultivoId ?? 0, tipoProblemaId: current?.tipoProblemaId ?? 0, visitaDeteccionId: current?.visitaDeteccionId ?? 0, fechaDeteccion: current?.fechaDeteccion ? this.toLocal(current.fechaDeteccion) : this.maximumDateTime, plantasAfectadas: current?.plantasAfectadas ?? 0, cantidadEstimada: current?.cantidadEstimada ?? false, severidad: current?.severidad ?? 'BAJA', observacion: current?.observacion ?? '' }); this.loadReferences(); this.dialog.nativeElement.showModal(); return new Promise<AdminModalResult>(r => this.resolver = r); }
    close() { if (!this.saving())

        return; const v = this.form.getRawValue(), common = { tipoProblemaId: Number(v.tipoProblemaId), plantasAfectadas: Number(v.plantasAfectadas) >= 0 ? Number(v.plantasAfectadas) : undefined, cantidadEstimada: v.cantidadEstimada, severidad: v.severidad, observacion: normalizeOptionalText(v.observacion) }; this.saving.set(true); this.error.set(null); const op: Observable<unknown> = this.current() ? this.update.execute(this.current()!.casoFitosanitarioId, common) : this.create.execute({ ...common, parcelaCultivoId: Number(v.parcelaCultivoId), visitaDeteccionId: Number(v.visitaDeteccionId), fechaDeteccion: new Date(v.fechaDeteccion).toISOString() }); op.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({ next: () => { this.toast.success(this.current() ?             this.form.patchValue({ tipoProblemaId: this.problems()[0].value }); done(); }, error: () => { this.problems.set([]); done(); } }); this.cropsUseCase.execute({ situacionCultivo: 'ACTIVO', page: 1, size: 200 }).subscribe({ next: r => { this.crops.set(r.items.filter(x => x.parcelaCultivoId != null).map(x => ({ value: x.parcelaCultivoId!, label: `${x.parcelaNombre} · ${x.variedad ?? 'Cultivo'}`, description: x.predioNombre }))); if (!this.current() && this.crops()[0])
            this.form.patchValue({ parcelaCultivoId: this.crops()[0].value }); done(); }, error: () => { this.crops.set([]); done(); } }); this.visitsUseCase.execute({ page: 1, size: 200 }).subscribe({ next: r => { this.visits.set(r.items.filter(x => x.estadoProceso === 'EN_CURSO').map(x => ({ value: x.visitaTecnicaId, label: `${x.predio} · ${x.tecnico}`, description: x.estadoProceso }))); if (!this.current() && this.visits()[0])
            this.form.patchValue({ visitaDeteccionId: this.visits()[0].value }); done(); }, error: () => { this.visits.set([]); done(); } }); }

<div class="desco-page"><app-page-header title="Detalle de visita" subtitle="Seguimiento técnico, ubicación, evaluaciones y evidencias." eyebrow="Visita técnica" [icon]="pageIcon"><div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/gestion-tecnica/visitas"><fa-icon [icon]="backIcon"/> Volver</a><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()"><fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon"/> Actualizar</button>@if(detail();as d){<button *appPermission="'VISITAS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="d.visita.estadoProceso!=='EN_CURSO'" (click)="openEdit()"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon"/> Editar</button><button *appPermission="'VISITAS_CONFIRMAR'" type="button" class="admin-success-button" [disabled]="d.visita.estadoProceso!=='EN_CURSO'||saving()" (click)="openFinish()"><fa-icon [icon]="finishIcon"/> Finalizar</button><button *appPermission="'VISITAS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-danger-button" [disabled]="d.visita.estadoProceso!=='EN_CURSO'||saving()" (click)="annulVisit()"><fa-icon [icon]="annulIcon"/> Anular</button>}</div></app-page-header><div class="mt-5">@if(loading()){<app-loading-state title="Cargando visita" message="Consultando la atención técnica."/>}@else if(error()){<app-error-state [message]="error()||'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="load()"/>}@else if(detail();as d){<section class="admin-detail-grid"><article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Predio</span><strong>{{d.visita.predio}}</strong></article><article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Técnico</span><strong>{{d.visita.tecnico}}</strong></article><article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Inicio</span><strong>{{d.visita.fechaHoraInicio|date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'}}</strong></article><article class="admin-detail-card"><span>Estado</span><strong>{{d.visita.estadoProceso}}</strong></article></section><div class="visit-detail-two mt-4"><section class="admin-surface"><div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Atención</p><h2>Objetivo y resultado</h2></div></div><div class="visit-copy"><div><span>Objetivo</span><p>{{d.visita.objetivo}}</p></div><div><span>Resumen</span><p>{{d.resumen||'—'}}</p></div><div><span>Recomendaciones</span><p>{{d.recomendaciones||'—'}}</p></div></div></section>@if(d.visita.latitud!==null&&d.visita.longitud!==null){<app-predio-map [latitude]="d.visita.latitud" [longitude]="d.visita.longitud" height="17rem"/>}</div><section class="admin-surface mt-4"><div class="admin-section-header"><div><p>Evaluaciones</p><h2>Evaluaciones registradas</h2></div><span class="admin-count-badge">{{d.evaluaciones.length}}</span></div><div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Tipo</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Resultado</th><th>Materia seca</th></tr></thead><tbody>@for(e of d.evaluaciones;track e.evaluacionAgronomicaId){<tr><td>{{e.tipoEvaluacion}}</td><td>{{e.fechaHora|date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'}}</td><td>{{e.resultado}}</td><td>{{e.porcentajeMateriaSeca!==null?(e.porcentajeMateriaSeca+' %'):'—'}}</td></tr>}@empty{<tr><td colspan="4" class="admin-table-empty">Sin evaluaciones.</td></tr>}</tbody></table></div></section><section class="mt-4"><app-evidence-panel [context]="{tipo:'VISITA',id:d.visita.visitaTecnicaId}"/></section>}</div></div>
<dialog #editDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault();closeDialog(editDialog)"><div class="modal-box admin-modal-box"><header class="admin-modal-header"><div class="admin-modal-title-group"><span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon"/></span><div><p>Visita</p><h2>Editar información</h2></div></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="closeDialog(editDialog)"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon"/></button></header>@if(modalError()){<div class="admin-inline-error">{{modalError()}}</div>}<form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="editForm" (ngSubmit)="saveEdit()"><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Objetivo</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" formControlName="objetivo" maxlength="250"></textarea></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Resumen</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" formControlName="resumen" maxlength="600"></textarea></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Recomendaciones</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" formControlName="recomendaciones" maxlength="600"></textarea></div><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="closeDialog(editDialog)">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">@if(saving()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando...}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon"/> Guardar}</button></footer></form></div></dialog>
<dialog #finishDialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault();closeDialog(finishDialog)"><div class="modal-box admin-modal-box"><header class="admin-modal-header"><div class="admin-modal-title-group"><span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="finishIcon"/></span><div><p>Visita</p><h2>Finalizar visita</h2></div></div><button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="closeDialog(finishDialog)"><fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon"/></button></header>@if(modalError()){<div class="admin-inline-error">{{modalError()}}</div>}<form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="finishForm" (ngSubmit)="saveFinish()"><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Fecha y hora de fin</label><input type="datetime-local" class="admin-input" formControlName="fechaHoraFin" [max]="maximumDateTime" /></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Resumen</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" formControlName="resumen" maxlength="600"></textarea></div><div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2"><label>Recomendaciones</label><textarea class="admin-textarea" rows="3" formControlName="recomendaciones" maxlength="600"></textarea></div><footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="closeDialog(finishDialog)">Cancelar</button><button type="submit" class="admin-success-button" [disabled]="saving()">@if(saving()){<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Finalizando...}@else{<fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon"/> Finalizar}</button></footer></form></div></dialog><app-action-confirm-dialog/>

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  VisitAnnulRequest,
  VisitFinishRequest,
  VisitStartRequest,
  VisitUpdateRequest,
  VisitasTcnicasService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { VisitasGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/visitas.gateway';
import { VisitaFiltro } from '../../../domain/visita-filtro.model';
import { VisitaStart, VisitaUpdate } from '../../../domain/visita-tecnica.model';
import { VisitasHttpMapper } from './visitas-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class VisitasHttpAdapter implements VisitasGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(VisitasTcnicasService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(VisitasHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: VisitaFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .visitasListar(
        {
          predioId: filter.predioId,
          empleadoId: filter.empleadoId,
          salidaCampoId: filter.salidaCampoId,
          estadoProceso: filter.estadoProceso,
          fechaDesde: filter.fechaDesde,
          fechaHasta: filter.fechaHasta,
          buscar: filter.buscar,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .visitasVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  start(input: VisitaStart) {
    const visitStartRequest: VisitStartRequest = input;
    return this.api
      .visitasIniciar(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          visitStartRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.created(response)));
  }

  update(id: number, input: VisitaUpdate) {
    const visitUpdateRequest: VisitUpdateRequest = input;
    return this.api
      .visitasEditar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          visitUpdateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  finish(
    id: number,
    fechaHoraFin: string,
    resumen: string,
    recomendaciones: string,
  ) {
    const visitFinishRequest: VisitFinishRequest = {
      fechaHoraFin,
      resumen,
      recomendaciones,
    };

    return this.api
      .visitasFinalizar(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          visitFinishRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }

  annul(id: number, motivo: string, fechaHoraFin: string) {
    const visitAnnulRequest: VisitAnnulRequest = {
      motivo,
      fechaHoraFin,
    };

    return this.api
      .visitasAnular(
        {
          id,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          visitAnnulRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response)));
  }
}

import { InjectionToken } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { PageResult } from '../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';

} from '../../../domain/visita-tecnica.model';

export interface VisitasGateway {
  list(filter: VisitaFiltro): Observable<PageResult<VisitaTecnica>>;
  get(id: number): Observable<VisitaDetalle>;
  start(input: VisitaStart): Observable<number>;
  update(id: number, input: VisitaUpdate): Observable<void>;
  finish(
    id: number,
    fechaHoraFin: string,
    resumen: string,
    recomendaciones: string,
  ): Observable<void>;
  annul(id: number, motivo: string, fechaHoraFin: string): Observable<void>;
}

export const VISITAS_GATEWAY = new InjectionToken<VisitasGateway>(
  'VISITAS_GATEWAY',
);

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/inicio/adapter/in/ui/components/alertas-panel/alertas-panel.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBell,
  faCircleExclamation,
  faCircleInfo,
  faClock,
  faTriangleExclamation,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { AlertaDashboard } from '../../../../../domain/alerta.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-alertas-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './alertas-panel.html',
  styleUrl: './alertas-panel.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlertasPanelComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) alertas: readonly AlertaDashboard[] = [];

  readonly bellIcon = faBell;

  iconFor(type: string) {
    const normalized = type.toUpperCase();

    if (normalized.includes('ERROR') || normalized.includes('CRIT')) {
      return faCircleExclamation;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('WARN') || normalized.includes('ALERTA')) {
      return faTriangleExclamation;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('PEND') || normalized.includes('VENC')) {
      return faClock;
    }

    return faCircleInfo;
  }

  toneClass(type: string): string {
    const normalized = type.toUpperCase();

    if (normalized.includes('ERROR') || normalized.includes('CRIT')) {
      return 'alert-tone-error';
    }

    if (normalized.includes('WARN') || normalized.includes('ALERTA')) {
      return 'alert-tone-warning';
    }

    return 'alert-tone-info';
  }
}
```

:host {

}

.section-heading {
  display: flex;

  letter-spacing: -0.02em;

  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.35rem;

.section-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.5rem;

  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.charts-grid {
  display: grid;
  width: 100%;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.chart-slot {
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

/*
 * Regla de composición:
 * - En escritorio siempre se muestran 2 gráficos por fila.
 * - Si la cantidad es impar, únicamente el último ocupa toda la fila.
 * - No se utiliza grafico.ancho para evitar que la configuración recibida
 *   fuerce cada tarjeta a una fila independiente.
 */
.charts-grid > .chart-slot:last-child:nth-child(odd) {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.empty-panel {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  border: 1px dashed var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .charts-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .charts-grid > .chart-slot:last-child:nth-child(odd) {
    grid-column: auto;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  inject,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faChartArea,
  faChartColumn,
  faChartLine,
  faChartPie,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { ChartCardComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/charts/chart-card/chart-card';
import { ChartCardData } from '../../../../../../../shared/charts/chart-card/chart-card.types';
import { ChartPresetsService } from '../../../../../../../shared/charts/chart-presets.service';
import {
  DashboardChart,
  DashboardChartSeries,
} from '../../../../../domain/grafico-dashboard.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-graficos-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ChartCardComponent, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './graficos-panel.html',
  styleUrl: './graficos-panel.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class GraficosPanelComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) graficos: readonly DashboardChart[] = [];

  private readonly presets = inject(ChartPresetsService);

  readonly sectionIcon = faChartArea;

  chartData(graph: DashboardChart): ChartCardData {
    const categories = this.categories(graph.series);
    const axisSeries = graph.series.map((series) => ({
      name: series.nombre,
      data: categories.map((category) => this.valueFor(series, category)),
    }));
    const primarySeries = graph.series[0];
    const primaryValues = categories.map((category) =>
      primarySeries ? this.valueFor(primarySeries, category) : 0,
    );

    const options =
      graph.tipoGrafico === 'LINE'
        ? this.presets.line(axisSeries, categories)
        : graph.tipoGrafico === 'AREA'
          ? this.presets.area(axisSeries, categories)
          : graph.tipoGrafico === 'COLUMN'
            ? this.presets.column(axisSeries, categories)
            : graph.tipoGrafico === 'DONUT'
              ? this.presets.donut(primaryValues, categories)
              : this.presets.bar(axisSeries, categories);

    return {
      title: graph.titulo,
      subtitle:
        graph.subtitulo ||
        (graph.unidad ? `Unidad: ${graph.unidad}` : undefined),
      icon: this.iconFor(graph.tipoGrafico),
      options,
      empty: categories.length === 0,
      emptyMessage: 'No existen datos en el periodo seleccionado.',
    };
  }

  private categories(
    series: readonly DashboardChartSeries[],
  ): readonly string[] {
    const values = new Map<string, number>();

    for (const item of series) {
      for (const point of item.puntos) {
        const current = values.get(point.categoria);

        if (current === undefined || point.orden < current) {
          values.set(point.categoria, point.orden);
        }
      }
    }

    return [...values.entries()]
      .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
      .map(([category]) => category);
  }

  private valueFor(
    series: DashboardChartSeries,
    category: string,
  ): number {
    return (
      series.puntos.find((point) => point.categoria === category)?.valor ?? 0
    );
  }

  private iconFor(type: DashboardChart['tipoGrafico']) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'LINE':
        return faChartLine;
      case 'AREA':
        return faChartArea;
      case 'DONUT':
        return faChartPie;
      default:
        return faChartColumn;
    }
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/inicio/adapter/in/ui/components/indicadores-panel/indicadores-panel.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBuildingWheat,
  faCalendarCheck,
  faChartColumn,
  faClipboardCheck,
  faCoins,
  faLeaf,
  faMoneyBillTransfer,
  faRoute,
  faSeedling,
  faTruck,
  faUserGroup,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { KpiCardComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/kpi-card/kpi-card';
import { KpiCardData } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/kpi-card/kpi-card.model';
import { Indicador } from '../../../../../domain/indicador.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-indicadores-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [KpiCardComponent, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './indicadores-panel.html',
  styleUrl: './indicadores-panel.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class IndicadoresPanelComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) indicadores: readonly Indicador[] = [];

  readonly chartIcon = faChartColumn;

  kpis(): readonly KpiCardData[] {
    return this.indicadores.map((indicator, index) => ({
      label: indicator.indicador,
      value: indicator.valor,
      description: this.description(indicator),
      icon: this.iconFor(indicator.codigo, indicator.indicador),
      tone:
        index % 4 === 1
          ? 'sky'
          : index % 4 === 2
            ? 'indigo'
            : index % 4 === 3
              ? 'slate'
              : 'blue',
    }));
  }

  private description(indicator: Indicador): string | undefined {
    if (!indicator.unidad) {
      return undefined;
    }

    if (indicator.unidad.toUpperCase() === 'PEN') {
      return 'Importe en soles';
    }

    return indicator.unidad;
  }

  private iconFor(code: string, label: string): IconDefinition {
    const normalized = `${code} ${label}`.toLowerCase();

    if (normalized.includes('productor') || normalized.includes('socio')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('predio') || normalized.includes('parcela')) {
      return faBuildingWheat;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('cultivo') || normalized.includes('produccion')) {
      return faSeedling;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('sanitar') || normalized.includes('caso')) {
      return faLeaf;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('salida') || normalized.includes('visita')) {
      return faRoute;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('campania') || normalized.includes('operativo')) {
      return faCalendarCheck;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('jaba') || normalized.includes('inventario')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('entrega') || normalized.includes('vehiculo')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('pago') ||
      normalized.includes('cobro') ||
      normalized.includes('saldo')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('gasto') ||
      normalized.includes('liquidacion') ||
      normalized.includes('importe')
    ) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    return faClipboardCheck;
  }
}

import {

  Component,
  OnInit,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBuilding,
  faCalendarDays,
  faChartLine,
  faCoins,
  faFileLines,
  faFilter,
  faGaugeHigh,
  faLeaf,
  faLocationDot,
  faMoneyBillTransfer,
  faSeedling,
  faTruck,
  faUserGroup,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ObtenerDashboardUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-dashboard.use-case';
import { AccesoRapido } from '../../../../../domain/acceso-rapido.model';
import { Dashboard, EMPTY_DASHBOARD } from '../../../../../domain/dashboard.model';
import { DashboardFilter } from '../../../../../domain/dashboard-filter.model';
import { AlertasPanelComponent } from '../../components/alertas-panel/alertas-panel';
import { GraficosPanelComponent } from '../../components/graficos-panel/graficos-panel';
import { IndicadoresPanelComponent } from '../../components/indicadores-panel/indicadores-panel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inicio-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    AlertasPanelComponent,
    IndicadoresPanelComponent,
    GraficosPanelComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './inicio.html',
  styleUrl: './inicio.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class InicioPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly useCase = inject(ObtenerDashboardUseCase);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly dashboard = signal<Dashboard>(EMPTY_DASHBOARD);

  readonly dashboardIcon = faGaugeHigh;
  readonly filterIcon = faFilter;
  readonly resetIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;

  readonly today = this.localIsoDate(new Date());
  readonly desde = signal(this.offsetDate(-89));
  readonly hasta = signal(this.today);

  readonly greeting = computed(() => {
    const user = this.access.user();
    const firstName = user?.nombres?.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

    return firstName ? `Hola, ${firstName}` : 'Dashboard';
  });

  readonly primaryRole = computed(
    () => this.access.roles()[0]?.nombre ?? 'Perfil autorizado',
  );

  readonly relatedAccesses = computed<readonly AccesoRapido[]>(() =>
    this.dashboard().accesosRapidos,
  );

  readonly filterError = computed(() => {
    const from = this.parseDate(this.desde());
    const to = this.parseDate(this.hasta());

    if (!from || !to) {
      return 'Selecciona un periodo válido.';
    }

    if (from.getTime() > to.getTime()) {
      return 'La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la fecha final.';
    }

    const days = Math.floor(
      (to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / 86_400_000,
    );

    if (days > 365) {
      return 'El periodo máximo permitido es de 366 días.';
    }

    if (this.hasta() > this.today) {
      return 'La fecha final no puede estar en el futuro.';
    }

    return null;
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    if (this.filterError()) {
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.useCase
      .execute(this.currentFilter())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (dashboard) => {
          this.dashboard.set(dashboard);

          if (dashboard.periodo.desde) {
            this.desde.set(dashboard.periodo.desde);
          }

          if (dashboard.periodo.hasta) {
            this.hasta.set(dashboard.periodo.hasta);
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  applyFilters(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  resetFilters(): void {
    this.desde.set(this.offsetDate(-89));
    this.hasta.set(this.today);
    this.load();
  }

  updateDesde(event: Event): void {
    this.desde.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }

  updateHasta(event: Event): void {
    this.hasta.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  }

  iconForModule(code: string): IconDefinition {
    const normalized = code.toUpperCase();

    if (normalized.includes('TIPO') && normalized.includes('BIEN')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('PRODUCTOR') || normalized.includes('SOCIO')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('PREDIO')) {
      return faLocationDot;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('CULTIVO') ||
      normalized.includes('PRODUCCION') ||
      normalized.includes('SANIDAD')
    ) {
      return normalized.includes('SANIDAD') ? faLeaf : faSeedling;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('CAMPANIA') ||
      normalized.includes('OPERATIVO') ||
      normalized.includes('SALIDA') ||
      normalized.includes('VISITA')
    ) {
      return faCalendarDays;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('INVENTARIO') ||
      normalized.includes('RECURSO') ||
      normalized.includes('JABA')
    ) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('ENTREGA')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes('PAGO') ||
      normalized.includes('COBRO') ||
      normalized.includes('LIQUID')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('GASTO') || normalized.includes('AJUSTE')) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('USUARIO') || normalized.includes('ROL')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('REPORTE') || normalized.includes('AUDITOR')) {
      return faFileLines;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('ORGANIZ')) {
      return faBuilding;
    }

    return faChartLine;
  }


  private currentFilter(): DashboardFilter {
    return {
      desde: this.desde(),
      hasta: this.hasta(),
    };
  }

  private offsetDate(days: number): string {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
    return this.localIsoDate(date);
  }

  private localIsoDate(date: Date): string {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  }

  private parseDate(value: string): Date | null {
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
      return null;
    }

    const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`);

    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { DashboardService } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { InicioGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/inicio.gateway';
import { DashboardFilter } from '../../../domain/dashboard-filter.model';
import { InicioHttpMapper } from './inicio-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class InicioHttpAdapter implements InicioGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(DashboardService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(InicioHttpMapper);

  getDashboard(filter: DashboardFilter) {
    const desde = filter.desde?.trim() || undefined;
    const hasta = filter.hasta?.trim() || undefined;

    return this.api
      .dashboardResumen(
        { desde, hasta },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.dashboard(response)));
  }
}

### 1238. `src/app/features/inicio/adapter/out/http/inicio-http.mapper.ts`

- Ruta: `src/app/features/inicio/adapter/out/http/inicio-http.mapper.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\inicio\adapter\out\http\inicio-http.mapper.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/inicio/adapter/out/http/inicio-http.mapper.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { ApiEnvelope } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { Dashboard } from '../../../domain/dashboard.model';
import {
  DashboardChart,
  DashboardChartSeries,
  DashboardChartType,
} from '../../../domain/grafico-dashboard.model';

type RecordValue = Record<string, unknown>;

@Injectable()
export class InicioHttpMapper {
  dashboard(response: unknown): Dashboard {
    const envelope = this.record(response) as ApiEnvelope<unknown>;

    if (envelope.exitoso === false) {
      throw new Error(envelope.mensaje || 'No se pudo cargar el dashboard.');
    }

    const data = this.record(envelope.datos);
    const period = this.record(data['periodo']);

    return {
      periodo: {
        desde: this.string(period['desde']),
        hasta: this.string(period['hasta']),
      },
      indicadores: this.array(data['indicadores'])
        .map((item) => {
          const row = this.record(item);

          return {
            codigo: this.string(row['codigo']),
            indicador: this.string(row['indicador']),
            valor: this.string(row['valor']),
            unidad: this.nullableString(row['unidad']),
            icono: this.nullableString(row['icono']),
            orden: this.number(row['orden']),
          };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden),
      graficos: this.array(data['graficos'])
        .map((item) => this.chart(item))
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden),
      alertas: this.array(data['alertas'])
        .map((item) => {
          const row = this.record(item);

          return {
            tipo: this.string(row['tipo']),
            mensaje: this.string(row['mensaje']),
            cantidad: this.number(row['cantidad']),
            orden: this.number(row['orden']),
          };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden),
      accesosRapidos: this.array(data['accesosRapidos'])
        .map((item) => {
          const row = this.record(item);

          return {
            moduloId: this.number(row['moduloId']),
            codigoModulo: this.string(row['codigoModulo']),
            nombreModulo: this.string(row['nombreModulo']),
            ruta: this.string(row['ruta']),
            icono: this.nullableString(row['icono']),
            orden: this.number(row['orden']),
          };
        })
        .filter((item) => Boolean(item.ruta))
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden),
    };
  }

  private chart(value: unknown): DashboardChart {
    const row = this.record(value);

    return {
      codigo: this.string(row['codigo']),
      titulo: this.string(row['titulo']),
      subtitulo: this.nullableString(row['subtitulo']),
      tipoGrafico: this.chartType(row['tipoGrafico']),
      unidad: this.nullableString(row['unidad']),
      ancho: Math.max(1, Math.min(2, this.number(row['ancho']) || 1)),
      orden: this.number(row['orden']),
      series: this.array(row['series'])
        .map((item) => this.chartSeries(item))
        .filter((item) => item.puntos.length > 0),
    };
  }

  private chartSeries(value: unknown): DashboardChartSeries {
    const row = this.record(value);

    return {
      nombre: this.string(row['nombre']),
      puntos: this.array(row['puntos'])
        .map((item) => {
          const point = this.record(item);

          return {
            categoria: this.string(point['categoria']),
            valor: this.number(point['valor']),
            orden: this.number(point['orden']),
          };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden),
    };
  }

  private chartType(value: unknown): DashboardChartType {
    const candidate = this.string(value).toUpperCase();

    if (
      candidate === 'LINE' ||
      candidate === 'AREA' ||
      candidate === 'BAR' ||
      candidate === 'COLUMN' ||
      candidate === 'DONUT'
    ) {
      return candidate;
    }

    return 'BAR';
  }

  private record(value: unknown): RecordValue {
    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? (value as RecordValue)
      : {};
  }

  private array(value: unknown): unknown[] {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  }

  private string(value: unknown): string {
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? '');
  }

  private nullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value : null;
  }

  private number(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }
}

<div class="desco-page account-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Dispositivos"
    subtitle="Administra los dispositivos asociados a tu cuenta."
    eyebrow="Mi cuenta"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <button
      pageActions
      type="button"
      class="btn rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
      [disabled]="loading()"
      (click)="load()"
    >
      <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
      Actualizar
    </button>
  </app-page-header>

  <nav class="account-tabs" aria-label="Mi cuenta">
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/perfil" routerLinkActive="active">Perfil</a>
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/seguridad" routerLinkActive="active">Seguridad</a>
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/sesiones" routerLinkActive="active">Sesiones</a>
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/dispositivos" routerLinkActive="active">Dispositivos</a>
  </nav>

  <div class="mt-5">
    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state title="Cargando dispositivos" message="Consultando los dispositivos de tu cuenta." />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="load()" />
    } @else {
      <div class="device-grid">
        @for (device of devices(); track device.dispositivoUsuarioId) {
          <article class="device-card" [class.current]="device.dispositivoActual">
            <div class="device-top">
              <div class="device-symbol">
                <fa-icon [icon]="deviceIcon" />
              </div>

              <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div class="device-title-row">
                  <h2>{{ deviceName(device) }}</h2>

                  @if (device.dispositivoActual) {
                    <span class="current-badge">Este dispositivo</span>
                  }
                </div>

                <div class="recognition-row">
                  <span
                    class="recognition-badge"
                    [class.recognized]="device.reconocidoVigente"
                  >
                    <fa-icon
                      [icon]="device.reconocidoVigente ? shieldIcon : untrustedIcon"
                    />
                    {{ device.reconocidoVigente ? 'Reconocido' : 'No reconocido' }}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="device-meta">
              <div>
                <fa-icon [icon]="locationIcon" />
                <span>{{ device.ultimaIp || 'IP no disponible' }}</span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <fa-icon [icon]="clockIcon" />
                <span>
                  Última actividad:
                  {{ device.fechaUltimaActividadUtc ? (device.fechaUltimaActividadUtc | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}
                </span>
              </div>

              @if (device.reconocidoVigente && device.fechaExpiracionReconocimientoUtc) {
                <div>
                  <fa-icon [icon]="shieldIcon" />
                  <span>
                    Reconocimiento hasta:
                    {{ device.fechaExpiracionReconocimientoUtc | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}
                  </span>
                </div>
              }
            </div>

            <div class="device-actions">
              <button
                type="button"
                class="recognition-button"
                [class.remove]="device.reconocidoVigente"
                [disabled]="processingId() === device.dispositivoUsuarioId"
                (click)="toggleRecognition(device)"
              >
                @if (processingId() === device.dispositivoUsuarioId) {
                  <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
                  Actualizando...
                } @else {
                  <fa-icon [icon]="device.reconocidoVigente ? untrustedIcon : checkIcon" />
                  {{ device.reconocidoVigente ? 'Quitar reconocimiento' : 'Reconocer dispositivo' }}
                }
              </button>
            </div>
          </article>
        } @empty {
          <div class="device-empty">
            No hay dispositivos para mostrar.
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    }
  </div>
</div>

### 1251. `src/app/features/mi-cuenta/adapter/in/ui/pages/dispositivos/dispositivos.ts`

- Ruta: `src/app/features/mi-cuenta/adapter/in/ui/pages/dispositivos/dispositivos.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\mi-cuenta\adapter\in\ui\pages\dispositivos\dispositivos.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/mi-cuenta/adapter/in/ui/pages/dispositivos/dispositivos.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCheck,
  faClock,
  faComputer,
  faLocationDot,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faShieldVirus,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ListarDispositivosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-dispositivos.use-case';
import { QuitarReconocimientoDispositivoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/quitar-reconocimiento-dispositivo.use-case';
import { ReconocerDispositivoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/reconocer-dispositivo.use-case';
import { DispositivoCuenta } from '../../../../../domain/dispositivo.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dispositivos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    RouterLinkActive,
    FaIconComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './dispositivos.html',
  styleUrl: './dispositivos.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DispositivosPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarDispositivosUseCase);
  private readonly recognizeUseCase = inject(ReconocerDispositivoUseCase);
  private readonly removeRecognitionUseCase = inject(
    QuitarReconocimientoDispositivoUseCase,
  );
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly devices = signal<readonly DispositivoCuenta[]>([]);
  readonly processingId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faComputer;
  readonly deviceIcon = faComputer;
  readonly shieldIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly untrustedIcon = faShieldVirus;
  readonly locationIcon = faLocationDot;
  readonly clockIcon = faClock;
  readonly checkIcon = faCheck;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (devices) => this.devices.set(devices),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async toggleRecognition(device: DispositivoCuenta): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processingId()) {
      return;
    }

    const recognize = !device.reconocidoVigente;
    const result = await this.alert.question(
      recognize ? 'Reconocer dispositivo' : 'Quitar reconocimiento',
      recognize
        ? `¿Deseas reconocer ${this.deviceName(device)}?`
        : `¿Deseas quitar el reconocimiento de ${this.deviceName(device)}?`,
      recognize ? 'Reconocer' : 'Quitar',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!result.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.processingId.set(device.dispositivoUsuarioId);

    const operation = recognize
      ? this.recognizeUseCase.execute(device.dispositivoUsuarioId)
      : this.removeRecognitionUseCase.execute(device.dispositivoUsuarioId);

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.processingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            recognize ? 'Dispositivo reconocido' : 'Reconocimiento retirado',
          );
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo actualizar el dispositivo',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  deviceName(device: DispositivoCuenta): string {
    return `${device.navegador || 'Navegador'} · ${
      device.sistemaOperativo || 'Dispositivo'
    }`;
  }
}
```

<div class="desco-page account-page">

    title="Mi cuenta"

  @if (loading() && !user()) {

          <div class="detail-item">

            </article>
          } @empty {
            <p class="empty-copy">No hay roles activos para mostrar.</p>
          }
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  }
</div>

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faAt,
  faBuilding,
  faIdBadge,
  faPhone,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faUser,
  faUserTag,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { CerrarSesionUseCase } from '../../../../../../acceso/application/use-case/cerrar-sesion.use-case';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from '../../../../../../acceso/application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-perfil-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    RouterLinkActive,
    FaIconComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './perfil.html',
  styleUrl: './perfil.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PerfilPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly contextUseCase = inject(ObtenerContextoActualUseCase);
  private readonly logoutUseCase = inject(CerrarSesionUseCase);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly loggingOut = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly user = this.access.user;
  readonly roles = this.access.roles;

  readonly displayName = computed(
    () =>
      this.user()?.nombreCompleto ||
      this.user()?.nombreUsuario ||
      'Usuario',
  );

  readonly initials = computed(() =>
    this.displayName()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
      .join(''),
  );

  readonly userIcon = faUser;
  readonly idIcon = faIdBadge;
  readonly phoneIcon = faPhone;
  readonly mailIcon = faAt;
  readonly buildingIcon = faBuilding;
  readonly roleIcon = faUserTag;
  readonly securityIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly logoutIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.refresh();
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.contextUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async logout(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.loggingOut()) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.alert.question(
      'Cerrar sesión',
      '¿Deseas finalizar la sesión actual?',
      'Cerrar sesión',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!result.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.loggingOut.set(true);

    this.logoutUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loggingOut.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => void this.router.navigate(['/login']),
        error: () => void this.router.navigate(['/login']),
      });
  }
}

<div class="desco-page account-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Seguridad"
    subtitle="Administra la contraseña y el correo asociado a tu cuenta."
    eyebrow="Mi cuenta"
    [icon]="securityIcon"
  />

  <nav class="account-tabs" aria-label="Mi cuenta">
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/perfil" routerLinkActive="active">Perfil</a>
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/seguridad" routerLinkActive="active">Seguridad</a>
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/sesiones" routerLinkActive="active">Sesiones</a>
    <a routerLink="/mi-cuenta/dispositivos" routerLinkActive="active">Dispositivos</a>
  </nav>

  <div class="security-grid">
    <section class="security-card">
      <header class="security-card-header">
        <span class="security-card-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="passwordIcon" /></span>
        <div>
          <p>Contraseña</p>
          <h2>Actualizar contraseña</h2>
        </div>
      </header>

      @if (passwordError()) {
        <div class="inline-error" role="alert">{{ passwordError() }}</div>
      }

      <form class="security-form" [formGroup]="passwordForm" (ngSubmit)="changePassword()">
        <div>
          <label for="passwordActual">Contraseña actual</label>
          <div class="input-wrap">
            <fa-icon [icon]="lockIcon" />
            <input
              id="passwordActual"
              type="password"
              formControlName="passwordActual"
              autocomplete="current-password"
            />
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="passwordForm.controls.passwordActual"
            fieldLabel="La contraseña actual"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="nuevoPassword">Nueva contraseña</label>
          <div class="input-wrap">
            <fa-icon [icon]="passwordIcon" />
            <input
              id="nuevoPassword"
              type="password"
              formControlName="nuevoPassword"
              autocomplete="new-password"
              placeholder="Mínimo 12 caracteres"
            />
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="passwordForm.controls.nuevoPassword"
            fieldLabel="La nueva contraseña"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="confirmarPassword">Confirmar contraseña</label>
          <div class="input-wrap">
            <fa-icon [icon]="checkIcon" />
            <input
              id="confirmarPassword"
              type="password"
              formControlName="confirmarPassword"
              autocomplete="new-password"
            />
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="passwordForm.controls.confirmarPassword"
            fieldLabel="La confirmación"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="primary-action"
          [disabled]="passwordLoading()"
        >
          @if (passwordLoading()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="checkIcon" />
            Cambiar contraseña
          }
        </button>
      </form>
    </section>

    <section class="security-card">
      <header class="security-card-header">
        <span class="security-card-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="mailIcon" /></span>
        <div>
          <p>Correo de seguridad</p>
          <h2>Actualizar correo</h2>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div class="current-email">
        <span>Correo actual</span>
        <strong>{{ user()?.correoSeguridad || 'No disponible' }}</strong>
        @if (user()?.correoSeguridadVerificado) {
          <span class="email-verified">
            <fa-icon [icon]="verifyIcon" />
            Verificado
          </span>
        }
      </div>

      @if (emailError()) {
        <div class="inline-error" role="alert">{{ emailError() }}</div>
      }

      <form class="security-form" [formGroup]="emailForm">
        <div>
          <label for="nuevoCorreo">Nuevo correo</label>
          <div class="input-wrap">
            <fa-icon [icon]="mailIcon" />
            <input
              id="nuevoCorreo"
              type="email"
              formControlName="nuevoCorreo"
              autocomplete="email"
              placeholder="correo@dominio.com"
            />
          </div>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="emailForm.controls.nuevoCorreo"
            fieldLabel="El correo"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          class="secondary-action"
          [disabled]="emailLoading()"
          (click)="requestEmailChange()"
        >
          @if (emailLoading()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Enviando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="sendIcon" />
            Enviar código
          }
        </button>

        @if (emailCodeSent()) {
          <div class="email-confirm">
            <label for="codigoCorreo">Código de confirmación</label>
            <input
              id="codigoCorreo"
              class="code-control"
              type="text"
              formControlName="codigo"
              inputmode="numeric"
              autocomplete="one-time-code"
              maxlength="8"
              placeholder="000000"
            />

            <app-form-error
              [control]="emailForm.controls.codigo"
              fieldLabel="El código"
              [messages]="{ pattern: 'Ingresa un código válido de 6 a 8 dígitos.' }"
            />

            <button
              type="button"
              class="primary-action mt-3"
              [disabled]="confirmEmailLoading()"
              (click)="confirmEmailChange()"
            >
              @if (confirmEmailLoading()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
                Confirmando...
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="verifyIcon" />
                Confirmar correo
              }
            </button>
          </div>
        }
      </form>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faAt,
  faCheck,
  faEnvelopeCircleCheck,
  faKey,
  faLock,
  faPaperPlane,
  faShieldHalved,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessService } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.service';
import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { SessionStore } from '../../../../../../../core/session/session.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from '../../../../../../acceso/application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';
import { CambiarPasswordUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cambiar-password.use-case';
import { ConfirmarCambioCorreoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/confirmar-cambio-correo.use-case';
import { SolicitarCambioCorreoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/solicitar-cambio-correo.use-case';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-seguridad-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    RouterLink,
    RouterLinkActive,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './seguridad.html',
  styleUrl: './seguridad.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SeguridadPage {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly passwordUseCase = inject(CambiarPasswordUseCase);
  private readonly requestEmailUseCase = inject(SolicitarCambioCorreoUseCase);
  private readonly confirmEmailUseCase = inject(ConfirmarCambioCorreoUseCase);
  private readonly currentContextUseCase = inject(ObtenerContextoActualUseCase);
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly sessionStore = inject(SessionStore);
  private readonly accessService = inject(AccessService);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  readonly passwordLoading = signal(false);
  readonly emailLoading = signal(false);
  readonly confirmEmailLoading = signal(false);
  readonly emailCodeSent = signal(false);
  readonly passwordError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly emailError = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly user = this.accessStore.user;

  readonly securityIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly passwordIcon = faKey;
  readonly lockIcon = faLock;
  readonly mailIcon = faAt;
  readonly sendIcon = faPaperPlane;
  readonly verifyIcon = faEnvelopeCircleCheck;
  readonly checkIcon = faCheck;

  readonly passwordForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    passwordActual: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(128)]],
    nuevoPassword: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(12), Validators.maxLength(128)],
    ],
    confirmarPassword: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(12), Validators.maxLength(128)],
    ],
  });

  readonly emailForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    nuevoCorreo: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(320)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.pattern(/^\d{6,8}$/)]],
  });

  async changePassword(): Promise<void> {
    this.passwordForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.passwordForm.invalid || this.passwordLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    const values = this.passwordForm.getRawValue();

    if (values.nuevoPassword !== values.confirmarPassword) {
      this.passwordError.set('Las contraseñas deben coincidir.');
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = await this.alert.question(
      'Cambiar contraseña',
      'Al guardar el cambio deberás iniciar sesión nuevamente.',
      'Cambiar contraseña',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!confirmation.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.passwordError.set(null);
    this.passwordLoading.set(true);

    this.passwordUseCase
      .execute(values)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.passwordLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.sessionStore.clear();
          this.accessService.clear();
          this.toast.success(
            'Contraseña actualizada',
            'Inicia sesión nuevamente para continuar.',
          );
          void this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.passwordError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  requestEmailChange(): void {
    this.emailForm.controls.nuevoCorreo.markAsTouched();

    if (
      this.emailForm.controls.nuevoCorreo.invalid ||
      this.emailLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.emailError.set(null);
    this.emailLoading.set(true);

    this.requestEmailUseCase
      .execute({
        nuevoCorreo: this.emailForm.controls.nuevoCorreo.value.trim(),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.emailLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.emailCodeSent.set(true);
          this.toast.info(
            'Código enviado',
            'Revisa el nuevo correo para confirmar el cambio.',
          );
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.emailError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  confirmEmailChange(): void {
    const codeControl = this.emailForm.controls.codigo;
    codeControl.addValidators([
      Validators.required,
      Validators.pattern(/^\d{6,8}$/),
    ]);
    codeControl.updateValueAndValidity();
    codeControl.markAsTouched();

    if (codeControl.invalid || this.confirmEmailLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    this.emailError.set(null);
    this.confirmEmailLoading.set(true);

    this.confirmEmailUseCase
      .execute({ codigo: codeControl.value })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.confirmEmailLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.emailCodeSent.set(false);
          this.emailForm.reset();
          this.toast.success(
            'Correo actualizado',
            'El nuevo correo quedó confirmado.',
          );

          this.currentContextUseCase.execute().subscribe({
            error: () => undefined,
          });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.emailError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }
}

:host {

}

.current-badge,
.inactive-badge {

.current-badge {

}

@media (max-width: 900px) {

              <div>

                <span>
                  Inicio:
