```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faClock,
  faComputer,
  faGlobe,
  faLocationDot,
  faRotate,
  faShieldHalved,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { CerrarOtrasSesionesCuentaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cerrar-otras-sesiones.use-case';
import { CerrarSesionRemotaUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cerrar-sesion-remota.use-case';
import { ListarSesionesUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-sesiones.use-case';
import { SesionCuenta } from '../../../../../domain/sesion.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sesiones-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    RouterLink,
    RouterLinkActive,
    FaIconComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './sesiones.html',
  styleUrl: './sesiones.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SesionesPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarSesionesUseCase);
  private readonly closeUseCase = inject(CerrarSesionRemotaUseCase);
  private readonly closeOthersUseCase = inject(CerrarOtrasSesionesCuentaUseCase);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly sessions = signal<readonly SesionCuenta[]>([]);
  readonly processingSessionId = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly closingOthers = signal(false);

  readonly sessionIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly deviceIcon = faComputer;
  readonly locationIcon = faLocationDot;
  readonly globeIcon = faGlobe;
  readonly clockIcon = faClock;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.listUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (sessions) => this.sessions.set(sessions),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async closeSession(session: SesionCuenta): Promise<void> {
    if (
      session.sesionActual ||
      !session.activa ||
      this.processingSessionId()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.alert.question(
      'Cerrar sesión',
      `¿Deseas cerrar la sesión de ${this.deviceName(session)}?`,
      'Cerrar sesión',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!result.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.processingSessionId.set(session.sesionPublicaId);

    this.closeUseCase
      .execute(session.sesionPublicaId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.processingSessionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Sesión cerrada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error('No se pudo cerrar la sesión', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  async closeOthers(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.closingOthers()) {
      return;
    }

    const result = await this.alert.question(
      'Cerrar otras sesiones',
      'Se cerrarán todas las sesiones activas excepto la actual.',
      'Cerrar otras',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!result.confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    this.closingOthers.set(true);

    this.closeOthersUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.closingOthers.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Otras sesiones cerradas');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudieron cerrar las sesiones',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  deviceName(session: SesionCuenta): string {
    const browser = session.navegador || 'Navegador';
    const os = session.sistemaOperativo || 'Dispositivo';

    return `${browser} · ${os}`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import {
  ChangeOwnPasswordRequest,
  CloseAccountSessionRequest,
  ConfirmOwnEmailChangeRequest,
  DeviceRecognitionRequest,
  MiCuentaService,
  RequestOwnEmailChangeRequest,
} from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { MiCuentaGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/mi-cuenta.gateway';
import {
  CambioPasswordCuenta,
  ConfirmacionCambioCorreo,
  SolicitudCambioCorreo,
} from '../../../domain/seguridad-cuenta.model';
import { MiCuentaHttpMapper } from './mi-cuenta-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class MiCuentaHttpAdapter implements MiCuentaGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(MiCuentaService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(MiCuentaHttpMapper);

  changePassword(input: CambioPasswordCuenta) {
    const changeOwnPasswordRequest: ChangeOwnPasswordRequest = input;

    return this.api
      .accountPasswordChange(
        { changeOwnPasswordRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  requestEmailChange(input: SolicitudCambioCorreo) {
    const requestOwnEmailChangeRequest: RequestOwnEmailChangeRequest = input;

    return this.api
      .accountEmailChangeRequest(
        { requestOwnEmailChangeRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  confirmEmailChange(input: ConfirmacionCambioCorreo) {
    const confirmOwnEmailChangeRequest: ConfirmOwnEmailChangeRequest = input;

    return this.api
      .accountEmailChangeConfirm(
        { confirmOwnEmailChangeRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  listSessions() {
    return this.api
      .accountSessionsList(
        undefined,
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.sessions(response)));
  }

  closeSession(sesionPublicaId: string) {
    const closeAccountSessionRequest: CloseAccountSessionRequest = {
      sesionPublicaId,
    };

    return this.api
      .accountSessionClose(
        { closeAccountSessionRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  closeOtherSessions() {
    return this.api
      .accountSessionsCloseOthers(
        undefined,
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }

  listDevices() {
    return this.api
      .accountDevicesList(
        undefined,
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.devices(response)));
  }

  updateDeviceRecognition(
    dispositivoUsuarioId: number,
    reconocer: boolean,
  ) {
    const deviceRecognitionRequest: DeviceRecognitionRequest = {
      dispositivoUsuarioId,
      reconocer,
    };

    return this.api
      .accountDeviceRecognitionUpdate(
        { deviceRecognitionRequest },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.voidResponse(response)));
  }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/mi-cuenta/adapter/out/http/mi-cuenta-http.mapper.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { ApiEnvelope } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { DispositivoCuenta } from '../../../domain/dispositivo.model';
import { SesionCuenta } from '../../../domain/sesion.model';

type RecordValue = Record<string, unknown>;

@Injectable()
export class MiCuentaHttpMapper {
  sessions(response: unknown): readonly SesionCuenta[] {
    return this.array(this.data(response))
      .map((item) => {
        const row = this.record(item);

        return {
          sesionPublicaId: this.string(row['sesionPublicaId']),
          fechaCreacionUtc: this.nullableString(row['fechaCreacionUtc']),
          fechaUltimaActividadUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaUltimaActividadUtc'],
          ),
          fechaExpiracionRenovacionUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaExpiracionRenovacionUtc'],
          ),
          ipCreacion: this.nullableString(row['ipCreacion']),
          ipUltimaActividad: this.nullableString(row['ipUltimaActividad']),
          sesionActual: this.boolean(row['sesionActual']),
          activa: this.boolean(row['activa']),
          dispositivoUsuarioId: this.nullableNumber(
            row['dispositivoUsuarioId'],
          ),
          navegador: this.nullableString(row['navegador']),
          sistemaOperativo: this.nullableString(row['sistemaOperativo']),
          fechaPrimeraDeteccionUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaPrimeraDeteccionUtc'],
          ),
          fechaUltimaActividadDispositivoUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaUltimaActividadDispositivoUtc'],
          ),
          reconocido: this.boolean(row['reconocido']),
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.sesionActual !== b.sesionActual) {
          return a.sesionActual ? -1 : 1;
        }

        return this.dateValue(b.fechaUltimaActividadUtc) -
          this.dateValue(a.fechaUltimaActividadUtc);
      });
  }

  devices(response: unknown): readonly DispositivoCuenta[] {
    return this.array(this.data(response))
      .map((item) => {
        const row = this.record(item);

        return {
          dispositivoUsuarioId: this.number(row['dispositivoUsuarioId']),
          navegador: this.nullableString(row['navegador']),
          sistemaOperativo: this.nullableString(row['sistemaOperativo']),
          fechaPrimeraDeteccionUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaPrimeraDeteccionUtc'],
          ),
          fechaUltimaActividadUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaUltimaActividadUtc'],
          ),
          ultimaIp: this.nullableString(row['ultimaIp']),
          reconocidoVigente: this.boolean(row['reconocidoVigente']),
          fechaReconocimientoUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaReconocimientoUtc'],
          ),
          fechaExpiracionReconocimientoUtc: this.nullableString(
            row['fechaExpiracionReconocimientoUtc'],
          ),
          dispositivoActual: this.boolean(row['dispositivoActual']),
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.dispositivoActual !== b.dispositivoActual) {
          return a.dispositivoActual ? -1 : 1;
        }

        return this.dateValue(b.fechaUltimaActividadUtc) -
          this.dateValue(a.fechaUltimaActividadUtc);
      });
  }

  voidResponse(response: unknown): void {
    this.data(response);
  }

  private data(response: unknown): unknown {
    const envelope = this.record(response) as ApiEnvelope<unknown>;

    if (envelope.exitoso === false) {
      throw new Error(envelope.mensaje || 'La operación no pudo completarse.');
    }

    return envelope.datos;
  }

  private record(value: unknown): RecordValue {
    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? (value as RecordValue)
      : {};
  }

  private array(value: unknown): unknown[] {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  }

  private string(value: unknown): string {
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? '');
  }

  private nullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value : null;
  }

  private number(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }

  private nullableNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }

  private boolean(value: unknown): boolean {
    return value === true || value === 1 || value === 'true' || value === '1';
  }

  private dateValue(value: string | null): number {
    if (!value) {
      return 0;
    }

    const parsed = Date.parse(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { DispositivoCuenta } from '../../../domain/dispositivo.model';
import {
  CambioPasswordCuenta,
  ConfirmacionCambioCorreo,
  SolicitudCambioCorreo,
} from '../../../domain/seguridad-cuenta.model';
import { SesionCuenta } from '../../../domain/sesion.model';

export interface MiCuentaGateway {
  changePassword(input: CambioPasswordCuenta): Observable<void>;

  requestEmailChange(input: SolicitudCambioCorreo): Observable<void>;

  confirmEmailChange(input: ConfirmacionCambioCorreo): Observable<void>;

  listSessions(): Observable<readonly SesionCuenta[]>;

  closeSession(sesionPublicaId: string): Observable<void>;

  closeOtherSessions(): Observable<void>;

  listDevices(): Observable<readonly DispositivoCuenta[]>;

  updateDeviceRecognition(
    dispositivoUsuarioId: number,
    reconocer: boolean,
  ): Observable<void>;
}

export const MI_CUENTA_GATEWAY =
  new InjectionToken<MiCuentaGateway>('MI_CUENTA_GATEWAY');
```

```typescript
import { MiCuentaHttpAdapter } from './adapter/out/http/mi-cuenta-http.adapter';
import { MiCuentaHttpMapper } from './adapter/out/http/mi-cuenta-http.mapper';

export function provideMiCuenta(): Provider[] {
  return [
    MiCuentaHttpMapper,
    MiCuentaHttpAdapter,
    {
      provide: MI_CUENTA_GATEWAY,
      useExisting: MiCuentaHttpAdapter,
    },
    CambiarPasswordUseCase,
    SolicitarCambioCorreoUseCase,
    ConfirmarCambioCorreoUseCase,
    ListarSesionesUseCase,
    CerrarSesionRemotaUseCase,
    CerrarOtrasSesionesCuentaUseCase,
    ListarDispositivosUseCase,
    ReconocerDispositivoUseCase,
    QuitarReconocimientoDispositivoUseCase,
  ];
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\pos\adapter\in\ui\components\pos-product-image\pos-product-image.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/pos/adapter/in/ui/components/pos-product-image/pos-product-image.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../../../../../../../shared/files/local-document-api.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-pos-product-image',
  standalone: true,
  templateUrl: './pos-product-image.html',
  styleUrl: './pos-product-image.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PosProductImageComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() fileId: number | null | undefined = null;
  @Input() imageUrl: string | null | undefined = null;
  @Input() alt = 'Producto';

  private readonly files = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private objectUrl: string | null = null;

  readonly src = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly failed = signal(false);

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['fileId'] || changes['imageUrl']) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.clearObjectUrl();
  }

  onError(): void {
    this.failed.set(true);
    this.src.set(null);
  }

  private load(): void {
    this.clearObjectUrl();
    this.failed.set(false);
    this.src.set(null);

    const id = Number(this.fileId ?? 0);

    if (id > 0) {
      this.loading.set(true);
      this.files
        .content(id)
        .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
        .subscribe({
          next: (blob) => {
            this.objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            this.src.set(this.objectUrl);
          },
          error: () => {
            this.failed.set(true);
          },
        });
      return;
    }

    const url = this.imageUrl?.trim();

    if (url) {
      this.src.set(url);
      return;
    }

    this.failed.set(true);
  }

  private clearObjectUrl(): void {
    if (!this.objectUrl) {
      return;
    }

    URL.revokeObjectURL(this.objectUrl);
    this.objectUrl = null;
  }
}
```

```css
  padding: 0.95rem;
}

.pos-section-header,
.pos-cart__header,
.pos-catalog-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

.pos-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.pos-section-header small,
.pos-cart__header small,
.pos-catalog-heading small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.59rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.pos-section-header strong,
.pos-cart__header strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.pos-section-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.pos-resolution-flow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
}

.pos-resolution-step {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.pos-resolution-step > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 1.55rem;
  height: 1.55rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.pos-resolution-step strong,
.pos-resolution-step small {
  display: block;
}

.pos-resolution-step strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.67rem;
}

.pos-resolution-step small {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.08rem;

  font-size: 0.55rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-resolution-arrow {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.pos-customer-search {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 8.5rem 7.5rem minmax(10rem, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  align-items: end;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
}

.pos-field {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
  gap: 0.32rem;
}

.pos-field > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.59rem;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.pos-field > span em {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.52rem;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
}

.pos-field > small {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-align: left;
}

.pos-customer-search__button {
  min-height: 2.65rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-customer-selected {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-customer-selected__main {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-customer-selected span,
.pos-customer-selected small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.61rem;
}

.pos-customer-selected strong {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.18rem 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-inline-note,
.pos-recovery-note,
.pos-success-note {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: left;
}

.pos-inline-note--success {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--desco-primary-text) 35%, var(--desco-border));
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.pos-inline-note--warning {
  border-color: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.35);
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08);
  color: #b45309;
}

.pos-inline-note--error {
  border-color: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.35);
  background: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.08);
  color: var(--desco-danger, #b91c1c);
}

.pos-recovery-note {
  display: grid;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 0.2rem;
  margin: 0;
  border-width: 0 0 1px;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
}

.pos-recovery-note strong,
.pos-success-note {
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.58rem;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-chip--success {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.pos-catalog-panel {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-catalog-heading {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-catalog-heading h2 {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-catalog-heading > span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  text-align: right;
}

.pos-product-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(14rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

.pos-product-card {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
  transition:
    border-color 140ms ease,
    transform 140ms ease,
    box-shadow 140ms ease;
}

.pos-product-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--desco-primary-text) 26%, var(--desco-border));
}

.pos-product-card__body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-product-card__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.pos-product-card__heading > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-product-card__heading small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.56rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-product-card__heading h3 {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.12rem 0 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-stock {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.45rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.56rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-product-card__body > p {
  min-height: 2.1rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.pos-product-card__footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.pos-product-card__footer small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.56rem;
}

.pos-product-card__footer strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.pos-cart {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 7.5rem);
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 0;
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
}

.pos-cart__header {
  position: sticky;
  z-index: 3;
  top: 0;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.85rem 0.9rem;
}

.pos-cart__header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.pos-cart__badge {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  height: 1.75rem;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.pos-cart__items {
  min-height: 8rem;
  max-height: min(30dvh, 17rem);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.9rem;
}

.pos-cart-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 3.7rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding: 0.7rem 0;
}

.pos-cart-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.pos-cart-item app-pos-product-image {
  width: 3.7rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__body {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading > div {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading strong {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.71rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-cart-item__heading small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.56rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 3.6rem auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__controls .admin-input {
  min-width: 0;
  padding-inline: 0.3rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.pos-cart-item__price {
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: right;
}

.pos-cart-item__price small,
.pos-cart-item__price strong {
  display: block;
}

.pos-cart-item__price small {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.54rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__price strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.pos-cart-item__error {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--desco-danger, #b91c1c);
  font-size: 0.56rem;
}

.pos-cart-empty {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 8rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  text-align: center;
}

.pos-cart-empty fa-icon {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.pos-cart-empty strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
}

.pos-cart-empty span {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
}

.pos-payment {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
}

.pos-payment__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

.pos-payment__heading > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.pos-payment__heading > small {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  text-align: right;
}

.pos-payment__fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.pos-field--full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.pos-observation {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 4.8rem;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-align: left;
}

.pos-cart__footer {
  position: sticky;
  z-index: 2;
  bottom: 0;
  display: grid;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem 0.9rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
}

.pos-cart__totals strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.pos-cart__grand-total {
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--desco-border);
  padding-top: 0.45rem;
}

.pos-cart__grand-total strong {
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pos-cart__totals > small {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
  text-align: left;
}

.pos-checkout-message,
.pos-success-note {
  margin: 0;
}

.pos-checkout-button {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-manual-document {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
  padding: 0.7rem;
}

.pos-manual-document span {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.pos-manual-document strong {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .pos-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(12rem, 16rem) minmax(13rem, 1fr) 5rem;
  }

  .pos-toolbar__summary:last-child {
    display: none;
  }

  .pos-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(21.5rem, 24rem);
  }

  .pos-resolution-step small {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .pos-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-cart {
    position: static;
    max-height: none;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .pos-cart__header,
  .pos-cart__footer {
    position: static;
  }

  .pos-cart__items {
    max-height: none;
  }

  .pos-toolbar {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(12rem, 16rem) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .pos-toolbar__summary {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .pos-customer-search {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .pos-customer-search__document {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .pos-customer-search__button {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .pos-resolution-flow {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-resolution-arrow {
    display: none;
  }

  .pos-resolution-step small {
    display: block;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .pos-toolbar,
  .pos-customer-search {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-customer-search__document,
  .pos-customer-search__button {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .pos-product-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .pos-customer-selected,
  .pos-section-header,
  .pos-catalog-heading,
  .pos-payment__heading {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .pos-catalog-heading > span,
  .pos-payment__heading > small {
    text-align: left;
  }

  .pos-cart-item {
    grid-template-columns: 3.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .pos-cart-item app-pos-product-image {
    width: 3.25rem;
  }

  .pos-cart-item__controls {
    grid-template-columns: auto 3.5rem auto;
  }

  .pos-cart-item__price {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .pos-manual-document {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

@media (max-height: 720px) and (min-width: 1025px) {
  .pos-cart {
    max-height: calc(100dvh - 6.8rem);
  }

  .pos-cart__items {
    max-height: 10rem;
  }

  .pos-observation {
    min-height: 4rem;
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page pos-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Punto de venta"
    eyebrow="POS"
    [subtitle]="'Venta directa de productos con stock disponible en ' + uot.label() + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="contextLoading() || catalogLoading() || processing()"
        (click)="loadContext()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  @if (contextError()) {
    <app-error-state
      [message]="contextError() || 'No fue posible preparar el POS.'"
      (retry)="loadContext()"
    />
  } @else if (contextLoading()) {
    <app-loading-state
      title="Preparando POS"
      message="Consultando almacenes y métodos de pago."
    />
  } @else {
    <section class="admin-surface pos-toolbar" aria-label="Controles del punto de venta">
      <div class="pos-toolbar__field">
        <span class="pos-toolbar__label">
          <fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" />
          Almacén de salida
        </span>

        <select
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="cart.warehouseId() ?? 0"
          [disabled]="processing() || cart.locked() || cart.items().length > 0"
          (change)="changeWarehouse($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option [value]="0">Seleccionar almacén</option>
          @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.warehouseId) {
            <option [value]="warehouse.warehouseId">
              {{ warehouse.name }}
              @if (warehouse.code) {
                · {{ warehouse.code }}
              }
            </option>
          }
        </select>

        @if (cart.items().length > 0) {
          <small>Vacíe el carrito antes de cambiar de almacén.</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="pos-toolbar__field pos-toolbar__field--grow">
        <span class="pos-toolbar__label">
          <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
          Buscar producto
        </span>

        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="search"
          autocomplete="off"
          placeholder="Código, nombre o categoría"
          [value]="search()"
          (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="pos-toolbar__summary">
        <span>Disponibles</span>
        <strong>{{ filteredCatalog().length }}</strong>
      </div>

      <div class="pos-toolbar__summary">
        <span>Unidades</span>
        <strong>{{ cart.itemCount() }}</strong>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="pos-layout">
      <main class="pos-workspace">
        <section class="admin-surface pos-customer">
          <header class="pos-section-header">
            <div class="pos-section-heading">
              <span class="pos-section-icon">
                <fa-icon [icon]="customerIcon" />
              </span>

              <div>
                <small>Cliente</small>
                <strong>Identificación de la venta</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            @if (cart.customer(); as customer) {
              <span class="pos-chip pos-chip--success">
                {{ customerSourceLabel(customer) }}
              </span>
            }
          </header>

          <div class="pos-resolution-flow" aria-label="Flujo de identificación del cliente">
            <div class="pos-resolution-step">
              <span>1</span>
              <div>
                <strong>DESCO</strong>
                <small>Primero se busca localmente</small>
              </div>
            </div>

            <span class="pos-resolution-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>

            <div class="pos-resolution-step">
              <span>2</span>
              <div>
                <strong>Factiliza</strong>
                <small>Solo si el cliente no existe</small>
              </div>
            </div>

            <span class="pos-resolution-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>

            <div class="pos-resolution-step">
              <span>3</span>
              <div>
                <strong>Manual</strong>
                <small>Solo si la validación no puede completarse</small>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          @if (cart.customer(); as customer) {
            <div class="pos-customer-selected">
              <div class="pos-customer-selected__main">
                <span>Cliente seleccionado</span>
                <strong>{{ customer.displayName }}</strong>
                <small>
                  {{ customer.type === 'EMPRESA' ? 'Empresa' : 'Persona' }}
                  · {{ customer.documentType }} {{ customer.documentNumber }}
                </small>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                (click)="cart.setCustomer(null); customerMessage.set(null); customerTone.set('neutral')"
              >
                Cambiar cliente
              </button>
            </div>
          } @else {
            <form
              class="pos-customer-search"
              [formGroup]="customerForm"
              (ngSubmit)="resolveCustomer()"
            >
              <label class="pos-field">
                <span>Tipo de cliente</span>
                <select
                  class="admin-select"
                  formControlName="type"
                  [disabled]="customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
                  (change)="onCustomerTypeChange()"
                >
                  <option value="PERSONA">Persona</option>
                  <option value="EMPRESA">Empresa</option>
                </select>
              </label>

              <label class="pos-field">
                <span>Documento</span>
                <select
                  class="admin-select"
                  formControlName="documentType"
                  [disabled]="customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA' || customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
                  (change)="onCustomerDocumentTypeChange()"
                >
                  <option value="DNI">DNI</option>
                  <option value="RUC">RUC</option>
                </select>
              </label>

              <label class="pos-field pos-customer-search__document">
                <span>Número de documento</span>
                <input
                  class="admin-input"
                  type="text"
                  inputmode="numeric"
                  autocomplete="off"
                  formControlName="documentNumber"
                  [attr.maxlength]="customerDocumentMaxLength()"
                  [readOnly]="customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
                  (input)="onCustomerDocumentInput()"
                />
              </label>

              <button
                type="submit"
                class="admin-primary-button pos-customer-search__button"
                [disabled]="customerLoading() || processing() || cart.locked()"
              >
                @if (customerLoading()) {
                  <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
                  Buscando...
                } @else {
                  <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
                  Buscar cliente
                }
              </button>
            </form>
          }

          @if (customerMessage()) {
            <div
              class="pos-inline-note"
              [class.pos-inline-note--success]="customerTone() === 'success'"
              [class.pos-inline-note--warning]="customerTone() === 'warning'"
              [class.pos-inline-note--error]="customerTone() === 'error'"
              role="status"
            >
              {{ customerMessage() }}
            </div>
          }
        </section>

        <section class="pos-catalog-panel">
          <header class="pos-catalog-heading">
            <div>
              <small>Catálogo disponible</small>
              <h2>Productos con stock</h2>
            </div>
            <span>Precio vigente y stock del almacén seleccionado</span>
          </header>

          @if (!cart.warehouseId()) {
            <app-empty-state
              title="Seleccione un almacén"
              message="El catálogo del POS se habilita cuando existe un almacén de salida."
            />
          } @else if (catalogLoading()) {
            <app-loading-state
              title="Cargando catálogo"
              message="Consultando precios vigentes y stock disponible."
            />
          } @else if (catalogError()) {
            <app-error-state
              [message]="catalogError() || 'No fue posible consultar el catálogo.'"
              (retry)="loadCatalog()"
            />
          } @else if (filteredCatalog().length === 0) {
            <app-empty-state
              title="Sin productos disponibles"
              message="No hay productos con precio vigente y stock para la búsqueda actual."
            />
          } @else {
            <div class="pos-product-grid">
              @for (product of filteredCatalog(); track product.productId) {
                <article class="admin-surface pos-product-card">
                  <app-pos-product-image
                    [fileId]="product.imageFileId"
                    [imageUrl]="product.imageUrl"
                    [alt]="product.name"
                  />

                  <div class="pos-product-card__body">
                    <div class="pos-product-card__heading">
                      <div>
                        <small>{{ product.code || 'SIN CÓDIGO' }}</small>
                        <h3>{{ product.name }}</h3>
                      </div>

                      <span class="pos-stock">
                        {{ product.stockAvailable | number:'1.0-3' }}
                        {{ product.unit }}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p>{{ product.description || product.category || 'Producto disponible para venta.' }}</p>

                    <div class="pos-product-card__footer">
                      <div>
                        <small>Precio de venta</small>
                        <strong>
                          {{ product.currency }}
                          {{ product.unitPrice | number:'1.2-2' }}
                        </strong>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small"
                        [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                        (click)="add(product)"
                      >
                        <fa-icon [icon]="plusIcon" />
                        Agregar
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </article>
              }
            </div>
          }
        </section>
      </main>

      <aside class="admin-surface pos-cart" aria-label="Venta actual">
        <header class="pos-cart__header">
          <div class="pos-section-heading">
            <span class="pos-section-icon">
              <fa-icon [icon]="cartIcon" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <small>Venta actual</small>
              <strong>Carrito</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="pos-cart__header-actions">
            <span class="pos-cart__badge">{{ cart.itemCount() }}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-icon-button"
              title="Vaciar carrito"
              [disabled]="cart.items().length === 0 || cart.locked() || processing()"
              (click)="clearCart()"
            >
              <fa-icon [icon]="trashIcon" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>

        @if (cart.locked()) {
          <div class="pos-recovery-note">
            @if (cart.pendingSaleId()) {
              <strong>Venta #{{ cart.pendingSaleId() }} en proceso.</strong>
            } @else {
              <strong>Registro de venta pendiente de confirmar.</strong>
            }
            <span>
              El carrito está bloqueado para evitar duplicados. Reanude la operación sin modificarlo.
            </span>
          </div>
        }

        <div class="pos-cart__items">
          @for (item of cart.items(); track item.productId) {
            <article class="pos-cart-item">
              <app-pos-product-image
                [fileId]="item.imageFileId"
                [imageUrl]="item.imageUrl"
                [alt]="item.name"
              />

              <div class="pos-cart-item__body">
                <div class="pos-cart-item__heading">
                  <div>
                    <strong>{{ item.name }}</strong>
                    <small>{{ item.code || 'SIN CÓDIGO' }} · {{ item.unit }}</small>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    title="Quitar producto"
                    [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                    (click)="cart.remove(item.productId)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div class="pos-cart-item__controls">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    title="Disminuir"
                    [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                    (click)="decrement(item.productId)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="minusIcon" />
                  </button>

                  <input
                    class="admin-input"
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    step="1"
                    [max]="item.stockAvailable"
                    [value]="item.quantity"
                    [readOnly]="cart.locked() || processing()"
                    (change)="changeQuantity(item.productId, $any($event.target).value)"
                  />

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="admin-icon-button"
                    title="Aumentar"
                    [disabled]="cart.locked() || processing() || item.quantity >= item.stockAvailable"
                    (click)="increment(item.productId)"
                  >
                    <fa-icon [icon]="plusIcon" />
                  </button>

                  <div class="pos-cart-item__price">
                    <small>{{ item.currency }} {{ item.unitPrice | number:'1.2-2' }} c/u</small>
                    <strong>
                      {{ item.currency }}
                      {{ item.unitPrice * item.quantity | number:'1.2-2' }}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                </div>

                @if (item.quantity > item.stockAvailable) {
                  <small class="pos-cart-item__error">
                    Stock actual: {{ item.stockAvailable | number:'1.0-3' }}.
                  </small>
                }
              </div>
            </article>
          } @empty {
            <div class="pos-cart-empty">
              <fa-icon [icon]="cartIcon" />
              <strong>Carrito vacío</strong>
              <span>Agregue productos desde el catálogo.</span>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <section class="pos-payment" [formGroup]="paymentForm">
          <div class="pos-payment__heading">
            <div>
              <fa-icon [icon]="paymentIcon" />
              <strong>Cobro</strong>
            </div>
            <small>Datos para finalizar la venta</small>
          </div>

          <div class="pos-payment__fields">
            <label class="pos-field">
              <span>Método de pago</span>
              <select
                class="admin-select"
                formControlName="paymentMethodId"
                [disabled]="processing()"
              >
                <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                @for (method of paymentMethods(); track method.paymentMethodId) {
                  <option [value]="method.paymentMethodId">
                    {{ method.name }}
                  </option>
                }
              </select>
            </label>

            @if (selectedPaymentMethod()?.requiresOperationNumber) {
              <label class="pos-field">
                <span>Número de operación</span>
                <input
                  class="admin-input"
                  type="text"
                  maxlength="120"
                  autocomplete="off"
                  placeholder="Código o referencia del pago"
                  formControlName="operationNumber"
                  [readOnly]="processing()"
                />
              </label>
            }

            <label class="pos-field pos-field--full">
              <span>Observación <em>Opcional</em></span>
              <textarea
                class="admin-textarea pos-observation"
                rows="3"
                maxlength="500"
                placeholder="Detalle adicional de la venta"
                formControlName="observation"
                [readOnly]="processing() || cart.locked()"
              ></textarea>
              <small>Máximo 500 caracteres.</small>
            </label>
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer class="pos-cart__footer">
          <section class="pos-cart__totals">
            <div>
              <span>Unidades</span>
              <strong>{{ cart.itemCount() }}</strong>
            </div>

            <div class="pos-cart__grand-total">
              <span>Total estimado</span>
              <strong>
                {{ cart.currency() }}
                {{ cart.total() | number:'1.2-2' }}
              </strong>
            </div>

            <small>
              El backend vuelve a validar precio vigente y stock antes de registrar el cobro.
            </small>
          </section>

          @if (checkoutError()) {
            <div class="admin-inline-error pos-checkout-message">
              {{ checkoutError() }}
            </div>
          }

          @if (lastSaleId()) {
            <div class="pos-success-note">
              Última venta completada: #{{ lastSaleId() }}
            </div>
          }

          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-primary-button pos-checkout-button"
            [disabled]="!canCheckout()"
            (click)="checkout()"
          >
            @if (processing()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="pageIcon" />
            }
            {{ checkoutLabel() }}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </aside>
    </div>
  }
</div>

<dialog
  #manualCustomerDialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); closeManualCustomer()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">

        <span class="admin-modal-icon">

      <button
        type="button"

        [disabled]="manualSaving()"

        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />

    <div class="pos-manual-document">
      <span>
        {{ customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA' ? 'Empresa' : 'Persona' }}

    <div class="pos-inline-note pos-inline-note--warning">

    <form

        <app-form-error
          [control]="manualForm.controls.email"
          fieldLabel="El correo"
        />
      </div>

      <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="admin-secondary-button"
          [disabled]="manualSaving()"
          (click)="closeManualCustomer()"
        >
          Cancelar
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="manualSaving()"
        >
          @if (manualSaving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="customerIcon" />
            Registrar cliente
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCartShopping,
  faCashRegister,
  faCreditCard,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faMinus,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTrash,
  faUserCheck,
  faWarehouse,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../../../../../core/access/access.store';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { CargarPosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cargar-pos.use-case';
import { ProcesarVentaPosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/procesar-venta-pos.use-case';
import { ResolverClientePosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/resolver-cliente-pos.use-case';
import {
  PosCustomer,
  PosCustomerType,
  PosDocumentType,
  PosPaymentMethod,
  PosProduct,
} from '../../../../../domain/pos.model';
import { PosCartStore } from '../../../../../state/pos-cart.store';
import { PosProductImageComponent } from '../../components/pos-product-image/pos-product-image';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-pos-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    PosProductImageComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './pos-page.html',
  styleUrl: './pos-page.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PosPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('manualCustomerDialog', { static: true })
  private readonly manualCustomerDialog!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly loadPos = inject(CargarPosUseCase);
  private readonly resolveCustomerUseCase = inject(ResolverClientePosUseCase);
  private readonly checkoutUseCase = inject(ProcesarVentaPosUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly cart = inject(PosCartStore);

  readonly contextLoading = signal(false);
  readonly catalogLoading = signal(false);
  readonly customerLoading = signal(false);
  readonly manualSaving = signal(false);
  readonly processing = signal(false);

  readonly contextError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly catalogError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly customerMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly customerTone = signal<'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'>('neutral');
  readonly checkoutError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly lastSaleId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly {
    warehouseId: number;
    code: string;
    name: string;
  }[]>([]);
  readonly paymentMethods = signal<readonly PosPaymentMethod[]>([]);
  readonly catalog = signal<readonly PosProduct[]>([]);
  readonly search = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faCashRegister;
  readonly cartIcon = faCartShopping;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly plusIcon = faPlus;
  readonly minusIcon = faMinus;
  readonly trashIcon = faTrash;
  readonly customerIcon = faUserCheck;
  readonly paymentIcon = faCreditCard;
  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly filteredCatalog = computed(() => {
    const term = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) {
      return this.catalog();
    }

    return this.catalog().filter((product) =>
      [
        product.code,
        product.name,
        product.description ?? '',
        product.category ?? '',
      ].some((value) =>
        value.toLowerCase().includes(term),
      ),
    );
  });

  readonly customerForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    type: ['PERSONA' as PosCustomerType, [Validators.required]],
    documentType: ['DNI' as PosDocumentType, [Validators.required]],
    documentNumber: ['', [Validators.required]],
  });

  readonly manualForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    names: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    paternalSurname: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    maternalSurname: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
    businessName: ['', [Validators.maxLength(200)]],
    phone: ['', [Validators.maxLength(30)]],
    email: ['', [Validators.email, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
  });

  readonly paymentForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    paymentMethodId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    operationNumber: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observation: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const uotId = this.uot.selectedId();
    const userId = this.access.user()?.usuarioId ?? 0;

    if (
      this.uot.isGeneral()
      || !uotId
      || uotId <= 0
      || userId <= 0
    ) {
      this.contextError.set(
        'El POS requiere una UOT específica. Seleccione una UOT antes de vender.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.cart.initialize(userId, uotId);
    this.loadContext();
  }

  loadContext(): void {
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();

    if (!uotId) {
      return;
    }

    this.contextLoading.set(true);
    this.contextError.set(null);

    this.loadPos
      .context(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.contextLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ warehouses, paymentMethods }) => {
          this.warehouses.set(warehouses);
          this.paymentMethods.set(paymentMethods);

          const paymentId =
            this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value;

          if (
            !paymentMethods.some(
              (item) => item.paymentMethodId === paymentId,
            )
          ) {
            this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.setValue(
              paymentMethods[0]?.paymentMethodId ?? 0,
            );
          }

          const currentWarehouseId = this.cart.warehouseId();
          const currentExists = warehouses.some(
            (item) => item.warehouseId === currentWarehouseId,
          );

          if (currentExists && currentWarehouseId) {
            this.loadCatalog();
            return;
          }

          if (this.cart.items().length > 0) {
            this.contextError.set(
              'El almacén guardado en el carrito ya no está disponible. No se modificó el borrador para evitar inconsistencias.',
            );
            return;
          }

          const firstWarehouseId =
            warehouses[0]?.warehouseId ?? 0;

          if (firstWarehouseId > 0) {
            this.cart.setWarehouse(firstWarehouseId);
            this.loadCatalog();
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.contextError.set(
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  loadCatalog(): void {
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();
    const warehouseId = this.cart.warehouseId();

    if (!uotId || !warehouseId) {
      this.catalog.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.catalogLoading.set(true);
    this.catalogError.set(null);

    this.loadPos
      .catalog(uotId, warehouseId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.catalogLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (products) => {
          this.catalog.set(products);
          this.cart.syncCatalog(products);
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.catalogError.set(
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  changeWarehouse(value: string): void {
    const warehouseId = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(warehouseId) || warehouseId <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (!this.cart.setWarehouse(warehouseId)) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Carrito activo',
        'Vacíe el carrito antes de cambiar de almacén.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.loadCatalog();
  }

  add(product: PosProduct): void {
    const error = this.cart.add(product);

    if (error) {
      this.toast.warning('No se agregó el producto', error);
    }
  }

  increment(productId: number): void {
    const item = this.cart.items().find(
      (candidate) => candidate.productId === productId,
    );

    if (!item) {
      return;
    }

    const error = this.cart.setQuantity(
      productId,
      item.quantity + 1,
    );

    if (error) {
      this.toast.warning('Cantidad no disponible', error);
    }
  }

  decrement(productId: number): void {
    const item = this.cart.items().find(
      (candidate) => candidate.productId === productId,
    );

    if (!item) {
      return;
    }

    this.cart.setQuantity(
      productId,
      item.quantity - 1,
    );
  }

  changeQuantity(productId: number, value: string): void {
    const quantity = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity)) {
      return;
    }

    const error = this.cart.setQuantity(
      productId,
      quantity,
    );

    if (error) {
      this.toast.warning('Cantidad no disponible', error);
    }
  }

  clearCart(): void {
    if (!this.cart.clearEditableCart()) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Venta en proceso',
        'No se puede vaciar un carrito que ya inició el registro de la venta.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.customerMessage.set(null);
    this.customerTone.set('neutral');
    this.checkoutError.set(null);
  }

  onCustomerTypeChange(): void {
    const type = this.customerForm.controls.type.value;

    if (type === 'EMPRESA') {
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.setValue('RUC');
    } else if (
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value !== 'DNI'
      && this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value !== 'RUC'
    ) {
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.setValue('DNI');
    }

    this.resetCustomerSelection();
  }

  onCustomerDocumentTypeChange(): void {
    if (this.customerForm.controls.type.value === 'EMPRESA') {
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.setValue('RUC');
    }

    this.resetCustomerSelection();
  }

  onCustomerDocumentInput(): void {
    const type = this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value;
    const control = this.customerForm.controls.documentNumber;
    const sanitized = control.value.replace(/\D+/g, '').slice(
      0,
      type === 'DNI' ? 8 : 11,
    );

    if (sanitized !== control.value) {
      control.setValue(sanitized, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    this.resetCustomerSelection();
  }

  resolveCustomer(): void {
    const type = this.customerForm.controls.type.value;
    const documentType =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value;
    const documentNumber =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentNumber.value.trim();

    if (
      !this.validDocument(
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
      )
    ) {
      this.customerTone.set('error');
      this.customerMessage.set(
        documentType === 'DNI'
          ? 'El DNI debe contener 8 dígitos.'
          : 'El RUC debe contener 11 dígitos.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.customerLoading.set(true);
    this.customerTone.set('neutral');
    this.customerMessage.set(null);

    this.resolveCustomerUseCase
      .resolve(
        type,
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
      )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.customerLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.customerMessage.set(result.message);

          if (result.customer) {
            this.customerTone.set('success');
            this.cart.setCustomer(result.customer);
            this.toast.success(
              result.source === 'FACTILIZA'
                ? 'Cliente importado desde Factiliza'
                : 'Cliente encontrado',
              result.customer.displayName,
            );
            return;
          }

          this.cart.setCustomer(null);

          if (result.manualEntryAllowed) {
            this.customerTone.set('warning');
            this.openManualCustomer();
            return;
          }

          this.customerTone.set('neutral');
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.customerTone.set('error');
          this.customerMessage.set(message);
          this.cart.setCustomer(null);
        },
      });
  }

  openManualCustomer(): void {
    if (this.cart.locked()) {
      return;
    }

    this.manualForm.reset({
      names: '',
      paternalSurname: '',
      maternalSurname: '',
      businessName: '',
      phone: '',
      email: '',
    });

    this.manualCustomerDialog.nativeElement.showModal();
  }

  closeManualCustomer(): void {
    if (
      !this.manualSaving()
      && this.manualCustomerDialog.nativeElement.open
    ) {
      this.manualCustomerDialog.nativeElement.close();
    }
  }

  saveManualCustomer(): void {
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();

    if (!uotId || this.manualSaving()) {
      return;
    }

    this.manualForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.manualForm.invalid) {
      return;
    }

    const type = this.customerForm.controls.type.value;
    const documentType =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value;
    const documentNumber =
      this.customerForm.controls.documentNumber.value.trim();
    const raw = this.manualForm.getRawValue();

    if (type === 'PERSONA') {
      if (!raw.names.trim() || !raw.paternalSurname.trim()) {
        this.toast.warning(
          'Datos incompletos',
          'Ingrese nombres y apellido paterno del cliente.',
        );
        return;
      }
    } else if (!raw.businessName.trim()) {
      this.toast.warning(
        'Datos incompletos',
        'Ingrese la razón social del cliente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.manualSaving.set(true);

    this.resolveCustomerUseCase
      .registerManual({
        uotId,
        type,
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
        names: raw.names.trim() || undefined,
        paternalSurname:
          raw.paternalSurname.trim() || undefined,
        maternalSurname:
          raw.maternalSurname.trim() || undefined,
        businessName:
          raw.businessName.trim() || undefined,
        phone: raw.phone.trim() || undefined,
        email:
          raw.email.trim().toLowerCase() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.manualSaving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (customer) => {
          this.cart.setCustomer(customer);
          this.customerTone.set('success');
          this.customerMessage.set(
            'Cliente registrado manualmente y seleccionado para la venta.',
          );
          this.closeManualCustomer();
          this.toast.success(
            'Cliente registrado',
            customer.displayName,
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo registrar el cliente',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  checkout(): void {
    const draft = this.cart.draft();
    const uotId = this.currentUotId();
    const warehouseId = this.cart.warehouseId();
    const customer = this.cart.customer();
    const paymentMethodId =
      Number(this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value);
    const method = this.selectedPaymentMethod();

    this.checkoutError.set(null);

    if (
      !draft
      || !uotId
      || !warehouseId
      || !customer
      || this.cart.items().length === 0
      || paymentMethodId <= 0
    ) {
      this.checkoutError.set(
        'Seleccione almacén, cliente, productos y método de pago antes de finalizar.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      this.cart.items().some(
        (item) =>
          item.quantity <= 0
          || item.quantity > item.stockAvailable,
      )
    ) {
      this.checkoutError.set(
        'Revise las cantidades del carrito. Uno o más productos ya no tienen stock suficiente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const operationNumber =
      this.paymentForm.controls.operationNumber.value.trim();

    if (
      method?.requiresOperationNumber
      && !operationNumber
    ) {
      this.checkoutError.set(
        'El método de pago seleccionado requiere número de operación.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.processing.set(true);

    this.checkoutUseCase
      .execute({
        uotId,
        warehouseId,
        customer,
        items: this.cart.items(),
        paymentMethodId,
        paymentOperation:
          operationNumber || undefined,
        observation:
          this.paymentForm.controls.observation.value.trim()
          || undefined,
        pendingSaleId: draft.pendingSaleId,
        createIdempotencyKey:
          draft.createIdempotencyKey,
        paymentIdempotencyKey:
          draft.paymentIdempotencyKey,
        deliveryIdempotencyKey:
          draft.deliveryIdempotencyKey,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.processing.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.lastSaleId.set(result.saleId);

          this.toast.success(
            `Venta #${result.saleId} completada`,
            `${result.currency} ${result.total.toFixed(2)} · ${result.state}`,
          );

          this.cart.clearAfterSuccess();
          this.customerForm.reset({
            type: 'PERSONA',
            documentType: 'DNI',
            documentNumber: '',
          });
          this.customerMessage.set(null);
          this.customerTone.set('neutral');
          this.paymentForm.controls.operationNumber.setValue('');
          this.paymentForm.controls.observation.setValue('');
          this.loadCatalog();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const baseMessage = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          const recovery = this.cart.locked()
            ? ' La venta quedó protegida para reintento; vuelva a pulsar “Reanudar venta” sin modificar el carrito.'
            : '';

          this.checkoutError.set(
            `${baseMessage}${recovery}`,
          );

          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo completar la venta',
            `${baseMessage}${recovery}`,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  customerSourceLabel(customer: PosCustomer): string {
    switch (customer.source) {
      case 'FACTILIZA':
        return 'Importado con Factiliza';
      case 'MANUAL':
        return 'Registro manual';
      default:
        return 'Registrado en DESCO';
    }
  }

  selectedPaymentMethod(): PosPaymentMethod | null {
    const id =
      Number(this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value);

    return this.paymentMethods().find(
      (method) => method.paymentMethodId === id,
    ) ?? null;
  }

  customerDocumentMaxLength(): number {
    return this.customerForm.controls.documentType.value === 'DNI'
      ? 8
      : 11;
  }

  checkoutLabel(): string {
    if (this.processing()) {
      return 'Procesando venta...';
    }

    const saleId = this.cart.pendingSaleId();

    if (saleId) {
      return `Reanudar venta #${saleId}`;
    }

    if (this.cart.creationUncertain()) {
      return 'Reanudar venta';
    }

    return 'Cobrar y entregar';
  }

  canCheckout(): boolean {
    return !this.processing()
      && this.currentUotId() !== null
      && this.cart.warehouseId() !== null
      && this.cart.customer() !== null
      && this.cart.items().length > 0
      && Number(
        this.paymentForm.controls.paymentMethodId.value,
      ) > 0;
  }

  private currentUotId(): number | null {
    const id = this.uot.selectedId();

    return id && id > 0
      ? id
      : null;
  }

  private validDocument(
    type: PosDocumentType,
    value: string,
  ): boolean {
    return type === 'DNI'
      ? /^\d{8}$/.test(value)
      : /^\d{11}$/.test(value);
  }

  private resetCustomerSelection(): void {
    if (this.cart.locked()) {
      return;
    }

    this.cart.setCustomer(null);
    this.customerMessage.set(null);
    this.customerTone.set('neutral');
  }
}
```
