- Ruta: `src/app/features/pos/adapter/out/http/pos-http.adapter.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\pos\adapter\out\http\pos-http.adapter.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/pos/adapter/out/http/pos-http.adapter.ts`

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { forkJoin, map } from 'rxjs';

import { POSVentasService } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/pOSVentas.service';
import { SaleCreateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleCreateRequest';
import { SaleManualCustomerRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/saleManualCustomerRequest';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { IdentityResolverService } from '../../../../../shared/identity/identity-resolver.service';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import {
  PosCustomer,
  PosCustomerResolution,
  PosCustomerResolutionSource,
  PosDocumentType,
  PosManualCustomerInput,
  PosPaymentMethod,
  PosProduct,
  PosSaleCreateInput,
  PosSaleSnapshot,
  PosWarehouse,
  PosCustomerType,
} from '../../../domain/pos.model';
import { PosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/pos.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class PosHttpAdapter implements PosGateway {
  private readonly sales = inject(POSVentasService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly identities = inject(IdentityResolverService);

  listWarehouses(uotId: number) {
    return this.resources
      .listWarehouses(uotId)
      .pipe(
        map((items) =>
          items
            .filter(
              (item) =>
                item.estado !== false
                && item.permiteSalida !== false
                && Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) > 0,
            )
            .map(
              (item): PosWarehouse => ({
                warehouseId: Number(item.almacenId),
                code: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
                name: item.nombre?.trim() ?? 'Almacén',
              }),
            )
            .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
        ),
      );
  }

  listCatalog(uotId: number, warehouseId: number) {
    return forkJoin({
      products: this.resources.listAllProducts(uotId),
      stock: this.resources.listStock(uotId, warehouseId),
    }).pipe(
      map(({ products, stock }) => {
        const stockByProduct = new Map(
          stock
            .filter(
              (item) =>
                Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) === warehouseId
                && Number(item.productoId ?? 0) > 0,
            )
            .map(
              (item) => [
                Number(item.productoId),
                Number(item.stockDisponible ?? 0),
              ] as const,
            ),
        );

        return products
          .map((item): PosProduct => ({
            productId: Number(item.productoId ?? 0),
            code: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
            name: item.nombre?.trim() ?? 'Producto',
            description: item.descripcion?.trim() || null,
            unit:
              item.unidadMedidaNombre?.trim()
              || item.unidadMedidaCodigo?.trim()
              || 'UND',
            category:
              item.categoriaNombre?.trim()
              || item.categoriaCodigo?.trim()
              || null,
            unitPrice: Number(item.precioVigente ?? 0),
            initialPrice: Number(item.precioInicial ?? 0),
            currency: item.moneda?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
            stockAvailable:
              stockByProduct.get(Number(item.productoId ?? 0)) ?? 0,
            imageFileId:
              Number(item.archivoPrincipalId ?? 0) > 0
                ? Number(item.archivoPrincipalId)
                : null,
            imageUrl: item.imagenPrincipalUrl?.trim() || null,
          }))
          .filter(
            (item) =>
              item.productId > 0
              && item.unitPrice > 0
              && item.stockAvailable > 0,
          )
          .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
      }),
    );
  }

  listPaymentMethods() {
    return this.sales
      .ventasMetodosPagoListar(
        {},
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            (unwrapApiResponse(response) ?? [])
              .map(
                (item): PosPaymentMethod => ({
                  paymentMethodId: Number(item.metodoPagoId ?? 0),
                  code: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
                  name: item.nombre?.trim() ?? 'Método de pago',
                  requiresOperationNumber:
                    item.requiereNumeroOperacion === true,
                }),
              )
              .filter((item) => item.paymentMethodId > 0),
        ),
      );
  }

  resolveCustomer(
    type: PosCustomerType,
    documentType: PosDocumentType,
    documentNumber: string,
  ) {
    return this.identities
      .resolve(
        type,
        documentType,
        documentNumber,
      )
      .pipe(
        map((result): PosCustomerResolution => {
          const source: PosCustomerResolutionSource =
            result.found
              ? result.insertedAutomatically
                ? 'FACTILIZA'
                : 'LOCAL'
              : result.manualEntryAllowed
                ? 'MANUAL'
                : 'PENDING';

          const customer =
            result.found && result.entityId
              ? {
                  type,
                  personId:
                    type === 'PERSONA'
                      ? result.entityId
                      : null,
                  companyId:
                    type === 'EMPRESA'
                      ? result.entityId
                      : null,
                  documentType,
                  documentNumber:
                    result.documentNumber ?? documentNumber,
                  displayName:
                    type === 'EMPRESA'
                      ? result.businessName
                        ?? result.message
                        ?? documentNumber
                      : this.personName(result)
                        || result.message
                        || documentNumber,
                  source:
                    source === 'PENDING'
                      ? 'LOCAL'
                      : source,
                }
              : null;

          return {
            customer,
            found: result.found,
            manualEntryAllowed: result.manualEntryAllowed,
            source,
            importedAutomatically: result.insertedAutomatically,
            message: this.customerResolutionMessage(
              source,
              result.message,
            ),
          };
        }),
      );
  }

  registerManualCustomer(input: PosManualCustomerInput) {
    const body: SaleManualCustomerRequest = {
      uotId: input.uotId,
      tipoCliente: input.type,
      tipoDocumento: input.documentType,
      numeroDocumento: input.documentNumber,
      nombres: input.names,
      apellidoPaterno: input.paternalSurname,
      apellidoMaterno: input.maternalSurname,
      razonSocial: input.businessName,
      telefono: input.phone,
      correo: input.email,
    };

    return this.sales
      .ventasClientesRegistrarManual(
        {
          saleManualCustomerRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response): PosCustomer => {
          const item = unwrapApiResponse(response);

          if (!item) {
            throw new Error(
              'El backend no devolvió el cliente registrado.',
            );
          }

          const personId =
            Number(item.clientePersonaId ?? 0) > 0
              ? Number(item.clientePersonaId)
              : null;
          const companyId =
            Number(item.clienteEmpresaId ?? 0) > 0
              ? Number(item.clienteEmpresaId)
              : null;

          return {
            type: item.tipoCliente === 'EMPRESA'
              ? 'EMPRESA'
              : 'PERSONA',
            personId,
            companyId,
            documentType:
              item.tipoDocumento === 'RUC'
                ? 'RUC'
                : 'DNI',
            documentNumber:
              item.numeroDocumento?.trim()
              || input.documentNumber,
            displayName:
              item.nombreCliente?.trim()
              || input.businessName
              || [
                input.names,
                input.paternalSurname,
                input.maternalSurname,
              ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' ')
              || input.documentNumber,
            source: 'MANUAL',
          };
        }),
      );
  }

  createSale(
    input: PosSaleCreateInput,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ) {
    const body: SaleCreateRequest = {
      uotId: input.uotId,
      almacenId: input.warehouseId,
      clientePersonaId:
        input.customer.personId ?? undefined,
      clienteEmpresaId:
        input.customer.companyId ?? undefined,
      detalle: input.items.map((item) => ({
        productoId: item.productId,
        cantidad: item.quantity,
      })),
      separar: false,
      observacion: input.observation?.trim() || undefined,
    };

    return this.sales
      .ventasCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
          saleCreateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => {
          const saleId =
            Number(
              unwrapApiResponse(response)?.ventaId ?? 0,
            );

          if (saleId <= 0) {
            throw new Error(
              'El backend no devolvió el identificador de la venta.',
            );
          }

          return saleId;
        }),
      );
  }

  getSale(saleId: number) {
    return this.sales
      .ventasVer(
        { id: saleId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response): PosSaleSnapshot => {
          const detail = unwrapApiResponse(response);
          const sale = detail?.venta;

          if (!sale?.ventaId) {
            throw new Error(
              'No fue posible recuperar la venta.',
            );
          }

          return {
            saleId: Number(sale.ventaId),
            total: Number(sale.total ?? 0),
            paid: Number(sale.pagado ?? 0),
            balance: Number(sale.saldo ?? 0),
            state: sale.estadoVenta?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'REGISTRADA',
            currency: sale.moneda?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN',
          };
        }),
      );
  }

  paySale(
    saleId: number,
    paymentMethodId: number,
    amount: number,
    operationNumber: string | undefined,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ) {
    return this.sales
      .ventasRegistrarPago(
        {
          id: saleId,
          xIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
          salePaymentRequest: {
            metodoPagoId: paymentMethodId,
            importe: amount,
            numeroOperacion:
              operationNumber?.trim() || undefined,
          },
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map(() => void 0));
  }

  deliverSale(
    saleId: number,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ) {
    return this.sales
      .ventasEntregar(
        {
          id: saleId,
          xIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map(() => void 0));
  }

  private customerResolutionMessage(
    source: PosCustomerResolutionSource,
    fallback: string,
  ): string {
    switch (source) {
      case 'FACTILIZA':
        return 'El cliente no existía en DESCO. Factiliza validó el documento y el backend guardó el registro automáticamente.';
      case 'LOCAL':
        return 'Cliente encontrado en DESCO. Se reutilizará el registro existente.';
      case 'MANUAL':
        return 'Factiliza no pudo completar la validación con datos utilizables. Puede registrar el cliente manualmente.';
      default:
        return fallback?.trim()
          || 'La validación automática sigue en proceso. Intente nuevamente en unos segundos.';
    }
  }

  private personName(
    result: {
      names: string | null;
      paternalSurname: string | null;
      maternalSurname: string | null;
    },
  ): string {
    return [
      result.names,
      result.paternalSurname,
      result.maternalSurname,
    ]
      .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value?.trim()))
      .join(' ')
      .trim();
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { InjectionToken } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {
  PosCustomerResolution,
  PosDocumentType,
  PosManualCustomerInput,
  PosPaymentMethod,
  PosProduct,
  PosSaleCreateInput,
  PosSaleSnapshot,
  PosWarehouse,
} from '../../../domain/pos.model';
import { PosCustomer, PosCustomerType } from '../../../domain/pos.model';

export interface PosGateway {
  listWarehouses(uotId: number): Observable<readonly PosWarehouse[]>;
  listCatalog(uotId: number, warehouseId: number): Observable<readonly PosProduct[]>;
  listPaymentMethods(): Observable<readonly PosPaymentMethod[]>;

  resolveCustomer(
    type: PosCustomerType,
    documentType: PosDocumentType,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): Observable<PosCustomerResolution>;

  registerManualCustomer(input: PosManualCustomerInput): Observable<PosCustomer>;

  createSale(
    input: PosSaleCreateInput,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ): Observable<number>;

  getSale(saleId: number): Observable<PosSaleSnapshot>;

  paySale(
    saleId: number,
    paymentMethodId: number,
    amount: number,
    operationNumber: string | undefined,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ): Observable<void>;

  deliverSale(
    saleId: number,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ): Observable<void>;
}

export const POS_GATEWAY =
  new InjectionToken<PosGateway>('POS_GATEWAY');
```

```typescript
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { POS_GATEWAY, PosGateway } from '../port/out/pos.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class CargarPosUseCase {
  constructor(
```

### 1287. `src/app/features/pos/application/use-case/procesar-venta-pos.use-case.ts`

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/pos/application/use-case/procesar-venta-pos.use-case.ts`

```typescript
import { Inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  Observable,
  catchError,
  map,
  of,
  switchMap,
  tap,
  throwError,
} from 'rxjs';

import { PosCheckoutInput, PosCheckoutResult } from '../../domain/pos.model';
import { PosCartStore } from '../../state/pos-cart.store';
import { POS_GATEWAY, PosGateway } from '../port/out/pos.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class ProcesarVentaPosUseCase {
  constructor(
    @Inject(POS_GATEWAY)
    private readonly gateway: PosGateway,
    private readonly cart: PosCartStore,
  ) {}

  execute(input: PosCheckoutInput): Observable<PosCheckoutResult> {
    const sale$ = input.pendingSaleId
      ? this.gateway.getSale(input.pendingSaleId)
      : this.gateway
          .createSale(
            {
              uotId: input.uotId,
              warehouseId: input.warehouseId,
              customer: input.customer,
              items: input.items,
              observation: input.observation,
            },
            input.createIdempotencyKey,
          )
          .pipe(
            tap((saleId) => {
              this.cart.markPendingSale(saleId);
              this.cart.markCreationUncertain(false);
            }),
            switchMap((saleId) => this.gateway.getSale(saleId)),
            catchError((error) => {
              this.cart.markCreationUncertain(this.isTransient(error));
              return throwError(() => error);
            }),
          );

    return sale$.pipe(
      switchMap((sale) => {
        if (sale.state === 'ANULADA') {
          return throwError(
            () => new Error('La venta pendiente fue anulada y no puede continuar.'),
          );
        }

        this.cart.markPendingSale(sale.saleId);

        if (sale.balance <= 0) {
          return of(sale);
        }

        return this.gateway
          .paySale(
            sale.saleId,
            input.paymentMethodId,
            sale.balance,
            input.paymentOperation,
            input.paymentIdempotencyKey,
          )
          .pipe(
            switchMap(() => this.gateway.getSale(sale.saleId)),
          );
      }),
      switchMap((sale) => {
        if (sale.state === 'ENTREGADA') {
          return of(sale);
        }

        return this.gateway
          .deliverSale(
            sale.saleId,
            input.deliveryIdempotencyKey,
          )
          .pipe(
            switchMap(() => this.gateway.getSale(sale.saleId)),
          );
      }),
      map((sale) => ({
        saleId: sale.saleId,
        total: sale.total,
        currency: sale.currency,
        state: sale.state,
      })),
    );
  }

  private isTransient(error: unknown): boolean {
    if (!error || typeof error !== 'object' || !('status' in error)) {
      return false;
    }

    const status = Number((error as { status?: unknown }).status);

    return status === 0
      || status === 408
      || status === 425
      || status === 429
      || (Number.isFinite(status) && status >= 500);
  }
}
```

- Ruta: `src/app/features/pos/state/pos-cart.store.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\pos\state\pos-cart.store.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/pos/state/pos-cart.store.ts`

```typescript
import { isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
import {
  Inject,
  Injectable,
  PLATFORM_ID,
  computed,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  PosCartDraft,
  PosCartItem,
  PosCustomer,
  PosProduct,
} from '../domain/pos.model';

@Injectable()
export class PosCartStore {
  private readonly storagePrefix = 'desco:pos:cart:v1';
  private storageKey: string | null = null;

  private readonly draftSignal = signal<PosCartDraft | null>(null);

  readonly draft = this.draftSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly items = computed(() => this.draftSignal()?.items ?? []);
  readonly customer = computed(() => this.draftSignal()?.customer ?? null);
  readonly warehouseId = computed(() => this.draftSignal()?.warehouseId ?? null);
  readonly pendingSaleId = computed(() => this.draftSignal()?.pendingSaleId ?? null);
  readonly creationUncertain = computed(
    () => this.draftSignal()?.creationUncertain ?? false,
  );
  readonly locked = computed(
    () => this.pendingSaleId() !== null || this.creationUncertain(),
  );
  readonly currency = computed(
    () => this.items()[0]?.currency ?? 'PEN',
  );
  readonly total = computed(() =>
    this.items().reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.unitPrice * item.quantity,
      0,
    ),
  );
  readonly itemCount = computed(() =>
    this.items().reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0),
  );

  constructor(
    private readonly idempotency: IdempotencyKeyService,
    @Inject(PLATFORM_ID)
    private readonly platformId: object,
  ) {}

  initialize(userId: number, uotId: number): void {
    this.storageKey =
      `${this.storagePrefix}:${userId}:${uotId}`;

    const stored = this.read();

    if (
      stored
      && stored.version === 1
      && stored.userId === userId
      && stored.uotId === uotId
    ) {
      this.draftSignal.set(stored);
      return;
    }

    this.draftSignal.set(
      this.emptyDraft(userId, uotId),
    );
    this.persist();
  }

  setWarehouse(warehouseId: number): boolean {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (
      current.warehouseId === warehouseId
      || warehouseId <= 0
    ) {
      return current.warehouseId === warehouseId;
    }

    if (current.items.length > 0 || this.locked()) {
      return false;
    }

    this.update({
      ...current,
      warehouseId,
    });

    return true;
  }

  setCustomer(customer: PosCustomer | null): void {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (this.locked()) {
      return;
    }

    this.update({
      ...current,
      customer,
    });
  }

  add(product: PosProduct): string | null {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (this.locked()) {
      return 'La venta ya está en proceso. Finalícela antes de modificar el carrito.';
    }

    if (product.stockAvailable <= 0) {
      return 'El producto no tiene stock disponible.';
    }

    const currentCurrency =
      current.items[0]?.currency ?? product.currency;

    if (currentCurrency !== product.currency) {
      return 'No se pueden mezclar productos con monedas distintas en una misma venta.';
    }

    const existing = current.items.find(
      (item) => item.productId === product.productId,
    );

    if (existing) {
      if (existing.quantity >= product.stockAvailable) {
        return 'La cantidad ya alcanzó el stock disponible.';
      }

      const items = current.items.map((item) =>
        item.productId === product.productId
          ? {
              ...item,
              unitPrice: product.unitPrice,
              initialPrice: product.initialPrice,
              stockAvailable: product.stockAvailable,
              quantity: item.quantity + 1,
            }
          : item,
      );

      this.update({ ...current, items });
      return null;
    }

    const item: PosCartItem = {
      productId: product.productId,
      code: product.code,
      name: product.name,
      unit: product.unit,
      unitPrice: product.unitPrice,
      initialPrice: product.initialPrice,
      currency: product.currency,
      quantity: 1,
      stockAvailable: product.stockAvailable,
      imageFileId: product.imageFileId,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
    };

    this.update({
      ...current,
      items: [...current.items, item],
    });

    return null;
  }

  setQuantity(
    productId: number,
    quantity: number,
  ): string | null {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (this.locked()) {
      return 'La venta ya está en proceso. No puede modificar cantidades.';
    }

    const item = current.items.find(
      (candidate) => candidate.productId === productId,
    );

    if (!item) {
      return null;
    }

    if (quantity <= 0) {
      this.remove(productId);
      return null;
    }

    if (quantity > item.stockAvailable) {
      return `Stock disponible: ${item.stockAvailable}.`;
    }

    this.update({
      ...current,
      items: current.items.map((candidate) =>
        candidate.productId === productId
          ? { ...candidate, quantity }
          : candidate,
      ),
    });

    return null;
  }

  remove(productId: number): void {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (this.locked()) {
      return;
    }

    this.update({
      ...current,
      items: current.items.filter(
        (item) => item.productId !== productId,
      ),
    });
  }

  syncCatalog(products: readonly PosProduct[]): void {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (current.items.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const byId = new Map(
      products.map((product) => [product.productId, product] as const),
    );

    const items = current.items.map((item) => {
      const product = byId.get(item.productId);

      if (!product) {
        return {
          ...item,
          stockAvailable: 0,
        };
      }

      return {
        ...item,
        unitPrice: product.unitPrice,
        initialPrice: product.initialPrice,
        currency: product.currency,
        stockAvailable: product.stockAvailable,
        imageFileId: product.imageFileId,
        imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
      };
    });

    this.update({
      ...current,
      items,
    });
  }

  markPendingSale(saleId: number): void {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    this.update({
      ...current,
      pendingSaleId: saleId,
      creationUncertain: false,
    });
  }

  markCreationUncertain(value: boolean): void {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    this.update({
      ...current,
      creationUncertain: value,
    });
  }

  clearAfterSuccess(): void {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    this.draftSignal.set({
      ...this.emptyDraft(
        current.userId,
        current.uotId,
      ),
      warehouseId: current.warehouseId,
    });

    this.persist();
  }

  clearEditableCart(): boolean {
    const current = this.requireDraft();

    if (this.locked()) {
      return false;
    }

    this.update({
      ...this.emptyDraft(
        current.userId,
        current.uotId,
      ),
      warehouseId: current.warehouseId,
    });

    return true;
  }

  private requireDraft(): PosCartDraft {
    const current = this.draftSignal();

    if (!current) {
      throw new Error('El carrito POS todavía no fue inicializado.');
    }

    return current;
  }

  private emptyDraft(
    userId: number,
    uotId: number,
  ): PosCartDraft {
    return {
      version: 1,
      userId,
      uotId,
      warehouseId: null,
      customer: null,
      items: [],
      pendingSaleId: null,
      creationUncertain: false,
      createIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
      paymentIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
      deliveryIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  private update(draft: PosCartDraft): void {
    this.draftSignal.set({
      ...draft,
      items: [...draft.items],
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    this.persist();
  }

  private persist(): void {
    if (
      !this.storageKey
      || !isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const draft = this.draftSignal();

    if (!draft) {
      return;
    }

    localStorage.setItem(
      this.storageKey,
      JSON.stringify(draft),
    );
  }

  private read(): PosCartDraft | null {
    if (
      !this.storageKey
      || !isPlatformBrowser(this.platformId)
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);

      if (!raw) {
        return null;
      }

      const value = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PosCartDraft>;

      if (
        value.version !== 1
        || typeof value.userId !== 'number'
        || typeof value.uotId !== 'number'
        || !Array.isArray(value.items)
        || typeof value.createIdempotencyKey !== 'string'
        || typeof value.paymentIdempotencyKey !== 'string'
        || typeof value.deliveryIdempotencyKey !== 'string'
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        version: 1,
        userId: value.userId,
        uotId: value.uotId,
        warehouseId:
          typeof value.warehouseId === 'number'
            ? value.warehouseId
            : null,
        customer:
          value.customer
            ? value.customer as PosCustomer
            : null,
        items: value.items as PosCartItem[],
        pendingSaleId:
          typeof value.pendingSaleId === 'number'
            ? value.pendingSaleId
            : null,
        creationUncertain: value.creationUncertain === true,
        createIdempotencyKey: value.createIdempotencyKey,
        paymentIdempotencyKey: value.paymentIdempotencyKey,
        deliveryIdempotencyKey: value.deliveryIdempotencyKey,
        updatedAt:
          typeof value.updatedAt === 'string'
            ? value.updatedAt
            : new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}
```

```css
  padding: .75rem;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.warehouse-movement-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.warehouse-lines {
  display: grid;
  gap: .7rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding-top: .8rem;
}

.warehouse-lines > header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem;
}

.warehouse-lines p,
.warehouse-lines h3 {
  margin: 0;
}

.warehouse-lines p {
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: .6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.warehouse-lines h3 {
  margin-top: .12rem;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-size: .82rem;
}

.warehouse-line {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(12rem, 2fr) repeat(5, minmax(7rem, 1fr)) auto;
  gap: .55rem;
  align-items: end;
  border: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  border-radius: .85rem;
  padding: .75rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface-soft);
}

.warehouse-remove {
  margin-bottom: .05rem;
}

@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  .warehouse-line {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .warehouse-line-product {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .warehouse-remove {
    justify-self: end;
  }
}

.warehouse-form-section {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--desco-border);
  padding-bottom: .35rem;
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: .62rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">

          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.codigo" fieldLabel="El código" />

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

        <div class="warehouse-form-section admin-field-span-2">

          <input

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label>Descripción</label>

        <div class="warehouse-form-section admin-field-span-2">

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label>

          <input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="lote" />

        <div class="admin-field">

        <div class="admin-field">

          <input

            formControlName="documentoReferencia"

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">

            formControlName="observacion"

        </div>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>

    } @else {

          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Almacén</label>

              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
              @for (warehouse of warehousesForUnit(); track warehouse.almacenId) {

          <div class="admin-field">

            <input class="admin-input" maxlength="120" formControlName="documentoReferencia" />
          </div>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label>Observación</label>
            <input class="admin-input" maxlength="500" formControlName="observacion" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <section class="warehouse-lines" formArrayName="detalle">
          <header>
            <div><p>Detalle</p><h3>Productos del movimiento</h3></div>
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" (click)="addLine()">
              <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
              Agregar línea
            </button>
          </header>

          @for (line of lines.controls; track $index; let index = $index) {
            <div class="warehouse-line" [formGroupName]="index">
              <div class="admin-field warehouse-line-product">
                <label>Producto</label>
                <select class="admin-select" formControlName="productoId">
                  <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                  @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
                    <option [value]="product.productoId">
                      {{ product.nombre }} · {{ product.codigo }}
                    </option>
                  }
                </select>
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Cantidad</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidad" />
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Costo unitario</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" formControlName="costoUnitario" />
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Moneda</label>
                <select class="admin-select" formControlName="moneda">
                  @for (currency of currencies(); track currency.code) {
                    <option [value]="currency.code">{{ currency.code }}</option>
                  }
                </select>
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Lote</label>
                <input class="admin-input" maxlength="80" formControlName="lote" />
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label>Vencimiento</label>
                <input class="admin-input" type="date" formControlName="fechaVencimiento" />
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                class="admin-icon-button warehouse-remove"
                title="Quitar línea"
                [disabled]="lines.length <= 1"
                (click)="removeLine(index)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="removeIcon" />
              </button>
            </div>
          }
        </section>

        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="actions"></ng-container>
      </form>
    }

    <ng-template #actions>
      <footer class="admin-modal-actions">
        <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
        <button
          type="submit"
          class="admin-primary-button"
          [disabled]="saving() || loadingProducts()"
        >
          @if (saving()) {
            <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            Guardando...
          } @else {
            <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" />
            Guardar
          }
        </button>
      </footer>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
export class AlmacenOperationFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);

  readonly initialPopulationCenterId = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly configureIcon = faBoxesStacked;

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly removeIcon = faTrashCan;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  readonly movementTypes = [
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra, label: 'Compra' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Donacion, label: 'Donación' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Devolucion, label: 'Devolución' },
    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Consumo, label: 'Consumo' },

    { value: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Otro, label: 'Otro' },
  ] as const;

    const warehouseId = Number(this.currentWarehouse()?.almacenId ?? 0);
    const configured = new Set(
      this.stock()
        .filter((item) => Number(item.almacenId ?? 0) === warehouseId)
        .map((item) => Number(item.productoId ?? 0)),

    return this.configureProducts().filter(

        Number(item.productoId ?? 0) > 0 &&
        !configured.has(Number(item.productoId)),
    );
  });

    const productId = Number(this.configureForm.controls.productoId.value);
    return (
      this.configureProducts().find(
        (item) => Number(item.productoId ?? 0) === productId,

    naturaleza: [ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E, [Validators.required]],
    documentoReferencia: ['', [Validators.maxLength(120)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
    detalle: this.fb.array([this.createLine()]),
  });

  get lines(): FormArray {
    return this.movementForm.controls.detalle;
  }

  openCreate(
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    const uotId = this.resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId);

    this.createForm.reset({
      uotId,
      distritoCodigo: '',
      centroPobladoId: 0,
      referencia: '',
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });
    this.initialDistrictCode.set('');
    this.initialPopulationCenterId.set(null);
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
    return this.show();
  }

  openShare(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('share', options, warehouse);
    this.shareForm.reset({
      uotId: 0,
      permiteEntrada: true,
      permiteSalida: true,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  openConfigure(
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('configure', options, warehouse);

    const uotId = this.uot.isSpecific()
      ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? warehouse.uotPropietariaId ?? 0
      : preferredUotId ?? warehouse.uotPropietariaId ?? 0;

    this.configureForm.reset({
      uotId,
      productoId: 0,
      stockInicial: 0,
      stockMinimo: 0,
      costoUnitario: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
      lote: '',
      fechaVencimiento: '',
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });

    this.configureForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL' ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadConfigureProducts();
    return this.show();
  }

  openMovement(
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('movement', options, null);
    this.lines.clear();
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
    this.movementForm.reset({
      uotId: this.resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId),
      almacenId: options.warehouses[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      tipo: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestTipoEnum.Compra,
      naturaleza: ResourceMovementRegisterRequestNaturalezaEnum.E,
      documentoReferencia: '',
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.movementForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.isGeneral() ? 'enable' : 'disable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });
    this.onMovementUnitChange();
    return this.show();
  }

  addLine(): void {
    this.lines.push(this.createLine());
  }

  removeLine(index: number): void {
    if (this.lines.length <= 1) return;
    this.lines.removeAt(index);
  }

  setGeography(selection: GeographySelection): void {
    this.createForm.patchValue({
      distritoCodigo: selection.districtCode,
      centroPobladoId: selection.populationCenterId ?? 0,
    });
    this.createForm.controls.distritoCodigo.markAsTouched();
  }

  onCreateUnitChange(): void {
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  onConfigureUnitChange(): void {
    this.configureForm.controls.productoId.setValue(0);
    this.loadConfigureProducts();
  }

  onConfigureProductChange(): void {
    this.syncConfigureProductRules();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') {
      this.saveShare();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'configure') {
      this.saveConfigure();
    } else if (this.mode() === 'movement') {
      this.saveMovement();
    } else {
      this.saveWarehouse();
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return 'Compartir almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'configure') return 'Agregar producto al almacén';
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return 'Registrar movimiento';
    return 'Registrar almacén';
  }

  icon() {
    if (this.mode() === 'share') return this.shareIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'configure') return this.configureIcon;
    if (this.mode() === 'movement') return this.movementIcon;
    return this.warehouseIcon;
  }

  warehousesForUnit(): readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[] {
    const unitId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.uotId.value);
    if (unitId <= 0) {
      return this.uot.isGeneral() ? [] : this.warehouses();
    }
    return this.warehouses().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.uotPropietariaId === unitId ||
        item.tipoAcceso?.toUpperCase() === 'COMPARTIDO',
    );
  }

  onMovementUnitChange(): void {
    const currentId = Number(this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.value);
    const valid = this.warehousesForUnit().some((x) => x.almacenId === currentId);
    if (!valid) {
      this.movementForm.controls.almacenId.setValue(
        this.warehousesForUnit()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0,
      );
    }
  }

  private saveWarehouse(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.createForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const code = raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase();

    this.run(
      this.api.createWarehouse({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        ubicacion: {
          distritoCodigo: raw.distritoCodigo.trim(),
          centroPobladoId:
            Number(raw.centroPobladoId) > 0
              ? Number(raw.centroPobladoId)
              : undefined,
          referencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.referencia),
        },
        codigo: code || undefined,
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
      }),
      'Almacén registrado',
    );
  }

  private saveShare(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.shareForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (!warehouse?.almacenId || this.shareForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;
    const raw = this.shareForm.getRawValue();

    if (Number(raw.uotId) === warehouse.uotPropietariaId) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Selecciona una UOT distinta de la propietaria.');
      return;
    }

    if (!raw.permiteEntrada && !raw.permiteSalida) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Habilite entrada, salida o ambas para compartir el almacén.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.shareWarehouse(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        permiteEntrada: raw.permiteEntrada,
        permiteSalida: raw.permiteSalida,
      }),
      'Acceso de almacén actualizado',
    );
  }

  private saveConfigure(): void {
    const warehouse = this.currentWarehouse();
    this.syncConfigureProductRules(false);
    this.configureForm.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
    this.configureForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      !warehouse?.almacenId ||
      this.configureForm.invalid ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.loadingProducts()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.configureForm.getRawValue();
    const cost = Number(raw.costoUnitario);

    this.run(
      this.api.configureWarehouseProduct(warehouse.almacenId, {
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        productoId: Number(raw.productoId),
        stockInicial: Number(raw.stockInicial),
        stockMinimo: Number(raw.stockMinimo),
        costoUnitario: cost > 0 ? cost : undefined,
        moneda: cost > 0 ? raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || 'PEN' : undefined,
        lote: normalizeOptionalText(raw.lote),
        fechaVencimiento: raw.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
      }),
      'Producto agregado al almacén',
    );
  }

  private saveMovement(): void {
    this.movementForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.movementForm.invalid || this.saving()) return;

    const raw = this.movementForm.getRawValue();
    const productIds = raw.detalle.map((line) => Number(line.productoId));

    if (new Set(productIds).size !== productIds.length) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No repitas un producto dentro del mismo movimiento.');
      return;
    }

    this.run(
      this.api.registerMovement({
        uotId: Number(raw.uotId),
        almacenId: Number(raw.almacenId),
        tipo: raw.tipo,
        naturaleza: raw.naturaleza,
        documentoReferencia: normalizeOptionalText(raw.documentoReferencia),
        observacion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.observacion),
        detalle: raw.detalle.map((line) => ({
          productoId: Number(line.productoId),
          cantidad: Number(line.cantidad),
          costoUnitario:
            Number(line.costoUnitario) > 0
              ? Number(line.costoUnitario)
              : undefined,
          moneda: line.moneda.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
          lote: normalizeOptionalText(line.lote),
          fechaVencimiento: line.fechaVencimiento || undefined,
        })),
      }),
      'Movimiento registrado',
    );
  }

  private resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId?: number): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0 ? preferredUotId : 0;
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!force && control.dirty && control.value.trim()) return;

    this.codeLoading.set(true);
    this.api
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'ALMACEN')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (!code) return;
          control.setValue(code, { emitEvent: false });
          control.markAsPristine();
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private loadConfigureProducts(): void {
    const uotId = Number(this.configureForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
    this.syncConfigureProductRules(false);

    if (uotId <= 0) return;

    this.loadingProducts.set(true);
    this.api
      .listAllProducts(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingProducts.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.configureProducts.set(items),
        error: (error) => {
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private syncConfigureProductRules(emitEvent = true): void {
    const product = this.selectedConfigureProduct();
    const lot = this.configureForm.controls.lote;
    const expiration = this.configureForm.controls.fechaVencimiento;

    lot.setValidators(
      product?.requiereLote
        ? [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(80)]
        : [Validators.maxLength(80)],
    );
    expiration.setValidators(
      product?.controlaVencimiento ? [Validators.required] : [],
    );

    lot.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
    expiration.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent });
  }

  private run(operation: import('rxjs').Observable<unknown>, success: string): void {
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    operation.pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.toast.success(success);
        this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
        this.errorMessage.set(message);
        this.toast.error('No se pudo completar la operación', message);
      },
    });
  }

  private createLine() {
    return this.fb.nonNullable.group({
      productoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
      cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
      costoUnitario: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
      moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.maxLength(3)]],
      lote: ['', [Validators.maxLength(80)]],
      fechaVencimiento: [''],
    });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: WarehouseFormMode,
    options: WarehouseOperationOptions,
    warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.warehouses.set(options.warehouses);
    this.products.set(options.products);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
    this.stock.set(options.stock);
    this.currentWarehouse.set(warehouse);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.loadingProducts.set(false);
    this.codeLoading.set(false);
    if (this.currencies().length === 0) {
      this.refs.catalog('MONEDA').subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.currencies.set(
          items.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label })),
        ),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
    }
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.currentWarehouse.set(null);
    this.configureProducts.set([]);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Almacenes y stock"
    [subtitle]="uot.isGeneral() ? 'Vista general de almacenes, stock y Kardex de tus UOT.' : 'Almacenes, stock y Kardex de ' + (uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'la UOT activa') + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" />
        Actualizar
      </button>
      <button
        *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-secondary-button"
        [disabled]="warehouses().length === 0 || products().length === 0"
        (click)="movement()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="movementIcon" />
        Movimiento
      </button>
      <button
        *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
        type="button"
        class="admin-primary-button"
        (click)="createWarehouse()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" />
        Registrar almacén
      </button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface warehouse-toolbar">
    @if (uot.isGeneral()) {
      <label>
        <span>Filtrar por UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }
    <label>
      <span>Almacén</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="warehouseFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onWarehouseChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">{{ warehouse.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Producto</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="productFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onProductChange($any($event.target).value)">
        <option [value]="0">Todos</option>
        @for (product of products(); track product.productoId) {
          <option [value]="product.productoId">{{ product.nombre }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
  </section>

  <div class="warehouse-tabs" role="tablist">
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'warehouses'" (click)="setTab('warehouses')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /> Almacenes
    </button>
    <button type="button" [class.active]="activeTab() === 'stock'" (click)="setTab('stock')">
      <fa-icon [icon]="stockIcon" /> Stock
    </button>
    <button
      *appPermission="'ALMACENES_KARDEX'"
      type="button"
      [class.active]="activeTab() === 'kardex'"
      (click)="setTab('kardex')"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="kardexIcon" /> Kardex
    </button>
  </div>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando almacenes" message="Consultando stock y movimientos." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los almacenes.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'warehouses') {
    @if (warehouses().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin almacenes" message="No existen almacenes disponibles para el contexto actual." />
    } @else {
      <section class="warehouse-card-grid">
        @for (warehouse of warehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
          <article class="admin-surface warehouse-card">
            <header>
              <span class="warehouse-card-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="warehouseIcon" /></span>
              <div>
                <strong>{{ warehouse.nombre || 'Almacén' }}</strong>
                <small>{{ warehouse.codigo || '—' }}</small>
              </div>
              <span class="warehouse-access">{{ warehouse.tipoAcceso || 'PROPIO' }}</span>
            </header>
            <dl>
              <div><dt>UOT propietaria</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.uotPropietaria || '—' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Entradas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteEntrada === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Salidas</dt><dd>{{ warehouse.permiteSalida === false ? 'No' : 'Sí' }}</dd></div>
            </dl>
            @if (warehouse.descripcion) { <p>{{ warehouse.descripcion }}</p> }
            <footer>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_MOVIMIENTO'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                [disabled]="warehouse.permiteEntrada === false"
                (click)="configureProduct(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="configureIcon" />
                Agregar producto
              </button>
              <button
                *appPermission="'ALMACENES_CREAR'"
                type="button"
                class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small"
                (click)="share(warehouse)"
              >
                <fa-icon [icon]="shareIcon" />
                Compartir
              </button>
            </footer>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }
  } @else if (activeTab() === 'stock') {
    @if (filteredStock().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin stock" message="No existen saldos para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>UOT</th><th>Almacén</th><th>Producto</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Actual</th><th>Reservado</th><th>Disponible</th><th>Actualización</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of filteredStock(); track item.almacenId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ stockUot(item) }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen }}</td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.producto }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedida }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockActual | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.stockReservado | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td><strong class="stock-value" [class]="stockTone(item)">{{ item.stockDisponible | number:'1.0-3' }}</strong></td>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaActualizacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  } @else {
    @if (kardex().length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin movimientos" message="No existen movimientos en el Kardex para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <section class="admin-surface warehouse-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Fecha</th><th>UOT</th><th>Almacén</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Producto</th><th>Naturaleza</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Referencia</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of kardex(); track item.movimientoInventarioId + ':' + item.productoId) {
                <tr>
                  <td>{{ item.fechaHora | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.almacen || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.tipoMovimiento || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.producto || '—' }}</td>
                  <td><span class="warehouse-nature">{{ item.naturaleza === 'E' ? 'Entrada' : 'Salida' }}</span></td>
                  <td>{{ item.cantidad | number:'1.0-3' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.documentoReferencia || '—' }}</td>
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    }
  }
</div>

<app-almacen-operation-form />
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/recursos/almacenes/adapter/in/ui/pages/almacenes-list/almacenes-list.ts`

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faBoxOpen,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBookOpen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faShareNodes,
  faWarehouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { ResourceKardexResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceKardexResponse';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { ResourceStockResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceStockResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import {
  AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  WarehouseOperationOptions,
} from '../almacen-operation-form/almacen-operation-form';

type WarehouseTab = 'warehouses' | 'stock' | 'kardex';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-almacenes-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    AlmacenOperationFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './almacenes-list.html',
  styleUrl: './almacenes-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AlmacenesListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(AlmacenOperationFormComponent)
  private form!: AlmacenOperationFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly activeTab = signal<WarehouseTab>('warehouses');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly warehouseFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly productFilter = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly warehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly products = signal<readonly ResourceProductListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly stock = signal<readonly ResourceStockResponse[]>([]);
  readonly kardex = signal<readonly ResourceKardexResponse[]>([]);

  readonly pageIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly warehouseIcon = faWarehouse;
  readonly stockIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly configureIcon = faBoxOpen;
  readonly kardexIcon = faBookOpen;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly shareIcon = faShareNodes;
  readonly movementIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  readonly filteredStock = computed(() => {
    const warehouseId = this.warehouseFilter();
    const productId = this.productFilter();
    return this.stock().filter(
      (item) =>
        (!warehouseId || item.almacenId === warehouseId) &&
        (!productId || item.productoId === productId),
    );
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.uot.isGeneral() ? null : this.uot.selectedId());
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const unitId = this.queryUnitId();

    forkJoin({
      warehouses: this.api.listWarehouses(unitId),
      products: this.api.listAllProducts(unitId),
      stock: this.api.listStock(unitId),
      kardex: this.api.listKardex(
        unitId,
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ warehouses, products, stock, kardex }) => {
          this.warehouses.set(warehouses);
          this.products.set(products);
          this.stock.set(stock);
          this.kardex.set(kardex);
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  setTab(tab: WarehouseTab): void {
    this.activeTab.set(tab);
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(null);
    this.productFilter.set(null);
    this.load();
  }

  onWarehouseChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.warehouseFilter.set(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null,
    );
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  onProductChange(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.productFilter.set(Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null);
    if (this.activeTab() === 'kardex') this.loadKardex();
  }

  async createWarehouse(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options(), this.queryUnitId());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async share(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openShare(warehouse, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async configureProduct(warehouse: ResourceWarehouseResponse): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openConfigure(
      warehouse,
      this.options(),
      this.queryUnitId(),
    );
    if (result.saved) {
      this.activeTab.set('stock');
      this.warehouseFilter.set(warehouse.almacenId ?? null);
      this.load();
    }
  }

  async movement(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openMovement(this.options(), this.queryUnitId());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  stockUot(item: ResourceStockResponse): string {
    const warehouse = this.warehouses().find(
      (candidate) => candidate.almacenId === item.almacenId,
    );

    return warehouse?.uotPropietaria ?? '—';
  }

  stockTone(item: ResourceStockResponse): string {
    const available = item.stockDisponible ?? 0;
    const minimum = item.stockMinimo ?? 0;
    if (available <= 0) return 'stock-value stock-value--danger';
    if (minimum > 0 && available <= minimum) return 'stock-value stock-value--warning';
    return 'stock-value stock-value--ok';
  }

  private loadKardex(): void {
    this.api
      .listKardex(
        this.queryUnitId(),
        this.warehouseFilter() ?? undefined,
        this.productFilter() ?? undefined,
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.kardex.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private queryUnitId(): number | undefined {
    return this.uot.isGeneral()
      ? this.unitFilter() ?? undefined
      : this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined;
  }

  private options(): WarehouseOperationOptions {
    return {
      warehouses: this.warehouses(),
      products: this.products(),
      stock: this.stock(),
    };
  }
}
```
