```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  InventoryAssetCreateRequest,
  InventoryAssetRetireRequest,
  InventoryAssetUpdateRequest,
  InventoryMileageUpdateRequest,
  InventorySupplyCreateRequest,
  InventorySupplyMovementAnnulRequest,
  InventorySupplyMovementRequest,
  InventorySupplyUpdateRequest,
  InventoryVehicleRegisterRequest,
  InventarioYVehculosService,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { InventarioVehiculosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/inventario-vehiculos.gateway';
import {
  BienInventarioCreate,
  BienInventarioFiltro,
  BienInventarioUpdate,
} from '../../../domain/bien-inventario.model';
import { MovimientoSuministroCreate } from '../../../domain/movimiento-suministro.model';
import { SuministroCreate, SuministroUpdate } from '../../../domain/suministro.model';
import { KilometrajeUpdate, VehiculoCreate } from '../../../domain/vehiculo.model';
import { InventarioVehiculosHttpMapper } from './inventario-vehiculos-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class InventarioVehiculosHttpAdapter implements InventarioVehiculosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(InventarioYVehculosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(InventarioVehiculosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  listAssets(filter: BienInventarioFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .inventarioBienesListar(
        {
          empresaId: filter.empresaId,
          tipoBienId: filter.tipoBienId,
          estadoBien: filter.estadoBien,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.assetsPage(response, filter.size)));
  }

  getAsset(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .inventarioBienesVer(
        { id },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  createAsset(input: BienInventarioCreate) {
    const inventoryAssetCreateRequest: InventoryAssetCreateRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      'inventario:bienes:crear',
      inventoryAssetCreateRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioBienesCrear(
            {
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventoryAssetCreateRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response))),
    );
  }

  updateAsset(id: number, input: BienInventarioUpdate) {
    const inventoryAssetUpdateRequest: InventoryAssetUpdateRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:bienes:editar:${id}`,
      inventoryAssetUpdateRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioBienesEditar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventoryAssetUpdateRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  retireAsset(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const inventoryAssetRetireRequest: InventoryAssetRetireRequest = { motivo };
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:bienes:baja:${id}`,
      inventoryAssetRetireRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioBienesBaja(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventoryAssetRetireRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  getVehicle(id: number) {
    return this.getAsset(id).pipe(
      map((detail) => this.mapper.vehicle(detail)),
    );
  }

  registerVehicle(id: number, input: VehiculoCreate) {
    const inventoryVehicleRegisterRequest: InventoryVehicleRegisterRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:vehiculos:registrar:${id}`,
      inventoryVehicleRegisterRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioVehiculosRegistrar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventoryVehicleRegisterRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response))),
    );
  }

  updateMileage(id: number, input: KilometrajeUpdate) {
    const inventoryMileageUpdateRequest: InventoryMileageUpdateRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:vehiculos:kilometraje:${id}`,
      inventoryMileageUpdateRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioVehiculosKilometraje(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventoryMileageUpdateRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  listSupplies(page: number, size: number) {
    return this.api
      .inventarioSuministrosListar(
        { pagina: page, tamano: size },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.suppliesPage(response, size)));
  }

  createSupply(input: SuministroCreate) {
    const inventorySupplyCreateRequest: InventorySupplyCreateRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      'inventario:suministros:crear',
      inventorySupplyCreateRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioSuministrosCrear(
            {
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventorySupplyCreateRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response))),
    );
  }

  updateSupply(id: number, input: SuministroUpdate) {
    const inventorySupplyUpdateRequest: InventorySupplyUpdateRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:suministros:editar:${id}`,
      inventorySupplyUpdateRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioSuministrosEditar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventorySupplyUpdateRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  movements(suministroId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .inventarioSuministrosKardex(
        { suministroId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.movements(response)));
  }

  registerMovement(id: number, input: MovimientoSuministroCreate) {
    const inventorySupplyMovementRequest: InventorySupplyMovementRequest = input;
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:suministros:movimiento:${id}`,
      inventorySupplyMovementRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioSuministrosMovimientoRegistrar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventorySupplyMovementRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response))),
    );
  }

  annulMovement(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const inventorySupplyMovementAnnulRequest: InventorySupplyMovementAnnulRequest = {
      motivo,
    };
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `inventario:suministros:movimiento-anular:${id}`,
      inventorySupplyMovementAnnulRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .inventarioSuministrosMovimientoAnular(

              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              inventorySupplyMovementAnnulRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header [title]="detail()?.nombre || 'Detalle del producto'" subtitle="Información comercial, imagen principal y precio vigente por UOT." eyebrow="Productos" [icon]="priceIcon">
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <a class="admin-secondary-button" routerLink="/recursos/productos"><fa-icon [icon]="backIcon" /> Volver</a>
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()"><fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar</button>
      <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="!detail()" (click)="versionPrice()"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /> Nuevo precio</button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  @if (loading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando producto" message="Consultando el detalle para la UOT seleccionada." /> }
  @else if (errorMessage()) { <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar el producto.'" (retry)="load()" /> }
  @else if (detail(); as item) {
    <section class="product-detail-layout">
      <article class="admin-surface product-detail-image"><app-resource-image variant="hero" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" /><div class="product-image-caption"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /><span>Imagen principal</span></div></article>
      <article class="admin-surface product-summary">
        <header><div><small>{{ item.uotNombre || 'UOT' }} · {{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</small><h2>{{ item.nombre }}</h2><span>{{ item.codigo }}</span></div><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></header>
        <div class="product-current-price"><span>Precio vigente</span>@if (item.precioVigente != null) { <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong><small>Versión {{ item.precioVersion || '—' }}</small> } @else { <strong>Sin precio vigente</strong> }</div>
        <dl><div><dt>Categoría</dt><dd>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Unidad de medida</dt><dd>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Control por lote</dt><dd>{{ item.requiereLote ? 'Sí' : 'No' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Control de vencimiento</dt><dd>{{ item.controlaVencimiento ? 'Sí' : 'No' }}</dd></div><div class="wide"><dt>Descripción</dt><dd>{{ item.descripcion || 'Sin descripción.' }}</dd></div></dl>
      </article>
    </section>

    <section class="admin-surface product-files-section">
      <app-local-file-panel [uotId]="item.uotId || targetUotId()" linkType="PRODUCTO" [linkId]="item.productoId || productId" [fileIds]="imageIds()" title="Imagen del producto" category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN" accept="image/*" [forcePrincipal]="true" [canUpload]="canUploadImages()" (changed)="load()" />
    </section>

    <section *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL'" class="admin-surface product-history-section">
      <header class="product-section-header"><div><p>Auditoría comercial</p><h2>Historial de precios</h2><span>Solo visible para perfiles autorizados.</span></div><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [disabled]="historyLoading()" (click)="loadHistory()"><fa-icon [icon]="historyIcon" /> Actualizar historial</button></header>
      @if (historyLoading()) { <app-loading-state title="Cargando historial" message="Consultando versiones de precio." /> }
      @else if (historyError()) { <app-error-state [message]="historyError() || 'No se pudo consultar el historial.'" (retry)="loadHistory()" /> }
      @else if (history().length === 0) { <app-empty-state title="Sin historial" message="Todavía no hay versiones de precio registradas en esta UOT." /> }
      @else {
        <div class="admin-table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>Versión</th><th>Precio</th><th>Vigencia</th><th>Origen</th><th>Usuario</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acción</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          @for (price of history(); track price.productoPrecioId) {
            <tr><td><strong>v{{ price.version }}</strong></td><td>{{ price.moneda }} {{ price.precioVenta | number:'1.2-2' }}</td><td>{{ price.fechaDesde ? (price.fechaDesde | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}<small class="history-help">hasta {{ price.fechaHasta ? (price.fechaHasta | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : 'actualidad' }}</small></td><td>@if (price.precioOrigenVersion) { v{{ price.precioOrigenVersion }} } @else { Nueva }</td><td>{{ price.nombreUsuario || 'Sistema' }}</td><td><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="price.vigente">{{ price.vigente ? 'Vigente' : 'Histórico' }}</span></td><td>@if (!price.vigente) { <button *appPermission="['PRODUCTOS_PRECIO','PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL']" type="button" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [disabled]="actionLoadingId() !== null" (click)="reactivate(price)">@if (actionLoadingId() === price.productoPrecioId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="reactivateIcon" /> } Reactivar</button> }</td></tr>
          }
        </tbody></table></div>
      }
    </section>

</div>
```

```typescript
import { DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, OnInit, ViewChild, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faArrowLeft, faClockRotateLeft, faCoins, faImage, faRotate, faRotateLeft } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin, of } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { PermissionService } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.service';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService, ResourceProductPriceHistory } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ResourceImageComponent } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-image/resource-image';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-detail-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, DecimalPipe, RouterLink, FaIconComponent, PermissionDirective, EmptyStateComponent, ErrorStateComponent, LoadingStateComponent, ActionConfirmDialogComponent, LocalFilePanelComponent, PageHeaderComponent, ResourceImageComponent, ProductoFormComponent],
  templateUrl: './producto-detail.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-detail.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoDetailPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent) private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly historyLoading = signal(false);
  readonly actionLoadingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly historyError = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly detail = signal<ResourceProductDetailResponse | null>(null);
  readonly history = signal<readonly ResourceProductPriceHistory[]>([]);

  readonly backIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly historyIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly reactivateIcon = faRotateLeft;

  readonly productId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  readonly requestedUotId = Number(this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('uotId')) || null;

  ngOnInit(): void { this.load(); }

  load(): void {
    const uotId = this.targetUotId();
    if (!this.productId || !uotId) { this.loading.set(false); this.errorMessage.set('No se identificó correctamente el producto y su UOT.'); return; }
    this.loading.set(true); this.errorMessage.set(null);
    const canHistory = this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL');
    forkJoin({
      detail: this.api.getProduct(this.productId, uotId),
      history: canHistory ? this.api.listProductPriceHistory(this.productId, uotId) : of([] as ResourceProductPriceHistory[]),
    }).pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: ({ detail, history }) => { this.detail.set(detail ?? null); this.history.set(history); },
      error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  loadHistory(): void {
    if (!this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_PRECIO_HISTORIAL')) return;
    this.historyLoading.set(true); this.historyError.set(null);
    const uotId = this.targetUotId();
    if (!uotId) { this.historyLoading.set(false); return; }
    this.api.listProductPriceHistory(this.productId, uotId).pipe(finalize(() => this.historyLoading.set(false))).subscribe({
      next: (items) => this.history.set(items),
      error: (error) => this.historyError.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
    });
  }

  async versionPrice(): Promise<void> {
    const item = this.detail(); if (!item) return;
    const uotId = this.targetUotId(); if (!uotId) return;
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item, uotId);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async reactivate(price: ResourceProductPriceHistory): Promise<void> {
    if (price.vigente || !price.productoPrecioId || this.actionLoadingId()) return;
    const result = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Reactivar precio histórico',
      message: `Se creará una nueva versión vigente con ${price.moneda} ${price.precioVenta.toFixed(2)}. La versión histórica no será modificada.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Crear versión vigente',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      tone: 'warning',
    });
    if (!result.confirmed) return;
    this.actionLoadingId.set(price.productoPrecioId);
    const uotId = this.targetUotId(); if (!uotId) { this.actionLoadingId.set(null); return; }
    this.api.reactivateProductPrice(this.productId, price.productoPrecioId, { uotId })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionLoadingId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => { this.toast.success('Precio reactivado como nueva versión'); this.load(); },
        error: (error) => this.toast.error('No se pudo reactivar el precio', mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  targetUotId(): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;
    }

    return this.detail()?.uotId ?? this.requestedUotId ?? 0;
  }

  canUploadImages(): boolean { return this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES') && this.permissions.has('ARCHIVOS_CREAR'); }
  imageIds(): readonly number[] { const id = this.detail()?.archivoPrincipalId; return id ? [id] : []; }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\features\recursos\productos\adapter\in\ui\pages\producto-form\producto-form.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/recursos/productos/adapter/in/ui/pages/producto-form/producto-form.ts`

```typescript
import { NgTemplateOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCoins, faFloppyDisk, faPlus, faXmark } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';

type ProductFormMode = 'create' | 'price';
type ProductPriceTarget = ResourceProductListItemResponse | ResourceProductDetailResponse;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-producto-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    FaIconComponent,
    FormErrorComponent,
    NgTemplateOutlet,
  ],
  templateUrl: './producto-form.html',
  styleUrl: './producto-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly mode = signal<ProductFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<ProductPriceTarget | null>(null);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly codeLoading = signal(false);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly categories = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly currencies = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    codigo: ['', [Validators.maxLength(50)]],
    nombre: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)]],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(700)]],
    unidadMedida: ['', [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(20)]],
    categoria: ['', [Validators.maxLength(40)]],
    precioInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    precioVenta: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  readonly priceForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotContextoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    precioInicial: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]],
    precioVenta: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    moneda: ['PEN', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(3)]],
  });

  openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('create');
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.createForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: this.resolveCreateUotId(preferredUotId),
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
      unidadMedida: '',
      categoria: '',
      precioInicial: 0,
      precioVenta: 0,
      moneda: 'PEN',
    });

    this.createForm.controls.uotContextoId[
      this.uot.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA' ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });

    this.loadReferences();
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);

    return this.show();
  }

  openPrice(
    item: ProductPriceTarget,
    uotId: number,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.mode.set('price');
    this.current.set(item);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.priceForm.reset({
      uotContextoId: uotId,
      precioInicial: Number(item.precioInicial ?? 0),
      precioVenta: Number(item.precioVigente ?? 0),
      moneda: item.moneda ?? 'PEN',
    });

    this.priceForm.controls.uotContextoId.disable({
      emitEvent: false,
    });

    this.loadReferences();

    return this.show();
  }

  availableUnits() {
    return this.uot.memberships();
  }

  onCreateUotChange(): void {
    this.loadSuggestedCode(true);
  }

  uotLabel(form: 'create' | 'price' = 'create'): string {
    const id =
      form === 'price'
        ? Number(this.priceForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId)
        : Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);

    return this.uot
      .memberships()
      .find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre
      ?? 'UOT no seleccionada';
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({
        saved: false,
        value: null,
      });
    }
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.mode() === 'price') {
      this.savePrice();
      return;
    }

    this.saveProduct();
  }

  private saveProduct(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.createForm.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.referencesLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();

    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .createProduct({
        uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
        codigo:
          raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
        nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
        descripcion:
          normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        unidadMedida:
          raw.unidadMedida.trim().toUpperCase(),
        categoria:
          raw.categoria.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
        precioInicial: Number(raw.precioInicial),
        precioVenta: Number(raw.precioVenta),
        moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Producto registrado');
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private savePrice(): void {
    const product = this.current();

    this.priceForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      !product?.productoId
      || this.priceForm.invalid
      || this.saving()
      || this.referencesLoading()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.priceForm.getRawValue();

    if (Number(raw.uotContextoId) <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'Seleccione una UOT antes de guardar.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .versionProductPrice(
        product.productoId,
        {
          uotContextoId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
          uotPrecioId: Number(raw.uotContextoId),
          precioInicial: Number(raw.precioInicial),
          precioVenta: Number(raw.precioVenta),
          moneda: raw.moneda.trim().toUpperCase(),
        },
      )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            'Nueva versión de precio registrada',
          );
          this.finish({
            saved: true,
            value: null,
          });
        },
        error: (error) => this.fail(error),
      });
  }

  private loadReferences(): void {
    if (this.referencesLoading()) {
      return;
    }

    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      units: this.refs.catalog('UNIDAD_MEDIDA'),
      categories: this.refs.catalog('CATEGORIA_PRODUCTO'),
      currencies: this.refs.catalog('MONEDA'),
    })
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ units, categories, currencies }) => {
          this.units.set(
            units.map((item) => ({
              code: item.code,
              label: item.label,
            })),
          );
          this.categories.set(
            categories.map((item) => ({
              code: item.code,
              label: item.label,
            })),
          );
          this.currencies.set(
            currencies.map((item) => ({
              code: item.code,
              label: item.label,
            })),
          );

          if (
            this.mode() === 'create'
            && !this.createForm.controls.unidadMedida.value
          ) {
            this.createForm.controls.unidadMedida.setValue(
              this.units()[0]?.code ?? 'UND',
            );
          }

          const defaultCurrency =
            this.currencies()[0]?.code ?? 'PEN';

          if (
            !this.currencies().some(
              (item) =>
                item.code
                === this.createForm.controls.moneda.value,
            )
          ) {
            this.createForm.controls.moneda.setValue(
              defaultCurrency,
            );
          }

          if (
            !this.currencies().some(
              (item) =>
                item.code
                === this.priceForm.controls.moneda.value,
            )
          ) {
            this.priceForm.controls.moneda.setValue(
              defaultCurrency,
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  private resolveCreateUotId(
    preferredUotId?: number,
  ): number {
    if (this.uot.isSpecific()) {
      return this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0;
    }

    return preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0
      ? preferredUotId
      : 0;
  }

  private loadSuggestedCode(force = false): void {
    const uotId =
      Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotContextoId);
    const control = this.createForm.controls.codigo;

    if (uotId <= 0) {
      if (force) {
        control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (
      !force
      && control.dirty
      && control.value.trim()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.codeLoading.set(true);

    this.api
      .suggestCode(uotId, 'PRODUCTO')
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.codeLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (code) => {
          if (code) {
            control.setValue(
              code,
              { emitEvent: false },
            );
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
        error: () => {
          if (force) {
            control.setValue(
              '',
              { emitEvent: false },
            );
            control.markAsPristine();
          }
        },
      });
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;

    this.errorMessage.set(message);
    this.toast.error(
      'No se pudo completar la operación',
      message,
    );
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }

    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Productos"
    [subtitle]="isGeneral() ? 'Vista general del catálogo y precios vigentes por UOT.' : 'Catálogo y precio vigente para ' + contextUotName() + '.'"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button class="admin-secondary-button" type="button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_CREAR'" class="admin-primary-button" type="button" (click)="create()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Registrar producto
      </button>
  
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface product-filters">
    @if (isGeneral()) {
      <label>
        <span>Filtrar por UOT</span>
        <select class="admin-select" [value]="unitFilter() ?? 0" (change)="onUnitChange($any($event.target).value)">
          <option [value]="0">Todas mis UOT</option>
          @for (unit of units(); track unit.uotId) {
            <option [value]="unit.uotId">{{ unit.nombre }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </label>
    }

    <label class="product-search">
      <span>Buscar</span>
      <div class="product-search-control">
        <input
          class="admin-input"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Código o nombre del producto"
          [value]="search()"
          (input)="search.set($any($event.target).value)"
          (keyup.enter)="applyFilters()"
        />
        <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Buscar" (click)="applyFilters()">
          <fa-icon [icon]="searchIcon" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Categoría</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="categoryFilter()" (change)="categoryFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()">
        <option value="">Todas</option>
        @for (category of categories(); track category.code) {
          <option [value]="category.code">{{ category.label }}</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Estado</span>
      <select class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); applyFilters()">
        <option value="ACTIVE">Activos</option>
        <option value="INACTIVE">Inactivos</option>
        <option value="ALL">Todos</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <div class="product-view-switch" aria-label="Modo de visualización">
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'table'" title="Vista tabla" (click)="setView('table')"><fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" /></button>
      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [class.active]="viewMode() === 'cards'" title="Vista tarjetas" (click)="setView('cards')"><fa-icon [icon]="cardsIcon" /></button>
    </div>
  </section>

  @if (loading()) {
    <app-loading-state title="Cargando productos" message="Consultando el catálogo paginado." />
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'No fue posible consultar los productos.'" (retry)="load()" />
  } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
    <app-empty-state title="Sin productos" message="No existen productos para los filtros seleccionados." />
  } @else {
    @if (viewMode() === 'table') {
      <section class="admin-surface product-table-shell">
        <div class="admin-table-scroll">
          <table class="admin-table">
            <thead><tr><th>Imagen</th><th>UOT</th><th>Código</th><th>Producto</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Unidad</th><th>Precio vigente</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of result().items; track rowKey(item)) {
                <tr>
                  <td><app-resource-image variant="thumb" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" /></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.uotNombre || '—' }}</strong><span>{{ item.uotCodigo || '' }}</span></div></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</strong></td>
                  <td><strong>{{ item.nombre || '—' }}</strong><small class="product-help">{{ item.descripcion || '' }}</small></td>
                  <td>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.precioVigente != null) {
                      <strong>{{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }}</strong>
                      @if (item.precioVersion) { <small class="product-help">Versión {{ item.precioVersion }}</small> }
                    } @else { <span class="product-help">Sin precio vigente</span> }
                  </td>
                  <td><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></td>
                  <td><div class="admin-table-actions">
                    <a *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_VER'" class="admin-icon-button" [routerLink]="['/recursos/productos', item.productoId]" [queryParams]="detailQuery(item)" title="Ver detalle"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></a>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Registrar nueva versión de precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                    <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Gestionar imagen" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
                  </div></td>
                </tr>
                @if (isImagesSelected(item)) {
                  <tr class="product-images-row"><td colspan="9">
                    <app-local-file-panel
                      [uotId]="item.uotId || 0"
                      linkType="PRODUCTO"
                      [linkId]="item.productoId || 0"
                      [fileIds]="imageIds(item)"
                      title="Imagen principal del producto"
                      category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN"
                      accept="image/*"
                      [forcePrincipal]="true"
                      [canUpload]="canUploadImages()"
                      (changed)="load()"
                    />
                  </td></tr>
                }
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    } @else {
      <section class="product-card-grid">
        @for (item of result().items; track rowKey(item)) {
          <article class="admin-surface product-card">
            <app-resource-image variant="card" [fileId]="item.archivoPrincipalId" [imageUrl]="item.imagenPrincipalUrl" [alt]="item.nombre || 'Producto'" />
            <div class="product-card-body">
              <div class="product-card-heading"><div><small>{{ item.uotNombre || 'UOT' }}</small><h3>{{ item.nombre || 'Producto' }}</h3><span>{{ item.codigo || '—' }}</span></div><span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estado !== false" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estado === false">{{ item.estado === false ? 'Inactivo' : 'Activo' }}</span></div>
              <p>{{ item.descripcion || 'Sin descripción.' }}</p>
              <dl><div><dt>Categoría</dt><dd>{{ item.categoriaNombre || item.categoriaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div><dt>Unidad</dt><dd>{{ item.unidadMedidaNombre || item.unidadMedidaCodigo || '—' }}</dd></div><div class="product-card-price"><dt>Precio vigente</dt><dd>@if (item.precioVigente != null) { {{ item.moneda || 'PEN' }} {{ item.precioVigente | number:'1.2-2' }} } @else { Sin precio }</dd></div></dl>
              <footer>
                <a *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_VER'" class="admin-secondary-button admin-secondary-button--small" [routerLink]="['/recursos/productos', item.productoId]" [queryParams]="detailQuery(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /> Detalle</a>
                <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_PRECIO'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Nuevo precio" (click)="price(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="priceIcon" /></button>
                <button *appPermission="'PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Gestionar imagen" (click)="selectImages(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="imageIcon" /></button>
              </footer>
              @if (isImagesSelected(item)) {
                <div class="product-card-files"><app-local-file-panel [uotId]="item.uotId || 0" linkType="PRODUCTO" [linkId]="item.productoId || 0" [fileIds]="imageIds(item)" title="Imagen principal" category="PRODUCTO_IMAGEN" accept="image/*" [forcePrincipal]="true" [canUpload]="canUploadImages()" (changed)="load()" /></div>
              }
            </div>
          </article>
        }
      </section>
    }

    <app-paginator
      [page]="result().page"
      [size]="result().size"
      [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
      [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
      (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
      (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
    />
  }
</div>

<app-producto-form />
```

```typescript
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCoins,
  faEye,
  faGrip,
  faImage,
  faList,
  faMagnifyingGlass,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faTags,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { PermissionService } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.service';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../../../../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { LocalFilePanelComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { PageResult, emptyPageResult } from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-api.service';
import { ResourceImageComponent } from '../../../../../../shared/resource-image/resource-image';
import { ProductoFormComponent } from '../producto-form/producto-form';

type ProductViewMode = 'table' | 'cards';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-productos-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    LocalFilePanelComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    ProductoFormComponent,
    ResourceImageComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './productos-list.html',
  styleUrl: './productos-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ProductosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(ProductoFormComponent) private form!: ProductoFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly refs = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private readonly permissions = inject(PermissionService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<ResourceProductListItemResponse>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly search = signal('');
  readonly unitFilter = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly categoryFilter = signal('');
  readonly stateFilter = signal('ACTIVE');
  readonly categories = signal<readonly { code: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  readonly viewMode = signal<ProductViewMode>('table');
  readonly selectedForImages = signal<ResourceProductListItemResponse | null>(null);

  readonly pageIcon = faTags;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly priceIcon = faCoins;
  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly searchIcon = faMagnifyingGlass;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly tableIcon = faList;
  readonly cardsIcon = faGrip;

  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.uot.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly units = computed(() => this.uot.memberships());
  readonly contextUotId = computed(() =>
    this.isGeneral() ? this.unitFilter() : this.uot.selectedId(),
  );
  readonly contextUotName = computed(() => {
    const id = this.contextUotId();
    return id
      ? this.units().find((unit) => unit.uotId === id)?.nombre ?? 'UOT'
      : 'Todas mis UOT';
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.unitFilter.set(this.isGeneral() ? null : this.uot.selectedId());
    this.refs.catalog('CATEGORIA_PRODUCTO').subscribe({
      next: (items) =>
        this.categories.set(items.map((item) => ({ code: item.code, label: item.label }))),
    });
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const active = this.stateFilter() === 'ALL'
      ? undefined
      : this.stateFilter() === 'ACTIVE';

    this.api
      .listProducts({
        uotId: this.contextUotId() ?? undefined,
        search: this.search(),
        category: this.categoryFilter() || undefined,
        active,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.result.set(result);
          const selected = this.selectedForImages();
          if (selected) {
            this.selectedForImages.set(
              result.items.find((item) => this.sameRow(item, selected)) ?? null,
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  applyFilters(): void {
    this.selectedForImages.set(null);
    this.load(1);
  }

  onUnitChange(value: string): void {
    const id = Number(value);
    this.unitFilter.set(Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0 ? id : null);
    this.applyFilters();
  }

  setView(mode: ProductViewMode): void {
    this.viewMode.set(mode);
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.contextUotId() ?? undefined);
    if (result.saved) this.load(1);
  }

  async price(item: ResourceProductListItemResponse): Promise<void> {
    const uotId = Number(item.uotId ?? this.contextUotId() ?? 0);
    if (!uotId) return;
    const result = await this.form.openPrice(item, uotId);
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  selectImages(item: ResourceProductListItemResponse): void {
    this.selectedForImages.set(
      this.sameRow(this.selectedForImages(), item) ? null : item,
    );
  }

  canUploadImages(): boolean {
    return this.permissions.has('PRODUCTOS_IMAGENES') && this.permissions.has('ARCHIVOS_CREAR');
  }

  imageIds(item: ResourceProductListItemResponse): readonly number[] {
    return item.archivoPrincipalId ? [item.archivoPrincipalId] : [];
  }

  rowKey(item: ResourceProductListItemResponse): string {
    return `${item.productoId ?? 0}-${item.uotId ?? 0}`;
  }

  isImagesSelected(item: ResourceProductListItemResponse): boolean {
    return this.sameRow(this.selectedForImages(), item);
  }

  detailQuery(item: ResourceProductListItemResponse): { uotId: number } {
    return { uotId: Number(item.uotId ?? this.contextUotId() ?? 0) };
  }

  private sameRow(
    left: ResourceProductListItemResponse | null,
    right: ResourceProductListItemResponse,
  ): boolean {
    return Boolean(
      left
      && left.productoId === right.productoId
      && left.uotId === right.uotId,
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Routes } from '@angular/router';

import { moduleAccessGuard } from '../../../core/access/module-access.guard';
import { permissionGuard } from '../../../core/access/permission.guard';

export const productosRoutes: Routes = [
  {
    path: 'productos',
    data: {
      breadcrumb: 'Productos',
      module: 'PRODUCTOS',
      permission: 'PRODUCTOS_LISTAR',
    },
    canActivate: [moduleAccessGuard, permissionGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/productos-list/productos-list').then(
        (m) => m.ProductosListPage,
      ),
  },
  {
    path: 'productos/:id',
    data: {
      breadcrumb: 'Detalle del producto',
      module: 'PRODUCTOS',
      permission: 'PRODUCTOS_VER',
    },
    canActivate: [moduleAccessGuard, permissionGuard],
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./adapter/in/ui/pages/producto-detail/producto-detail').then(
        (m) => m.ProductoDetailPage,
      ),

];
```

```html
<dialog #dialog class="modal desco-modal" (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()">
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon"><fa-icon [icon]="icon()" /></span>
        <div><p>Recursos</p><h2>{{ title() }}</h2></div>

      <button type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (mode() === 'create') {
      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="createForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">

          <select

            (change)="changeUot($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT</option>
            @for (unit of uot.memberships(); track unit.uotId) {
              <option [value]="unit.uotId">
                {{ unit.codigo ? unit.codigo + ' · ' : '' }}{{ unit.nombre }}
              </option>
            }
          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.uotId" fieldLabel="La UOT" />
          <small class="resource-helper">
            @if (uot.isGeneral()) {
              En vista general elige explícitamente la UOT donde se programará el recurso.
            } @else {
              La programación se registrará en la UOT activa.
            }
          </small>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationType">Tipo de destino</label>
          <select
            id="resourceDestinationType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="destinoTipo"
            [disabled]="loadingDestinations() || createForm.controls.uotId.value <= 0"
            (change)="changeDestinationType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="SALIDA">Salida de campo</option>
            <option value="OPERATIVO">Operativo de venta</option>
            <option value="CAMPANIA">Campaña de venta</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceDestinationId">Destino</label>
          <select

            formControlName="destinoId"

            (change)="changeDestination($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option [value]="0">
              {{ createForm.controls.uotId.value <= 0 ? 'Primero seleccione una UOT' : loadingDestinations() ? 'Cargando destinos...' : 'Seleccionar destino' }}
            </option>
            @for (destination of destinationsForSelectedType(); track destination.tipo + ':' + destination.destinoId) {
              <option [value]="destination.destinoId">
                {{ destinationOptionLabel(destination) }}

          </select>
          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.destinoId" fieldLabel="El destino" />
          @if (selectedDestination(); as destination) {
            <small class="resource-helper">
              UOT: {{ destination.uotNombre || destination.uotCodigo || '—' }}
              @if (destination.estadoProceso) { · {{ destination.estadoProceso }} }
            </small>
          }
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceType">Tipo de recurso</label>
          <select
            id="resourceType"
            class="admin-select"
            formControlName="recursoTipo"
            [disabled]="!selectedDestination() || loadingAvailability()"
            (change)="changeResourceType($any($event.target).value)"
          >
            <option value="BIEN">Bien / vehículo</option>
            <option value="SUMINISTRO">Suministro</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="admin-field">
          <label for="resourceId">Recurso disponible</label>
          <div class="resource-select-row">
            <select
              id="resourceId"
              class="admin-select"
              formControlName="recursoId"
              [disabled]="!selectedDestination() || loadingAvailability()"
            >
              <option [value]="0">
                {{ !selectedDestination() ? 'Primero seleccione un destino' : loadingAvailability() ? 'Cargando recursos...' : 'Seleccionar recurso' }}
              </option>
              @if (createForm.controls.recursoTipo.value === 'BIEN') {
                @for (asset of availableAssets(); track asset.bienInventarioId) {
                  <option [value]="asset.bienInventarioId">
                    {{ asset.codigoPatrimonial }} · {{ asset.nombre }} · {{ asset.estadoBien }}
                  </option>
                }
              } @else {
                @for (supply of availability().suministros; track supply.suministroId) {
                  <option [value]="supply.suministroId">

                  </option>

            <button

          <app-form-error [control]="createForm.controls.recursoId" fieldLabel="El recurso" />
          @if (selectedDestination(); as destination) {

          <section class="admin-surface">

                    <tr>

                      <td>{{ movement.usuario || '—' }}</td>
                      <td>{{ movement.observacion || '—' }}</td>
                    </tr>
                  } @empty {
                    <tr><td colspan="5" class="admin-table-empty">No hay movimientos registrados.</td></tr>
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions"><button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" (click)="close()">Cerrar</button></footer>
        </div>
      } @else if (mode() === 'edit') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="editForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · {{ detail.estadoProceso }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="editQuantity">Cantidad programada</label>
            <input id="editQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadProgramada" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="editObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="editObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving()">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Guardando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="saveIcon" /> Guardar }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      } @else if (mode() === 'return') {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="returnForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong><span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · cantidad programada {{ detail.cantidadProgramada }}</span>

          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="returnQuantity">Cantidad a devolver</label>
            <input id="returnQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadDevuelta" [readOnly]="!!detail.bienInventarioId" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="returnObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="returnObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>

      } @else {
        <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="consumeForm" (ngSubmit)="save()">
          <div class="resource-context-card admin-field-span-2">
            <strong>{{ resourceLabel(detail) }}</strong>
            <span>{{ destinationLabel(detail) }} · pendiente {{ pendingQuantity(detail) }} {{ detail.unidadMedida || '' }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field">
            <label for="consumeQuantity">Cantidad consumida</label>
            <input id="consumeQuantity" class="admin-input" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0.001" [max]="pendingQuantity(detail)" step="0.001" formControlName="cantidadConsumida" />
            <app-form-error [control]="consumeForm.controls.cantidadConsumida" fieldLabel="La cantidad" />
          </div>
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="consumeObservation">Observación</label>
            <textarea id="consumeObservation" class="admin-textarea" rows="3" maxlength="300" formControlName="observacion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
            <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="saving()" (click)="close()">Cancelar</button>
            <button type="submit" class="admin-primary-button" [disabled]="saving() || pendingQuantity(detail) <= 0">
              @if (saving()) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span> Registrando... }
              @else { <fa-icon [icon]="consumeIcon" /> Registrar consumo }
            </button>
          </footer>
        </form>
      }
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```
