import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faEye,
  faFloppyDisk,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUtensils,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/consultar-disponibilidad-recursos.use-case';
import { EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/editar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-destinos-recursos.use-case';
import { ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/obtener-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ProgramarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/programar-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-consumo-recurso.use-case';
import { RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/registrar-devolucion-recurso.use-case';
import { DisponibilidadRecurso } from '../../../../../domain/disponibilidad-recurso.model';
import {
  DestinoRecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
  TipoRecursoProgramable,
} from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';

export type RecursoProgramadoFormMode =
  | 'create'
  | 'edit'
  | 'view'
  | 'return'
  | 'consume';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurso-programado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [DatePipe, ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './recurso-programado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './recurso-programado-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursoProgramadoFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly destinationsUseCase = inject(ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly availabilityUseCase = inject(ConsultarDisponibilidadRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly getUseCase = inject(ObtenerRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly programUseCase = inject(ProgramarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly updateUseCase = inject(EditarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly returnUseCase = inject(RegistrarDevolucionRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly consumeUseCase = inject(RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly mode = signal<RecursoProgramadoFormMode>('create');
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly loadingDestinations = signal(false);
  readonly loadingAvailability = signal(false);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly current = signal<RecursoProgramadoDetalle | null>(null);
  readonly destinations = signal<readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[]>([]);
  readonly availability = signal<DisponibilidadRecurso>({
    bienes: [],
    suministros: [],
  });

  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly resourceIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly consumeIcon = faUtensils;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult<number>) => void) | null = null;

  readonly createForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    destinoTipo: ['SALIDA' as TipoDestinoRecurso, [Validators.required]],
    destinoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    recursoTipo: ['BIEN' as TipoRecursoProgramable, [Validators.required]],
    recursoId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly editForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadProgramada: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly returnForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadDevuelta: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly consumeForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    cantidadConsumida: [0, [Validators.min(0.001)]],
    observacion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(300)]],
  });

  readonly availableAssets = computed(() =>
    this.availability().bienes.filter((item) => item.disponible),
  );

  selectedSupply() {
    const id = Number(this.createForm.controls.recursoId.value);
    return (
      this.availability().suministros.find(
        (item) => item.suministroId === id,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }

  async openCreate(preferredUotId?: number): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState('create');

    const uotId = this.uot.isSpecific()
      ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? 0
      : preferredUotId && preferredUotId > 0
        ? preferredUotId
        : 0;

    this.createForm.reset({
      uotId,
      destinoTipo: 'SALIDA',
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoTipo: 'BIEN',
      recursoId: 0,
      cantidadProgramada: 1,
      observacion: '',
    });
    this.createForm.controls.uotId[
      this.uot.isSpecific() ? 'disable' : 'enable'
    ]({ emitEvent: false });
    this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();

    if (uotId > 0) {
      this.loadDestinations();
    }

    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  async openDetail(
    item: RecursoProgramado,
    mode: Exclude<RecursoProgramadoFormMode, 'create'>,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    this.resetState(mode);
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    this.loadDestinations(false);
    this.loading.set(true);

    this.getUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (detail) => {
          this.current.set(detail);
          this.editForm.reset({
            cantidadProgramada: detail.cantidadProgramada,
            observacion: detail.observacion ?? '',
          });
          this.returnForm.reset({
            cantidadDevuelta: detail.bienInventarioId
              ? 1
              : Math.max(0.001, detail.cantidadProgramada),
            observacion: '',
          });
          this.consumeForm.reset({
            cantidadConsumida: this.pendingQuantity(detail),
            observacion: '',
          });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });

    return this.resultPromise();
  }

  destinationsForSelectedType(): readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[] {
    const type = this.createForm.controls.destinoTipo.value;
    const uotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotId);

    return this.destinations().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.tipo === type &&
        (uotId <= 0 || item.uotId === uotId),
    );
  }

  selectedDestination(): DestinoRecursoProgramado | null {
    const type = this.createForm.controls.destinoTipo.value;
    const id = Number(this.createForm.controls.destinoId.value);
    return (
      this.destinations().find(
        (item) => item.tipo === type && item.destinoId === id,
      ) ?? null
    );
  }

  destinationOptionLabel(destination: DestinoRecursoProgramado): string {
    const code = destination.codigo ? `${destination.codigo} · ` : '';
    const unit = destination.uotNombre ? ` · ${destination.uotNombre}` : '';
    return `${code}${destination.nombre}${unit}`;
  }

  changeUot(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    const uotId = Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0;

    this.createForm.patchValue({
      uotId,
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoId: 0,
    });
    this.destinations.set([]);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    if (uotId > 0) {
      this.loadDestinations();
    }
  }

  changeDestinationType(value: string): void {
    const type = value as TipoDestinoRecurso;
    this.createForm.patchValue({
      destinoTipo: type,
      destinoId: 0,
      recursoId: 0,
    });
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  changeDestination(value: string): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    this.createForm.controls.destinoId.setValue(
      Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0,
    );
    this.createForm.controls.recursoId.setValue(0);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    if (this.selectedDestination()) {
      this.loadAvailability();
    }
  }

  changeResourceType(type: string): void {
    const resourceType = type as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    this.createForm.patchValue({ recursoTipo: resourceType, recursoId: 0 });

    if (resourceType === 'BIEN') {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.setValue(1);
    }
  }

  loadDestinations(reportError = true): void {
    if (this.loadingDestinations()) return;

    const createUotId = Number(this.createForm.getRawValue().uotId);
    const uotId =
      this.mode() === 'create'
        ? createUotId > 0
          ? createUotId
          : undefined
        : this.uot.isSpecific()
          ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined
          : undefined;

    if (this.mode() === 'create' && !uotId) {
      this.destinations.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.loadingDestinations.set(true);
    this.destinationsUseCase
      .execute(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingDestinations.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (destinations) => this.destinations.set(destinations),
        error: (error) => {
          if (reportError) {
            this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
          }
        },
      });
  }

  loadAvailability(): void {
    const destination = this.selectedDestination();

    if (!destination) {
      this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione un destino antes de consultar recursos.');
      return;
    }

    if (this.loadingAvailability()) return;

    this.loadingAvailability.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availabilityUseCase
      .execute(destination.uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loadingAvailability.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (availability) => this.availability.set(availability),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  save(): void {
    const mode = this.mode();
    if (this.saving() || this.loading() || mode === 'view') return;

    if (mode === 'create') {
      this.saveCreate();
    } else if (mode === 'edit') {
      this.saveEdit();
    } else if (mode === 'return') {
      this.saveReturn();
    } else {
      this.saveConsume();
    }
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
  }

  title(): string {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create':
        return 'Programar recurso';
      case 'edit':
        return 'Editar programación';
      case 'return':
        return 'Registrar devolución';
      case 'consume':
        return 'Registrar consumo';
      default:
        return 'Detalle del recurso programado';
    }
  }

  icon() {
    switch (this.mode()) {
      case 'create':
        return this.addIcon;
      case 'edit':
        return this.editIcon;
      case 'return':
        return this.returnIcon;
      case 'consume':
        return this.consumeIcon;
      default:
        return this.viewIcon;
    }
  }

  destinationLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    const identity = this.destinationIdentity(detail);

    if (identity) {
      const destination = this.destinations().find(
        (item) =>
          item.tipo === identity.tipo && item.destinoId === identity.id,
      );
      if (destination) return this.destinationOptionLabel(destination);

      if (identity.tipo === 'CAMPANIA') return `Campaña #${identity.id}`;
      if (identity.tipo === 'OPERATIVO') return `Operativo #${identity.id}`;
      return `Salida de campo #${identity.id}`;
    }

    return 'Sin destino';
  }

  resourceLabel(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): string {
    return detail.bien ?? detail.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  pendingQuantity(detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle): number {
    const delivered = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'ENTREGA')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    const returned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);
    const consumed = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'CONSUMO')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);

    return Math.max(0, Number((delivered - returned - consumed).toFixed(3)));
  }

  private saveCreate(): void {
    this.createForm.markAllAsTouched();

    if (
      this.createForm.invalid ||
      this.loadingDestinations() ||
      this.loadingAvailability()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const destination = this.selectedDestination();
    if (!destination) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione un destino válido.');
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.createForm.getRawValue();
    const resourceType = raw.recursoTipo as TipoRecursoProgramable;
    const quantity =
      resourceType === 'BIEN' ? 1 : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);
    const selectedSupply = this.selectedSupply();

    if (
      resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' &&
      selectedSupply &&
      quantity > selectedSupply.stockDisponible
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        `La cantidad supera el stock disponible (${selectedSupply.stockDisponible} ${selectedSupply.unidadMedida}).`,
      );
      return;
    }

    const input = {
      campaniaVentaId:
        destination.tipo === 'CAMPANIA' ? destination.destinoId : undefined,
      operativoVentaId:
        destination.tipo === 'OPERATIVO' ? destination.destinoId : undefined,
      salidaCampoId:
        destination.tipo === 'SALIDA' ? destination.destinoId : undefined,
      bienInventarioId:
        resourceType === 'BIEN' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      suministroId:
        resourceType === 'SUMINISTRO' ? Number(raw.recursoId) : undefined,
      cantidadProgramada: quantity,
      observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.programUseCase
      .execute(input)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (id) => {
          this.toast.success('Recurso programado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: id });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveEdit(): void {
    this.editForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.editForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.editForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId
      ? 1
      : Number(raw.cantidadProgramada);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.updateUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadProgramada: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Programación actualizada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveReturn(): void {
    this.returnForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || this.returnForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.returnForm.getRawValue();
    const quantity = detail.bienInventarioId
      ? 1
      : Number(raw.cantidadDevuelta);
    const alreadyReturned = detail.movimientos
      .filter((movement) => movement.tipoMovimiento === 'DEVOLUCION')
      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + movement.cantidad, 0);

    if (quantity + alreadyReturned > detail.cantidadProgramada) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'La devolución supera la cantidad programada pendiente.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.returnUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadDevuelta: quantity,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Devolución registrada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private saveConsume(): void {
    this.consumeForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const detail = this.current();
    if (!detail || detail.bienInventarioId || this.consumeForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.consumeForm.getRawValue();
    const pending = this.pendingQuantity(detail);
    const quantity = Number(raw.cantidadConsumida);

    if (quantity > pending) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La cantidad supera el pendiente por regularizar.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.consumeUseCase
      .execute(detail.recursoProgramadoId, {
        cantidadConsumida: quantity > 0 ? quantity : undefined,
        observacion: raw.observacion.trim() || undefined,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Consumo registrado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: detail.recursoProgramadoId });
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private destinationIdentity(
    detail: RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  ): { tipo: TipoDestinoRecurso; id: number } | null {
    if (detail.campaniaVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'CAMPANIA', id: detail.campaniaVentaId };
    }
    if (detail.operativoVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'OPERATIVO', id: detail.operativoVentaId };
    }
    if (detail.salidaCampoId) {
      return { tipo: 'SALIDA', id: detail.salidaCampoId };
    }
    return null;
  }

  private resetState(mode: RecursoProgramadoFormMode): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.loading.set(false);
    this.loadingDestinations.set(false);
    this.loadingAvailability.set(false);
    this.current.set(null);
    this.destinations.set([]);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.createForm.controls.cantidadProgramada.disable({ emitEvent: false });
  }

  private resultPromise(): Promise<AdminModalResult<number>> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult<number>): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.destinations.set([]);
    this.availability.set({ bienes: [], suministros: [] });
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}

<div class="desco-page">
  <app-page-header
    title="Recursos programados"
    [subtitle]="uot.isGeneral() ? 'Vista general de recursos programados de tus UOT; cada destino conserva su UOT.' : 'Recursos programados de ' + (uot.selected()?.nombre ?? 'la UOT activa') + '.'" 
    eyebrow="Recursos"
    [icon]="pageIcon"
  >
    <div pageActions class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" class="admin-secondary-button" [disabled]="loading()" (click)="load()">
        <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" /> Actualizar
      </button>
      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button" (click)="create()">
        <fa-icon [icon]="addIcon" /> Programar recurso
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-page-header>

  <section class="admin-surface mt-5">
    <div class="admin-toolbar">
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="resourceStateFilter">Estado</label>
        <select id="resourceStateFilter" class="admin-select" [value]="stateFilter()" (change)="stateFilter.set($any($event.target).value); load(1)">
          <option value="">Todos</option>
          <option value="PROGRAMADO">Programado</option>
          <option value="EN_EJECUCION">En ejecución</option>
          <option value="COMPLETADO">Completado</option>
          <option value="CANCELADO">Cancelado</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="admin-field admin-toolbar-field">
        <label for="resourceDestinationFilter">Destino</label>
        <select
          id="resourceDestinationFilter"
          class="admin-select"
          [value]="destinationFilter()"
          [disabled]="destinationsLoading()"
          (change)="onDestinationFilter($any($event.target).value)"
        >
          <option value="">{{ destinationsLoading() ? 'Cargando destinos...' : 'Todos los destinos' }}</option>
          @for (destination of destinations(); track destination.tipo + ':' + destination.destinoId) {
            <option [value]="destinationKey(destination)">{{ destinationOptionLabel(destination) }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (loading()) {
      <app-loading-state title="Cargando recursos" message="Consultando programaciones y movimientos." />
    } @else if (errorMessage()) {
      <app-error-state [message]="errorMessage() || 'Intenta nuevamente.'" (retry)="load()" />
    } @else if (result().items.length === 0) {
      <app-empty-state title="Sin recursos programados" message="No hay programaciones para los filtros seleccionados." />
    } @else {
      <div class="admin-table-wrap">
        <table class="admin-table resource-program-table">
          <thead>
            <tr><th>Recurso</th><th>UOT</th><th>Destino</th><th>Cantidad</th><th>Programación</th><th class="text-center">Estado</th><th class="text-right">Acciones</th></tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (item of result().items; track item.recursoProgramadoId) {
              <tr>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ resourceName(item) }}</strong><span>{{ resourceKind(item) }} · #{{ item.recursoProgramadoId }}</span></div></td>
                <td>{{ resourceUot(item) }}</td>
                <td>{{ destination(item) }}</td>
                <td><div class="admin-stack-copy"><strong>{{ item.cantidadProgramada }}</strong><span>Devuelto: {{ item.cantidadDevuelta }}</span></div></td>
                <td>{{ item.fechaProgramacion ? (item.fechaProgramacion | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') : '—' }}</td>
                <td class="text-center">
                  <span class="admin-status" [class.admin-status--info]="item.estadoProceso==='PROGRAMADO'" [class.admin-status--warning]="item.estadoProceso==='EN_EJECUCION'" [class.admin-status--active]="item.estadoProceso==='COMPLETADO'" [class.admin-status--inactive]="item.estadoProceso==='CANCELADO'">
                    {{ item.estadoProceso }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="admin-row-actions">
                    <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_VER'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Ver detalle" (click)="view(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="viewIcon" /></button>
                    @if (item.estadoProceso === 'PROGRAMADO') {
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_EDITAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" title="Editar" (click)="edit(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="editIcon" /></button>
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--success" title="Asignar" [disabled]="actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId" (click)="assign(item)">
                        @if (actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="assignIcon" /> }
                      </button>
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_RETIRAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button admin-icon-button--danger" title="Cancelar" [disabled]="actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId" (click)="cancel(item)">
                        @if (actionId()===item.recursoProgramadoId) { <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span> } @else { <fa-icon [icon]="cancelIcon" /> }
                      </button>
                    } @else if (item.estadoProceso === 'EN_EJECUCION') {
                      <button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-primary-button admin-primary-button--small" (click)="returnResource(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="returnIcon" /> Devolver</button><button *appPermission="'RECURSOS_CREAR'" type="button" class="admin-icon-button" [disabled]="item.estadoProceso!=='EN_EJECUCION'" title="Registrar consumo" (click)="consume(item)"><fa-icon [icon]="consumeIcon" /></button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <app-paginator
        [page]="result().page"
        [size]="result().size"
        [totalRecords]="result().totalRecords"
        [totalPages]="result().totalPages"
        (pageChange)="load($event, result().size)"
        (sizeChange)="load(1, $event)"
      />
    }
  </section>
</div>

<app-recurso-programado-form />
<app-action-confirm-dialog />

import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRotateLeft,
  faBan,
  faBoxesStacked,
  faCheck,
  faEye,
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faRotate,
  faUtensils,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PaginatorComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/data-display/paginator/paginator';
import { ActionConfirmDialogComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/action-confirm-dialog/action-confirm-dialog';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import {
  PageResult,
  emptyPageResult,
} from '../../../../../../../../shared/models/page-result.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../../../uot/state/uot-context.store';
import { AsignarRecursoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/asignar-recurso.use-case';
import { CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/cancelar-recurso-programado.use-case';
import { ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-destinos-recursos.use-case';
import { ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase } from '../../../../../application/use-case/listar-recursos-programados.use-case';
import {
  DestinoRecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramado,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
} from '../../../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { RecursoProgramadoFormComponent } from '../recurso-programado-form/recurso-programado-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recursos-programados-list-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    PaginatorComponent,
    ActionConfirmDialogComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    RecursoProgramadoFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './recursos-programados-list.html',
  styleUrl: './recursos-programados-list.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class RecursosProgramadosListPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(RecursoProgramadoFormComponent)
  private form!: RecursoProgramadoFormComponent;

  @ViewChild(ActionConfirmDialogComponent)
  private confirm!: ActionConfirmDialogComponent;

  private readonly listUseCase = inject(ListarRecursosProgramadosUseCase);
  private readonly destinationsUseCase = inject(ListarDestinosRecursosUseCase);
  private readonly assignUseCase = inject(AsignarRecursoUseCase);
  private readonly cancelUseCase = inject(CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  readonly uot = inject(UotContextStore);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly destinationsLoading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly actionId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly result = signal<PageResult<RecursoProgramado>>(emptyPageResult(20));
  readonly destinations = signal<readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[]>([]);

  readonly stateFilter = signal('');
  readonly destinationFilter = signal('');

  readonly pageIcon = faBoxesStacked;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly viewIcon = faEye;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly assignIcon = faCheck;
  readonly returnIcon = faArrowRotateLeft;
  readonly consumeIcon = faUtensils;
  readonly cancelIcon = faBan;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadDestinations();
    this.load(1);
  }

  load(page = this.result().page, size = this.result().size): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const destination = this.selectedFilterDestination();

    this.listUseCase
      .execute({
        estadoProceso: this.stateFilter() || undefined,
        campaniaVentaId:
          destination?.tipo === 'CAMPANIA'
            ? destination.destinoId
            : undefined,
        operativoVentaId:
          destination?.tipo === 'OPERATIVO'
            ? destination.destinoId
            : undefined,
        salidaCampoId:
          destination?.tipo === 'SALIDA'
            ? destination.destinoId
            : undefined,
        page,
        size,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => this.result.set(result),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadDestinations(): void {
    if (this.destinationsLoading()) return;

    const uotId =
      this.uot.isSpecific()
        ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined
        : undefined;

    this.destinationsLoading.set(true);
    this.destinationsUseCase
      .execute(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.destinationsLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.destinations.set(items),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  onDestinationFilter(value: string): void {
    this.destinationFilter.set(value);
    this.load(1);
  }

  destinationKey(destination: DestinoRecursoProgramado): string {
    return `${destination.tipo}:${destination.destinoId}`;
  }

  destinationOptionLabel(destination: DestinoRecursoProgramado): string {
    const type = this.destinationTypeLabel(destination.tipo);
    const code = destination.codigo ? `${destination.codigo} · ` : '';
    const unit = destination.uotNombre ? ` · ${destination.uotNombre}` : '';
    return `${type} · ${code}${destination.nombre}${unit}`;
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(
      this.uot.isSpecific() ? this.uot.selectedId() ?? undefined : undefined,
    );
    if (result.saved) {
      this.loadDestinations();
      this.load(1);
    }
  }

  async view(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    await this.form.openDetail(item, 'view');
  }

  async edit(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'edit');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async returnResource(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'return');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async consume(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'EN_EJECUCION') return;
    const result = await this.form.openDetail(item, 'consume');
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async assign(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Asignar recurso',
      message: `El recurso ${this.resourceName(item)} pasará a ejecución y quedará asignado a ${this.destination(item)}.`,
      tone: 'primary',
      confirmLabel: 'Asignar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      requiresReason: false,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.assignUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Recurso asignado');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo asignar el recurso',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  async cancel(item: RecursoProgramado): Promise<void> {
    if (item.estadoProceso !== 'PROGRAMADO' || this.actionId()) return;

    const confirmation = await this.confirm.show({
      title: 'Cancelar programación',
      message: `La programación de ${this.resourceName(item)} para ${this.destination(item)} quedará cancelada.`,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirmLabel: 'Cancelar programación',
      cancelLabel: 'Volver',
      requiresReason: true,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Indica el motivo de la cancelación.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
    });
    if (!confirmation.confirmed || !confirmation.reason) return;

    this.actionId.set(item.recursoProgramadoId);
    this.cancelUseCase
      .execute(item.recursoProgramadoId, confirmation.reason)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.actionId.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Programación cancelada');
          this.load();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo cancelar',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  resourceName(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bien ?? item.suministro ?? 'Recurso';
  }

  resourceKind(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    return item.bienInventarioId ? 'Bien / vehículo' : 'Suministro';
  }

  resourceUot(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    const identity = this.destinationIdentity(item);
    if (!identity) return '—';

    const destination = this.destinations().find(
      (candidate) =>
        candidate.tipo === identity.tipo &&
        candidate.destinoId === identity.id,
    );

    if (!destination) return '—';

    const code = destination.uotCodigo ? `${destination.uotCodigo} · ` : '';
    return `${code}${destination.uotNombre ?? 'UOT'}`;
  }

  destination(item: RecursoProgramado): string {
    const identity = this.destinationIdentity(item);
    if (!identity) return '—';

    const destination = this.destinations().find(
      (candidate) =>
        candidate.tipo === identity.tipo &&
        candidate.destinoId === identity.id,
    );

    if (destination) {
      const unit = destination.uotNombre ? ` · ${destination.uotNombre}` : '';
      const code = destination.codigo ? `${destination.codigo} · ` : '';
      return `${code}${destination.nombre}${unit}`;
    }

    if (identity.tipo === 'CAMPANIA') return `Campaña #${identity.id}`;
    if (identity.tipo === 'OPERATIVO') return `Operativo #${identity.id}`;
    return `Salida de campo #${identity.id}`;
  }

  private selectedFilterDestination(): DestinoRecursoProgramado | null {
    const key = this.destinationFilter();
    if (!key) return null;
    return this.destinations().find((item) => this.destinationKey(item) === key) ?? null;
  }

  private destinationIdentity(
    item: RecursoProgramado,
  ): { tipo: TipoDestinoRecurso; id: number } | null {
    if (item.campaniaVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'CAMPANIA', id: item.campaniaVentaId };
    }
    if (item.operativoVentaId) {
      return { tipo: 'OPERATIVO', id: item.operativoVentaId };
    }
    if (item.salidaCampoId) {
      return { tipo: 'SALIDA', id: item.salidaCampoId };
    }
    return null;
  }

  private destinationTypeLabel(type: TipoDestinoRecurso): string {
    if (type === 'CAMPANIA') return 'Campaña';
    if (type === 'OPERATIVO') return 'Operativo';
    return 'Salida';
  }
}

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import {
  RecursosProgramadosService,
  ResourceProgramCancelRequest,
  ResourceProgramConsumeRequest,
  ResourceProgramProgramRequest,
  ResourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
  ResourceProgramUpdateRequest,
} from '../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import { ProgramadosGateway } from '../../../application/port/out/programados.gateway';
import { RecursoProgramadoFiltro } from '../../../domain/recurso-programado-filtro.model';
import {
  RecursoProgramadoConsumo,
  RecursoProgramadoCreate,
  RecursoProgramadoDevolucion,
  RecursoProgramadoUpdate,
  TipoDestinoRecurso,
} from '../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';
import { ProgramadosHttpMapper } from './programados-http.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ProgramadosHttpAdapter implements ProgramadosGateway {
  private readonly api = inject(RecursosProgramadosService);
  private readonly mapper = inject(ProgramadosHttpMapper);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(filter: RecursoProgramadoFiltro) {
    return this.api
      .recursosListar(
        {
          estadoProceso: filter.estadoProceso,
          campaniaVentaId: filter.campaniaVentaId,
          operativoVentaId: filter.operativoVentaId,
          salidaCampoId: filter.salidaCampoId,
          pagina: filter.page,
          tamano: filter.size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.page(response, filter.size)));
  }

  get(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.detail(response)));
  }

  destinations(uotId?: number, tipo?: TipoDestinoRecurso) {
    return this.api
      .recursosDestinosListar(
        { uotId, tipo },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.destinations(response)));
  }

  availability(uotId: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosDisponibilidad(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.availability(response)));
  }

  program(input: RecursoProgramadoCreate) {
    const resourceProgramProgramRequest: ResourceProgramProgramRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      'recursos-programados:programar',
      resourceProgramProgramRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosProgramar(
            {
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceProgramProgramRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.createdId(response))),
    );
  }

  update(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoUpdate) {
    const resourceProgramUpdateRequest: ResourceProgramUpdateRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos-programados:editar:${id}`,
      resourceProgramUpdateRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosEditar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceProgramUpdateRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  assign(id: number) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos-programados:asignar:${id}`,
      { id },
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosAsignar(
            { id, xIdempotencyKey: key },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  returnResource(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoDevolucion) {
    const resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest: ResourceProgramReturnResourceRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos-programados:devolver:${id}`,
      resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosRegistrarDevolucion(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceProgramReturnResourceRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  consume(id: number, input: RecursoProgramadoConsumo) {
    const resourceProgramConsumeRequest: ResourceProgramConsumeRequest = this.compact(input);
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos-programados:consumir:${id}`,
      resourceProgramConsumeRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosRegistrarConsumo(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceProgramConsumeRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  cancel(id: number, motivo: string) {
    const resourceProgramCancelRequest: ResourceProgramCancelRequest = { motivo };
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos-programados:cancelar:${id}`,
      resourceProgramCancelRequest,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosCancelar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceProgramCancelRequest,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => this.mapper.void(response))),
    );
  }

  private compact<T extends object>(value: T): T {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter(([, item]) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== ''),
    ) as T;
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { DisponibilidadRecurso } from '../../../domain/disponibilidad-recurso.model';
import {
  DestinoRecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramado,
  RecursoProgramadoDetalle,
  RecursoProgramadoMovimiento,
} from '../../../domain/recurso-programado.model';

@Injectable()
export class ProgramadosHttpMapper {
  private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);

  page(response: unknown, size: number) {
    return this.api.page(response, (row) => this.summary(row), size);
  }

  detail(response: unknown): RecursoProgramadoDetalle {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return {
      recursoProgramadoId: this.api.number(row['recursoProgramadoId']),
      campaniaVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['campaniaVentaId']),
      operativoVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['operativoVentaId']),
      salidaCampoId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['salidaCampoId']),
      bienInventarioId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['bienInventarioId']),
      bien: this.api.nullableString(row['bien']),
      estadoBien: this.api.nullableString(row['estadoBien']),
      suministroId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['suministroId']),
      suministro: this.api.nullableString(row['suministro']),
      unidadMedida: this.api.nullableString(row['unidadMedida']),
      cantidadProgramada: this.api.number(row['cantidadProgramada']),
      observacion: this.api.nullableString(row['observacion']),
      estado: this.api.boolean(row['estado']),
      estadoProceso: this.api.string(row['estadoProceso']),
      usuarioProgramacionId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['usuarioProgramacionId']),
      fechaProgramacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaProgramacion']),
      usuarioCancelacionId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['usuarioCancelacionId']),
      fechaCancelacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaCancelacion']),
      motivoCancelacion: this.api.nullableString(row['motivoCancelacion']),
      movimientos: this.api
        .array(row['movimientos'])
        .map((item) => this.movement(this.api.record(item))),
    };
  }

  destinations(response: unknown): readonly DestinoRecursoProgramado[] {
    const rows = this.api.array(this.api.data<unknown>(response));

    return rows.map((item) => {
      const row = this.api.record(item);
      const type = this.api.string(row['tipo']);

      return {
        tipo:
          type === 'CAMPANIA' || type === 'OPERATIVO' || type === 'SALIDA'
            ? type
            : 'SALIDA',
        destinoId: this.api.number(row['destinoId']),
        uotId: this.api.number(row['uotId']),
        uotCodigo: this.api.nullableString(row['uotCodigo']),
        uotNombre: this.api.nullableString(row['uotNombre']),
        codigo: this.api.nullableString(row['codigo']),
        nombre: this.api.string(row['nombre']),
        estadoProceso: this.api.nullableString(row['estadoProceso']),
        fechaReferencia: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaReferencia']),
        descripcion: this.api.nullableString(row['descripcion']),
      };
    });
  }

  availability(response: unknown): DisponibilidadRecurso {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return {
      bienes: this.api.array(row['bienes']).map((item) => {
        const value = this.api.record(item);
        return {
          bienInventarioId: this.api.number(value['bienInventarioId']),
          uotId: this.api.number(value['uotId']),
          uotCodigo: this.api.nullableString(value['uotCodigo']),
          uotNombre: this.api.nullableString(value['uotNombre']),
          codigoPatrimonial: this.api.string(value['codigoPatrimonial']),
          nombre: this.api.string(value['nombre']),
          estadoBien: this.api.string(value['estadoBien']),
          disponible: this.api.boolean(value['disponible']),
        };
      }),
      suministros: this.api.array(row['suministros']).map((item) => {
        const value = this.api.record(item);
        return {
          suministroId: this.api.number(value['suministroId']),
          uotId: this.api.number(value['uotId']),
          uotCodigo: this.api.nullableString(value['uotCodigo']),
          uotNombre: this.api.nullableString(value['uotNombre']),
          codigo: this.api.string(value['codigo']),
          nombre: this.api.string(value['nombre']),
          unidadMedida: this.api.string(value['unidadMedida']),
          stockActual: this.api.number(value['stockActual']),
          stockReservado: this.api.number(value['stockReservado']),
          stockDisponible: this.api.number(value['stockDisponible']),
          stockMinimo: this.api.number(value['stockMinimo']),
          requiereReposicion: this.api.boolean(value['requiereReposicion']),
        };
      }),
    };
  }

  createdId(response: unknown): number {
    const row = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
    return this.api.number(row['recursoProgramadoId']);
  }

  void(response: unknown): void {
    this.api.void(response);
  }

  private summary(row: Record<string, unknown>): RecursoProgramado {
    return {
      recursoProgramadoId: this.api.number(row['recursoProgramadoId']),
      campaniaVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['campaniaVentaId']),
      operativoVentaId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['operativoVentaId']),
      salidaCampoId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['salidaCampoId']),
      bienInventarioId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['bienInventarioId']),
      bien: this.api.nullableString(row['bien']),
      suministroId: this.api.nullableNumber(row['suministroId']),
      suministro: this.api.nullableString(row['suministro']),
      cantidadProgramada: this.api.number(row['cantidadProgramada']),
      estadoProceso: this.api.string(row['estadoProceso']),
      fechaProgramacion: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaProgramacion']),
      observacion: this.api.nullableString(row['observacion']),
      cantidadEjecutada: this.api.number(row['cantidadEjecutada']),
      cantidadDevuelta: this.api.number(row['cantidadDevuelta']),
    };
  }

  private movement(row: Record<string, unknown>): RecursoProgramadoMovimiento {
    return {
      recursoMovimientoId: this.api.number(row['recursoMovimientoId']),
      tipoMovimiento: this.api.string(row['tipoMovimiento']),
      cantidad: this.api.number(row['cantidad']),
      fechaHora: this.api.nullableString(row['fechaHora']),
      observacion: this.api.nullableString(row['observacion']),
      usuario: this.api.nullableString(row['usuario']),
    };
  }
}

    RegistrarConsumoRecursoUseCase,
    CancelarRecursoProgramadoUseCase,
  ];
}

import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { EMPTY, expand, map, reduce } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { RecursosService } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/recursos.service';
import { PageResponseResourceAssetListItemResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/pageResponseResourceAssetListItemResponse';
import { PageResponseResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/pageResponseResourceProductListItemResponse';
import { ResourceAssetCreateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetCreateRequest';
import { ResourceAssetDetailResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetDetailResponse';
import { ResourceAssetIncidentRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetIncidentRequest';
import { ResourceAssetListItemResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetListItemResponse';
import { ResourceAssetStateChangeRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetStateChangeRequest';
import { ResourceAssetUpdateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetUpdateRequest';
import { ResourceCodeSuggestionResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceCodeSuggestionResponse';
import { ResourceKardexResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceKardexResponse';
import { ResourceMovementRegisterRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceMovementRegisterRequest';
import { ResourceProductCreateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductCreateRequest';
import { ResourceProductDetailResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductDetailResponse';
import { ResourceProductListItemResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductListItemResponse';
import { ResourceProductPriceHistoryResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductPriceHistoryResponse';
import { ResourceProductPriceReactivateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductPriceReactivateRequest';
import { ResourceProductPriceVersionRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceProductPriceVersionRequest';
import { ResourceStockResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceStockResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseCreateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseCreateRequest';
import { ResourceWarehouseProductConfigureRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseProductConfigureRequest';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseShareRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseShareRequest';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { PageResult } from '../../../shared/models/page-result.model';

export type ResourceCodeKind = 'BIEN' | 'PRODUCTO' | 'ALMACEN' | 'SUMINISTRO';

export interface ResourceAssetListQuery {
  uotId?: number;
  search?: string;
  typeId?: number;
  state?: string;
  page?: number;
  size?: number;
}

export interface ResourceProductListQuery {
  uotId?: number;
  search?: string;
  category?: string;
  active?: boolean;
  page?: number;
  size?: number;
}

export interface ResourceProductPriceHistory {
  productoPrecioId: number;
  productoId: number;
  productoCodigo: string | null;
  producto: string | null;
  uotId: number;
  uotCodigo: string | null;
  uotNombre: string | null;
  precioInicial: number;
  precioVenta: number;
  moneda: string;
  version: number;
  fechaDesde: string | null;
  fechaHasta: string | null;
  vigente: boolean;
  usuarioId: number | null;
  nombreUsuario: string | null;
  precioOrigenId: number | null;
  precioOrigenVersion: number | null;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ResourceApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(RecursosService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  suggestCode(uotId: number, tipo: ResourceCodeKind) {
    return this.api
      .recursosCodigoSugerido({ uotId, tipo }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<ResourceCodeSuggestionResponse>(response)?.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
        ),
      );
  }

  listAssets(query: ResourceAssetListQuery = {}) {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const size = query.size ?? 20;
    return this.api
      .recursosBienesListar(
        {
          uotId: query.uotId,
          buscar: query.search?.trim() || undefined,
          tipoBienId: query.typeId,
          estado: query.state?.trim() || undefined,
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapAssetPage(
            unwrapApiResponse<PageResponseResourceAssetListItemResponse>(response),
            page,
            size,
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  listAllAssets(uotId?: number) {
    const size = 100;
    return this.listAssets({ uotId, page: 1, size }).pipe(
      expand((page) =>
        page.page < page.totalPages
          ? this.listAssets({ uotId, page: page.page + 1, size })
          : EMPTY,
      ),
      reduce(
        (all, page) => [...all, ...page.items],
        [] as ResourceAssetListItemResponse[],
      ),
    );
  }

  getAsset(id: number) {
    return this.api
      .recursosBienesVer({ id }, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse<ResourceAssetDetailResponse>(response)));
  }

  createAsset(body: ResourceAssetCreateRequest) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      'recursos:bienes:crear',
      body,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosBienesCrear(
            {
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceAssetCreateRequest: body,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response))),
    );
  }

  updateAsset(id: number, body: ResourceAssetUpdateRequest) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos:bienes:editar:${id}`,
      body,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .recursosBienesEditar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              resourceAssetUpdateRequest: body,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },

      producto: item.producto ?? null,

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/recursos/shared/resource-image/resource-image.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../../../../shared/files/local-document-api.service';

export type ResourceImageVariant = 'thumb' | 'card' | 'hero';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-resource-image',
  standalone: true,
  templateUrl: './resource-image.html',
  styleUrl: './resource-image.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ResourceImageComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() fileId: number | null | undefined = null;
  @Input() imageUrl: string | null | undefined = null;
  @Input() alt = 'Imagen del recurso';
  @Input() variant: ResourceImageVariant = 'thumb';

  private readonly files = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private objectUrl: string | null = null;

  readonly src = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly failed = signal(false);

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['fileId'] || changes['imageUrl']) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.clearObjectUrl();
  }

  onImageError(): void {
    this.failed.set(true);
    this.src.set(null);
  }

  private load(): void {
    this.clearObjectUrl();
    this.src.set(null);
    this.failed.set(false);

    const id = Number(this.fileId ?? 0);
    if (id > 0) {
      this.loading.set(true);
      this.files
        .content(id)
        .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
        .subscribe({
          next: (blob) => {
            this.objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            this.src.set(this.objectUrl);
          },
          error: () => {
            this.failed.set(true);
            this.src.set(null);
          },
        });
      return;
    }

    const url = this.imageUrl?.trim();
    if (url) {
      this.src.set(url);
      return;
    }

    this.failed.set(true);
  }

  private clearObjectUrl(): void {
    if (this.objectUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(this.objectUrl);
      this.objectUrl = null;
    }
  }
}
```

import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { SuministrosService } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/suministros.service';
import { PageResponseSupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/pageResponseSupplySummaryResponse';
import { SupplyCreateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyCreateRequest';
import { SupplyMovementCancelRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyMovementCancelRequest';
import { SupplyMovementCreateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyMovementCreateRequest';
import { SupplyMovementResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyMovementResponse';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { SupplyUpdateRequest } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplyUpdateRequest';

export interface SupplyPage {
  items: readonly SupplySummaryResponse[];
  page: number;
  size: number;
  totalRecords: number;
  totalPages: number;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SupplyApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(SuministrosService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(uotId?: number, page = 1, size = 100) {
    return this.api
      .suministrosUotListar(
        {
          uotId,
          pagina: page,
          tamano: size,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapPage(
            unwrapApiResponse<PageResponseSupplySummaryResponse>(response),
            page,
            size,
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  listAll(uotId?: number) {
    return this.list(uotId, 1, 200).pipe(map((page) => page.items));
  }

  create(body: SupplyCreateRequest) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      'recursos:suministros:crear',
      body,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .suministrosUotCrear(
            {
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              supplyCreateRequest: body,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response))),
    );
  }

  update(id: number, body: SupplyUpdateRequest) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos:suministros:editar:${id}`,
      body,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .suministrosUotEditar(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              supplyUpdateRequest: body,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response))),
    );
  }

  kardex(id: number, uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .suministrosUotKardex(
        { id, uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            (unwrapApiResponse<SupplyMovementResponse[]>(response) ?? []) as readonly SupplyMovementResponse[],
        ),
      );
  }

  registerMovement(id: number, body: SupplyMovementCreateRequest) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos:suministros:movimiento:${id}`,
      body,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .suministrosUotMovimientoCrear(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              supplyMovementCreateRequest: body,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response))),
    );
  }

  cancelMovement(
    id: number,
    body: SupplyMovementCancelRequest,
  ) {
    return this.idempotency.idempotent(
      `recursos:suministros:movimiento-anular:${id}`,
      body,
      (key) =>
        this.api
          .suministrosUotMovimientoAnular(
            {
              id,
              xIdempotencyKey: key,
              supplyMovementCancelRequest: body,
            },
            'body',
            false,
            { transferCache: false },
          )
          .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response))),
    );
  }

  private mapPage(
    value: PageResponseSupplySummaryResponse | undefined,
    requestedPage: number,
    requestedSize: number,
  ): SupplyPage {
    return {
      items: [...(value?.items ?? [])],
      page: Number(value?.pagina ?? requestedPage),
      size: Number(value?.tamanio ?? requestedSize),
      totalRecords: Number(value?.totalRegistros ?? 0),
      totalPages: Number(value?.totalPaginas ?? 0),
    };
  }
}

class AuditoriaHttpMapper{private readonly a=inject(AdminApiMapper);page(r:unknown,s:number){return this.a.page(r,x=>this.event(x),s);}detail(r:unknown):AuditoriaDetalle{const x=this.a.record(this.a.data<unknown>(r));return{evento:this.event(this.a.record(x['evento'])),transiciones:this.a.array(x['transiciones']).map(v=>{const cols=['fechaHoraUtc','nombreUsuario','nombrePersona','modulo','accion','nombreEntidad','identificador','motivo','resultado'],q=(v:unknown)=>`"${String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')}"`,csv=[cols.map(q).join(','),...rows.map(r=>cols.map(c=>q((r event(x:Record<string,unknown>):AuditoriaEvento{return{auditoriaEventoId:this.a.number(x['auditoriaEventoId']),fechaHoraUtc:this.a.nullableString(x['fechaHoraUtc']),usuarioId:this.a.nullableNumber(x['usuarioId']),nombreUsuario:this.a.nullableString(x['nombreUsuario']),nombrePersona:this.a.nullableString(x['nombrePersona']),moduloId:this.a.nullableNumber(x['moduloId']),codigoModulo:this.a.nullableString(x['codigoModulo']),modulo:this.a.nullableString(x['modulo']),accion:this.a.string(x['accion']),esquemaEntidad:this.a.nullableString(x['esquemaEntidad']),nombreEntidad:this.a.nullableString(x['nombreEntidad']),identificador:this.a.nullableString(x['identificador']),motivo:this.a.nullableString(x['motivo']),resultado:this.a.nullableString(x['resultado']),endpoint:this.a.nullableString(x['endpoint']),ip:this.a.nullableString(x['ip']),sesionUsuarioId:this.a.nullableNumber(x['sesionUsuarioId']),sesionPublicaId:this.a.nullableString(x['sesionPublicaId']),dispositivoUsuarioId:this.a.nullableNumber(x['dispositivoUsuarioId']),navegador:this.a.nullableString(x['navegador']),sistemaOperativo:this.a.nullableString(x['sistemaOperativo']),userAgent:this.a.nullableString(x['userAgent']),dispositivoReconocido:this.a.boolean(x['dispositivoReconocido']),correlacionId:this.a.nullableString(x['correlacionId']),solicitudId:this.a.nullableString(x['solicitudId']),datosAnteriores:x['datosAnteriores'],datosPosteriores:x['datosPosteriores']};}}

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/reportes-control/reportes/adapter/out/http/reportes-http.mapper.ts`

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { AdminApiMapper } from '../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-api.mapper';
import { Reporte, ReporteDatos } from '../../../domain/reporte.model';
@Injectable()
export class ReportesHttpMapper {
    private readonly api = inject(AdminApiMapper);
    catalog(response: unknown): readonly Reporte[] {
        return this.api.array(this.api.data<unknown>(response)).map((value) => {
            const item = this.api.record(value);
            return {
                codigo: this.api.string(item['codigo']),
                nombre: this.api.string(item['nombre']),
                grupo: this.api.nullableString(item['grupo']),
                descripcion: this.api.nullableString(item['descripcion']),
            };
        });
    }
    data(response: unknown): ReporteDatos {
        const data = this.api.record(this.api.data<unknown>(response));
        const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = this.api
            .array(data['filas'])
            .map((value) => this.api.record(value));
        const columns: string[] = Array.from(new Set<string>(rows.flatMap((row) => Object.keys(row))));
        return {
            reporte: this.api.string(data['reporte']),
            secciones: [
                { codigo: 'RESULTADOS', titulo: 'Resultados', columnas: columns, filas: rows },
            ],
        };
    }
    toCsv(data: ReporteDatos): Blob {
        const rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] = data.secciones.flatMap((section) => section.filas);
        const columns: string[] = Array.from(new Set<string>(data.secciones.flatMap((section) => [...section.columnas])));
        const quote = (value: unknown): string => `"${String(value ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        const csv = [
            columns.map(quote).join(','),
            ...rows.map((row) => columns.map((column) => quote(row[column])).join(',')),
        ].join('\n');
        return new Blob(['\ufeff', csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    }
}
```

- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/features/uot/adapter/in/ui/components/uot-context-switcher/uot-context-switcher.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  Input,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faBuildingCircleCheck, faGlobe } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { ScreenLoadingService } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/screen-loading/screen-loading.service';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-context-switcher',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-context-switcher.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-context-switcher.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotContextSwitcherComponent {
  @Input() compact = false;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);
  private readonly screenLoading = inject(ScreenLoadingService);

  readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly changing = signal(false);
  readonly unitIcon = faBuildingCircleCheck;
  readonly generalIcon = faGlobe;

  readonly value = computed(() =>
    this.store.isGeneral()
      ? 'GENERAL'
      : String(this.store.selectedId() ?? ''),
  );

  readonly modeLabel = computed(() =>
    this.store.isGeneral() ? 'GENERAL' : 'UOT',
  );

  readonly disabled = computed(
    () =>
      this.changing() ||
      !this.store.loaded() ||
      this.store.memberships().length === 0,
  );

  change(value: string): void {
    if (this.disabled()) return;

    const general = value === 'GENERAL';
    const parsedUotId = Number(value);

    if (!general && (!Number.isFinite(parsedUotId) || parsedUotId <= 0)) {
      return;
    }

    if (
      (general && this.store.isGeneral()) ||
      (!general &&
        this.store.isSpecific() &&
        this.store.selectedId() === parsedUotId)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const targetUnit = general
      ? null
      : this.store.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === parsedUotId) ?? null;

    this.changing.set(true);
    this.screenLoading.show(
      general ? 'Activando vista general' : 'Cambiando unidad de trabajo',
      general
        ? 'Actualizando la información para mostrar todas tus UOT autorizadas.'
        : `Actualizando permisos y datos para ${targetUnit?.nombre ?? 'la UOT seleccionada'}.`,
    );

    this.api
      .selectContext(
        general ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA',
        general ? undefined : parsedUotId,
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            general
              ? 'Vista general activada'
              : `UOT activa: ${targetUnit?.nombre ?? 'unidad seleccionada'}`,
          );
          void this.refreshCurrentRoute();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.changing.set(false);
          this.screenLoading.hide();
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo cambiar la UOT',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private async refreshCurrentRoute(): Promise<void> {
    const returnUrl = this.router.url;

    try {
      const moved = await this.router.navigateByUrl('/__contexto-uot', {
        skipLocationChange: true,
      });

      if (moved) {
        await this.router.navigateByUrl(returnUrl, { replaceUrl: true });
      }
    } finally {
      this.changing.set(false);
      this.screenLoading.hide();
    }
  }
}
```

import {

} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
