```typescript
  faPen,
  faPlus,
  faPowerOff,
  faRotate,
  faSitemap,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import { PermissionDirective } from '../../../../../../../core/access/permission.directive';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/empty-state/empty-state';
import { ErrorStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/error-state/error-state';
import { LoadingStateComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/data-display/loading-state/loading-state';
import { PageHeaderComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/layout/page-header/page-header';
import { ListarRolesUseCase } from '../../../../../../administracion/roles-permisos/application/use-case/listar-roles.use-case';
import { ListarUsuariosUseCase } from '../../../../../../administracion/usuarios/application/use-case/listar-usuarios.use-case';
import { loadAllAdminPages } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-reference.util';
import { AdminSelectOption } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotUnit } from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';
import { UotDeactivationFormComponent } from '../uot-deactivation-form/uot-deactivation-form';
import {
  UotFormComponent,
  UotFormOptions,
} from '../uot-form/uot-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-admin-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    PermissionDirective,
    EmptyStateComponent,
    ErrorStateComponent,
    LoadingStateComponent,
    PageHeaderComponent,
    UotFormComponent,
    UotDeactivationFormComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './uot-admin.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-admin.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotAdminPage implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(UotFormComponent) private form!: UotFormComponent;
  @ViewChild(UotDeactivationFormComponent)
  private deactivationForm!: UotDeactivationFormComponent;

  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly listUsers = inject(ListarUsuariosUseCase);
  private readonly listRoles = inject(ListarRolesUseCase);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly referencesLoading = signal(true);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly allUnits = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly users = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly showInactive = signal(false);

  readonly units = computed<readonly UotUnit[]>(() =>
    this.showInactive()
      ? this.allUnits().filter((item) => !item.estado)
      : this.allUnits().filter((item) => item.estado),
  );

  readonly activeUnits = computed<readonly UotUnit[]>(() =>
    this.allUnits().filter((item) => item.estado),
  );

  readonly pageIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly addIcon = faPlus;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly accessIcon = faKey;
  readonly deactivateIcon = faPowerOff;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
    this.loadReferences();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .list(this.showInactive())
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.allUnits.set(items),
        error: (error) =>
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  loadReferences(): void {
    this.referencesLoading.set(true);

    forkJoin({
      users: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.listUsers.execute({ page, size }),
      ),
      roles: loadAllAdminPages((page, size) =>
        this.listRoles.execute(page, size),
      ),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.referencesLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ users, roles }) => {
          this.users.set(
            users.map((item) => ({
              value: item.usuarioId,
              label:
                item.empleado?.trim() ||
                item.nombreUsuario ||
                `Usuario ${item.usuarioId}`,
              description: item.nombreUsuario,
            })),
          );
          this.roles.set(
            roles
              .filter((item) => item.estado)
              .map((item) => ({
                value: item.rolId,
                label: item.nombre,
                description: item.codigo,
              })),
          );
        },
        error: () => {
          this.users.set([]);
          this.roles.set([]);
        },
      });
  }

  async create(): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openCreate(this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async edit(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openEdit(unit, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.load();
  }

  async access(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.form.openAccess(unit, this.options());
    if (result.saved) this.loadReferences();
  }

  async deactivate(unit: UotUnit): Promise<void> {
    if (!unit.estado || unit.esRaiz) return;
    const result = await this.deactivationForm.open(
      unit,
      this.activeUnits(),
    );
    if (result.saved) {
      this.showInactive.set(true);
      this.load();
    }
  }

  toggleInactive(value: boolean): void {
    this.showInactive.set(value);
    this.load();
  }

  parentName(unit: UotUnit): string {
    if (!unit.uotPadreId) return 'Raíz';
    return (
      this.allUnits().find((item) => item.uotId === unit.uotPadreId)?.nombre ??
      `UOT #${unit.uotPadreId}`
    );
  }

  private options(): UotFormOptions {
    return {
      units: this.activeUnits(),
      users: this.users(),
      roles: this.roles(),
    };
  }
}
```

```html
<dialog
  #dialog
  class="modal desco-modal"
  (cancel)="$event.preventDefault(); close()"
>
  <div class="modal-box admin-modal-box admin-modal-box--wide">
    <header class="admin-modal-header">
      <div class="admin-modal-title-group">
        <span class="admin-modal-icon admin-modal-icon--danger">
          <fa-icon [icon]="deactivateIcon" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p>Administración UOT</p>
          <h2>Deshabilitar {{ current()?.nombre || 'UOT' }}</h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        class="admin-icon-button"
        aria-label="Cerrar"
        [disabled]="loading() || transferring() || deactivating()"
        (click)="close()"
      >
        <fa-icon [icon]="closeIcon" />
      </button>
    </header>

    @if (errorMessage()) {
      <div class="admin-inline-error" role="alert">{{ errorMessage() }}</div>
    }

    @if (loading()) {
      <div class="uot-deactivation-loading">
        <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-md"></span>
        <span>Analizando dependencias y recursos de la UOT…</span>
      </div>
    } @else if (impact(); as data) {
      <section class="uot-impact-grid">
        <article><span>Usuarios activos</span><strong>{{ data.usuariosActivos }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Empleados activos</span><strong>{{ data.empleadosActivos }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Áreas activas</span><strong>{{ data.areasActivas }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Organizaciones</span><strong>{{ data.organizacionesActivas }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Bienes activos</span><strong>{{ data.bienesActivos }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Productos con stock</span><strong>{{ data.productosConStock }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Suministros con stock</span><strong>{{ data.suministrosConStock }}</strong></article>
        <article><span>Operaciones abiertas</span><strong>{{ data.ventasAbiertas + data.campaniasAbiertas + data.operativosAbiertos + data.salidasAbiertas + data.recursosAbiertos }}</strong></article>
      </section>

      @if (data.bloqueos.length) {
        <section class="uot-blockers">
          <header>
            <fa-icon [icon]="warningIcon" />
            <div>
              <strong>La UOT todavía no puede cerrarse</strong>
              <span>Resuelve los siguientes puntos antes de ejecutar la baja.</span>
            </div>
          </header>
          <ul>
            @for (block of data.bloqueos; track block) {
              <li>{{ block }}</li>
            }
          </ul>
        </section>
      }

      <form class="admin-form-grid" [formGroup]="form">
        @if (requiresResourceTransfer()) {
          <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
            <label for="uotTransferTarget">UOT destino</label>
            <select
              id="uotTransferTarget"
              class="admin-select"
              formControlName="uotDestinoId"
              [disabled]="transferring() || deactivating()"
              (change)="onTargetChange($any($event.target).value)"
            >
              <option [value]="0">Seleccionar UOT destino</option>
              @for (unit of targetOptions(); track unit.uotId) {
                <option [value]="unit.uotId">
                  {{ unit.codigo }} · {{ unit.nombre }}
                </option>
              }
            </select>
            <small>
              Los bienes y suministros activos se transferirán a esta UOT. El Kardex histórico permanecerá en la UOT origen.
            </small>
          </div>

          @if (data.productosConStock > 0 || data.stockReservado > 0) {
            <label class="admin-switch-row admin-field-span-2">
              <span>
                <strong>Transferir stock de productos</strong>
                <small>Generará salida en origen y entrada en destino.</small>
              </span>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                class="admin-switch-control"
                formControlName="transferirStock"
              />
            </label>

            @if (form.controls.transferirStock.value) {
              <div class="admin-field">
                <label for="uotSourceWarehouse">Almacén origen</label>
                <select
                  id="uotSourceWarehouse"
                  class="admin-select"
                  formControlName="almacenOrigenId"
                >
                  <option [value]="0">Seleccionar</option>
                  @for (warehouse of sourceWarehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
                    <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">
                      {{ warehouse.codigo }} · {{ warehouse.nombre }}
                    </option>
                  }
                </select>
              </div>

              <div class="admin-field">
                <label for="uotTargetWarehouse">Almacén destino</label>
                <select
                  id="uotTargetWarehouse"
                  class="admin-select"
                  formControlName="almacenDestinoId"
                  [disabled]="targetLoading()"
                >
                  <option [value]="0">
                    {{ targetLoading() ? 'Cargando…' : 'Seleccionar' }}
                  </option>
                  @for (warehouse of targetWarehouses(); track warehouse.almacenId) {
                    <option [value]="warehouse.almacenId">
                      {{ warehouse.codigo }} · {{ warehouse.nombre }}
                    </option>
                  }
                </select>
              </div>
            }
          }

          <div class="uot-transfer-summary admin-field-span-2">
            <span>{{ assets().length }} bien(es) detectados</span>
            <span>{{ supplies().length }} suministro(s) detectados</span>
            <span>{{ data.productosConStock }} producto(s) con stock</span>
          </div>
        }

        <div class="admin-field admin-field-span-2">
          <label for="uotDeactivateReason">Motivo</label>
          <textarea
            id="uotDeactivateReason"
            class="admin-textarea"
            rows="3"
            maxlength="300"
            formControlName="motivo"
            placeholder="Indica el motivo de la transferencia o de la baja."
          ></textarea>
          <app-form-error
            [control]="form.controls.motivo"
            fieldLabel="El motivo"
            [messages]="{ blank: 'El motivo no puede contener solo espacios.' }"
          />
        </div>

        <footer class="admin-modal-actions admin-field-span-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-secondary-button"
            [disabled]="loading() || transferring() || deactivating()"
            (click)="refresh()"
          >
            <fa-icon [class.animate-spin]="loading()" [icon]="refreshIcon" />
            Recalcular impacto
          </button>

          @if (requiresResourceTransfer()) {
            <button
              type="button"
              class="admin-secondary-button"
              [disabled]="transferring() || deactivating()"
              (click)="transfer()"
            >
              @if (transferring()) {
                <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
              } @else {
                <fa-icon [icon]="transferIcon" />
              }
              Transferir recursos
            </button>
          }

          <button
            type="button"
            class="admin-danger-button"
            [disabled]="!data.puedeDeshabilitar || transferring() || deactivating()"
            (click)="deactivate()"
          >
            @if (deactivating()) {
              <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span>
            } @else {
              <fa-icon [icon]="deactivateIcon" />
            }
            Deshabilitar UOT
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    }
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightArrowLeft,
  faPowerOff,
  faRotate,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { forkJoin, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { ResourceAssetListItemResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceAssetListItemResponse';
import { ResourceWarehouseResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/resourceWarehouseResponse';
import { SupplySummaryResponse } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/supplySummaryResponse';
import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import {
  closeAnimatedDialog,
  openAnimatedDialog,
} from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import { AdminModalResult } from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { ResourceApiService } from '../../../../../../recursos/shared/resource-api.service';
import { SupplyApiService } from '../../../../../../recursos/shared/supply-api.service';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import {
  UotDeactivationImpact,
  UotUnit,
} from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-deactivation-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-deactivation-form.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-deactivation-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotDeactivationFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly resources = inject(ResourceApiService);
  private readonly suppliesApi = inject(SupplyApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly current = signal<UotUnit | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly impact = signal<UotDeactivationImpact | null>(null);
  readonly assets = signal<readonly ResourceAssetListItemResponse[]>([]);
  readonly supplies = signal<readonly SupplySummaryResponse[]>([]);
  readonly sourceWarehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);
  readonly targetWarehouses = signal<readonly ResourceWarehouseResponse[]>([]);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly targetLoading = signal(false);
  readonly transferring = signal(false);
  readonly deactivating = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly transferIcon = faArrowRightArrowLeft;
  readonly deactivateIcon = faPowerOff;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;
  readonly warningIcon = faTriangleExclamation;

  private resolver: ((result: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly form = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotDestinoId: [0],
    almacenOrigenId: [0],
    almacenDestinoId: [0],
    transferirStock: [true],
    motivo: [
      '',
      [
        Validators.required,
        notBlankValidator,
        Validators.minLength(5),
        Validators.maxLength(300),
      ],
    ],
  });

  open(
    unit: UotUnit,
    units: readonly UotUnit[],
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.current.set(unit);
    this.units.set(units);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.impact.set(null);
    this.assets.set([]);
    this.supplies.set([]);
    this.sourceWarehouses.set([]);
    this.targetWarehouses.set([]);

    const defaultTarget =
      units.find(
        (item) =>
          item.estado &&
          item.uotId !== unit.uotId &&
          !this.isDescendantOf(item, unit.uotId),
      ) ?? null;

    this.form.reset({
      uotDestinoId: defaultTarget?.uotId ?? 0,
      almacenOrigenId: 0,
      almacenDestinoId: 0,
      transferirStock: true,
      motivo: '',
    });

    this.loadSource();
    if (defaultTarget) {
      this.loadTargetWarehouses(defaultTarget.uotId);
    }

    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    if (
      !this.loading() &&
      !this.transferring() &&
      !this.deactivating()
    ) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  targetOptions(): readonly UotUnit[] {
    const current = this.current();
    if (!current) return [];

    return this.units().filter(
      (item) =>
        item.estado &&
        item.uotId !== current.uotId &&
        !this.isDescendantOf(item, current.uotId),
    );
  }

  onTargetChange(raw: string): void {
    const id = Number(raw);
    this.form.controls.almacenDestinoId.setValue(0);

    if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) {
      this.targetWarehouses.set([]);
      return;
    }

    this.loadTargetWarehouses(id);
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this.loadSource();
  }

  transfer(): void {
    const unit = this.current();
    const impact = this.impact();

    if (!unit || !impact || this.transferring()) return;

    this.form.controls.motivo.markAsTouched();
    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const targetId = Number(raw.uotDestinoId);

    if (targetId <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Seleccione la UOT que recibirá los recursos.');
      return;
    }

    if (this.form.controls.motivo.invalid) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Indique el motivo de la transferencia.');
      return;
    }

    const transferStock =
      raw.transferirStock &&
      (impact.productosConStock > 0 || impact.stockReservado > 0);

    const sourceWarehouseId = Number(raw.almacenOrigenId);
    const targetWarehouseId = Number(raw.almacenDestinoId);

    if (
      transferStock &&
      (sourceWarehouseId <= 0 || targetWarehouseId <= 0)
    ) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'Para transferir stock seleccione el almacén origen y el almacén destino.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const assetIds = this.assets()
      .filter((item) => item.estado !== false)
      .map((item) => Number(item.bienInventarioId))
      .filter((id) => id > 0);

    const supplyIds = this.supplies()
      .filter(
        (item) =>
          item.estado !== false &&
          Number(item.stockActual ?? item.stock ?? 0) > 0,
      )
      .map((item) => Number(item.suministroId))
      .filter((id) => id > 0);

    this.transferring.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .transferResources(unit.uotId, {
        uotDestinoId: targetId,
        almacenOrigenId:
          transferStock && sourceWarehouseId > 0
            ? sourceWarehouseId
            : undefined,
        almacenDestinoId:
          transferStock && targetWarehouseId > 0
            ? targetWarehouseId
            : undefined,
        transferirStock: transferStock,
        bienIds: assetIds.length ? assetIds : undefined,
        suministroIds: supplyIds.length ? supplyIds : undefined,
        motivo: normalizeText(raw.motivo),
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.transferring.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.toast.success(
            'Recursos transferidos',
            `${result.productosTransferidos} productos, ${result.bienesTransferidos} bienes y ${result.suministrosTransferidos} suministros procesados.`,
          );
          this.loadSource();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudieron transferir los recursos', message);
        },
      });
  }

  deactivate(): void {
    const unit = this.current();
    const impact = this.impact();

    if (
      !unit ||
      !impact?.puedeDeshabilitar ||
      this.deactivating()
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.form.controls.motivo.markAsTouched();
    if (this.form.controls.motivo.invalid) {
      this.errorMessage.set('Indique el motivo de la baja de la UOT.');
      return;
    }

    this.deactivating.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .deactivate(unit.uotId, normalizeText(this.form.controls.motivo.value))
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.deactivating.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('UOT deshabilitada');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: unit.uotId });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo deshabilitar la UOT', message);
        },
      });
  }

  requiresResourceTransfer(): boolean {
    const value = this.impact();
    return Boolean(
      value &&
        (value.productosConStock > 0 ||
          value.bienesActivos > 0 ||
          value.suministrosConStock > 0),
    );
  }

  hasOperationalBlocks(): boolean {
    const value = this.impact();
    return Boolean(
      value &&
        (value.ventasAbiertas > 0 ||
          value.campaniasAbiertas > 0 ||
          value.operativosAbiertos > 0 ||
          value.salidasAbiertas > 0 ||
          value.recursosAbiertos > 0 ||
          value.stockReservado > 0 ||
          value.suministrosReservados > 0),
    );
  }

  private loadSource(): void {
    const unit = this.current();
    if (!unit) return;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    forkJoin({
      impact: this.api.impact(unit.uotId),
      assets: this.resources.listAllAssets(unit.uotId),
      supplies: this.suppliesApi.listAll(unit.uotId),
      warehouses: this.resources.listWarehouses(unit.uotId),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ impact, assets, supplies, warehouses }) => {
          this.impact.set(impact);
          this.assets.set(assets);
          this.supplies.set(supplies);
          this.sourceWarehouses.set(
            warehouses.filter(
              (item) =>
                item.estado !== false &&
                item.permiteSalida !== false,
            ),
          );

          const sourceId = Number(this.form.controls.almacenOrigenId.value);
          if (
            sourceId <= 0 ||
            !this.sourceWarehouses().some(
              (item) => Number(item.almacenId) === sourceId,
            )
          ) {
            this.form.controls.almacenOrigenId.setValue(
              Number(this.sourceWarehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0),
            );
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
        },
      });
  }

  private loadTargetWarehouses(uotId: number): void {
    this.targetLoading.set(true);

    this.resources
      .listWarehouses(uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.targetLoading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.targetWarehouses.set(
            items.filter(
              (item) =>
                item.estado !== false &&
                item.permiteEntrada !== false,
            ),
          );
          this.form.controls.almacenDestinoId.setValue(
            Number(this.targetWarehouses()[0]?.almacenId ?? 0),
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.targetWarehouses.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message);
        },
      });
  }

  private isDescendantOf(
    candidate: UotUnit,
    ancestorId: number,
  ): boolean {
    let parentId = candidate.uotPadreId;
    const visited = new Set<number>();

    while (parentId && !visited.has(parentId)) {
      if (parentId === ancestorId) return true;
      visited.add(parentId);
      parentId =
        this.units().find((item) => item.uotId === parentId)
          ?.uotPadreId ?? null;
    }

    return false;
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.current.set(null);
      this.impact.set(null);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faFloppyDisk,
  faKey,
  faPen,
  faSitemap,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { Observable, concatMap, finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../../../../../../shared/feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { FormErrorComponent } from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/form-error/form-error';
import {
  normalizeOptionalText,
  normalizeText,
  notBlankValidator,
} from '../../../../../../../shared/forms/validators/desco-input.validators';
import {
  AdminModalResult,
  AdminSelectOption,
} from '../../../../../../administracion/shared/admin-modal.types';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotUnit } from '../../../../../domain/uot.model';

type UotFormMode = 'create' | 'edit' | 'access';

export interface UotFormOptions {
  units: readonly UotUnit[];
  users?: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
  roles?: readonly AdminSelectOption[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FaIconComponent, FormErrorComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-form.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-form.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotFormComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private readonly dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly mode = signal<UotFormMode>('create');
  readonly current = signal<UotUnit | null>(null);
  readonly units = signal<readonly UotUnit[]>([]);
  readonly users = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly roles = signal<readonly AdminSelectOption[]>([]);
  readonly saving = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly addIcon = faSitemap;
  readonly editIcon = faPen;
  readonly accessIcon = faKey;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly saveIcon = faFloppyDisk;

  private resolver: ((value: AdminModalResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly unitForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    uotPadreId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    ubicacionId: [0, [Validators.min(0)]],
    codigo: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(40)],
    ],
    nombre: [
      '',
      [Validators.required, notBlankValidator, Validators.maxLength(180)],
    ],
    descripcion: ['', [Validators.maxLength(500)]],
  });

  readonly accessForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({
    usuarioId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    rolId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    predeterminada: [false],
  });

  openCreate(options: UotFormOptions): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('create', options, null);
    const parent =
      options.units.find((item) => item.esRaiz && item.estado) ??
      options.units.find((item) => item.estado) ??
      null;

    this.unitForm.reset({
      uotPadreId: parent?.uotId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: 0,
      codigo: '',
      nombre: '',
      descripcion: '',
    });
    this.unitForm.controls.codigo.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openEdit(
    unit: UotUnit,
    options: UotFormOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('edit', options, unit);
    this.unitForm.reset({
      uotPadreId: unit.uotPadreId ?? 0,
      ubicacionId: unit.ubicacionId ?? 0,
      codigo: unit.codigo,
      nombre: unit.nombre,
      descripcion: unit.descripcion ?? '',
    });
    this.unitForm.controls.codigo.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    return this.show();
  }

  openAccess(
    unit: UotUnit,
    options: UotFormOptions,
  ): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.prepare('access', options, unit);
    this.accessForm.reset({
      usuarioId: options.users?.[0]?.value ?? 0,
      rolId: options.roles?.[0]?.value ?? 0,
      predeterminada: false,
    });
    return this.show();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.saving()) {
      this.finish({ saved: false, value: null });
    }
  }

  title(): string {
    if (this.mode() === 'access') return 'Asignar acceso UOT';
    return this.mode() === 'edit' ? 'Editar UOT' : 'Registrar UOT';
  }

  save(): void {
    if (this.saving()) return;

    if (this.mode() === 'access') {
      this.saveAccess();
      return;
    }

    this.saveUnit();
  }

  parentOptions(): readonly UotUnit[] {
    const currentId = this.current()?.uotId ?? null;
    return this.units().filter(
      (item) => item.estado && item.uotId !== currentId,
    );
  }

  private saveUnit(): void {
    this.unitForm.markAllAsTouched();
    if (this.unitForm.invalid) return;

    const raw = this.unitForm.getRawValue();
    const current = this.current();
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const operation: Observable<unknown> = current
      ? this.api.update(current.uotId, {
          uotPadreId:
            Number(raw.uotPadreId) > 0 ? Number(raw.uotPadreId) : undefined,
          ubicacionId:
            Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        })
      : this.api.create({
          uotPadreId: Number(raw.uotPadreId),
          ubicacionId:
            Number(raw.ubicacionId) > 0 ? Number(raw.ubicacionId) : undefined,
          codigo: raw.codigo.trim().toUpperCase(),
          nombre: normalizeText(raw.nombre),
          descripcion: normalizeOptionalText(raw.descripcion),
        });

    operation
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success(
            current ? 'UOT actualizada' : 'UOT registrada',
          );
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo guardar la UOT', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private saveAccess(): void {
    this.accessForm.markAllAsTouched();
    const unit = this.current();

    if (this.accessForm.invalid || !unit) return;

    const raw = this.accessForm.getRawValue();
    const usuarioId = Number(raw.usuarioId);
    const rolId = Number(raw.rolId);

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.api
      .assignUser(unit.uotId, {
        usuarioId,
        predeterminada: raw.predeterminada,
      })
      .pipe(
        concatMap(() =>
          this.api.assignRole(unit.uotId, {
            usuarioId,
            rolId,
          }),
        ),
        finalize(() => this.saving.set(false)),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Acceso UOT asignado');
          this.finish({ saved: true, value: null });
        },
        error: (error: unknown) => {
          const message = mapOpenApiError(error).message;
          this.errorMessage.set(message);
          this.toast.error('No se pudo asignar el acceso', message);
        },
      });
  }

  private prepare(
    mode: UotFormMode,
    options: UotFormOptions,
    current: UotUnit | null,
  ): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.current.set(current);
    this.units.set(options.units);
    this.users.set(options.users ?? []);
    this.roles.set(options.roles ?? []);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }

  private show(): Promise<AdminModalResult> {
    this.dialogRef.nativeElement.showModal();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  private finish(result: AdminModalResult): void {
    if (this.dialogRef.nativeElement.open) {
      this.dialogRef.nativeElement.close();
    }
    this.resolver?.(result);
    this.resolver = null;
    this.current.set(null);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRight,
  faBuildingCircleCheck,
  faGlobe,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ThemeService } from '../../../../../../../core/ui/theme.service';
import { UotApiService } from '../../../../out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-uot-selection-page',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './uot-selection.html',
  styleUrl: './uot-selection.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class UotSelectionPage implements OnInit {
  private readonly api = inject(UotApiService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);

  readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);
  readonly theme = inject(ThemeService);
  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly selecting = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly unitIcon = faBuildingCircleCheck;
  readonly generalIcon = faGlobe;
  readonly arrowIcon = faArrowRight;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.api
      .loadContext()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (context) => {
          if (!context.requiereSeleccion && context.uotSeleccionadaId) {
            void this.finishNavigation();
          }
        },
        error: (error) => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  select(uotId: number): void {
    this.commit('ESPECIFICA', uotId, this.selectionKey(uotId));
  }

  selectionKey(uotId?: number): string {
    return String(uotId ?? '');
  }

  selectGeneral(): void {
    this.commit('GENERAL', null, 'GENERAL');
  }

  private commit(
    mode: 'ESPECIFICA' | 'GENERAL',
    uotId: number | null,
    key: string,
  ): void {
    if (this.selecting()) return;

    this.selecting.set(key);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.api
      .selectContext(mode, uotId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.selecting.set(null)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => void this.finishNavigation(),
        error: (error) => this.error.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  private finishNavigation(): Promise<boolean> {
    const returnUrl = this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('returnUrl');
    const safe =
      returnUrl &&
      returnUrl.startsWith('/') &&
      !returnUrl.startsWith('//') &&
      !returnUrl.startsWith('/seleccionar-uot')
        ? returnUrl
        : '/inicio';

    return this.router.navigateByUrl(safe);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map, switchMap, tap } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../../../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { UOTService } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/uOT.service';
import { UotAssignRoleRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotAssignRoleRequest';
import { UotAssignUserRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotAssignUserRequest';
import { UotCreateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotCreateRequest';
import { UotDeactivateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotDeactivateRequest';
import { UotDeactivationImpactResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotDeactivationImpactResponse';
import { UotResourceTransferResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotResourceTransferResponse';
import { UotSelectContextRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotSelectContextRequest';
import { UotTransferResourcesRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotTransferResourcesRequest';
import { UotUpdateRequest } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotUpdateRequest';
import { UotContextResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotContextResponse';
import { UotUnitResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/uotUnitResponse';
import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../../../../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { ObtenerContextoActualUseCase } from '../../../../acceso/application/use-case/obtener-contexto-actual.use-case';
import {
  UotContext,
  UotDeactivationImpact,
  UotMode,
  UotResourceTransfer,
  UotTransferResources,
  UotUnit,
} from '../../../domain/uot.model';
import { UotContextStore } from '../../../state/uot-context.store';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UotApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(UOTService);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);
  private readonly accessContext = inject(ObtenerContextoActualUseCase);
  private readonly store = inject(UotContextStore);

  loadContext() {
    return this.api
      .uotContexto({}, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map((response) => this.mapContext(unwrapApiResponse<UotContextResponse>(response))),
        tap((context) => this.store.set(context)),
      );
  }

  selectContext(mode: UotMode, uotId?: number | null) {
    const body: UotSelectContextRequest = {
      modo: mode,
      uotId: mode === 'ESPECIFICA' ? uotId ?? undefined : undefined,
    };

    return this.api
      .uotSeleccionarContexto(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotSelectContextRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => this.mapContext(unwrapApiResponse<UotContextResponse>(response))),
        switchMap((context) =>
          this.accessContext.execute().pipe(map(() => context)),
        ),
        tap((context) => this.store.set(context)),
      );
  }

  list(includeInactive = false, uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .uotListar(
        { incluirInactivas: includeInactive, uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          (unwrapApiResponse<UotUnitResponse[]>(response) ?? []).map((item) =>
            this.mapUnit(item),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  create(body: UotCreateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotCrear(
        {
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotCreateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  update(uotId: number, body: UotUpdateRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotEditar(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotUpdateRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  impact(uotId: number) {
    return this.api
      .uotImpactoBaja(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapImpact(
            unwrapApiResponse<UotDeactivationImpactResponse>(response),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  transferResources(uotId: number, input: UotTransferResources) {
    const uotTransferResourcesRequest: UotTransferResourcesRequest = {
      uotDestinoId: input.uotDestinoId,
      almacenOrigenId: input.almacenOrigenId,
      almacenDestinoId: input.almacenDestinoId,
      transferirStock: input.transferirStock,
      bienIds: input.bienIds ? [...input.bienIds] : undefined,
      suministroIds: input.suministroIds ? [...input.suministroIds] : undefined,
      motivo: input.motivo.trim(),
    };

    return this.api
      .uotTransferirRecursos(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotTransferResourcesRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          this.mapTransfer(
            unwrapApiResponse<UotResourceTransferResponse>(response),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  deactivate(uotId: number, reason: string) {
    const uotDeactivateRequest: UotDeactivateRequest = {
      motivo: reason.trim(),
    };

    return this.api
      .uotDeshabilitar(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotDeactivateRequest,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  assignUser(uotId: number, body: UotAssignUserRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotAsignarUsuario(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotAssignUserRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  assignRole(uotId: number, body: UotAssignRoleRequest) {
    return this.api
      .uotAsignarRol(
        {
          uotId,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
          uotAssignRoleRequest: body,
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  private mapContext(value: UotContextResponse | undefined): UotContext {
    const uots = (value?.uots ?? [])
      .filter((item) => Number(item.uotId) > 0)
      .map((item) => ({
        usuarioUotId: item.usuarioUotId ?? null,
        uotId: Number(item.uotId),
        codigo: item.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
        nombre: item.nombre?.trim() || `UOT ${item.uotId}`,
        predeterminada: item.predeterminada === true,
        roles: [...(item.roles ?? [])],
      }));

    const selected = Number(value?.uotSeleccionadaId);
    const mode: UotMode = value?.modo === 'GENERAL' ? 'GENERAL' : 'ESPECIFICA';

    return {
      modo: mode,
      uotSeleccionadaId:
        Number.isFinite(selected) && selected > 0 ? selected : null,
      requiereSeleccion: value?.requiereSeleccion === true,
      permiteModoGeneral: value?.permiteModoGeneral === true,
      uots,
    };
  }

  private mapUnit(value: UotUnitResponse): UotUnit {
    return {
      uotId: Number(value.uotId ?? 0),
      uotPadreId: value.uotPadreId ?? null,
      ubicacionId: value.ubicacionId ?? null,
      codigo: value.codigo?.trim() ?? '',
      nombre: value.nombre?.trim() ?? '',
      descripcion: value.descripcion?.trim() || null,
      esRaiz: value.esRaiz === true,
      fechaInicio: value.fechaInicio ?? null,
      fechaFin: value.fechaFin ?? null,
      estado: value.estado !== false,
      asignada: value.asignada === true,
      predeterminada: value.predeterminada === true,
    };
  }

  private mapImpact(
    value: UotDeactivationImpactResponse | undefined,
  ): UotDeactivationImpact {
    return {
      uotId: Number(value?.uotId ?? 0),
      uotIncluidas: Number(value?.uotIncluidas ?? 0),
      usuariosActivos: Number(value?.usuariosActivos ?? 0),
      usuariosExclusivos: Number(value?.usuariosExclusivos ?? 0),
      empleadosActivos: Number(value?.empleadosActivos ?? 0),
      areasActivas: Number(value?.areasActivas ?? 0),
      organizacionesActivas: Number(value?.organizacionesActivas ?? 0),
      prediosActivos: Number(value?.prediosActivos ?? 0),
      almacenesActivos: Number(value?.almacenesActivos ?? 0),
      productosConStock: Number(value?.productosConStock ?? 0),
      stockReservado: Number(value?.stockReservado ?? 0),
      suministrosConStock: Number(value?.suministrosConStock ?? 0),
      suministrosReservados: Number(value?.suministrosReservados ?? 0),
      bienesActivos: Number(value?.bienesActivos ?? 0),
      ventasAbiertas: Number(value?.ventasAbiertas ?? 0),
      campaniasAbiertas: Number(value?.campaniasAbiertas ?? 0),
      operativosAbiertos: Number(value?.operativosAbiertos ?? 0),
      salidasAbiertas: Number(value?.salidasAbiertas ?? 0),
      recursosAbiertos: Number(value?.recursosAbiertos ?? 0),
      puedeDeshabilitar: value?.puedeDeshabilitar === true,
      bloqueos: [...(value?.bloqueos ?? [])],
    };
  }

  private mapTransfer(
    value: UotResourceTransferResponse | undefined,
  ): UotResourceTransfer {
    return {
      movimientoSalidaId: value?.movimientoSalidaId ?? null,
      movimientoEntradaId: value?.movimientoEntradaId ?? null,
      productosTransferidos: Number(value?.productosTransferidos ?? 0),
      bienesTransferidos: Number(value?.bienesTransferidos ?? 0),
      suministrosTransferidos: Number(value?.suministrosTransferidos ?? 0),
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { computed, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { UotContext } from '../domain/uot.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UotContextStore {
  private readonly contextSignal = signal<UotContext | null>(null);

  readonly context = this.contextSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly loaded = computed(() => this.contextSignal() !== null);
  readonly modo = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.modo ?? 'ESPECIFICA');
  readonly memberships = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.uots ?? []);
  readonly selectedId = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.uotSeleccionadaId ?? null);
  readonly requiresSelection = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.requiereSeleccion ?? false);
  readonly canUseGeneral = computed(() => this.contextSignal()?.permiteModoGeneral ?? false);
  readonly isGeneral = computed(() => this.modo() === 'GENERAL');
  readonly isSpecific = computed(() => this.modo() === 'ESPECIFICA');

  readonly selected = computed(() => {
    const id = this.selectedId();
    return id ? this.memberships().find((item) => item.uotId === id) ?? null : null;
  });

  readonly label = computed(() =>
    this.isGeneral()
      ? 'Vista general'
      : this.selected()?.nombre ?? 'Seleccionar UOT',
  );

  set(context: UotContext): void {
    this.contextSignal.set({
      ...context,
      uots: [...context.uots],
    });
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.contextSignal.set(null);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivateFn, Router, UrlTree } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, map, of, switchMap } from 'rxjs';

import { SessionStore } from '../../core/session/session.store';
import { UotApiService } from './adapter/out/http/uot-api.service';
import { UotContext } from './domain/uot.model';
import { UotContextStore } from './state/uot-context.store';

export const uotContextGuard: CanActivateFn = (_route, state) => {
  const session = inject(SessionStore);
  const api = inject(UotApiService);
  const store = inject(UotContextStore);
  const router = inject(Router);

  if (!session.authenticated()) {
    store.clear();
    return router.createUrlTree(['/login']);
  }

  const resolve = (context: UotContext): true | UrlTree => {
    if (
      context.modo === 'ESPECIFICA' &&
      !context.uotSeleccionadaId &&
      context.uots.length > 1
    ) {
      return router.createUrlTree(['/seleccionar-uot'], {
        queryParams: { returnUrl: state.url || '/inicio' },
      });
    }

    if (context.requiereSeleccion) {
      return router.createUrlTree(['/seleccionar-uot'], {
        queryParams: { returnUrl: state.url || '/inicio' },
      });
    }

    return true;
  };

  return api.loadContext().pipe(
    switchMap((context) => {
      if (
        context.modo === 'ESPECIFICA' &&
        !context.uotSeleccionadaId &&
        context.uots.length === 1
      ) {
        return api
          .selectContext('ESPECIFICA', context.uots[0].uotId)
          .pipe(map((selected) => resolve(selected)));
      }

      return of(resolve(context));
    }),
    catchError(() =>
      of(router.createUrlTree(['/service-unavailable'])),
    ),
  );
};
```

```typescript
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  exitoso?: boolean;
  codigo?: string;
  mensaje?: string;
  datos?: T | null;
  correlacionId?: string;
  fechaHoraUtc?: string;
}

export class ApiEnvelopeError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly code: string,
    message: string,
    readonly correlationId: string | null,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiEnvelopeError';
  }
}

export function unwrapApiResponse<T>(response: ApiEnvelope<T>): T {
  if (response.exitoso === false) {
    throw new ApiEnvelopeError(
      response.codigo ?? 'OPERACION_NO_COMPLETADA',
      response.mensaje ?? 'La operación no pudo completarse.',
      response.correlacionId ?? null,
    );
  }

  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(response, 'datos')) {
    return undefined as T;
  }

  return response.datos as T;
}
```

```typescript
import { Configuration, ConfigurationParameters } from './configuration';
```

```typescript
     * - If a parameter has multiple values, returns a readonly array of values.
     */
    toRecord(): Record<string, string | number | boolean | ReadonlyArray<string | number | boolean>> {
        const parts: Record<string, string | number | boolean | ReadonlyArray<string | number | boolean>> = {};

        for (const [key, entry] of this.params.entries()) {
            const encodedKey = this.encoder.encodeKey(key);

            if (entry.options.explode) {
                parts[encodedKey] = entry.values.map((v) => this.encoder.encodeValue(v));
            } else {
                const encodedValues = entry.values.map((v) => this.encoder.encodeValue(v));

                // join with the delimiter *unencoded*
                parts[encodedKey] = encodedValues.join(entry.options.delimiter);
            }
        }

        return parts;
    }

    /**
     * Return an Angular's HttpParams with an identity parameter codec as the parameters are already encoded.
     */
    toHttpParams(): HttpParams {
        const records = this.toRecord();

        let httpParams = new HttpParams({encoder: new IdentityHttpParameterCodec()});

        return httpParams.appendAll(records);
    }
}

export function concatHttpParamsObject(httpParams: OpenApiHttpParams, key: string, item: {
    [index: string]: any
}, delimiter: Delimiter): OpenApiHttpParams {
    let keyAndValues: string[] = [];

    for (const k in item) {
        keyAndValues.push(k);

        const value = item[k];

        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            keyAndValues.push(...value.map(convertToString));
        } else {
            keyAndValues.push(convertToString(value));
        }
    }

    return httpParams.set(key, keyAndValues, {explode: false, delimiter: delimiter});
}

function convertToString(value: any): string {
    if (value instanceof Date) {
         return value.toISOString();
    } else {
        return value.toString();
    }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

import { ApiError, isApiError } from '../../core/http/models/api-error.model';
import { safeApiMessage } from '../../core/http/safe-api-message';
import { ApiEnvelopeError } from './api-response-unwrapper';

export function mapOpenApiError(error: unknown): ApiError {
  if (isApiError(error)) {
    return {
      ...error,
      message: safeApiMessage(error.status, error.message, error.code),
      details: null,
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof ApiEnvelopeError) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      code: error.code,
      message: safeApiMessage(400, error.message, error.code),
      correlationId: error.correlationId,
      timestamp: null,
      details: null,
    };
  }

  if (error instanceof HttpErrorResponse) {
    const payload =
      error.error && typeof error.error === 'object'
        ? (error.error as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};
    const candidate = typeof payload['mensaje'] === 'string' ? payload['mensaje'] : null;
    const code = typeof payload['codigo'] === 'string' ? payload['codigo'] : 'ERROR_HTTP';

    return {
      status: error.status,
      code,
      message: safeApiMessage(error.status, candidate, code),
      correlationId:
        typeof payload['correlacionId'] === 'string' ? payload['correlacionId'] : null,
      timestamp:
        typeof payload['fechaHoraUtc'] === 'string' ? payload['fechaHoraUtc'] : null,
      details: null,
    };
  }

  return {
    status: 0,
    code: 'ERROR_CLIENTE',
    message: safeApiMessage(0, null, 'ERROR_CLIENTE'),
    correlationId: null,
    timestamp: null,
    details: null,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {
  CatlogosService,
  GeografaService,
} from '../infrastructure/openapi/generated';
import {
  GeographyItem,
  ReferenceCatalogCode,
  ReferencePage,

import { unwrapApiResponse } from '../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { ReferenceDataHttpMapper } from './reference-data-http.mapper';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ReferenceDataHttpAdapter implements ReferenceDataGateway {
  private readonly catalogs = inject(CatlogosService);
  private readonly geography = inject(GeografaService);

  listCatalog(
    catalog: ReferenceCatalogCode,
    page: number,
    size: number,
  ): Observable<ReferencePage> {
    return this.catalogs
      .catalogosListar(
        { catalogo: catalog, pagina: page, tamano: size },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) => ReferenceDataHttpMapper.catalogPage(value)),
      );
  }

  listDepartments(): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.geography
      .geografiaListarDepartamentos(undefined, 'body', false, { transferCache: false })
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) => ReferenceDataHttpMapper.departments(value)),
      );
  }

  listProvinces(departmentCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.geography
      .geografiaListarProvincias(
        { codigo: departmentCode.trim() },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) => ReferenceDataHttpMapper.provinces(value)),
      );
  }

  listDistricts(provinceCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.geography
      .geografiaListarDistritos(
        { codigo: provinceCode.trim() },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) => ReferenceDataHttpMapper.districts(value)),
      );
  }

  listPopulationCenters(districtCode: string): Observable<readonly GeographyItem[]> {
    return this.geography
      .geografiaListarCentrosPoblados(
        { codigo: districtCode.trim() },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)),
        map((value) => ReferenceDataHttpMapper.populationCenters(value)),
      );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  GeographyItem,
  ReferenceItem,
  ReferencePage,
} from '../core/reference-data/reference-data.model';

interface CatalogItemDto {
  id?: unknown;
  codigo?: unknown;
  nombre?: unknown;
  descripcion?: unknown;
  estado?: unknown;
  cantidadUso?: unknown;
  enUso?: unknown;
}

interface PageDto {
  items?: unknown;
  pagina?: unknown;
  tamanio?: unknown;
  totalRegistros?: unknown;
  totalPaginas?: unknown;
}

interface DepartmentDto {
  departamentoCodigo?: unknown;
  departamentoNombre?: unknown;
}

interface ProvinceDto {
  provinciaCodigo?: unknown;
  provinciaNombre?: unknown;
}

interface DistrictDto {
  distritoCodigo?: unknown;
  distritoNombre?: unknown;
}

interface PopulationCenterDto {
  centroPobladoId?: unknown;
  codigoInei?: unknown;
  centroPobladoNombre?: unknown;
}

export class ReferenceDataHttpMapper {
  static catalogPage(value: unknown): ReferencePage {
    const page = (value ?? {}) as PageDto;
    const items = Array.isArray(page.items) ? page.items : [];

    return {
      items: items.map((item) =>
        ReferenceDataHttpMapper.catalogItem(item as CatalogItemDto),
      ),
      page: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.number(page.pagina, 1),
      size: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.number(page.tamanio, items.length),
      totalRecords: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.number(
        page.totalRegistros,
        items.length,
      ),
      totalPages: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.number(
        page.totalPaginas,
        items.length > 0 ? 1 : 0,
      ),
    };
  }

  static departments(value: unknown): readonly GeographyItem[] {
    return ReferenceDataHttpMapper.array(value)
      .map((item) => {
        const row = item as DepartmentDto;

        return {
          id: null,
          code: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.departamentoCodigo),
          label: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.departamentoNombre),
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => item.code && item.label);
  }

  static provinces(value: unknown): readonly GeographyItem[] {
    return ReferenceDataHttpMapper.array(value)
      .map((item) => {
        const row = item as ProvinceDto;

        return {
          id: null,
          code: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.provinciaCodigo),
          label: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.provinciaNombre),
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => item.code && item.label);
  }

  static districts(value: unknown): readonly GeographyItem[] {
    return ReferenceDataHttpMapper.array(value)
      .map((item) => {
        const row = item as DistrictDto;

        return {
          id: null,
          code: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.distritoCodigo),
          label: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.distritoNombre),
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => item.code && item.label);
  }

  static populationCenters(
    value: unknown,
  ): readonly GeographyItem[] {
    return ReferenceDataHttpMapper.array(value)
      .map((item) => {
        const row = item as PopulationCenterDto;
        const id = ReferenceDataHttpMapper.number(
          row.centroPobladoId,
          0,
        );

        return {
          id: id > 0 ? id : null,
          code: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.codigoInei),
          label: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(
            row.centroPobladoNombre,
          ),
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => item.id !== null && item.label);
  }

  private static catalogItem(row: CatalogItemDto): ReferenceItem {
    const idValue =
      typeof row.id === 'number' || typeof row.id === 'string'
        ? row.id
        : ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.codigo);

    return {
      id: idValue,
      code: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.codigo),
      label: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.text(row.nombre),
      description:
        typeof row.descripcion === 'string'
          ? row.descripcion
          : null,
      active: row.estado !== false,
      inUse: row.enUso === true,
      usageCount: ReferenceDataHttpMapper.number(
        row.cantidadUso,
        0,
      ),
    };
  }

  private static array(value: unknown): unknown[] {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  }

  private static text(value: unknown): string {
    return typeof value === 'string'
      ? value.trim()
      : String(value ?? '').trim();
  }

  private static number(
    value: unknown,
    fallback: number,
  ): number {
    const numeric = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : fallback;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ApexAxisChartSeries,
  ApexChart,
  ApexNonAxisChartSeries,
  ApexOptions,
} from 'ng-apexcharts';

const BLUE_PALETTE = [
  '#2563EB',
  '#0EA5E9',
  '#1D4ED8',
  '#0284C7',
  '#60A5FA',
  '#38BDF8',
  '#1E40AF',
];

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ChartPresetsService {
  line(
    series: ApexAxisChartSeries,
    categories: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return this.axisBase('line', series, categories, {
      stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
      markers: { size: 0, hover: { sizeOffset: 4 } },
    });
  }

  area(
    series: ApexAxisChartSeries,
    categories: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return this.axisBase('area', series, categories, {
      stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 0.12 },
      markers: { size: 0 },
    });
  }

  bar(
    series: ApexAxisChartSeries,
    categories: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return this.axisBase('bar', series, categories, {
      plotOptions: {
        bar: {
          horizontal: true,
          borderRadius: 7,
          barHeight: '58%',
        },
      },
    });
  }

  column(
    series: ApexAxisChartSeries,
    categories: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return this.axisBase('bar', series, categories, {
      plotOptions: {
        bar: {
          horizontal: false,
          borderRadius: 7,
          columnWidth: '52%',
        },
      },
    });
  }

  pie(series: ApexNonAxisChartSeries, labels: readonly string[]): ApexOptions {
    return this.circularBase('pie', series, labels);
  }

  donut(
    series: ApexNonAxisChartSeries,
    labels: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return {
      ...this.circularBase('donut', series, labels),
      plotOptions: {
        pie: {
          donut: {
            size: '72%',
            labels: {
              show: true,
              total: {
                show: true,
                label: 'Total',
                color: '#64748B',
                fontSize: '12px',
                fontWeight: 600,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    };
  }

  radialBar(
    series: ApexNonAxisChartSeries,
    labels: readonly string[],

    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('radialBar'),
      labels: [...labels],

        radialBar: {

          polygons: {
            strokeColors: '#E2E8F0',
            connectorColors: '#E2E8F0',
            fill: { colors: ['#FFFFFF', '#F8FAFC'] },
          },
        },
      },
    };
  }

  polarArea(
    series: ApexNonAxisChartSeries,
    labels: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('polarArea'),
      labels: [...labels],
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      stroke: { colors: ['#FFFFFF'], width: 2 },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 0.92 },
      legend: this.legend(),
      dataLabels: { enabled: true },
    };
  }

  scatter(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('scatter'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      xaxis: {
        tickAmount: 8,
        labels: { style: { colors: '#64748B', fontSize: '11px' } },
      },
      yaxis: {
        labels: { style: { colors: '#64748B', fontSize: '11px' } },
      },
      grid: this.grid(),
      legend: this.legend(),
      markers: { size: 6, strokeWidth: 0 },
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  bubble(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      ...this.scatter(series),
      chart: this.chart('bubble'),
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 0.72 },
    };
  }

  heatmap(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('heatmap'),
      colors: ['#2563EB'],
      dataLabels: { enabled: false },
      plotOptions: {
        heatmap: {
          radius: 5,
          shadeIntensity: 0.45,
          colorScale: {
            ranges: [
              { from: 0, to: 20, color: '#DBEAFE' },
              { from: 21, to: 40, color: '#BFDBFE' },
              { from: 41, to: 60, color: '#60A5FA' },
              { from: 61, to: 80, color: '#2563EB' },
              { from: 81, to: 1000000, color: '#1E40AF' },
            ],
          },
        },
      },
      grid: this.grid(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  treemap(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('treemap'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      legend: { show: false },
      dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        style: { fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600 },
      },
      plotOptions: {
        treemap: {
          distributed: true,
          enableShades: false,
        },
      },
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  rangeBar(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('rangeBar'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      plotOptions: {
        bar: {
          horizontal: true,
          borderRadius: 6,
        },
      },
      grid: this.grid(),
      legend: this.legend(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  rangeArea(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('rangeArea'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 2 },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 0.18 },
      grid: this.grid(),
      legend: this.legend(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  candlestick(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('candlestick'),
      plotOptions: {
        candlestick: {
          colors: {
            upward: '#2563EB',
            downward: '#94A3B8',
          },
        },
      },
      grid: this.grid(),
      xaxis: { type: 'datetime' },
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  boxPlot(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('boxPlot'),
      colors: ['#2563EB', '#93C5FD'],
      plotOptions: {
        boxPlot: {
          colors: {
            upper: '#2563EB',
            lower: '#93C5FD',
          },
        },
      },
      grid: this.grid(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  funnel(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('funnel'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        style: {
          fontSize: '12px',
          fontWeight: 600,
          colors: ['#FFFFFF'],
        },
      },
      plotOptions: {
        funnel: {
          shape: 'trapezoid',
          lastShape: 'taper',
        },
      },
      legend: { show: false },
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  pyramid(series: ApexAxisChartSeries): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('pyramid'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        style: {
          fontSize: '12px',
          fontWeight: 600,
          colors: ['#FFFFFF'],
        },
      },
      legend: { show: false },
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  gauge(
    value: number,
    label = 'Avance',
  ): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series: [value],
      chart: this.chart('radialBar'),
      labels: [label],
      colors: ['#2563EB'],
      plotOptions: {
        radialBar: {
          startAngle: -110,
          endAngle: 110,
          hollow: {
            size: '66%',
          },
          track: {
            background: '#E2E8F0',
            strokeWidth: '100%',
            margin: 0,
          },
          dataLabels: {
            name: {
              offsetY: 22,
              color: '#64748B',
              fontSize: '12px',
              fontWeight: 600,
            },
            value: {
              offsetY: -18,
              color: '#0F172A',
              fontSize: '28px',
              fontWeight: 700,
              formatter: (currentValue: number) => `${Math.round(currentValue)}%`,
            },
          },
        },
      },
      stroke: {
        lineCap: 'round',
      },
    };
  }

  mixed(
    series: ApexAxisChartSeries,
    categories: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart('line'),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      dataLabels: { enabled: false },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 1 },
      stroke: {
        width: [0, 3, 2],
        curve: 'smooth',
      },
      plotOptions: {
        bar: {
          borderRadius: 7,
          columnWidth: '48%',
        },
      },
      xaxis: {
        categories: [...categories],
        axisBorder: { show: false },
        axisTicks: { show: false },
        labels: { style: { colors: '#64748B', fontSize: '11px' } },
      },
      yaxis: {
        labels: { style: { colors: '#64748B', fontSize: '11px' } },
      },
      grid: this.grid(),
      legend: this.legend(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  generic(options: ApexOptions): ApexOptions {
    return {
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      grid: this.grid(),
      legend: this.legend(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
      dataLabels: { enabled: false },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 1 },
      ...options,
    };
  }

  private axisBase(
    type: 'line' | 'area' | 'bar' | 'radar',
    series: ApexAxisChartSeries,
    categories: readonly string[],
    extra: ApexOptions = {},
  ): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart(type),
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      dataLabels: { enabled: false },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 1 },
      grid: this.grid(),
      legend: this.legend(),
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
      stroke: { width: type === 'bar' ? 0 : 3, curve: 'smooth' },
      xaxis: {
        categories: [...categories],
        axisBorder: { show: false },
        axisTicks: { show: false },
        labels: { style: { colors: '#64748B', fontSize: '11px' } },
      },
      yaxis: {
        labels: { style: { colors: '#64748B', fontSize: '11px' } },
      },
      ...extra,
    };
  }

  private circularBase(
    type: 'pie' | 'donut',
    series: ApexNonAxisChartSeries,
    labels: readonly string[],
  ): ApexOptions {
    return {
      series,
      chart: this.chart(type),
      labels: [...labels],
      colors: BLUE_PALETTE,
      legend: this.legend(),
      dataLabels: { enabled: true },
      stroke: { colors: ['#FFFFFF'], width: 3 },
      fill: { type: 'solid', opacity: 1 },
      tooltip: this.tooltip(),
    };
  }

  private chart(type: NonNullable<ApexChart['type']>): ApexChart {
    return {
      type,
      height: 320,
      fontFamily: 'Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif',
      foreColor: '#64748B',
      toolbar: { show: false },
      animations: {
        enabled: true,
        speed: 450,
      },
      background: 'transparent',
    };
  }

  private grid(): NonNullable<ApexOptions['grid']> {
    return {
      borderColor: '#E2E8F0',
      strokeDashArray: 4,
      padding: { left: 4, right: 8, top: 4, bottom: 0 },
    };
  }

  private legend(): NonNullable<ApexOptions['legend']> {
    return {
      position: 'bottom',
      horizontalAlign: 'center',
      fontSize: '12px',
      fontWeight: 500,
      labels: { colors: '#475569' },
      itemMargin: { horizontal: 12, vertical: 4 },
    };
  }

  private tooltip(): NonNullable<ApexOptions['tooltip']> {
    return {
      theme: 'light',
      style: {
        fontSize: '12px',
        fontFamily: 'Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif',
      },
    };
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
  <div class="overflow-x-auto desco-scrollbar">
    <table class="table w-full">
      <thead class="bg-slate-50">
        <tr class="border-b border-slate-200">
          @for (column of columns; track column.key) {
            <th
              class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500"
              [class]="alignClass(column.align) + ' ' + (column.headerClass ?? '')"
              [style.width]="column.width ?? null"
            >
              @if (column.sortable) {
                <button

                  class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-1 py-1 transition hover:text-blue-700"
                  (click)="sortBy(column)"
                >
                  <span>{{ column.label }}</span>

                  @if (sort?.field === column.key) {
                    <fa-icon
                      class="text-blue-600"
                      [icon]="sort?.direction === 'asc' ? ascendingIcon : descendingIcon"
                    />
                  }
                </button>
              } @else {
                {{ column.label }}
              }
            </th>
          }
        </tr>
      </thead>

      <tbody>
        @if (loading) {
          @for (row of [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; track row) {
            <tr class="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0">
              @for (column of columns; track column.key) {
                <td class="px-4 py-4">
                  <div class="skeleton h-4 w-full max-w-36 rounded-md"></div>
                </td>
              }
            </tr>
          }
        } @else {
          @for (row of rows; track rowIdentity($index, row)) {
            <tr
              class="border-b border-slate-100 transition last:border-0 hover:bg-blue-50"
              [class.cursor-pointer]="rowClickable"
              [class.bg-white]="!rowClickable"
              (click)="rowClickable && rowClick.emit(row)"
            >
              @for (column of columns; track column.key) {
                <td
                  class="px-4 py-3.5 text-sm text-slate-700"
                  [class]="alignClass(column.align) + ' ' + (column.cellClass ?? '')"
                >
                  {{ display(row, column) }}
                </td>
              }
            </tr>
          } @empty {
            <tr>
              <td
                class="px-6 py-14 text-center text-sm text-slate-500"
                [attr.colspan]="columns.length"
              >
                <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-sm flex-col items-center">
                  <div class="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600">
                    <fa-icon [icon]="tableIcon" />
                  </div>
                  <p class="mt-3 font-medium text-slate-700">
                    {{ emptyMessage }}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          }
        }
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>
```
