```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowDown,
  faArrowUp,
  faTableColumns,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { DataTableColumn, DataTableSort } from './data-table.types';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-data-table',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './data-table.html',
  styleUrl: './data-table.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DataTableComponent<T extends object> {
  @Input({ required: true }) columns: readonly DataTableColumn<T>[] = [];
  @Input() rows: readonly T[] = [];
  @Input() sort: DataTableSort | null = null;
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() rowClickable = false;
  @Input() trackByKey: string | null = null;
  @Input() emptyMessage = 'No hay registros disponibles.';

  @Output() sortChange = new EventEmitter<DataTableSort>();
  @Output() rowClick = new EventEmitter<T>();

  readonly tableIcon = faTableColumns;
  readonly ascendingIcon = faArrowUp;
  readonly descendingIcon = faArrowDown;

  value(row: T, column: DataTableColumn<T>): unknown {
    if (column.value) {
      return column.value(row);
    }

    return (row as Record<string, unknown>)[column.key];
  }

  display(row: T, column: DataTableColumn<T>): string {
    const value = this.value(row, column);

    if (column.format) {
      return column.format(value, row);
    }

    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return '—';
    }

    if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      return value ? 'Sí' : 'No';
    }

    return String(value);
  }

  sortBy(column: DataTableColumn<T>): void {
    if (!column.sortable) {
      return;
    }

    const direction =
      this.sort?.field === column.key && this.sort.direction === 'asc'
        ? 'desc'
        : 'asc';

    this.sortChange.emit({
      field: column.key,
      direction,
    });
  }

  rowIdentity(index: number, row: T): unknown {
    if (this.trackByKey) {
      return (row as Record<string, unknown>)[this.trackByKey] ?? index;
    }

    return index;
  }

  alignClass(align: DataTableColumn<T>['align']): string {
    switch (align) {
      case 'center':
        return 'text-center';
      case 'right':
        return 'text-right';
      default:
        return 'text-left';
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { SortDirection } from '../../models/sort.model';

export type DataTableAlign = 'left' | 'center' | 'right';

export interface DataTableColumn<T extends object> {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  sortable?: boolean;
  align?: DataTableAlign;
  width?: string;
  value?: (row: T) => unknown;
  format?: (value: unknown, row: T) => string;
  cellClass?: string;
  headerClass?: string;
}

export interface DataTableSort {
  field: string;
  direction: SortDirection;
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowDown,
  faArrowRight,
  faArrowUp,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import {
  KpiCardData,
  KpiTone,
  KpiTrendDirection,
} from './kpi-card.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-kpi-card',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './kpi-card.html',
  styleUrl: './kpi-card.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class KpiCardComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) data!: KpiCardData;

  trendIcon(direction: KpiTrendDirection | undefined) {
    switch (direction) {
      case 'up':
        return faArrowUp;
      case 'down':
        return faArrowDown;
      default:
        return faArrowRight;
    }
  }

  toneClass(tone: KpiTone | undefined): string {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'sky':
        return 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 ring-sky-100';
      case 'indigo':
        return 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 ring-indigo-100';
      case 'slate':
        return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 ring-slate-200';
      default:
        return 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-blue-100';
    }
  }

  trendClass(direction: KpiTrendDirection | undefined): string {
    switch (direction) {
      case 'up':
        return 'text-emerald-600';
      case 'down':
        return 'text-red-600';
      default:
        return 'text-slate-500';
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faCheck,
  faSpinner,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

export type LoadingButtonTone =
  | 'primary'
  | 'secondary'
  | 'success'
  | 'danger'
  | 'ghost';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-loading-button',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './loading-button.html',
  styleUrl: './loading-button.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class LoadingButtonComponent {
  @Input() label = 'Guardar';
  @Input() loadingLabel = 'Procesando...';
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() disabled = false;
  @Input() fullWidth = false;
  @Input() tone: LoadingButtonTone = 'primary';
  @Input() type: 'button' | 'submit' = 'button';
  @Input() icon: IconDefinition = faCheck;

  @Output() pressed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly spinnerIcon = faSpinner;

  buttonClass(): string {
    switch (this.tone) {
      case 'secondary':
        return 'border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50';
      case 'success':
        return 'border-0 bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700';
      case 'danger':
        return 'border-0 bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700';
      case 'ghost':
        return 'border-0 bg-transparent text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100';
      default:
        return 'border-0 bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700';
    }
  }

  onClick(): void {
    if (!this.loading && !this.disabled) {
      this.pressed.emit();
    }
  }
}
```

```html
      <strong>{{ firstRecord }}</strong>
      a
      <strong>{{ lastRecord }}</strong>
      de
      <strong>{{ totalRecords }}</strong>

      <select
        class="desco-paginator-select"
        [value]="size"
        (change)="changeSize($any($event.target).value)"
      >
        @for (option of pageSizes; track option) {
          <option [value]="option">{{ option }} por página</option>
        }
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <nav class="desco-paginator-nav" aria-label="Paginación">
    <button
      type="button"
      class="desco-paginator-button"
      [disabled]="page <= 1"
      aria-label="Página anterior"
      (click)="goTo(page - 1)"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="previousIcon" />
    </button>

    @for (pageNumber of visiblePages; track pageNumber) {
      <button
        type="button"
        class="desco-paginator-button"
        [class.desco-paginator-button--active]="pageNumber === page"
        [attr.aria-current]="pageNumber === page ? 'page' : null"
        (click)="goTo(pageNumber)"
      >
        {{ pageNumber }}
      </button>
    }

    <button
      type="button"
      class="desco-paginator-button"
      [disabled]="page >= totalPages || totalPages === 0"
      aria-label="Página siguiente"
      (click)="goTo(page + 1)"
    >
      <fa-icon [icon]="nextIcon" />
    </button>
  </nav>
</div>
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowLeft,
  faArrowRight,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-paginator',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './paginator.html',
  styleUrl: './paginator.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class PaginatorComponent {
  @Input() page = 1;
  @Input() size = 20;
  @Input() totalRecords = 0;
  @Input() totalPages = 0;
  @Input() pageSizes: readonly number[] = [10, 20, 50, 100];

  @Output() pageChange = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() sizeChange = new EventEmitter<number>();

  readonly previousIcon = faArrowLeft;
  readonly nextIcon = faArrowRight;

  get firstRecord(): number {
    return this.totalRecords === 0 ? 0 : (this.page - 1) * this.size + 1;
  }

  get lastRecord(): number {
    return Math.min(this.page * this.size, this.totalRecords);
  }

  get visiblePages(): readonly number[] {
    if (this.totalPages <= 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const start = Math.max(1, Math.min(this.page - 2, this.totalPages - 4));
    const end = Math.min(this.totalPages, start + 4);

    return Array.from(
      { length: end - start + 1 },
      (_, index) => start + index,
    );
  }

  goTo(targetPage: number): void {
    if (
      targetPage < 1 ||
      targetPage > this.totalPages ||
      targetPage === this.page
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.pageChange.emit(targetPage);
  }

  changeSize(value: string): void {
    const nextSize = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(nextSize) || nextSize <= 0 || nextSize === this.size) {
      return;
    }

    this.sizeChange.emit(nextSize);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { ScreenLoadingState } from './screen-loading.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ScreenLoadingService {
  private readonly stateSignal = signal<ScreenLoadingState>({
    visible: false,
    title: 'Procesando',
    message: null,
  });

  private depth = 0;

  readonly state = this.stateSignal.asReadonly();

  show(
    title = 'Procesando',
    message: string | null = 'Esta operación puede tomar unos segundos.',
  ): void {
    this.depth += 1;

    this.stateSignal.set({
      visible: true,
      title,
      message,
    });
  }

  hide(): void {
    this.depth = Math.max(0, this.depth - 1);

    if (this.depth === 0) {
      this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
        ...current,
        visible: false,
      }));
    }
  }

  forceHide(): void {
    this.depth = 0;
    this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      visible: false,
    }));
  }

  async run<T>(
    task: () => Promise<T>,
    title = 'Procesando',
    message: string | null = 'Esta operación puede tomar unos segundos.',
  ): Promise<T> {
    this.show(title, message);

    try {
      return await task();
    } finally {
      this.hide();
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faCircleExclamation,
  faShieldHalved,
  faTriangleExclamation,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import {
  closeAnimatedDialog,
  openAnimatedDialog,
} from '../dialog-lifecycle/dialog-lifecycle.util';

import {
  ActionConfirmConfig,
  ActionConfirmResult,
  ActionConfirmTone,
} from './action-confirm-dialog.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-action-confirm-dialog',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FormsModule, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './action-confirm-dialog.html',
  styleUrl: './action-confirm-dialog.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ActionConfirmDialogComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialog', { static: true })
  private dialogRef!: ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>;

  readonly config = signal<ActionConfirmConfig | null>(null);
  readonly reason = signal('');
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  private resolver: ((result: ActionConfirmResult) => void) | null = null;

  show(config: ActionConfirmConfig): Promise<ActionConfirmResult> {
    if (this.resolver) {
      this.resolver({ confirmed: false, reason: null });
      this.resolver = null;
    }

    this.config.set({
      confirmLabel: 'Confirmar',
      cancelLabel: 'Cancelar',
      tone: 'primary',
      requiresReason: false,
      reasonLabel: 'Motivo',
      reasonPlaceholder: 'Describe el motivo de esta acción.',
      minimumReasonLength: 5,
      maximumReasonLength: 500,
      ...config,
    });

    this.reason.set('');
    openAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement);

    return new Promise<ActionConfirmResult>((resolve) => {
      this.resolver = resolve;
    });
  }

  confirm(): void {
    const current = this.config();

    if (!current || !this.canConfirm()) {
      return;
    }

    const reason = this.reason().trim();

    this.finish({
      confirmed: true,
      reason: reason || null,
    });
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.finish({
      confirmed: false,
      reason: null,
    });
  }

  canConfirm(): boolean {
    const current = this.config();

    if (!current?.requiresReason) {
      return true;
    }

    const length = this.reason().trim().length;
    const minimum = current.minimumReasonLength ?? 5;
    const maximum = current.maximumReasonLength ?? 500;

    return length >= minimum && length <= maximum;
  }

  iconFor(tone: ActionConfirmTone | undefined) {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'danger':
        return faCircleExclamation;
      case 'warning':
        return faTriangleExclamation;
      default:
        return faShieldHalved;
    }
  }

  iconClass(tone: ActionConfirmTone | undefined): string {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'danger':
        return 'bg-red-50 text-red-600';
      case 'warning':
        return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600';
      default:
        return 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600';
    }
  }

  confirmButtonClass(tone: ActionConfirmTone | undefined): string {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'danger':
        return 'bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700';
      case 'warning':
        return 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 hover:bg-amber-600';
      default:
        return 'bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700';
    }
  }

  private finish(result: ActionConfirmResult): void {
    closeAnimatedDialog(this.dialogRef.nativeElement, () => {
      this.resolver?.(result);
      this.resolver = null;
      this.config.set(null);
      this.reason.set('');
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import {
  AppAlertConfig,
  AppAlertRequest,
  AppAlertResult,
} from './app-alert.model';

interface PendingAlert {
  request: AppAlertRequest;
  resolve: (result: AppAlertResult) => void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class AppAlertService {
  private readonly currentSignal = signal<AppAlertRequest | null>(null);
  private readonly queue: PendingAlert[] = [];
  private activeResolver: ((result: AppAlertResult) => void) | null = null;

  readonly current = this.currentSignal.asReadonly();

  open(config: AppAlertConfig): Promise<AppAlertResult> {
    const request: AppAlertRequest = {
      id: this.createId(),
      config: {
        tone: config.tone ?? 'info',
        title: config.title,
        message: config.message,
        confirmLabel: config.confirmLabel ?? 'Aceptar',
        cancelLabel: config.cancelLabel ?? null,
        dismissible: config.dismissible ?? true,
        icon: config.icon ?? null,
      },
    };

    return new Promise<AppAlertResult>((resolve) => {
      this.queue.push({ request, resolve });
      this.pump();
    });
  }

  info(title: string, message: string): Promise<AppAlertResult> {
    return this.open({ tone: 'info', title, message });
  }

  success(title: string, message: string): Promise<AppAlertResult> {
    return this.open({ tone: 'success', title, message });
  }

  warning(title: string, message: string): Promise<AppAlertResult> {
    return this.open({ tone: 'warning', title, message });
  }

  error(title: string, message: string): Promise<AppAlertResult> {
    return this.open({ tone: 'error', title, message });
  }

  question(
    title: string,
    message: string,
    confirmLabel = 'Confirmar',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancelar',
  ): Promise<AppAlertResult> {
    return this.open({
      tone: 'question',
      title,
      message,
      confirmLabel,
      cancelLabel,
    });
  }

  confirm(): void {
    this.finish({ confirmed: true });
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.finish({ confirmed: false });
  }

  private pump(): void {
    if (this.currentSignal() || this.queue.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const next = this.queue.shift();

    if (!next) {
      return;
    }

    this.activeResolver = next.resolve;
    this.currentSignal.set(next.request);
  }

  private finish(result: AppAlertResult): void {
    const resolver = this.activeResolver;

    this.activeResolver = null;
    this.currentSignal.set(null);

    resolver?.(result);

    queueMicrotask(() => this.pump());
  }

  private createId(): string {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
      return crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  faCheck,

  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class AppAlertComponent {
  readonly alertService = inject(AppAlertService);
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;

  @HostListener('document:keydown.escape')
  onEscape(): void {
    const current = this.alertService.current();

    if (current?.config.dismissible) {

  iconFor(request: AppAlertRequest) {

    switch (request.config.tone) {
```

```typescript
const CLOSING_CLASS = 'desco-modal--closing';
const CLOSE_DURATION_MS = 150;

const pendingClose = new WeakMap<HTMLDialogElement, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

export function openAnimatedDialog(dialog: HTMLDialogElement): void {
  const timer = pendingClose.get(dialog);

  if (timer) {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    pendingClose.delete(dialog);
  }

  dialog.classList.remove(CLOSING_CLASS);

  if (!dialog.open) {
    dialog.showModal();
  }
}

export function closeAnimatedDialog(
  dialog: HTMLDialogElement,
  afterClosed: () => void,
): void {
  const finish = (): void => {
    pendingClose.delete(dialog);

    if (dialog.open) {
      dialog.close();
    }

    dialog.classList.remove(CLOSING_CLASS);
    afterClosed();
  };

  if (!dialog.open) {
    finish();
    return;
  }

  if (dialog.classList.contains(CLOSING_CLASS)) {
    return;
  }

  const reducedMotion =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  if (reducedMotion) {
    finish();
    return;
  }

  dialog.classList.add(CLOSING_CLASS);
  pendingClose.set(dialog, setTimeout(finish, CLOSE_DURATION_MS));
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { ToastInput, ToastMessage } from './toast.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ToastService {
  private readonly toastSignal = signal<readonly ToastMessage[]>([]);

  readonly toasts = this.toastSignal.asReadonly();

  show(input: ToastInput): string {
    const id = this.createId();

    const toast: ToastMessage = {
      id,
      tone: input.tone ?? 'info',
      title: input.title,
      message: input.message ?? null,
      durationMs: input.durationMs ?? 4500,
      dismissible: input.dismissible ?? true,
    };

    this.toastSignal.update((current) => [...current, toast]);

    if (toast.durationMs > 0) {
      globalThis.setTimeout(() => this.dismiss(id), toast.durationMs);
    }

    return id;
  }

  success(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show({ tone: 'success', title, message });
  }

  info(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show({ tone: 'info', title, message });
  }

  warning(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show({
      tone: 'warning',
      title,
      message,
      durationMs: 6000,
    });
  }

  error(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show({
      tone: 'error',
      title,
      message,
      durationMs: 7000,
    });
  }

  dismiss(id: string): void {
    this.toastSignal.update((current) =>
      current.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id),
    );
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.toastSignal.set([]);
  }

  private createId(): string {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
      return crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { map } from 'rxjs';

import { IdempotencyKeyService } from '../../core/http/services/idempotency-key.service';
import { DocumentosLocalesService } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/documentosLocales.service';
import { LocalDocumentFileResponse } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/localDocumentFileResponse';
import {
  ApiEnvelope,
  unwrapApiResponse,
} from '../../infrastructure/openapi/api-response-unwrapper';
import { environment } from '../../../environments/environment';

export interface LocalFileUpload {
  uotId: number;
  file: File;
  category?: string;
  description?: string;
  linkType?: string;
  linkId?: number;
  principal?: boolean;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class LocalDocumentApiService {
  private readonly api = inject(DocumentosLocalesService);
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly idempotency = inject(IdempotencyKeyService);

  list(uotId?: number) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesListar(
        { uotId },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map(
          (response) =>
            unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse[]>(response) ?? [],
        ),
      );
  }

  upload(input: LocalFileUpload) {
    const body = new FormData();
    body.append('archivo', input.file, input.file.name);

    let params = new HttpParams()
      .set('uotId', String(input.uotId))
      .set('categoria', this.normalizeCategory(input.category))
      .set(
        'vinculoTipo',
        (input.linkType ?? 'NINGUNO').trim().toUpperCase(),
      )
      .set('principal', String(input.principal ?? false));

    const description = input.description?.trim();
    if (description) {
      params = params.set('descripcion', description);
    }

    if ((input.linkId ?? 0) > 0) {
      params = params.set('vinculoId', String(input.linkId));
    }

    /*
     * No establecer Content-Type manualmente.
     * El navegador agrega multipart/form-data con su boundary real.
     */
    const headers = new HttpHeaders({
      'X-Idempotency-Key': this.idempotency.create(),
    });

    return this.http
      .post<ApiEnvelope<LocalDocumentFileResponse>>(
        `${environment.apiBaseUrl}/api/v1/documentos/local`,
        body,
        {
          params,
          headers,
        },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) =>
          unwrapApiResponse<LocalDocumentFileResponse>(response),
        ),
      );
  }

  content(archivoId: number) {
    return this.api.documentosLocalesContenido(
      { archivoId },
      'body',
      false,
      { transferCache: false },
    );
  }

  retire(archivoId: number, reason: string) {
    return this.api
      .documentosLocalesRetirar(
        {
          archivoId,
          motivo: reason,
          xIdempotencyKey: this.idempotency.create(),
        },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(map((response) => unwrapApiResponse(response)));
  }

  private normalizeCategory(value?: string): string {
    const category = (value ?? 'DOCUMENTO')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

    if (
      category === 'IMAGEN'
      || category === 'BIEN_IMAGEN'
      || category === 'PRODUCTO_IMAGEN'
    ) {
      return 'FOTOGRAFIA';
    }

    return category || 'DOCUMENTO';
  }

}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\shared\files\local-file-panel\local-file-panel.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/shared/files/local-file-panel/local-file-panel.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowUpRightFromSquare,
  faFileImage,
  faImage,
  faRotate,
  faUpload,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { mapOpenApiError } from '../../../infrastructure/openapi/openapi-http-error.mapper';
import { ToastService } from '../../feedback/toast-center/toast.service';
import { LocalDocumentApiService } from '../local-document-api.service';

interface FilePreview {
  id: number;
  url: string | null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-local-file-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './local-file-panel.html',
  styleUrl: './local-file-panel.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class LocalFilePanelComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input({ required: true }) uotId = 0;
  @Input({ required: true }) linkType = 'NINGUNO';
  @Input({ required: true }) linkId = 0;
  @Input() fileIds: readonly number[] = [];
  @Input() title = 'Imágenes y documentos';
  @Input() accept = 'image/*';
  @Input() category = 'FOTOGRAFIA';
  @Input() forcePrincipal = false;
  @Input() canUpload = true;

  @Output() changed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  private readonly api = inject(LocalDocumentApiService);
  private readonly toast = inject(ToastService);

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);
  readonly previews = signal<readonly FilePreview[]>([]);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly imageIcon = faImage;
  readonly fileIcon = faFileImage;
  readonly uploadIcon = faUpload;
  readonly viewIcon = faArrowUpRightFromSquare;
  readonly refreshIcon = faRotate;

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['fileIds']) {
      this.load();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.revokeAll();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.revokeAll();
    const ids = [...new Set(this.fileIds.filter((id) => id > 0))];

    if (ids.length === 0) {
      this.previews.set([]);
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    forkJoin(
      ids.map((id) =>
        this.api.content(id).pipe(
          map((blob) => ({
            id,
            url: URL.createObjectURL(blob),
          }) satisfies FilePreview),
          catchError(() => of({ id, url: null } satisfies FilePreview)),
        ),
      ),
    )
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => this.previews.set(items),
        error: (error) => this.errorMessage.set(mapOpenApiError(error).message),
      });
  }

  upload(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    const file = input.files?.item(0) ?? null;
    input.value = '';

    if (!file || this.uploading() || !this.canUpload) return;

    if (file.size <= 0) {
      this.toast.error('Archivo vacío', 'Selecciona un archivo con contenido.');
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Archivo demasiado grande',
        'El archivo no puede superar 15 MB.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      this.accept.includes('image') &&
      !file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith('image/')
    ) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Formato no permitido',
        'Selecciona una imagen válida.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.uotId <= 0 || this.linkId <= 0) {
      this.toast.error(
        'Contexto incompleto',
        'No se pudo determinar la UOT o el registro vinculado.',
      );
      return;
    }

    this.uploading.set(true);

    this.api
      .upload({
        uotId: this.uotId,
        file,
        category: this.category,
        linkType: this.linkType,
        linkId: this.linkId,
        principal: this.forcePrincipal || this.fileIds.length === 0,
      })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.uploading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.toast.success('Archivo guardado');
          this.changed.emit();
        },
        error: (error) =>
          this.toast.error(
            'No se pudo guardar el archivo',
            mapOpenApiError(error).message,
          ),
      });
  }

  open(preview: FilePreview): void {
    if (!preview.url) return;
    window.open(preview.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }

  private revokeAll(): void {
    for (const item of this.previews()) {
      if (item.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(item.url);
    }
    this.previews.set([]);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { faCircleExclamation } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-form-error',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './form-error.html',
  styleUrl: './form-error.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class FormErrorComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) control: AbstractControl | null = null;
  @Input() fieldLabel = 'Este campo';
  @Input() messages: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {};

  readonly errorIcon = faCircleExclamation;

  get message(): string | null {
    const control = this.control;

    if (!control || !control.invalid || (!control.touched && !control.dirty)) {
      return null;
    }

    const errors = control.errors;
    if (!errors) {
      return null;
    }

    const key = Object.keys(errors)[0];
    if (this.messages[key]) {
      return this.messages[key];
    }

    switch (key) {
      case 'required':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} es obligatorio.`;
      case 'blank':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} no puede contener solo espacios.`;
      case 'email':
        return 'Ingresa un correo electrónico válido.';
      case 'minlength':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} es demasiado corto.`;
      case 'maxlength':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} supera la longitud permitida.`;
      case 'min':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} es menor al valor permitido.`;
      case 'max':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} supera el valor permitido.`;
      case 'pattern':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} tiene un formato inválido.`;
      case 'personName':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} solo puede contener letras, espacios, apóstrofes o guiones.`;
      case 'phone':
        return 'Ingresa un teléfono válido de 7 a 15 dígitos.';
      case 'dni':
        return 'Ingresa un DNI válido de 8 dígitos.';
      case 'ruc':
        return 'Ingresa un RUC válido de 11 dígitos.';
      case 'rucNature':
        return 'El RUC no corresponde al tipo de registro seleccionado.';
      case 'futureDate':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} no puede ser futura.`;
      case 'underage':
        return 'La persona debe ser mayor de edad.';
      case 'ageOutOfRange':
        return 'La fecha está fuera del rango permitido.';
      case 'invalidDate':
        return 'Ingresa una fecha válida.';
      case 'dateOrder':
        return 'Revisa el orden de las fechas.';
      case 'integer':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} debe ser un número entero.`;
      case 'decimal':
      case 'decimalPrecision':
        return `${this.fieldLabel} tiene un valor numérico inválido.`;
      case 'passwordUppercase':
        return 'Incluye al menos una letra mayúscula.';
      case 'passwordLowercase':
        return 'Incluye al menos una letra minúscula.';
      case 'passwordDigit':
        return 'Incluye al menos un número.';
      case 'passwordSpecial':
        return 'Incluye al menos un carácter especial.';
      case 'username':
        return 'Usa solo letras minúsculas, números, punto, guion o guion bajo.';
      case 'passwordOuterWhitespace':
        return 'La contraseña no puede comenzar ni terminar con espacios.';
      case 'passwordControlCharacter':
        return 'La contraseña contiene caracteres no permitidos.';
      default:
        return `${this.fieldLabel} contiene un valor inválido.`;
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<section class="geography-cascade" aria-label="Ubicación geográfica">
  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoDepartment">Departamento</label>
    <select
      id="geoDepartment"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || locationLocked || loading()"
      (change)="changeDepartment($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option value="" [selected]="!selectedDepartment()">Seleccionar departamento</option>
      @for (item of departments(); track item.code) {
        <option [value]="item.code" [selected]="item.code === selectedDepartment()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoProvince">Provincia</label>
    <select
      id="geoProvince"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || locationLocked || loading() || !selectedDepartment()"
      (change)="changeProvince($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option value="" [selected]="!selectedProvince()">Seleccionar provincia</option>
      @for (item of provinces(); track item.code) {
        <option [value]="item.code" [selected]="item.code === selectedProvince()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoDistrict">Distrito <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <select
      id="geoDistrict"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || locationLocked || loading() || !selectedProvince()"
      (change)="changeDistrict($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option value="" [selected]="!selectedDistrict()">Seleccionar distrito</option>
      @for (item of districts(); track item.code) {
        <option [value]="item.code" [selected]="item.code === selectedDistrict()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-field">
    <label for="geoPopulationCenter">Centro poblado <span>(opcional)</span></label>
    <select
      id="geoPopulationCenter"
      class="admin-select"
      [disabled]="disabled || populationCenterLocked || loading() || !selectedDistrict()"
      (change)="changePopulationCenter($any($event.target).value)"
    >
      <option [value]="0" [selected]="selectedPopulationCenter() === null">Sin centro poblado</option>
      @for (item of populationCenters(); track item.id) {
        <option [value]="item.id" [selected]="item.id === selectedPopulationCenter()">{{ item.label }}</option>
      }
    </select>
  </div>

  @if (loading()) {
    <div class="geography-status" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
      Cargando ubicación...
    </div>
  } @else if (errorMessage()) {
    <div class="geography-status geography-status--error" role="alert">
      <span>{{ errorMessage() }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        class="geography-retry"
        [disabled]="disabled"
        (click)="retryLoad()"
      >
        Reintentar
      </button>
    </div>
  }
</section>
```

### 2100. `src/app/shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade.ts`

- Ruta: `src/app/shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade.ts`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\shared\forms\geography-cascade\geography-cascade.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/shared/forms/geography-cascade/geography-cascade.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  OnInit,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { finalize, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

import {
  GeographyItem,
} from '../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.model';
import { ReferenceDataService } from '../../../core/reference-data/reference-data.service';

export interface GeographySelection {
  departmentCode: string;
  provinceCode: string;
  districtCode: string;
  populationCenterId: number | null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-geography-cascade',
  standalone: true,
  templateUrl: './geography-cascade.html',
  styleUrl: './geography-cascade.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class GeographyCascadeComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges {
  @Input() districtCode = '';
  @Input() populationCenterId: number | null = null;
  @Input() disabled = false;
  @Input() locationLocked = false;
  @Input() populationCenterLocked = false;

  @Output() readonly selectionChange =
    new EventEmitter<GeographySelection>();

  private readonly references = inject(ReferenceDataService);
  private initialized = false;
  private synchronizationVersion = 0;
  private retryAction: (() => void) | null = null;

  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly departments = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);
  readonly provinces = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);
  readonly districts = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);
  readonly populationCenters = signal<readonly GeographyItem[]>([]);

  readonly selectedDepartment = signal('');
  readonly selectedProvince = signal('');
  readonly selectedDistrict = signal('');
  readonly selectedPopulationCenter = signal<number | null>(null);

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initialized = true;
    this.synchronizeFromInputs();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (
      this.initialized &&
      (changes['districtCode'] || changes['populationCenterId'])
    ) {
      this.synchronizeFromInputs();
    }
  }

  changeDepartment(value: string): void {
    const departmentCode = value.trim();

    this.selectedDepartment.set(departmentCode);
    this.selectedProvince.set('');
    this.selectedDistrict.set('');
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
    this.provinces.set([]);
    this.districts.set([]);
    this.populationCenters.set([]);
    this.emitSelection();

    if (!departmentCode) {
      this.retryAction = null;
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      return;
    }

    this.loadProvinces(departmentCode);
  }

  changeProvince(value: string): void {
    const provinceCode = value.trim();

    this.selectedProvince.set(provinceCode);
    this.selectedDistrict.set('');
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
    this.districts.set([]);
    this.populationCenters.set([]);
    this.emitSelection();

    if (!provinceCode) {
      this.retryAction = null;
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      return;
    }

    this.loadDistricts(provinceCode);
  }

  changeDistrict(value: string): void {
    const districtCode = value.trim();

    this.selectedDistrict.set(districtCode);
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
    this.populationCenters.set([]);
    this.emitSelection();

    if (!districtCode) {
      this.retryAction = null;
      this.errorMessage.set(null);
      return;
    }

    this.loadPopulationCenters(districtCode);
  }

  changePopulationCenter(value: string): void {
    const numeric = Number(value);

    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(
      Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric > 0
        ? numeric
        : null,
    );

    this.emitSelection();
  }

  retryLoad(): void {
    if (this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    const action = this.retryAction;

    if (action) {
      action();
      return;
    }

    this.synchronizeFromInputs();
  }

  private loadProvinces(departmentCode: string): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.retryAction = () => this.loadProvinces(departmentCode);

    this.references
      .provinces(departmentCode)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.provinces.set(items);
          this.retryAction = null;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.provinces.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron cargar las provincias.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private loadDistricts(provinceCode: string): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.retryAction = () => this.loadDistricts(provinceCode);

    this.references
      .districts(provinceCode)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.districts.set(items);
          this.retryAction = null;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.districts.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron cargar los distritos.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private loadPopulationCenters(districtCode: string): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.retryAction = () =>
      this.loadPopulationCenters(districtCode);

    this.references
      .populationCenters(districtCode)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.populationCenters.set(items);
          this.retryAction = null;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.populationCenters.set([]);
          this.errorMessage.set(
            'No se pudieron cargar los centros poblados.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private synchronizeFromInputs(): void {
    const version = ++this.synchronizationVersion;
    const districtCode = (this.districtCode ?? '').trim();
    const departmentCode = districtCode.length >= 2
      ? districtCode.slice(0, 2)
      : '';
    const provinceCode = districtCode.length >= 4
      ? districtCode.slice(0, 4)
      : '';
    const populationCenterId =
      this.populationCenterId && this.populationCenterId > 0
        ? this.populationCenterId
        : null;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);
    this.retryAction = () => this.synchronizeFromInputs();

    if (!districtCode) {
      this.selectedDepartment.set('');
      this.selectedProvince.set('');
      this.selectedDistrict.set('');
      this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(null);
      this.provinces.set([]);
      this.districts.set([]);
      this.populationCenters.set([]);

      this.references
        .departments()
        .pipe(finalize(() => {
          if (version === this.synchronizationVersion) {
            this.loading.set(false);
          }
        }))
        .subscribe({
          next: (items) => {
            if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
              return;
            }

            this.departments.set(items);
            this.retryAction = null;
          },
          error: () => {
            if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
              return;
            }

            this.departments.set([]);
            this.errorMessage.set(
              'No se pudo cargar la ubicación.',
            );
          },
        });

      return;
    }

    /*
     * Conservamos la selección proveniente de la entidad mientras se
     * recargan las opciones. Ante una falla temporal no se borra del
     * formulario el distrito que ya estaba guardado.
     */
    this.selectedDepartment.set(departmentCode);
    this.selectedProvince.set(provinceCode);
    this.selectedDistrict.set(districtCode);
    this.selectedPopulationCenter.set(populationCenterId);

    forkJoin({
      departments: this.references.departments(),
      provinces: this.references.provinces(departmentCode),
      districts: this.references.districts(provinceCode),
      populationCenters:
        this.references.populationCenters(districtCode),
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => {
        if (version === this.synchronizationVersion) {
          this.loading.set(false);
        }
      }))
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
            return;
          }

          this.departments.set(result.departments);
          this.provinces.set(result.provinces);
          this.districts.set(result.districts);
          this.populationCenters.set(result.populationCenters);
          this.retryAction = null;
        },
        error: () => {
          if (version !== this.synchronizationVersion) {
            return;
          }

          this.errorMessage.set(
            'No se pudo cargar la ubicación seleccionada.',
          );
        },
      });
  }

  private emitSelection(): void {
    this.selectionChange.emit({
      departmentCode: this.selectedDepartment(),
      provinceCode: this.selectedProvince(),
      districtCode: this.selectedDistrict(),
      populationCenterId:
        this.selectedPopulationCenter(),
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  AbstractControl,
  ValidationErrors,
  ValidatorFn,
} from '@angular/forms';

export type RucNature = 'ANY' | 'NATURAL' | 'JURIDICA';

export const MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE = 18;
export const MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE = 120;

const RUC_WEIGHTS = [5, 4, 3, 2, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2] as const;
const NATURAL_RUC_PREFIXES = new Set(['10', '15', '17']);
const PERSON_NAME_PATTERN = /^[\p{L}\p{M}]+(?:[ \x27\-][\p{L}\p{M}]+)*$/u;
const USERNAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$/;
const PHONE_PATTERN = /^\+?\d{7,15}$/;

export function notBlankValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  return String(value).trim().length > 0
    ? null
    : { blank: true };
}

export function optionalNotBlankValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '');

  if (value.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return value.trim().length > 0
    ? null
    : { blank: true };
}

export function personNameValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return PERSON_NAME_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { personName: true };
}

export function phoneValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return PHONE_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { phone: true };
}

export function usernameValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return USERNAME_PATTERN.test(value)
    ? null
    : { username: true };
}

export function passwordSafetyValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '');

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (value !== value.trim()) {
    return { passwordOuterWhitespace: true };
  }

  return /[\r\n\t\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(value)
    ? { passwordControlCharacter: true }
    : null;
}

export function dniValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return /^\d{8}$/.test(value)
    ? null
    : { dni: true };
}

export function rucValidator(
  nature: RucNature = 'ANY',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isValidRuc(value)) {
      return { ruc: true };
    }

    const prefix = value.slice(0, 2);

    if (nature === 'JURIDICA' && prefix !== '20') {
      return { rucNature: true };
    }

    if (
      nature === 'NATURAL'
      && !NATURAL_RUC_PREFIXES.has(prefix)
    ) {
      return { rucNature: true };
    }

    return null;
  };
}

export function notFutureDateValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!isValidIsoDate(value)) {
    return { invalidDate: true };
  }

  return value <= todayLocalIsoDate()
    ? null
    : { futureDate: true };
}

export function adultBirthDateValidator(
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
  maximumAge = MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE,
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isValidIsoDate(value)) {
      return { invalidDate: true };
    }

    if (value > maxBirthDateIso(minimumAge)) {
      return { underage: true };
    }

    if (value < minBirthDateIso(maximumAge)) {
      return { ageOutOfRange: true };
    }

    return null;
  };
}

export function dateOrderValidator(
  startControlName: string,
  endControlName: string,
  errorKey = 'dateOrder',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const start = String(control.get(startControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();
    const end = String(control.get(endControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!start || !end) {
      return null;
    }

    return end >= start
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function dateAfterMinimumAgeValidator(
  birthControlName: string,
  eventControlName: string,
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
  errorKey = 'dateBeforeMinimumAge',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const birth = String(control.get(birthControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();
    const event = String(control.get(eventControlName)?.value ?? '').trim();

    if (!birth || !event || !isValidIsoDate(birth) || !isValidIsoDate(event)) {
      return null;
    }

    const minimumEventDate = addYearsIso(birth, minimumAge);

    return event >= minimumEventDate
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function isValidRuc(value: string): boolean {
  const ruc = value.trim();

  if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(ruc)) {
    return false;
  }

  const sum = RUC_WEIGHTS.reduce(
    (total, weight, index) =>
      total + Number(ruc.charAt(index)) * weight,
    0,
  );

  let checkDigit = 11 - (sum % 11);

  if (checkDigit === 10) {
    checkDigit = 0;
  } else if (checkDigit === 11) {
    checkDigit = 1;
  }

  return checkDigit === Number(ruc.charAt(10));
}

export function sanitizeDocument(
  type: string,
  value: string,
): string {
  const normalizedType = type.trim().toUpperCase();

  if (normalizedType === 'DNI') {
    return value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  }

  if (normalizedType === 'RUC') {
    return value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  }

  return value
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 30);
}

export function sanitizePersonName(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{M} \x27\-]/gu, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s*([-\x27])\s*/g, '$1')
    .replace(/^\s+/, '');
}

export function sanitizePhone(value: string): string {
  const raw = String(value ?? '').trim();
  const hasLeadingPlus = raw.startsWith('+');
  const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 15);

  if (!digits) {
    return '';
  }

  return hasLeadingPlus ? `+${digits}` : digits;
}

export function sanitizeUsername(value: string): string {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]/g, '')
    .replace(/[._-]{2,}/g, '.')
    .replace(/^[._-]+|[._-]+$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 80);
}

export function normalizeText(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

export function normalizeOptionalText(
  value: string,
): string | undefined {
  const normalized = normalizeText(value);
  return normalized || undefined;
}

export function todayLocalIsoDate(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  return isoFromLocalDate(now);
}

export function maxBirthDateIso(
  minimumAge = MINIMUM_ADULT_AGE,
): string {
  return yearsAgoIso(minimumAge);
}

export function minBirthDateIso(
  maximumAge = MAX_REASONABLE_PERSON_AGE,
): string {
  return yearsAgoIso(maximumAge);
}

export function addYearsIsoDate(
  value: string,
  years: number,
): string | null {
  const normalized = String(value ?? '').trim();
  return isValidIsoDate(normalized)
    ? addYearsIso(normalized, years)
    : null;
}

function yearsAgoIso(years: number): string {
  const today = new Date();
  const year = today.getFullYear() - Math.max(0, Math.trunc(years));
  const month = today.getMonth();
  const day = clampDay(year, month, today.getDate());
  return formatIsoDate(year, month + 1, day);
}

function addYearsIso(value: string, years: number): string {
  const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);
  const targetYear = year + Math.trunc(years);
  const targetMonthIndex = month - 1;
  const targetDay = clampDay(targetYear, targetMonthIndex, day);
  return formatIsoDate(targetYear, month, targetDay);
}

function isValidIsoDate(value: string): boolean {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    return false;
  }

  const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);

  if (month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1) {
    return false;
  }

  return day <= clampDay(year, month - 1, 31);
}

function clampDay(year: number, monthIndex: number, day: number): number {
  const lastDay = new Date(year, monthIndex + 1, 0).getDate();
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, day), lastDay);
}

function isoFromLocalDate(value: Date): string {
  return formatIsoDate(
    value.getFullYear(),
    value.getMonth() + 1,
    value.getDate(),
  );
}

function formatIsoDate(year: number, month: number, day: number): string {
  return `${String(year).padStart(4, '0')}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function notFutureDateTimeValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return { invalidDateTime: true };
  }

  return parsed.getTime() <= Date.now()
    ? null
    : { futureDateTime: true };
}

export function notPastDateTimeValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = String(control.value ?? '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return { invalidDateTime: true };
  }

  /*
   * Tolerancia de un minuto para evitar rechazar el mismo valor que el
   * formulario acaba de generar por el tiempo transcurrido hasta el submit.
   */
  return parsed.getTime() >= Date.now() - 60_000
    ? null
    : { pastDateTime: true };
}

export function nonNegativeIntegerValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return null;
  }

  const numberValue = Number(value);

  return Number.isInteger(numberValue) && numberValue >= 0
    ? null
    : { nonNegativeInteger: true };
}

export function positiveIntegerValidator(
  control: AbstractControl,
): ValidationErrors | null {
  const value = control.value;

  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return null;
  }

  const numberValue = Number(value);

  return Number.isInteger(numberValue) && numberValue > 0
    ? null
    : { positiveInteger: true };
}

export function decimalPrecisionValidator(
  integerDigits: number,
  fractionDigits: number,
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = control.value;

    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const raw = String(value).trim();

    if (!/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(raw)) {
      return { decimalPrecision: true };
    }

    const unsigned = raw.replace(/^-/, '');
    const [integerPart, fractionPart = ''] = unsigned.split('.');

    return integerPart.length <= integerDigits
      && fractionPart.length <= fractionDigits
      ? null
      : { decimalPrecision: true };
  };
}

export function numberOrderValidator(
  lowerControlName: string,
  upperControlName: string,
  errorKey = 'numberOrder',
): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const lowerRaw = control.get(lowerControlName)?.value;
    const upperRaw = control.get(upperControlName)?.value;

    if (
      lowerRaw === null
      || lowerRaw === undefined
      || lowerRaw === ''
      || upperRaw === null
      || upperRaw === undefined
      || upperRaw === ''
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    const lower = Number(lowerRaw);
    const upper = Number(upperRaw);

    if (!Number.isFinite(lower) || !Number.isFinite(upper)) {
      return null;
    }

    return lower <= upper
      ? null
      : { [errorKey]: true };
  };
}

export function localDateTimeInputNow(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const offset = now.getTimezoneOffset();
  return new Date(now.getTime() - offset * 60_000)
    .toISOString()
    .slice(0, 16);
}
```

```typescript
import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {
  IdentityResolveRequest,
  IdentityResolveRequestEntidadObjetivoEnum,
  IdentityResolveRequestTipoDocumentoEnum,
} from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/model/identityResolveRequest';
import { ValidacinDeIdentidadService } from '../../infrastructure/openapi/generated/api/validacinDeIdentidad.service';

export type IdentityTarget = 'PERSONA' | 'EMPRESA';
export type IdentityDocumentType = 'DNI' | 'RUC';
export type IdentityOrigin = 'LOCAL' | 'MANUAL' | string;

export interface IdentityResolution {
  origin: IdentityOrigin;
  found: boolean;
  insertedAutomatically: boolean;
  manualEntryAllowed: boolean;
  target: IdentityTarget;
  entityId: number | null;
  personType: string | null;
  documentType: string | null;
  documentNumber: string | null;
  names: string | null;
  paternalSurname: string | null;
  maternalSurname: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  businessName: string | null;
  birthDate: string | null;
  sex: string | null;
  locationId: number | null;
  departmentCode: string | null;
  departmentName: string | null;
  provinceCode: string | null;
  provinceName: string | null;
  districtCode: string | null;
  districtName: string | null;
  populationCenterId: number | null;
  populationCenterName: string | null;
  locationReference: string | null;
  entityActive: boolean | null;
  isEmployee: boolean;
  isPartner: boolean;
  isAssociation: boolean;
  queryStatus: string | null;
  suggestedFiscalAddress: string | null;
  retryFromUtc: string | null;
  message: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class IdentityResolverService {
  private readonly api = inject(ValidacinDeIdentidadService);

  resolve(
    target: IdentityTarget,
    documentType: IdentityDocumentType,
    documentNumber: string,
  ): Observable<IdentityResolution> {
    const request: IdentityResolveRequest = {
      entidadObjetivo:
        target === 'EMPRESA'
          ? IdentityResolveRequestEntidadObjetivoEnum.Empresa
          : IdentityResolveRequestEntidadObjetivoEnum.Persona,
      tipoDocumento:
        documentType === 'RUC'
          ? IdentityResolveRequestTipoDocumentoEnum.Ruc
          : IdentityResolveRequestTipoDocumentoEnum.Dni,
      numeroDocumento: documentNumber.trim(),
    };

    return this.api
      .identidadResolverDocumento(
        { identityResolveRequest: request },
        'body',
        false,
        { transferCache: false },
      )
      .pipe(
        map((response) => {
          const data = this.record(response.datos);

          if (!data) {
            throw new Error(
              'No fue posible obtener la información del documento.',
            );
          }

          return {
            origin: this.string(data['origen']) ?? 'MANUAL',
            found: this.boolean(data['encontrado']),
            insertedAutomatically: this.boolean(
              data['insertadoAutomaticamente'],
            ),
            manualEntryAllowed: this.boolean(
              data['permiteCargaManual'],
            ),
            target:
              this.string(data['entidadObjetivo']) === 'EMPRESA'
                ? 'EMPRESA'
                : 'PERSONA',
            entityId: this.number(data['entidadId']),
            personType: this.string(data['tipoPersona']),
            documentType: this.string(data['tipoDocumento']),
            documentNumber: this.string(data['numeroDocumento']),
            names: this.string(data['nombres']),
            paternalSurname: this.string(
              data['apellidoPaterno'],
            ),
            maternalSurname: this.string(
              data['apellidoMaterno'],
            ),
            phone: this.string(data['telefono']),
            email: this.string(data['correo']),
            businessName: this.string(data['razonSocial']),
            birthDate: this.string(data['fechaNacimiento']),
            sex: this.string(data['sexo']),
            locationId: this.number(data['ubicacionId']),
            departmentCode: this.string(
              data['departamentoCodigo'],
            ),
            departmentName: this.string(
              data['departamentoNombre'],
            ),
            provinceCode: this.string(
              data['provinciaCodigo'],
            ),
            provinceName: this.string(
              data['provinciaNombre'],
            ),
            districtCode: this.string(data['distritoCodigo']),
            districtName: this.string(data['distritoNombre']),
            populationCenterId: this.number(
              data['centroPobladoId'],
            ),
            populationCenterName: this.string(
              data['centroPobladoNombre'],
            ),
            locationReference: this.string(
              data['referenciaUbicacion'],
            ),
            entityActive: this.nullableBoolean(
              data['estadoEntidad'],
            ),
            isEmployee: this.boolean(data['esEmpleado']),
            isPartner: this.boolean(data['esSocio']),
            isAssociation: this.boolean(data['esAsociacion']),
            queryStatus: this.string(data['estadoConsulta']),
            suggestedFiscalAddress: this.string(
              data['direccionFiscalSugerida'],
            ),
            retryFromUtc: this.string(data['reintentoDesdeUtc']),
            message:
              response.mensaje ||
              'La información del documento fue procesada.',
          } satisfies IdentityResolution;
        }),
      );
  }

  private record(
    value: unknown,
  ): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
      : null;
  }

  private string(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()
      ? value.trim()
      : null;
  }

  private number(value: unknown): number | null {
    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)
      ? value
      : null;
  }

  private boolean(value: unknown): boolean {
    return value === true;
  }

  private nullableBoolean(value: unknown): boolean | null {
    return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  DestroyRef,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { Router, RouterLink, NavigationEnd } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faChevronRight,
  faHouse,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { filter, startWith } from 'rxjs';

import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../../core/navigation/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from '../../../core/navigation/navigation-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-breadcrumb',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './breadcrumb.html',
  styleUrl: './breadcrumb.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class BreadcrumbComponent {
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly breadcrumbService = inject(BreadcrumbService);
  private readonly destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  readonly items = signal<readonly BreadcrumbItem[]>([]);
  readonly homeIcon = faHouse;
  readonly separatorIcon = faChevronRight;

  constructor() {
    this.router.events
      .pipe(
        filter((event) => event instanceof NavigationEnd),
        startWith(null),
        takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef),
      )
      .subscribe(() => {
        this.items.set(
          this.breadcrumbService.build(this.router.routerState.snapshot.root),
        );
      });
  }
}
```

- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\src\app\shared\layout\sidebar\sidebar-item.ts`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/src/app/shared/layout/sidebar/sidebar-item.ts`

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core';
import {
  faBoxesStacked,
  faBuilding,
  faChevronDown,
  faCircle,
  faClipboardList,
  faCoins,
  faFileShield,
  faFolderOpen,
  faGaugeHigh,
  faLeaf,
  faLocationDot,
  faMoneyBillTransfer,
  faRoute,
  faSeedling,
  faShop,
  faTruck,
  faUserGroup,
  faUsersGear,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { NavigationItem } from '../../../core/navigation/navigation-item.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sidebar-item',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, RouterLinkActive, FaIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './sidebar-item.html',
  styleUrl: './sidebar-item.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SidebarItemComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) item!: NavigationItem;
  @Input() collapsed = false;

  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() requestExpand = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly expanded = signal(false);
  readonly chevronIcon = faChevronDown;
  readonly childIcon = faCircle;

  toggleGroup(): void {
    if (this.item.children.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.collapsed) {
      this.requestExpand.emit();
      this.expanded.set(true);
      return;
    }

    this.expanded.update((value) => !value);
  }

  iconFor(item: NavigationItem): IconDefinition {
    const code = item.code.toUpperCase();

    if (code === 'INICIO') {
      return faGaugeHigh;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_TECNICA')) {
      return faSeedling;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_COMERCIAL')) {
      return faShop;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_FINANZAS')) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_RECURSOS')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_ADMIN')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (code.includes('GRP_REPORTE')) {
      return faFileShield;
    }

    if (code.includes('TIPO') && code.includes('BIEN')) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('PRODUCTOR') || code.includes('SOCIO') || code.includes('PARTICIPANTE')) {
      return faUserGroup;
    }

    if (code.includes('PREDIO')) {
      return faLocationDot;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('CULTIVO') ||
      code.includes('PRODUCCION') ||
      code.includes('SANIDAD')
    ) {
      return code.includes('SANIDAD') ? faLeaf : faSeedling;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('SALIDA') ||
      code.includes('VISITA') ||
      code.includes('OPERATIVO')
    ) {
      return faRoute;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('JABA') ||
      code.includes('INVENTARIO') ||
      code.includes('RECURSO')
    ) {
      return faBoxesStacked;
    }

    if (code.includes('ENTREGA')) {
      return faTruck;
    }

    if (
      code.includes('PAGO') ||
      code.includes('COBRO') ||
      code.includes('LIQUID')
    ) {
      return faMoneyBillTransfer;
    }

    if (code.includes('GASTO') || code.includes('AJUSTE')) {
      return faCoins;
    }

    if (code.includes('USUARIO') || code.includes('ROL')) {
      return faUsersGear;
    }

    if (code.includes('ORGANIZ')) {
      return faBuilding;
    }

    if (code.includes('REPORTE') || code.includes('AUDITOR')) {
      return faFileShield;
    }

    if (code.includes('CAMPANIA') || code.includes('PRECIO')) {
      return faShop;
    }

    if (code.includes('CENSO') || code.includes('EVALUACION')) {
      return faClipboardList;
    }

    return faFolderOpen;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
  computed,
  inject,
  signal,
} from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faArrowRightFromBracket,
  faChevronLeft,
  faChevronRight,
  faSeedling,
  faXmark,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../core/access/access.store';
import { NavigationService } from '../../../core/navigation/navigation.service';
import { CerrarSesionUseCase } from '../../../features/acceso/application/use-case/cerrar-sesion.use-case';
import { UotContextSwitcherComponent } from '../../../features/uot/adapter/in/ui/components/uot-context-switcher/uot-context-switcher';
import { AppAlertService } from '../../feedback/app-alert/app-alert.service';
import { SidebarItemComponent } from './sidebar-item';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sidebar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    FaIconComponent,
    SidebarItemComponent,
    UotContextSwitcherComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './sidebar.html',
  styleUrl: './sidebar.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class SidebarComponent {
  private readonly navigation = inject(NavigationService);
  private readonly access = inject(AccessStore);
  private readonly logoutUseCase = inject(CerrarSesionUseCase);
  private readonly alert = inject(AppAlertService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  @Input() mobileOpen = false;
  @Input() collapsed = false;

  @Output() mobileOpenChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Output() collapsedChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  readonly items = this.navigation.items;
  readonly loggingOut = signal(false);

  readonly logoIcon = faSeedling;
  readonly closeIcon = faXmark;
  readonly collapseIcon = faChevronLeft;
  readonly expandIcon = faChevronRight;
  readonly logoutIcon = faArrowRightFromBracket;

  readonly primaryRole = computed(
    () => this.access.roles()[0]?.nombre ?? 'Usuario autorizado',
  );

  closeMobile(): void {
    this.mobileOpenChange.emit(false);
  }

  toggleCollapsed(): void {
    this.collapsedChange.emit(!this.collapsed);
  }

  expandSidebar(): void {
    if (this.collapsed) {
      this.collapsedChange.emit(false);
    }
  }

  async logout(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.loggingOut()) return;

    const result = await this.alert.question(
      'Cerrar sesión',
      '¿Deseas finalizar la sesión actual?',
      'Cerrar sesión',
      'Cancelar',
    );

    if (!result.confirmed) return;

    this.loggingOut.set(true);
    this.closeMobile();

    this.logoutUseCase
      .execute()
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loggingOut.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => void this.router.navigate(['/login']),
        error: () => void this.router.navigate(['/login']),
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  Output,
  computed,
  inject,
} from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FaIconComponent } from '@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome';
import {
  faBars,
  faChevronDown,
  faCircleUser,
  faClockRotateLeft,
  faDisplay,
  faMoon,
  faShieldHalved,
  faSun,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';

import { AccessStore } from '../../../core/access/access.store';
import { ThemeService } from '../../../core/ui/theme.service';
import { UotContextSwitcherComponent } from '../../../features/uot/adapter/in/ui/components/uot-context-switcher/uot-context-switcher';
import { BreadcrumbComponent } from '../breadcrumb/breadcrumb';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-topbar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterLink,
    FaIconComponent,
    BreadcrumbComponent,
    UotContextSwitcherComponent,
  ],
  templateUrl: './topbar.html',
  styleUrl: './topbar.css',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class TopbarComponent {
  private readonly accessStore = inject(AccessStore);
  readonly theme = inject(ThemeService);

  @Output() menuToggle = new EventEmitter<void>();

  readonly menuIcon = faBars;
  readonly userIcon = faCircleUser;
  readonly sessionsIcon = faClockRotateLeft;
  readonly devicesIcon = faDisplay;
  readonly securityIcon = faShieldHalved;
  readonly chevronIcon = faChevronDown;
  readonly lightIcon = faSun;
  readonly darkIcon = faMoon;
  readonly user = this.accessStore.user;

  readonly displayName = computed(
    () =>
      this.user()?.nombreCompleto ||
      this.user()?.nombreUsuario ||
      'Usuario DESCO',
  );

  readonly initials = computed(() =>
    this.displayName()
      .trim()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
      .join(''),
  );
}
```

```typescript
  readonly spinnerIcon = faSpinner;

  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, computed, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { Sort } from '../models/sort.model';
import {
  ListQueryState,
  createDefaultListQueryState,
} from './list-query-state.model';

@Injectable()
export class ListQueryStateService<TFilters extends Record<string, unknown>> {
  private initialFilters = {} as TFilters;
  private initialSize = 20;

  private readonly stateSignal = signal<ListQueryState<TFilters>>(
    createDefaultListQueryState(this.initialFilters, this.initialSize),
  );

  readonly state = this.stateSignal.asReadonly();
  readonly page = computed(() => this.stateSignal().page);
  readonly size = computed(() => this.stateSignal().size);
  readonly filters = computed(() => this.stateSignal().filters);
  readonly sort = computed(() => this.stateSignal().sort);

  initialize(filters: TFilters, size = 20): void {
    this.initialFilters = { ...filters };
    this.initialSize = size;
    this.stateSignal.set(
      createDefaultListQueryState({ ...filters }, size),
    );
  }

  setFilters(filters: TFilters): void {
    this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page: 1,
      filters: { ...filters },
    }));
  }

  patchFilters(filters: Partial<TFilters>): void {
    this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page: 1,
      filters: {
        ...current.filters,
        ...filters,
      },
    }));
  }

  setPage(page: number): void {
    this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page: Math.max(1, page),
    }));
  }

  setSize(size: number): void {
    this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page: 1,
      size: Math.max(1, size),
    }));
  }

  setSort(sort: Sort | null): void {
    this.stateSignal.update((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page: 1,
      sort,
    }));
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.stateSignal.set(
      createDefaultListQueryState(
        { ...this.initialFilters },
        this.initialSize,
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**

  express.static(browserDistFolder, {
    maxAge: '1y',
    index: false,
    redirect: false,
  }),
);

/**
 * Handle all other requests by rendering the Angular application.
 */
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  angularApp
    .handle(req)
    .then((response) =>
      response ? writeResponseToNodeResponse(response, res) : next(),
    )
    .catch(next);
});

/**
 * Start the server if this module is the main entry point, or it is ran via PM2.
 * The server listens on the port defined by the `PORT` environment variable, or defaults to 4000.
 */
if (isMainModule(import.meta.url) || process.env['pm_id']) {
  const port = process.env['PORT'] || 4000;
  app.listen(port, (error) => {
    if (error) {
      throw error;
    }

    console.log(`Node Express server listening on http://localhost:${port}`);
  });
}

/**
 * Request handler used by the Angular CLI (for dev-server and during build) or Firebase Cloud Functions.
 */
export const reqHandler = createNodeRequestHandler(app);
```
