```css
  line-height: 1.45;
}



/* Apertura y cierre controlados: evita que el contenido cambie durante
   la salida y elimina el flash del modal al destruir su estado. */
.desco-modal[open]::backdrop {
  animation: desco-modal-backdrop-in 160ms ease-out both;
}

.desco-modal[open] > .modal-box {
  animation: desco-modal-panel-in 160ms ease-out both;
}

.desco-modal.desco-modal--closing::backdrop {
  animation: desco-modal-backdrop-out 150ms ease-in both;
}

.desco-modal.desco-modal--closing > .modal-box {
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: desco-modal-panel-out 150ms ease-in both;
}

@keyframes desco-modal-panel-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.6rem) scale(0.985);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-panel-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.35rem) scale(0.992);
  }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-backdrop-in {
  from { background: transparent; }
  to { background: var(--desco-overlay); }
}

@keyframes desco-modal-backdrop-out {
  from { background: var(--desco-overlay); }
  to { background: transparent; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .desco-modal[open]::backdrop,
  .desco-modal[open] > .modal-box,
  .desco-modal.desco-modal--closing::backdrop,
  .desco-modal.desco-modal--closing > .modal-box {
    animation-duration: 0ms !important;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — TABLAS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
}

.admin-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 48rem;
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
}

.admin-table th {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.025em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-table th.text-center,
.admin-table td.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table th.text-right,
.admin-table td.text-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.admin-table td {
  height: 3.65rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.85rem;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table td > .admin-entity,
.admin-table td > .admin-stack-copy,
.admin-table td > .admin-row-actions,
.admin-table td > .admin-status,
.admin-table td > .admin-code,
.admin-table td > .admin-count-badge,
.admin-table td > .admin-muted-badge {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-table .admin-row-actions {
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.admin-table tbody tr {
  transition: background 120ms ease;
}

.admin-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
}


.admin-table-primary {
  color: var(--desco-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-table-muted {
  color: var(--desco-text-muted);
}

.admin-table-empty {
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — ENTIDADES Y COPIA
   ============================================================ */

.admin-entity {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 12rem;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 0.72rem;
}

.admin-entity > div,
.admin-stack-copy {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-self: center;
}

.admin-entity > div > strong,
.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy strong,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-entity strong,
.admin-stack-copy strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text-soft);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > div > span,
.admin-stack-copy span {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0.08rem 0 0;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 0.95rem;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon,
.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-entity-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  min-width: 2.25rem;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  flex: 0 0 2.25rem;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-avatar {
  background: #1d4ed8;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  place-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
}

.admin-entity-icon > fa-icon,
.admin-avatar {
  margin: 0;
}

.admin-code {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge,
.admin-muted-badge,
.admin-count-badge,
.admin-usage-badge,
.admin-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.6rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.52rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-type-badge {
  background: #eef2ff;
  color: #4338ca;
}

.admin-muted-badge {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-count-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-usage-badge {
  min-width: 1.75rem;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-usage-badge--used {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #c2410c;
}

.admin-status {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

.admin-status--active {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
}

.admin-status--inactive {
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-status--info {
  background: var(--desco-primary-soft);
  color: var(--desco-primary-text);
}

.admin-status--warning {
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #b45309;
}

.admin-status--neutral {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #64748b;
}

 .admin-managed-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0 0.65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-field-hint {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: #7b8ba1;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — DETALLE
   ============================================================ */

.admin-detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.admin-detail-card {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: var(--desco-surface);
  padding: 0.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.03);
}

.admin-detail-card span,
.admin-detail-card strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-detail-card span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-detail-card strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.22rem;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-info-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
}

.admin-info-list > div {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.admin-info-list > div:nth-child(-n + 2) {
  border-top: 0;
}

.admin-info-list span,
.admin-info-list strong {
  display: block;
}

.admin-info-list span {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.admin-info-list strong {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.18rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.admin-chip-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.admin-chip-list article {
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 0.78rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
}

.admin-chip-list strong,
.admin-chip-list span {
  display: block;
}

.admin-chip-list strong {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.admin-chip-list span {
  margin-top: 0.12rem;
  color: #60a5fa;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.admin-empty-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — AVISOS
   ============================================================ */

.admin-notice {
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  background: #eff6ff;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  color: #1e40af;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.admin-notice--warning {
  border-color: #fde68a;
  background: var(--desco-warning-soft);
  color: #92400e;
}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .admin-toolbar,
  .admin-toolbar--end {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-field {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: none;
  }

  .admin-toolbar-actions {
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .admin-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-field-span-2 {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .admin-option-grid,
  .admin-info-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-info-list > div:nth-child(2) {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--desco-border-subtle);
  }

  .admin-modal-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
  }

  .admin-modal-actions > button,
  .admin-modal-actions > a {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .admin-detail-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .admin-row-actions {
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .admin-icon-button {
    width: 2.1rem;
    height: 2.1rem;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ADMINISTRACIÓN — CENTRADO NORMALIZADO DE IDENTIFICADORES
   ============================================================ */

.admin-table .admin-entity {
  align-items: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar,
.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon {
  display: grid;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: start;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-avatar {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.admin-table .admin-entity > .admin-entity-icon fa-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* GESTION TECNICA - NORMALIZACION TRANSVERSAL */
.technical-toolbar{align-items:flex-end}.technical-search-form{display:flex;min-width:min(100%,28rem);flex:1 1 28rem;align-items:flex-end;gap:.5rem}.technical-search-form .admin-input{min-width:12rem;flex:1 1 18rem}.technical-filter-switch{min-width:11.5rem;flex:0 1 14rem;padding:.62rem .72rem}.technical-filter-switch strong{font-size:.7rem}.technical-filter-switch span{margin-top:.08rem;font-size:.6rem}.technical-table-copy{display:grid;min-width:0;gap:.12rem}.technical-table-copy>strong,.technical-table-copy>span{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.technical-table-copy>strong{color:#0f172a;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800}.technical-table-copy>span{color:#64748b;font-size:.64rem;font-weight:600}.technical-loading-button{min-width:6.5rem}.admin-icon-button--success{border-color:#bbf7d0;background:#f0fdf4;color:#15803d}.admin-icon-button--success:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#86efac;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}.technical-modal-context{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.55rem;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:.85rem;background:#f8fafc;padding:.7rem}.technical-modal-context span,.technical-modal-context strong{display:block}.technical-modal-context span{color:#94a3b8;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.035em}.technical-modal-context strong{margin-top:.16rem;overflow:hidden;color:#334155;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:760px){.technical-search-form{flex-wrap:wrap}.technical-search-form .admin-input{flex-basis:100%}.technical-filter-switch{flex-basis:100%}.technical-modal-context{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
```

```css
/* Switch administrativo en modo oscuro.
   OFF = track neutro oscuro y thumb claro a la izquierda.
   ON  = el mismo azul sólido del modo claro y thumb blanco a la derecha.

   Importante: algunos estilos base de checkbox usan currentColor para el
   fondo de :checked. Por eso el color del propio control también se fija
   al token del switch; así ningún estilo global puede volver el track blanco. */
:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) .admin-switch-control:not(:checked) {
  color: var(--desco-switch-off-bg) !important;
  border-color: var(--desco-switch-off-border) !important;

  background-image: none !important;
}

  background: #f8fafc !important;
}

:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) .admin-switch-control:checked {
  color: var(--desco-switch-on-bg) !important;
  border-color: var(--desco-switch-on-border) !important;
  background: var(--desco-switch-on-bg) !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) .admin-switch-control:checked::after {
  background: #ffffff !important;
}

:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) input[type='checkbox']:not(.admin-switch-control),
:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) input[type='radio'] {
  accent-color: var(--desco-primary);
}


:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) .admin-modal-title-group p {
  color: var(--desco-primary-text) !important;
}

:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) .admin-modal-title-group h2 {
  color: var(--desco-text) !important;
}
/* Los switches deshabilitados conservan contraste sin perder su estado visual. */
:is(html[data-theme='dark'], html.dark) .admin-switch-control:disabled {
  opacity: 1 !important;
}
```

```css
html,
body {
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--desco-text);
  background: var(--desco-page-bg);
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--desco-primary);
  color: var(--desco-on-primary);
}

/* El tema se aplica de forma atómica. Durante el commit se desactivan
   transiciones locales para que ningún componente quede a medio recolorear. */
html.desco-theme-commit,
html.desco-theme-commit body,
html.desco-theme-commit body *,
html.desco-theme-commit body *::before,
html.desco-theme-commit body *::after {
  transition: none !important;
}

/* View Transitions: el navegador captura el estado anterior y el nuevo,
   y hace un único fundido de la aplicación completa. */
::view-transition-old(root),
::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: 280ms;
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

::view-transition-old(root) {
  animation-name: desco-theme-old;
}

::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-name: desco-theme-new;
}

@keyframes desco-theme-old {
  from { opacity: 1; }
  to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes desco-theme-new {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

/* Fallback para navegadores sin View Transitions. El overlay cubre el único
   frame en que se sustituyen los tokens y luego desaparece suavemente. */
.desco-theme-switch-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2147483647;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 110ms ease;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--light {
  background: #f8fafc;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--dark {
  background: #000000;
}

.desco-theme-switch-overlay--visible {
  opacity: 0.96;
}
```

### 2140. `tools/openapi/generate-api.mjs`

- Ruta: `tools/openapi/generate-api.mjs`
- Ruta absoluta: `D:\FrancoSystem\desco_frontend\tools\openapi\generate-api.mjs`
- URL: `file:///D:/FrancoSystem/desco_frontend/tools/openapi/generate-api.mjs`

```javascript
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

const projectRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..', '..');

const configPath = resolve(
  projectRoot,
  'tools',
  'openapi',
  'openapi-generator-config.json',
);

const outputPath = resolve(
  projectRoot,
  'src',
  'app',
  'infrastructure',
  'openapi',
  'generated',
);

const cliPath = resolve(
  projectRoot,
  'node_modules',
  '@openapitools',
  'openapi-generator-cli',
  'main.js',
);

if (!existsSync(cliPath)) {
  throw new Error(
    [
      'No se encontró @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli.',
      '',
      'Ejecuta primero:',
      'npm install',
    ].join('\n'),
  );
}

if (existsSync(outputPath)) {
  rmSync(outputPath, {
    recursive: true,
    force: true,
  });
}

console.log('==============================================');
console.log(' DESCO - GENERACIÓN CLIENTE OPENAPI');
console.log('==============================================');
console.log(`Configuración : ${configPath}`);
console.log(`Salida        : ${outputPath}`);
console.log('');

try {
  execFileSync(
    process.execPath,
    [
      cliPath,
      'generate',
      '--config',
      configPath,
    ],
    {
      cwd: projectRoot,
      stdio: 'inherit',
      windowsHide: false,
    },
  );
} catch (error) {
  console.error('');
  console.error('No se pudo generar el cliente OpenAPI.');

  if (error instanceof Error) {
    console.error(error.message);
  }

  process.exit(1);
}

if (!existsSync(outputPath)) {
  throw new Error(
    `OpenAPI Generator terminó, pero no se creó la carpeta esperada: ${outputPath}`,
  );
}

/*
 * Compatibilidad OpenAPI Generator:
 * Springdoc puede describir ApiResponse<Void> / ApiResponse<?> con un esquema
 * JSON null. Algunas versiones de typescript-angular generan imports a
 * "./null" pero omiten el archivo correspondiente. Se materializa el alias
 * únicamente cuando el generador no lo creó por sí mismo.
 */
const modelPath = resolve(outputPath, 'model');
const nullModelPath = resolve(modelPath, 'null.ts');

if (!existsSync(modelPath)) {
  mkdirSync(modelPath, { recursive: true });
}

if (!existsSync(nullModelPath)) {
  writeFileSync(
    nullModelPath,
    [
      '/**',
      ' * Compatibilidad para esquemas OpenAPI cuyo valor es JSON null.',
      ' * Archivo materializado automáticamente por tools/openapi/generate-api.mjs.',
      ' */',
      'export type Null = null;',
      '',
    ].join('\n'),
    'utf8',
  );

  console.log(`Compatibilidad Null: ${nullModelPath}`);
}

console.log('');
console.log('==============================================');
console.log(' OPENAPI GENERADO CORRECTAMENTE');
console.log('==============================================');
console.log(outputPath);
```
